Headline_English: Claim of 3,600 murders in 14 months due to internal strife in Jamaat
Content_English: Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami's internal conflict has resulted in 3,600 murders across the country in the last 14 months. Even though they want to file a case in the aforementioned murders, the police are not taking any cases.

Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death on November 17 after finding her guilty in a case of crimes against humanity committed during the July Movement. Asaduzzaman, demanding that “there is no point in apologizing” and “Hasina’s death sentence be quashed.” In the video, Attorney General Md. Headline_English: Three Bollywood Khans donate money to Babri Masjid
Content_English: Bollywood stars Shah Rukh Khan, Salman Khan and Aamir Khan are donating large sums of money to the initiative to rebuild the Babri Masjid in Murshidabad, India.

Headline_English: Babri Mosque is being built in Bangladesh
Content_English: The Babri Mosque in Ayodhya, which is associated with the memory of Mughal Emperor Babur, was demolished on December 6, 1992, at the initiative of leaders and activists of some Hindutva organizations including the Vishwa Hindu Parishad. Some initiatives can be seen in different parts of the world to preserve the memory of that mosque. The Indian government had allocated 5 acres of land for the construction of the 'Ayodhya Mosque', 22 kilometers away from the demolished original mosque. However, due to some complications including the design of the mosque, work has not started yet. An initiative was taken to build a new mosque in the style of the Babri Mosque and with the same name in Kalatia, Mohammadpur under Keraniganj police station of Dhaka. Babri Mosque is being built in Bangladesh

Headline_English: Islamic Movement asks Jamaat for 200 seats! Jamaat says, if you get it from anyone, give us 100 too
Content_English:
Bargaining in politics is nothing new, but recently, a news has been doing the rounds that the Islamic Movement Bangladesh (IAB) is demanding 200 seats from Jamaat-e-Islami in the upcoming elections. The matter has created a lot of laughter in the country's political circles. It is learnt from unreliable (but undisclosed) sources that upon hearing this demand, the Jamaat Ameer immediately sat down in a whisper meeting and made an unimaginable counter-proposal. After this sky-high demand, a special message was sent from the Jamaat headquarters. In that message, the Jamaat Ameer thanked the IAB and politely said, "Thank you for your generosity. But you should know that we are also in a state of need to bring salt. If we really had the capacity to give 200 seats to someone, we would have formed the government after August 5th! Now our request is, if you can get 300 seats from somewhere, please give us the opportunity to hold elections with at least 100 seats from there." We also want to fly in the sky! 
A political analyst, who did not want to be named, joked about this incident, saying, "It's like a rickshaw puller telling another rickshaw puller, 'Listen brother, I will be friends with you only if you give me 200 bighas of land.'" Political observers believe that this demand of the Islamic Movement was basically a kick-off for negotiations, where they might want to get 1-2 seats. On the other hand, Jamaat's counter-response proves that they are quite aware of their current real situation.

Headline_English: DUCSU leaders became nostalgic after listening to Jamaat leader Shahjahan Chowdhury's speech
Content_English:
Recently, Jamaat leader Shahjahan Chowdhury is being criticized for several of his statements in a meeting. There, he said, the election is not only about the people... we have to bring all those who are in the administration in their constituency under our control. They will rise up to our words, sit on our words, arrest us on our words, file cases on our words. After hearing this statement, while others commented negatively on the matter, DUCSU leaders have become quite nostalgic about the matter. When asked what the reason for their nostalgia is, they became even more emotional. Some of them even started laughing when they heard the administration being 'brought under'. However, some of the DUCSU leaders got quite angry when asked the reason, one of them said to our reporter, 'Fascist's friend! Foreign nut seller! Who is asking you to enter the campus?' 

Many ignorant people have also called this Jamaat leader's statement a demo version of the new democracy. On the other hand, it has been heard that some of the fugitive Awami League members are feeling quite nostalgic about this leader's statement, because this is the first time anyone has made such a statement since the Awami League.

Headline_English: Awami League is changing its name, the new name is Bangladesh Online League
Content_English: Tired and frustrated by living an online-dependent life for the past few days, the Awami League has finally been forced to admit its reality. Even though no one cares on the field, the party's activities in these areas - status, live, reactions on Facebook - have been flourishing day by day, and finally the party's announcement came: the new name of the party will be Bangladesh Online League (BAL). The president of the party's fugitive branch said in an exclusive video message from a mysterious hole in India, since we are doing all the work online - starting from the shutdown announcement to the lockdown declaration, the name of the party also needs to be online-friendly. From now on, we will do status-based politics. The thought of going on the field is out. The game will be online, come and play. However, the mother of humanity, Sheikh Hasina, is a little angry at the announcement of the party's name change. Addressing the leaders and activists of her party, she said, "I am in this situation today because of the children of Razakars like you. If I could kill people properly in reality instead of online, I would not have to live in the next room today."

Headline_English: Girls demand money from Jamaat Ameer, not respect
Content_English:
Jamaat Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman said that they will reduce women's working hours to 5 hours so that women can handle housework and child-rearing. He also said that if women do housework instead of going to the workplace, the government will honor them. But the women's society disagreed with Ameer Saheb's statement. One woman said from her fake ID, "I want money, not respect." Explaining the matter further, another woman told eRK from her fake ID, "We have done a lot of calculations and see that respect cannot buy anything. You cannot even fulfill your hobbies with respect. I do all the housework. My husband respects me. But at the end of the day, the house is in his name. His money is in the bank balance! My bank balance is zero. I wanted to go to Nepal to relax a little, but when I went, I found that plane tickets could not be purchased with respect. I could not even purchase a bus ticket to Sajek with respect. Will those who have no father, whose husband is sick or has logged out of the world, now live on respect? 
Another woman said, we understand these respect-taunts. Earlier, fathers and brothers have killed their wealth by giving respect. They have killed the money they have saved. The husband has killed the provident fund of a lifetime. These hunks and pankis will not work. You keep your respect, explain to us your rights. Isn't respect a good thing? To our question, this woman leader said, respect is a good thing, but it is not as good as money. If I had money, I would buy some respect from the supermarket. You cannot get money with respect, but you can get respect with money. 

Another woman said, addressing the Ameer of Jamaat, I will give you lakhs of respect, for now leave politics and focus on household chores.

Headline_English: Awami League suddenly strengthened, leaders and activists said it feels good to be able to kill people again
Content_English: The fugitive Awami League leaders and workers have suddenly become quite energetic. When we tried to find out the reason for this excitement among them, the party leaders and workers said that they had been unemployed for so long, and after a long time, they felt very happy to be able to kill people by setting fire to cars or bombing them. When we asked a very happy leader with a shiny face about this, he popped out of his hole and said, "My days are not in my golden cage, how long have you been gone, no more arrogance of power. I cannot oppress and torture people. My hand was getting rusty and my talent was getting rusty, I thought I might never get the time again, but I got that desired opportunity again. Even if I can't do it openly, I can kill people secretly again, I feel quite peaceful. I killed them in that last July. Please pray for us so that I can burn at least a thousand people to death, otherwise I won't be able to die in peace." Another fugitive leader in Kolkata said, "Oh, how good it feels." In excitement, I want to set fire to a few cars here and kill people. I want to say to you, who are continuing this work from the pits of the country, I am proud of you. It is learnt that American citizen Lalpani Joy has organized a Lalpani party in Delhi to wish for the success of this arson attack.

Headline_English: Where is my credit! I don't accept this agreement: Donald Trump on the peace agreement between Dhaka College and Ideal College.
Content_English:
US President Donald Trump has directly rejected and denied the peace agreement between Dhaka College and Ideal College. He burst into tears on his Not Only Truth But Also Unsocial account. Yet this country called Bangladesh did not pay any attention to me! I do not accept this agreement! Food delivery. If I were him, I would have arranged to bring them to the top! This is not a peace agreement! This is a Chudling Pong agreement!"

If you had told me earlier, I would have sent 10 truckloads of beer bottles!" Headline_English: Nobel Committee announces that Peace Prize will be awarded jointly to Dhaka and Ideal College
Content_English: Dhaka and Ideal College have finally raised the flag of peace, ending the long-standing war at the Science Lab intersection. Yesterday afternoon, instead of holding each other's throats, both sides shook hands and signed a 'permanent peace agreement'. According to the agreement, the two sides took an oath not to engage in any kind of squabbles from now on. They also expressed their determination to bring the Science Lab under the shadow of peace by feeding each other sweets and garlanding each other. However, the news of this peace agreement between Dhaka and Ideal College has reached the international community beyond the borders of the country. The Nobel Committee has even announced that the next Peace Prize will be jointly awarded to Dhaka and Ideal College. In a statement, they said that in a world where countries are still fighting over borders, the two colleges have set an example of peace. Bringing the Science Lab intersection under the shadow of peace is like bringing oxygen to Mars. However, critics say that City College was invited during the signing of the agreement, but they did not go there. According to experts, if this peace agreement lasts for at least a month, it will be considered the most sustainable peace initiative in South Asia.

Headline_English: Trump lashed out at the voting, calling it a 'farce election' as it took place in the dark of night (Bangladesh time)!
Content_English:
US President Donald Trump, the youngest mayor since 1912 and the first Muslim mayor in the history of New York, is also suspicious of his victory in his first election with 10,33,975 (50.4%) votes! He said, "This vote was held at night Bangladesh time. We do not accept votes that are held in the dark of night." 
He expressed his anger by mentioning Mamdani's smile and said, "When I smile, the whole of New York appears on my face, but not even a metro rail can be seen on Mamdani's face." During the election campaign, Mamdani promised to suspend rent increases for New Yorkers, provide free public transportation, and provide services for all children. He also proposed imposing additional taxes on the rich. Trump has called on other countries, including the United States, to speak out against such oppression of the rich. Praising Bangladesh highly, he said, "This is the only country where only the rich are given due respect, regardless of party or opinion." Trump has vowed to interfere in Bangladesh's elections after retirement! 
He said that he has full confidence in the local aunties of Bangladesh, even though the Bangladeshi aunties in New York supported Mamdani with their deception.

Headline_English: Mamdani hired the Sarvamitra gang as mayor of New York, the homeless will have to be evicted
Content_English: New York's 111th mayor has been elected as the first African-born Muslim and immigrant of Ugandan and Indian descent, Zoharan Mamdani. Headline_English: We welcome the initiative of the interim, we will cancel the appointment of music teachers in Santiniketan too: Rabindranath Tagore
Content_English: Many are criticizing the interim government for announcing the cancellation of the recruitment of music teachers in primary schools. This rebellious poet has even expressed his determination to give back everything he has earned through music and singing.

Headline_English: New Yorkers want Ishraq as City Daddy, not Mamdani
Content_English: The New York mayoral election campaign is in full swing. The Bengalis there are especially campaigning for Mamdani, but in the midst of all this, something different has come to light. New Yorkers want Ishraq as the Urban Daddy, not Mamdani. Headline_English: Banasree residents say they will vote only for NCP
Content_English:

They are expressing their support for NCP by getting a symbol like the portrait of an iconic intersection in their area. When a local resident of Banasree was contacted to verify the truth of the matter, he said, NCP is a Banasree-oriented party, I never thought that this thing could also be an election symbol, but when it happened, we are happy, we will vote for NCP this time. 
However, when asked why he was so surprised that Shapla Kali was the election symbol, the brother was even more surprised, because he thought that the thing by which they locally know that intersection was given as the NCP symbol. However, when asked what that object was, the brother refused to answer, instead telling our reporter to delete whatever he recorded or there would be problems.

Headline_English: I sent a representative to Iceland. I dream of biting someone like Donald Trump.
Content_English:
Recently, a millennial (2 weeks old) Aedes mosquito has made his debut as a blogger. Headline_English: Sarvamitra is being considered for the lead role in 'Phatakesth 2', shooting will be at DU
Content_English:
DUCSU representative Sarbamitra Chakma has caught the attention of the producers of Phatakest by conducting an eviction drive in DU in a very Phatakest style. Headline_English: Keep going bro, take the stick if you need it: Orthopedic surgeons to Sarvamitra
Content_English: There is a lot of discussion and criticism surrounding the eviction drive by DUCSU from the Dhaka University area. He will break the legs.

Headline_English: Trump wants to run for Republican Party in Bangladesh elections
Content_English: New wind in Bangladeshi politics - US President Donald Trump has expressed interest in participating in this year's elections. The reason? He heard that a party called the Republican Party in the country has received an 'elephant' symbol. As soon as he heard the news, Trump said with excitement, 'This is tremendous! Our party in Bangladesh is already great again!' Trump told reporters outside the White House, "In America, an elephant means Republican, and in Bangladesh it is the same. I think I can hold a victory rally as soon as I land in Dhaka. There is only one thing needed - a 'Big, Beautiful, Wall' must be built in Dhaka as well. This will make voters understand that I am a true leader. He also said, "I have heard that voting in Bangladesh means a festival. I want to bring such a festival to America as well." However, the leaders of the Bangladeshi party are now struggling to explain to Trump that the elephant here actually means a local political symbol, not a branch of the Republican Party. However, Trump commented on this and said, 'No one can stop me, the people are on my side.'

Headline_English: Satyajit is making 'Mahanayak', the sequel to 'Swargaye Nayak', says Mahanayak has been found
Content_English: Satyajit Ray is back in the spotlight after many years. After the success of 'Nayak', he has now embarked on the sequel - 'Mahanayak'. Headline_English: I have brought so much peace, I will also resolve the conflict between NCP and Jamaat: Trump
Content_English: Social media is abuzz with the rift between the NCP and Jamaat. One group gets angry at the sight of the other, and they are doing it to spite each other! Content_English: NCP leader Nahid Islam has posted a huge English status, calling Jamaat-e-Islam's PR-centric campaign a political fraud. Say whatever you want, but it will all be in Urdu." Content_English: In late autumn, the temporarily retired cuckoo society suddenly noticed that someone had started queuing queuing before spring. Meanwhile, until the last news, a politician named Sarjis was seen roaming the streets looking for liver. When asked, he said, I heard that liver is the best medicine for COVID-19! So I am looking for it. If I get some, I will cook Pinakida and eat it.

Headline_English: Pakistan Army thanks Chittagong Jamaat Ameer, tweets 'Big Fan Sir'
Content_English: The world witnessed this historic bridge of ideology directly from Chittagong to Rawalpindi. Recently, in a rally, the Chittagong Jamaat Ameer claimed that the Pakistani army had launched a crackdown on March 25 in response to the massacre of Mujib's army. While there was a storm of criticism across the country for making such a statement while standing on Bangladeshi soil, the Pakistan Army was seen floating in the opposite direction. Immediately after the incident, an emotional tweet was sent from the official Twitter (X) account of the Pakistan Army. It read, Big fan, sir! The tweet was accompanied by a blurry picture with a clapping emoji on a green background, and lightly written below, 1971 was misunderstood. To understand the sentiments of the incident, the soul of the infamous Lieutenant General Niazi of 1971 was brought down on a special planchette. Niazi, overcome with emotion upon hearing the question, said in pure Bengali, "My mind is spinning. Red salute from my elder brother." We ourselves could not have created such a narrative for the Pakistan Army. He also said that Jamaat is like an aunt to us. Because an aunt is more compassionate than a mother. In addition, Niazi's soul also claimed that if the then Pakistan Army had had such local support in 1971, then the international media could have been managed as well. Finally, according to Pakistan Army sources, it is being considered to give the post of Honorary Narrative Contributor (1971 Revision Wing) to the Chittagong Jamaat Ameer.

Headline_English: Chhatra League mourns in Kolkata after India's defeat to Bangladesh
Content_English: Yesterday, the Indian football team lost a heartbreaking match to the Bangladesh football team, and the whole of India has been sad since the loss. There have also been reports of TVs being broken in some places. Indians may be saddened by India's loss, but the interesting thing is that the Chhatra League leaders and activists who are staying there are more saddened than the Indians after India's loss to Bangladesh. Even after India's loss to Bangladesh, the Chhatra League has organized a condolence meeting in Kolkata. A Chhatra League leader with tears in his eyes told us, we and our beloved allies are losing in every field, I thought that today we would celebrate India's victory by drinking red wine and going to the pit, but the children of the Razakars have taken away all the joys of our lives. We don't have the opportunity to hold condolence meetings in the country, everyone trolls. So I thought it would be better to do it in Kolkata. See, no one cares here, we can also mourn in peace. Although the members present at the condolence meeting are wearing black badges, the people of Kolkata are quite confused because the badges have 'India My Beloved' written on them. When a passerby asked, a Chhatra League member replied, "We do Bangladeshi politics, but with Indian drones in our mouths. We always have Bharat Bandhan on our lips, even though Bangladesh is our motherland, India is our fatherland." At the end of the condolence meeting, a minute's silence was observed in memory of the 'bright future' of Indian football. However, the Kolkata Police eventually dispersed the condolence meeting, saying they had never seen a scene before where a political organization from another country was mourning the loss of one country.

Headline_English: Trump is coming to Bangladesh to mediate between Pinaki and Sayer, may win Nobel Peace Prize
Content_English:
Last night, Pinaki got the news of a queuing in Bangladesh while he was asleep. His patriotic nature woke up and he immediately went live on his Facebook page. In this live broadcast late at night, he warned the countrymen and called on them to come out on the streets. He kept requesting them repeatedly to stop the queuing with a joint effort. Meanwhile, his friend Zulkarnain Sayer was watching a movie at that time. As soon as his friend came on live, he saw that Pinaki was calling the countrymen due to his long-standing insomnia and habit of eating this and that before going to sleep. He was terribly annoyed by his friend's actions. Thinking that he was leaving a great movie to watch all this, his mood worsened. He also came on live broadcast and called his friend 'Ghuma Shalarput' with a friendly adjective. After learning about the rift in the relationship between the two friends due to the live broadcast, Trump decided to come to Bangladesh immediately to resolve the problem. He told us in a phone call that night that he is currently working tirelessly to bring peace to the whole world. It cannot happen that Sayer and Pinaki's friendship will break like this while I am alive. I have officially invited them to come to Bangladesh. It is my responsibility to convince them and restore peace. Meanwhile, the Nobel Committee is shocked by Trump's initiative in this incident. When our representative called them, they said that they did not understand that Trump is working so hard to restore peace. Now it seems that we have given the Nobel to the wrong person. It is time to take the Nobel from Machado and give it to Trump. 
However, Elias has called Trump an accomplice of tyranny. Pinaki warned him and said, "Dada, you should not go to Bangladesh at the call of this Trump. If you go, my door will always be closed to you!"

Headline_English: Naughty Kokil files a copyright case against Pinaki
Content_English:
The country is once again in the midst of the ‘cue’ rumor. And following that trend, Pinaki Bhattacharya, sitting in France, has come to Facebook Live like every other time. However, this time Pinaki is in danger, because Dushtu Kokil has filed a copyright case against him. 
The main reason for the case is that Pinaki Bhattacharya is using the word ‘cue’ so much that it now sounds like ‘ku ku ku ku’. Pinaki is repeatedly copying the melody and call of the famous song line from the recently discussed Shakib Khan movie—Dushtu Kokil Dake Re Ku Ku Ku Ku’—in his live. Analyzing the Facebook live clip, experts have said that Pinaki said ‘cue’ at least 47 times in the one-hour live. Lawyers have claimed that saying ‘cue’ so many times means directly stealing the cuckoo’s call pattern. Meanwhile, in response to the Facebook live, Dushtu Kokil said, “Are you going to copy my call? I am a fan of Dipjol. I will definitely make it.” Pinaki, however, said in his defense, I only said 'cue' in a political science discussion, I have no intention of copying the cuckoo's call. I am a naughty Pinaki, why should I be a naughty cuckoo. The country is now divided into two camps over the whole issue: on one side there is the Naughty Cuckoo Supporters Group, on the other side the 'Three inches' Cue Alliance. Both sides are now busy on social media, where one side is saying 'ku ku ku', the other side is saying ku ku ku.

Headline_English: Sarjis Alam opens a liver-slicing shop in Agargaon
Content_English:
A new food fair centered in Agargaon has been launched to give the taste of cake to the mouths of food-loving Bengalis. As the afternoon passed, hundreds of people started meeting. Some came to eat food, some came to serve food. Although initially there was talk of cakes, later pitha, pudding, etc., from today, liver singara is available in Agargaon. It is not just liver singara, but liver singara made by Sarjis Alam. His close associates said that Sarjis got the idea of ​​selling liver singara while on a trip to Panchagarh. When the power goes out during a political trip, there is nothing to do. At such moments, the mic does not work, it feels hot, the crowd of people feels unbearable, at such times, it seems that the current has become too much behind the people in the current, creating such a situation. Many people saw Sarjis shouting Eureka Eureka, thinking about how big the livers of the people in the current could be. Although there are many ways to win people's hearts, everyone knows that food is the first and only ingredient to enter people's hearts. In electoral politics, when people's hearts are not won despite a lot of shouting and shouting, sometimes serving something sweet has a good effect. That is why many times it is seen that there is a frenzy of eating and drinking before voting. Starting from biryani, khichuri to tea and cigarettes, everyone eats whatever they get from the candidates. It is said that Sarjis wants to serve Kolija Singara from this idea. 
Talks have been made with several companies to sell Kolija Singara. Although it is said to be homemade, the livers will be imported, a Michelin chef will be there to make the whole thing, and Sarjis is responsible for tasting the salt and pepper and finalizing it. If everything goes well, this special recipe of Kolija Singara will be available if you go to Agargaon this evening. The eArch team has learned that many people have not eaten since this morning to eat Sarjis' Kolija Singara. Everyone is preparing for the first meal of the day by eating Sarjis's liver singara. Many are also rehearsing who will dance with which coin while eating singara. It is understood that today is a special day for many. Those who cannot go to Agargaon on this special day can order from Foodpanda.

Headline_English: Asif Mahmud hosts duck dinner with friends at Westin to mark Postal Day
Content_English:
Today is World Postal Day! Although this day is celebrated by exchanging letters all over the world, Asif Mahmud, advisor to the interim government, celebrated this day in a slightly different way. It is learned from a completely fake source that he organized a big party to eat pork with friends at the Westin. 
Regarding this event, he said from his fake ID, "I was very happy to hear that today is World Postal Day. I came to know about it in the morning. After that, I went to Nila Market with my friends to eat pork. But since the shops there were closed, I organized it at the Westin. He also said, it is important to take care of your health. That is why these days have to be celebrated. If I don't eat pork at all on Postal Day, what is the point of living this life? We have eaten pork, you too. However, many have criticized Asif Mahmud's actions. As well as criticizing the critics, Asif Mahmud's crazy fans. One such crazy fan said, "Brother, why do you criticize on any day you want? Ask us first, when should we criticize." Then we will let you know. That way, we can criticize according to our convenience! Isn't there a etiquette for criticism? Or do you need to be taught etiquette?

Headline_English: Government wants to appoint Tamim Iqbal as press conference advisor
Content_English:
In the past few years, cricketer Tamim Iqbal has been in the news more for holding press conferences than playing. Tamim regularly holds press conferences on any issue, be it being in the national team or the BCB elections. Even if he is not on the field of play, there is nothing new to say that he is a set batsman in the media field. Impressed by Tamim's regular press conference arrangements, strong performance in front of the microphone, and ability to calmly take singles by defending difficult questions from journalists, the interim government now wants to appoint him as a 'press conference advisor'. The government spokesperson said that Tamim bhai has wasted his time only playing cricket for so long, his real talent is organizing press conferences. We hope that Tamim bhai will respond to our proposal very soon and will get his name in the Guinness Book of World Records for organizing press conferences. 
It is learned that the government wants to give Tamim the responsibility to spread the press conference industry at the national level. There is a plan that at least three press conferences will be held in each ministry per month under Tamim's training. Even a new course called 'Effective Press Conference Management 101 - By Tamim Iqbal' is going to be launched for government officials. Sources close to Tamim say that he is considering the proposal and if he is given the responsibility of BCB President, he will take up the responsibility. The Guinness Book authorities have also already shown interest. They say that if a person does more press conferences than playing cricket, then it is worthy of the record book.

Headline_English: Dead voters want to surround EC, seek Ishraq's help
Content_English: On October 6, the Chief Election Commissioner announced that 2.1 million dead voters had been identified and excluded in the voter list update. He also said that many of them had voted earlier. As soon as this news spread, there was a lot of commotion in the dead community. Many were disappointed, many were sad. We went to Azimpur graveyard late at night to talk to them. A resident of grave number 6 in line 4 of this graveyard told us about his sadness. He said, "I could never vote when I was alive. Whenever I went to the polling station, Polapan would say, 'Uncle, your vote has been cast.' After I died and became a ghost, I regained my right to vote. Special arrangements were made for us to vote in the dark of night. Will you take away that right now because I am no longer alive? On the other hand, when I went to the Banani graveyard, a dead leader said in a rebellious voice, "We will not accept such injustice. Do we have no future because we have become ghosts? Voting is the tradition of the dead. If this tradition is broken, the grave will tremble." He also said, "If necessary, we will surround the EC." We have been voting for so long, will this tradition be lost so easily? We will not tolerate this. They said that they have also contacted Ishraq in this regard. He said, "Gherao means Ishraq. Currently, there is no one more expert than him in terms of gheraoing any place. We have full confidence in him. We went to Jurain Graveyard and asked the resident of Grave No. 2 what he thought. He was very disappointed and said, "I have recently passed away. I thought I would be able to vote at night in this election." I was quite happy about this, but I am quite saddened by this decision of the EC. I want my voting rights back."

Headline_English: Donald Trump builds medal showcase to house Nobel Peace Prize
Content_English:
Former US President Donald Trump has not yet received the Nobel Peace Prize, but he has already made a place to keep it. Recently, a huge glass showcase was installed at his Mar-a-Lago resort, where Trump has placed a golden plate with the words Soon-to-be Nobel Prize for Peace written on it in his own words. Visitors to the resort can now see this glittering medal in Trump's showcase. In response to a question from reporters, Trump said, "Many say I could not bring peace. But I tried to bring peace on Twitter. I ended most of the wars with tweets! How many people in the world have this power now? There is some uncertainty about Trump receiving the Nobel. Trump also spoke about this issue. He said, "Even if it is uncertain, it is not a problem! I know that if the conspiracy wins in the end, I may lose. The Nobel may not come to my house. That is why I have already made a medal from Jackson Heights Nilkhet. By chance, if I do not get the real Nobel. So…’ 
His close aide said that Trump has considered three names for the possible design of the medal, Make Peace Great Again, The Best Peace Ever and Tremendous Nobel. Meanwhile, the Nobel Committee refused to comment, but a Norwegian journalist said, we think he may not yet understand that the prize comes first, the showcase later. Meanwhile, Elon Musk has expressed his opinion on the matter! Advising Trump to sleep peacefully, he said, “Don’t stress, boss! If you don’t get the Nobel this time, I will launch a Nobel Prize myself! After that, all the Nobels are yours! You can order another showcase if you need it.”

Headline_English: An app with a collection of election promises and pledges is coming to the market soon, 'Let's make promises!'
Content_English: The national elections in February are being talked about very strongly. As the number of parties has changed due to the participatory elections after a long time, there will be differences in the announcements or meetings. But the election promises that have been passed down since the dinosaur era will be valid as always this time too. In this change from the era of letters to the era of artificial intelligence, the promises will also have various additions, changes, and enhancements, along with a touch of modernity. Due to this, an app is coming to the market very soon. Here, the election promises that which parties will make can be found in the link or QR code. Not only the promises, but who is giving what warnings will also be mentioned. Although many people expressed joy at the news of this app, a look of sadness can be seen on the faces of some party leaders in the next moment. Although they said that winter is ahead, their faces are sometimes becoming like this in preparation for it. It is heard that some parties have already drafted a few promises for uploading on the app. For example, if you win the election, you will have a certificate in one hand and a job in the other, if you have another hand, you can also arrange for your marriage. If you win the election, everyone will be given a mobile phone, which will play an automatic song when you press the button, the election is coming, the election is coming... If you win the election, you will no longer have to go to the salon to get your hair cut, our volunteer team will reach your home faster than Harpic's advertisement, if you are not at home, they will find you on the street. If you win the election, our team will not give any more warnings. Since promises are made with the intention of breaking them, there will be no word count fence for this. A top official of the app said, I grew up reading creative questions, so I made this app. Because we have seen that there are no more creative and innovative promises like election promises.

Headline_English: Awami League-Chhatra League joyous processions in various parts of India after Bangladesh-India match
Content_English: India won the last match of the Asia Cup Super Four by 41 runs in yesterday's India-Bangladesh match. After the match, the citizens of that country took to the streets of India to celebrate, but among all this, the Awami League-Chhatra League joyous processions in various parts of India, including Kolkata and Delhi, have come under special discussion. It is known that along with Indian citizens, Chhatra League and Awami League leaders and activists celebrated India's victory over Bangladesh. The Awami League party flag was also hoisted in the crowd of Indian flags on the streets of India at night. From Park Street in Kolkata to Connaught Place in Delhi—wherever there is a crowd, Bangladeshi party leaders and activists raised slogans: 130 crore people have one decision, India will win, there is no tension. Not only on the streets, but also in Delhi's Lutyens Bungalow, a special party was organized. However, whether it was held to celebrate India's victory or some other political meeting, is still unclear. A fugitive Awami League leader said from the crowd of the procession, "No, we marched out of gratitude to India." Just as we had India by our side when we were in power, their holes are our last hope when we are on the run. So tell me, how does it feel not to rejoice in India's victory?

Headline_English: Sargis was appointed as a 'regarded' advisor!
Content_English: In the current political and non-political context, there is a need to 'look into' something every day. In this regard, the authorities appointed Sarjis Alam as the 'look into' advisor as he considered him the best. The personal secretary of a low-ranking official under a high-ranking official said, "Look, we have a lot of work that we can look into ourselves. But how much of it can be seen! We are busy with various tasks. Many times, we cannot even say 'look into' in public. We are impressed by Sarjis's determination. We think he will be able to look into it properly. We are also trying hard to make him the head of the 'warning' department." Another official said in a heavy voice, "This department has a lot of work. In addition to making a list of who needs to be seen, how many times a day or a week they need to be seen, or how many times a quarter they need to be 'looked into', monitoring their data and properly looking into it, his approval will be the final word in the 'hard look' and 'soft look' departments." The warning that the National Citizen Party will see how the next election goes if it does not give the election symbol of Shapla has fascinated us. We know and can do it. It is heard that a mobile app called 'Madhu' may come, through which requisitions can be made on who to meet when and how through login. Any officer or employee, from the field level to the high-ranking ones, can avail this service. There may be various offers without any post.

Headline_English: Former footballer Tarek Monowar strongly condemns Yamal for not giving him the Ballon d'Or
Content_English: This year's Ballon d'Or feels like an earthquake is shaking the entire football world. Chat rooms, newsstands, and even political talk shows were filled with the hope that Yamal would win the Ballon d'Or. But at the last minute, the announcement came - the award will go to France's Dembele. Immediately after the incident, anger, the only South Asian superstar to play in the English Premier League in the nineties, the legendary Tarek Manowar, vented his anger about the matter. He said in an angry voice, "If it were our time, I would have stopped European football in response to this injustice." Seeing Yamal reminds me of my own youth. He added, "If you don't look at skill, at least look at age! If you don't give the Ballon d'Or to a 17-year-old boy, will you give it to him at the age of 40?" FIFA has been shaken after seeing the criticism and anger of Tarek Manowar. There are now rumors in the football community that FIFA may soon introduce a new category to appease Tarek Monowar: 'Ballon d'Or Under-18 with South Asian Approval'. Meanwhile, after receiving Tarek Monowar's support, Yamal tweeted that he is a big fan of Tarek Monowar. He even threatened to surround the FIFA office with siege expert Nagardaddy Ishraq Hossain if the Ballon d'Or is not given to him.

Headline_English: Tahsan will also donate the money and fame he earns from singing and playing.
Content_English: Recently, at a concert abroad, musician Tahsan Khan said that this is his last concert. He will not sing or play music anymore. His daughter has grown up, and he no longer likes to jump around on stage. Meanwhile, a secret source has revealed that Tahsan is not only quitting singing and playing music. He will also donate the money and fame earned from singing and playing music. That is why he is looking for an orphanage. Tahsan said from his fake ID, "I used to have a lot of fun in my youth. I will not do it anymore. I will follow the path of religion. I am thinking that I can join Jamaat-e-Islami. Along with that, I will also donate the money earned from singing and playing music. All of these are haram. May Allah not feed me haram things." Meanwhile, a fan of Tahsan said, "This is actually a trick of my brother! There has not been a good song for the last 10 years! People are not calling me like before. The market is a bit slow! So my brother has given this to the system. He is called a cunning man."

Headline_English: Interim wants to appoint Ishraq Hossain as advisor on siege issues
Content_English:
Dhaka South City Corporation Mayor Ishraq Hossain had secured his mayoral post by besieging the City Corporation office. This time, Ishraq, alleging rigging in the BCB election, announced that he would also besiege the BCB office if necessary and he has also stood by Tamim Iqbal in this fight. Although many have taken the matter as a negative, the interim government wants to use Ishraq's talent for sieges and appoint him as an advisor on sieges. After learning about this, Ishraq said, "It's good to know, they have evaluated my talent. I hope I can repay the government's trust. If my position is not explained to me soon, I will besiege the secretariat tomorrow." According to internal government sources, a 'siege criteria' will be developed under Ishraq's supervision. Before any place is surrounded, a standard operational protocol must be followed—where the type, duration, and protocol of the siege will be determined according to the package provided. According to the spokesperson, since mob culture is well-established in the country, what is wrong with making it official and earning a couple of bucks? The planners of the siege ministry have already released an open list of possible packages—from basic to deluxe. The basic package will have a line-up of protestors in front of the office; the premium package will include dragging chairs and tables and a hunger strike to death; and the deluxe package will include a mic setup and a live Facebook session along with all these. 
Ishraq Saheb's own 'Gherao Seindal'—It is learnt that those who already have a PhD in siege will be given permanent jobs in the ministry. This army will rush to any part of the country whenever needed. They will bring the situation in their favor by surrounding everything from public buildings to railway tracks or someone's house.

Headline_English: School of Lies launched at JU, Dean Hamir Hamza
Content_English: In a recent video, sermon speaker and Jamaat leader Amir Hamza was heard saying that he got a chance in the journalism department of Jahangirnagar University in 2011 and he also claimed that the masters students there used to drink alcohol in the morning. As soon as the incident was heard, people started laughing and joking about him on social media, and even JU students protested the matter and said that Amir Hamza was lying. Although the students criticized Amir Hamza's alcohol-coolie theory, the JU administration saw the whole matter differently. According to them, it is important to use such perfect lies in academic terms. As a result, the School of Lies is going to be officially launched at Jahangirnagar University. Here, lying techniques, story-making strategies and how to spread the truth in a flashy way will be taught. The administration's announcement said that Amir Hamza himself will take charge as the first dean. When Amir Hamza was called to inquire about the truth of the matter, he said, "Yes, JU contacted me, I will consider their request. But there is one condition, no one in my class can tell the truth. There is another condition, no one in my class can even be a porter."

Headline_English: Bangladesh fans demand PR method for sharing trophy in Asia Cup
Content_English: The PR system is gaining momentum in the country's politics, many are demanding elections using this method. However, this PR has now crossed the country's borders and touched the international level, including the Asia Cup. Bangladesh has never won the Asia Cup, and the team's fans are not very optimistic that it will win in the near future. This time, the demands of Bangladeshi fans surrounding the Asia Cup are completely novel. Leaving aside the calculation of wins and losses on the field of play, they are demanding the tested method of politics—the PR (Proportional Representation) system for sharing the trophy. I agree that the cup did not go to our hands, but why should it not go at all? - said a supporter, shaking off his anger. If the cup is shared like in elections, at least we will have something to say. According to the fans' proposal, even if India and Pakistan get the lion's share of the trophy, Bangladesh should also have some shares. For example, the lower part of the trophy or a handle should be given to Bangladesh, and the trophy should be brought to Mirpur Stadium for at least a few hours to take pictures. Another supporter argued that under the existing system, our race is only up to the runner-up. But this system is a fascist system! The cup will never be won in this way. So, even if it is divided, we want the cup. Another person added, just as in politics, everyone runs the government together, what is the problem if everyone keeps the cup in cricket? If necessary, give us the lid of the cup, let them keep the rest. However, the President of the Indian Cricket Board strongly opposed this system and said, don't be too fussy, this cup is also ours like the throne of your power. If things don't go as we say, just as you have elected dummy candidates by excluding everyone, we will also field two or three more dummy teams from India and play the Asia Cup.

Headline_English: Awami League leaders and activists are celebrating World Bamboo Day from Jar Jar Obasan
Content_English: Today is World Bamboo Day. While others laugh and joke about the day, Awami League leaders and activists are celebrating the day with due dignity and seriousness from their respective homes. According to them, this day is so deeply intertwined with their political life that there is no chance of denying it. The father of the Internet, Palak Saheb, himself gave a special message from prison. He said, even if no one else observes this day, I had to observe it. Because the leader I trusted did not run away, that leader herself left me and ran away with bamboo. Therefore, to protect the dignity of the day, I requested the district chief and turned off the internet inside the prison myself. On the other hand, a Chhatra League leader walking the streets of Kolkata told us on a video call, I have not eaten rice for a year, I have been surviving on bamboo. However, it has also benefited me - look, I have no stomach aches at all. You have improved my body by running away. So, today, we are celebrating World Bamboo Day in honor of you. Meanwhile, it has been learned that the biggest event of Bamboo Day is being held at Lutyens Bungalow in Delhi. Workers and supporters of the Delhi Awami League branch have already started gathering there. You will give a speech to the people gathered in the morning on the pain of losing a loved one. After that, there will be a lunch with singara and coke in the afternoon. After the lunch, Hindi language expert Hasinaputra Joy will organize a special Lalpani party in the afternoon to forget the pain of Bamboo Day a little.

Headline_English: Interim government will provide loans to purchase hilsa in installments
Content_English: The market is on fire with hilsa. According to Daily Prothom Alo, the price of hilsa above 1 kg in the market is around 3,000 taka. One kg of hilsa costs 2,500 taka. Even though the current politicians and Awami League corrupt people can eat this hilsa, the common man cannot even smell it. Thinking about the people of the country, the interim government has said that they will provide government loans to buy hilsa in installments. The loan will have to be repaid in 10 installments. Even if they fail to repay, there is no problem. They will not do anything, the government will just take away the tins. This has been confirmed by eRK from a 100% unreliable source. In this regard, a spokesperson for the interim government said, our main goal is to bring hilsa back to the people. Although the previous government did not allow people to eat rice in their feet, we are trying to at least deliver the hilsa. One thing must be kept in mind, it is the right of people to get a loan to buy hilsa. A very poor van driver from Moghbazar said, I have never received such happy news in my life. I am thinking of taking a loan soon. At this time, he showed the V-sign and said, "We want the interim government to be in power for 5 years." Meanwhile, a representative of the World Food Program said, "The interim government has handled everything very well. Bangladesh has been self-sufficient in fish and rice until now, but from now on, it will be self-sufficient in mustard and hilsa."

Headline_English: BCB to make algebra compulsory for cricketers and fans
Content_English: Bangladesh Cricket Board has announced that from now on, learning algebra is mandatory for cricketers and cricket fans. They said that both players and spectators are getting extremely confused while doing various calculations in matches. Traditional attire | A BCB official said, in every tournament, we spend more time in the math notebook, in the calculator chest than in the field game. Various calculations, various equations after every match! All in all, if you are not good at math, you will not enjoy watching Bangladeshi cricket! There is no excitement! That is why we have taken this decision. Cricketers have given mixed reactions to this innovative initiative. A young batter said, as difficult as it is for me to reduce 12 runs from 15 runs in the last over, solving algebra 'x²+2x+1=0' is even more difficult. However, the coach said, if I can find the derivative, then it will be easier to get a place in the final squad. On the other hand, an excited fan in the gallery said, earlier I would watch the game only if I understood cricket, but now I have to understand math. Yesterday, I took a calculator to the gallery, and my uncle sitting next to me said, "Brother, look at the runs on the scoreboard, there's no need to find the value of x." Still, I believe that knowing the quadratic equation will help you calculate the Super Four. Meanwhile, the BCB has signed a memorandum of understanding with the Ministry of Education. A separate subject will be introduced in schools and colleges - 'Cricket Algebra'. It will teach, if Sri Lanka defeats Afghanistan with 3 overs remaining, what is the percentage chance of Bangladesh going to the next round! There will be some more math, if Liverpool defeats Barcelona in the English Premier League, how many minutes will Bangladesh have to crawl against the current to reach the Super Four port. Experts believe that if this initiative is implemented, viewers will never be confused whether the match is within reach or out of reach. However, there is a fear that Bangladesh's batsmen will become so preoccupied with the equation that they will spend more time figuring out the 'value of x' than scoring runs.

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer Shafiqur Rahman offers PR solution to take Bangladesh to Asia Cup Super Four
Content_English: Bangladesh is playing in Group B or Group of Death of Asia Cup 2025 with Sri Lanka, Afghanistan, and Hong Kong. Except for Hong Kong, all the other teams are Test-playing teams. Hong Kong has lost all its matches so far and has been eliminated from the tournament long ago. Bangladesh has also won two out of three matches. Now, there is no equation that Bangladesh will go to the Super Four just by winning the next match. Rather, Bangladesh will have to look at who is beating whom by how many runs. In this equation of run rate and wickets, the Ameer of Jamaat has given a great tip for Bangladesh to reach the Super Four. The only way to take Bangladesh to the Super Four is the PR method. He commented that there is no better method other than this method. When eRK team wanted to talk to the Ameer of Jamaat to know how the PR method will work in a game like cricket, he was told that the PR method has a solution to any problem in the world. You look at Ukraine today, you look at Syria, you look at Palestine, if you want to come out of all this chaos, they could have used the PR method. This is the situation because they did not go for PR. A post was written by an unverified Facebook page of Jamaat Ameer last night that went viral. Calling all cricket-crazy fans of Bangladesh to be on standby, it was said that at any moment they may have to participate in an international cricket election online. He has instructed all those who have bot IDs to log in to all the bot IDs to take Bangladesh to the Asia Cup. The equation of the B-group is gradually becoming difficult, the only solution to this issue can be the PR method on Facebook. Jamaat Ameer's Facebook status went viral in an instant. Many people wrote in the comments that even though I have given up my weapons, I have not forgotten training. Just tell me how many comments you need. I will give all the comments with my bot army. I can do nothing else for Bangladesh, I can contribute a little online. If nothing else, I can give a few thousand reactions. Many people have come and said that no one can exclude Bangladesh from the Asia Cup, as long as we are here, Bangladesh will advance to the Super Four through the PR method, and even win the semis, quarters and even the finals from the Super Four. The Jamaat Ameer said, if you don't believe me, don't just look at the PR method. You have looked at quadratic equations, simple equations, complex equations, how many equations you have looked at, now look at PR. You will see that it will be good. Drawing the attention of the interim government, he said, if only the government had thought about the matter a little. Hania Ameer is real, Bakul laughed after hearing Oli's words, if only they had given the election a little PR method!

Headline_English: Noah Harari says going to camp is the same as studying at Oxford, through Shafiqul Islam Masud
Content_English: One of the wisest people of our time, Noah Harari, has said that doing Shibir is equivalent to studying at Oxford. It is known that he told this about Shibir through Jamaat leader Shafiqul Alam. Shafiqul Islam said these things while taking a class on Shibir chapter in a classroom recently. Quoting this Jamaat leader, it is known that Noah Harari wrote in one of his research-based books, that the solution to all the problems of the universe is hidden in Shibir. Once you join Shibir, you will understand why Shibir is needed in this universe. Harari said that doing Shibir is better than studying at Oxford, Harvard or Cambridge. Many teachers of these universities have done Shibir first and later taught at the university. Harari requested the Bangladesh government to include a separate subject on Shibir in the curriculum. In the meantime, several research-based courses on Shibir are being launched at Oxford, Harvard and Cambridge. Tourism package| At the end of his speech, Noah Harari also said that people are like two-wheeled bicycles.

Headline_English: Marvel writers want to create an Amirverse like the Marvel Universe to celebrate Hania Amir's arrival in Bangladesh
Content_English: Pakistani star Hania Amir is coming to Bangladesh. Not only fans are excited about this news, Marvel writers are also unexpectedly overjoyed. According to them, this moment of getting two different 'Amiras' from two countries on the same platform can make history. And so, they are planning to create a new cinematic world 'Amir Verse' like the Marvel Universe, centered around Hania Amir's visit to Bangladesh. In this context, a writer from the Marvel team said, we had made Avengers before. If this time Hania Amir and the Amir of Jamaat can be brought together in the same frame, then it will undoubtedly be the most profitable and strangely mixed cinematic universe in history. Just think - Hania who makes sweet reels on Instagram on one hand, and Amir Sahib from the field of politics on the other. This verse will be a complete mess with these two. Another Marvel producer added an extra dimension and said, from a consciousness point of view, both of them actually seem to be quite similar. Like Hania, Aamir Sahab also puts the country first. Of course, which country is not very important, the main thing is that both of them have some kind of love for a particular country. The joy of working with like-minded people is different. However, no final decision has been made yet on how the main story of the Aamirverse will progress, or who will be the hero and who will be the villain here. However, one of the Marvel writing team hinted that the structure of the story is still in the process, but one thing is certain - both will be given equal importance and equal screen time.

Headline_English: Hasina, Putin, Kim Jong Un celebrate the day with great pomp
Content_English: Today is the International Day of Democracy. The day is being celebrated all over the world, but the most grandiose arrangements were seen in the homes of three leaders—Hasina, Putin, and Kim Jong Un. Hasina said while cutting the Democracy Day cake in the morning, "I am the brainchild of democracy." During my rule, I have protected the democratic rights of myself and my party workers. For now, I am spending my days with the pain of losing relatives and power, but if I get the chance again, I will definitely bind democracy in a new way, meaning I will protect it. Meanwhile, at the Democracy Day fair organized in Russia, Putin told reporters that there is no democratic environment like my country anywhere in the world. The people here have democratically elected me forever. Not having an opposition candidate is actually a spontaneous decision of the people. On the other hand, Kim Jong Un himself organized a fireworks display on the occasion of Democracy Day in North Korea, where the people were forced to clap democratically. Kim said, democracy in our country is so strong that every voter agrees 100 percent.

Headline_English: Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi was saying, 'I actually support Shibir, BJP is my mask'
Content_English: After the massive success of Shibir in DUCSU and JACSU, Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi said in an excited voice, "How much more?" That is, how much more love will he keep in his heart? Breaking the anxiety created by keeping unspoken words in his heart for years, he now made his debut in a yearning voice, saying, "No matter how much BJP does, my heart is Shibir!" He declared in an unequivocal voice, and I am not afraid of fascism. I have become fed up with living under the shadow of BJP. Sometimes I feel like I am going on a hunger strike demanding my own resignation. When I heard this at home, I heard, 'Leave the drama and drink it'! Hey, I have been acting so much for so long. It is time to show myself. So my goal now is to join Shibir and stand by them all the time. I believe Shibir has crores of supporters here. In addition to promising to recruit Shibir workers in all universities in India, Modi expressed his optimism for Shibir's expected victory in all the Bhaksu, Raksu, and Muksu elections, and sang along with Shibir in a melodious voice, "Sayyara mein to badla nehi haye, mausam thorasa badlarahahe..."

Headline_English: Journalist Ilias Hossain divorces Sadiq Kayem, Pinaki tries to mediate
Content_English: Sadiq Kayem won DUCSU. But he didn't have a minute to call journalist Ilyas! The matter caused a lot of pain to journalist Ilyas. Unable to bear the pain, he decided to divorce Sadiq Kayem. This has been confirmed by eArchi from a completely investigative fake ID. Coming live with a full chest of pride, Ilyas Hossain said, Sadiq, how much I love you! More than my own life! I sold my blood and bought a gift for you. I left a kidney so that I can give it to you if you ever need a kidney. And you didn't even give me a call! How much does it cost to make a call? If I needed it, I would have recharged your number! Otherwise, I would have called you on WhatsApp. You could have even given me a post! And you forgot about me! It is known that Ilyas also got a tattoo of Sadiq Kayem on his chest or side out of love for Sadiq. Now he has also got into new trouble about removing that tattoo. This tough investigative journalist is unable to get into a new relationship. Meanwhile, Pinaki has appeared on the scene to untangle the stones of their relationship. Advising Ilyas to stay calm, Pinaki says, "Look Ilyas, Sadik is a busy man! Maybe he doesn't have time to call you! But remember, true love is never destroyed by lack of communication. No matter what Sadik does while traveling around the world, at the end of the day, when he comes home, he is yours! Don't be sad. Get married and be okay again."

Headline_English: Uber introduces copter rides to help dictators escape
Content_English: A new trend has begun after the then Prime Minister of Bangladesh fled the country in a helicopter in 2024. The Prime Minister of Nepal has joined this trend. Both of them fled in a helicopter in the same style, opening up the possibility of a new service. Thinking about the convenience of the dictators who still exist in the world, Uber has come up with Copter Ride. Arranging a helicopter with the army is both troublesome and time-consuming. In this case, there is a lot of risk. So Uber has come up with a simple solution. Just climb onto the roof of your house and book a copter ride, and the helicopter will fly in an instant and drop you at your destination. Kim Jong Un, Putin and many others are happy with the arrival of this service. When our correspondent asked them about their thoughts on this matter, Putin said, "Sometimes I used to worry a lot about what I would do if I needed to flee a country like Bangladesh and there was no fuel in the helicopter." Thanks to Uber, this has put an end to my worries. Meanwhile, when contacted, Uber said that the way prime ministers have started escaping by helicopter in different countries, launching this service was the need of the hour.

Headline_English: Fans call for Shibir members to join Bangladesh team to ensure Asia Cup win
Content_English: Every time the Bangladesh cricket team goes to a tournament, there is drama in the beginning, but in the end everything falls apart. For years, the fans have been quite fed up with the situation of their team. On the other hand, Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir has been winning consecutively in DUCSU and JACSU in recent times. In such a situation, the fans have found a revolutionary solution and collaboration plan, and that is to take two or three Shibir members into the team. Their argument in this regard is that whoever is in the Shibir now has a hidden winning formula. If they can win in the voting field, they can also turn the situation around in the bat and ball field. A fan commented on the matter on social media, saying, "We have tried many times to bring the beaten specialist Chhatra League into the team, but it was not possible to implement it because they were busy with guest rooms, vote rigging, and student murders." I hope the Shibir brothers will not disappoint us, if the brothers enter the team, winning the Asia Cup is certain. They are political people, there may be various party restrictions, but if they want, they can enter the team even keeping their political identity a secret, there is no expert in this matter than them. Meanwhile, a BCB official said on condition of anonymity, we are considering the matter. Everything is fine, but the concern is, if they take out the razor in the middle of the match, there is a possibility that the sky will be full of stars.

Headline_English: Election Engineering to be added to BUET
Content_English: After observing the various elections going on in the country, the University Grants Commission has decided to open a new department at the Bangladesh University of Engineering and Technology. It is reported that new students will be admitted through an admission test in the next academic year. People who have the ability to spread rumors to the maximum extent and are good at finding loopholes in the election code of conduct will be given priority in admission to this department. When we tried to contact the BUET administration, they said that election engineering is an important subject at present, it is possible to snatch victory in any election by hiring a skilled election engineer. By participating in the election in the traditional way, you may have to struggle a lot to win the election, it will also cost a lot of money from your pocket, but before the election, a skilled election engineer will be able to take the responsibility of arranging everything for your election and give you the experience of voting in a cheerful mood. A very encouraging attitude is also being observed among the political parties. The subject has made its presence felt through the controversy surrounding election engineering in the DUCSU and JACSU elections. In the future, an election engineer will act as a technical, psychological, and political mastermind and will work to bring the party to victory by engineering wherever engineering is needed.

Headline_English: Solaiman Sukhan wants to be Sushila's 'Ashiq Chowdhury'. If given the opportunity, he would also like to take on responsibility as the government's 'Asif Nazrul'.
Content_English: Former Chief Justice Sushila Karki has taken charge as the interim chief justice of Nepal. Her belief in the zero tolerance policy made Sushila Karki quite popular at that time. In that vein, the people there are looking at her taking charge in a very positive light. The interim government has many responsibilities. Properly posting on Facebook and Instagram, speaking eloquently in front of the microphone, good presentations, preparing dream drafts, analyzing the future of a place after twenty to thirty years, etc. In that case, Solomon Sukhan expressed his eagerness to fulfill this important responsibility by becoming the 'Ashiq Chowdhury' of the friendly country Nepal, i.e. Sushila's government, in a video message. Sharing the phone number on the screen below, he also said that he has been looking at the phone for more than twelve hours, just one phone call... one phone call... He also said, 'Oh Allah Khaled, if I had the opportunity to serve Nepal once, I would have worked with my life.' The ability to do many things with one hand is my great quality, so I should be considered as the 'Asif Nazrul' of the Sushila government. Nepal is a friendly country, that's all we can claim, right? Moreover, the new government will need many reforms. Sukhan promised to make this 'roadmap' as soon as possible without AI. He said that if the government wants to do a drone show about the mass uprising, I can make the system.

Headline_English: Nepal's army chief asks for some white stones to give a speech with a stone pressed to his chest
Content_English: Recently, political unrest has been going on in Nepal. The young generation has taken up the movement against corruption and the ban on social media, which later turned into mutual conflict. In the face of the ongoing protests, the Home Minister resigned first. Then the current government also fell, and the head of government fled in a helicopter in the face of the angry crowd. Nepal's Army Chief General Ashok Raj Sigdel has called on the protesters to sit at the negotiating table in a video message on social media. He also called on everyone to come forward to maintain law and order, ensure national unity, and prevent any loss of life and property. Among the many similarities between this incident in Nepal and the mass uprising in Bangladesh in 2024, one thing is missing. But Bangladesh has cordial relations with Nepal. The Army Chief is willing to discuss the copyright issue with a 'stone on his chest' to keep it natural and sincere. The discussion of the white stones of Sylhet has been quite hyped recently, so the Army Chief has asked for some white stones as stones. It's best if it's 'recovered after being lost'! Any recovered item has a different taste, be it a stone or not.

Headline_English: Nepal's Prime Minister also escaped by helicopter, Sheikh Hasina applies for patent for Hasina style escape
Content_English: After the resignation and fall of the government, Nepalese Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli fled in a helicopter just like Sheikh Hasina. Although the people of Nepal are happy about this, Sheikh Hasina is terrified. Fearing that she will lose the copyright for copying her style, she has directly applied to the World Intellectual Property Organization (WIPO) to patent the Hasina style escape in her name. In this regard, she said, I am the first person in the world to escape like this, if the copyright goes to anyone other than me, the committee that granted the patent is a child of the Razakar. She also posted Jasim's 'You want to put a shala competition in that shala's house' meme targeting the Nepalese Prime Minister. Awami League leaders and activists hiding in the country and abroad have also held protest marches on the issue. They are even holding online and offline marches with the slogan 'If the patent for Hasina style escape is not upheld, fire will burn in every house'.

Headline_English: Donald Trump, looking ahead to the DUCSU elections, can send a 'come to Raju' message to Modi at any time!
Content_English: Trump wrote from his personal 'Not Only Truth, But Also Unsocial' account, 'I really wanted to get admitted to Dhaka University at least once. At that time, I also wanted to run for DUCSU, I would have been the VP, GS all by myself. But I did not get a visa at that time. Disappointed by the broken dream and unable to find a way, I finally ran for the US President. My heart still cries for the DUCSU VP post. I have not been able to sleep for the past few nights due to worry. I have been listening to Taylor Swift's songs anxiously since morning. All eyes on DUCSU! With a few smiley emojis, he wrote, Let the DUCSU elections be held, then I will message Modi, 'Come to Raju!' My phone is not picking up, how dare you! Some bot IDs started asking for votes for their favorite candidate on Trump's post. It is estimated that they will continue to comment asking for votes until four o'clock. Among them, one comment received quite a reaction. The comment was quoted exactly as follows: Dear Trump, I heard you used to play the league. Your family also used to play the league. You got into a lot of trouble while supporting the league, we have all the records. Now we can take responsibility for getting you out of trouble if you vote for our candidate. It is said that Trump is just sweating after seeing this comment. He is a league football fan. He once got into a lot of trouble when he was caught with one girlfriend by another. How did they know this?

Headline_English: The Nobel Committee wants to award the Home Affairs Advisor the Nobel Peace Prize for maintaining peace in the overall situation in the country.
Content_English: The law and order situation in the country is deteriorating at an alarming rate. The mob culture, extortion, murder, robbery, terrorism—everything is going on together with full vigor across the country. While the common people are trembling with fear in this situation, the current Home Affairs Advisor is calm like a meditating yogi. Such a strange calmness is rare in history. Some say that he is not an advisor in charge of the law and order of the country, but rather a 'brand ambassador of peace'. The Nobel Committee is also shocked to see such extraordinary self-control. After much thought, they have decided that this year the Nobel Peace Prize should go to the one who has embraced peace within himself, no matter what happens outside. The committee informed that when the mob is reigning around, he is giving reviews of the police's rice and dal and occasionally comes and drops messages at press conferences. Only such a pure and peaceful person is worthy of the Nobel Peace Prize. However, it is being heard that the Home Affairs Advisor may not go to Sweden to receive the Nobel. That is why the Nobel Committee has taken a special initiative. One of their members said, if we want, we can throw the Nobel directly from Sweden into his office window. It will not cause him any trouble. He can remain in peace.

Headline_English: Demand for Abid, the candidate for DUCSU VP of Chhatra Dal, is increasing in the Waz market.
Content_English: Abid of Chhatra Dal has come into the discussion by giving a fiery speech on the campus as a candidate for the post of DUCSU VP. Some people are sharing the video on social media and writing – ‘Bhai was born to break the mic!’, while others have commented – ‘Bhai should not only be VP, but also the president of the WAJ committee with this voice.’ But what people on social media are making fun of is what the WAJ market has taken seriously. Organizers have already started trying to put him on the booking list. A veteran WAJ organizer said, Abid Bhai has everything that is needed to heat up the WAJ. If we bring him to WAJ, the cost of renting loudspeakers or mics will also be reduced, I believe if he comes to this line, the red light will definitely come on in the business of the rest. We bring other Huzoors by helicopter, but if Abid Bhai comes to this line, we are also willing to arrange a rocket for his travel. On the other hand, it is heard that some popular Huzoors are now afraid of losing their places. From a hole in the Antarctic continent, a friend of the once English Premier League-shaking and world-famous rich Bell Grade, a monk, regretfully posted the meme "My body is shaking with fear" on his profile.

Headline_English: Hasnat and Rumin Farhana's hearts may melt under Obaidul Quader's mediation
Content_English: There was some misunderstanding and some disagreement between NCP leader Hasnat Abdullah and BNP leader Rumin Farhana a few days ago. They have talked a lot to each other, there has been a wide discussion across the country. That discussion has not been limited to the borders of the country but has also gone abroad. The Awami League General Secretary was spending his idle time sitting in a hotel abroad, when a young man gave him an update on Hasnat Abdullah and Rumin Farhana, and he was moved. Putting the glass of soft drink in his hand next to him, he called Rumin Farhana without thinking much. A person very close to Obaidul Quader told eRK that although he called Rumin Farhana several times, she did not answer at first. Later, Quader Saheb sent a secret message with 50 paisa on Bikash, and Rumin Farhana called back. In the phone call, Quader Saheb told Rumin Farhana, "Look, there is a big gap between you and Hasnat, there is a lot of distance in your mind." Even if you don't see eye to eye, you can talk on the telephone. You can have an understanding, a relationship. What will happen if that happens? Will everything be limited to formalities? Will you not talk? What is the difficulty in talking on the telephone? Overwhelmed by these words, Rumeen Farhana realizes her mistake. She tells Kader's brother, "I have made a big mistake. I am making arrangements to fix the relationship today. Don't worry, I am managing everything." Rumeen Farhana sits down to think about how to fix the relationship. After much thought, she decides to send some gifts for Hasnat. Then, she sends gifts for Hasnat Abdullah through her own people. Hasnat Abdullah is also quite happy with the gifts. She said that there was some misunderstanding between us. But she sent people to inquire and also gave some gifts. This is a positive message, we definitely welcome it.

Headline_English: Students want Riaz-Ferdous dance on truck to make DUCSU election campaign festive
Content_English: During the Awami League era, film stars Ferdous and Riaz were famous for their election campaigns by dancing and singing on trucks for the League. Be it national or local elections, they could be seen everywhere. No election procession was complete without the dancing and singing of these two stars. Whenever the truck got on, their sweaty 'extra energy steps' could be seen. Not only in dancing and singing, but they were also unique in their strategy of giving fuel to the party in the media. Especially Riaz, who sometimes forgot the dialogues of his movies while praising the Awami League in front of the camera. There is no Khan League, and their dancing and jumping have also been missing from social media for a long time. Meanwhile, after the fall of the Awami League, the Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU) elections are going to be held again, but voters and candidates have claimed that the election campaign is not very successful without the dancing of Riaz and Ferdous on trucks. DUCSU elections mean political excitement on campus, poster-making, loud slogans and commotion all over the campus. But everyone seems to be feeling a huge void in this year's election campaign. Students claim that this election will not be festive in any way if Riaz-Ferdous does not dance on the truck. Now there is only one question going around among voters: 'Will Riaz-Ferdous come?' A first-year student told our representatives that he does not feel like voting unless he sees Riaz Bhai dancing on the truck. That is the real election vibe for us. However, since both of them have been absconding from Zar-Zar Obasan since the fall of the government, the students are in a dilemma - will this duo not dance on the truck this time? Or will we have to spend the entire election in nostalgia of the old days? Political analysts also express their concerns about the matter and say that if Riaz-Ferdous does not come, voter turnout in the DUCSU elections could drop from 60% to 12%. On the other hand, some students have proposed launching a 'Ducsu Dance Competition' as an alternative plan. Some believe that even if some dummy Riaz-Ferdous are found through this competition, the DUCSU elections will be crowded, whether real or not.

Headline_English: Asif Nazrul takes charge as advisor to the Ministry of Strong Condemnation and Protest
Content_English: Asif Nazrul, the interim government's law, justice and parliamentary affairs advisor, is taking charge of a new ministry. Although he has been working on law and justice for a long time, he may not be able to properly implement the law or do anything about judicial conduct, which is why he is increasingly criticizing on Facebook.
