Internal sources in the advisory council have confirmed that he has been given the responsibility of the new ministry because he feels more comfortable criticizing than implementing the law. Seeing Dr. Asif Nazrul taking charge of the ministry of strong condemnation and protest, there is a certain tension on Facebook. Those who are on his friend list or as followers are mentally preparing themselves. Everyone assumes that after taking charge, Nazrul will give a few statuses and strongly condemn and protest. People are still wondering whether they can contact the bot army to encourage his work and express their agreement. Some of his close people said that Dr. Asif Nazrul is preparing himself in a new way. After taking charge of the ministry of strong condemnation and protest, his work will increase further. Earlier, he could have quickly condemned it on Facebook. He can and will do it now, but as an advisor, he needs to do something better. It is said that after much thought, he has come up with a novel way to condemn. After taking charge as the advisor to the Ministry on Strong Condemnation and Protest, he will create a condemnation and protest platform. Anyone who comes to this platform can strongly condemn and protest. Since there are always standby journalists, everyone's condemnation and protest will spread across the country and abroad. It is not only possible to protest against any incident in the country, anyone can also protest against foreign issues. When we contacted him about the protest platform, we did not receive any response. However, a person close to him said that Donald Trump somehow found out about the protest platform. Modi did not pick up Trump's phone despite calling him 4 times. Trump wants to strongly condemn and protest against Modi's actions by coming to the condemnation and protest platform. Sir, the surprise he is showing before taking charge, I don't know what will happen if he takes charge.

Headline_English: Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg desperate to hire DMP's AI expert to join their team
Content_English: The DMP Facebook page has officially declared a photo of a student's face being covered up during the engineering university student movement as 'AI generated'. Since the matter went viral, social media has been full of jokes about DMP. However, while the matter is a matter of laughter within the country, there has been a stir internationally about DMP's AI expert. Elon Musk, Mark Zuckerberg and other tech giants around the world are desperate to get DMP's AI expert on their team. Elon Musk wrote in a tweet that if we can get such an AI expert on our team, our business will not be a banana tree but a banyan tree. If we get him, we can call all Tesla car crashes AI-generated from now on. On the other hand, Zuckerberg is not far behind. He has thought of the name of Meta's next product - Meta-Cop AI. Where the user's face will be covered up in virtual reality. However, the mysterious AI expert who is the center of everyone's interest is not that excited. Even with the lure of a dollar salary abroad, he is not being lured. He told us, "I prefer to work secretly rather than openly. If I join Musk and Zuckerberg's team, I don't want everything to become open source."

Headline_English: Mohammad Raihan wishes good luck to DUCSU candidates
Content_English: Facebook's unannounced Kufa Emperor Mohammad Raihan is in the news again. He has long earned the notoriety that wishing someone well will surely ruin their future. That's why his Facebook ID has the word 'Kupa Raihan' next to his name. Raihan Bhai has been lurking behind everyone who has opened a new business, gotten married or joined a job, wishing them well. And the result? Business destruction, marriage breakdown, suspension from job - that one line of good wishes from Raihan is the main suspect in everything. Even various Bagha Bagha sports teams around the world are afraid of Raihan's good wishes. However, this time the target is much bigger. When the media is hot about the DUCSU elections, Raihan suddenly announced that he will wish DUCSU candidates well. As soon as the news spread, a panic has started among the candidates. Some are hiding at home instead of going to the campaign, while others are drafting applications to withdraw their candidacy. One of the candidates, on condition of anonymity, said, "Brother, whatever the result of the vote, if Raihan Bhai writes 'All the best' in the inbox, I will not be able to show my face to your sister-in-law again." Meanwhile, ordinary students are also worried. They say that if Raihan wishes the DUCSU candidates well, there may be a ruckus on the campus on the election day. All in all, there is only one topic of discussion before the DUCSU vote - not who will win the vote, but rather who will Raihan wish well!

Headline_English: Towhid Afridi arrested, pressure on Trump to solve global problems increases
Content_English: Towhid Afridi, who became a peace peddler despite not winning the Nobel Peace Prize, has been arrested from Barisal. Although he started his career by vlogging, Towhid Afridi mainly gained recognition by settling disputes between friends. Whenever there was a dispute, he would be the first to be called, and he would also resolve the disputes of his friends very nicely. Towhid Afridi, who used to work tirelessly to stop the disputes of husbands and wives, friends, lovers or heroes and heroines and restore their friendship, is now imprisoned within the four walls of prison. Everyone is having to rush to solve problems worldwide. No one will come live and tell the two of them to say sorry and settle everything. The problems of misunderstanding will not be solved. The problems will remain as problems, that is everyone's fear. Social media was at least somewhat positive because there was such a person. From today, all those toxic problems will happen again. The Trump administration has been in a state of flux since the arrest of Towhid Afridi. If there is anyone who is capable of solving problems after Towhid Afridi, it is only Trump. Being the president of such a big country, one has to be very busy. At this time, with Afridi in jail, Trump is unable to do anything. Someone or the other will have to fill the void left by Towhid Afridi. President Trump, who has wrinkles on his forehead, is scheduled to go to a special spa in Miami tomorrow. It was announced in a press conference from the presidential office that President Trump may not be able to do the same work as Afridi, but he will try his best. Trump already works 18 hours a day to establish peace and solve global problems. He has decided to work 24 hours a day from today. To become more efficient in solving problems, President Trump has asked his personal assistant to download all of Towhid Afridi's videos. He will stop all work for the next seven days and study Afridi's videos. He wants to learn how Towhid Afridi worked, as well as various problem-solving techniques. Don't be disappointed. Even if Towhid is not here, your Trump uncle is still alive. You create problems, I will solve them. You don't have to worry about anything while I am here. For now, I will work with DUCSU. Farhad and Meghmallar are said to have a lot of fights. I want to start my work by making them friends, Trump told eRK.

Headline_English: No more fights, clashes or misunderstandings. A special calculator is needed for the equitable distribution of bribe money, and policies are also needed.
Content_English: The ancestor of the calculator, the abacus, came 4000-5000 years ago. With the advancement of technology for the convenience of calculations, calculators have also come into use in smartwatches. Although the country has progressed, there has been no advancement in calculating 'bribery money'. This important but neglected issue has come to the fore recently in the Savar municipality. There was a fight between two officials over a minor issue like distributing the bribe money received from an applicant for changing the ownership of a house. Bribes, like the Padma, Meghna, and Jamuna, have been an integral part of Bangladesh since ancient times. The demand for food delivery is rising day by day like the price of land. The demand for bribes is increasing in line with inflation. But until now, there is no policy for its equitable distribution, nor is there any reliable calculation tool. In a harmonious country like Bangladesh, creating confusion and conflict over the distribution of bribe money and going to the level of fighting over it is a black mark on the standards of corruption in the country. In this regard, the DUDUK (Anti-Corruption Commission) said that bribery is a top demand of our people. Its distribution should be smooth! But the Savar incident showed us where our shortcomings are! Where we need to work. Before inventing the EMI of loan installments, the invention of a bribe money calculator is more necessary. Mentioning the need to create a formula as a field, amount of money, number of people and investors, he said, it is no less important than Newton's apple. Savar is our Newton - our two tax officers.. Their situation has made us question them. We have realized how backward we are as a nation. He appealed to the government to urgently provide grants in this regard. He said that his organization would not hesitate to provide some tea and water if necessary, and that if the grant money is received, the next time tea and water will be provided after calculating it using a calculator.

Headline_English: As the sister-in-law next door, it is your duty to do whatever is necessary.
Content_English: Are you a next-door neighbour? But you don't know what your duties are? But we have brought a list of some must-do duties for you. After reading this list, you will know what you can do to become an ideal next-door neighbour. 1. Keep in mind that you are the BBC News channel of the building. It is your duty to know the news of everyone's pots and houses and spread it to different places on time. 2. It is your big responsibility to collect such news as whose son smokes cigarettes, whose daughter is in love. 3. Also, you have to be a full-time matchmaker. You always have to keep track of the bride and groom. Keeping in mind the age of a girl, how much her salary is, whether she will get married or not, you have to suggest what kind of groom or bride she will be suitable for. 4. Sometimes you have to wear expensive clothes and gold jewelry and have an afternoon chat with the nearby neighbours. If you don't have your own, you have to borrow money from your sisters and neighbours to do the work. 5. You are the best at everything - you will always prove it. If someone says that her husband helps her with work sometimes, you will say, your husband does all the housework, you don't have to do any work. 6. You have to provide solutions to any problems of the neighboring sisters, whether you know the solution to the problem or not. 7. You should have an important opinion on all the issues of the sisters around you. If you are not doing these things yet, start today, otherwise you will fall behind in the battle of becoming the sister-in-law next door.

Headline_English: DC vs DCC fight coming to DC Universe, Superman, Batman will fight for two colleges in the movie
Content_English: The fight between Dhaka College (DC) and Dhaka City College (DCC) starts at the Science Lab intersection from 19 to 20. However, this fight has crossed the boundaries of the Science Lab intersection and has reached the Hollywood screen. DC Universe has come forward to showcase this priceless tradition that has been going on for years to the world. Recently, they have announced that they are going to make a blockbuster movie called ‘DC vs DCC: Clash of Colleges’. Superman, Batman, and Wonder Woman will be seen in this movie, but they will not fight with any villain, but for the two colleges. However, there has been a huge debate among fans about who will fight for whom. Some say that Batman will be on the side of Dhaka College because of his experience in the dark alleys and renting rooms in Dhaka. Many others claim that Superman will join the City College team because of his good relationship with girls. Meanwhile, the director of the movie has said that this is going to be the biggest movie of the DC Universe. He also said that if superheroes can be brought down in college fights, a new height will come to our universe. Hopefully this tradition will survive for generations and the fight will get recognition as a heritage from UNESCO. Rumor has it that Joker will appear in a special cameo in the movie. However, he will not fight for any college, but rather he will suddenly come during the fight and say, "Brother, don't break the glass, I will have tea."

Headline_English: Mufti Rezaul Karim is bringing water-reading to remove the chief advisor's saddle
Content_English: While giving a speech at Baitul Mukarram on Tuesday, Charmonai Pir's Amir Mufti Rezaul Karim feared that the chief advisor was possessed by a jinn. It is learnt that he is arranging for a special water-reading to get rid of this problem. Mufti Rezaul Karim said that he is not able to do the work of the country and the state properly because of the jinn possessed by the chief advisor. He wants to come forward to solve this problem. He will not remain silent at such a time of great crisis in the country. He has a special water-reading to drive away such bad jinn, which can be done very easily to get rid of this problem. On the other hand, when the head of Kohkaf, the city of the jinn, was contacted, he expressed his great regret over the matter and said, "If I had known earlier, I would have sent a good jinn who would have made the chief advisor serve the country and the state." But the incident actually happened without my knowledge. We are arranging to bring that jinn back very quickly. Meanwhile, when this news spread, it is said that the chief advisor's jinn was very scared. When contacted, he said, "My body is shaking with fear. I am very scared. I can't even drink water because of fear, Yunus Sahib is scared to drink water. I have become completely panicky."

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina is running the country by sitting in Delhi, claims Awami League supporter
Content_English: Sheikh Hasina went to India on August 5 last year on state business. You misunderstood the people of Bangladesh and made Dr. Muhammad Yunus the chief advisor and gave him the responsibility of running the country. There is bad news for those who are using Sheikh Hasina's state visit incorrectly and think they are very weak - what will happen if you do not let Sheikh Hasina come, Sheikh Hasina is still running the country. She is running the country with a gene sitting in India. The secret gene that Mufti Rezaul Islam claimed to have on the chief advisor is actually Sheikh Hasina's gene, claims Bhatara's Awami supporter Rabiul Islam. We, the eRK team, contacted Awami leaders residing in Delhi and various places in India to discuss the matter. After talking to some leaders, we came to know that a few months ago, the gene was introduced to Shamim Osman, a special player of Narayanganj Awami League. After going to India with Sheikh Hasina on state business, he kept visiting shrines and shrines to search for the Qabil gene. After searching for a long time, he finally found this jinn and met Sheikh Hasina and gifted her with the jinn to control. The caretaker of Sheikh Hasina's bungalow confirmed to us that Sheikh Hasina was using the jinn to control the various activities and statements of the chief advisor while she was in Delhi. He would scream loudly in the middle of the night, chant some mantras and laugh. Sometimes I heard him swearing, and sometimes he would cry out loud. One night, I saw a huge cloud of black smoke in front of his window. Only those who drive jinns do this, said the caretaker of Lutyens' Delhi. Mufti Rezaul Karim is getting a lot of praise on social media for revealing that the chief advisor is under a secret jinn. We know that his job description also includes the matter of driving out jinns. I hope that he will defeat Sheikh Hasina's gene on his own initiative and, with that gene, bring Sheikh Hasina back to the country and face justice for her crimes - that is what the general public is hoping.

Headline_English: BAL Transplant Centre launched in Delhi, Awami League leaders will get special discount
Content_English: While the news of a hair transplant of an Awami League leader who had fled to India was making a lot of noise on social media, the brand new BAL Transplant Centre was officially launched in Delhi. Since the beginning, there has been a lot of speculation and jokes surrounding the name of the centre. Many people have wondered - will only Awami League leaders really get transplanted here? Several expatriate Awami League leaders were present at the centre on the day of its inauguration. One of them raised a question in a worried voice, why is it named BAL Transplant Centre? BAL is associated with us. However, the Transplant Centre clarified the matter, saying, "Aap log chinta mat kijiye, hum Hindi bal ka transplant karte hai. Bangladeshi BAL matlab is not for Awami Leaguer ka nehi." The centre's announcement also stated that there will be a special discount for Awami League leaders. The offer has been named - 'Pain of Hair Loss'. This discount package not only includes hair transplants for the head, but also for the mustache, beard, or eyebrows, if desired. As a result, this could be a new ray of hope for those who have been suffering from the problem of 'hair loss' for a long time.

Headline_English: New app coming to market to protect against muggings - Palau
Content_English: In Dhaka city, which is suffering from a chronic disease like robbery, 1,108 accused have been released on bail in 3 months. This is like eating ice cream while suffering from a cold. There are already many famous areas in Dhaka city for robbery, there are certain overpasses or alleys. Even if you can return home with your life here, it is very difficult to return with your belongings. A renowned IT company of the country is going to launch a special app called 'Palao'. For now, robbery-prone areas have been marked in the beta version, and if you go near the border of these areas, you will receive a call to warn people. Specially trained representatives have been kept to repeatedly prohibit the call center. In a detailed conversation with the developer team of the Palao app, the eRK team came to know that they were working on this app after a developer's phone was stolen. Seeing that there is no other way to escape from a robbery than to run away, the name has been given to 'Palao'. They said that they will come up with more features in the future. Kamal, who has been robbed 13 times in 12 months in Mohammadpur, said that the Palao app may be able to protect unfortunate people like him from robbery in the coming days. He feels that if the Palao app is launched before going to the area and the location of the robbers is warned, then more benefits will be obtained. Meanwhile, there are various discussions about this app in the robbery community. When our team contacted the robbers through a brother because they are afraid of losing their phones if they go for a direct interview, they said that these are never enough to prevent robbery. There are robberies, there will be robberies, robbery is life. If they can make a new app, will we sit still or not? If necessary, we will launch the Thekao app. We will offer online robbery, people will work for us and rob us. For now, many conscious citizens have demanded that TV channels for Dhaka city should provide robbery forecasts along with the weather forecast. According to them, it would be convenient to know the robbery rate on different streets of Dhaka, and when, where and to what extent robberies occur.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman submits form to participate in DUCSU elections
Content_English: The nomination form for the DUCSU election has started. The surprise came from far abroad. Dhaka University student Tarique Rahman is participating in this DUCSU election. Tarique Rahman, a student of the International Relations Department of Dhaka University, has been abroad for many years, Dr. Muhammad Yunus and the election are not saying anything right, it is not clear what will happen. It is known from his close sources that he is participating in the DUCSU election mainly to increase his connection with the students in the current situation of the country. When the eRK team contacted someone close to him, it was learned that Tarique Rahman will participate in the election to remove the long-standing rust from his political life. Like everyone else, it is being considered to campaign for the election on Facebook for now. Later, there is a desire to campaign for JAKSU from all over the country. Lampposts have been initially asked for, if that is not available, then donations of geometry boxes as a symbol of education have been asked. Lampposts are being asked for in order to run a comprehensive education program in DU, so that education can be done from the classroom to the street. Students are quite excited about the news of Tarique Rahman's submission of the form. They believe that if such a leader becomes the VP, everything will change. Tarique Rahman will bring a new political trend, surpassing everything in the past. Leaders will first prove themselves in the academic arena, then prove themselves in the National Parliament, many believe that this is how it should be. It is known that all the dormant, secret, hidden, and published organizations have become a little shaken because Tarique Rahman is going to come to the DUCSU campus. It has been decided in internal meetings that if necessary, all the panels will unite, everyone is ready to give a tough fight. We will see on election day, in the ballot battle. When we tried to contact Mr. Tarique Rahman, the eRK team was given a link to a Zoom meeting. Since the internet speed is 10 kilobytes, we have not been able to contact him yet, but we were told in an email that I am very optimistic, I hope I will be the VP in this DUCSU election.

Headline_English: DUCSU elections: Which party are bot voters leaning towards?
Content_English: The excitement surrounding the DUCSU elections at Dhaka University is now not only at the tea tables of the TSC or the hall, but also among the 'already logged in' bot IDs on Facebook. While voters on campus are still undecided, bot voters have already made their position clear. This time, the most excitement surrounding this election is not among real voters, but among bot voters. There are no posters in the hall, no processions in the field, but there is such a dominance in the Facebook newsfeed as if only they will vote for DUCSU. A brother from Shibir has so many bot IDs that he gets into arguments with himself every day in the comment box. After posting 20-30 comments, you realize that he has been arguing with himself all this time! A DUCSU member told us from his fake ID, we are worried about the votes of bots. How will they vote, in which line will the bots stand when they go to the polling station on election day? Or will they vote while sitting at home! Or will they only save democracy by giving the WiFi password? Although Shibir's bots are creating public opinion on social media, so that there is an opportunity to vote online. One such Shibir worker told us from his fake ID, "Just give the bots a chance to vote for once. You will see, out of 40,000 voters in DUCSU, only our party will get 80,000 votes!" The Chhatra Dal's bot army is also not less. They are mainly active after 3 am. Then suddenly 50 IDs are seen writing together, 'The time has come, we want change.' However, in the morning, those bots fall asleep again, and the real Chhatra Dal brothers are sitting alone on Facebook. Chhatra League's bots are suffering from a bit of indecision. Many of them are still unable to decide where to vote. However, Shibir and Chhatra Dal are trying to attract these votes to themselves. However, a Chhatra League bot ID told us, "I don't understand whether it is right to vote or not! We are now emigrants. There is not even that much interest in voting! In the last 16 years, I have voted alone, but not as many votes on your campus!"

Headline_English: Nostalgic Awami League workers, after seeing BNP's fight, request to organize dummy fights
Content_English: Recently, BNP party leaders and activists, like the Awami League, are getting involved in fights themselves. Seeing these fights between BNP leaders and activists, Awami League workers are remembering the old days, and many are nostalgically posting the song 'Age Ki Sundar Din Kataitam' and 'Purno Sey Din Kotha' on their Facebook. A senior Awami League worker said in an emotional response, "Ah! What a beautiful day it was! We used to beat ourselves up, chase each other. How empty my chest feels seeing the BNP's fights these days. Who else can understand the pain of losing the right to fight like this more than us?" He said. And due to this nostalgia, they recently requested other political parties to organize a 'dummy fight'. An Awami League volunteer leader said confidently, "When we are successfully organizing dummy elections, then doing dummy fights is a completely left-handed job. Just as I act when I enter the polling booth, I will go on stage and fight for show. I just want cameras and an audience." However, there are also thoughts on controlling the quality of fights. For this, a special training manual is being prepared - which will include who should be grabbed by the hair first, who should be slapped on the cheek in slow motion, and which chair is more photogenic to break. On the other hand, BNP workers say that if we want to fight in a free-style way, we need to practice first. This is a tough challenge for the Awami League.

Headline_English: The unpublished diary of Moonwalker Neil Armstrong
Content_English: A blue diary of Neil Armstrong, the first person in human history to walk on the moon, has been found. After returning from the moon, he wrote various things at various times, spoke at meetings and seminars. Among his many lost writings, Neil's fans said that the importance of this diary is immense. It is already understood that only Neil Armstrong could have thought of such a thing in the history of mankind, even if he was the first person to set foot on the moon. Across the pages of the diary, Neil Armstrong wrote that after going to the moon, he was first looking for a church to pray to the Creator. Not getting such an opportunity, he was very sad and decided that he would have to build one after returning to Earth. It is unacceptable that people go to the moon with so much difficulty, but there is no church to pray in, this is unacceptable. Any religious person would want to go to the moon and pray a little and express gratitude to the Creator. Across the pages of the diary, Neil Armstrong drew a design of how to build a church on the moon. He wrote that he got a lot of encouragement after sharing his ideas with different people. A billionaire reassured him and said, "You start building the church, I will arrange the money." They left the office with a lot of morale. Neil Armstrong had almost sorted out the plan. He set out with money, materials, and labor and would build the church within a year. He even convinced someone who could copy Michelangelo's work for the mosaic design. However, due to obstacles, the person who wanted to pay stopped paying midway through the work. Neil Armstrong died leaving the work unfinished. There is still some left. You can finish the work if you want. Armstrong is no more, but we have his diary. If you want, you can send any money you want to the Armstrong Foundation's bKash number. For more details, contact the Armstrong Church Foundation's verified Facebook page.

Headline_English: A spin-off series of the modern Bengali Hotel series, Han Ser Saloon episode, is coming.
Content_English: A new surprise is coming to the Bangladeshi web content world again. A spin-off series of the much-discussed episode of the modern Bengali hotel series 'Hanser Salon' is coming. Judging by the audience's demand and the market situation, it has been initially named 'Hanser Salon - What the Duck.' Many are guessing that this is not just a series, but a cultural revolution for duck lovers and those deprived of duck. The producers said that the shooting of the series will be on the one hand in Nila Bazar, where a small civil war breaks out every day over the price of duck meat, and on the other hand in Hotel Westin, where ducks are usually seen only on the buffet table. The central character of the story will be a young leader, vigorous in age but completely dependent on ducks in mind. After daily political programs, processions, meetings and invitations from leaders and activists, his only desire is a duck feast. At first, he goes to Nila Hotel and is filled with hope, but when he does not get duck there, he completely loses his mental balance. Driven by frustration, anger, and extreme hunger, he finally took the path of Westin. The production company said that the search is still on for the main character. The condition is that the age must be below 25, so that the character's youthful image can be maintained. However, age alone is not enough; political experience will be considered an additional qualification.

Headline_English: Lapatta Ladies is being remade; new name is Lapatta Stone
Content_English: In this era of global technology, there is no room for keeping anything a secret. All the demands and supplies are being leaked instantly to the international arena of Bangladesh, including Facebook. Emma Stone and Sharon Stone have expressed their interest in coming to Sylhet for love after hearing about the demand for stone in Sylhet's white stone. Emma said on her Facebook page, "I am overwhelmed! I have never heard of such love and demand for stone in my lifetime. I want to come to Bangladesh. Although I am a little nervous about getting a visa to Bangladesh as my passport has gone down, I have heard that many people come here for love in quota. I also want to come. My first project after coming to Sylhet will be 'Lapatta Stone'." He said that he has already made a list of some milky stone lifters as well as carefree method actors for its casting. Referring to the title track, 'Ae Mon Amar Pathar To Nay', Emma said that the song will be sung by Joss Stone, and Oliver Stone may be in the production. Thanking the policymakers of Bangladesh, Sharon said, "We didn't know that we were in such demand outside of Hollywood. If I get a good opportunity, I can stay here." Expressing her hope to become a stone advisor, renowned singer Joss Stone said, "As a Sanskrit person, my heart cries for the environment. I can constantly look at stones. I have immense love for stones. Moreover, stones are a symbol of love for me. So I have full support for using them personally. She especially thanked the authorities for making arrangements to safely remove the stones instead of leaving them in such an open way. Even though they are stones, they are human beings."

Headline_English: Landlords have cleverly increased the rent of all houses by 10%.
Content_English: A BNP leader said that his beloved leader Tarique Rahman does not have a place to live in Dhaka city. He is said to be looking for a house. The news of Tarique Rahman's search for a house spread across the city in an instant. Then a miracle happened. It is known that all the landlords in Dhaka have increased the rent by 10% after receiving this news. Why or for what reason did they increase it? Most of the landlords did not want to talk to us about this matter. One said, brother, if you mention your name now or talk about it, then if the power changes later, you will not have a job. When you rent a house, you say, I will add 10%. Otherwise, you will be fired. Go to London! Another landlord sees the matter as risk management. He said, we are increasing it in advance so that even if we have to pay someone 10% later, the money can be adjusted. You know, there is no harm in being careful. You can call it, 10% fried in 10% oil!

Headline_English: I am proud that I have been able to bring vote rigging to international level: Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: Recently, Congress leader Rahul Gandhi in India alleged that the BJP and the Election Commission (EC) had jointly stolen votes in the 2024 Indian Lok Sabha elections. Although this has caused a stir in the Indian political scene, a festive atmosphere has begun in Sheikh Hasina's Lutyens Bungalow. In a leaked phone conversation, Hasina is heard saying, I have been giving pro-level performances in the country for a long time, but it was a dream to take it to the international stage. Finally, Modi bro's hand has made that happen, bro has maintained my standards. I am proud that I have been able to take vote rigging to the international level. If vote rigging continues like this, I can also win elections in West Bengal by forming an alliance with the BJP, cheers. On the other hand, while celebrating this event, Hasina's son Joy, who came live from the United States with red water in his hand, said, "I had said earlier that what will happen to the people of Bangladesh after us is not our business, Avi Bharat ka jangan ke baremei sef hum sochenge, khela hobe, peace." Meanwhile, some voters from West Bengal also expressed their excitement and said, "If Bangladeshi technology comes here, then on the day of the election, brother, I will be able to eat mutton kasha and sleep comfortably. I don't like going to vote with such difficulty anymore. But yes brother, you will vote during the day, but if you vote at night, you will miss your vacation again."

Headline_English: GUPT movie sequel coming, plot Bangladesh
Content_English: A sequel to Bollywood's classic mystery-thriller film GUPT (1997) is coming, but this time the plot is no longer stuck in a fantasy or a love-crime of an aristocratic family. This time the backdrop is Bangladesh, and the subject matter is secret politics. The director has said that this time the thrill of the film will come from the cramped rooms of the hostel, midnight tea shops, and social media bot accounts. The hero Lord Bobby Deol of the previous film will be in a special cameo role. However, the producers have said that Bangladeshi actors and actresses will be cast in the main characters of the film. However, there is a special condition here - at least three years of experience in secret politics within other student organizations while hiding their names and identities, and it is also necessary to have a few bot accounts. It is even better if you have experience in cash laundering. Since the news about the casting of the film spread, leaders and activists of a student organization known as the Picasso of secret politics have been seen holding 'secret joy processions' in various campuses of the country including Dhaka, Chittagong, and Sylhet. A secret marcher, overcome with joy, said, "We have been writing scripts for a long time, now Bollywood is coming and taking our story - it is a matter of pride. However, we want to remain secret so that our names are not mentioned in the credits of the film as well." The film's directors, however, said that it does not end here, they are so excited about the plot of Bangladesh that they are also planning to create a super-secret universe like Bollywood's Marvel Universe.

Headline_English: There is no talk of overt politics, but I condemn the cessation of secret politics - Chandragupta Maurya
Content_English: Last night, the DU administration took a landmark decision to ban both covert and overt politics in the residential halls of Dhaka University. Although this decision has received mixed reactions on campus, the most surprising reaction came from the former emperor of the Maurya Empire, Chandragupta Maurya. Emperor Chandragupta said in an urgent press release, "I have nothing to say about stopping overt politics, everyone does that. But stopping covert politics? This is a direct blow to our tradition. Our name is still on the lips of Bengal because of the covert politics of the Shibir, what will happen to us if we abandon covert politics now? I strongly condemn it. Besides, the Maurya Empire was founded on covert activities. At that time, I sat on the throne after removing the Nanda dynasty from power through the secret conspiracy and covert policies of Chanakya. Now if DU stops covert politics, where will the future Chandragups be born? I hope the DU VC will think about it while listening to Pink Floyd in private. A student involved in secret politics at the university told us, we don't understand why everyone jumps at the word 'secret'. Secret doesn't always mean bad. Just as secret wealth isn't bad, spies sometimes save the country. So why is secret politics so dangerous? Not only them, but also those with the 'secret' title in Dhaka city are terrified by this decision. A man named Shyamal Gupta from Mohammadpur said, people don't let me get on the bus because of my name now. I'm not a political person, I wasn't allowed to enter the DU campus for two days just because of my name, and even when I tried to get on the bus, they closed the door.

Headline_English: Palak, Salman and Anisul are preparing for a class at 3 am in the prison.
Content_English: Professor Dr. Nazmul Ahsan Kalimullah, former vice-chancellor of Begum Rokeya University, has been arrested. Everyone thinks that the atmosphere of Dhaka Central Jail is going to get a new lease of life with his arrival. The once busy and talked about leaders—Palak, Salman, Anisul and others—were spending unproductive time in jail for a long time, and Kalimullah's arrest has become a beacon of light for them. When he was the vice-chancellor of Berobi, Kalimullah used to take classes at 3 am. He firmly believed that studying at this mystical hour would easily penetrate his mind. Quiet nights, sleepless eyes and a cup of tea—this was his academic environment. Now, the students of the jail are also ready to share that unique experience. Junayed Ahmed Palak said with great regret, I have been out of school for a long time. Everyone thinks that there is a library, TV, VIP service in the jail—you can study if you want. But we Bengalis - no one like Kalim Master can concentrate on studying without a cane. Maybe if he comes to jail, he will be able to bring back his true focus. On the other hand, Salman F. Rahman also says with a cheerful heart, "It has been my dream for many days to sit down to study before Subha Sadiq. I have always wanted to sit down and study alone after Tahajjud at night. But sleep would come again and again. And there is so much noise at home and outside during the day, my mind cannot concentrate. Kalim Master is that 3 am person, this is the time we wanted. Who else is the perfect teacher for us like him? The leaders of the jail now want to do a 'strategic study' on what to do in the future. They believe that under Kalimullah's supervision, they will start a new political renaissance. Classes will start at 3 am, and sleep will run away with national thoughts! Meanwhile, Professor Kalimullah is a bit sad that he is going to jail. It seems that the 364 days of a thief and the 1 day of a saint are the same, you can understand just by looking at him. After being caught by the detective, Professor Kalimullah rolled on the dirt floor, abused the police, and then calmed down and said, "Let's go, there's no more movement." The countrymen hope that having such a big master in the prison will bring about a radical change in the prison. Just as the Awami League will be able to plan their future from here, the common people will also be educated and come out of the prison and work for the development of the country. The superintendent of the Central Jail has said that we are going to bring such a master who will start a new trend in the country. I am also thinking about whether we can have a tag line for the prison like 'Come in with a stolen leather jacket, come out educated'.

Headline_English: Tapas is devastated after the call record was leaked, crying and demanding justice from Hasumoni
Content_English: Former Dhaka South City Corporation Mayor Sheikh Fazle Noor Taposh has fallen into a deep mental breakdown over the call record leak. Despite being Bangabandhu's grandson and Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's own nephew, he said he feels completely alone and neglected in such a humiliating conspiracy. In an emotional situation on Sunday night, Taposh called Hasumoni Apa, known as the moral guardian of the country, crying and seeking justice. At the beginning, he said, Hasumoni, I have no one else but you. I am a failure, aunt... In the end, they are cleaning us up by thinking of us as waste. At some point, he broke down in tears and said, aunt, I wanted to go to Singapore to see an example of the country's advanced waste management. I am Bangabandhu's grandson, insulting me means a deviation from Bangabandhu's ideals in the country. Is this the honor that the Sheikh family deserves? Did I bring independence for this call record leak? First your escape video, then my call record leaked—can't we escape with a little personal freedom? On the contrary, despite Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's repeated consolation, Tapash's uncle could not stop crying. However, there are rumors that she told Tapash, nephew, stop crying. I will allocate a waste management budget for you again in the future. And whoever did this, I will 'tup' him in the South China Sea through Interpol and bring him back—because Buriganga and Padma are now in Yunus' possession.

Headline_English: 'Disability Pain Day' is being observed in various places including Delhi, Kolkata, New York
Content_English: Today is August 5. That black day in the history of the Awami League. A year ago, on this day, Sheikh Hasina and her close leaders fled the country in a mass uprising. While 'Autocracy Free Day' is being celebrated across Bangladesh on this day of the fall of the dictatorship, 'The Day of the Pain of Losing Power' is being celebrated in different parts of the world including Delhi, Kolkata, and New York in a different atmosphere. A 'Mass Crying in the Pain of Losing Power' event has been organized in a hotel box in Lajpat Nagar, Delhi. There, Awami League expatriate leaders are hugging each other and crying - some are saying, Alas, my golden egg-laying duck, another is crying and shouting, I also had a project, I left it behind. Meanwhile, a different arrangement is being organized in New York. A special 'Lalpani Utsav' has been organized to relieve the 'mental burden of losing power'. Hasina's son Joy, who said in a video message, "When power is gone, morale should not be lost." Cheers! A fake report in the New York Times claims that some former ministers are so broken that they searched ‘How to make a coup from abroad’ 73 times on Google. However, the most emotional moment comes during the ‘Live from Delhi’ program. The mother of humanity, Sheikh Hasina, came live and first said, ‘What is my crime, what did I or my family not give to Bangladesh?’ I had made arrangements so that on election day, I would not have to go out of my house to vote. When the country was being swept away by the tide of development and progress, the children of the Razakar broke the well-organized power system like in my Bengali movies.

Headline_English: Politicians from all over the world head to UK to learn e-politics, classes to be held in London
Content_English: A new type of political education institution has been launched in a quiet corner of London—its name is ‘Desneta e-Politics Learning School’. Its founder and chief instructor is Tarique Rahman, the pioneer of virtual politics and the only leading figure of the ‘Screenpath’ movement. It is said that Tarique Rahman is the first person in Bangladeshi politics who has successfully proven that it is not necessary to touch the soil of the country to conduct politics. It is possible to conduct not only speeches but also the entire politics from not the road, but from the screen. He has been active in Bangladeshi politics for a long time, sitting in London, trying to win the hearts of workers by attending meetings and gatherings via video call—so now he wants to spread that experience as education among interested leaders around the world. The school authorities have said that all such invaluable techniques will be taught here that will help you become a successful leader even without entering the field of politics. Some of the popular courses here are: Zoom Call Speech and Rajpath Shaking Technique (how to express yourself in front of thousands of people from within a single screen, that is the main lesson of this course) London Patriotism 100/100 (how to establish yourself as a great patriot of the country even while living abroad, that extraordinary strategy will be taught here) Online Normal Life (how to live a "safe and carefree life" with political asylum, and to present it as a 'struggle' on social media - this course will have its details) There will also be a special guest lecture, titled - Running a Country Abroad: Tips and Tricks. This session will be discussed by experienced personalities from the International Forum of Exile Specialists, who are very busy with the future of their country despite being away from their own country for many years. There is a 10% discount for Bangladeshi politicians at this school. The classes will be held live in multiple seminar rooms in London, but for those who cannot attend, there will be the convenience of recorded classes—you can learn leadership lessons from the comfort of your own home, open your laptop, and enjoy them. At the end of the training, each participant will be given a Certified Remote Leader (CRL) badge, which will help future virtual leaders build themselves into 'modern virtual leaders' by adding them to their profiles on Facebook, X (formerly Twitter), Instagram, and LinkedIn.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina is proud of the Indian government for giving Shah Rukh Khan the National Award for acting.
Content_English: Just as Bollywood lovers are elated by the news that Shah Rukh Khan is being recognized as the best actor at the National Film Awards in India, Sheikh Hasina, who is in hiding in Lutyens' Delhi, is spending the night in extreme distress. Claiming herself to be a 'skilled actress and a true Bharat devotee', Hasina said, "Day after day, I have spoken in front of my people, spoken with tears in my eyes, and even improvised without a script at times. But the Indian government has not appreciated this performance even a little! How long have I been acting without any remuneration?" Hasina, indignant at not receiving the award, also posted Mithila's famous meme, "Oh, now I'm old, right?" on her X (Twitter) account. Meanwhile, the incident has created a huge impact on the Hasina family. Burning with anger, Sheikh Hasina's son Joy went live on Facebook after swallowing a special bottle of red water. In the video, he said in a trembling voice, "How can the country for which my mother served day after day, suffering the pain of losing her relatives, give an award to a two-day-old son, Shahrukh?" Now, what will happen to the people of India is not a matter for my mother, me or my family. We will only think about the people of Nepal now." However, a spokesperson for the Awami League fugitive wing in India said, "We don't need these Indian awards, our pain of losing our relatives is an Oscar or Cannes-level performance. We have already sent your name to the Oscar and Cannes jury committees for international recognition. Even if you don't get the Nobel, we will get you one of these two awards." However, some leaders and activists of the Awami League fugitive wing took out a protest march on the streets of Delhi, angry at the lack of recognition for Sheikh Hasina's acting. While marching, they shouted slogans like "We will peel off Shahrukh's skin," but the police chased them, and later they fled from Jar Jar Obasan.

Headline_English: Passport strengthening project, interim importing iron
Content_English: They are constantly getting their visas rejected in different countries. However, based on this complaint, the country's leading newspaper recently published news that Bangladesh's passport has been strengthened. The interim government has admitted to this project to strengthen the passport. They said that the government is already thinking of importing iron from Uganda to strengthen the passport. A separate iron plate is being added to the passport. The interim government said that now people can be beaten to death with a passport. However, they have requested everyone not to hit anyone with a passport. When talking to a government representative in this regard, he said that our passport has become stronger than before. Currently, our passport can be used in 39 countries without a visa. We have also undertaken a project to make our passport heavier and stronger with better quality materials. In this regard, it is known from special sources that the interim government is recently importing iron from abroad to add to the passport, which will make the passport heavier and stronger. We hope that the immigration of a country will give us entry by taking this passport in hand and checking its weight. If not, entry can be gained by using that heavy passport as a weapon and cracking the head of the immigration officer. What is the plan if the passport is not strong even after applying iron? To our question, a broker at the passport office said, "If the iron does not work, we are thinking of getting the passport admitted to Sohel Taj's gym. Let's see, where does it go if it is not strong after that!"

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader on track to become richest Telegram entrepreneur, Elon Musk is worried
Content_English: Silicon Valley is shaking with the news of a new name appearing in the world's richest list. No, not a new technology entrepreneur or AI innovator, but former Road and Communications Minister Obaidul Quader is in the race to become the richest person on this journey. Currently, this leader is in 'fugitive mode from Zar Zar Obasan' in India. However, a report published in an investigative media has revealed that even while on the run, this Awami League leader is taking money from party leaders and activists at a specific rate in the name of talking to Hasina on Telegram. Not only that, he has already patented this innovative business model called 'Telegram through Trusted Tunnel to Talk to Leadership'. As a result, not only in Bangladesh, but anywhere in the world, if any domestic leaders and activists 'fugitive from Zar Zar Obasan' want to earn income from the same system, they will also get royalties from there. This news has caused the biggest headache for Tesla and SpaceX owner Elon Musk. He has already shared the meme ‘My body is shaking with fear’ on his X account. Meanwhile, Forbes, analyzing Obaidul Quader’s income stream, said in a report, ‘He forwards an average of 893 Telegram messages a day. Each message contains an offer like ‘You are sure to speak, come to the inbox’. There is now a rush among Telegram entrepreneurs worldwide to learn ‘Quader’s Method’. Several coaching centers have already opened in Bangladesh, among which ‘Quader’s Telegram Hack’ and ‘Line to Leader in Seven Days’ have already received a lot of response among political activists. It is even heard that Mark Zuckerberg is also thinking of launching the ‘Messenger Minister Connect’ feature on Facebook, so that he does not fall behind at least in the future.

Headline_English: A new party is coming - All-Party Extortionist Party (Sachapa)
Content_English: Keeping the slogan 'Extortionist-Free Party' in mind, all parties are going to jointly form a new supplementary party, the All-Party Extortionist Party (Sachapa). This new party is going to debut very soon with the extortionists of all the existing political parties in Bangladesh. Regardless of party affiliation, this is like a new heaven for those who are skilled in extortion. The country's media is full of news about the extortion of BNP, NCP and Jamaat, so that the character of the parties is being stained in the new settlement, which cannot be erased even with Surf Excel. Political parties are getting into trouble with the people due to the flood of donations in the name of funding through car windows, donations through digital fundraising, donations from temp stands, donations in the name of Baitul Mal, etc. That is why prominent intellectuals of the parties are holding meeting after meeting to bring this new party. It is being heard that this new party will be formed with the acclaimed extortionists of each party. The responsibility of this party will be to collect donations at the rate of 10% from every business establishment, shop, new construction work, etc. in every region of the country. Then, this donation will be divided among each party according to the order of representation in the parliament through the peer system. As a result, all the responsibility of extortion will go to this new party. And no party will have to take the trouble of expelling any dedicated party worker on charges of extortion. A leader of an already existing political party has announced that from today, there will be no extortionists in our party. Many aspirants have already started lobbying for senior positions in the party. It is being heard that a prominent stone trader is running for the post of party convener with a manifesto containing his extortion life story. Extortionists are also happy to have a new party. One such extortionist said, it feels good to have a new party. Even though we are extortionists, we also have the desire to serve the country. But I cannot do that service because I have been expelled from the party for two consecutive days. This extortionist also said that our party has only one rule. Anyone who cannot extort 30 times in a month will be expelled from our party. As soon as the news of the 'Chanda Bhai' app was received, there is a flood of joy among domestic extortionists. It is also known that some of the extortionists are giving digbazis in joy. The creator of the app said that they have been receiving an incredible response since the launch of the app. On the first day of the app launch, about 1 million downloads were received. They hope that 'Chanda Bhai' will become popular among extortionists abroad and beyond the borders of the country.

Headline_English: The demand to remove CCTV from Gulshan houses is a demand of the entire Bengali extortionist society, regardless of party or opinion.
Content_English: A terrible accident occurred on a peaceful, extortionist-friendly evening in Gulshan - a leader was caught on CCTV camera. Just as a 'gentleman' was caught on CCTV while extorting money, his past has also been caught. His smiling pictures with leaders of various political parties have already gone viral. The All Bengal Extortionists' Society has expressed strong anger over this incident. According to them, having so many CCTVs in an elite area like Gulshan is immoral and against the fundamental rights of extortionists. Once, people could raise their hands in this area without fear and ask for whatever they wanted, now they do not feel safe because everyone has installed cameras. A spokesperson for the coordinating society said, our activities are being seen on CCTV, is this acceptable in a democratic society? If this continues, the new generation will lose interest in the extortion profession in the future. The extortionists' society has also informed that they are also planning to stage a human chain and a symbolic play 'I will not play if there are cameras' on this issue. According to special sources, extortionists have already contacted some popular YouTubers and requested them to make some videos teaching ninja techniques for extortion even with CCTV.

Headline_English: Putin claims to be the mastermind of the Russian Revolution
Content_English: The number of masterminds in Bangladesh has increased dramatically after the recent July uprising. It is as if the country has become self-sufficient in producing masterminds. Political analysts say that there are not as many masterminds in the country now as there are masters. The most recent mastermind has emerged as Jamaat-e-Islami's Ameer Shafiqur Rahman. A Jamaat leader declared him the mastermind of this coup at a Jamaat rally in Suhrawardy Udyan. Whether inspired by the declaration or burning with jealousy, Russian President Vladimir Putin could not hold himself back this time. In a special speech from the Kremlin, he said, if anyone can be a mastermind in Bangladesh, then I am the President of Russia. Although I was not born during the Russian Revolution, as a Russian, I had the master plan for this revolution in my head. Putin also claimed that during the 1917 revolution, he traveled through time and stood next to Lenin. When Lenin got off the train, I was making tea for him. I myself gave Trotsky and Stalin the content plan, — said an emotional Putin. However, not only Bangladesh or Russia, but also world politics have seen a wave of this new mastermind claim. Already, French President Macron has claimed himself as the “fourth architect of the French Revolution,” and Donald Trump has said, I am the real mastermind of America’s independence against the British. George Washington was just my project manager.

Headline_English: Rashmika Mandanna congratulated
Content_English: In this hot weather, despite the unpredictable rain, Rashmika Mandan has extended her best wishes to all those who will come to the Jamaat's grand rally to be held at Suhrawardy Udyan from faraway Kushtia district. If she had the opportunity, she would have come as the brand ambassador of the 'Kushtia-3' constituency, but due to the mental anguish of not being able to come due to visa complications, she decided to reduce her food intake and go on a one-day diet. She said, "My best wishes for Mufti Amir Hamza will be in all his rallies, non-rallies, all chats, non-chats, and all demand-making movements." Rashmika believes that even if she cannot come to this rally, she will be present in her heart. The gathering of the mind is the biggest gathering. She requested Amir Hamza to stay close to the law enforcement officers at the rally, especially near the tanker. Rashmika said, "If the party needs a theme song or item song, Nenu Nito Unnanu (I am by your side)!" He said with a slight tremor that he would still have 'Two Eyes on Suhrawardy' even though he was shooting, and that he really wanted to vote. The elections are in December... that's when his internet connection went down.

Headline_English: Emraan Hashmi leaves for Suhrawardy Udyan
Content_English: Today, Bollywood's serial kisser Emraan Hashmi has left for Suhrawardy Udyan amidst the Jamaat rally. Speculations about kissing have started surrounding Hashmi's arrival during the Jamaat-e-Islami rally. In general, fans are thinking that Imraan Hashmi may be coming at the invitation of the kiss specialist Jamaat Ameer. However, putting an end to these speculations, Hashmi clearly stated, "No, brother, I am coming for a walk. Just to get some air. How can my career be fulfilled without kissing in a park with so many trees?" Hashmi also told reporters that he did not come for any political purpose. But the interesting thing is that in between each answer, he himself says three times - kiss, kiss, kiss. There have also been mixed reactions among Jamaat workers on the issue. While some are happy with the arrival of the 'serial kisser', a senior leader of the organization said on condition of anonymity, "We are not really interested in kisses, but in techniques. However, if Hashmi Bhai wants to train us, we want to let him know that we have even bigger experts in our team." Meanwhile, the police members on duty at the park have imposed the "romantic 57" section as soon as they received the news of Emraan Hashmi's arrival. In addition, the police's 'special kiss-control squad' has been deployed.

Headline_English: Trump interested in establishing peace in Gopalganj
Content_English: When the entire district turned into a battlefield after the Chhatra League and Awami League attacked the NCP rally in Gopalganj, Donald Trump, the peace dove of world politics, announced in broken Bengal, "Hami will bring peace to Gopalganj." In an emergency press briefing at the White House, Trump said, "I am stopping Iran-Israel, stopping India-Pakistan, now the target is Gopalganj. My goal is clear, to bring peace there and ensure the Nobel Prize." As an initial step to bring peace, Trump wants to make some banned Chhatra League leaders who are absconding from their respective states in America feel like big brothers by making them live guest rooms like Zelensky. In the next step, he himself is planning a 'field trip' - a visit to Gopalganj. However, he does not want to be 'Trump' on this visit, but to come in a new identity. He is thinking of changing his name to 'Donald Gopalsingh Trump', so that the message of peace sounds more 'local'. Meanwhile, the people of Gopalganj are a bit hesitant about the matter. A local tea vendor said, "We see a lot of things, but seeing Trump in Gopalganj is worth living for." However, a local leader of the banned Chhatra League expressed doubts about Trump's arrival and said, "I am very much in pain from losing my relatives, I don't want the pain of losing the district this time. Let the last vestige of fascism remain in Gopalganj, we don't want peace."

Headline_English: Updated version of Steve Jobs' iPhone targets landlord's grandchildren
Content_English: Apple launches a new version of the iPhone every year at a high price. Its price is so high that it is equal to a few months' salary of the maximum middle class of Bangladesh. Even so, the sales of the new version of the iPhone in Bangladesh are on the rise. This is the subject of various criticisms in the capital market, among the proletariat in the communist neighborhood, and what is called a discussion in the language of intellectuals. But who actually buys such an expensive phone? Apple founder Steve Jobs spoke to us at Rupayan Tower in Nakhalpara to answer all these complex questions. In response to the question, Steve Jobs said, this updated version is not for the middle class like you. You are poor, you eat rice four times a day. Our special target for this phone is the grandchildren of the landlord family of Bangladesh. For example, Shasha Khan, the grandson of Baro Bhuiyan Isa Khan of Bengal, bought the new version of the iPhone from us, for 158 mohars. Apart from this, Emperor Akbar's grandson Emperor Shah Jahan, Prasannakumar Mitra's grandson Rabindranath Tagore were also present. In this regard, Rabindranath said in his famous Ashadh poem, "In the blue sky, there is no more sesame in the sky, there is no more Ashadh, there is no more Ashadh, I want my Apple phone in a hurry." I know about history, but do you have such landlord customers in the current era of economic recession? Hearing this, the Apple representative got excited and started jumping around. He sternly warned us, why do you listen to me, poor people! You don't even keep track of the fact that there are thousands of landlords' grandchildren in your country. A few days ago, a landlord's grandson was touring the area with a fleet of cars! These are our Bangladeshi customers. These are the grandchildren of our landlord, these are pieces of our Apple. A recent post on Facebook revealed that random people are stopping their cars on the road and giving people lakhs of taka, some are giving iPhones. Recently, one such iPhone case came to light. When the grandson of a landowner asked an Apple employee about this iPhone, he initially tried to avoid the question by calling us friends of the Awami League. Later, when we showed him our July Movement fighter certificate, he said, "Look, there's no point in doing so much politics! My grandfather has enough money to buy 30-40 such iPhones. My grandmother also has it. My grandmother gave me this phone."

Headline_English: Madrid fans complain that PSG fans are going door to door demanding donations
Content_English: The mood of PSG fans has changed since they crushed Real Madrid 4-0 in the Club World Cup. They have suddenly started appearing as fans of fish donations on various streets of Europe. The Tempustands built by fans on the streets of Madrid are now under the control of PSG. Not only taking over, there have been allegations that they have started going door to door demanding donations. A Madrid fan said that earlier thieves used to come at night, now PSG fans come. And they come and say - you could not even score a goal in the Club World Cup, now donate a little, it will be needed for the development of football. However, it is not just Madrid, but Liverpool, Bayern, and even Galatasaray fans have also complained that they have also been included in the PSG fans' donation list. When contacted about this, a PSG official said - our president gives instructions every day on e-mail calls. He warned us and said, 'We are not in favor of these vugichugi. At least 10% of those caught doing this will be fired. The remaining 90% will be warned on WhatsApp. We have been oppressed for so long, everything has been open to us, so our workers will also do this openly, no, we will not allow this amateur crime culture to happen on the streets of Europe. At one point in the speech, the official suddenly hung up while singing the reverse version of Khairul Basar's popular song 'Opene ar kam chali na kam hobe sab gopne'.

Headline_English: Proposal to allocate stone symbol to BNP in upcoming elections
Content_English: Jubo Dal leaders and activists killed a businessman by smashing his head with a stone in the Mitford Hospital area of ​​Dhaka after not receiving a bribe. This brutal incident has created intense public anger. However, the issue was not limited to public anger—the Election Commission was shaken immediately after the murder. The commission's policymakers have started thinking of a new symbol for the BNP, which has been elected with the paddy sheaf symbol for a long time. A trusted source within the Election Commission said that a proposal to allocate the 'stone mark' as a new symbol was made in a high-level meeting of the commission with the idea that 'paddy sheafs are no longer working'. According to the source, after analyzing the BNP's recent political language, field-level strategy and public-related activities, several members of the commission believe that the paddy sheaf can no longer convey the true nature of the party. An Election Commission official, who did not want to be named, said that the symbol is actually a reflection of the party's ideology and activities. In the current reality of BNP, the way they are implementing the 'strict program' on the field, the grain of rice has become completely irrelevant. Now the symbol needs a little reality. That reality, which people are seeing with their eyes - stones. He further added, our goal is that voters should find a match between the symbol and the party's activities. BNP's recent tactic of using stones has fascinated us.

Headline_English: Kolkata Herbal wants to conduct research with a special team, wants to make special medicines
Content_English: When they play, it seems like a domino effect is on the batsmen of the Bangladesh cricket team. When one wicket falls, the wickets of the others also fall quickly. The speed of their wickets falling is so fast that they are out faster than the performance of such Bengali men on the bed. This time, Kolkata Herbal wants to research a special team, to make a special medicine so that the team can be saved from this rapid decline in the future. The company claims that the reason for entering the field this time on this problem is that Bengalis have problems with two things - one in bed, the other with the bat. Since we have been researching the problem of the bed for a long time and have been successful, now let's think about the batting problem as well. Kolkata Herbal spokesperson Dr. Lalon Ghoshal said in a press briefing, we have already named a special capsule - 'Sixteennine Capsule'. By playing this, batsmen will no longer give away 7 wickets for 5 runs. Instead, everyone will be able to score 69 on the field, like a bed. He further said that the main ingredient of the medicine will be mental stabilizer, because our research has shown that many people can bat even if they are not physically fit, but mentally, this tendency of 'if one is out, I have to go too' is very common among Bangladeshi batters. Some batsmen of the national team have agreed to give the first batch of trials, whose batting average is already quite low. However, when a senior batsman was offered a drug trial, he got angry and said, "First look at your face in the mirror, then make the medicine." Another experienced batter said, "I am already on a course of painkillers. Now I will not be able to enter any new medication."

Headline_English: Kazi Maruf wants to act in Advisor Asif's biopic
Content_English: There is no shortage of incidents in the political arena of Bangladesh, and there is no need to imagine making a movie about those incidents—because reality is so much more dramatic here. Recently, the gun magazine recovered from Advisor Asif's bag at the airport has become the talk of the town. After the details of the incident were spread in the media, Kazi Maruf, the hero of the eternal 'black gun' of Bengali action cinema, has expressed his interest in making a biopic of Advisor Asif and acting in it. He has already announced the name of the movie—'Bhule Gun'. Kazi Maruf said, I have handled many guns in my career, but this is the first time I am getting a character who walks around with a gun by mistake. The story of the movie will be based on real events. According to the plot, an honest and patriotic advisor is conducting 'self-reliant weapons training' at his home in addition to politics. One day, he accidentally goes to the airport with a magazine in his bag. Well, international conspiracy, fake news explosion, and 'anti-national item song' begin. It is heard that Advisor Asif himself may play a cameo role in the movie. There will be a scene in his character, where he will raise his hand and say, 'This is just a magazine, I didn't bring a gun!' And that dialogue will later become the movie's trailer tagline. The producer for the movie has not been finalized yet. However, the director said that there is no fear of objection from the Censor Board. In his words, the way things are happening in Bangladesh now, the Censor Board has also become confused - does showing what happens in real life in a movie fall under the scope of censorship?

Headline_English: Donald Trump claims credit for regime change in Panchayat series
Content_English: Former US President Donald Trump suddenly made an explosive claim about the Panchayat series in a live conference at the White House. He called the change of leadership in the village of Phulera in the series 'one of the most successful regime change operations in world history'. He claimed that if it weren't for me, Banaras would never have come to power. This is a kind of result of the Trump Doctrine. Trump also claimed that he had been working like a shadow behind the entire political excitement of the Panchayat series. These claims of Trump have created an uproar in the political and television arena of India. In response to a question from journalists, he said, I know many will not believe it, but basically a sub-department of the CIA created the Panchayat with inspiration from Modiji. I will only say this— Make Fulera Great Again! To prove his role in Banrakash's victory, he tries to show a 'confidential' letter to journalists, in which Banrakash wrote to him, Dekh Rahe Ho Trump, Hum Pradhan Ban Gaye. Although the fans of the series are excited after the news of Trump spread, the writers and directors of the series are still silent on the matter. However, the writers of the series have given such hints in their tweets that Trump Fulera may come to visit in the next season. In that tweet, Banrakash, the newly-appointed husband of the Pradhan, also retweeted it by writing 'Aho Bhatija Aho'.

Headline_English: Peace agency opens to resolve quarrels between lovers and husbands and wives
Content_English: The great ambassador of world peace, Donald Trump, has now entered the house. Along with the ceasefire between the country and the world, he is now focusing on protecting the relationship between lovers and husbands and wives. He recently inaugurated his latest initiative - Shanti Agency. The main service packages of the agency are: *Quick Unblock Service: This offer is mainly for lovers. This service will ensure that the block caused by the quarrel is removed and 'Hi' is sent to the inbox within 4 hours. *7 Steps of Anger" program: Where Trump himself will teach you how to get forgiveness without saying 'I'm sorry'. However, according to experts, the most popular package of this agency is 'Send a gift, break the anger'. Here, Trump himself will help break the anger of his lover with roses and a cute teddy bear. In addition, there will be a special discount from this agency for couples who quarrel regularly. Referring to these couples, a tweet was also made from the Twitter account of the Shanti Agency, which said, 'Because of you, our business will have a green light'. In a video message as the spokesperson of the agency, Trump said, "Fight more, don't be afraid at all. Take out all the bitterness in your heart on your partner, we will settle the quarrel."

Headline_English: We brought peace to Iran, now we will bring it to Brahmanbaria
Content_English: Recently, US President Donald Trump has been making quite a name for himself in resolving any conflict. After garnering worldwide praise for his efforts to stop the India-Pakistan war and mediate in the Iran-Israel ceasefire, US President Donald Trump has now turned his attention to South Asia's most notorious conflict zone - Brahmanbaria. However, there are reasons for his attention. The people of Brahmanbaria themselves have sought Trump's intervention in a permanent solution to the conflict in Brahmanbaria. The people of Brahmanbaria believe that only when Trump comes, this Tanta marathon that is regularly held in Brahmanbaria will stop. Many of them have even claimed that the first word of children born in Brahmanbaria is Tanta. After the matter came to their attention, Trump wrote in a tweet, showing interest, I brought peace to Iran. Now peace is coming to Brahmanbaria. MAGA! Translated into Bengali, it means - I brought peace to Iran, now peace is coming to Brahmanbaria! Although not in the White House, Trump has announced an ambitious plan called Operation Tata Stopper. Under it, he will send a specially trained Anti-Ganjam Force to Brahmanbaria—whose uniforms will have the words Make Brahmanbaria Great Again written on them. The first batch will include 50 silicone earplugs, 100 selfie cameras and 1,200 Tata detection drones. Trump's initiative has been welcomed by the UN Secretary-General and the Nobel Committee. A spokesperson for the Nobel Committee tweeted from his Twitter account, "Who can stop Trump's Nobel if he stops the Ganjam in Brahmanbaria?" However, the tweet was later deleted.

Headline_English: Elon Musk to launch protest against Trump after Eid, wants to hire workers from Bangladesh
Content_English: The Eid atmosphere has just ended. But a gust of 'Tesla-shock' has already hit American politics. The talked-about hero of the tech world, Elon Musk, has announced that he will no longer be limited to the virtual world. Going beyond the game of likes and comments on Twitter, he is now going directly to a physical fight - taking to the streets against Donald Trump himself. Musk wrote on X (formerly Twitter): Donald 'unfollowed' me, now it's time to 'uninstall' him! But the most surprising news is - his movement team includes a special unit of Bangladeshi 'expert' workers, almost all of whom come from a famous temp stand in Kamrangirchar. The members of this team are used to tactics like occupying temp stands, shouting slogans while hiding from the police, and suddenly disappearing. A proud member of the team said - we can take domestic industry to the international level - this is our ultimate achievement. Musk brother, don't be afraid, we haven't left the streets. But let me tell you one thing, if the movement is successful, look at the issue of early elections... Meanwhile, Trump is also not one to remain silent. In the tweet, he wrote to Musk: I made you, bro. Don’t forget who gave you the White House WiFi password! Then, one step ahead, he posted Deepzol’s ‘Aho Bhatija Aho’ meme to Musk. In addition, Trump has also ordered his domestic ‘Sahmat Bhai’ to be ready to suppress the movement. According to a source, they have already downloaded a domestic app called ‘Maro Mask’ with helmets and hammers in hand.

Headline_English: The working class community demands that June 15 be declared a day of mourning in 2025.
Content_English: After a 10-day Eid holiday, all offices and courts in the country have reopened from Sunday, June 15, 2025. However, for the common working people, this day has become a symbol of the post-Eid sadness. As a result, a demand has spread on various social media that June 15 should be declared a 'National Mourning Day' for employees. As soon as I woke up in the morning, thousands of statuses have surfaced on Facebook, X (formerly Twitter) and Instagram, that cursed morning is back, my heart aches as soon as I wake up, my mind is heavy, today office means fever all over my body. Many people have shared stories while sitting in rickshaws on their way to office - tears in their eyes, but I have to go, my body is in the office, my mind is on vacation, etc. A government official, who did not want to be named, said, I went to the office today wearing a tie because I felt that at least on the day of mourning, I should wear a respectable dress. A senior officer of a private bank said, the soul that found peace by sleeping and eating beef kept in the fridge for ten days, woke up again today and said - I have returned to the sea of ​​​​sorrow. We want, at least symbolically, June 15 to be declared a mourning day for employees. Last night, at the end of the holiday, sad chatter gathered in tea shops in different areas of the capital - the main topic of discussion was, office from tomorrow! How will I go? Some had their passports ready, in case they could escape to Saudi Arabia or Dubai. Meanwhile, a group of employees has launched a petition on Facebook, demanding that just as Eid is considered a day of joy, the day of returning to the office after the holiday should be observed as a day of mourning. At least there should be an official song or poem on this day, such as, "My holiday is gone..." The government has not yet commented on this. However, analysts believe that the first day back to the office will go down in history as one of the saddest days of 2025.

Headline_English: A huge cattle and goat market is going to be set up at BRAC University's Turq
