Content_English: A huge market of sacrificial cows and goats is being held in the Turk area of ​​BRAC University to shed light on education. It is learnt that this market has been organized with the joint efforts of the university authorities and students. The organizers of the market say that we have several highly educated cows. Our aim is to showcase them to the public. A senior teacher from the university's IBS department said, "We have heard for a long time that 'hybrids' roam around in Turk. So I thought, this time we should also bring hybrid cows so that there is a balance in everything." The market will have talented cows and goats of local and foreign breeds. Researchers, PhD holders, graduates, and various categories of cows and goats will be there. However, to maintain the quality of the market, no cow below CGPA 3 will be brought to the market. A technical cow parking zone has already been built in front of the university gate. The cows have different names - Lamborghini Goat, Topper Cow, First Class First Buffalo. However, some students of the university are vocal against this arrangement. An environmentalist student said, if cows and goats are brought in like this, there will be no grass on the campus, and the canteen outside the university may also be closed. The university has informed that those who have a CGPA below 3.50 at the market will be able to determine the price of each cow or goat with their GPA. A student said, my GPA is 2.75. So I am taking a small goat, but I have made it study, it will become a cow next semester. The market will be inaugurated by a former student, who is currently running a startup called 'Goat-like Leadership'. The market will continue until the moon appears, or until the final exams - whichever comes first.

Headline_English: The demand for coordinators is increasing in the wedding market, coordinators can get cash jobs if they get married
Content_English: The demand for coordinators is increasing in the marriage market. It is known that if you marry a coordinator, you can get a job in cash. That is not even a job! A six-digit salary in a managerial post. No prior experience is required. A line of both children and adults has been seen in front of the coordinator's house to grab such an offer. One of these people said, I have tried for 3 years for a job. To no avail. I have done bank coaching, BCS coaching, insurance coaching, IELTS! But I have not seen a job again. I am thinking, what a waste of all this hard work. It is easy to get a job if you marry a coordinator! That is why I stood in this line. But the coordinator you are standing in front of has already got a marriage? To our question, this woman said, Coordinators deserve three or four marriages. I am also willing to be his fourth wife. When we went to the house of a male coordinator, we saw a boy standing there. He was wearing a sherwani and had a turban on his head. We want to know from him, why is he in the line of the boy coordinator? He said, he will get married and take the job. He will not start a family. He will stay separate if necessary. This is the risk one can take for a six-digit job.

Headline_English: Niazi, Tikka Khan also want a reception at Shahbagh! He tweeted - What was our crime?
Content_English: Former acting general secretary of Jamaat-e-Islami A. T. M. Azharul Islam has been acquitted of a crime against humanity case. Azhar served as the Rangpur district president of the Islami Chhatra Sangh for Pakistan during the Liberation War. After his acquittal, the Jamaat leader was also given a reception at Shahbagh. Although Jamaat leaders and activists are happy about the matter, former Pakistani generals Niazi and Tikka Khan are quite unhappy. Two of Pakistan's 'iconic heroes' of 1971—General Niazi and Tikka Khan—suddenly 'fired up' after seeing the scene of Azharul Islam's reception at Shahbagh. They claim, what was our crime? We also did the same thing—on behalf of Pakistan against Bangladesh! So why don't we get it—what kind of injustice is this! Food delivery| In a tweet, Niazi wrote, are we deprived just because we are Pakistanis? Azhar's brother was only the commander of Al Badr, we are above him in the chain of command. We do not accept this discrimination with us in any way. Of course, seeing this enthusiasm of Niazi Tikka Khan, Sheikh Hasina, known as the mother of humanity, has also expressed her desire to receive such a reception by sticking her face out of the hole in the Lutyens area of ​​Delhi. Sheikh Hasina started with her magical three words, 'What is my crime?' Then she said that if Azhar can receive a reception for crimes against humanity. Tikka, Niazi can ask for a reception, then I also deserve it, I have not killed any less people. I have the pain of losing a relative in it, at least considering the humanitarian aspect, I want such a reception.

Headline_English: Rashmika Mandanna wants to vote for Aamir Hamza as a voter from Kushtia 3 constituency
Content_English: Every day, new surprises happen in the political arena. But this time, the incident seems to be completely cinematic! Indian actress Rashmika Mandana wants to drop all her busy schedule and become a direct voter for Jamaat-nominated speaker Aamir Hamza in Kushtia-3 constituency. This popular star from South India said that she wants to participate in the campaign for Aamir Hamza out of her 'special respect and personal preference'. She is even ready to exercise her right to vote as a voter of Kushtia-3 constituency by taking Bangladeshi citizenship if necessary. In front of reporters, Rashmika said, I have heard many speakers, but no one speaks like Aamir Hamza. There is a kind of pull in his words, which touches the heart. I believe that he will be able to do something for the people of this area. But it does not end here. Rashmika is now practicing her Bengali pronunciation so that she does not make mistakes while campaigning. She has even ordered a T-shirt with the words 'Kushtia 3 constituency' written on it. On the other hand, Aamir Hamza sees the whole matter as just the interest of an enthusiastic voter. He clearly said, 'I know Rashmika, but she is not a relative or close to me. I have said something about her in some of my speeches, now if she is attracted by it and wants to vote for me, I don't see anything wrong with it. However, I want to tell Rashmika that if you want to vote, you have to come during the day, it won't happen if you come at night like during the Awami regime.'

Headline_English: Kiss Band's new song is coming; new member joining from Bangladesh
Content_English: A huge surprise in the rock world! Legendary rock band KISS has announced one of the most controversial and dramatic collaborations of the century. The 'romantic revolutionary' of Bangladeshi politics, Jamaat-e-Aamir, is joining as a guest artist in their next song 'Chumu Chumu Chumu'! According to the band members, they have never seen such a perfect kissing skill and emotional expression. A statement from the KISS band said, "We have always wanted to work with artists who have a deep insight into 'Chumu'. When we learned about this Aamir, we immediately understood - he is the most suitable face for our next song!" In addition, one of their very emotional members told us, "We have been kissing on stage with face paint for many years, but we are fascinated by the way he is kissing children directly on the lips and cheeks. We are honored to have a dedicated kisser like him. We thought we were the kissing gurus." But after seeing Aamir, I realized that we are still beginners. He is a leader, a lover, and from now on our new 'Chief Kiss Consultant'. Experts say that after the release of this song, there may be a possibility of a new vote bank called 'Kiss Vote' in Bangladeshi politics.

Headline_English: BNP workers have suddenly increased demand in drought-prone regions and desert countries
Content_English: When the deterioration of the global climate and the devastation of droughts are destroying agriculture from Africa to Arabia, a bright ray of hope has emerged - the leaders of Bangladesh's BNP! No, they are not taking up water supply projects at the United Nations, but their special 'organic skills' are now in high demand internationally. It all started with an innocent political statement. In response to a comment by an NCP leader, BNP Vice Chairman Shamsuzzaman Dudu roared, 'If BNP leaders defecate together, we will be swept away by it and fall into the Bay of Bengal!' Hearing this announcement, there was a breeze of joy in the desert sands. From Saudi Arabia, Somalia, Namibia to the drought-prone areas of California, the demand for 'BNP Fluid Force' is suddenly at its peak. The United Nations has already formed a special committee called 'Political Urine for Agricultural Revival' (PUAR). This method of meeting water shortage by bringing together BNP leaders and activists is now in the running for the Nobel Peace Prize under the name 'Alternative Irrigation Model'. Meanwhile, this news has created a new job market in the country. Popular job sites are taking applications for a new position called 'Irrigation Consultant (BNP Specialist)'. A young activist said, "Earlier, I thought there was no future in politics. Now I understand that by joining BNP, I can save the desert." My father says - you are saving the country, providing water! Although the Bangladesh government is still silent on the issue, it will not be surprising if we see 'BNP urine stations' being set up in foreign soil in the near future."

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina's arrest, the best achievement of the interim government in 9 months
Content_English: After a long wait, the interim government of Bangladesh has finally seen its biggest success, the arrest of Sheikh Hasina. However, it is not the real Sheikh Hasina, but the screen Sheikh Hasina who has been arrested. It is said that Nusrat Faria has been arrested in a case filed for the murder of a student. When asked about the reason for arresting the screen version instead of Sheikh Hasina, a government spokesperson said in a fictional interview that even if the real Sheikh Hasina is out of reach, at least her cinematic version is within reach! We are committed to justice. Therefore, the arrest of Nusrat Faria is a milestone in our 'dramatic justice delivery'. I appeal to the film directors to make films about the Awami League leaders who are still absconding abroad or have not been caught in the country, so that even if we cannot catch the real ones, we can catch the cinematic version like a Shaheen, like catching a Nauti Pola. Although Sheikh Hasina did not say anything directly on the matter, a post was made from a fake Twitter account named Sheikh Hasina, which read, "Ops, I survived." It was accompanied by a meme of the legendary Jasim.

Headline_English: Nationalist researchers say that just holding early elections will stop the spread of thunder reels in newsfeeds
Content_English: Recently, a crisis on social media has created extreme frustration and annoyance among people. A strange type of reel is now taking its place in Facebook, Instagram, and even YouTube recommendations: Expatriates are catching sanda for a child of a prostitute in the desert. Although the issue was initially a source of humor, it has now become a social disaster. In the midst of various reports, memes, and manifestos, the Bangladesh Nationalist Research Group has now come to the side of the masses. In a surprising study conducted in secret, they claimed that the only reason for this flood of sanda reels is the lack of early elections in the country. If elections are not held immediately, the flood of sanda reels on Facebook's newsfeed will continue. The head of the research team, well-known election analyst Dr. Khattar, said in a press briefing, "We have been monitoring people's newsfeeds for the past month. It has been seen that the more the demands for elections are ignored, the more the amount of sanda videos have increased. This is not just a coincidence, but a social algorithmic effect—we call it the ‘election algorithm rebound effect.’ They claim that Sanda Reels are not ordinary content—they are essentially a ‘digital signal.’ These reels give people the signal that if elections are not held quickly through a democratic process, it will not take long for your situation to become like Sanda in the desert. Even those who still do not understand the importance of elections will see these reels running at 2x speed in their newsfeeds. Of course, the Researcher Shibir Samiti has opposed this study. According to them, this study by nationalist researchers is not credible at all. Rather, they are saying that the solution to this problem is not politics, but love. In our opinion, to be saved from these Sanda Reels, we need to ‘kiss, kiss, kiss.’

Headline_English: Preparations to eat Sandar Biryani in Chandpur in conjunction with Kafil
Content_English: The pride of the desert—Sanda—reaches the owners of the Kafil by carrying sanda from the desert of Saudi Arabia. And in Bangladesh, the people of Chandpur celebrate Eid a day earlier every year in line with Saudi Arabia. A new tradition is being born between these two mills—preparing to eat Sanda Biryani! Recently, the youth of Chandpur are jokingly saying that just as the Bengalis of Saudi Arabia carry Sanda from the desert to their owners, similarly, we celebrate Eid a day earlier in Chandpur in memory of Sanda minus Kafil. Now it's our turn to eat Sanda Biryani! Saudi Chandpur brothers. The owner of a local biryani shop said that our plan is to make such a biryani by combining the traditions of Sanda and Kafil that when eaten, it will feel like the heat of the desert and the sweetness of Chandpur are bursting together. That Sanda meat will tie Saudi and Bangladesh together. Locals say that while eating this biryani, you must have 'hot Sangur Hadi, with Sanda oil as the sauce.' Because when eaten with hot sangu, sandar biryani brings a different taste, which once those who are fascinated by it, never look back. On the other hand, sandar oil will make you more powerful and masculine. Meanwhile, new memes and reviews are now circulating in Chandpur's Facebook groups about sandar biryani, where everyone is saying that without eating sandar biryani, you will not understand the manners of desert caravans. The people of Chandpur are now waiting for when they will be able to eat this biryani like a big festival and tell the stories of traditional Saudi caravan owners in a fun way again.

Headline_English: Mumtaz wants to hear the songs of prisoners in jails after the parliament
Content_English: When the political arena of Bangladesh was going through one dramatic turn after another, the songbird Momtaz emerged—this time not on the stage of parliament, but on the stage of the prison. During the Awami League era, parliament became her singing stage. Even many MPs would sing along with Momtaz—some in tune, some out of tune. After the government went into hiding, this artist-cum-MP could not escape even though many others fled from the prison. He was hiding in Dhanmondi and was arrested yesterday. After the incident became known, Momtaz's fans fought over his book, but Momtaz conveyed a message of hope. Instead of taking the arrest as a negative, he said that he wants to enrich his prison life by listening to the prisoners' songs on the prison stage. On this subject, Momtaz told our hired reporter, "The parliament is gone, now it's time to entertain the prisoners. They also have minds and ears. If only singing there could ease some of the pain!" It is heard that the stage has already been set for Mumtaz Apa in the prison. Even the news of Mumtaz Apa's arrest is causing a flood of happiness among the Awami League leaders and activists who are already in jail. Some have even tweeted with the hashtag #Morar_Kokilke_Swagatam. However, when asked how they tweeted despite not having a mobile phone, the tweet was deleted by itself.

Headline_English: Trump on Bangladesh visit: Plan to stop Mamun-Laila war
Content_English: Former US President Donald Trump arrived in Dhaka today on an unannounced visit. Trump, who earned the title of 'peace ambassador' for stopping the India-Pakistan war, has now turned his attention to Bangladesh's most important, discussed and TikTok-ravaged conflict—Mamun vs. Layla. Speaking to reporters after landing at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport, Trump said, "I have ended many wars. But this one—this TikTok war—is the most complicated. More than North Korea." He also said, "Mamun and Layla must stop going live every Thursday night. It's hurting the youth." Trump has proposed a new agreement between Mamun and Layla called 'No Live Before'. The agreement will include: a ban on more than 3 live broadcasts in a month, a fine for fighting without a ring light, and a 7-day TikTok ban for fake breakups to get views. An official of the UN Committee on World Peace said that if Trump can solve the Mamun-Laila problem and bring peace, he will be given the 'Diamond Badge' of TikTok, not the Nobel Prize. A young man from the capital said, "Brother, Trump saved my mental health. Every morning I think about what new drama I will watch today!" However, after this matter reached Laila's ears, nothing good was heard. Through a fake live, Laila said that if Trump comes between me and Mamun, I will file 5 cases in his name.

Headline_English: It is mandatory for those who do not have AC at home to open an account on OnlyFans.
Content_English: When the common people of the country are pretending to live under the fan in the intense heat, the 'National Temperature Tolerance Organization' has taken a groundbreaking decision. The organization has said that citizens who do not yet have AC at home will have to mandatorily open an account on OnlyFans. According to policymakers, this decision has two benefits - on the one hand, people will get the opportunity to wear less clothes in the heat, and on the other hand, they will also earn money through it. Domestic heat and foreign viewers - a perfect combination. The government notification has said that all AC-deprived citizens should immediately create a 'content plan' on OnlyFans. If someone wants, they can sit under the van and make videos, that is also acceptable. A spokesperson for the Ministry of Public Administration said, we just want people to find peace in the heat. And if a little dollar comes, what's the harm? Rafiq Bhai, a rickshaw puller in the capital, said, 'Brother, it is difficult to wear a shirt in the heat. Now if you can earn income from this too, then the shirt is completely out!' On the other hand, the opposition party called it a 'government of moral decay' and said, the people of the country are sweating, the government wants OnlyFans - what kind of development is this? However, the government has already launched a 'brave shorts campaign against the heat'. Where monetization can be obtained even with a 3-minute handfan video. According to experts, this decision will increase the country's OnlyFans GDP by 37%. If someone gets famous by sweating in the heat, what is the harm in it?

Headline_English: Bangladeshi businessmen want to shoulder the cost of the India-Pakistan war
Content_English: A war is going on in India and Pakistan, while 'nepotism' is starting in the Dhaka market. As soon as the war between India and Pakistan started, the humanity of Bangladeshi businessmen suddenly burst out. They have declared that we will bear the cost of this war. Although the war is far away from the border, it is still very close to our hearts and profits. In this context, a retail trader said, we have helped people during wars in the past. For example, during the Russia-Ukraine war, we warned people by doubling the prices of salt, eggs, sugar - everything. We are still ready. Another trader said, the war is happening in our neighboring country. Who will go if we do not move forward? So we are sharing the burden of the war. Even if the government does not say so, we are taking responsibility - voluntarily. Analysts say that this 'international sympathy' of Bangladeshi businessmen has been seen before. War, fire - anything acts as an incentive for their price increase. When asked how much onion prices will be in Bangladesh if there is a war on Mars in the future, a wholesale trader said that the price will depend on the transportation costs on Mars. But rest assured, we will not be left behind.

Headline_English: Demand to give Hasnat Abdullah the title of Qawmi Janak
Content_English: A new chapter has been added to the meeting of religion and politics in Bangladesh. After Sheikh Hasina received the title of 'Qawmi Janani', there has been a strong demand that former Chhatra League and current NCP leader Hasnat Abdullah should be declared 'Qawmi Janak'. A group of 'title proposal experts' of the Hefazat gharana say that a mother alone is not enough, a father is also needed! This demand was not made in the air. Recently, at a huge rally in Dhaka's Suhrawardy Udyan against the Women's Rights Reform Commission, the whistle of the 'Narividwesh Express' train was blown by Hefazat. The speakers addressed the members of the commission as 'Magi', 'Hijra', 'Beshya' etc., showing how Islam is a religion of peace. Hasnat Abdullah spoke at such an abusive rally. No one remembered what he said well, because a speaker from behind was shouting slogans like 'I don't accept commission, I don't understand anything except abuse'. It was in this context that the groundbreaking proposal for the title 'Qawmi Janak' came to the fore. A Hefazat supporter said that if Sheikh Hasina is the Qawmi Janani, then Hasnat Bhai, a staunch follower of her politics, should become the Qawmi Janak. This will bring fulfillment to politics. The country's future 'Qawmi Parivar Plan' will be successful. Meanwhile, Hasnat Abdullah has not said anything about this yet, but one of his followers shouted at a tea shop in Barisal, saying that my leader is the 'Qawmi Janak' and I am the Qawmi uncle. Because Hasnat Abdullah is my elder brother. According to political commentators, if this trend continues, we will see Obaidul Quader being given the title of 'Qaumi Baro Bhai', Inu Bhai being given the title of 'Qaumi Khalu', and Fazle Noor Taposh being given the title of 'Qaumi Jamai'. People are waiting - when will the 'Qaumi Family Card' be launched, so that they can get title-based ration, free tea and biscuits at Waz Mahfil and live Facebook prayers.

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader's former photographer joins Sarjis Alam as photographer
Content_English: Even though the leader fled, the photographer did not. In the pursuit of livelihood, a new leader has been found. Now, political photography, not politics, is changing the scene in the country. Obaidul Quader's former photographer has just been appointed as Sarjis Alam's personal photographer. That is why there has been an explosion of confusion - there is no way to tell by looking at the picture, is it Sarjis Alam or Obaidul Quader! A Facebook user said, "Brother, now you can't tell who is the leader and who is the former one without reading the caption!" If Sarjis Alam also appoints Quader's brother's copywriter like the photographer, then there will be no difference. One Quader is on the run, the target is in every Quader's house. It is known that the news of Sarjis Alam copying photos like this has reached Obaidul Quader's ears. In this regard, he said, "She has taught us how to click picture. If someone copies my picture, she has told us how to claim copyright." The photographer himself, however, did not open his mouth about this. However, close sources say, "I picked it up just as Sir said. I didn't teach anything, I am being suspected here for no reason."

Headline_English: Trump-supporting Republicans want a temp stand in the country, want to get a taste of power
Content_English: This morning, a group of people are standing on the Brooklyn Bridge in New York, holding banners and shouting, "Tempo stands or death!" They are all pure Trump supporters, some wearing MAGA caps, some wearing T-shirts with "Make Tempo Great Again." The Republican candidate for president in the United States came to power a few months ago. But when asked why the party's workers and supporters are so angry, a Trump supporter said, "I heard in Bangladesh that people occupied 3 shops and 2 Tempo stands in the market before coming to power! Why are we so backward even after coming to power? What will happen with such power, where I can't even occupy a rickshaw stand in my area? How can we do this? We don't have these healthy political cultures." A leader of the Republican Party's youth unit complained, "I heard in Bangladesh that political workers collect money from shops, occupy sidewalks and lord it over passengers before coming to power. And look at how boring everything is here, if this is the state of politics, how will we students be interested in entering politics in the future?" There is a wave of movement all over America. Protests have started in New York, New Jersey, Texas—wherever Trump's votes are high. The streets are shaking with banners ranging from 'No Stand, No Peace!' to 'Tempo Stand or Death!'. There is even a new trend on social media: #StandForStand. Some people, not realizing the issue, are posting pictures of their old bicycle stands. A senior leader of the Republican Party said that a new committee called 'Tempo Affairs and Stand Management' has already been formed in the party. The president's own advisor said that this is part of democracy. Whoever is in power, has a tempo stand. According to special sources, in the face of Republican demands, the White House is considering a proposal to install tempo stands in some places on a 'trial basis' at some point. However, Democrats strongly opposed this and said, "You can't just arrange a temp stand for yourself, you have to keep 10% for us too." Analysts say that this demand by Republicans is ushering in a new era in American politics - tempocracy. There are also rumors that a plan is underway to set up a 'model temp stand' next to the White House in the future.

Headline_English: Shibir stands by farmers during the rice harvest season
Content_English: Once upon a time, the rice harvesting season meant the Chhatra League's 'selfie as a worker' festival. Back then, they would go down to the rice fields with a gamcha on their heads and a sickle in their hands (of course, that too was occasionally captured just to be in the camera frame). After harvesting two sheaves of rice, a huge photo session would begin. Even if there was no news of rice sales, there would be a line of flatterers in the inbox. But times have changed. Now, the Chhatra League is no longer in power. As a result, they no longer have a dazzling presence in the rice fields. Seeing the empty rice fields and lonely farmers, a new force has come forward—the Chhatra Shibir. The young activists of the Shibir have taken to the field with a great vow to stand by the farmers. However, there was a small 'mistake'—they brought razors instead of sickles! In some strange revolutionary imagination, they thought that rice could be harvested easily with a razor. The result? As soon as they entered the field, the farmers ran away, saying, "My veins are trembling with fear." The Shibir workers were initially upset about the matter, but later explained to the farmers that this time they had only come to harvest rice with razors. A Shibir leader who did not reveal his identity told us, "Kiss, kiss

Headline_English: New law being passed; Must have at least 200,000 followers on Facebook to become an advisor
Content_English: How many advisors have been, are being, and will be in the future? However, this time, new eligibility criteria are being passed for advisors. Without the minimum requirements, no one can apply for the position of advisor, let alone give a status on Facebook expressing their desire to be one. Even if nothing comes of this law to the public, those who want to be advisors are in a lot of trouble. Because there is a possibility of some of them being filtered out in this filtering. Qualifications required: At least two lakh or more followers on Facebook. Teaching experience in at least a third-class university in any country in the world. At least 5 photos with coordinators. At least 10 people's 'agreement sir' in the Facebook comment box. Without these qualifications, no one will be considered eligible for the position of advisor. Currently, there are some among the advisory board who do not have more than ten thousand followers. A fake source has said that some are losing credibility in their advisory career due to lack of followers. An advisor, who did not want to be named, said, "I became an advisor with a glamorous life. I am trying to increase my followers. If necessary, I can also get on TikTok."

Headline_English: Elon Musk supports Tesla drivers' protest
Content_English: Local Tesla drivers have erupted in a fierce protest after the recent ban on electric rickshaws in the Gulshan-Banani area. They have been blocking the road to protest the issue for a few days, but it has been alleged that some drivers have raised their hands on locals who came to stop them from blocking the road. Although the locals are angry with these Tesla drivers, the real Tesla owner Elon Musk has expressed his support for this movement. Originally, a video clip of a rickshaw driver with the caption 'Tesla Mode On' went viral on international social media. This is how Elon Musk himself came across this movement. At first, he thought it might be some science fiction-based content. But no! He himself was a little surprised to see a rickshaw in the name of his company plying on the streets of Gulshan. Musk wrote on his social media account, Tesla drivers are under attack in Bangladesh. I stand with them. Then he added in another tweet, If needed, I will send real Teslas to join the protest. Model 3 will march with Model Rickshaw! Tesla enthusiasts around the world are divided over the incident. Some say Musk shouldn't be so serious, while others say that this is the true development of technology. A 'Tesla driver' in Bangladesh told the media, Musk understands our sorrow. Even if the spaceship doesn't run on the streets of Gulshan, special rickshaws can run. The Bengal Tesla Drivers Association is certainly happy to receive such unwavering support from Musk. They are thinking of giving Elon Musk an honorary membership in their organization and gifting him a Bengali Tesla. The leaders and activists of the organization have even said that one day, if he loses money in business, he will have the freedom to drive a Tesla on the streets of Gulshan in exchange for 10% tax.

Headline_English: Mamunur Rashid Qasemi to be appointed as head of Family Planning Department Reform Commission
Content_English: About 100 million people in the country want to see popular online public figure Mamunur Rashid Qasemi as the head of the Family Planning Reform Commission. The eager Janata Party has said that Shahbag will be surrounded very soon in this regard. Qasemi Sahib has been campaigning online for a long time about polygamy and having children at an early age. His fans say that Qasemi Sahib has come among us as a pioneer of what we have been thinking about in our hearts for so long but could not say publicly. I was afraid to talk about a second marriage to my wife before. Now I don't say it anymore, I send the link to Huzoor's post directly. Dr. Nabila Tabassum said, sometimes the number of patients decreases. We need such pioneers in increasing the number of patients. Although it is not that important what the patient is going through personally, our pocket is getting better; this is good news. Besides, Qasemi Sahib is a highly educated, tasteful person. Since he is saying it, he is right. Couples are also waking up, moved by Qasemi Saheb's philosophy. A couple from Mirpur, who participated in the #BachchanaoAndolan, said, "A big family is a happy family. Those who used to say the opposite are part of ignorance. Population is the only hope to increase the country's GDP. The more wives, the more children, the more talent will be created. This is our new settlement. Not only that, but across the country, first wives are looking for new wives for their husbands. In this case, their first choice is the bestie from varsity life. Meanwhile, condom and contraceptive pill manufacturers have collapsed in this campaign. Locals say that they have already closed their businesses and gone home to their wives.

Headline_English: Bacteria, Virus and Insect Society declares Dhaka WASA as their sanctuary
Content_English: After a long period of research, survey and microscopic observation, the Bacteria, Virus and Insect Society (BVPS) has finally declared Dhaka's WASA-supplied water as their sanctuary. This is what our special correspondent from the depths of WASA water has revealed. Last week, when a water tap in Moghbazar was opened, a whole family of 17 insects jumped out. They were also carrying a small banner that read, We are permanent residents of this water - not thieves, but hereditary rights! During this time, they were seen chanting slogans like 'Who are you and who am I? Dhaka WASA, Dhaka WASA'. In a statement, BVPS President Mr. Pipes Sigillas, a prominent E. coli bacterium, said, "All the filters and chlorine in the world have failed. In the environment that WASA has created for us, we are real citizens. People only pay the bill, our rights are ours. We are the indigenous people of WASA pipes." When contacted by Dhaka WASA, an official said, "If there are insects in the water, it proves that the water is alive." Is it less fortunate to drink living water? I drink it regularly! Moreover, we also give meat with water. The bill should be increased from next month. Then he takes out a mineral water called Vacoapina from his pocket and drinks it himself. Meanwhile, environmental organizations claim that WASA water is now a 'biological wonder full of diversity'. They are proposing to declare it as a UNESCO World Heritage Site. Meanwhile, a resident expressed his anger and said, "One day I turned on the tap and saw insects running away in fear of me. So I am a new intruder in WASA water!" BVPS is now planning to organize a conference in WASA's tank, where the Zika virus, early dengue larvae and a retired amoeba will be the guests.

Headline_English: Space protests to celebrate Mars' name change; hundreds of spaceships stuck in traffic jam
Content_English: For the first time, a 'name-related' movement has been seen in space. After recently changing the name of the Baisakhi Mars procession in Bangladesh to 'Barshavaran Ananda Shobhajatra', a group of space-conscious citizens have also taken issue with the name of Mars. They claim that the name 'Mars' is too Hindu. So they have come up with a new proposal - the planet should be named 'Ananda'. The protest has started in a circular area between Mars and Earth. These protesters suddenly started gathering at the nearby satellite stations without giving any prior notice. Due to this protest, traffic in the entire orbit is at a standstill. Sources say that about 127 spaceships are stuck at red lights. The captain of the Venus tourist shuttle said, I am running out of fuel, I don't know if I will be able to reach Venus on time. Now if the customers reduce the rating, I am finished. However, the space traffic police have also highlighted their limitations. An intergalactic constable said, "We went to explain to the protesters that they spat on us and ran away, so we couldn't do anything special." Meanwhile, the movement is taking a different turn, along with changing the name of Mars. This time, a section of the protesters has also demanded that the name of Tuesday be changed. NASA said that they are monitoring the issue and will talk to the International Planetary Nomenclature Organization. However, a spokesperson for the ESA (European Space Agency) said, "Enthusiasm is good, but if you want to change the name of Mars, you have to update all the mission reports, papers and files - no way. There is no budget, brother."

Headline_English: Bangladesh's agreement with NASA, this time Saddam and Inan want to travel to space under the leadership of Ashiq Chowdhury
Content_English: Bangladesh signed the Artemis Accords agreement with NASA. As a result, a new feather has been added to Bangladesh's space journey. Many believe that this agreement has opened a new horizon in the history of Bangladesh's space research. But another group of space enthusiasts say that this is not history, but the 'Chhattal League Space Mission-2025' is about to begin. Earlier, the two fierce kings of the banned student organization Chhattal League - Saddam and Inan - had announced sole dominance in space in Bangladesh. Wearing black Punjabi, they said at a press conference, 'The way we roam the campus, we will roam space one day too. Under the leadership of Sheikh Hasina, that day is not far away! However, it is sad but true, a few days after that announcement, on August 5, Sheikh Hasina crossed the border in a helicopter and left for Delhi. Upon receiving the news, Inan and Saddam deleted all their posts about their space mission and started walking towards the border. They secretly left the country with their dreams of space in their chest pockets, bags on their shoulders and masks on their faces. Recently, while sitting in an unknown hostel in Europe, they opened up again. They said, "They are not leaving this space mission. But this time, they are not asking for Sheikh Hasina, but Ashiq Chowdhury as the captain of the space mission." Ashiq Bhai is a leader of that level. He was silent for 42 minutes on Zoom once in a meeting—that's when we realized that he has depth. Only he can handle deep things like space," said Inan. Saddam added, "You are currently in Delhi, it will take time for him to come to space. We are thinking, first, we will take Ashiq Bhai and clean up the space a little, and then we will receive him." These two leaders said that upon reaching space, they will first visit the Bangabandhu Satellite, recite some prayers there, and reconstitute the regional committee through a Zoom meeting 'via satellite'. They will then head to the International Space Station, where they plan to hold the first space election.

Headline_English: New disease discovered in medical science; Wakarosis stenosis
Content_English: Medical discovery is a never-ending process. In this amazing profession, researchers are always new. They invent new germs, diseases, medicines and vaccines. However, not as part of the process, but suddenly, a new disease 'Walkerosis Stenosis' has been discovered in the country. Usually, the problem of a blood vessel becoming narrow is called stenosis. Although the name is similar, the new disease, meaning stenosis, is quite different from stenosis. Stenosis is the process of stone accumulation in the chest. Although stones can accumulate in the gallbladder, kidney or urinary bladder before, this is the first example of stone accumulation in the chest. While walking, this stone can suddenly lodge in your chest. Before you know it, this stone can do whatever you want. Although it is a micro-sized stone at first, its shape can gradually change and become huge. The initial symptoms of this disease include a strange heavy feeling in the chest, the invisible pressing pain of losing someone dear to you, or an excessive greed for getting something. A doctor who did not want to be named said, "Although the issue of stones in the chest was considered a poetic matter until now, research is now saying that it is actually scientific. We sincerely feel sorry for those lovers who did not pay attention or treat them after hearing that they felt 'heavy in the chest', assuming it was just an emotional outburst. Those who are at risk of this disease are those who have been working for forty years or more, whose wisdom and experience are so great that it often turns into a curse. So, rest after a certain age, retire from work, and be free from varicocele and stenosis."

Headline_English: Barrister Suman wants to let Hamza play for his club while the cow is alive.
Content_English: Once upon a time, Barrister Suman came into the spotlight by selling 13 cows for the development of his football club. Now, that grand plan of selling cows is on the way to being implemented again. Because British Bangladeshi footballer Hamza Chowdhury has come to the country. Although he is currently in prison, Suman's love for football has not diminished at all. He received news of Hamza's arrival from inside the prison. He immediately sat up. The prison walls are shaking with excitement! The prisoners next to him initially thought that maybe the news of bail had come from the court. But no! The only reason for Suman's excitement is Hamza Chowdhury. It is known that Suman observes the course of world football from inside the prison. Although he discusses Brazil's Neymar, Argentina's Messi, or England's Kane - everyone, this time his eyes are only on Hamza. He wants to get a taste of British Leicester for the club! But there is only one problem; to bring Hamza to the team, it will take money. And where will the money come from? The solution is simple! It's time to sell cows again. Sitting inside the jail, he announced that no matter how much that ox costs, even if he sells cows, I will bring Hamza to my team. However, it is known from secret sources that after such an announcement, Suman's cows have become a little worried. Meanwhile, Hamza Chowdhury has not said anything yet. However, football analysts say that if he comes to Bangladesh and joins Barrister Suman's team, then this will be a historic event in the world of football! Because usually European players sign multi-million dollar contracts to join a new team. But here a player will join the team with the money of selling cows! The Football Federation is also quite excited about this new transfer model. Because Suman's cow-centric economic model can open new horizons in Bangladesh football in the future. Many clubs have now started to inquire whether the rule of raising transfer funds through selling cows falls within FIFA's transfer rules...

Headline_English: Yunus' Urdu speech in Rohingya camp: Hasina and Joy express anger
Content_English: After the popular uprising in the country, Sheikh Hasina has now fled to Delhi, and her son Joy is now mainly unemployed, although he is busy giving interviews in broken Hindi on Indian TV channels for a few days. Meanwhile, Dr. Yunus took charge as the new head of state in Bangladesh after August 5. But since he took charge, the 'former' ruling class has been looking for conspiracies in every sentence he uttered. Recently, Yunus spoke in the regional language of Chittagong while visiting the Rohingya camps in Cox's Bazar. That's it! This is how Hasina's failed cyber propaganda cell started to shake again. Immediately after Yunus's speech, Sheikh Hasina called a 'national disaster meeting' at Lutyens Bungalow, where, while eating sweet pumpkin purée, the mother of humanity said with a serious face, 'Didn't I tell you? This Yunus has been a broker of Pakistan from the beginning! Look how he is persuading the Rohingyas in Urdu! We liberated Bangladesh, don't hand it over to Pakistan! Seeing the anger on his face and the trembling in his throat, an Indian official sitting next to him tried to calm him down and said, "Apa, don't be angry, I will do it!" Hasina then put down her tea cup and said, "Look, do something quickly without giving knowledge, people like Yunus could not tolerate our development, that's why today they have created chaos in the country in the name of democracy! If I had a government, all this would not have happened. The children of bloody poor Razakars, Bangladeshis, chose democracy over me, Shame Shame." On the other hand, Hasina's son Joy, who is ignorant of Hindi, joined a live broadcast with a host selling ointment on a popular Indian channel and said, "Ye toh bahut bara khatarnak baat hai! Bangladesh avi Pakistan ke dik me dhabit ho raha hai. We are always talking nonsense, this Yunus is a conspirator." My mother used to run the country, but the country was India-oriented, and the digital one was digital, while the country was Pakistan-oriented. Although Yunus did not say anything directly about these things, we finally learned that a fake Twitter account called 'Yunus's Extreme Price' tweeted 'Joy, a Sudanese girl'.

Headline_English: Mob Studio is about to start, first song; Women should not go out without wearing a veil
Content_English: ‘Mob Studio’ is going to bring a revolutionary change in the music world of Bangladesh. Respecting the recent mob justice practices in the country, a new musical journey is starting, where there will be songs—but only in the tune of discipline, advice and orders! Just by listening to the title of the first song, it is understood that it has been written for the ‘welfare’ of women—If you don’t wear a veil, don’t go out. The self-proclaimed moral ‘Guardian Angel’ army of the society is acting as the songwriter, composer and music director, who are working with the great vow of controlling the movement, clothing and breathing rate of women everywhere. The song has received a huge response even before its release. It is now top trending, especially in various ‘policy-protecting’ groups on Facebook. Some say that this is a unique initiative on the path of social reform! Some of these singers have also expressed interest in joining this new platform. In particular, they think that in the future there should be some more useful and instructive songs, such as - You are not a good woman if you do not wear a burqa, women stay home, why do women go out after 8 pm? After the success of Mob Studio, the company is also thinking about a film project called 'Mob Films'. The name of the first film could be - Woman, you are a man's slave! Where it will be shown how an ideal woman is praised if she follows the rules of society and becomes a victim of mob justice if she does not. It is also heard that plans are underway to start an educational institution called Mob University, where courses on the theory of decency, women's responsibilities and duties will be held!

Headline_English: What happens with the phone's 'airplane mode' or 'flight mode'? Find out now
Content_English: Do you know what the 'flight mode' or 'airplane mode' on your phone is? If you don't know, then know this. The function of airplane mode or flight mode is not only that you touch the switch and your mobile network stops working. Rather, this mode has another important function. Keeping your mobile in flight mode or airplane mode means that it is flying. That is, even if the mobile leaves your hand, it will not fall to the ground but will continue to fly. But there is one condition, your phone's charge must be more than 50%. Are you laughing? Don't believe me? Check it yourself, you don't have to believe us...

Headline_English: Street morale cops want a separate department for themselves in the police
Content_English: The self-proclaimed moral police, who conduct moral cleansing campaigns on the streets, have now demanded a separate department under the police. One of them argues that since we have been carrying out the responsibility of social reform for so long without pay, we should be given formal recognition. As is the case every day, these moral police were stopping a few young women at a busy intersection in Dhaka and analyzing the appropriateness of their clothing. At one point, highlighting their contribution to preventing the 'degradation' of society, they demanded that the government immediately launch a 'moral supervision and fashion consultation' department for them. A renowned moral police (who introduces himself as a 'moral savior') said, we are the shadow administration of the streets. We have to dress people the way we want and behave. During the dictatorship, we stopped all these atrocities, now we can do all these things with full heart, you can say that these are our fundamental rights now! He also said that it is because of our hard work that girls in the country are somewhat afraid today. But if we have police uniforms, why shouldn't we have them? Will we be moral police only in words? Another moral policeman also demanded that only they should have the power to file cases, and that a law should be made so that no one can file cases against them. Another member of the moral police said, "When we are fixing the dress code for the people, we also need to have a specific dress code for ourselves. I propose that dhoti-punjabi or at least minimum decent dress should be made mandatory for us." However, there has been a mixed reaction among the general public regarding this demand of the moral police. Many think that this is just a new type of publicity stunt. A passerby said with a laugh, "Hey brother, they don't need a separate department, they need a separate hospital."

Headline_English: 'Dako' service launched at Sehri; 50 for every missed call, 'Ogo Ghum Te Utho' package 300
Content_English: The holy month of Ramadan has arrived. For 30 long days, devout Muslims will fast, exercise restraint and pray for self-purification. However, most young people of the rising age group, especially those who live outside the home, face a problem. That is, they are unable to get up for Sehri. As a result, they fast without having Sehri and therefore suffer from various gastrointestinal problems. To find a way out of this, the online call service 'Dako' is being launched across Bangladesh. In this, a group of volunteers, nocturnal and frustrated young people, will work as Sehri callers. Nisha (22), the female entrepreneur of 'Dako', said, "Along with my studies, I work part-time jobs throughout the year. My body becomes weak during fasting. At the end of the day, I end up in bed. That is why I started the 'Dako' service as a source of income during fasting two years ago. But I did not bring it to the app version. This is the first time I have made my debut as a start-up due to its popularity." When asked how the app works, Nisha's colleague explained in detail. First, the app has a caller preference option. You can choose a female, male or third gender as the caller of your choice. Then comes the details of your package choice. For one day, weekly or monthly packages, all premium services are available. Just to give a missed call, it costs 50 taka per day, 100 taka for 1 minute of talk, 250 taka for 5 minutes, and if you want to hear 'Ogo shuncho ghum te utho', you have to count 300 taka per call. Sadat Rafi, Managing Director of Daco, said that there are some bad guys who are not called properly. For them, there is that piggy wake up package. Now see what you like, take it.

Headline_English: Delhiites impressed by purple pumpkin, thank Sheikh Hasina, want more such options
Content_English: An unprecedented scene was seen at Iftar in an elite restaurant in Delhi. Pumpkin puri arranged in layers on the table, date sherbet next to it. Delhi's food lovers around the table are completely fascinated by this new type of food. This puri pumpkin originated in Bangladesh. When the price of brinjal increased in the market when Sheikh Hasina was the Prime Minister, Hasina suggested that puri pumpkin could be made using pumpkin instead of brinjal. However, although many laughed about it at that time, today it has become a great food in Delhi. Some food experts say, incomparable! Extraordinary! Sheikh Hasina has brought a revolution in the food culture of the Indian subcontinent. Thank you to the students and people of Bangladesh for sending such an innovator to our country. A famous food blogger said in an excited voice, "Pumpkin puri is not just a food, it is a philosophy! This is a unique example of crisis management!" He also said, "Why only pumpkin is purple? We are now waiting to make biryani and kebab with jackfruit. Seeing Sheikh Hasina's innovative thinking, the Mayor of Delhi has announced that from now on she will be honored as the 'Pioneer of Alternative Food Cuisine'. Experts say that one day, a new food revolution may come with her hand, where people can eat kachu leaves instead of chicken and banana peels instead of eggs! Meanwhile, a research committee has been formed by the Indian government, which will analyze what other food items can support people's lives? They are ready to take more advice from Sheikh Hasina. On this issue, Sheikh Hasina told us, look, I said earlier, crisis means new opportunity. If people learn to find alternatives, nothing is a problem! People's eating habits have to change. I will share the recipe for making payesh with potato peels next, everyone will pray for me. However, I want to say one thing very clearly, even if there are alternatives to everything, I have no alternative. This simple fact is not understood by the children of the Razakars of our country."

Headline_English: Trump invites Zelensky to guest room
Content_English: The Oval Office of the White House seemed to have turned into a guest room in a hall of Dhaka University for a moment! Donald Trump, like an experienced senior brother, invited Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky to the guest room. The ‘guest room’ of the Chhatra League is a familiar and terrifying experience in the political culture of Bangladesh, where seniors would invite juniors and give them various ‘educations’. Looking at Trump’s dominance, pressure of speech, and Zelensky’s helplessness in the meeting between Trump and Zelensky, it seems that the guest room method has been introduced in international diplomacy as well! At the beginning, Zelensky started speaking with natural confidence. But Trump was in a completely ‘senior brother’ mood. According to netizens, Trump’s body language was saying—where did this junior get the courage to say so much? Even though Zelensky wanted to explain the need for American military assistance, Trump was in a grandiose mood throughout the meeting. According to netizens, this was the international version of the ever-familiar Chhatra League guest room. Not only Trump, but also his Vice President took Zelensky one-handed like a junior. In the suddenness of the whole incident, Zelensky went into a mood of 'Honorable Speaker, I have been fucked' like Saka Chowdhury. We did not know whether he buried his face in the pillow and cried after returning to the hotel. Guest rooms are nothing new to Bangladeshi students, but such a scene is rare in international politics! Netizens say that the world has now started to run in the Chhatra League style. Trump proved that 'guestrooming' does not only happen in universities, even big presidents sometimes have to become helpless in front of their senior brothers. However, activists of the fugitive branch of Chhatra League held a joyous procession online from Jar Jar Obstan, thanking Trump for taking this Chhatra League art to the international level.

Headline_English: Goa Hall is being built at CU at the special request of students
Content_English: Chittagong University is one of the first-tier universities in Bangladesh. Recently, in a discussion of the extraordinary meeting, the CU decided to name a hall after Faka Chowdhury. The CU students were overjoyed by this. However, to increase the joy, they have now requested to name a hall after 'Goa', according to a fake source. When asked why a hall would be named after a vulgar and obsolete word like 'Goa', the CU student leader said in a bored tone, no word in the world is vulgar. The form, level and acceptability of a language changes with time, that's what it is. Besides, the name Goa is very important for us. There is a language soldier and freedom fighter by this name, without whom Bangladesh would have seen the light of day. This is our effort to show respect to him. If possible, we can also name another hall after 'Bia'. Then the culture of showing respect will be maintained for generations. A first-year student named Fazlu (21) said, I don't know anything about this. But I went to Goa once. It's a very beautiful place. I want to go to such places again and again. It would be nice if the hall was named Goa Hall in memory of that place.

Headline_English: North South's Zayed seeks help from Home Affairs Advisor to wake up for 8am class
Content_English: To get rid of the agony of 8 am classes, North South University student Zayed has sought the intervention of the country's Home Affairs Advisor, Lieutenant General (Retd.) Md. Jahangir Alam Chowdhury. Zayed said, "We have 8 am classes, but none of us can get up. We have tried many things—clock alarms, mother's scolding, roommates' banter—but nothing works! Since the Home Affairs Advisor holds a press conference at 3 am and visits the police station in the morning, we think only he can do this impossible task. He also said, "We want him to ring the red light in our room after dawn. Knock on the door, threaten us with dismissal if necessary. Only then will we get up!" Zayed's earnest plea has already received a lot of response. Students from various universities in the country have expressed solidarity with him. Some have claimed that if the Home Affairs Advisor runs 'Operation Utho' every morning, the attendance rate at universities in Bangladesh will cross 90%. Online Market Although the Home Affairs Advisor has not made any official comment on this matter, his office has said that the matter is being considered seriously. According to experts, if this is implemented, attendance at police outposts as well as students may increase!

Headline_English: Extortionists are struggling financially, seeking quick power
Content_English: An unprecedented crisis is going on in the country's politics - extortionists are in financial trouble! Under the rule of the interim government, everything has come to a standstill, and the neglected (!) extortionist society of the country has been the worst victim. As extortion has been stopped for months, some are unable to pay their flat installments properly, while others are struggling to pay the fuel costs of expensive cars. Even due to the lack of extortion, many have gone on diets, and many extortionists have started losing weight without going to the gym. An upcoming extortionist brother who is trying to take over the temp stand tells us, "I am in great trouble, brother. Temp stand, bus stand, market - I am looking like a vulture everywhere, now I just need a little taste of power, otherwise extortion is not becoming halal. You gave fascists a chance to eat for 15 years, now give us a chance, I hope we will not disappoint you." In this situation, the top leaders of the extortionist society have claimed that it is not possible to overcome this great crisis unless there is an early election. According to them, elections are the only solution, because once they return to power, 'business' will resume as before. Prominent political analysts say that whether the public is interested in elections or not, the elections need to be held quickly in the interest of the extortionists' economic freedom.

Headline_English: Nahid Islam becomes the first Bangladeshi to voluntarily resign; name entered in Guinness Book of Records
Content_English: Today is a historic day in Bangladeshi politics! Information and Telecommunication Advisor Nahid Islam has voluntarily resigned and made it to the Guinness Book of World Records! The reason? No one in Bangladesh resigns voluntarily—it is an unwritten tradition of the country's political arena to cling to office. The Guinness authorities said in a statement, we have seen many incredible records—longest fingernails, most times breaking a coconut with your head, 50 sneezes in 10 seconds. But someone from Bangladesh would voluntarily resign—this was beyond our imagination! That is why we are recognizing Nahid Islam for this rare achievement. Meanwhile, a shadow of mourning has descended on the country's political circles. A senior politician said, this is a black day in the politics of this country! We have been teaching new strategies to stay in power for a long time, and he came and ruined everything. What will the future generation learn? Another leader said, Nahid Bro has ruined the whole vibe, it will be a blunder, we will ask for his resignation, he will try to disperse our movement by grabbing the post, there will be some political violence, then the tradition of domestic politics will not be maintained. But no, what did he do, no, politics has entered politics, brother. There is extreme panic among politicians over this incident. According to confidential sources, some of the country's top leaders have started searching on Google by typing 'What happens if you resign voluntarily?' Especially the leaders of the Awami League have also termed the matter as the eighth wonder. Sheikh Hasina, however, has also made a fake tweet by writing 'If you did not enjoy power by removing me, then I was better off, Nahid Islam, the son of the Razakar'.

Headline_English: Palak is launching a seven-day educational tour course in prisons
Content_English: Awami League leader and former Information Technology Minister Junaid Ahmed Palak has taken an exceptional initiative to bring about radical changes in the country's education sector and to make the young society aware of real life. He has announced that every citizen should spend at least seven days in jail, because prison life is educational. Since this announcement, mixed reactions have started in the country's education circles. Many say that this educational tour is a great opportunity for the students in the country. Especially for university students, it will be a unique experience. According to Palak's plan, this seven-day course will be divided into three parts. Initial orientation: Basic survival techniques after being arrested, basic techniques for spending a night in a police station. Intermediate training: Techniques for self-defense during remand, techniques for surviving without food or by eating other people's food. Graduation part: How to argue in front of the media, how to please the 'higher echelons' to get bail, how to become an 'experienced' leader after getting out of jail? At the end of this educational tour, some lucky students will also get a special internship opportunity. They will be given the opportunity to work directly under political leaders, where they will learn how to use digital security laws to suppress opposition voices, how to silence people by shutting down the internet, and how to prove themselves innocent by blaming others. Many young people have welcomed this initiative. A university student said, it seems that they are not as far-sighted as Palak Bhai. This seven-day educational tour can change my life. However, many victims of the Awami regime are sarcastically saying that the person who arranged to send us to jail, now wants to educate us in prison education himself. Wow, a novel initiative! Responding to journalists' questions in this regard, Palak said, I want our youth to get practical education. What is the use of just studying theory? Life is not just about campus, courts, police stations, and prisons are also part of the philosophy of life. He also said, I myself would like to try this course one day. But of course in the 'VIP cell'!

Headline_English: Clickbait journalist Kilik Mahmud wants Ekushey Padak
Content_English: The country's renowned (?) clickbait journalist Kilik Mahmud has sparked a new controversy in the news world of Bangladesh. This journalist, who went viral for providing cheap excitement, misleading headlines and exaggerated information to readers, has now taken to the field to demand the Ekushey Padak. In support of his claim, he said that in a country where you can get a national award even if you sing with grammatical mistakes, no one will pay the price for a good clickbait headline, that cannot be! Kilik Mahmud came into the discussion by writing a report titled 'Surprise! Your life's footsteps will change in just 1 minute' on a renowned (!) online portal. Although the inside story was that value time, only then will your life change. By then, readers had scrolled through the report 37 times and eaten up their brains, but Kilik Mahmud believes that the job of an artist is to entertain readers. That's what I do, even if it's a little deceptive! This journalist expressed his anger at not seeing his name on the Ekushey Padak list this year. He said, "I know who sits in the press club! What kind of journalism do those who haven't written a single line of clickbait for years have?" He also said, "My news gets a few lakh hits every month! The government should take this into consideration. In fact, there is a conspiracy to suppress talents like me!" Meanwhile, there has been mixed reactions to Kilik Mahmud's demand for the Ekushey Padak. Some said, this great hero of the destruction of the country's media industry definitely deserves the award! On the other hand, many feel that if we get this medal, we will have nothing more to say! There is a storm of discussion on Facebook about this. However, if you want to comment under this report, you must first read another news titled 'Netizens cried after reading this'!

Headline_English: Demand from the world to stop Netflix subscriptions and buy Bangladeshi subscriptions
Content_English: Netflix is ​​a very popular site in the global market. Everything from movies to series is at your fingertips. Once you buy a Netflix subscription, your life is just dramas and dramas. However, now a competitor to Netflix has entered the market! It is better than Netflix in quality, fresh, and even capable of supplying new dramas every day. Therefore, people around the world are stopping their Netflix subscription and buying Bangladeshi subscriptions. When we talked to a loyal consumer who has been buying Netflix subscriptions for 10 years, he told us that Netflix is ​​good, but everything they show is Delulu. Moreover, it takes time for new things to come. But in Bangladesh, even if you say it is every day, it would be wrong; new dramas and series are going on every hour! One is more interesting than the other. Even different dramas are going on in different places at the same time. So if a site were to release all the dramas, it would improve the economic situation of Bangladesh and we would also get the opportunity to watch good dramas. When asked about the statement of Netflix CEO on this matter, he refused to talk. Later, at 7 pm, he came live wearing a black suit and cried. And said, I understand the pain of losing a Netflix subscription.

Headline_English: Well-wishers want Titumir University to be a primary school
Content_English: Students of Titumir College have recently started a movement demanding that their educational institution be converted into a university. Many are calling this new method of disrupting the lives of the general public, sitting on the streets and raising slogans, and establishing their demands amidst the symphony of horns the most innovative movement of the 21st century! Dhaka city is already famous for its traffic jams, and seeing this new blockade by students, some have taken to social media to demand that Titumir College be converted directly into a primary school! In support of the argument why Titumir should be converted into a primary school, a well-wisher said, if it is a university, not everyone will be able to handle the pressure of studying. But if it is a primary school, they will get an hour of sports time every day! They will run, jump, laugh and spend their lives playing! Therefore, primary school is much more profitable than university. Another well-wisher stuck in the jam said, studying at university is difficult, you have to do research, classes, theses all day long! And if you go to primary school, you get the opportunity to draw pictures, learn handwriting, and eat lozenges! So I say, make their lives easier—make them primary schools! Meanwhile, a student protester said, "We just want our fair rights! If we go to university, it will look good on our CV!"

Headline_English: Global Dictator Summit to be held in Delhi; Dictators are joining in droves
Content_English: The first-ever ‘Global Dictator Summit’ is going to be held with dictators. The entire event will be held in the Indian capital Delhi. It is said that various dictators known for successfully suppressing democracy in recent years will attend the conference. Former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina will attend the event as a special guest. This historic conference will be held in a specially secured area of ​​Delhi. The host country is India, whose Prime Minister Narendra Modi himself will serve as the host and will also hold a special session on ‘Tips for establishing a dictatorship in a democracy’ as the upcoming Dictator. We have learned that Kim Jong Un, among the world’s renowned dictators, will take a masterclass on how to run a country while starving the people. Vladimir Putin will also be there and will conduct a workshop on the strategy of ‘invisibility’ of the opposition. Bashar al-Assad will give a speech on the best tactics of wartime genocide. Sheikh Hasina will hold a special session where she will share her experience on how to neutralize all opposition parties before the elections. Along with this, this mother of humanity will also discuss the recent massacre she carried out and the pain of losing relatives. A grand dinner has been organized at the end of the conference, where the main attraction will be a symbolic event called 'Creating the Grave of Democracy'. In this, the participants will burn a ballot box together and officially bid farewell to democracy! Meanwhile, even though Indian civil society and democracy lovers have called for protests against the conference, the Modi government is already taking steps to send them to jail, calling them 'traitors'. While expressing excitement about the entire event, comedian Mayukh Ranjan Ghosh of the Indian channel Republic Bangla came live and said, 'No, there will be no democracy.'

Headline_English: Institute of freedom of speech to be launched, faculty members to be
Content_English: Freedom of speech is a strange myth, and the Institute of Freedom of Speech is going to be launched to turn this myth into reality. Interestingly, all the great leaders who believe in freedom of speech are going to be appointed as its faculty, but only for themselves. From Sheikh Hasina, Kim Jong Un, Vladimir Putin to Bashar al-Assad, all the freedom of speech experts will be teachers at this Institute. Even India's Narendra Modi will join this Institute as a part-time teacher. In a word, all the big stars of censorship and autocracy worldwide under one roof. The main goal of this institute is to teach students how to suppress free speech strategically, and in doing so, convince the people that everything is being done for their good. Sheikh Hasina has taken charge of the 'Consciousness Studies' department here. She will teach the technique of keeping the people in the dark by feeding them the opium of consciousness. Kim Jong Un will teach 'the practice of democracy in a one-party government'. Putin and Assad will teach 'Strategies for Declaring Alternative Opinion as Treason.' In addition, India's Narendra Modi will occasionally be here to teach a special course 'Media Hijacking and Propaganda Creation'. The founders of the institute hope that the graduates who come out of here will be able to play a role in establishing freedom of speech worldwide in the next few decades.
