Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina calls Tulip's resignation a disgrace to her family
Content_English: Tulip Siddiqui, Sheikh Hasina's niece and UK anti-corruption minister and MP, has resigned over allegations of involvement in corruption. It is reported that the chandelier in a Lutyens bungalow in Delhi lit up three times after hearing the news of her resignation. Some say it was an electrical problem. Others say it was a divine response to the family's anti-traditional behavior. Although no reaction was known at first, Sheikh Hasina later said in a somewhat tearful voice, "Tulip did not understand the correct interpretation of our lineage's tradition, which has been proven by her resignation today." The history of our family in power. No matter how many times we have come to power, we have not said goodbye; rather, we have been sent off with tata-bye-bye-khatam. Look at me; the people of the country are chasing me away. I have not submitted my resignation letter even after fleeing to India by helicopter! That is us." Regarding Tulip's resignation, Sheikh Hasina also said that how successful a leader is in politics is measured by how long he can stay in power. Moreover, remaining in power despite being involved in corruption is an art of our family politics. And before learning that art, Tulip closed her knowledge base, Shi! She is a disgrace to our lineage! On the other hand, after Sheikh Hasina's statement, Tulip said, I am not Bangladeshi, I am British, I am a British MP.

Headline_English: Double-decker bus passengers want special technology to reach driver's ears
Content_English: In Dhaka, the bus engine runs more on people's abuse than on diesel. Regardless of whether there is a gate lock or seating service, the bus will run like a local bus, and if possible, the bus conductor and driver would stop the bus and go to the passenger's house to pick up the passenger. Since that is not possible for various reasons, the bus stops a little further away and sits as if someone called while leaving the house, and two friends have taken the bus to take them to the wedding. Understanding the movements of the driver and conductor on the bus, the passengers exercise their mouths by swearing. Although swearing alone does not do much, the bus engine starts by accident with the combined insults, but that is for a short time. The insults stop working like expired medicine after a while, only to hear another round of insults. In a single-decker bus, one can only insult face to face. But those sitting on the upper deck of a double-decker bus, even if they are in a hurry to reach their destination, have no way to urge the driver. As the space of a double-decker bus is larger, the driver will intentionally stand for a little longer. The conductor will get out of the bus to bring a paan bidi cigarette, and even if the passengers on the lower deck abuse them, the passengers on the upper deck cannot. It is not always possible to come down and abuse them again and again. A passenger who regularly travels on a double-decker bus posted a viral post on Facebook asking if there is any way to reach the ears of the driver of a double-decker bus. Thousands of people shared it and wrote, "A microphone should be installed next to the driver's ear in the buses, and the abuse will be delivered directly to the driver's ears from the microphone on the upper deck." The unemployment rate in the country has increased so much that some have said they want to abuse the driver on a freelance basis. According to Aad, if they pay a small amount, they will sit on the bus all day long, they will curse whenever the bus stops anywhere other than the stand, and in return, they agree if the passengers pay a certain amount of allowance. Meanwhile, some of the passengers have proposed that if the skill of cursing is improved, it will be useful to curse the passengers on the lower deck, so they want a separate training center on cursing to be started. So that the passengers can curse in the right rhythm and tone. This proposal has received a huge response. Now we just have to wait and see when these proposals will become reality and the passengers of the country's double-decker buses will be able to convey their greetings—oh, I mean curses—to the driver properly. Ultimately, it remains to be seen whether this initiative will be established as the 'cursing technology' of bus driving all over the world!

Headline_English: New VATman declares Dhaka as the Gotham of the East
Content_English: The sky over Dhaka is now not only foggy, but also covered in VAT clouds. In these difficult economic times, a new superhero has emerged to fight the country's financial crisis—VATman! His real identity? Salehuddin Ahmed, who as a financial advisor has surprised the city's residents with his new VAT policy. While Gotham's Batman used to fight crime, our VATman is fighting the battle to fill the empty coffers of the economy. He has announced that each of our citizens is a VAT soldier, and we will collect VAT from them daily. Recently, in a fictional press conference, Salehuddin Ahmed announced in VATman style that wherever there is expenditure, there will be VAT. In the future, VAT will be levied on everything from Dhaka's fuchka to the sound of rickshaw bells. Immediately after his announcement, social media was filled with various reactions to him. One user wrote, Abul Maal Abdul Muhith was the 'VAT Guru' of our previous era, but Salehuddin Ahmed has surpassed him. He is not only imposing VAT, he has also surpassed people's imagination with VAT. Another joker commented that the name of the VATman's new movie could be - The Dark Knight Taxes. Where he will light the VAT lights in every alley of Dhaka! Some are saying that the way the VATman is working, soon the 'smell of VAT' will be found even in the air pollution of Dhaka. VATman's assistant Robin from Bengal told us in a secret video call that an app called VatGo will also be launched for VAT collection, which will directly inform you of the VAT amount associated with your daily expenses. The slogan of this app will be, Spend Smart, Tax Hard! There are memes about the VATman on Facebook, Twitter and Instagram. A designer has proposed the design of his suit, which will have a huge V sign on the chest. Although he will continue his activities within the country for now, this new VATman from Bengal has announced to build a VAT movement in the international arena in the future. He has expressed his determination to bring polar bears from the North Pole to the South Pole, even faraway Siberia, under the ambit of VAT. "There will be no VAT-free zone on earth," he was seen tweeting.

Headline_English: New courses launched at Udbhas and Unmesh for admission to Titumir University; Sure shot in 3 months!
Content_English: Titumir University has emerged with the aim of providing world-class education from Bangladesh. To ensure that there is no question about the quality of education at the university, its students have demonstrated their skills at various times. As the journey of Titumir University as an international standard university has begun, there is excitement among the students, and the teachers and officials of Udbhas and Unmesh are spending their time working day and night. Everyone has realized that the admission test of Titumir University will be tougher and more innovative than any other university. Everyone will be in a panic in the upcoming admission test of the new batch, and we at Udbhas and Unmesh are coming forward to ensure admission by passing. Just as Titumir University is ahead in the field of universities, Udbhas-Unmesh are also ahead in the world of admission coaching, said a top official of Udbhas. Titumir University is going to launch various departments including Common Sense and IQ Development Studies, ProGD Studies in Bangladesh. This is the first time that such a course is being launched in any university in the country or abroad. As a result, students from different countries are inquiring about admission to Titumir University, according to the university authorities. In Udbhas's class, each admitted student will be taught exclusively for Titumir University. Udbhas said that while there is an opportunity to prepare for multiple institutions by coaching for other universities, the entire system is different in the case of Titumir. For this, a dedicated research team has been formed. Students admitted to Titumir University will have to compete with international competitors. For this, the Udbhas-Unmesh family is advising them to prepare with a hard-working mindset from the beginning. On the other hand, a student studying at MIT has also expressed interest in getting admitted to Titumir University. To compete with MIT students, Udbhas is emphasizing on watching TikTok videos made by current students of Titumir University, so that those admitted can be mentally prepared.

Headline_English: Justin Trudeau wants to enroll in Titumir University to spend his retirement
Content_English: After nine years, Justin Trudeau is finally getting some free time. If he were the prime minister of any other country, he would have planned to withdraw money from his Swiss bank account and live a luxurious life immediately after resigning. But the newly-minted prime minister is going to walk a completely different path. After the official announcement of his resignation, he said in an unofficial message, "I want to enroll in Titumir University in Bangladesh and pursue higher studies in IQ development and common sense studies." Trudeau mentioned in his message that he had the opportunity to talk to Sheikh Hasina at various international conferences and discussed the IQ and common sense of Bangladeshi students. Especially when the students of Bangladesh gave Sheikh Hasina a beating last year, he understood how sharp the intellect of Bangladeshi students is. Trudeau also said that during the last movement of the students of Titumir College, he also understood the truth behind the demands made by their department and their faculty. Since Titumir's university journey is starting anew, and he himself has been wanting to study for a long time, he has decided to come to Bangladesh. He believes that no one will be able to stop his comeback if he gets admitted to Titumir University. In addition, he plans to enroll in the university and join the ruling party as a student activist. Trudeau's resumption of studies has sparked discussions in international circles. Many academic experts believe that if Trudeau resumes his studies, many more international personalities will come to Bangladesh after seeing him. Some quarters are also seeing it as a 'reverse brain drain', because Trudeau's return to the country will also generate interest from others. Meanwhile, celebrations have started at Titumir University from tomorrow. The level of joy has skyrocketed after the news of Trudeau's release. A student at the university said that if the former Canadian Prime Minister takes classes with us, we will be able to learn a lot. They expressed hope that they will also be able to create various viral content by TikToking with Trudeau. A TikTok video of a student of Titumir University has gone viral since yesterday. He says, "We want our university to be renamed University of Titumir." This name is much sexier than Titumir University. At the end of the TikTok, he requested everyone to share this issue and inform everyone.

Headline_English: Consciousness business market collapses, entrepreneurs turn to spirit business
Content_English: Once upon a time, the demand for consciousness was high in the political market. Like a national fan, consciousness was once strong and its demand was everywhere. If someone was caught doing something wrong, they would throw a little consciousness on that issue, and everyone around them would rush to grab it. The market for consciousness had reached such a point that many people's lives could not go on without a dose of consciousness morning, noon, and night. The supply of consciousness also came in line with the demand. Not only politics, but also educational institutions, offices, and even social media were booming with consciousness. Due to such a large supply, the market quickly became saturated. And the masters of economics say that if the supply is higher than the demand, the price of the product decreases. The market becomes flooded with fake products. This is what happened in the case of consciousness too. Many people say that over time, the market has become very chaotic due to fake consciousness. At the same time, due to the blatant occupation of consciousness, this market fails, and entrepreneurs start looking for new ways. When something fails in the economy, something new comes up as an alternative. After the consciousness market collapsed, entrepreneurs came across spirit. People's interest in this new product and entrepreneurs' trust in it is gradually increasing. They say spirit is something that will work anywhere. And interestingly, wherever it is needed, spirit can be supplied. Many entrepreneurs have already started cultivating spirit. It is still unclear whether they will maintain a monopoly in their market or leave the business to the free market economy. However, some are clearly noticing one thing - they are asking them to get out of the market if they object to the fundamentals of the business. One of the oldest companies in the country, Keru, has already expressed interest in becoming an official partner in the spirit business. Keru, known for the slogan "Buy local products and be blessed", wants to collaborate with new entrepreneurs in the spirit business. They argue that both parties will benefit from this collaboration. Keru's experience with spirits can be helpful for new entrepreneurs, and the innovative thinking of new entrepreneurs will play a role in expanding Keru's business field. The collapse of the spirit market and the rise of spirits have ushered in a new era for entrepreneurs. Those who once ran their businesses around spirits are now considering spirits as a future asset. Will new entrepreneurs be able to succeed in the spirit business? Will their business model remain a monopoly or will it be left to the free market? Will the joint venture with Keru really bring new vitality to the market? Time will tell the answers to these questions. However, one thing is certain—the spirit business is now a new light of hope for entrepreneurs.

Headline_English: Tahsan found a partner; Shibir congratulates him
Content_English:
Although Chhatra League did not make a comeback at the beginning of the year, this year's best comeback may be that of Tahsan Khan. A new chapter in his life has captured everyone's attention. After breaking up with Mithila five years ago, people's curiosity about the personal life of this popular musician was endless. However, Tahsan answered those questions in his own way. Recently, a picture of him with Roza Ahmed went viral. And this incident has started a storm of discussion across the country. Seeing the picture, there were mixed reactions among the young and old. A young woman says, I was single for Tahsan for so long, where did Roza suddenly come from today? Many others commented, Tahsan finally found the light of the moon. However, the most surprising news is an official congratulatory message from Chhatra Shibir on the occasion of Tahsan finding a partner. 

This greeting message from the Shibir's unverified Facebook page says that no progress is possible in life without a partner. Behind every successful person is a partner. Congratulations to Tahsan Bhai, he has found his partner. Shibir's comment is making everyone think. Many have raised questions about whether there is a deep political motive behind it. 

Some believe that Roza Ahmed will enter Tahsan's house today as a companion, in a few months she will become a secretary, and Tahsan will become the president, which is probably why Shibir is congratulating her. 

A former Shibir leader (who did not want to be named) said, "We are very happy to have found Tahsan Bhai's companion." However, it needs to be made clear that we are not sure whether Roza Apu is an old companion of ours. If she has joined our organization, then she will add more motivation to our path. Tahsan Bhai may also work with us one day. 

Who is Roza Ahmed? This question is now on everyone's lips. Some quarters in Shibir are claiming that Roza has been associated with them for a long time. However, no evidence has been found for this claim yet. Others are saying that although Roza is actually Tahsan's life-changing companion, she has no connection with politics. However, there are rumors in political circles, will this new relationship of Tahsan bring him into the political arena in the future? 

Meanwhile, Tahsan's fans say that whatever he does, Tahsan will do it with a bang. Just as he has been singing stories of loneliness for a long time, this time his songs may have a different color. Because this time he will write songs for his partner.

Headline_English: Following the example of the East, Oxford in the West has banned outsiders from its campus; only ambulances will be allowed to enter
Content_English:
Dhaka University, known as the Oxford of the East, has recently banned outsiders from entering the campus and outside vehicles from entering. Although the people of Dhaka are unhappy with the incident, they applauded it and even imitated the real Oxford of the West and did the same thing on their campus. "If Dhaka can do it, so can we," said a spokesperson for the Oxford administrative committee. He added that from now on, only students, teachers and approved campus cats will be able to enter our campus. Ambulances will be allowed to enter for emergency needs, but of course with prior notice. Otherwise, no outside wheels will be allowed to turn. Robot guards have already been deployed at the Oxford gates, which scan every identity card and allow only authorized people to enter. An angry former student said, "I have been coming and going to this campus for 25 years. Now if I want to enter, I have to prove that I actually studied here! I have been asked to show my degree certificate. Is this the freedom we wanted from Oxford?"

On the other hand, tea shop owners inside Oxford are quite disappointed with this decision. They said that since outsiders are not allowed to enter, they are forced to turn off the green lights and keep the red lights on. However, some local pigeons are unhappy with this decision. One pigeon complained, "We are not outsiders, we have always been here. Now we are not allowed to enter either!" 

A researcher at the university described this decision as "a symbol of Oxford's deep respect for Dhaka." He also said that inspired by this initiative in Dhaka, we want to further consolidate our campus. However, our goal is that no outsider can touch even a leaf of our tree. If we want to touch it, we must first get a chance and show it. 

A top official of the university commented, "We have heard that the Dhaka campus is now so peaceful that even the birds are singing. We want to see that atmosphere on our campus too." Of course, Oxford students are the happiest about this decision. They even held a joyous procession on the campus with the slogan "Harvard or Oxford, Oxford, Oxford". 

The university administration, however, said that this decision is experimental. If it seems effective, some more innovative decisions will be taken to surprise the Dhaka administration.

Headline_English: Doctors have started using cold water instead of anesthesia
Content_English:
At the beginning of 2025, a new horizon has been opened in medical services in Bangladesh. Instead of anesthesia, cold water is now being used in minor cuts, stitches, and various operations. This method has been applied in all the operations performed in most medical colleges of the country, including DMCH, since yesterday. The patients have also accepted the matter positively. When a patient in the surgery department was offered to use anesthesia during an operation, he said, "Doctor, skip all this. Bring a mug of cold water from outside and pour it. You will see, your body will be numb within seconds." At first, the doctors expressed doubts, but at the insistence of the patient, the operation was finally performed by pouring water. After the surgery was successful, this method was applied to other patients as well, and everyone got the same result—the operation was completed without any pain. 
A senior surgeon at DMCH said, "The effectiveness of cold water surprised us too. Since every operation was successful, we have now contacted other medical colleges to apply this method." 

eArchi's fact-checking team spoke to patients and found that they were very satisfied with the effectiveness of cold water. One patient said that when cold water is applied to the skin, the entire area becomes numb. Instead of wasting money on anesthesia injections, the operation is done with water. There was no pain at all during the operation. 

Dhaka WASA is already thinking about processing and marketing this special cold water. According to them, WASA water has a positive reputation, especially in the case of yellow water, red water, and black water. If special cold water for anesthesia can now be produced, it will become a milestone in the country's medical science. 

This new method is expected to not only reduce medical costs, but also put Bangladesh on the international medical map in a new way.

Headline_English: The Himalayas are visible just a few steps from Uttara.
Content_English:
The whole country is covered in a blanket of fog. When you step out of your house, you can't see what's in front of you. If you look at the weather app, you'll feel like you're not in Bangladesh, but in a cold country in Europe. If it gets this cold in Europe, the authorities would have closed schools and colleges for three days and advised students to stay with their families. Even in this situation, many people are stepping out of their homes. One of them is Weed Khan, who had an incredible experience while walking in Uttara today. He said that the Himalayas are visible from afar! Just a few steps ahead, the base camp is there, and if you go a little further, your hands and feet are freezing. 
Weed Khan shared a video on Facebook and wrote, "The Himalayas are visible from afar, I suddenly went out to find out why it was so cold. When I arrived in Uttara, I saw the Bangladesh Base Camp in the Himalayas! I couldn't even imagine that I would see the Himalayas covered in white snow so close. The entire credit goes to my friend, who let me out of my house yesterday. 

It is not yet clear whether the Himalayas have firmly moved to Bangladesh or not. However, the news of the Himalayas migrating in the dark of night has created a sensation in Nepal and Bhutan. Both countries have alleged that Bangladesh has forcibly disappeared the Himalayas. The Gurkha forces of Nepal and Bhutan have threatened that a joint military operation will be launched if the Himalayas are not returned within two days. 

However, the people of Bangladesh are not paying attention to these allegations and are preparing for a picnic in the Himalayas. Everyone is excited to have such a tourist spot near the city. Various tour management companies have already announced packages like 'One night, one day in the Himalayas', 'Two nights, three days in the Himalayas'. 

On the other hand, some have applauded the transfer of the Himalayas. According to them, the Himalayas have returned to their original place. One commented that the Himalayas are truly patriotic. They were exiled in Nepal during your rule. As soon as you left, the son of the house returned home like a good son.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina wants to launch painting courses
Content_English:
The graffiti of Sheikh Hasina painted on a metro rail pillar in the TSC area of ​​Dhaka has created a sensation. Two days before its collapse, a crowd of students had painted the graffiti and tied a garland of shoes to express their hatred. Last Saturday night, when the City Corporation workers tried to remove the graffiti with the permission of the Dhaka University administration, they faced strong protests from the students. On Sunday, the university administration expressed regret for the incident, and today, Monday, new graffiti was painted on the pillar again. However, this time, looking at the graffiti, it looks like a Sheikh Hasina from a parallel universe is standing there! This graffiti, which looks worse than the previous one, has started laughing on social media. A student commented that the exam results were worse when she retaken. Sheikh Hasina herself reacted angrily to the new graffiti. She told her son on the phone, "Look, dad, nothing is happening with these people. You don't know how to draw, so why did you go and pick up a brush? If this continues, I will lose my respect. Anyway, even a 15-year-old fascist has some respect!"

In addition to expressing her disappointment at the new graffiti, Sheikh Hasina has taken a novel initiative to teach drawing. She has announced that she will launch an online course for the country's students by purchasing a Bamboo model drawing tablet. 

This course will teach the art of realistic drawing. Not only drawing, Sheikh Hasina has promised that as part of the class, she will also teach lessons on finding alternative food options and enduring the pain of losing a loved one. 

When asked about the course, Sheikh Hasina said, "The respect that I spent 15 years protecting is being mixed into the ground with a few crooked marks. So I thought, first of all, they need to increase their artistic consciousness. I have been in power for 15 years, who knows the dignity of art better than me?" 

Analysts say that Sheikh Hasina's initiative may usher in a new era of artistic practice among the youth, but before that, another Hasina chapter may be written in the country's graffiti industry.

Headline_English: Public entry banned at Dhaka University; ambulances join rally on 31st in droves
Content_English:
Dhaka University (DU) authorities have been imposing strict restrictions on outsiders for some time to protect the campus's learning environment and prevent noise pollution. Vehicles without stickers have been banned from entering the campus and strict surveillance is being maintained at the main gates. Vehicles are actually being sent back, and even if it is not confirmed whether the occupants of the vehicles are DU students, they are being detained there. 

Amidst this ban, rumors have arisen that some special event is going to happen at the Central Shaheed Minar on December 31 at 3 pm. What is going to happen at the Shaheed Minar? Facebook posts by leaders of the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement and the National Citizens Committee are making the matter even more mysterious. Everyone is giving special messages on their status, but what exactly will happen is still unknown. 
But the biggest question is; for whom has this event been announced. Outsiders are banned, and the number of students on the DU campus is not very high. So for whom are so many posts being made on Facebook? At the moment, no one except ambulances has access to DU. So are ambulances being invited to Shaheed Minar in Facebook statuses? 

We heard a rumor circulating from the Mohakhali CNG stand last night. Several CNGs were heard while filling gas that Dhaka ambulances are preparing to go to Shaheed Minar on the 31st. 

DU Ambulance Service Secretary Ambulance Prime said that it would be a mistake to think that only Dhaka local ambulances will come. He said in a virtual seminar that since there is no provision for people to go, and we are getting VIP passes as ambulances, we have decided to enter DU together from all over the country and set a record. We have been drawing patients all year round, this time we can have a little fun on the 31st. We have also taken extra oil and water with gas. It will be an event. 

Various rumors and sensational information surrounding these events have already spread on social media. In reality, it is not clear whether this is a day of opening new horizons or a celebration of the different joys of ambulances. However, there is no way to deny that this exceptional event has once again brought the Dhaka University campus to the center of discussion. The afternoon of December 31 may solve the mystery, or deepen this mystery.

Headline_English: Who is the main leader of Janashakti? John Kabir, John Abraham, John Cena and Johnny Sins in the four-way clash
Content_English:
A new organization called Janashakti is about to make its debut. However, there is a heated discussion in the public about who will be the main leader of this organization. All four of them, John Kabir from Bangladesh, John Abraham from India, John Cena from America and the multi-talented John Sins, have claimed that they are the most qualified leaders. Traditional attire 

John Kabir believes that his contribution in naming the organization Janashakti is undeniable. He said, the idea of ​​this organization came from my name. No one can run this organization except me. Through a strong leadership, I can take our country forward. John Kabir's confidence has kept him ahead in this race. 
On the other hand, Indian Bollywood star John Abraham, while exercising by making a motorcycle dumbbell, warned that if I am not declared the president, then I will see how this organization survives. If Janashakti is in the name of 'John', then this organization will not run without me. And will a new competitor like John Kabir challenge me? I will not let this happen. 

However, American wrestling icon John Cena has come up with a novel solution to this debate. He has proposed that a Royal Rumble match be organized between those who want to be president. Whoever wins will be the leader. He is quite confident about his victory and has already prepared his first conference speech. According to him, no one but me can take on this responsibility. 

On the other hand, multi-faceted professional John Cena believes that he is the real John. He claims that I have been a doctor, a scientist, a teacher, an astronaut—everything. No one but me has seen the lives of ordinary people so closely. This organization needs someone like me, who truly understands the needs of the people. 

So who will be the leader? All four people's claims are strong in their respective positions. However, we will have to wait until the committee's decision to know who will actually be the leader of the people. The public is also eagerly waiting to hear that announcement!

Headline_English: Oxford of the East announces flying ambulance to reach DMC avoiding traffic jams
Content_English:
For the past few days, general vehicles have been banned from entering Dhaka University. Of course, university students are spending their days happily. But peace has been lost from the lives of ordinary people in Dhaka city. Traffic jams are being created every day on the roads around Dhaka University area. Of course, if ordinary people were sitting in traffic jams, there would be no problem. It is the job of ordinary people to suffer. 

However, the problem has arisen elsewhere. Due to the traffic jam, ambulances going to DMC are facing some trouble in reaching the hospital. Although DU has kindly kept the gates open for ambulances. But since entry to DU is closed, traffic jams are being created on the surrounding roads. In which the ambulances are stuck for hours. There is also discussion and criticism on social media. 

However, students of Oxford of the East have advised the public not to worry. They said that they have taken up the work of inventing a flying ambulance to solve this problem. The students said that the work will be completed soon. 

They said, we have started working after eating tea, chap, and chumucha worth 10 taka. I have already made the wings of the ambulance. Now I have started working on the wheels. Don't worry. For a while, you sit in the traffic jam with the patients and God will do it. We will bring the ambulance as soon as it is made. 

Another student said from his fake ID, we have already opened the gate for the ambulance. You just have to struggle a little to reach the gate, you can't even do that! You are criticizing us again. How much more will we do for you!

Headline_English: S Alam disappointed with bank robbers' performance, launching special course
Content_English:
The failed robbery incident at a Rupali Bank branch in South Keraniganj, Dhaka, last Friday has revealed the dire state of the bank robbery industry. In this dramatic incident that lasted for about four hours, the failed robbers finally had to surrender despite demanding only 1.5 million taka and a safe escape. After long negotiations with the police, the situation came under control when the three robbers surrendered at 5:30 pm. 

S Alam, known as one of the pioneers of the bank robbery industry in Bangladesh, was disappointed to see such clumsiness of the robbers. This controversial person, known as the guru of modern bank robbery, who is currently hiding in Singapore, called the incident a shame for the bank robbery industry. Food Delivery In a confidential online interview, S Alam said, "In our time, bank robbery was an industry. We used to withdraw thousands of crores of taka from banks with the stroke of a pen. But today's youth? They put on a failed drama for hours and hours for 1.5 million taka and finally get caught by the police. It really hurts me to see this. Doing so will destroy the tradition of bank robbery. 

Out of his love and sense of responsibility for the robbery industry, S Alam has announced the launch of an online training course. In a post that went viral on Facebook, he said, "I am starting a course titled 'Failure Techniques of Bank Robbery' in collaboration with Coursera. Through this course, the correct techniques of robbery will be taught in an international standard. Those who have financial problems can take the course for free with financial aid. 

S Alam's announcement has created a storm on social media. Those who used to play thief-cop in their childhood are looking for a new opportunity to enter the field. An excited commenter wrote, "Brother, I have wanted to do robbery for a long time, but I did not have the courage due to the lack of proper guidelines. Now I will learn by taking the course and finally try it." 

Many people think that it is possible to solve the country's reserve crisis by emptying foreign banks and bringing millions of dollars home. Several economists have commented on social media that it is possible to eliminate the country's economic crisis by legalizing the robbery industry. 

This initiative by S Alam can not only highlight the domestic bank robbery industry in the country, but also highlight Bangladesh on the international stage. Many say that through the success of this course, the world will recognize Bangladesh as one of the centers of bank robbery. 

All in all, S Alam's fans hope that this bold initiative will take the bank robbery industry to new heights.

Headline_English: I want to enter the country to buy glittering balloons; I get a purely imaginary phone call from you.
Content_English:
Sheikh Hasina has been very depressed since the day the glittering balloons started flying in the market. An unreliable source says that whenever she opens Facebook, she sees 10 glittering balloons on every scroll and is crying in her heart. She wants to quickly enter the country and make a fortune. 

Whenever she goes outside, she sees some hawkers walking around with some strange kind of balloons. These balloons have lights on them, and different shapes are designed on the balloons. Young women are breaking up with them out of pride because they did not buy these balloons that can fly. Our lady has never missed a trend. When she talked about everything that happened, she participated, forgetting about her age. Recently, since Facebook was flooded with pictures of glittering balloons, she has not been able to stay in Delhi. If she can't go around with a shiny balloon, her mind won't calm down, and she thinks she will quickly enter the country and buy a shiny balloon. In a fictional phone call with Arki's representative, Apa discussed her love for shiny balloons and entering the country in detail. We are presenting the fascinating part of the phone call for the readers. Sheikh Hasina has not spoken to any Bangladeshi media since she went to Delhi. This is the first time she has given a fictional interview to Arki over the phone. What she said is something like this; I actually liked playing with balloons since I was very young. There were always colorful balloons at home—some red, some blue, some yellow. Even though I have grown older, in my heart I am still that teenage Hasina, who, whenever I get a little time, feels like jumping in the pond, catching fish with a fishing pole, climbing the mango tree when it is ripe and eating it. 

I can see the increase in the number of glittering balloons since I left the country. I don't know if someone has conspired to spread this to make me jealous, but I am very jealous of the young people of today. I can make alternatives to potatoes, chillies, and brinjals if I want, but I can't find any alternative to these glittering balloons. 

Every day goes by and I am getting weaker and weaker for balloons in my heart, if this continues, I will not be able to survive. So I have decided to enter the country quickly. My first task after entering the country will be to buy at least 100 pieces of balloons. Using these balloons, I will fly around, sing songs to the fullest. For how long has there been no peace in my mind, I can't sleep because of the pain of losing my relatives, now I am crying even more in my chest, maybe by buying balloons I will be able to forget the pain of losing my relatives a little.

Headline_English: Junaid Ahmed Palak is getting a call in Golmaal 5 to play the role of Boba
Content_English:
Good news for movie lovers! The fifth installment of Rohit Shetty's Golmaal series is ready for release in 2025. However, in the meantime, a big surprise! Rohit Shetty has announced that Tusshar Kapoor is being dropped from the fifth movie of the series. Former ICT Minister of Bangladesh Junaid Ahmed Palak is being made his debut in this movie in his place. 

Junaid Ahmed Palak has done all this in his long career - singing, dancing, lying, and doing politics. Now, he is a dumb man! He himself admitted that he has become dumb. This video of his went viral on social media, which also received international response. Even the clip started circulating on Indian director Rohit Shetty's news feed. Rohit Shetty said in a short video message that Tusshar Kapoor's time is up, there is no more fuss about him. For a long time, I was thinking that a good actor was needed for the role of Lucky. When I was not getting the right actor, the movie was not progressing. However, after watching Palak's video yesterday, I decided that if Palak doesn't play the role of Lucky, I won't make any more movies in the Golmaal series. 

After hearing Rohit's good news, news came that Junaid Ahmed Palak couldn't sleep happily at night in jail. He had been regretting the mistake he made in politics for a long time. Entering politics as an artist was the biggest mistake of his life. However, now he has become happily dumb after receiving the offer to play the role of a dumb person. 

With Palak playing the role of Lucky, Hindi language movies will also be released in Bangladesh in the list of pan-Indian movies - seeing this, the country's film industry is most happy. Cinema halls are almost closed, but if Golmaal comes to the country through Junaid Ahmed, they may see profits again after many years. 

The countrymen are also quite positive about Junaid Ahmed making a Palak movie. Some say that he is such a big actor that we understood during the July movement. I am not surprised at all that he is doing movies. Not only him, but if Rohit Shetty thinks of making more movies with some other Awami League leaders, that would be great. They all have nothing but acting in their blood.

Headline_English: Sajib Wazed Joy slams Farooqui for not casting Sheikh Hasina in the lead role in the movie 840
Content_English:
The recently released Mostafa Sarwar Faruqi's 840 movie is going crazy all over the country. But Sajeeb Wazed Joy has expressed his anger and regret over not casting Sheikh Hasina in the main role in this movie. He is also very angry with Faruqi for the fact that the plot of the movie is copy-pasted from Sheikh Hasina's life. In his words, I can't understand how untalented someone can make an entire movie by copying the life of someone in front of them. While talking about this in a Facebook live from his unverified Facebook page, Joy's eyes turned red and he roared with anger. He said, addressing Faruqi, who was a better option than my mother for the character of Dablu? He is making a movie about the life story of what my mother has done for the country, but he did not cast her in the main role! This is unacceptable. 
A source close to Joy has revealed that he has been watching movies regularly recently, hiking, and keeping track of his mother. However, since watching 840, he has been in a heated mood. Sometimes he got angry when the character of Dablu came on screen, and sometimes he cried loudly saying 'Ammu'. Unable to handle this mixed feeling of anger and tears, he came live and threatened to take Farooqui to see him. 

According to Joy, Sheikh Hasina does not disappear like this, she will not disappear like this. In a private conversation with his mother, he promised, why only one movie about your life? I will make a dozen movies. The story of each movie will be as you wish. If you want to steal votes, there will be scenes of vote theft in the whole movie. If you want to disappear, there will only be disappearance. And if you want to abuse, the movie will be flooded with a flood of abuse. There is nothing to upset you, Ammu. I also understand the pain of losing a relative. 

Many netizens have asked Joy to watch the movie 840 with the eyes of the heart instead of the eyes of the skin. According to them, even though Sheikh Hasina is not visible, her existence is clear behind every scene of the movie. If Joy had opened his inner eyes, there would have been no question of making such a complaint. 

Farooqui, however, refused to comment on the matter. However, film critics in the country believe that it may be time for Joy to make a new film—Amma: The Legend.

Headline_English: We will enter the country quickly; Bashar al-Assad warns leaders and activists not to be disappointed
Content_English:
At first glance, it may seem that Bashar al-Assad has fled Syria on his plane, but there is no reason to think so, he said. He went out for a short walk in the morning to get some fresh air due to the increased air pollution in Damascus, and some are spreading the news that he has fled. He asked to be careful against all propaganda. Reliable sources have reported that Assad's plane has landed in the foothills of the Himalayas. Upon landing there, he breathed in the clean air and was able to use 100% of his brain. After taking a breath, he declared, Assad is not fleeing, Assad will not flee. Everyone, stay in your place, we will rush in at any time. He also claimed that the incident of Assad boarding the plane has been distorted. He was angry when he saw that the incident of boarding his plane and taking a breath with the escape of the leader of another country was compared. From there, he threatened to check everyone. A close aide of Bashar al-Assad can be heard crying on the phone, and the audio recording is now circulating on the net. The man addresses Assad as brother and says, brother, you have boarded the plane, brother, brother, it has not been two hours, brother, brother, what conspiracy are they starting with the country, brother. Brother, don't worry, brother, brother, we are here, brother, brother, you come back, brother. 

Assad scolds him and stops him and says, I am around the country, don't worry. I will enter quickly at any time. For now, try to create a mess in the country. See if you can prevent a communal riot. If nothing else works, go to their procession and fight among yourselves. 

There is no longer any doubt about whether Assad has fled or not. However, the Syrian people are sure of one thing first of all - Assad will enter quickly at any time. A man who has ruled the country alone for 54 years, there must be 1001 secret ways to return. And if there is any obstacle along the way, he will probably come down from the Himalayas in a paraglider—this country is his, he can take it over anytime he wants.

Headline_English: British Council wants to give Barrister Partha 9 out of 10 in IELTS
Content_English:
While trying to catch a horn fish with ashes, Indian journalist Devika Chopra realized that she had mistakenly invited an electric eel to the show instead of a horn fish. Barrister Partha has blown away those who want to verbally abuse guests on talk shows, like cannonballs fired 31 times on Independence Day and Victory Day. Partha's fluent English speaking skills impressed everyone in a controversial talk show that sought to establish allegations of persecution of minority Hindus in Bangladesh. This interview did not go unnoticed by British Council officials. Even the head of operations of the British Council was impressed by his fluency and choice of words while presenting his well-crafted arguments in favor of the country. Bangla books are being listened to, many years ago Partha sat for the IELTS exam. The two-year period of that exam has passed long ago, but the edge of his words has become like old wine day by day. After seeing this interview, the British Council has decided that Parth will be given an honorary score of 10 in IELTS. 

An inside source of the British Council said that Barrister Parth handled the entire interview as easily as a son's hand. After hearing his fluent English, many British Council officials have become skeptical about their own English skills. Not only giving a score of 10, they also want to learn a new speaking course from Parth. 

On the other hand, a coaching center with a strange name in Farmgate has used Parth's picture to advertise that Parth took classes from them before the interview. Now everyone who wants to do well in IELTS is being advised to go to that coaching center. 

Barrister Parth has not yet commented on getting a score of 10 instead of 9 in IELTS. However, a source close to him said, He is everyday English, he drinks English, he sleeps English, his life is total English.

Headline_English: BUET student wants to write an assignment with Yusuf Sarkar after writing a song that goes viral
Content_English:
New excitement among Bangladeshi students! Students of BUET have demanded that Yusuf Sarkar, who is at the center of discussion across the country by writing the theme song of BPL, write an assignment for them. They want to leave trivial matters like assignments to the government for a little relief in their busy lives. Tourism Package 

Who doesn't know about Yusuf Sarkar's talent! After listening to the song he wrote for the theme song of BPL, Weed Khan, a student of BUET's Space Research Center, felt that Yusuf Sarkar could handle his mountain of assignments. Why didn't Yusuf Sarkar come earlier, then he would have had 4 in CG 4 from the first year. 

Weed Khan recently posted on Facebook, writing, I know Yusuf Sarkar can do anything he wants. My pending assignments are not a problem for him. I will pay 40 paisa per ward. There will be no problem with money. 

It didn't take long for this post to go viral. Students of various universities in the country have also supported Weed Khan's proposal and demanded that they write their assignments. Several students have commented, why should we write assignments while Yusuf Sarkar is there? Before taking admission in the university, I used to hear from everyone that the university is just chill and chill. But now I see, our lives are over because of assignments. We will not write anymore! Yusuf Sarkar will write everything. 

Due to this undeclared rebellion, the country's education system has practically come to a standstill. The students are adamant in their demand that Yusuf Sarkar should write all their assignments. This unexpected pressure has made Yusuf Sarkar frown. He has silently commented that writing a song with two lines and writing an assignment with two thousand lines is not the same thing. 

The thing he could not say to the students, even though he wanted to say it, was that if it is so difficult to do the assignment, then give a presentation. In this, they will learn themselves and teach others. However, seeing the stubborn stance of the students, Yusuf Sarkar has decided to remain silent for now. 

Time will tell whether Yusuf Sarkar will enter the world of writing assignments outside of songs. But one thing is certain—there is no shortage of innovative thinking among Bangladeshi students!

Headline_English: BTS wants Dr. Yunus as a songwriter for their next album
Content_English:
Economist, pioneer of microfinance, teacher, orator, motivational speaker—Dr. Muhammad Yunus's qualities seem endless. Despite handling so many tasks, he has now appeared in a new identity. It is said that he wrote two lines of the theme song of the recently started BPL. When an internationally recognized personality like Dr. Yunus does something, it spreads around the world in an instant. The theme song of BPL was no exception. This news has reached the ears of the South Korean pop band BTS. And since then, their huge popularity has started. 
BTS has been singing for a long time. Their dance, songs, choreography, millions of fans—everything is fine. But the band members themselves feel that the tempo, tone, and content of their songs are all becoming the same. They wanted to get rid of this repetition of themselves. 
At that time, the theme song of BPL forced them to think anew. They had never experienced such a thrill of Yunus' magic before. They spent the whole night discussing the lyrics of the theme song. The next morning, they decided that no one else but Dr. Yunus could write the lyrics of their next album. 

According to sources, BTS is coming to Bangladesh very soon. Their plan is the same—they will not return without writing the songs for the entire album by Dr. Yunus. In fact, it is said that they have only booked tickets for the return; they have no plans to return for now. Bangla Book 

It is also said that if Dr. Yunus does not respond to their demands, they will call the BTS Army to join them in a rally at Raju Bhaskar in Dhaka. 

They have prepared Plan A, Plan B to Plan E. If necessary, Mamata Banerjee will be shouted at, or a long march will be announced. 

Dr. Yunus has not yet commented on this activity of BTS. However, sources close to him say that he is against discrimination. Koreans will not treat BTS unfairly. He is taking time to consider their demands.

Headline_English: Ministry of Threats coming to India, Mamata Banerjee gets the responsibility
Content_English:
A new history is about to be written in Indian politics—a new ministry, the Ministry of Threats. This is being considered as a strategic initiative by the country's Prime Minister Narendra Modi, where there is talk in the market about giving the responsibility to Mamata Banerjee. The current tense relations between India and its neighboring countries show that they are going through an uncertain time. Especially with Pakistan, China, Nepal, and the Philippines. In this situation, the Indian government has decided to establish the Ministry of Threats as a special ministry to deal with the hostility and threats of neighboring countries. 

According to official sources, a plan has been made to give this responsibility to a strong leader like Mamata Banerjee. The huge strategic impact that her long movement, speeches, and multiple protest programs have, seems to be quite frightening for other countries of the world. Mamata's political activities include dancing, poetry recitation, and her unique oratory, which has put her in a strong enough position to get the responsibility of this ministry. Modi's close associates believe that her bright roar will shock the neighboring countries. There are even rumors on social media that Mamata's roar once caused an earthquake across India. Kolkata-based sociologist Jhotan Nath praised Mamata's 'special power' and said that Mamata's roar may allow her to live a worry-free life for a few days. In addition, journalist Mayukh is also planning to organize a workshop on this roar, so that she can give a stronger and more influential roar in the future - but not in a loud way, but as if she were roaring like a tiger. Through this, she will know how to learn to roar. 

People have come out on the streets of India to encourage Mamata, and there is also a lot of work going on in the political circles of India. Experts say that the plan to send Indian submarines to the airspace of Bangladesh is mainly Mamata Banerjee. And maybe if she gets the responsibility of this new ministry, she will think of bigger plans to showcase India's strength against neighboring countries.Tourism Package 

It is also heard that the power of Mamata Banerjee's roar in world politics can sometimes make international superpowers think. Therefore, the ongoing discussion about this roar ministry can bring a new turn not only for Indian politics, but also in international politics.

Headline_English: Run-no-run expert gets job as a cook at BCB
Content_English:
In the history of Bangladesh cricket, Liton Das has long established himself as an expert in scoring runs despite occasionally showing flashes of the bat. Days and months pass, but Liton Das' form of scoring runs never goes away. Considering this, BCB analysts want to see Liton Das' new position as a kitchen cook. Bengali Book

No one has any doubts about Liton Das' performance, cricket fans are looking favorably on the fact that he is being sent to the kitchen because he is good at scoring runs. A fan of Liton Das immediately commented on Facebook, "After so many days, someone is learning to give a proper value to Liton Das's hand. We will be upset if Liton Das does not just score runs in BCB. We want him to organize public events to show his hand to cricket fans from time to time. Some food scientists have also expressed their fear that if Liton Das enters the cooking industry, Raju Da's paratha business will collapse. Raju Da's unlimited curry paratha for 30 taka is not available in Bangladesh, but Liton Das has gifted us unlimited eggs in the game. If he cannot survive in BCB, he will go out on the streets and sell parathas, along with his own eggs. If that happens, Rajuda will not have to make videos anymore, everyone will be hungry to eat Liton Da's eggs." 

Liton Das was called repeatedly to talk about his new position, but he did not pick up the phone. However, a while ago, from a fake Facebook ID named Liton Das, he wrote, "I have never liked the playground. You have noticed that I shout so much and go to the dressing room so quickly, but no one has ever asked why I go. Today, I will say that I am actually a person who does not run or likes to run. Instead of running on the field, I go to the dressing room and cook. That is why the management has sent me to play for so long. Everyone praises my cooking so much that they have no complaints about not running. 

We have come to know that the country's big Michelin chefs have also expressed their concerns about their jobs. If a celebrity chef like Liton Das once manages to impress with his cooking magic, then no one will eat at their hotel, they have also strongly protested against such a decision of the BCB.

Headline_English: Paris School of Pinocomics launches; will offer master's degree in Propaganda Studies
Content_English:
While the world's renowned universities are busy with advanced research on topics like climate change, AI, or nanotechnology, the Paris School of Pinocomics has taken a step forward with a groundbreaking initiative. A master's program in propaganda studies. Because, whoever can spread rumors, can run the world—that is their motto. 

The university's vice-chancellor said in a press release, "We want a world where the division between truth and falsehood will completely disappear. Our goal is to produce scholars who will present lies through propaganda in such a way that it becomes the scripture of the new age." 
In terms of faculty recruitment, they are thinking not only of theorists, but also of practitioners in the field. It is heard that some Bangladeshi journalists and social media activists have already been invited as guest faculty. One journalist said, "We have been playing a leading role in spreading rumors lately." If we get recognition for this international standard work, our lives will be meaningful. Food Delivery 

On the other hand, Ilyas Hossain's name is coming up as a part-time teacher for the digital propaganda course. Although he has not said anything yet, sources close to him say that he has already launched an online course on YouTube, Propaganda: Tool of Mastermind. The course is providing hands-on training: how to mislead people in a three-minute video and how to go viral overnight with fake news. 

Journalists from various Indian newspapers and television stations have expressed great interest in working better on propaganda. It is already known that Republic Channel has contacted the university's admissions team to get their entire team to do a masters together. Journalist Mayukh has announced his return on Facebook in a more terrifying way, although I did not understand the reason before, now I understand why he said this. 
However, many people think that it is not possible to learn an important subject like propaganda in a one-year course. It absolutely needs to be taught from primary school, commented a prominent Facebooker. Some people are saying, what is the use of doing a master's degree from the Paris School of Pinocomics? If you take Elias Hossain's course, you will get instant results! 

The future of world politics is now divided into two poles. On one side is the propaganda studies of the Paris School of Pinocomics, and on the other side is Elias Hossain's YouTube course. It can be said that the days of Netflix are coming to an end. Now people will play games with rumors, and learn the engineering of lies. 

Time will tell who will win this race. But one thing is certain: we are entering a new era in the death of truth, the rise of lies, and the festival of propaganda.

Headline_English: Elias' prediction of Dhaka attack, Arifin Shuvo tells everyone to stay calm
Content_English:
Dhaka is sitting on a dormant volcano. A terrible attack could happen any time after the 30th, journalist Ilyas Hossain made such a thrilling prediction. In a recent 30-minute video, Ilyas analyzed the current political situation in the country and intelligence from secret sources and said that an armed guerrilla attack is being planned, the target of which is the capital Dhaka. 

Ilyas said in a status on his fake Facebook account that this is not just a warning. The situation is very worrying. The people of the country must be aware and prepared. If anything happens at any time, we will have nothing to do. Although Ilyas' statement has spread anxiety among the common people, there is room for hope. Meanwhile, star actor Arifin Shuvo has instilled new hope in the minds of the citizens of Dhaka. Hearing about this guerrilla attack in Dhaka, he said, I have saved Dhaka before and will save it this time too. Like in movies, I am ready to fight by risking my life in real life. I have no hesitation in giving up my film fees for the country. Everyone, stay calm, even if Dhaka is attacked, I am here. 

Arifin Shuvo is preparing himself right now. While talking to our correspondent at a gym in Dhaka, he said, "I have no blood in my body, courage flows in my veins. If you listen to my heartbeat, you will hear not a thud but an atak atak." Dhaka attack is part of my career, now I am preparing to defend Dhaka in reality. While doing push-ups, he promises with a smile, no matter how big the risk, I will defend Dhaka. 

By all accounts, Dhaka is now like a shooting set for a real action movie! On one side is journalist Ilias Hossain, who claims to be the mastermind of the secret intel, and on the other side, Arifin Shuvo, who appears as the Superman of Dhaka. The incident has reached such a point that it seems that 'Dhaka Attack 2: The Return of Shuvo' will soon be seen on the streets of Dhaka. 

Even the boys of the neighborhood are now flocking to the gym to build a body like Shuvo. A young man even said, "Brother, we are also ready for Dhaka. We will run whenever Shuvo Bhai calls us." 

Meanwhile, the combination of Elias' secret intel and Shuvo's push-up action has made the situation so thrilling that we have received information that Hollywood scriptwriters are booking tickets to come to Dhaka to find new stories.

Headline_English: 47th BCS circular published, Abed Ali special question bank coming
Content_English:
Yesterday, the Bangladesh Public Service Commission published the circular for the 47th preliminary examination. The last date for applying according to the circular is December 31. The preliminary examination is likely to be held in May, 2025. Like all other times, Abed Ali Gong is the ultimate hope of some candidates. The search has started since the BCS circular was issued. Where is Abed Ali? Bangla Book 

According to fake sources who do not want to be named, it has been learned that Abed Ali is busy creating a question bank. Like other years, this time too, he will release a book containing three sets of question banks the night before the exam. However, the price of this question bank is sky-high. In response to the question of why the price of a question bank is so high, he said, you will get 100% common. This is Abed Ali's promise... 

During conversations with 47 BCS candidates, different pictures can be seen. Some have already started studying in a hurry. Some are still hoping for the question bank. 

A candidate named Siam said, "I just read the question bank the day before the exam. I am also studying for the SSC, HSCO and admission exams in this way. Every time I find some angels like Abed Ali. Luckily, they were there! For them, I'm just a chill guy...

Headline_English: The new season of the Sons of Anarchy series is coming, the plot is being written centered on Dhaka
Content_English:
The makers of Hollywood's timeless series Sons of Anarchy have announced a new season. And this time, the center of their story will be Dhaka. The ongoing anarchic situation in Dhaka, clashes between colleges, gang jams on the streets, and the autorickshaw-CNG fight—all of which are going to be part of the script of the new season. 

The new season will see the formation of an empire of chaos in Dhaka with the Afos League gang and the 'short fuse leaders' of Collegepara. Rumor has it that the series will focus on the DRMMC gang, 7 college shadows, and autorickshaw ninjas—these three powerful groups. The fight for dominance between them will continue from the tea shop in Gulistan to the autorickshaw race in Hatirjheel. 
At one point, the gang leaders can be heard saying at the climax of the clash, no one can stop us on the roads of Dhaka. The bikers who hit the brakes stop, but we don't! 

The makers also want to use the Prothom Alo office in Dhaka and its surrounding areas for shooting. One of the biggest clash scenes in the story will be created around this location. In one scene, the leaders of another gang called the Goru Gang will enter the Prothom Alo office and throw beef steaks. 

It is even rumored that gangs from outside Dhaka will also arrive in the new season. Viking Raiders from Scandinavia, Panda Clan from China and Truder Tribes from the West will appear to clash with Bangladeshi gangs. 

‘We want to take Dhaka’s gang war to a global scale’, the series’ screenwriter told us in a fictional interview. 

Another important theme of this season will be the ‘CNG vs. Autorickshaw’ battle. Both sides will want to establish their dominance on the streets of Dhaka. This conflict will spread tension on the roads from Mirpur to Motijheel, from Mohammadpur to Hatirjheel.

Headline_English: NCTB under siege to remove interest-based calculations from math books
Content_English:
A strange unrest is going on across the country. Almost every day of the month, some people in the country are encircling some office in excitement. After the media, this time the target is NCTB i.e. National Curriculum and Textbook Board. 

It has been learned from a fake source that the students have surrounded NCTB to remove the interest-bearing chapter from the math book. Roni (12), an eighth grade student, said, even doing calculations on a lowly subject like interest is a sin. Even if it is just simple profit, we would have thought about it, but compound profit, compound interest... No way bro... I don't want to indulge in these injustices at the beginning of my life. 

Student leader Jewel Uddin Das, a tenth grade student, said, there is a test exam ahead. If there is any number from the interest-bearing chapter in the exam, Yusuf Sarkar will have to pay the ultimate price for it. This is the last time I have given a stern warning. After that, there will be no more verbal communication, only verbal communication... 

It is believed that not only school students, but also government job and BCS examinees are behind this as supporters. Even if they are not in the field, they are keeping an eye on the siege program. 

Considering the overall situation, NCTB book writers are going through a very difficult time. Mathematics book writer Osman Gani said in a meeting with the students, "Fathers, you tell me what will be in the book. Each of you can also take responsibility for each chapter. The book will be written the way you want."

Headline_English: Proposal to rename Newmarket Road to Panipath
Content_English:
Newmarket Road has long been in the news for gangbangs, fights, and commotion. The gangbangs that have occurred in the Newmarket area recently have reportedly put a few extra wrinkles on the foreheads of the members of the Reform Bangladesh Reform Commission. 

A member of the Reform Commission said in a status on Facebook from a fake ID that Science Lab-Newmarket Road is famous for various reasons, but its reputation for gangbangs is now world-wide. Here, students from one college occasionally remove billboards of another college and have a showdown. Even ordinary people get caught up in the attacks and counterattacks. 
The current situation is such that it is not only students who are gangbanging, but whoever feels like it, is going to Newmarket Road and doing something. This morning, eyewitnesses reported that no buses are running in the Newmarket area. Thousands of people are walking on the road, and it is known that several minor fights have also taken place in such a crowd. As members of the Yusuf government's reform commission, our main task will be to decide how to bring this chaos into order. 

When we spoke to another member of the reform commission, he said, requesting anonymity, "We cannot change the attitude of students or other professionals even if we want to. However, we can change the name of the entire New Market Road. We are thinking of renaming the road Panipath. From 2025, the new name of New Market Road will be Panipath." 

There is also great enthusiasm among the people of Dhaka. Many years ago, two historic battles took place at Panipath. After many wars, no one's desire to see a third or fourth Panipath battle has been fulfilled. It is hoped that in the future we will see many more Panipath battles. New brave warriors will be created in our country. Their heroic stories will spread across the world.

Headline_English: Junaid Ahmed Palak formed a band called Chauddashik with other leaders detained in prison
Content_English:
Junaid Ahmed Palak has formed a new band called Chauddashik while sitting in prison! Former ICT State Minister Palak claims that politics could never fully satisfy him, because he had an artistic nature hidden in his heart. After eating prison khichuri and iodine salt, one day he realized that he was actually a born artist. Although he did politics under family pressure, his mind was filled with songs, songs and more songs. Palak started Chauddashik with two other leaders of the Awami League—Barrister Sumon (base guitar) and Dr. Murad (Kahn). 

So far, they have written several original songs. The band's live performances now wake up the prisoners in the morning. Plans are also underway to recruit new members. It is reported that Salman F. Rahman, Hasanul Haque Inu and Dr. Dipu Moni are being taught to sing to be included in the group. 

However, the prison authorities are angry with Chauddashik's activities. According to an official, it would have been tolerated if the three of them had sung together. But now they have started a whole band project and turned the prison into a stage for madmen. It seems that we are the prisoners and they are the authorities. 

The prisoners' reaction is also mixed. Although initially the songs of Chauddashik became their only source of entertainment, the attempt to sing songs with other leaders has changed the situation. One prisoner said, Chauddashik was a blessing for us. But now they have robbed us of sleep at night. I was in favor of the Chauddashik of the three people in the beginning, but I am not in favor of what they are doing now. 

Among them, one prisoner fainted after listening to their songs, so the atmosphere in the prison is quite tense. The leader of the prisoners in the prison has announced, either the Chauddashik stops their songs or we will all start singing songs ourselves from tomorrow, you will understand the rest. However, one prisoner has expressed a different opinion. He wants to hear Chauddashik sing about you, especially – You are my life, you are my death. I can't see you, but listening to his songs makes me feel a little better. You can't bring him to jail, if you can bring him a little bit with your songs. 

In the wake of this incident, the prison authorities are planning to transfer Palak and his bandmates to separate cells. The prison warden said that they will not tolerate the mental pressure on all the other prisoners for the songs of 4/5 people. I am afraid to even listen to Chauddashik's songs when I go home, and you can understand the condition of those who live with them, he was saying.

Headline_English: 'Stone Throwing Studies' department to be opened at Titumir College
Content_English:
Students are protesting to demand that Titumir College be declared a university. Although they have been actively involved in various activities including road blockades and train stops, thousands of questions have been raised in the public mind about the effectiveness of the movement. In particular, their weakness in stone throwing is worrying everyone. 

Recently, a section of the protesters said that they are continuing this movement by following the syllabus of the July movement. However, the problem has arisen with the issue of stone throwing on trains. Since there is no reference to this in the syllabus of the July movement, the stones have hit ordinary people instead of reaching the right target, which has called into question the qualifications of the protesters. 
Considering this situation, the Titumir College administration has decided to start a new department. An exceptional department called 'Stone Throwing Studies' is going to be started in the college, where students will be given international standard training from selecting stones to throwing stones at the right target. 
A teacher at the college said on condition of anonymity that the lack of skill of our students in the protest has put us to shame. How will those who cannot throw stones at the target correctly achieve the goal of the movement? That is why we have decided to launch the ‘Stone Throwing Studies’ department. 

He further said that experts in throwing stones will be appointed as teachers for the department. For example, there are plans to bring in skilled individuals like leaders who threw eggs in the court premises, people who threw shoes at George Bush, etc. as trainers. Under their supervision, students will be able to lead future movements with skill. 

Those concerned hope that this initiative of Titumir College will improve the quality of the students’ movement and pave the way for them to achieve their goals.

Headline_English: Winter Lover wants advisor on winter weather
Content_English:
Winter lovers' minds race when winter comes—wearing hoodies, the comfort of blankets, basking in the afternoon sun, or stretching out their bodies in the cold, raw air. But there's only one problem: no one knows when winter will come! Rumors are circulating that winter has arrived, while others say it hasn't yet. However, most people have one opinion: this time winter will come slowly. 

How emotional winter lovers are about winter can be understood from their aesthetic plans for celebrating winter. Hoodies, coats, and mufflers—without these, their lives seem meaningless. However, without a specific announcement about when winter will arrive, they have not yet been able to enjoy the true joy of winter. In such a situation, winter lovers have unitedly demanded that a ministry on winter should be opened in Bangladesh and an advisor should be appointed! A member of the Winter Lovers Association expressed his anger and said, "Should we start celebrating winter just by hearing rumors over and over again? We too have emotions! I want to know from a reliable source when winter is coming." He further said, "In foreign countries, summer or winter is announced in advance, but we have no plans for winter here. We came out wearing a hoodie, and everyone around us was wearing short-sleeved shirts. When this happens, we feel ashamed and want to cut off our heads." 

According to winter lovers, no one is more qualified than Chhotan Kaka to be an advisor on how to get out of winter. Chhotan Kaka is our inspiration for winter love, said a winter lover. When he says he is not going to stand in the cold, we are assured that winter has finally arrived. Without his words, winter remains incomplete. A fan of Chhotan Kaka directly said that if Chhotan Kaka is not made an advisor, then we will go out on the streets naked this winter. 

On the other hand, the Night King of Game of Thrones is also a possible candidate. Once he says that winter is coming, we will start observing winter from our own position, said a Night King fan. 

The Winter Lover Association has informed that if they do not get an advisor as soon as possible, they will be left bare-chested for the rest of their lives, and Yusuf Sarkar will pay a heavy price for this. Now it is just a matter of time, it remains to be seen whether Choton Kaka, the Night King or someone else will take on the responsibility of this winter!

Headline_English: Nijhum Majumdar, Syed Abdullah's supporters, told Mayukh of Republic Bengal to take Harpic regularly to clear his head
Content_English:
A new medicine has arrived in the country. People's minds are becoming clear by taking it. The mute can speak, the insane are getting better, the lame are starting to walk. The success story of Harpik has crossed the country's borders and even reached the talk show table. Last night, on a talk show, a talk show host named Syed Abdullah showed Harpik to another talk show host named Nijhum Majumdar. That too live. Various discussions and criticisms are going on about this. 

In the meantime, Nijhum Majumdar and Syed Abdullah's supporters have advised Mayukh of Republic Bengal to take Harpik. They say that the mental imbalance that has arisen in Mayukh of Republic Bengal will be corrected only by taking Harpik regularly. 

Regarding this, Nijhum Majumdar said, I myself am proof. Earlier I was a fool. Now I am fully fit after taking Harpik regularly. Mayukh brother can also take it. He is fine. Besides, I am in India, you can take it from me. I have premium quality food grade Harpic. 

Syed Abdullah himself has also talked about the benefits of Harpic. From a fake ID, he said, I didn't eat it before. I didn't believe it. Later, I ate it last night and it felt good. I had some physical complications. I am healthy now after eating Harpic. Mayukh should also eat Harpic. Otherwise, today he is saying that Chittagong will be taken over by India, tomorrow he will say that America will take over India. If this continues, we will not be able to show our faces as South Asians in the world.

Headline_English: Zuckerberg's CEO position is being taken away because he passed Inter
Content_English:
Mark Zuckerberg, CEO of Meta, the owner of Facebook, Instagram, and Threads, has a college education. It can be said that he is an inter-graduate. Many are tearing their hair out over how an inter-graduate can become the CEO of a large organization like Meta. Many Bangladeshis are losing sleep over this question. 

Inter-graduates are actually not qualified to hold any position, and the person who is not qualified to make tea in the Facebook office is occupying the CEO chair, a rising youth was expressing his anger by saying. According to him, those who have not studied more than an inter-graduate are not qualified to hold any position, be it an advisor or a CEO of any position. Thousands of people are posting on Facebook with #StepDownZuckerberg to attract the attention of the Meta authorities. This has also created a tense atmosphere in the Meta office. Many are saying that there is an in-depth discussion going on in the board of directors about Zuckerberg's CEO position, which has also affected the performance of the employees.

An international representative of ours spoke to the Mather board of directors. A board member, speaking on condition of anonymity, said that Zuckerberg's passing out of an internship has hurt the feelings of many Bangladeshi users. We are considering the matter seriously and hope to provide a positive update on the matter soon. Tourism Package 

When contacted, Mark Zuckerberg jokingly said, "If I had known earlier, I would have completed my studies at Harvard even if I had cheated." It's good to see so much concern for my studies. If you want, I can get admitted to Harvard again, but I need everyone's prayers." 

Meanwhile, a young intellectual wrote in his status on Facebook, "I am running a site created by an internship graduate who couldn't even finish college. What is his CEO position again? Zuckerberg should come to Bangladesh and sell fuchka!"

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina expresses hope of becoming interim government's escape advisor
Content_English:
The interim government is being expanded in line with the needs of the time. So far, 24 advisors are working tirelessly to speed up the work of various ministries and to perform the work better. It is learned that a few more advisors will be appointed. 

Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who fled the country, is spending idle time in India.
