She has expressed the hope of doing something good when she returns to power, and has also expressed her interest in becoming the advisor on escape to the interim government. Although direct contact with Sheikh Hasina was not possible, our delegation was able to contact her son Sajeeb Wazed Joy. When asked about his mother's interest in becoming an advisor, Joy said, "In the thousand-year history of Bengal, no one has left power and escaped in a helicopter like this. No one is as skilled in escaping as my mother. Therefore, my mother is a suitable candidate as an advisor on escape." 

Awami League leaders and activists have been waiting for Sheikh Hasina to return for a long time. Since the rumors of Sheikh Hasina becoming an advisor spread, many people have been hopeful. She has been silent for so long, saying that she might return as an advisor. Our Apa loses but does not disappear, said an Awami League fan. 

If Sheikh Hasina is not appointed as an advisor on escape, director Delwar Hossain Jhantu has announced that he will remake the movie Escape Plan with her. He wrote in a post from a fake Facebook account, "No one can escape like Sheikh Hasina; therefore, a remake of 'Escape Plan' is possible with her. No one can even act like a crybaby like her. I want to bring a few Oscars to the country by having her act if I don't win the Nobel Prize."

Headline_English: Chama lovers protest demanding declaration of Monas 10 as national medicine
Content_English:
The cold weather has not yet set in, but the crowds at pharmacies are increasing to buy winter medicines. The demand for various winter medicines has increased manifold in every area. In the morning, our representative noticed a long line of people coming to buy medicines in front of a pharmacy. Some are sneezing, some are coughing, and some are watering their noses. 

Our representative understood the real issue by talking to those who work in pharmacies. It is known that the sale of various winter medicines, including Monas 10, has increased at an alarming rate in pharmacies. Everyone is stocking up on medicines for several months at a time, so the Pharmacy Association has imposed restrictions. Now no one can buy more than 10 pieces of medicine at a time. I don't like winter at all. I am a summer lover; whenever winter comes, I have to spend my days eating Monas 10 and Fexo. I want winter not to come again. And even if it does, I don't have to suffer so much, said Monirul of Mohammadpur. 
Meanwhile, a crisis of Monas 10 has arisen across the country. The situation is such that each person is willing to spend more than 100 taka per piece to get Monas 10. When we tried to talk to a victim, he said that he did not have the strength to talk in such a situation. Still, he said that if something needs to be done, either the winter season will have to be stopped, or Monas 10 will have to be declared a national medicine and an endless supply at a low price will have to be ensured. 

Summer Lovers are quite vocal in demanding that Monas 10 be declared a national medicine. At a recent human chain, the spokesperson of the Summer Lovers Association said, "We are still alive today because of Monas 10. For people like us, Monas 10 is in demand after oxygen. This medicine deserves international recognition. Although the international issue is not in our hands, at least it should be declared as a national medicine in the country. Otherwise, we will be doing injustice to winter." He also said that if necessary, they will form a coordinating committee today, whose main task will be to ensure the right place of Monas 10 in the country.

Headline_English: Khaled Mahmud Sujan is being appointed to speed up the work of the interim government.
Content_English:
The number of advisors being appointed is being gradually increased to speed up the work of the interim government. The current advisory board of this government, which started its work with 17 advisors, has now reached 24, and may increase further in the future. 

Recently, when the issue of speeding up the work of the government by appointing new advisors gained importance, the expert community has also proposed the name of ‘speed demon’ Khaled Mahmud Sujan. Well-known as an expert on speed, Khaled Mahmud Sujan is known for his speed. Wherever he is, speed increases manifold—be it on the cricket field or in the government. In this context, experienced captain Sajmul Hasan Supta commented, wherever Khaled Mahmud is, there will be an explosion of speed. 
Khaled Mahmud’s fans are quite excited about this news. While talking to one of Sujan’s fans, our eRK reporter noticed that Sujan’s fans talk so fast that it is not possible to record everything. However, as far as we can understand, his main point was that Sujan is the speed magician of modern Bengal. Wherever he goes, the magic of speed will spread. 

Even in the upper echelons of the interim government, there is a positive attitude towards Khaled Mahmud. A high-ranking official said, if the speed of work increases many times because of an advisor, then there is no need to hire more people unnecessarily. Everyone knows that more monks are a waste of time. 

Meanwhile, Khaled Mahmud himself is also honing his speed in serving the country. He watches Flash three times a day and tries to make himself more dynamic by watching Quicksilver videos while eating. He said, if I were the advisor, any citizen's desire for any government work would be done as soon as he expressed it; there would be no need to say it out loud.

Headline_English: Shakib joins Sri Lankan Cricket League; asks to pay salary in cash
Content_English:
Bangladesh cricket star Shakib Al Hasan will play in the upcoming Lanka T-10 League starting from December 12. He has signed a direct contract with Galle Marvels without participating in the auction process. However, in this league, he wants to take his salary in hand, because Bangladesh Bank has recently frozen his bank account. 

Shakib said about his salary, I can no longer trust the bank. In the future, I will take money in hand for all types of payments. Although the bank account was frozen, it did not affect his decision to play. He also said that some experienced people have been appointed from abroad to receive and calculate the salary on his behalf, who will count every taka by hand and confirm the accounts by counting it. There have been rumors that he has a crisis of confidence in the country's banking system since Bangladesh Bank froze several of Shakib's bank accounts. When one of our representatives tried to contact him, Shakib said, if you keep money in the bank, it gets frozen during the winter. If you have money in your own hand, you don't have to worry about these things, you can also play the game with great concentration. So I think it is safe to take money in hand. 

When I wanted to talk to Shishir Bhabi about this, she said that she was thinking of writing a big Facebook post, but she told us in advance what she would write. Her statement was something like this, the Bengali nation is really innocent, they got to celebrate so many victories for Shakib, and now they have frozen the bank account for some petty corruption. Hey, is there a lack of a refrigerator in our house? We will not take money from the bank anymore, our money is hot, keeping our money frozen is pointless. 

After Shakib's decision to take money in hand, his fans are trying to volunteer to help. In a post from a fake Facebook profile, he said, I will carry my money myself, if necessary, I will go to Sri Lanka a hundred times. I will not hand over money to others. In the words of a poet, he also said, bookish knowledge is not wealth, knowledge is not wealth, if necessary.

Headline_English: Arefin Shuvo is coming to Gulistan; has been preparing for 3 months
Content_English:
With the fall of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and the Bangladesh Awami League, many people's careers and vitality have run out. Bangladesh Awami League is currently an endangered and extinct political party. The fall of this party does not only mean a change in power, but some of the party lovers like Momtaz, Tanvin Sweety or Rokeya Prachi have become fragile and dull. Their lives are in serious danger today. However, some turn around in the midst of this. One of them is renowned actor and bodybuilder Arefin Shuvo. Bangla Books 

Arefin Shuvo uploaded a picture of himself from his Facebook page 15 hours ago. There he is seen taking a mirror selfie in a smoky state with an amulet around his neck and a bracelet in his hand. The caption reads, 'Checkmate'. Some of the fans and viewers have started exploring the hidden meaning of this picture. Many people think that this film has a special meaning. A fake source who does not want to be named said, Shuvo Bhai has been preparing for today (November 10) since the fall of the government. He has built a very good body. He is also learning Kung Fu and Karate. Whoever obstructs the Awami League at zero point, he will slap the forehead of his brother. You should be careful... Brother, but that's the thing...' 

Another source told us that Apa and Bhai have reached an official agreement. Earlier, he got a ten-katha plot in Purbachal for one taka in the film. However, this time Apa has said that he will increase the rate. He will get 5 kathas of land in Gulshan to give per person a batam. And if he can send him to the hospital, 15 kathas... 

Not only Arefin Shuvo, but from reliable sources, it is known that Meher Afroz Shaon and Momtaz will also be present there. Former MP Momtaz will sit on a floating red carpet 1500 feet above the ground and sing the song 'Fightya Jay'. Also, popular visual, vocal and dance artist Meher Afroz Shaon will play an important role at Zero Point. It is known that when the Awami-Youb League gets tired or to distract the enemy, she will sing the song 'Amar Ache BAL' and 'Amar Ache Jal' and perform a dance.

Headline_English: 'Chaps' is being launched to remind you when you've been bitten by someone;
Content_English:
Chapping is a part of our daily life. Many people come to Cox's Bazar for 100 taka, some take four lovers together and do it. Some put their uncle in the secretariat, while others leave their luxurious Bugatti cars in the back alleys of Dhaka. Influential chapping masters become the crushes of hundreds of people due to their chapping. 

There are few people who have not been caught chapping in the chats of friends or with seniors and juniors. Recently, when an eArch reporter wanted to interview a popular chapping master, the chapping master said, "I am talking to Donald Trump right now." However, this did not work at all. Our reporter actually called the chapping master while leaving Donald Trump online, which is why the chapping master got caught. The chapping master also has a mild regret that he no longer remembers who he chaped. Seeing the amnesia of the chapping masters, a software company in the country is launching a special app called 'Chaps'. This app will detect and save the lies of cheaters. As a result, by opening the app once before going to bed at the end of the day, you can easily remember who cheated whom today. 

A member of the developer team of the Chaps app said that the situation of cheaters is such that by cheating different people, they forget who they said what at the end of the day. This often leads to them losing their respect after being caught. The app will help cheaters solve this problem. As a special feature, the premium version will have a real-time cheat detection feature. If someone tries to cheat on a topic differently, the app will immediately notify them and ask them to stop cheating. 

There has been quite a craze for cheaters about Chaps. Many have claimed that with the help of the app, they will go on a trip to Hawaii with their friends after improving their cheating skills.

Headline_English: I have won 3 consecutive elections, I have the sole right to go to the White House: Sheikh Hasina
Content_English:
The discussion about who is controlling world politics is never-ending. On one side is Kamala Harris, on the other is Donald Trump. We will have to wait until the final election results to know who will finally occupy the White House. 

Former fugitive Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina, who is in India, is closely monitoring the dynamics of the US election. When no one in the world can say exactly who will end up in the White House, she has said that she has the only right to go to the White House. 
In this regard, her only son Sajeeb Wazed said in a video message from his fake Facebook account, "My mother has been elected Prime Minister three times in a row through fair elections. While Kamala Harris is dreaming of going to the White House by voting in advance alone, my mother used to vote in advance with her entire party during the elections. Considering the election strategy, everyone will admit that the only person worthy of going to the White House is my mother. 

When no one doubts Sheikh Hasina's qualifications to enter the White House, neither Trump nor Kamala Harris understands why she is in India. A personal assistant of Trump told the American delegation of eArchie that after the election campaign ended, Trump was seen on video calls with Sheikh Hasina to update her on the progress of the election and to regularly seek political advice. 

On the other hand, it is known that Kamala Harris also voted early for the first time on Sheikh Hasina's advice. None of the other members of her party showed such courage, so they also did not participate in the early voting. A close person of Kamala said, whoever the president is, Sheikh Hasina will be behind the scenes in power. So whether Trump or Kamala enters the White House is not that important, the real issue is when Sheikh Hasina enters.

Headline_English: National Moon Sighting Committee is meeting to decide on the day to wear the hoodie.
Content_English:
Winter is almost here. Fog appears in the morning, many people sleep with their heads covered in kathas and fans on at night. The nights also seem to be long. It is clear that winter is standing at our doorstep. Everyone is now worried about winter clothes, especially the youth who are worried endlessly—when can we wear hoodie jackets? 

The situation is like this, it is cold, but no one dares to wear a hoodie. If you go out alone wearing a hoodie, your friends will laugh at you! Thousands of young people are waiting with the cold feeling of winter, when they will be able to go out with everyone around them, at the same time wearing a hoodie. One of our correspondents talked to his own mind about the matter. Why do I feel so hesitant to wear a hoodie? His mind replied with a slight smile, if you go out wearing a hoodie today, thousands of people will look at you and laugh. Do you want to be the laughing stock or not? 
Considering the concerns of these young people, the National Moon Sighting Committee has held a special moon sighted meeting. The only topic of discussion is when can we start wearing hoodies. Once the new moon is properly visible in the sky, they will announce a day, and the 'hoodie festival' will begin from that day! On that desired day of wearing hoodies, everyone will come out wearing hoodies at once. 

In this regard, the spokesperson of the moon sighting committee said that they are fully prepared. However, due to the cloudy weather and the new moon in the sky, there is a little delay in fixing the date. But surely the announcement will come soon. 

On the other hand, not only the youth are excited about this announcement, but also the hoodie sellers are looking forward to it. The day the moon sighting committee announces the date for wearing hoodies, they will organize a big event. Everyone will wear hoodies in the cold winter air, and that day will be memorable for everyone!

Headline_English: Search at Mamunul Haque's house: Huge quantity of charas seized
Content_English:
Among Islamic scholars in Bangladesh, a prominent scholar, Mamunul Haque, is known as a bright symbol of wisdom, intelligence, and uncompromising leadership. His insightful speeches and leadership have brought a new dimension and new vigor to the Islamic society of the country. With a combination of extraordinary wisdom, sharp analytical skills, and spiritual perspective, he has been working tirelessly to protect Bangladesh from the hands of a deviant culture. 

In a recent speech, he said that when women win something, people make a fuss about it. But even when boys win many World Cups, he does not make much fuss about it. After such a statement, a search was recently conducted at the house of this prominent person. This angered religious people including civil society. Some are saying, how can such things be in the house of such a God-fearing person? Is he a media person who would have a house full of liquor and illegal things? 
When asked about the reason for the search, a member of the search team said, the shelves of BCB and BFF trophies are empty. If the World Cups won by the boys are found in his house, the shelves will be filled up a bit. Moreover, the question of the boys' honor and dignity is also involved. If they get the cups, they can be thrown in the face of the countrymen. 

Although Mamunul Haque was initially reluctant to open his mouth about this, he eventually agreed. He said, the Chyaras are actually winning many World Cups. But since they are not arrogant, they do not like to show off. That is why they used to deposit them with me. I have told you many times, take these, do not keep them with me. None of them have listened to me. Why, I do not see so much jumping about them by the people of Bangladesh... The truth is, people jump when they see Cheri. That too, Cheri wearing half pants. Win or lose is just a joke. 

Although the Chyaras' World Cup was not found after the search, Mamunul Haque assured him from his fake ID. He said that even if it is not at home, it may be somewhere else. He will look for it.

Headline_English: Jumlung Sherpa came to Panchagarh from Nepal to see Kanchenjunga
Content_English:
With the arrival of winter, a Nepalese tourist has come to Bangladesh. After setting foot in Panchagarh, he said that he had come only to enjoy the beautiful beauty of Kanchenjunga. The tourist named Jumlung Sherpa told eArchi's representative, "I am so bored after seeing Kanchenjunga from Nepal that I don't feel anything anymore. I had heard that this mountain peak looks very beautiful from Bangladesh. I came to Bangladesh to experience that. Fashion Products 

The people of Panchagarh are quite happy with the arrival of Jumlung Sherpa. A section of the locals are wondering whether any steps can be taken to ensure that Kanchenjunga can be seen from Panchagarh all year round. Some are jokingly saying that if Kanchenjunga could somehow be brought from Nepal to Bangladesh, then we would not have to bother with binoculars to see it! 
The Panchagarh Hotel Owners Association is already planning to set up some 'Kanchenjunga View' resorts for tourists. Various packages are being announced to attract international tourists. Even special food has been brought from Kushtia, which will make tourists feel like they are sitting near Kanchenjunga. 

Meanwhile, local businessmen have become very enthusiastic. An initiative has been taken to open a restaurant called 'Nepali Dumpling and Momo House' next to the Kanchenjunga View Resort. A restaurant owner says, we are trying to create an environment in which tourists will feel like they are sitting in a village in Nepal and seeing Kanchenjunga. 

With this thought in mind, the locals are preparing to adapt to the global culture. Many have expressed interest in learning Russian, Chinese, Japanese and other languages ​​besides learning Nepali.

Headline_English: Boys from the boys' cricket team line up to get water to wash the feet of the women's football team.
Content_English:
The women's football team has created history by winning the SAFF Championship by defeating Nepal on Nepalese soil for the last two times. Earlier, the girls were crowned Asian champions in cricket in 2018. The boys are under a lot of pressure due to the girls' back-to-back success. It is also known that the boys of the cricket team are being bullied socially. They are unable to leave the house, and whenever they go out, everyone says, "Drink the water that washed the girls' feet." 

After such an incident, it has been reported that the boys of the cricket team are standing in line to drink the water that washed their feet. 
A cricketer named Lajmul Hasan Prant told journalist Riasat Azim on condition of anonymity that nutrition experts believe that the secret to the success of the female footballers is hidden in their feet. A member of the national men's football team told our correspondent that despite playing in the international arena for many years, we have not achieved anything to be proud of. However, the girls are winning one after another. It seems that there is some magical power in their feet that is bringing them such success. That is why we want to drink the water that washed their feet. 

Meanwhile, many cricketers are complaining of cheating after collecting and drinking the water they used to wash their feet. One such cricketer said, "We are cheated wherever we go in the school. They gave us Dhaka WASA water on the pretext of washing the feet of the women's football team. They also took a lot of money. Now two cricketers are sick after drinking this water. My stomach is also turning. Why does this always happen to us?"

Headline_English: Tigers want to take a course to learn how to pose with the trophy; BCB reluctant due to unnecessary expenses
Content_English:
After winning the World Cup, Lionel Messi posed while sleeping with the trophy. After that, it became a trend, in any sport, be it cricket or football, anyone who wins a trophy sleeps and poses like Messi. Even recently, the members of the Bangladesh women's football team, who became champions in women's soccer, gave the same pose. The Bangladesh cricket team, or Tigers, are quite excited about this issue. 

They want to be prepared in advance so that they can pose like this even if they don't win any trophy so far or at least win a series even if they don't win any trophy in the future. For now, only Captain Shanta has the skill in this matter, but they want this skill to spread to the entire team. In this regard, a Tiger wrote in his daily status, PO trophy, you and I will bloom flower buds together, I will take you to pose on the night of the flower bed. Aylabiu, this is real. 

However, BCB officials have strongly objected to the issue. They have expressed their reluctance to spend unnecessarily on this new course for cricketers, in addition to not having sufficient funds. In this regard, the BCB's Sahamat Bhai told us in a purely fictional interview, "Our fixed deposit of Tk 900 crore is over, now we will teach them to pose with the trophy again while raising all these Arkama tigers. If they have time after giving status and savage replies in the press conference, let them use that time to at least win a few matches first, and then we can think about all this."

Headline_English: Dollar price drops sharply, reaches record high; Yusuf Sarkar will give currency price
Content_English:
The dollar has been the sole dominant currency in international trade for so long, because there was no alternative medium of exchange other than the dollar, but this week the dollar's value began to plummet. Experts say that the dollar has fallen so much since the 'price will be paid by the Yusuf government' currency was added to the exchange rate. Most countries have already voted in favor of using this currency. However, the International Monetary Fund has said that not only the normal price will be needed for the import and export of some products, but also the 'Yusuf government will have to pay an extreme price' currency. 

Our reporter found a dollar trader selling dollars on the street in a very disappointed state. Later, when we asked him for more details about the incident, he said in a very angry state, the Yusuf government will have to pay an extreme price for kicking us in the stomach and playing the twelve of the syndicate. We will come back as dollars in a terrible form by mixing with the Chhatra League, he wrote. 

However, the country's money launderers and corrupt circles are quite happy with the use of this currency. One such corrupt person called us from his secret lair and told us, "Earlier, I used to pay all my expenses by putting guns on the shoulders of ordinary people, but now I am quite tense. Anyway, it's better. I want to buy a house in Canada, and that desire has become even stronger since I learned that the Yusuf government will pay the price."

Headline_English: Scotland Yard assigned to solve Mohammadpur smoke mystery
Content_English:
Last night, the sky and air of Mohammadpur were filled with a mysterious smoke. No one had any way of understanding where this smoke came from, how it spread and why it was so thick! After various research and speculations, no one could solve the mystery despite trying all night. Finally, helplessly giving up, the people of Mohammadpur were forced to fall asleep. 

The Mohammadpur Security Council organized a special meeting as soon as they woke up in the morning. A proposal was made to form an investigation committee to find out the cause of the smoke. The matter has become so important that an initiative has been taken to bring help from outside the country for the investigation. The world-famous Scotland Yard has been appointed to unravel the mystery of the Mohammadpur smoke! When contacted, a spokesperson for Scotland Yard said, "Just why the smoke, if we want, where did this smoke originate, who did it, why did it, we can find out everything. We have a dog squad, if you put this smoke in their noses once, they will go straight to the original place." Bangladesh no longer has to worry about smoke. Food delivery 

Meanwhile, the country's famous detective Feluda has expressed his anger over the appointment of these foreign detectives. In a status on his Facebook profile, Feluda said that no one but the people of this country can solve the riddle of the alleys of Mohammadpur. They are bringing people from abroad, they will lose their way after crossing two or three alleys. Will you solve the mystery of the smoke with those who cannot find their own way? You have to admire your intelligence! 

According to Feluda, despite the fact that there are so many detectives in this country, asking them to bring a foreign agency to search for smoke in the alleys of Mohammadpur is like a national insult.

Headline_English: Director plans to bring Lootera 2, wants top Awami leaders including Sheikh Hasina in lead roles
Content_English:
The director is planning to bring a sequel to the famous Bollywood movie Lootera starring Ranveer Singh and Sonakshi Sinha. He also said that work is in the pipeline to bring two series named S Alam or Darvesh Baba as spin-offs of this movie. They will also be made based on bank robbery. Headline_English: In addition to Chrome, Yusuf is demanding a price from the government for Google, Chatgpt and Opera mini.
Content_English:
Recently, our beloved Yusuf Sarkar is paying a high price for Chrome. The responsibility of paying the price for Chrome from Jar Jar Obasan to wherever it is running is on Yusuf Sarkar's shoulders. Since Saturday morning, Google, Chatgpt and Opera mini have called for a movement against Yusuf Sarkar. In the meantime, they have occupied Raju and made the surroundings noisy with slogans. 

To find out more about this, one of our reporters went down to Shahbagh on his way from Old Dhaka in the morning. There he met Chatgpt. Chatgpt said, I am a smart AI. I am a thousand times better than Chrome. Why would Yusuf Sarkar pay the price for Chrome instead of me? Chrome does not even have a paid version, so where will it pay the price? Headline_English: Mymensingh farmer Abed Ali has decided to give up paddy cultivation.
Content_English:
The interim government has banned the Awami League's student organization Bangladesh Chhatra League. At the same time, it has listed this student organization as a banned entity. The decision was announced in a notification by the Home Ministry yesterday. 

Since the banning of the Chhatra League, there has been panic among the country's farming community. Especially rice farmers have been deprived of sleep at night. This morning at Fulbari Bazar in Mymensingh, farmer Abed Ali publicly announced that he would give up rice cultivation. In public, he said, "I have been cultivating rice for many years, there was no tension about harvesting rice. For the past few years, Chhatra League leaders used to harvest our rice. We used to sleep peacefully. The organization has been banned, who will harvest our rice now?" Abed Ali cried for a while after finishing his speech. 

This situation has created deep anxiety not only in Mymensingh but also in the minds of farmers across the country. When eRK field representatives spoke to the farmers, they said that until now, Chhatra League brothers used to help them harvest paddy. But if Chhatra League is banned, they will not be able to harvest our paddy even if they wanted to. For so long, we have not had any concerns about harvesting our paddy. How will we survive at this time? 

A kind of panic has spread not only among the farmers, but also among the garment workers. Garment workers in Narayanganj said that if Chhatra League leaders join the garment factory after losing the opportunity to extort money, then they will start vying for our jobs. 

However, Chhatra League has appealed to the farmers not to worry. From an unknown location, Chhatra League fugitive president Saddam Hossain said in a video message with a sickle in his hand, even if it is banned, you have no tension. We may not have a party, but we will still harvest. We are always by the side of the farmers. Whether it is raw or ripe paddy, we will continue to harvest. 

On the other hand, the leaders of the Workers Party are saying that no farmer should worry about rice cultivation. We are people who have been sickles all our lives. What happened if there is no Chhatra League? We started sharpening our sickles from last night.

Headline_English: Awami League supporters demand name change for Cyclone Dana
Content_English:
Cyclone Dana is moving towards West Bengal and Odisha from the deep depression formed in the Bay of Bengal. But even after Apa left us, we could not forget her. Therefore, we want the cyclone to be named Apa instead of Dana. 

An Awami League worker wrote in a status from his fake Facebook ID, if Apa comes, the whole country will change like a storm. There is no alternative but Apa to stop the existing corruption and irregularities in the country, there was no other option than Apa, there was no other option before. We want Apa to come back as a cyclone, at least. Let all injustices be swept away. 

With this demand for name change, a few people gathered for 5 minutes in Shahbagh, raised a few slogans and left the place quickly after a short speech. In a speech, a leader said, "Today, because there is no Apa in the country, a fire is burning from the market to the hearts of people. Only this cyclone named Apa can extinguish this fire. Whatever comes to the country now, let it be Apa. We cannot imagine anything other than Apa." 

When a leader of the foreign wing of the Awami League was asked about this, he said, "We are in a meeting with the International Cyclone Naming Committee. If the name of Dana is not changed, the results will not be good for the Yusuf government. You have not recognized Apa even in 15 years. Apa and cyclone, they are the same."

Headline_English: Children fall asleep in fear when you tell them stories, the old women are angry with the monster-witch stories
Content_English:
In Bangladesh, there is a long tradition of putting young children to sleep by telling them stories about witches and old women. Young children would fall asleep quickly after hearing these stories. Many would also enjoy these stories. But a different picture has been emerging over the past two months. Food Delivery 

For the past two months, parents in different parts of the country have been putting their children to sleep by telling them stories about Sheikh Hasina instead of the old fairy tale witches and demons. Earlier, to scare children, they used to say that if they don't go to sleep, the witch will come, and now parents say that if they don't go to sleep, Hasina will come. After talking to several children, we learned that they get both scared and entertained by listening to scary stories before going to bed. When asked how Apa's story was, one child ran away without saying a word. 
The reason behind telling the story of Apa, leaving aside all the famous witch stories of the past, is that after the disappearances, murders, and corruption that have taken place during the tenure of Sheikh Hasina's government in the last fifteen years, along with the killing of thousands of people in July-August, countless people losing their eyesight in shootings, and countless people becoming disabled, Sheikh Hasina has become something bigger than just a witch. 

Some new parents are also thanking Hasina. One such parent said, "Babu used to stay up all night. We two couldn't even spend time on our own. Now, thank God, we are at peace. He falls asleep just by listening to Hasina's story." 

The old women who are the witches of the story are upset after seeing so much fuss about Sheikh Hasina. The old women who are the witches of the story, who are living under the trees and bushes of the Sheora tree all over the country, have gathered and made their position clear, saying, "We cannot accept the story of Sheikh Hasina being told in our place." I urge you to investigate whether attempts are being made to rehabilitate those who do not deserve to stay in the country through stories.

Headline_English: Most of Royal Enfield's orders come from India, Thailand, Dubai
Content_English:
Since the launch of Royal Enfield motorcycles in the Bangladeshi market yesterday, every scroll on Facebook has been filled with Royal Enfield pictures and regretful stories. Some are proudly returning from the showroom after buying one, while others are posting sadly, "I dream of buying a Royal Enfield while smoking Royal cigarettes." Health Products 

Amidst all this buzz about Royal Enfield, information coming to us from confidential sources says that more Royal Enfield motorcycles are being pre-ordered from abroad than they are being sold in the country. To clarify this matter, eArchi's special detective team went to Royal Enfield showrooms, manufacturing companies and Bangladesh Bank branches. After the investigation, they came up with a surprising information; despite so many orders, Royal Enfields are not seen much on the roads of Dhaka. 
We stood in traffic jams at several major places in Dhaka all day long trying to find Royal Enfields. From morning to evening, we could not see anything except one or two Enfields in the traffic jam on the road. However, Bangladesh Bank said that applications have been submitted to open LC (letter of credit) to import Royal Enfield from several places including India, Thailand, Dubai. 

When a pre-orderer in Dubai was asked about his party affiliation regarding buying a Royal Enfield from the country, he said, "No, sir, I do not belong to any party, sir, I am just buying bikes as a hobby, sir, I believe you." 

So is Royal Enfield going outside the country? Several investigations have shown that those who are importing these bikes were actually in the country two months ago! 

Meanwhile, another interesting piece of information has come to light. It is known that some people from the famous Begumpara in Canada have also pre-ordered Royal Enfields. However, it is not yet certain whether the bikes are returning to Dhaka. 

An extortionist leader of the Awami League wrote on a fake Facebook account, "You can enter the country quickly at any time." As part of our preparations, we also pre-ordered the Royal Enfield so that we could get into the hero's world quite quickly, right along with you.

Headline_English: Just by buying one kilogram of green chilies, your name will appear in the ACC database.
Content_English:
Currently, the spiciness of raw chilies in the vegetable market is the highest. When you go to buy one kilogram of raw chilies, you have to pay 400 to 800 taka from your pocket, depending on the place. For 800 taka, you can get not only chilies but also warnings. 

Pepper sellers are warning you when you go to buy chilies in the raw market. Although they do not say what the warning is, it is clear that there is some kind of scam in it. 
This morning, when e-Riki's market representative went to the market, he saw that the ACC was calling those who bought one kilogram of raw chilies. That is why the shopkeepers are being warned. 
A consumer named Rakib told e-Riki that he received a pretty good amount of money in salary bonus this month. Thinking that the chilies that were 800 taka today would be 1600 taka tomorrow, he spent 800 taka and bought green raw chilies in bulk. And from that moment on, all the troubles started. 

On his way back home from the market, he received a message. The message is from the ACC— ‘Congratulations! You have purchased one kilogram of green chillies. Your bank account has been placed under ACC monitoring to verify your financial capacity.’ 

When the eRK correspondent contacted an ACC official, he said, “I wanted to see the bank statements of those who are buying chillies for 800 taka. We want to get an idea of ​​the source of money of those who can buy one kilogram of green chillies, do you understand?” 

An ACC official said in a status from his fake account, “How do people in Bangladesh buy chillies for 800 taka per kg? It is not possible to buy chillies for so much money without bribery and corruption. The bigwigs of Gulshan are now buying chillies by the pound. Your name comes up in our database when you buy one kilogram of chillies. So far, everyone has seen chillies, but they have not yet seen the real spiciness of chillies.

Headline_English: BNP wants to teach Chhatra League ninja techniques for quick processions, Ruhul Kabir Rizvi will take the course

Headline_English: Singles demand cancellation of Valentine's Day, 'Sudden Breakup Community' expresses solidarity

A leader of the single society and breakup society, begging the government for the lives of the members, said, "If these days are celebrated, we will have no place to live. We will either die of a heart attack or go into hiding. Please cancel these Western days and beg for our lives."

Headline_English: The world will one day belong to extortionists: Extortionist Emperor Kashem

Headline_English: Uttara's Anwar is preparing to break down the gate from today to go to Atif Aslam's concert.
Content_English:
The magician of music Atif Aslam is coming to Dhaka in November, and the excitement among his fans is high. No one has any objection to the four thousand taka worth of tickets. Atif will come and sing, that is a big deal for everyone. 

But in the case of Anwar from Uttara, the last experience was quite different. He went to the concert after buying a ticket of three and a half thousand taka, and was uploading several pictures on Facebook. While listening to the song, he suddenly heard from the side, "Dost, give me a lighter, I'll light a bidi." Looking up, some friends from his area were standing and listening to the song. 
Anwar knew that none of them had bought tickets. It didn't take long to figure out how they got into the concert. At one point during the concert, many of his friends broke through the gate and entered. The concert that he had borrowed money from so many places to see was the concert that people were watching for free. Atif's songs no longer sounded melodious, Anwar could hear in every song, all those who bought tickets were fools. 

This time Anwar has embarked on a new mission with some deceived friends like him. The ticket price is higher than the previous time. If no one wants to pay, they have no choice but to sit at the farm gate and beg. It would be wiser to break through the gate together. An event has been opened on Facebook to bring together those who want to break through the gate because of the high ticket price, and they have also opened their own chat group. They are planning day and night to find a way to successfully watch the concert without tickets. For now, their primary goal is to go and break through the gate at a specific time during the concert. 

The responsibilities of each group have also been decided. One group will monitor the security system, another group will lead the work of breaking the gate, and another group will look after security. There is also a plan to take some money from those who want to watch the concert for free. 

A friend of Anwar, eArki, told the reporter, "Last time we were cheated by buying tickets. This time we will not buy tickets, but will watch the concert from the front. Our plan is foolproof, and even if it does not cost anything, it will still generate some income."

Headline_English: Kathgolap camp leader joins Chatim camp with 300 leaders and activists
Content_English:
A new competitor has come to the market to challenge the dictatorship of the Kathgolap in urban aesthetic culture. It seems that at the beginning of winter, a strange intoxicating scent is overwhelming urban flower lovers. It is rumored that many people are getting addicted to the intoxicating scent of Chhatim lately. 

On the other hand, Kathgolap had a monopoly on Facebook for a long time, but with the arrival of winter, Chhatim has declared a complete rebellion. Flower lovers in almost all areas of the city are so enamored with the intoxicating scent of Chhatim that they are choosing Chhatim as their first choice. 
That evening, a prominent leader of the Kathgolap camp joined the Chhatim camp, bringing 300 leaders and activists with him. He said at the press conference, Kathgolap used to be good, but the intoxicating scent of Chhatim has given us a new lease of life. We have found a new strength in this scent. 

Meanwhile, a heated discussion is going on in the city's tea shops - who will be the king of flowers? Some say that the scent of chrysanthemum is absolutely wild, while others say that the days of wood rose are over. The joy of the supporters of the Chrysanthemum camp is endless after being able to break the sole dominance of wood rose. 

Meanwhile, the supporters of the Chrysanthemum camp have taken out processions across the streets of the city, slogans have been raised, the scent of chrysanthemum is captivating, say goodbye to wood rose in summer. 

Some say that in keeping with the times, we have appeared under the shade of chrysanthemum. Seeing that there is no song about chrysanthemum, many wood rose lovers are trolling us. But we are not disappointed by this, we are planning to make a song about chrysanthemum soon with Ahmed Hassan Sunny.

Headline_English: Elon Musk is coming to Bangladesh to learn the screenshot business
Content_English:
The screenshot business is booming in Bangladesh. As soon as you enter Facebook, you see exposed screenshots of various colors. The number of customers is also surpassing the previous record. Seeing such success, Elon Musk is now thinking of doing business in this sector. 

In the Bangladeshi market, young people are currently earning an average of 5 to 1 million rupees per month by doing screenshot business. Along with running their families, they are also donating. Many young people are starting their own screenshot companies after quitting their jobs. Many talented young people are also returning to the country from abroad through reverse brain drain. 

Such changes in the country's youth have made Musk interested in doing business in this sector. Musk said from his Twitter account, the youth of Bangladesh have always inspired me. I am also impressed with their recent initiative in the screenshot business. I am thinking of going into this sector. I don't like working with rockets and faucets anymore. Less money, more sex. 

Who will you target when you start a business? To such a question, Elon Musk mentioned Mark Zuckerberg. He said, initially I will bring screenshots of Jukka and Sundar Pichai to the market. Then Jeff Bezos and Jack Ma are in the pipeline. Then I will start punishing my ex-girlfriends and wives.

Headline_English: 20 Chhatra League leaders arrested while studying in a group to join the camp
Content_English:
The news had spread quickly since morning. Militant police had surrounded a house in Ashulia, near Dhaka. Hearing the news from a completely unreliable source, we rushed to find out what had happened. But was a notorious militant caught? Or a famous robber? 

But what the police found in the end completely shocked them. About twenty-five young people were sitting in a circle around a table doing group study! Some helmets, stamps, and Ram Da were scattered around. At the same time, a razor blade or two could be seen glinting next to the books they were reading. 

When the police asked everyone the purpose of their gathering, they said that they no longer wanted to do politics in the Awami League because of the failure of the Awami League. They were sitting together and researching how to get into the Jamaat. One of them said that now there is no more honey in the Bhai League. If you enter the Jamaat, there is honey, jaggery, and chira. So a little more… 

When asked about the helmets, hockey sticks, and Ramdas lying around, a thin smile appeared on their faces. When the police members asked them the reason behind this smile, they smiled and said, don't you understand? We used to keep these for playing sports while in the league. We are gradually giving up playing with these. 

However, when asked about razors, no one gave any answer. They only said that you can play sports with razors. Anyone who knows how to play can play with everything. Just as there is no age limit for playing sports, there is no need to discriminate against sports equipment. We are young people. If we don't play sports, the country will not progress as it should.

Headline_English: Either it's completely cold or completely hot! Hasnat Abdullah's stern warning about the weather
Content_English:
No one can really grasp the true nature of the current weather. Suddenly hot and suddenly rain or cold wind are making people confused unga bunga. Seeing such a plight of people, the coordinator Hasnat Abdullah, known as the warning man, could not restrain himself. In a Facebook live on his fake account, he gave a stern warning to the weather, demanding either complete cold or complete heat. He also warned that such a hybrid model of fascist weather will not be allowed on Bengali soil. He also gave a 24-hour ultimatum to the weather. If the weather does not improve within 24 hours, everyone is also called to gather in Raju in that Facebook live. 

On the other hand, after seeing such a stern warning from Hasnat Abdullah, an account called Bangladesh Weather shared the meme 'My body is shaking in fear' on Twitter. When we tried to contact the owner of the account to find out if it was a coincidence or a warning that he was actually shivering in fear of the weather, we learned that he had fled to India illegally.

Headline_English: Prominent citizens demand removal of Common and Neuter gender from English grammar
Content_English:
This time, Bengalis are going to revolutionize the English language as well. As a new step in the linguistic struggle, a group of prominent citizens have demanded the removal of Common and Neuter gender from the English language. According to them, we are being led away from the path of light by being taught these things from childhood. There has never been and will never be any other gender except for two types—woman and man. 

A revolutionary leader named Asif said, Common Gender is an education imposed on us. When everyone, from educational institutions to the workplace, is being introduced with such arbitrary identities as Teacher, Doctor or Student, then how can we understand who is a woman and who is a man? The real gender is being suppressed here in the narrative of common gender. At the same time, a group of misguided people are taking advantage of this and distorting their identity and claiming to be a different gender outside of women and men. This is against our cultural and religious values. 
The thoughts of citizens aware of Neuter gender are quite important and hopeful. A renowned linguist said, all living things in the world have two genders, either women or men. There is no middle ground.

In response to the question of whether things like ‘Table’, ‘Chair’ etc. are male or female, Sir said, since they have not received ‘life’, they cannot receive any gender—that is the truth. No one without gender will find a place in the gender chapter. The day chairs and tables are born with gender, we will also give them a place in the pages of our book. Of course, ‘He’ chair, ‘She’ chair can also be continued like this. We are giving a final update after thinking a little more. 

As far as we know, this language reform is not only about gender, something bigger is coming. As a next step, well-thinking people are thinking of eliminating other complex gender-determining words in English, such as, they or it. 

Intellectuals say that even though there are ‘He’ and ‘She’ everywhere, since women are made from the ribs of men’s chest, ‘He’ will come first in all cases...

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina wants Indian cricket team to help rebuild Chhatra League
Content_English:
After Sheikh Hasina fled on August 5, the Chhatra League, like the Awami League, has also disintegrated. Despite trying to come back in various forms several times, the Chhatra League could not exert its influence as fiercely as before. This time, Sheikh Hasina has taken the initiative to restructure the Chhatra League and she wants the Indian cricket team in this restructuring. It is said that after recently whitewashing the Bangladesh team in the first match of the T20 series, she has the Indian team in mind. 

In a fictional interview, Sheikh Hasina told us, tears came to my eyes after seeing their beating skills. I have been praying for the wrong team so far. From now on, I will pray for the Indian team. However, along with playing, I want this team to reshape the Chhatra League, I saw the last beating like this in July. If they want, state-of-the-art helmets, hockey sticks and hammers will also be brought from Europe for them. 

On the other hand, Hardik Pandya said that Sheikh Hasina's call for the restructuring of the Chhatra League is an honor for them. In a leaked phone call with Hasina, Pandya can be heard saying, "Apa, apa, don't worry apa. We are with you apa. Just give a call and we will come immediately. If you want, I will beat the players of the Bangladesh team along with the ball in the next match." 

At this stage, Hasina can be heard saying, "Don't talk too much, I will say it when necessary. It is not good to show so much power, you will see later that you will not have the power. Who knows the pain of losing power more than me."

Headline_English: Sajeeb Wazed Joy wants to take a course on how to complain in Arabic
Content_English:
Despite raising a storm of complaints about his mother's resignation for a long time, this time Sajeeb Wazed Joy is planning to run it in a new language. It is known that Sheikh Hasina is now going to take refuge in the United Arab Emirates after staying in India for two months, and Joy is preparing to enroll in an Arabic language course. 

Sajeeb Wazed Joy said in a status from a fake ID, "My complaints about my mother's resignation are endless, but language is also needed to complain. I improved my skills by learning Hindi while living in India, but when I came to the United Arab Emirates, I realized that if I don't learn Arabic here, I can't complain properly!" 
However, it's not just a matter of language, Joy has understood that it's better to complain in the local language when giving interviews to Arab televisions. He further added, "I learned Hindi to save my mother's honor, and this time I will learn Arabic—you can't be stuck in one language while complaining. Let the entire Middle East know that my mother did not resign." 

Crowds have started gathering at local language learning centers in the United Arab Emirates after receiving the news. A representative of the education center said, "The demand for our course has increased a lot, everyone wants a new language to learn to complain! We are opening a separate department called the 'Language of Complaints Department'." 

Meanwhile, politicians around the world are worried that Joy's ability to complain globally will increase manifold after learning Arabic. One analyst said, "At the rate Joy is complaining now, no government or administration will be safe from her in the future. We will continue to hear more extensive Arabic-language statements about her mother's resignation until next year."

Headline_English: We want equal rights for all, we want night voting; said Awami League
Content_English:
Awami League leaders have demanded equal rights for everyone in the upcoming elections, and as a symbol of protecting everyone's rights, the Awami League has even demanded a separate night voting system for them. In addition, the party has also called for giving the opportunity to the well-known grave dwellers as their own vote bank to vote. They also plan to organize several programs to protect the right to vote for everyone, living or dead. 

An Awami League leader from the pit told us, "We have always been and still are striving for the right to vote for people. We do not make any difference between living or dead voters. Just as everyone had the right to vote in our time, we hope that it will continue. The main purpose of calling for night voting for us is so that night voters can also participate in the elections. 

When asked whether the tradition of the helmet force guarding the center or intimidating the opponent will continue in the upcoming election days, as in the past, Sammat Bhai told us, "I will appeal to the leaders and workers to be in the field. Wear helmets and hammers and try to stop the opponent, but if the attempt fails, then run away from the Jar Jar Obasan."

Headline_English: Long queue of European chickens in front of Bangladesh Embassy after hearing about egg prices
Content_English:
Seeing the rise in egg prices in Bangladesh, the European chicken community has started choosing Bangladesh for their careers. In the past month, egg prices have skyrocketed, and after seeing the skyrocketing egg prices, they have become dizzy. The long queues of chickens instead of people in front of Bangladesh embassies in different European countries hoping for visas are also quite noticeable. 

When a chicken standing in the queue was asked about the reason for his interest in Bangladesh, he said, life in Europe is very difficult. Everything here follows rules and regulations. There is no syndicate, so there is no extra income for businessmen, and we also do not have extra care for the sake of the sake. Life is one, why should I waste my life sitting here and suffer? The syndicate system in Bangladesh has fascinated me, it is better to live on the streets there than in Europe. I have heard that there is even a separate university there for our studies. If a country cares so much about chickens, who will I love or not? 

However, the domestic chicken community is not looking positively at the arrival of European chickens in Bangladesh. A leader of the local chicken society said, referring to European chickens, that chickens want to introduce competition in their house, competition. To resist them, broiler, golden, and local chickens must unite. If necessary, we will join hands with the fox, but foreign chickens have no place in Bengal. At this stage, he started shouting the slogan, "All chickens of the world, unite and fight."

Headline_English: A 5-member committee was sent to NASA to find out how cold it is in Magh.
Content_English:
How many Maghs does winter actually last? This is a question we are all familiar with. Does it last for one Magh? Does it last for two Maghs? Or does winter never last? Some people say that winter never lasts—winter hides even in summer. Others say that winter sleeps inside all the heat, waiting for an opportunity. 

Recently, you have been saying that winter does not last for one Magh. Although people in this country have been saying this for a long time, after hearing it from you, it has taken on a new dimension. It seems that everyone has accepted it because you said it. But the question is, how many Maghs does winter actually last? 

To find a way out of this critical situation, the country's Ministry of Meteorology and Disaster Management has formed a special committee of 5 members. The task of this committee will be to meet with NASA scientists to find out how many Maghs does winter actually last. 

The committee has already reached NASA. We hope that after an urgent meeting with scientists, they will solve this complex mystery. The countrymen are looking forward to this committee. Will the eternal question of how long does winter last be answered? Or will winter continue to dominate the entire country with its exclusive power? 

Let scientific research continue, let our preparations begin to bid farewell to winter!

Headline_English: Monir from Mirpur in the capital says no to bathing from today
Content_English:
If you don't take a bath every day, it is very difficult to survive in this cruel city of Dhaka. However, many people boycott taking a bath in winter every time to cope with the winter. The idea of ​​boycotting taking a bath in winter has become quite familiar to us. But, surprisingly, this time, Monir from Mirpur boycotted taking a bath at the beginning of this monsoon. Our reporter confirmed this yesterday through a fake information. 

When we spoke to Monir, he told us that he knows that many problems arise if you don't take a bath every day. You don't come to give me this knowledge. What I mean is, taking a bath has nothing to do with being healthy, taking a bath has to do with heat and sweat. If I don't sweat in September, if I don't feel hot, then why should I wait for winter to boycott taking a bath? You don't understand the weather conditions that are raining in September, that winter has already arrived? If you understand, you understand, if you don't understand, then this is the final. 

After going to Monir's house, it was seen that a crowd of about a thousand people had gathered at his house after his decision. Monir's office colleagues, friends, and relatives had all brought hundreds of perfumes for him. When we spoke to a friend, he told us that it was good that he decided not to bathe, but he did not decide not to chat. If we want to survive by his side, we will have to invest this much in his support.

Headline_English: Shamim Osman embarks on world tour
Content_English:
After the courtship of India's Nizamuddin Auliya, Shamim Osman was seen at a shopping mall in Dubai, United Arab Emirates. This was reported by the Daily Ittefaq. 

Many believe that Shamim Osman fled the country after the fall of the Awami League government on August 5. However, Shamim Osman says that he is basically on a world tour. He went to the Emirates from India and will return home after completing his Europe tour. He told eRK this from a fake ID. 

Shamim Osman said that he will go to Mecca from Dubai and perform Umrah. He has a plan to play a match with Ronaldo there. After that, he will go to America, play with Messi and leave for Spain. This politician, known as 'Khela Hobe', also has a plan to play a match in La Liga. 

In response to various criticisms around him about his world tour, Shamim said, "I went on a world tour to represent Bangladesh. And you are criticizing me." 

During this time, he also abused his critics as the Apsos League. 

While explaining his current mental state, Shamim Osman said, 

I am an immigrant 

I travel abroad 

I anchor in every port 

I anchor in every port 

I anchor in every port…

Headline_English: Vice President Samaj disappointed over lack of vice president position in DU Shibir committee
Content_English:
The full committee of DU Shibir has just been published, in which the vice-president community has expressed particular disappointment amid various discussions and criticisms. They have protested that the Shibir committee does not have the post of vice-president despite having all the remaining posts. Many vice-presidents have also been left in a state of shock after seeing how the post of vice-president is not in the committee of a student organization. 

A former vice-president hiding in a hole told us that we would have been happy if we had the post of vice-president in any organization. Selfies with the PO guardian, eating leftovers in the hall canteen with the power of this post, or bringing ordinary students to the guest room and entertaining them were the oxygen for us to survive. But now that Ammo is gone, we are desperate. We were hoping that even if no one else understands, at least Shibir will understand our sorrows and give us a place in the committee. We had adopted Shibir as our own in the Chhatra League, but why couldn't they? My appeal is that we should be given positions in the Shibir committee, otherwise we will wear helmets and launch a tough movement in Shahbagh. 

When we tried to talk to a leader in an important position in the DU Shibir committee about the issue, he started giving us a knife and our reporter ran away from there.

Headline_English: Thousands of people didn't wake up because they didn't post 'Wake up September ends'; study says
Content_English:
Recently, a special study was conducted around the world. The study revealed that people who slept in September have not woken up yet. When trying to uncover the mystery behind this, a special reason has come out, for which the whole world was not ready. It is known that thousands of people did not wake up because of not sharing the post Wake up September ends. 

In this regard, when we spoke to someone who woke up on October 1, he told us that there is no plan B to wake up if you sleep in September. I myself slept in September, then opened Facebook in my sleep and gave the status, Wake up September ends. I woke up after giving this status. After waking up, I saw that not only me, thousands of other people woke up using this method. I also have friends who did not give this status, we went to their houses. After going to my friends' houses, I saw that they were still sleeping. I could not wake them up in any way. 

To find out whether those who are still asleep will actually wake up or not, and even if they do wake up, when will they wake up, we had one of our reporters sleep in September. That reporter sent us a report in his sleep. It was learned that many people are unable to give the correct status because they do not know how to spell September, and many others are not aware that September has already disappeared from their lives due to excessive sleep.

Headline_English: Fire breaks out at egg market; all eggs are being boiled
Content_English:
The egg market has now become a huge cauldron. When you go to buy raw eggs in the market, you see that they are all cooked. When you go to the market, you can no longer ask the simple question 'Brother, how much is an egg?' like before. Now, when you go to buy eggs, your chest and wallet tremble. Hearing the price of eggs, your heart is in a bad state. Because it is as if each egg is turning into gold before it comes out of the chicken coop. 

The government announced on September 15 that the price of eggs will be 11 taka 87 paisa. Hearing this, the people said, 'There is no need to add so much money, you could have said 12 taka.' But in reality, when you go to the market, you see a different scenario. Each egg costs 15 taka! Yes, this is the current situation, even though it may sound unbelievable. And if you want to buy a dozen, you have to mortgage your kidney for that. A dozen eggs cost 170 taka! This means that with a dozen eggs, you get a dozen headaches for free. However, the government is looking positively at the issue of boiled eggs in this way. From a fake ID, they said, if you buy eggs from the market for 15 taka, you won't have to bother boiling them. Both time and gas will be saved. 

Members of the egg syndicate said they are planning to increase the price further. A member of the syndicate said from a fake ID, many people are complaining that eggs bought for 15 taka are not being boiled properly. They remain half-boiled. We are thinking of releasing fully boiled eggs in the market under the quick rental model. In this, the price may increase from 15 to 18. Anyway, we always want to give the best product to the customer. 

The situation has become such that not only the buyers but also the chickens are shocked. A chicken is saying to another chicken, don't you understand, our eggs are now so valuable that when you lay an egg, it feels like you are laying an iPhone 17 Pro Max! 

Everyone calls a meeting in the chicken coop and says, 'We are laying eggs as usual, but why is there so much demand in the market?' Economist chickens may also start a course—'Golden Eggs of Economics: How to Control the Market with Eggs.

Headline_English: Bangladeshis are buying eggs in the same way that Kolkatans buy fish
Content_English:
Due to the rising price of eggs, many buyers are unable to buy them alone. To escape this problem, many people in Kolkata have started buying eggs in parts, like fish. In the markets of Gulshan and Banani, two people buy an egg, while in other markets in the city, six people are seen buying an egg in parts. Some are even bringing up this issue of buying eggs in parts in their blogs. 

When we went to a market in Mirpur to verify the truth of the incident, we saw that after buying eggs, a few people were involved in a fight over the sharing of the yolk. Later, after stopping them, one of them told us, I thought the country would be like Europe. But only the prices of goods became like Europe, what kind of freedom did I want? Here, the three of us bought an egg together with the white part. Even after the settlement was made, no one wanted to give up the yolk part! If I don't get my share of the yolk, I will be a fool. 

When we asked about the reason for the sudden fire in the egg market, a chicken, while laying eggs, told us that there was a kerosene mine in the ground under the egg market. In the heat of the current summer, that oil caught fire and spread to the egg market as well. 

Although many people were embarrassed by this issue of buying eggs in installments, the people of Kolkata, however, welcomed the issue, saying that they were relieved that they would no longer be made fun of for buying fish.

Headline_English: Nobel Committee plans to award Nobel Prize for peace and unrest, Sheikh Hasina nominated
Content_English:
A new category is going to be added to the list of Nobel Prizes from this year. Until now, the Nobel Committee has decided to award the Nobel Prize for unrest as well. It is also known that Sheikh Hasina's name has already been nominated as a worthy contender for this year in this new category. It is believed that she can not only be nominated but also set a record of becoming the first Nobel laureate in unrest, because after Sheikh Hasina, no one has been nominated in this particular category. 

When we tried to contact the committee spokesperson to find out why the Nobel Prize will be awarded for unrest, he told us, 'The mother of peace has fled, peace is not seen much in the world these days. So who will we give the Nobel Prize for peace to? My own wife does not let me live in peace, I thought I would give her a nomination along with you, but later I did not, thinking it would be nepotism. However, I am optimistic about you, you yourself, the history of creating such an atmosphere of unrest in your own country is rare. If you don't give me the Nobel, I will start a riot in the Nobel Committee myself.' 

When we tried to find out Sheikh Hasina's feelings on the matter, she refused to say anything. Later, when we went to a member of her "Alo Abebi" group to find out more, she chased our reporter away by threatening to throw hot water on him.

Headline_English: The lovers' society has launched a movement to give Kashful and Kadam the status of national flowers.
Content_English:
Autumn has come. Kashful and Kadam, which suddenly appear in the monsoon, have created waves in nature. However, the struggle of the lover/lover society over these two flowers has now taken the form of a movement. They have taken to the field to give Kashful and Kadam the status of national flowers, because imagining their love life without these two flowers is like a nightmare. 

Thousands of lovers go on a mission to find Kadam during the monsoon. While searching, it gets to the point that their clothes are ruined while searching, but they still want Kadam. Some people climb Kadam trees to please their lovers with Kadam in their hands and break their backs. Their list in the hospital increases day by day during the monsoon. But there is no initiative to solve the problem! 

With the arrival of autumn, lovers have taken another step forward. There is no shortage of efforts to take pictures with Kashful during the golden hour. If a lover cannot take a picture during the golden hour, the story of his disappointment spreads. Some people in the city have already announced that they are planning to buy a piece of land for Kashful, so that they do not have to face their lovers for lack of Kashful. 

In this situation, the lovers' community has demanded that Kashful and Kadam be declared national flowers. According to them, if these flowers are given the status of national flowers, the availability of these flowers will increase, and their love life will be happier. Therefore, not only photo shoots, but also protests are going on in the Kashful field. 'Kashful, I want national flowers!' - this is the slogan of the lovers' community. 

However, the main leader of the movement has said that if Kadam and Kashful are not recognized as national flowers soon, otherwise they will make the declaration themselves without waiting for anyone.

Headline_English: Mob Justice and Moral Policing Studies are being opened in universities
Content_English:
Recently, both the industries of mob justice and moral policing are developing rapidly in Bangladesh. Keeping in mind the huge demand for these two industries, the country's universities are going to open the Mob Justice and Moral Policing Studies Department. It is said that in a hypothetical meeting yesterday, representatives of the universities reached a consensus on the issue while eating sa-sop and singara. Although it was opened in public universities in the initial stage, this department will gradually be opened in private universities. 

The VC of Shahbag University told us, 'Mob Justice and Moral Policing is not the auspicious procession of Pahela Boishakh or communal harmony, but the thousand-year-old tradition of Bengal. These had started to disappear gradually, but I would like to thank the extremists of Bengal, because of their welfare, this industry is getting back to life. However, without adequate training, it will not be possible to keep this industry alive for long. People of any age who cannot tolerate dissent can get admission here, and everyone will be given a PhD degree after completing the coursework. We want Uts Sir as the department head, we tried to contact him but he is busy with paper publishing work and has not been able to confirm anything yet. 

On the other hand, the VC of Savar Higher University told us that any student seeking admission will be given a scholarship from the department only if they have six months of practical experience in either Mob Justice or Moral Policing.

Headline_English: Proposal to change S Alam's name to Robinhood Alam
Content_English:
The CID is investigating the allegations of laundering Tk 113,245 crore abroad against S Alam Group Chairman Saiful Islam and his family. Hearing the amount of money looted from his bank, one can feel the chills! 

Not only the money he looted, but he also donated to various charities at different times and gave jobs to many unemployed youth. Just like Robin Hood. On one hand, he looted, and on the other hand, he also helped the poor. Considering this extraordinary human quality of S Alam, many S Alam fans have proposed changing his name to Robin Hood Alam. 

An S Alam fan named Mahmudullah said, he did not eat money alone, he also donated to the people of the country. He could not sleep because of the thoughts of the poor people. He had to take sleeping pills every night to sleep. 

This S Alam fan also said that while praying, the man had a scar on his forehead, and while donating to charity, he had become a fakir. I absolutely cannot accept that he should be tried for a minor bank robbery and money laundering. Rather, take action against those rotten university teachers. They are the root of all evil. 

It is learnt that many are also thinking of making a movie called 'Bangladesh's Robin Hood Alam' based on this tearful story in S Alam's life.

Headline_English: Moral Police headquarters to be set up on Bangladesh streets
Content_English:
A new headquarters of the International Moral Police is being established in Bangladesh to further strengthen moral policing activities around the world. According to statistics, Bangladesh currently has the highest number of moral policing cases, and for this reason the country has been called the 'capital of moral policing'. 

The main reason for establishing the headquarters is said to be to bring the country's citizens' dress and behavior in the right direction. In particular, multiple units will work to increase public awareness about the headscarf, hijab, and beard length. The IG of Moral Police said in this regard, we are surprised to see the way people dress in Bangladesh! No one wears the headscarf properly, and some do not grow their beards long. We want everyone to follow the rules. 
'Clothing inspectors' will be deployed on the streets every day from the new office of the Moral Police, who will ensure the length of people's clothes and the correct use of religious clothing. For further development of this department, ‘morality checkpoints’ will be set up in various parts of the city, where passengers will be checked for proper compliance with the rules of hijab, beard and headscarf. 

Eyewitnesses said that since the introduction of this new moral policing system, burqas and Punjabis have been sold on the streets of Dhaka. According to local burqa and beard shopkeepers, they have never seen such sales before! By the grace of God, people are now dressing properly despite the fear of the moral police. Boys are also buying headscarves, girls are also buying fake beards. 

Meanwhile, the general public has given mixed reactions to this move. A young woman said, moral policing has now become a part of our lives. If the headquarters is established, our country will become a moral hub. I hope that exporting morals from our country to the world will add a new dimension to the country’s economy. 

Not only that, the head of the moral police said about the future plans, "The next step will be to check morality on social media. If someone's profile picture on Facebook or Instagram is without a hijab, we will directly send a 'moral reminder'." 

In short, Bangladesh is no longer just a developing country, it is now the world's first-class morality hub.

Headline_English: There are no birthdays on September 28 in Bangladesh, says a surprising study
Content_English:
Is there a date on which no one was born? If you search all over the world, you may not find such a date. But, a very secret information has come out in a false and surprising study in Bangladesh. It has been learned that no one was born on September 28 in Bangladesh. No one has a birthday on this day. 

The entire research was done on Facebook. By checking the birthdays of everyone's friend list on Facebook, it was found that no one in their friend list has a birthday on September 28. But, when you go to Memories, different information comes up again. It turns out that thousands of people celebrated their birthdays on September 28 last year too. 

When I spoke to someone who celebrated his birthday last year in this regard, he secretly told me that my birthday was actually on a fake date for all these years. I was born on December 29 but I used to celebrate it on December 28. I didn't want to keep this secret anymore, I wanted to tell everyone the truth. So this time I have to face the truth. 

However, the lie detector says something different. After installing the country map lie detector, various lies have been seen from different corners of the country.

Headline_English: Extra Aesthetic People want a September version of the song in December City
Content_English:
In December, along with winter, pie, and love, the song "December City" is at the top of the popularity scale. In December, this song is the national anthem of aesthetic people. Their social site stories, phone playlists, and even phone ring tones are all about December City. This time, December is still too late. But, December weather, December love, and even the scent of December have entered the air without following the rules. Such a change in everything except the month has put the world's extra aesthetic people in a lot of trouble. So they demand that this September also be centered around the month of December. 

One such extra aesthetic person (AAS) told us, the weather is cold outside, the sun is not coming in the sky, a mountain of sadness is in the heart, and yet it is September! It is completely unimaginable that such feelings would arise in such a month. But, we cannot even throw away our inner aesthetic attitude. We are celebrating this September like December, only the music is the problem. In September, music cannot be played in the city of December. So we want a system for this song. 

Another person said, there is no problem even if the new song does not come. They will be happy even if December is cut to September. However, it is not possible to say when such a mood swing occurs in any month, so our demand is that the song be sung based on the name of each month. Then we will be worry-free!

Headline_English: Badda's Bablu invites the entire neighborhood for a 7-day party after receiving money from a hamster
Content_English:
Bablu of Badda, a well-known face in the area, has created a stir in the entire neighborhood this morning with a strange announcement. The incident is that he has received crores of taka from the Hamster Combat game! No one wants to believe it, everyone is shocked to hear who he is talking to!
