In this joy, he has invited the entire neighborhood for 7 days. He said that the residents of the neighborhood will eat at his house for three meals a day. When this news reached the ears of the elder of the area, Rafiq Mia, he said that Bablu has gone crazy playing games. Don't listen to him. 

After investigating, it was found that for the past one month, Bablu has opened accounts in small and big shops in the area. Grocery stores, meat shops, fish markets - Bablu has said the same thing everywhere, money is coming from hamsters. Don't rush, everything will be paid off on the 26th. 

Although the shopkeepers were a little skeptical at first, seeing Bablu's confidence, they also started giving things in accounts. Every few days, Bablu opened a new bank account. He never bought anything less than a thousand taka when he went to the shop. For a month, he would often stand in front of the shop, puffing on a cigarette, and tell everyone, "Money is coming in, brother, crores of taka!" 

Suddenly, he went to the market and announced, "Brothers! All the products in this market will go to my house. I invited everyone in the neighborhood for seven days. Come and eat!" 

Hearing this, the market vendors suddenly became stunned. "What did you say?" a chicken vendor asked. Bablu raised his voice again, "Give it all to my house." I couldn't count how many crores of taka the hamster had deposited into my account, it was so empty that my eyes were wide open!

Headline_English: The country's economic rocket will be launched into space from today
Content_English:
For gamers, today will be written in gold letters in history. Because today, September 26, the accumulated prize money of the Hamster Combat game is reaching the PayPal accounts of all gamers. The country's economy is like a rocket in space. 

Seeing such a large transfer of billions of dollars, PayPal's gateway has started shaking, resulting in the server going down. With the slogan 'PayPal saves, the country saves', gamers are gathering today and waiting for their payments. 
Meanwhile, Sheikh Hasina from India said that the beginning of this economic revolution started during my tenure. The saplings that I planted will be enjoyed by Dr. Yunus today. 
On the other hand, an official of Bangladesh Bank, who did not want to be named, said that due to the influx of so many dollars, our reserves are overflowing. We will have to rent new warehouses to store money. If you buy gold now, there will be no loss. Clothing design 

Young economists say that there is no way to call the wheel of the country's economy a wheel anymore. It is now an economic rocket, which is flying directly into space.

Among them, one such economist has commented, at the speed at which this rocket is flying, we will start living on Mars in the next few years. 

Meanwhile, Sattar Mia of Savar said, I am preparing to send a rocket into space with my own funding. The rocket will be launched on September 26, 2025, and that rocket will have my own satellite, 'Sattar Satellite.' Bangladesh will not only dominate the economy, but also space with its own rocket.

Headline_English: Singles are filled with hope ahead of Durga Puja
Content_English:
Durga Puja is coming. Keeping the puja in mind, the single community is filling their chests with hope. Some are hoping that the family will complete the marriage work during this puja, while some are waiting for the arrival of Durga in the hope of love after a long single life. 

One such bachelor says, I am living for the puja. The puja will come, love will come in my life. Otherwise, when would I have left this life? 

Many are hoping for marriage. One such bachelor says, I have long understood that love will not come from me. Now the last hope is puja. In fact, puja means that I will not ask for anything else at the feet of my mother, I will only ask for a life partner. 

Many are so single that they think that even with the blessings of Durga, there is no possibility of their love or marriage. They are looking at their families. They are filling their chests with hope that if the family, happy with the puja, gets them married, then life is worthwhile.

Headline_English: Gulshan student Faraji demands half-pass for Uber as well as buses
Content_English:
For a long time, public buses in Bangladesh have been providing half-pass facilities to students. Since only Friday and Saturday are public holidays, the bus owners' association had put aside these two-day half-passes due to their own power. However, this time the new government has announced that half-passes will be allocated for students 7 days a week in every public bus. This has brought laughter to every household in Bengal. However, many people in Gulshan Banani are upset because such facilities are only available on buses. According to a secret false source, they are gathering at Shahbuddin Park to express their upset. (They will have to walk a lot if the Long March to Shahbagh is held, hence the arrangement) 

When we spoke to a student named Farazi from Gulshan about this, he told us, why shouldn't we be upset? We are very disappointed. Are only those who travel by bus students? We don't have the habit of traveling by bus, we travel by Uber car or bike. In that case, where is our half-pass? We are not being given any half-pass! Why isn't it happening? We need a half pass. If the new government also does such a skibidi with us, we will not leave anyone out. Our only demand is that we want a half pass for Uber as well. 

After Farazi's statement, many present agreed with him. One person came out from behind the crowd and said, Half pass for buses, half pass seven days a week, half pass for 12 hours, now half pass for Uber, half pass for metro rail tomorrow, toll waiver on Padma Bridge the day after tomorrow, is this the freedom we wanted?

Headline_English: Shibir's Jewish wing debuts with Einstein as president and Zuckerberg as secretary
Content_English:
This time, the president and secretary of the Jewish branch of the camp have made their debut. Through a Facebook post, the famous scientist Albert Einstein introduced himself as the president of the camp. Mark Zuckerberg has also made his debut as the secretary. 

However, many do not accept Mark Zuckerberg as the secretary. One such person said that a dropout and bad student like Mark Zuckerberg can never be the secretary of the camp. Einstein can be accepted. His CGPA is good. I do not accept Zuckerberg with a bad CGPA. 

Where have you been all this time? When asked, Albert said, I was in hiding among the Nazi forces. I was the vice-president of the Nazi Berlin branch, and Juka was a member. 

Meanwhile, such debuts like Albert-Mark are happening at various times. According to a news report from Bangladesh, more than fifty Argentina fans had been hiding in the Brazil camp for a long time, disguised as Brazil fans. They made their debut immediately after Argentina won the World Cup.

Headline_English: Zen-Jira calls for movement demanding Surya's resignation
Content_English:
The dictatorship has left the country. We have a Bangladesh without dictatorship. There are coordinators in every house but no dictatorship anywhere. Surya is standing tall in this time of dictatorship. It has become difficult to stand properly in the heat of the sun, let alone survive. At such a time, the Zenjis have come to everyone's side again. The Zenji community of the country has called for a movement demanding Surya's resignation. 

When we wanted to talk to the coordinator of this program, a Zenji coordinator told us, in a country where we have been able to expel dictatorship, what is Surya like? We have not taken the field for that long. Our demands are twofold, either Surya resigns or reduces his austerity. We have left options for him, he can choose either option A or B if he wants. It's his choice. We are not interfering in anyone's choice. But, if our demands are not met, the same thing will happen to Surya as happened with the dictatorship. 

It is reported that Gen-X and Millennials have joined the Genjis by noon. Meanwhile, Gen Alpha is still not sure what to do, there is a chance that schools and colleges will be closed if the sun heats up a little more. They are not able to understand whether it is a holiday or a movement first.

Headline_English: Crush's heart is melting in the excessive heat; Chances of falling in love in a day are 3,000
Content_English:
The heat is unbearable all around. A group has already left for Shahbagh, with the aim of a long march to heat. It has been confirmed through various sources that overtime has increased in showrooms, corporate offices, and agencies. Employees are not willing to leave the office and go home. Even students of private universities are not being taken out of classes. Along with such surprising information, another piece of information has reached our hands. It has been learned that crushes' hearts are melting in the excessive heat; there are 3,000 chances of falling in love in a day. 

After two days of observation in different areas of the capital, our reporter has researched and found out that in today's heat, about 3,000 crushes' hearts in the country will melt. If the crushes' hearts melt, love will freeze. From that possibility, we fear that there will be 3,000 loves today. In this regard, our experienced team spoke to a newly famous influencer, whom many call crushes. He said that everything is melting in this heat. Yesterday I saw that the director of my new music video has also melted. Where I was being given a side role, I am getting the main role. If everyone else has melted, what else can I do! I am willing to melt with a little effort. 

When the news of Crush's heart melting became known overnight, the young single community took to the field. It is learned that another program called Long March to Crush's Heart is also moving towards Raju.

Headline_English: Government bans use of plastic on Ustad Bam
Content_English:
After banning plastic in Cox's Bazar, supermarket, state guest house Jamuna, the government has now banned the use of plastic in Ustad Bame. This is the fourth far-sighted decision of this government after declaring war on plastic. This has been confirmed by eRK from a fake source. 

The government said in a fake statement that there is no peace for plastic in the house. Meanwhile, whenever I go out on the streets, I hear Ustad Dine Plastic, Ustad Bae Plastic - the mood gets even hotter. Just as there will be no plastic in this country, there will also be no name for plastic. 

This incident has seen a negative reaction among bus helpers. An Awami League supporter bus helper criticized this decision and said, this is a matter of taking away freedom of speech. If I cannot go out on the streets and say Ustad Bame Plastic as I please, then how can I live? You say people can live without freedom of speech? This government staged a coup to fix freedom of speech, where is freedom of speech now? Is this the freedom we wanted? 

It is known that this bus helper is a former Chhatra League leader. He is now surviving as a bus helper due to the need for character. He will make his debut when the time is right. 

Meanwhile, supporters of the football club Manchester City have demanded a ban on calling someone a plastic fan.

Headline_English: Kamala Harris, Donald Trump want to swear in coordinators if elected
Content_English:
In addition to warning each other, the coordinators have been criticized for administering the oath to the proctor and pro-VC of Shabi-Probir. Although the people of the country have taken the matter negatively, these coordinators of Shabi-Probir have been praised internationally. Many famous people have expressed their interest in taking the oath from these coordinators. 

Although there are Bollywood and Hollywood stars in this list, American presidential candidate Kamala Harris and Donald Trump have caught everyone's attention. Regarding her interest, Kamala Harris told us in broken Bengali, "Please vote well, friends, so that beautiful Kamala can dance. Pray so that I can get elected, then I will import some coordinators from your country." From the very beginning of my political career, I had a dream of administering the oath to the coordinators, but I could never get elected. Now that opportunity has come, if necessary, I will vote like Hasu Apa at night and get elected, but I want this dream to come true. 

On the other hand, Modi's close friend, Donald Trump's brother, known as Dolan Trump, said from his fake ID that if necessary, the coordinators will be given American red cards, but they want to take the oath. Although we have an idea about the American green card, he cut off the call when asked for details about the red card.

Headline_English: Be careful with your words, we are family robbers. My father was one, and so was I.
Content_English:
He was the State Minister of Bangladesh, then became the Land Minister at the behest of Sheikh Hasina. After the fall of Sheikh Hasina's government, an investigation by Al Jazeera found that this minister had assets worth more than 8,000 crore taka. He has bought 360 houses in Britain. He is living a luxurious life abroad. It is also known that Saifuzzaman has become the owner of this vast wealth by smuggling thousands of crores of taka out of Bangladesh. Many call him a robber. 

However, Saifuzzaman has warned the people of the country. Reminding them of his father, he said, "We are not today's robbers, we are family robbers. My father was a robber, so was I. Speak carefully." 

At this time, he also reminded them of the past glory of his father Akhtaruzzaman Babu. He said, "My father is taking over banks with a gun, this glory of our family is not very long ago. From whom is your S Alam learning the wisdom of taking over banks? From our father. These are our family businesses. 

Saifuzzaman also said that there is a big purpose behind building billions of taka of wealth abroad. He said, Sheikh Hasina has done the shelter project in the country and I have done it abroad. So that when someone from the country comes abroad, he does not have to sleep on the streets, but can sleep at home.

Headline_English: Salon customers may increase in the next two months
Content_English:
The Bangladesh Salon Research Institute has reported that salon customers will increase in the next two months. The organization has provided this information after reviewing the recent political developments in Bangladesh. In addition, boys with long hair, girls with colored hair, boys with colored hair and boys with unusual haircuts have been asked to show the number 8 danger signal. 

Bangladesh recently gave the army the responsibility of executive magistrates. However, the Salon Research Institute has emphasized that giving executive power to the army has nothing to do with the increase in salon customers. 

After the publication of this study, salons have been busy. All salons are hiring new hairdressers. It has also been reported that hairdressers who can do army cuts are in high demand. 

When talking about the issue, a salon owner said, someone please stop this guy. What is he doing? Now I can't even handle the customers. After a long time, we have a government that thinks about salon owners like us. 

Many salon owners have also announced that they will be offering a 50% discount on Army Cutting Cuts during these two holy months. Along with this, there will be a free golden facial.

Headline_English: HILSA essence has arrived for the cooks of Kolkata, the aroma of Hilsa can be felt when mixed in cooking
Content_English:
Like every time, this time, hilsa is not being exported to Kolkata. On the one hand, the hilsa market is on fire due to not getting hilsa, on the other hand, hilsa lovers are making a fuss. However, to reduce the disappointment of hilsa lovers in Kolkata, HILSA essence has already come to their market. Like vanilla essence, if you mix it while cooking any fish, it will bring out the taste of hilsa. 

The owner of HILSA essence told us while eating hilsa fish for the cooks of Kolkata, that due to this hilsa diplomacy, the suffering of the people of Kolkata was not visible to the eyes. Our initiative is so that people can smell hilsa even while eating putimas, even if it is not hilsa. If you add one drop of essence to every 200 grams of fish, you will feel like you are swimming next to hilsa in the Padma. I can challenge you to say that even real hilsa does not have this much scent. 

A user of this essence has already cooked chicken with HILSA essence. He also gave us a very positive review. According to him, this company deserves a Nobel Prize for such a groundbreaking discovery. The brother said that he also applies a few drops to his hands throughout the day in addition to cooking. His colleagues have even started to envy him, suspecting that he eats rice with hilsa every day. At this stage, he said, "It is very difficult to survive in this world if you are not a little clever," and fell down on the ground laughing and fainted.

Headline_English: BTS's concert is also coming with a curtain system
Content_English:
Recently, Mirpur Bangla College has been filled with nasheeds and qawwali. Many young people have ignored the rain to attend. However, a wonderful picture is going viral on Facebook. It can be seen that the girls have been seated together and covered with a veil. They are listening to the nasheed from behind the veil. The men have gathered in front of the veil, that is, near the stage. 

Various sociologists of the Chalaiden Group have said that this system is very promising for our current society. It is heard that this system of Mirpur Bangla College has been appreciated by BTS, Linkin Park, Maroon-5, Cigarettes after Sex and other big bands. On behalf of BTS, Jungkook said, it is a wonderful system. Many women have complained that they have not been able to come to our concerts so far due to the lack of a veil system. We are sorry because we could not take proper measures. Mirpur Bangla College has created a path. We will walk on that path...' 
Meanwhile, Backstreet Boys, One Direction, The Naked Brothers, Jonas Brothers also expressed their views. The lead vocalist of Backstreet Boys said, "Sometimes I don't want to perform in front of girls. Even then, I sing naked, sometimes wearing short clothes, like everyone else. It would be good if there was a curtain system." 

Nick Jonas of Jonas Brothers said, "I have a lot of problems with these girls, bro. Sometimes I even fight with Priyanka about these things. Even though there are various restrictions before marriage, I can't follow them anymore. Curtains between boys and girls at concerts, if possible, walls, are the demand of the time. 

Not only that, 90 other bands have released a statement on social media expressing solidarity with such demands. However, Mike Shinoda of Linkin Park regretted not being able to be with them. Shinoda said, "I hired a girl for the band two days ago. Of course, I don't like seeing girls either. I'm telling Emily that I'll make a room surrounded by a curtain on the stage. She will stand there and sing. The audience didn't come to see her. They came to listen to the music!"

Headline_English: Dhaka residents can get a job at NASA only if they have experience going to the office on a rainy day in their CV
Content_English:
NASA has announced that it will offer jobs to Dhaka residents only if they mention the experience of going to the office on a rainy day in their CV. Going to the office on a normal day in Dhaka is more difficult than going to the moon! A NASA expert has compared the battle of going to the office on a rainy day to going to Mars. 

In a Zoom call from Spaceship, this expert told us that I will always have huge respect for the people of Dhaka. For a long time in my life, I was working at the Saidi Moon Research Center in Dhaka, and I used to see my friends at NASA go to the moon before I went to the office. I even have experience of working in the office during the rain. Living in Dhaka has created a kind of love for the people of Dhaka, and as a reward for that love, I want to employ Dhaka residents at NASA. Not only Bangladeshis living in Dhaka, but also Bangladeshis living in America who were once in Dhaka but now live very close to NASA, can quickly apply here and get in if they want. 

However, when we asked how it is possible to get a job in NASA without any knowledge of space engineering, the brother told us, people in Dhaka are always in survival mode. I believe that people who regularly ride local buses will be able to survive in a spaceship. However, I will give special priority to people from Mirpur and Bashundhara areas of Dhaka.

Headline_English: Dhaka University declares IBA as external
Content_English:
In the wake of the demand for an outsider-free campus, the Dhaka University student body has now declared IBA as an outsider. While arguing why IBA is an outsider, a DU student told us that despite being from the same campus, they hide their proud DHA identity. They introduce themselves everywhere as IBians. Aren't such unscrupulous people outsiders? We demand that they be deprived of the SA, SOP and Singara of this campus. 

On the other hand, after the matter became known, IBA students also made a fictional protest. They also claim DU as an outsider of their campus. An IBA student told us in broken Bengali, before calling IBA an outsider, give it a chance here. And we are not as poor as you to deprive us of SA, SOP and Singara, we don't eat those. We eat fried rice and burgers. 

After this student's speech, several ex-DHA students tweeted on Twitter, saying, "First get a chance to show DU's own intellectual property, no IBA student can use it for their own benefit. You first get a chance to show it here." 

However, between such a ganjam of IBA and DU, the ex-ADUBhais are in a lot of trouble. The session is over but there is one ADUBhai who is still in the hall, we have learned that he has also tweeted with the hashtag 'My body is shaking in fear'.

Headline_English: Why should Taheri be the director of Shilpakala Academy?
Content_English:
Every country has its own assets. In the ethnic context, 'personal' assets are more promising and beneficial than material assets. 

Marie Curie, Voltaire, Napoleon Bonaparte, Victor Hugo, Claude Monet—they were the assets of France. Again, Salvador Dali, Picasso, Penelope Cruz are the assets of Spain. Similarly, one of those who will be at the top of the list of Bangladesh's assets as individuals is Giasuddin Taheri. Not being able to use a person like Taheri at the national level is nothing but the failure of the state. Real estate 
When the tide of dissatisfaction on Facebook with the newly appointed Director General of the Shilplakala Academy, Syed Jamil, Taheri's name actually came up as an alternative. It is known from Chalaiden sources that netizens think that no one can be more suitable for this responsibility than Taheri. 

A gentleman named Shakur (55) said, Taheri is a man who shakes the stage in both places - Waj and music. His performance is equal in poetry, acting, and pantomime. 

I hope he will do well as a dancer. We deserve such a multi-qualified director general... 

Another Taheri devotee named Tamalika said, we want a director general who puts on a mask, loves coffee, and is hospitable. If he becomes the director general, a new milestone will be added to our literary arts. 

When we spoke to Taheri about this, he said to our representative, "Sit down, sit down, go to the bathroom," but he has not yet come out. Our representative is still waiting.

Headline_English: Artist Society opens new group; you'll be there
Content_English:
During the movement, several artists opened a group called Alo Asbei and came to the discussion. Later, their group went into darkness due to the lack of light, but netizens told everyone about the group. Although most of the members of that group are currently in hiding, we have learned from an unreliable source that they have opened a new group called 'Apa Asbei'. It is known that there are several like-minded brothers in the group along with them. 

Karuna Asbei, the group's admin and a businessman from Giza, told us that although there was a plan to bring light earlier, our main goal now is to initially bring Apa. Apa will indeed come. However, we want to move everything forward at a very slow pace. Because the internet speed is very slow in the holes where we are working now. 

On the other hand, the vice-president of the group's European branch, from a hole on the side of the Eastern European road, told us that if we want to move the country forward at the speed of Europe, we will need Apa. Apa wanted to make the country's roads like Europe. But you didn't like it. 

When asked about their plans in detail by another member of the group, he ran away while giving a dig.

Headline_English: Aruna Biswas is going to open a geyser company under her own name.
Content_English:
After leaving politics, there is a buzz about new business ventures. Actress Aruna Biswas, who gave controversial advice on the Awami League WhatsApp group about the anti-discrimination student movement, has now changed her career and is heading for a new business in Canada. She has announced in Canada that she is entering the geyser business! 

She has entertained us as an actress for years. Now, she is going to open a company named 'Aruna Geyser' under her own name and turn the advice to pour hot water into a new business success. This company is definitely going to be a revolution in the cold climate of Canada. Time will tell whether the geyser will be launched; but she is giving some advice on hot water for free. 

While promoting her company, away from political controversy, she said, I wanted to explain the benefits of hot water to students, and this geyser company is a part of that. People cannot live without hot water. So my geyser company will change their lives! 

No matter how much criticism against her on social media rises, the inauguration ceremony of Aruna Geyser is already a hit! After the screenshot of the 'Alo Asbei' group went viral, Aruna Biswas's name has now become known beyond the country's circle and even among Canadian expatriates. On a cold night in Canada, many are probably waiting for her geyser—when will that warmth come? 

From actress to CEO of a geyser company—some are thanking her for this change, while others are asking, how long can this geyser actually keep the country warm?

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader suggests marrying Chhatra League to get back in shape
Content_English:
After the mass uprising, the country is in a political storm. Sheikh Hasina and her gang cannot be found. Big leaders have left the country, and no one feels the need to search for Chhatra League anymore, seeing that they cannot be found even if they search with a hurricane. 

However, since Chhatra League is a phoenix bird, they will return. Awami League General Secretary Obaidul Quader is showing new hope to Chhatra League workers by posting a status with a fake ID. 
Chhatra League's performance is not going well - all the top leaders of Awami League are worried about the matter at the moment. Some of the party leaders are saying that Chhatra League's form is not like before, they are not seen on the streets. 
At this very time, Obaidul Quader has come with a new piece of advice! If Chhatra League wants to return to form like Kohli's form in the political field, they must get married! Standing at a public meeting, he raised his hands and said, "Get married, Chhatra League!" I told you so. Those who are not in shape, those who can no longer fight like before—marriage is the solution for you. Look, get married once, all your problems will be solved. If you don't get married and just lie around with your sleepy aunt and PC, your life will not improve. 

Saying these words, he looks at the Chhatra League leaders with a smile, as if the key to resolving the party's crisis is hidden in them. 

He also said, I know how a student leader cries inside when he cannot lead well. I myself have been through this situation. But don't make the same mistake again! There will be no more crying this time. I am telling the Chhatra League brothers, they are of marriageable age. As an elder brother, I am telling you, get married. You will see, everything will be as before! 

Meanwhile, another secret source has come to light, Chhatra League leaders are not finding a bride and groom to marry. It is also known that many are looking for a phoenix bird for marriage after not finding a bride and groom.

Headline_English: Awami League leaders in the country requested Shamim Osman to bring the tabarak of Nizamuddin Dargah
Content_English:
Sheikh Hasina fled to India after the last mass uprising. But the whereabouts of the controversial Shamim Osman have been known for a long time. Recently, a Facebook user based in Delhi uploaded a photo claiming to have seen Shamim Osman at the Dargah of Nizamuddin Auliya. Although the truth of the incident is not known, Awami League leaders in the country have wanted to send a message to Shamim Osman in Delhi. They have requested that Shamim Osman bring Nizamuddin's Tabarak for the rest of the people when he comes to the country. This has been confirmed by eArki from a fake source. 

The matter was not meant to be ordinary, but Facebook is a place where even ordinary things take on extraordinary forms. At first, some fans wrote that it seems that Shamim Bhai has started walking on a new spiritual path. On the other hand, some opponents are saying, Nizamuddin Auliya, save us! Shamim Bhai will not rule over us with Tabarak this time, will he? 

Awami League leaders immediately sent a message, Shamim Bhai, you are not able to come to the country. At least send the tabarak. I have heard that playing the tabarak of the dargah increases the votes! 

Another fake source has informed that Shamim Osman will open another dargah next to the dargah of Nizam Uddin Aulia. The name of that dargah will be Shamim Osman Aulia's dargah. Calling on Awami League leaders in the country to be patient, Shamim said, I will bring the tabarak for you from my own dargah. The game will be played again.

Headline_English: So few companions! Yunus lacks love for the people of the country
Content_English:
Dr. Yunus has said that he will attend the UN General Assembly with 7 entourage. Awami League leaders and activists have strongly condemned his decision from afar. Many also say that they have never seen any minister do such a lowly act before. They are all shocked by Yunus' lack of love for the country. It was revealed through a fair vote inside the hole that Yunus is the first person in the world to do this. However, no decision has been made about whose world this world is. 

One of our reporters was sent to the hole to find out their decision in more detail. When we spoke to a leader there who did not want to be named, he said, you removed our people-loving, compassionate, and compassionate person from his post. You brought in someone of your choice. But look, this person of your choice does not have a single drop of love for you. The person you dismissed loved us all no matter what he did. I remember, once 3 people were asked to go on a foreign trip to install an elevator in a government office. All of us were upset, only three of us! Our leader understood our state of mind. That time, a total of 25 of us went. To keep our mental state good while we were abroad, our wives, children and grandchildren were also allowed to go with us. Not only that, our work was for 2 days. We stayed there for 2 months. After such a refreshment, we all returned home and spent double the people's money, took bribes, and caused damage to the state. The leader knew how to make us work. How can a head of government be so inconsiderate? Another leader raised this question and said, 160 million people in a country. You are going abroad with only 7 people! Aren't the rest the people of this country? Our leader could not take 160 million people with him due to the lack of planes. Still, she took, sometimes 200, sometimes 300. 

Before coming out of the hole, our reporter asked in a clever way, to send you on your foreign tour, now that your leader has gone abroad permanently, leaving everyone behind. How do you see this? Although he was a little angry, he controlled his anger and said, "He has not gone permanently. He will return, maybe as a Hindu, or as an Ansar, or we don't know what!"

Headline_English: Children go on hunger strike to demand that Baby Shark be made the national anthem
Content_English:
Former army officer Brigadier General (dismissed) Abdullahil Aman Azmi has called for the creation of a new national anthem. Based on this, various people across the country are talking about making different songs the national anthem. 

Meanwhile, children have launched a novel movement demanding a change in the country's national anthem. Thousands of children have started a hunger strike in the capital's Shahbagh since this morning demanding that the children's favorite song, Baby Shark Doo Doo Doo, be made the national anthem. The main demand of the protesters is that they are not willing to eat rice after listening to the current national anthem. Their food is digested only to the tune of Baby Shark. 

A four-year-old protester (who did not want to be named) told reporters that when mommy plays Baby Shark, rice tastes good. He does not want to eat if he is given the current national anthem, so we have to accept his demand. His mother, who was next to the child, expressed her anger and said that today's children are intelligent. They will not force anything. Therefore, if Baby Shark is not the national anthem, there will be a huge loss for the future generation.

An organization called ‘Maa Sangha’ has also come forward to support this demand of the children. According to them, the easiest way to feed children is to win their hearts through their favorite songs. A leader of the organization said, “We have been seeing for a long time that children only remain silent when they listen to the current national anthem. There is no progress in eating. But when Baby Shark is played, miracles happen!”

In addition, another demand has emerged in the movement – ​​to declare ‘Cocomelon’ as the national television instead of BTV, the country’s national television. According to the protesters, through Cocomelon’s educational songs, children can not only eat but also learn. They also claim that BTV is of no use to us now, but Cocomelon changes our lives every day.

Meanwhile, discussions are underway on the children’s demands from the government. Although no decision has been made yet, the Information Minister said that the issue of declaring Baby Shark as the national anthem will be considered in depth. In addition, we are also examining the technical aspects of turning BTV into Cocomelon.

During the movement, children formed their own band and are strengthening the movement by singing Baby Shark. Parents are encouraging them, saying that the country's anthem can be changed not only with Baby Shark, but also with Baby Elephant or Baby Gorilla, but the matter must be acceptable to the children.

Headline_English: Fans are concerned about Haji Selim's return from the hospital with his jawan
Content_English:
After the fall of the dictatorship, Haji Selim was arrested by the police like many other Awami League leaders. However, while others were able to speak for themselves in court or on remand, Selim Saheb is unable to hold his own in these places. He has even been seen crying in court. After appearing in court, he fell ill and was admitted to the hospital. Although he had not spoken fully for a long time, this politician used to keep his leaders and activists motivated by saying Nuka Nuka. However, his fans are worried about whether he will be able to return from the hospital with the rest of his tongue this time. Because Haji Selim has lost the ability to speak after being admitted to the hospital once before. 

When we tried to talk to Haji Selim about the matter, he abused our reporter in the ‘F’ category and bit his tongue saying, “Ops, I have spoken.” Later, he said Nuka Nuka several times and hung up. Haji Selim’s personal assistant later called us to tell us that he is fine and his habit of saying Nuka Nuka continues as before. He also told us that Salim Sahib is trying his best not to talk in front of the doctors so that he can eat eggs at the hospital instead of the DB office for a few more days.

Headline_English: Faraj Karim Chowdhury on his way to flood-hit Dhaka with relief
Content_English:
The heavy rain has raised water on the streets of Dhaka. Bashundhara, Mirpur, Dhanmondi areas have been submerged under water. During such a humanitarian disaster, Faraj Karim Chowdhury, the country's prominent humanitarian hawker, could not sit at home at all. 

In a purely fictional interview, Faraj Karim said, "My Bashundhara, Mirpur, Dhanmondi are under water today. I cannot stay on the water in such a situation. I am going to Dhaka. To stand by the flood-affected people. I am leaving my bKash number for you. 

Faraj also said that he has been very happy since receiving the news of the flood in Dhaka this morning. He said from the fake ID, "I am a social worker, and if I cannot serve the society, my heart is very sad. Hearing that there is a flood in Dhaka, I feel very happy. I want to dance with the joy of being able to serve humanity." 

He also criticized many people during this time. Referring to the recent Feni floods, he said, "When Feni was flooded, everyone jumped in. Where are you when Dhaka is under water today?" 

Asking a question to the countrymen, he said, "Are the people of Feni human beings and the people of Dhaka not human beings?"

Headline_English: Saddam and Inan seen in space
Content_English:
In September last year, the Chhatra League announced at a conference that they would roam space from the surface. Chhatra League workers recited this in an oath. 

Recently, after the autocratic government fled, many Chhatra League leaders could not be found. Although the Chhatra League leader of Dhaka University was caught at Saikat Airport, the whereabouts of Saddam and Inan were unknown. 

Meanwhile, a fake source has revealed that these two former Chhatra League leaders have been seen in space. They are roaming around the Bangabandhu Satellite area from the International Space Station. It is learnt that these two leaders lost their memory after colliding with the space station. Then they regained their memory after colliding with the Bangabandhu Satellite. 

It is learnt that they are also thinking about a new committee for the Chhatra League space wing. They told the Chhatra League leaders on earth, indicating that a committee could be given soon, that they will give a committee. You start communicating. Keep the money ready. The game will be played from space.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina's century, wants a place in Bangladesh Test team
Content_English:
Sheikh Hasina has completed a century in the case of genocide and murder, and now she is seeking a place in the Bangladesh Test team. She has become so skilled with the bat soaked in the blood of the country's people that she has applied to be included in the team at the BCB board meeting in Delhi. This is what eArchi has learned from a completely fake source. 

Sheikh Hasina has shown such a performance in the field in July that the protesters and the public in a thirty-yard circle tried their best to send all the balls that came out of the bowlers' hands out of the field. Sometimes with straight shots, sometimes crossing the boundary. The performance of the Bangladesh Police and Chhatra League as the Prime Minister's loyal batsman was the most terrible in the history of time. From where she hit four sixes as soon as any kind of ball came, the field and the streets were drenched in blood. She played a strange game, sitting in the dugout and enjoying the game by giving instructions to others to play. 

Sheikh Hasina's goal is even bigger after completing a century in the murder case. He said, not just a century, he owns 9 centuries by killing at least 900 people in July. These cases should be closed soon. If these cases are closed, he will be able to cross the country's borders and play in the international arena. 

Regarding his extraordinary performance, Sheikh Hasina said from Fake ID, it doesn't matter, I score centuries on whatever field I play. And I have to continue playing as a part of some team. 

Not only Bangladesh. Hasina has also sought a place in India's Test team. Showing her record of genocide, Hasina said, What a great man, Sachin. They are the greatest of all time. Hey brother, what am I? They send the ball outside the boundary and I am sending at least 800 to 1000 people outside the world. India should quickly give me a place in their Test team.

Headline_English: Bribery-takers who buy rice with salary money are not getting tested
Content_English:
For the past 15 years, many bribe-taking government employees have not had to touch their salary accounts. They used to live comfortably with bribe money. However, due to the change in government, there have been several changes in the lives of these employees. Especially since the issue of bribery has started to disappear from their lives, now they are struggling to meet their daily needs with their salary money. Some have also complained that they are not getting the test like before on the rice bought with salary money. 

When we contacted a specialist to find out the reason for not getting the test, he told us that for 15 consecutive years, the tongues of these officials had become accustomed to the rice of dishonest earnings, so now they are suddenly unable to take the rice of regular salary money. It will take some time for the pH level of honesty in their tongues to return. Although it will be difficult for a few days, I hope that these officers' tongues will come back in line, then there will be no more problems related to tash. 

When contacted to know the expression of a bribe-taker in this regard, he said, "Bribery was like a dear friend in our lives. Who else understands the pain of suddenly losing such a dear friend better than me? Apa is gone from life, bribery is gone, and finally the test of eating is gone, what will we live on now? Was this the freedom we wanted?"

Headline_English: New magazine coming to understand context
Content_English:
Dear readers, especially those who start their day by logging into Facebook's timeline every morning. Looking for context among other people's posts, good news for you! And you don't have to struggle to scroll through Facebook and beg for context. A new magazine is coming, called 'Daily Context!' 



In an independent country, new events happen at night, various rants are blabbering. Bengalis who have been awake all night suffering from insomnia go to sleep after a series of incidents. Meanwhile, you wake up and see a bouquet of various statuses, memes and arguments from different parties across the newsfeed. Sometimes a robber takes the country, sometimes Raw, sometimes the Chhatra League, which was banned in BUET, gets exposed to announce a party after this, and sometimes the teachers of MIST get exposed. In the morning, the hanged head due to sleep makes the posts of people seen in the newsfeed without context hang even more. And while you are begging for context in the comments, you see that a new incident has happened. So the daily Context newspaper has one goal - to bring out the context behind all kinds of events and present it to you. It will reach your home in the morning and tell you the answers to thousands of questions like, 'Are RAW agents really taking over Bangladesh?' or 'Why is the boy who was standing on the bus listening to music on headphones last night upset?' - In addition, the newspaper has a special section called 'Flashback', which provides detailed analysis of the context of an event five years ago behind any status. If someone writes, I heard, the father of the country or Devdas? You will know that his context came from some 'unsourced' article many years ago. 

There is also an 'Emergency Context Helpline', where you can call 24/7 and find out the context of any status. You just say, brother, someone gave a status that life cannot go on like this, what does it mean? You will be immediately answered - Dada, his favorite cricket team lost yesterday. 

No more begging for context on Facebook scroll after scroll. Daily Context will make your life easier, and you will be sure that you will never miss a single context. 

So, subscribe to Daily Context today, and get the hidden context behind all the statuses, messages, and emojis every day. No more begging for context, Context is now at your doorstep!

Headline_English: Hero Alam asks police to return sweets money
Content_English:
Yesterday, August 28, we learned through Facebook that the State Minister for Information and Broadcasting Mohammad Ali Arafat had been arrested by the police. This news quickly spread across the country. The happiest person to hear this news was Facebook sensation Hero Alam, who contested against Arafat in the Dhaka-17 by-election on July 17 last year and was beaten up on election day. Since then, Arafat has been the envy of his two eyes. Hearing the news of Sheikh Hasina's escape, Hero Alam told newsmen that Arafat should be found and massacred. Upon hearing the news of Arafat's arrest on Facebook, Hero Alam took to the streets with a thong of sweets and gave sweets to everyone he met, from passers-by to guards of various institutions and fan followers. 

However, an hour later, it was learned that the source of the news was Chalaiden; although a police raid was conducted at Arafat's house, it was not possible to arrest him. 

Hero Alam's happiness was instantly shattered upon hearing this news. It is learnt from a fake source that Hero Alam is now asking the police to refund his sweets. From a fake account, he said, "I spent so much money buying sweets because the police arrested Arafat. I fed them to people. People also ate sweets in joy over Arafat's arrest. Now if I hear that Arafat has not been arrested, then these people who eat sweets have been betrayed! Even a diabetic patient is happily eating sweets. What will happen to him now?" 

Meanwhile, from his fake ID, Hero Alam has also announced that the day Arafat is actually arrested, I cannot go out on the streets to feed sweets. My request is that you remember me and eat sweets as you wish. 

Requesting the police, Hero Alam said from his fake ID, "Please catch him. I am ordering sweets from all the shops across the country. Or inform Arafat that I am looking for him to feed sweets." He himself is afraid that he will be caught by the police.

Headline_English: People demand to keep songs by Hero Alam and Mahfuz Sir in remand of Awami leaders
Content_English:
Awami League leaders have been in a lot of trouble since the fall of the government. Most of them are currently absconding, while many are spending a challenging time in DB custody. Although eggs are usually served on remand, a section of the general public has demanded something more special for the Awami League leaders. As part of this special demand, some have demanded that songs by Hero Alam and Mahfuz Sir be played to these leaders during their remand. 

Although the general public is excited about the issue, the party's fugitive leaders fear that it could put the health of the leaders on remand at risk. Some have also suggested that Pakistani singer Chahat Fateh Ali Khan's songs be played instead. However, both Hero Alam and Mahfuzur Rahman have expressed their displeasure over the issue. Although Hero Alam is quite normal, Mahfuzur Rahman is seen angry that his song is being used for the accused on remand. He tells us, people sit in front of the TV during Eid to listen to my songs, do you think I sing badly? What is the point of using my songs in these places to insult me? Listen to one of my songs and see if I really sing that badly. When he starts singing, our reporter faints. 

A confidential source says that the leaders on remand have already started falling ill after learning that the songs of these two will be played. We have even learned that some are pretending to be unconscious so as not to listen to the songs.

Headline_English: Civil society wants roster for Secretariat siege program
Content_English:
Dhaka is the city of movement, and its capital is the Secretariat. After the formation of the interim government, every community in the country has come forward with its own demands to besiege the Secretariat. One day doctors, one day dim-mats, one day Ansar, one day rickshaw pullers—it is going on like this. Even in the temporary flood situation, the Secretariat is not being released. 

The civil society, which wanted change in the country within 1 month of the second independence, is very worried about the country today. Some say, did we want such independence...? However, no one from any profession is behind the movement. An employee of the Secretariat, who did not want to be named, said, we are in a big problem. We employees want to protest one day. But there are no slots available within the next month. The roster is done... Saying this, he showed us a calendar where the schedule of who will protest and when throughout September is scheduled. 

Meanwhile, a member of the Ansar force named Ansar said, "It is not working anymore. I went to join the Ansar movement. I am joining the rickshaw pullers' movement because I was late due to traffic jams. I am thinking about the situation." However, the story of the activists is different. A social activist named Sheikh Joyrunnesa wrote on Facebook, "So many movements! The movement is ending as we are trying to decide which one to keep and which one to express solidarity with. We request the protesters to give us your roster. We also want to join the movement of our choice."

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina expresses anger over metro rail being launched in just 1 month
Content_English:
The anti-discrimination student movement was at its peak. Students and ordinary people were clashing with Sheikh Hasina's Chhatra League and the police. In the meantime, someone set fire to two metro stations. 

On the one hand, Mughd, Abu Sayeed and many other students and the general public were losing their lives in police firing. After the attack on the metro, the following headlines started floating on the news channels. 
The violence on Friday (July 19) by the saboteurs paralysed the Mirpur 10 and Kazipara stations of the metro. Authorities said that it would take at least a year for these two stations to reopen. 

Awami Propaganda added a twist from many Facebook pages to inform that the metro has been damaged so much that it will not reopen even in a year. 

Meanwhile, the metro has been reopened since yesterday. Although these two stations have not yet opened. They will open soon. 

However, Sheikh Hasina is not looking at the matter well at all. He expressed his anger at the metro rail being opened so quickly from a fake ID. From the fake ID, he said, they could have taken at least 6 months. There is no way to give so much comfort to the people of Bangladesh. As soon as they get comfort, they start criticizing. After riding the metro rail and going to the office or home, they will pick up the keyboard again to criticize me. Clothing Design 

Hasina asked to pay attention to the fact that even if the metro rail is fixed, the remaining two stations should not be fixed easily. From her fake ID, she said, I gave them electricity and mobile phones, and they used that electricity and mobile phones to go against me. That is why I sometimes thought of turning off the electricity. The current government should also think like this. It would not be right to open the two stations within at least 2 years. Let them suffer a little more. Let them understand what I was!

Headline_English: The face of Discovery Channel's Bear Grylls is changing; the ability to stay on the banana leaf will take precedence.
Content_English:
One of the few things that dominated Zenjid's childhood entertainment was the Discovery Channel. I think no one would have known how much time passed if we had turned on the Discovery Channel. We would have had the opportunity to visit Africa, Canada, and Australia from home in one program after another. However, the most thrilling and exciting program was Man vs. Wild. 

A gentleman named Bear Grylls would sometimes get stuck somewhere. He was not the type to panic when he was stuck. He was a fearless adventurer. He would save his life with whatever was at hand. If necessary, he would catch fish with his hands in the river, trap a ferocious wild boar for dinner. 
Those of us who grew up watching Bear Grylls know how to survive any situation in life. Recently, Justice Manik embarked on an adventurous expedition like Bear Grylls. Sheikh Hasina's fan Justice Manik may have spent an important time in his life watching Bear Grylls. So after Sheikh Hasina fled, he himself set out to leave the country on a solo adventure. 

How cunning he really is can be understood from the timing of his escape. During the floods, when everyone was busy with rescue, boats and volunteerism, he was preparing to go to India through the Sylhet border alone. Darvesh Baba has shaved his beard and given a new look, while Justice Manik has given a new look by growing a beard. 

He can be given ten out of ten for his camouflage skills. He can be given another ten out of ten for choosing a remote area like Sylhet. Then he wrapped himself in banana leaves for shelter at night, for which he can be given ten out of ten. But he has been defeated in one matter. His luck is getting worse. While escaping, a man saw him. While stationed near the Dana border area of ​​​​Kanaighat upazila of Sylhet, the BGB received a report that an unknown person was trying to cross the border. 

After Justice Manik's daring expedition was reported by several international media outlets including the BBC, Discovery Channel has announced a new production of Man vs. Wild. They believe that Justice Manik will be the perfect cast for the Bangladesh-based show.

Headline_English: Mayor Tapas-Atik removed, Dhaka's beauty under threat
Content_English:
Like the rest of the city corporations in the country, the mayors of Dhaka's two city corporations, Sheikh Fazle Noor Taposh and Atiqul Islam, have been removed. It is believed that the removal of these two mayors is going to threaten the beauty of Dhaka. Especially the beauty of Dhaka South will be particularly affected in the absence of Mayor Taposh. Many even believe that in addition to the loss of beauty, the amount of trees and forests in Dhaka South will increase. 

On the other hand, the mosquito community of Dhaka is also worried about the removal of these two mayors. When we contacted a representative of the mosquito community to find out the reason for their fear, he told us, we wanted independence but we did not want such independence. Because these mayors were there, we could happily eat two meals of blood and rice with our wives and children. Where will we go now? 

After the removal of Mayor Taposh, several people are suddenly coming out of Buriganga. They mentioned themselves as critics of Taposh, saying that Taposh had thrown all of them in a sack and thrown them into the Buriganga. Now that freedom of speech has returned, they are coming back. However, the special-ignorant members of the Afos League have demanded that these two mayors be retained in their posts to maintain the beauty of Dhaka.

Headline_English: Fugitive Awami League leaders want their own team in the English Premier League
Content_English:
Many Awami League leaders have fled the country in the face of mass protests. They are spending their free time abroad. To make use of their idle time, these fugitive Awami League leaders have now asked for their own team in the English Premier League. It is even said that they have asked the Premier League Authority for several quota facilities on the field as a special team of the league because of the league at the end of their name. 

For more details, a fugitive Leaguer brother living in London told us that our demand to play in the English Premier League is the most logical of any team. Because we are their league cousins. In addition, we also want the right to wear hockey sticks and helmets on the field. If our games are held at night, we are also thinking of hiring some players from the grave. However, when asked why they would take to the field with hockey sticks in a football game, the brother gave our reporter a run. 

After the news of Awami League's inclusion in the English Premier League spread, many of the Leaguer brothers living in London have started practicing. Some leaguer brothers also demanded that the opposing team's players be allowed in the guest room before the game starts. They even said that there will be a special mirror room facility for their sake if any player, coach or spectator of the opposing team says anything against their team. 

However, the leaders and activists of London BNP said that they will stand against it if Awami League is taken into the Premier League. They claim that their leaders have much more rights than Awami leaders in the Premier League. If Awami League is taken into this tournament, their nominated 'Khamba FC' team will also have to be taken. Otherwise, they said that they will go on a strict movement after Christmas.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi spacecraft to go to Mars with two astronauts
Content_English:
Although Bangladesh successfully conquered the moon long ago through an old man, Mars has been elusive to the country for so long. However, a picture recently circulating on social media has revealed that this time the country's astronauts are leaving for Mars. The matter has been confirmed by eArchi from a 100% fake source, looking at the helmets on their heads and astronaut-like clothes. 

The names of these two astronauts waiting to leave for Mars are Salman and Anis. It is learned that they were picked up from Sadarghat and taken to police custody for the purpose of going to Mars. If everything goes well, they will be sent to Mars soon. 

Talking about the preparations for going to Mars, a clean-shaven astronaut named Salman said from a fake ID, the preparations are good. I have cut my beard, turned my white hair black, and turned my white eyebrows black. After shaving, I also did a facial. Lungi and T-shirt are all ready. 

Another astronaut, Anis, said that he plans to take his brother with him after going to Mars. He said from a fake ID, "We are going. After we calm down a bit, we will take the rest with us. Arafat, Palak, Kamal Bhai, Kader Bhai - it will be difficult for us to be on Mars without them."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus in trouble, patients crowd in front of his house
Content_English:
Dr. Muhammad Yunus has recently been sworn in as the chief advisor of the interim government. Despite all the usual efforts in the hope of a healthy country, Dr. Yunus himself has fallen into trouble. Let's find out what kind of sweet danger he is in. 

A source named 'Chalaiden' tells us that long lines are constantly seen in front of the state guest house and the chief advisor's office 'Jamuna' after waking up. Upon questioning, it is learned that they all have come to see Dr. Yunus with various physical problems. Some are asking, what kind of doctor is Dr. Yunus? 
This important question was asked in Parliament earlier by former MP Sheikh Selim. 
A gentleman named Faizul (56) said, "My leg has been broken for 3 days. I cannot walk. I have heard that Dr. Yunus is a great doctor. He has also received the Nobel Prize. I came to see him with this hope... 

From pregnant women to patients with fever, cold, and cough, there are people standing in the line. 

Meanwhile, the number of very serious patients is not less. A young woman named Atika (33) said, "Someone pulled her hair out a few days ago. Now, several places including the brain are empty. I am in a lot of trouble... Sir, if you would take a look at it..." the young woman kept crying. 

Meanwhile, Dr. Yunus woke up and was in a lot of trouble. He said, "After Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah, I think I am the second person to have such a problem. Shahidullah Sahib also used to give homeopathic treatment. I am not going to go away... Saying this, he sat in a bad mood all morning. 

Meanwhile, a young man named Mani (30) standing in the line shouted to Jamuna, "Dr. Yunus is from Chittagong. I want a minute. We are going to be proud of each other..." 

Then Dr. Yunus could no longer stay at home. It is said that he came out onto the balcony, waved to the patients, exchanged smiles, and sent them off to the hospital.

Headline_English: Robber society orders people to learn dance in preparation for robbery
Content_English:
Recently, due to the increase in robberies, people have started guarding the area at night. Although they were able to rob with ease at first, the robbers are not able to rob freely due to the awareness of the people. In addition, the robber society is in a lot of trouble because the robbers have started dancing. They have to be harassed quite a lot due to their lack of previous experience and practice in dancing. 

This time, the robber society has ordered them to learn dance as a preparation for robbery. Their president said that as a professional robber, it is necessary to be a good dancer along with all other skills. While practicing the dance, he told us that not being able to rob freely in an independent country is mentally distressing. Some time ago, the ministers and bureaucrats who robbed and smuggled so many crores of taka, could not make even one of them dance. They can only do it with us. Anyway, I want to tell my robber brothers, learn to dance, even if it is for your own protection. Be it Kathyak, Hip Hop or any other genre, be experienced in dancing. Then at least if you get caught, you can survive with a little fun. 

On the other hand, several dance schools in Dhaka have started a special short dance course for robbers, taking this as a new business area. Any robber brother can learn to dance at night in these schools by hiding his identity. However, the condition is that their school cannot be robbed. Even an MP minister of the previous government can do the course under this quota if he wants. However, the course fee for them will be slightly higher.

Headline_English: 350 patch-ups in Dhaka to control traffic
Content_English:
Dhaka city is such a magical city that if you count hundreds of people resigning daily, spitting break-ups. In such a city of break-ups, the word patch-up seems to be unfamiliar to anyone. But, this time after the fall of the government, patch-ups were seen during the days of traffic control. According to a source, around 300-350 patch-ups are being done every day in traffic control. Yesterday, a total of 350 patch-ups were done every Sunday, confirmed our source. 

To talk to the newly patched-up students in this regard, one of our reporters went down the street with his student ID card hanging around his neck. He spoke to one of them. He told us that my girlfriend and I used to argue most of the time. Our decision-making was completely skibidi. Tbh, we couldn't take it anymore, so we broke up. But at this moment. I got a little sus when I got to the traffic, here both of our opinions were the same! Both are available for the movement. So our 6-month break-up got patched up today. 

We were expecting many more interviews from our reporter. But, from another source we know, the reporter saw his ex while doing the interview. And they also got patched up. The two of them are now managing the traffic on the road!

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan offered to make Punjabi, loincloth and pajamas
Content_English:
Bangladeshi cricketer and former Awami League MP, Shakib Al Hasan, is currently staying in the United States. His supporters have requested him to return to the country. After the fall of the Awami League government through a mass uprising, a new government has been formed. However, he has not returned to the country yet. There are various rumors among his supporters about this. 

However, eArchi has learned from a fake source that he has allowed Punjabi, loincloth and pajamas to be made. He will return to the country as soon as they are made. 

When asked why he allowed Punjabi, loincloth and pajamas to be made? Shakib said from his fake ID, I heard that Dr. Muhammad Yunus has become the chief advisor to the Bangladesh government. I have liked his fashion sense for a long time. But I could not wear it because I had the Mujib coat on me for so long. Now I can wear it. 

Shakib Al Hasan said that he will return to the country as soon as all the clothes are made. 

While leaving, he asked our representative, when will the interim government release nominations for the election? I think I will stand for their party this time. 

It is learned that along with Shakib Al Hasan, Mashrafe Bin Mortaza has also ordered Yunus Kati, Punjabi and Pajama.

Headline_English: Elon Musk wants to supply artificial spines to teachers, intellectuals and artists
Content_English:
In the rational movement for quota reform, most of the country's teachers, intellectuals and artists are on the side of the government instead of taking the side of the students. Some are even defending the government. In such a situation, a fake study by Elon Musk's Bangladeshi research team has revealed that most of the teachers, intellectuals and artists in this country are actually reptiles. Although they look like humans, they actually do not have a spine. As a result, they are forced to support the government.

When contacted about the matter, Musk brother told us, "You see, I am a businessman, I am where there is profit. Bangladesh is quite a potential market for artificial spines. Most of your people there are not in favor of anything rational. I especially like your intellectual community. I am sending the first lot of spines next month. If business is as expected, I will set up a factory in Bangladesh."

After a few days, the family came to know that Anjan was actually doing an unpaid internship. The MacBook on the desk was not his, but a friend's. He had borrowed it for the 3 months of the internship. 

When we talked about the matter, Anjan said that he was not getting married for the job. The offer for this unpaid internship had been there for a long time. But I didn't really need this kind of unpaid internship, since I was earning thousands of rupees by doing tuition. Later I thought, since the offer was there, I didn't get married. 

Anjan also expressed his anger about the case in his own name. He said, why would they file a case in my name? If they file a case, they should file it in the name of those organizations that give us such unpaid internship opportunities.

Headline_English: BCB is exporting 15 pieces of burqa to the West Indies
Content_English:
How many strange things happen in the world! Sometimes the reason for this can be found, sometimes it remains undetected. One such strange incident is known from a secret source. In the dark of night, 15 burqas are being sent to the West Indies by the BCB. The reason behind this could not be known despite many attempts. 

It is known that all 15 burqas were made at Saudia Burqa House. Rajib Hasan, the head of Saudia Burqa House, said, I woke up this morning to a call from Papanda. I was surprised! He ordered 15 burqas of different sizes and said, emergency. It will be needed tonight. It will go to the West Indies. I said, 'Why West Indies!' He hung up the phone on his face without giving any answer. Maybe he has some family affairs. Who knows... 

When looking into the details about the burqa, it was found that all the burqas are made of precious cherry georgette. The seller said that the price has come down a little because the fabric is a little more expensive than normal women. This black burqa is covered with a black cloth and there is a niqab system. When you wear these burqas, you can see nothing but your eyes. He also said, 'When I was young, I thought burqas were only for women. Now I see that even government employees, sir, order them in a hurry when they go abroad. So I have them specially made for them in advance. They are tall and broad people! There is no telling how long they will have to stay under the burqa. Just be comfortable...' 

Not only that, Nazmul Hasan Papon has also taken 15 black glasses from Mitali Chashma Bitan in New Market. Efforts are still underway to recover the story of the burqa and glasses. As soon as the incident comes to light, it will be shared with the readers. Rest assured.

Headline_English: No Bangladeshi will get a foreign visa without committing corruption
Content_English:
We now live in a global village. Migration was once very expensive and challenging, but now it is completely within reach. Higher education, vacation, or a clean slate—for whatever reason, people are constantly going abroad. However, rumors are circulating that recently, the UN Secretary-General, Ugandan Bin Vuski, took an important decision at the fictional General Assembly. After meeting with the remaining 193 countries, he said, 'No Bangladeshi will get a visa abroad without corruption.' 

Not only that, in this conference, the United States, Canada, and the United Kingdom have set their standards even higher. Several leaders from Canada, Malaysia, Dubai, and Singapore said, 'We are not a country of swindlers. To come to these countries from Bangladesh, you have to corrupt at least 7 billion taka. No one will be able to come for any other purpose...' 

However, the Nordic Council has come up with a special idea in this context. The chairperson of the council said, ‘We can make a list of visa applicants like the results of university or medical college admission tests. The more evidence of corruption he can show, the better the country and security he will get... If he does not show even the minimum evidence of corruption, he will be considered as rejected by the visa center..’ 

Two people who successfully migrated abroad from Bangladesh through corruption were also given a special reception at this time. They are Benazir Ahmed and Matiur Rahman. 

The countries present gladly accepted this proposal. However, since this incident, numerous PhD aspirants and people from Sylhet who got 7 in IELTS have been hospitalized..

Headline_English: Messi sets world record with 50 million stories in a day
Content_English:
The Gen-Z generation is famous for giving birthday wishes in stories. Some people annoy their friends by posting fifty, some even a hundred wishes in stories. However, Messi has surpassed all of them. This footballer has set a world record by posting 50 million stories in a day. Messi said that no one is even close to his achievements in football. He wanted to do something like this in terms of giving stories. 

In a video call from his fake Instagram account, Messi told us that in America, you don't have to work hard for football, you have plenty of time. I thought let's make use of the time, although I didn't give some wishes, they were made by Ronaldo fans. 

On the other hand, many Ronaldo fans are proud of Messi's record, some have even sent legal notices asking why Ronaldo never gave such a story about their wishes. However, we have learned from a fake source that he will surpass Messi by sending 60 million wish stories on his next birthday.

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan to bat with one hand against Afghanistan
Content_English:
Tiger XI will take to the field tomorrow morning against Afghanistan in the last match of the Super Eight. The Tigers are sure to return home after their excellent performance in the first two matches. So they do not have much pressure to win the match against Afghanistan. They will play normal cricket. 

However, Shakib Al Hasan is planning to play a slightly lower level of cricket than normal cricket. It is known that this confident cricketer will bat with one hand in this pressure-free match. Talking about the matter, Shakib Al Hasan said from one of his fake IDs, since there is no pressure to beat Afghanistan, there is nothing to lose, so we want to enjoy our game. So I am thinking that I will bat with one hand. I have told the rest of the team, there is no need to take too much pressure, to enjoy the game. The left-handed batter will bat with his right hand and the right-handed batter will bat with his left hand. When it comes to fielding, we are giving more priority to lying down and fielding in this match. 

At this time, everyone present shouted Savage Savage at Shakibal's speech. 

Shakibal gave various advice to the cricketers as well as the journalists and fans. He said, you are also free. You don't have to sit in America until the final of the Hudai. You can return to the country before that. Fans don't need to be tense about the Bichi anymore. From today, your Bichi is free from risk.

Headline_English: The family's younger sons want to train with Usain Bolt to run after cows
Content_English:
A special tradition of Eid-ul-Adha is running after cows. This responsibility falls on the shoulders of the sons of the family. As soon as they leave the market with the cows, they start running after the cows. Sometimes it is their own cows, sometimes those of relatives, sometimes those of neighbors, sometimes those of strangers, there is no telling who they have to run after. 

But, human running is nothing compared to cow running. Therefore, the younger sons of the family want to increase their running speed to compete with the cows. To increase that speed, they are taking refuge in Usain Bolt. A two-day training is their special need. They said that if necessary, they will go to Usain Bolt's house and get training, but they still want this training. 

When we tried to talk to Usain Bolt about this, he ran away. However, we were informed from one of his fake imo accounts that he is looking for a trainer to run after cows himself. I thought if I couldn't find anyone, I would take refuge with Flash Bhai. As far as I know, he is the only one who is good at this job.

Headline_English: People are eager to hire Tamil heroes for butchery work
Content_English:
The most important work of the Eid-ul-Adha is the work of the butcher. There may be many butchers, but you can't find the right butcher. We always hire the wrong people as butchers. Now, after much thought, the people have found a suitable candidate as a butcher. Tamil movie heroes are the only suitable butchers. 

When asked about the reason for such a decision, an anonymous person said, what is the job of a butcher? Cutting meat! If you have ever watched Tamil movies, you will agree with your eyes closed that Tamil movie heroes are masters of this job. They not only cut, but also use different irony styles. Some can cut in the air, some can cut with their eyes closed, some can cut two hundred with both hands at once! They cut with first class speed and one hundred. If a Tamil hero works as a butcher, you can put the cow in the oven within 10 minutes of slaughtering. 

When we talked to Tamil movie heroes about this, they did not immediately object. However, they have their own demands for this work, they want to shoot at least 100 movies in between jobs. Only if this demand is met will they devote themselves to the work of butchers.

Headline_English: Benazir bought a cow worth 20 lakh taka for just 20 thousand taka
Content_English:
According to a fake report, former IGP Benazir Ahmed Gabtli bought the most handsome cow in the market for Eid al-Adha. When the huge cow was being taken from the market, everyone seemed to stop their work and look at the price of the cow with awe. 

The offline representative of eArki was present at the market. Not a single detail of the whole matter escaped his attention. 
Speculation was going on in the entire market about the price of the charcoal-black, almost 7-foot-long cow. When Benazir Sahib was asked about the price, he said in a dream, I bought the cow according to my ability to please Allah. I do not want to remove my name from the book of Allah's blessings because of the price of the cow. Our representative came forward to reveal the price of the cow, expressing regret for putting an honest, fair police officer in such an embarrassing situation. 

After a while, he realized exactly who Benazir had bought the cow from. He was asked, as if he were being rude, how much the cow was worth. At first, he did not want to admit that he had sold the cow. After Benazir Ahmed's name was mentioned several times, he looked around and said in a soft voice, "20,000." 

How can this huge 7-foot cow cost 20,000? The owner of the cow said sadly, "My cow was as big as it was black as coal. It stood like a hero and ate grass. Even Australian Friesian cows would fail if you put on glasses. The cow could eat a lot of me. It would eat grass, straw, and husk from its beak, which was scary." 

I named the cow Benazir, who was as black as a RAB, completely fearless, and a possessive food lover. I raised the cow with great affection. This morning, when the cow arrived from the country, Benazir Sir was the first to price it. I liked the man very much. And the cow is also very good. So I paid 20 thousand. 

Since the man's words did not seem credible, I talked to some more people to find out the truth. The cat in the bag came out of them. It was learned from them that the cow seller has a lot of debt in the area. The lower the price he can show for selling the cow, the easier it will be for him to survive on this journey. That is why he is talking about 20 thousand.

Headline_English: Lovers accused of calling home to clean their bowels because no one was home
Content_English:
The atmosphere of Eid-ul-Azhar is all around. Some have bought cows themselves, some have sacrificed them as partners. Eid means sharing the joy. But how much can women really participate in Eid or other festivals? Is the kitchen work their only responsibility? How civilized is this scene in modern society? 

However, people have changed with time. Women are also gradually becoming smarter. This is precisely why complaints have been made about lovers. It is heard that lovers are calling their lovers home because no one is home and having their lovers clean their intestines. Initially, such incidents were heard only around Dhaka, but now lovers all over the country are making the same complaint. 

A young man named Rubel said angrily, "He put me on a short video call and said, no one is home. Come, please. I will come quickly after playing FIFA. Understand the situation. After bringing the shower tower, he says, I have a surprise for you.. Close your eyes. After closing my eyes, I see him bringing the intestines. I mean, I couldn't believe it...' 

Another young man named Faruk said, 'My story is even more tragic. After cleaning the cow's intestines, he showed me the goat's intestines and said, "Are you going to do it or should I call my best friend?" Remember, if you call him, not only will the intestines be cleaned. I was forced to do that too...'
