However, the most tragic story is told from a young man named Adnan. He said, 'I went to my girlfriend's house and saw me and her just friend, two of us. Cow intestines in one pot and brains in another. She let me clean the intestines and brains with my best friend, but she said, "I won't let anyone clean what they don't have..."

Headline_English: Mojo thanks Coke's marketing team
Content_English:
Coca-Cola Bangladesh recently created an advertisement ahead of Eid. There is a lot of discussion and criticism going on around the advertisement. Amidst this discussion and criticism, Mojo, one of Coke's competitors in the Bangladeshi market, thanked Coke. It is learned that they thanked Coke's marketing team for saving Mojo's Eid campaign costs. 

An official from the Mojo marketing team said from his fake ID, "Thank you Coke. If you have a competitor like Coke, no one needs friends. They do everything. Look, our entire Eid campaign costs have been saved. Coke did that. Where else can you find such a competitor! 

This official also said that he will share the Eid profits with Coke as a thank you. From his fake ID, he said, "I am thinking of giving some of the profit we make on Eid to Coke." We would also like to give some money to Coke's branding team for making such an amazing advertisement on our behalf. 

Meanwhile, after the publication of this advertisement, the sky has fallen on the heads of the people in the Coke sales team. They are very worried about whether they will be able to meet the sales target on Eid or not. One such person said from his fake ID, "Brother, I was thinking that I will sell Coke on this Eid and blow it up. I was also setting a lot of targets. After watching this advertisement, one thing came out of my mouth, Ustad, Goa Mara Sara. Now where will I go with this sales target."

Headline_English: Aryabhatta wants to give credit for zero discovery to Soumya
Content_English:
With two left-handed openers from Bangladesh at the crease, the Sri Lankans started the attack with part-timer Dhananjaya de Silva. Soumya failed to sweep him with the first ball. However, he could not remain calm. He was caught by Wanindu Hasaranga while trying to blow him at mid-on. Traditional attire

And thus, Soumya Sarkar wrote his name in an extraordinary record in the cricket book. A record that reminds us of Aryabhatta a hundred years ago. Some say that Soumya will also be called Zero Sarkar from today, he says in his Facebook status.
No matter what you call him, Soumya Sarkar or Zero Sarkar, he is not only the owner of the most zeros in his T20 career, he is also the king of the highest number of zeros in his T20 World Cup career among Bangladeshis.
Seeing Soumya's love for zero, Aryabhatta, the inventor of zero, made a remarkable announcement. He wants to give the entire credit for the invention of zero to Soumya Sarkar. Talking about the matter, Aryabhatta said, "Even though I discovered zero, Soumya has drawn me closer to it with love. Only a Pakistani named Afridi has loved zero more than Soumya before. Impressed by this love, I decided to give Soumya the credit for discovering zero. 

Soumya Sarkar may not be able to roast all the ducks he has scored together and eat them at a night party, but he himself is already being roasted on social media. 

When Soumya Sarkar was asked about such records personally, he said that he does not play for records, if he played for records, he would not have made this record today after playing so many matches. He would have scored the first duck in his debut match. 

In addition, the Department of Primary Education has decided to make some changes in the math book for class one. The counting system will start with Soumya. Soumya, one, two, ...... ten.. In this way, children will be taught to count so that they can remember Soumya's name for his contribution to zero for a lifetime. 

On the other hand, Ireland captain Paul Stirling, who has been the undisputed king of ducks in T20Is, tweeted about Soumya and invited him to become the president of his 'Top Duck' club. The duck club had not had a new member for a long time, and he was very happy with Soumya's arrival today and hopes that Soumya can surpass him and take himself far and wide.

Headline_English: Harun Mia's international rice hotel branches to be launched in Kolkata and Nepal
Content_English:
The country's famous food chain Harun Mia's Rice Hotel is going to be launched internationally in Kolkata and Nepal, crossing the country's borders. Initially, two branches will be opened in New Town, Kolkata and Pokhara, Nepal. Later, the hotel owner Harun Chacha is planning to spread this rice hotel to other parts of the country. 

Harun Chacha is currently busy organizing the hotel's operations in Nepal after checking the meat supply lot in Kolkata. Despite this busy schedule, he told us in a fake video call, "I am proud of being able to spread Bangladeshi food culture to the world." Meat will be supplied from Kolkata to these branches of our hotel, and the menu will include meat jhalfries, as well as dal and potato bhatra. If a VIP or media person comes to eat, they will get a 2% discount in exchange for a live video and selfie. Traditional Clothing 

Harun Chacha opened this hotel about a year ago on a road next to Ramna Park in Dhaka. Later, when various celebrities and political figures started coming to his hotel regularly to eat, the name of this hotel spread in different directions. Another special feature of this hotel is that they serve food on newspapers.

Headline_English: Feluda requests DB Harun to be given charge of Sagar-Runi murder case
Content_English:
Harun-ur-Rashid, the head of the intelligence wing of the Dhaka Metropolitan Police, is traveling from country to country to solve the murder case of MP Anwarul Azim Anar. Sometimes he is roaming around Nepal, sometimes Kolkata. It seems that he will leave after solving Anar's murder case. 

Feluda himself is impressed by DB Harun's diligence. He gave Harun the title of Feluda of Bangladesh. He also requested that DB Harun be given the responsibility of the Sagar-Runi murder case. He said this through a fake source. 

In a fake video message, he said that DB Harun is the Feluda of Bangladesh. He is traveling from country to country to solve the murder case of Anar, working day and night. I want DB Harun, known as the Feluda of Bangladesh, to be given the responsibility of investigating the Sagar-Runi murder case. He is going abroad and solving the murder case. This murder case of the country is like rice porridge to him. 

Harun Saheb Feluda is a little embarrassed by such a statement. From the fake ID, he said, he is looking at me more. I am a detective who eats dal and rice. I am just doing my duty, nothing more. This is my responsibility to the country. 

Besides, he is very optimistic about the Sagar-Runi case. From his fake ID, he said, whoever does not get nine, will not get ninety or one hundred. I knew in advance that it would not happen with those who were responsible for it before. If I am given the responsibility of the investigation, then this will be the last investigation about them.

Headline_English: Police loan being introduced in Bangladesh
Content_English:
A woman has died in police custody in Abhaynagar Upazila of Jessore. The family alleges that the police tortured her to death after detaining her with Yaba and failing to get two lakh taka. 

Incidents of torture and death at the hands of the police are often heard of when a bribe is not asked for. However, a high-ranking leader of the Bangladesh government has said that such incidents will not be heard of again. He said this from his fake ID after the Jessore incident. He also shared a plan for such incidents of murder without receiving a bribe. 

He said that so that no one else dies due to police torture if they cannot pay the bribe, we are arranging a police loan. This loan will be handed over to the victim as soon as possible so that people can pay immediately if the police suddenly come and ask for a bribe. Then he will give it to the police to prevent torture and murder. 

Another high-ranking government leader, using a fake ID, said from the roof of an 8-story building, "Usually, big people can hide their crimes by moving money before they are arrested on any charges. Even if they commit a crime, they can get away with it because of bribery. The problem is for the middle and lower-class people. Whether they commit a crime or not, when the police come to their homes to collect money, they cannot immediately pay two to four lakh taka. Or they cannot even say goodbye by saying they will take time. As a result, we see incidents of torture and murder. 

Expressing hope that this loan will be launched as soon as possible to avoid such incidents, this leader said, "Once this loan is launched, no one will die because of not being able to bribe the police. The police will also be able to show a little more humanity. If this small loan is launched, Bangladesh's name may soon be adorned next to the countries of the happiest people. And government money will remain with government people. There will be no possibility of economic damage to the country due to this."

Headline_English: Benazir won't get any discount on her shopping even if she goes abroad; Obaidul Quader in a purely fictional interview
Content_English:
Benazir Ahmed, the successful corrupt politician of Bangladesh, has gone abroad, hiding everyone's eyes. When the news of her going abroad came to light, we immediately went to Obaidul Quader with a beautiful camera. Instead of taking a photo with our beautiful camera, Obaidul Quader told us from one of his fake IDs that Benazir has gone abroad, fooling us! The money in the bank account has already been removed. However, we want to inform the countrymen that no matter who the culprit is, no one will get any discount. Even if Benazir goes abroad, we are working hard to ensure that she does not get any discount on her purchases there. 

When asked whether Benazir will not get a discount on all foreign brands or some selected brands, he told us that the amount of money that Benazir has will not go to the general market. It will go to the shops of these brands like Gucci, Louis Vuitton, Rolex, Nike, Audi, Mercedes, etc. For now, we are withdrawing Benazir's discount from these brands. She will not get any exemption! We are also sending some government officials abroad to ensure that she does not get any exemption. They will stay abroad and ensure that Benazir does not get any exemption. 

When the matter of not getting exemption reached Benazir's ears, Benazir told us through a fake account, 'What if I am not released? Are my arms not long enough? I will do my shopping with the police and army in various positions in Uganda. I will not take this money myself.

Headline_English: Demand that government employees declare corruption money as freelancing income
Content_English:
Several levels of government employees are protesting demanding that the corruption money of government employees be declared as freelancing income. This has been confirmed by a fake source, e-archive. 

In his speech at the rally, the president of the organization said, everyone knows that a government job is a golden deer. It is natural that once a golden deer is obtained, only a flood of money will flow into the life of the one who gets it. Files that have been stuck for years are cleared in an instant by the hand of a government official. Do you know where the cash on delivery system that we have when shopping online these days comes from? Government officials like us, who speed up the process of signing a dirty file of a century, either take some honorarium or a gift for signing. Is there anything to blame us for this? During this time, where have you seen anything happening without money, you have to buy a glass of water on the street with money. You will spend money to drink water, build a house with money, buy a car, send your child to school with money, and take our sign for free? This is not possible. 
The country's youth earn lakhs of taka by freelancing, and signing government officials in exchange for money is also a type of freelancing. Government officials do this work outside of work. So even if they are appreciated, this income of government employees is called corruption. Government officials have criticized such a view. 

A government official also said, you know, we keep personal trainers for ourselves to make our signs beautiful. We whisper behind each other's backs about whose sign is the most beautiful. We stay up all night to bring curves to the signs. You can't just make us work for free. We know how much damage we do to the precious nerves of our hands by signing dozens of files a day. And you call that corruption! 

In his closing speech, a junior vice-president of the organization said, "We want you to come into our shoes and understand our situation. Learn to respect our profession. We want the signs that we do not pay for to be recognized as freelancing." Through this recognition, the country will not only be saved from dishonor, but thousands of crores of taka will be deposited in the state treasury as taxes. The country's GDP will increase rapidly.

Headline_English: After price hike, drinking WASA water will cure all diseases
Content_English:
By increasing prices 16 times in 16 years, WASA is the only one that is showing its efficiency. There are many other government institutions that have files stuck with them for years, dust accumulates, and water is wasted. No one has any clue. On the other hand, WASA is increasing prices every year, thinking about the service of its customers. It is improving the quality of service. 

WASA taps used to produce sharbat, now after increasing the price, there is a plan to produce sharban tahura—a fake internal source of WASA, who does not want to be named, said this in connection with the recent increase in WASA prices. News of many people getting sick after drinking Dhaka WASA water is published on various pages. WASA officials call such news fake and purposeful. Rather, they cited the statement of a cake maker to explain the taste of WASA water. This cake seller has been using WASA water to make chocolate cakes for a long time. When we offered the cake to him, he said, "First, we had to give him food coloring and various things." But now we don't give him anything. Why use food coloring when WASA water is available, you can make a chocolate cake by boiling it a little. My expenses have also come down a lot. 

It has been learned from another fake source that WASA water will now be used as medicine. While talking about the matter, a WASA official said from his fake ID, WASA water is no longer water. It has become a life-saving medicine. After drinking this water at an increased price, all diseases from cold to cancer, depression to insomnia will be cured. 

When we repeatedly called WASA MD to congratulate him for such a success, but he was not available, he himself called back and told us that he could not receive the call because he was testing WASA water. I was testing the variant of water that will be available after WASA increased the price and the current one. After testing the previous variant, my stomach was rumbling a little. I feel quite comfortable after drinking the new one. After increasing the price, we will supply such a water that, if consumed regularly, three times a day for seven days, will cure any disease.

Headline_English: If you dare, check the air pollution index today: Mayor
Content_English:
The impact of Cyclone Remal on Dhaka began the night before yesterday. From night to day and last night, it rained and gusted all over Dhaka. So this morning, Dhaka looked quite cool and calm. There was no dust, no excessive heat, and not even any mosquitoes. 

And in the meantime, the Mayor of Dhaka took a look at the media. He said, if you have the courage, show the air pollution index of Dhaka today. This has been confirmed by e-archy from a completely unreliable source. 

The Mayor said to the media from one of his fake IDs, if you have the courage, check the air pollution index today, see how much hair is on whose chest. 

Trying to explain the matter a little, the Mayor said from another fake ID, they make news every day. Today Dhaka is first in air pollution, today second, today third. But today they ask you to do it, but you don't. Because today there is nothing to worry about! 

To those who always say that the mayor does nothing—the mayor also said, if he works, you won't see it. This is the fact that we have eliminated air pollution from the city in one storm—isn't this work? You won't see it with your own eyes. 

When asked about the rising water levels in various parts of Dhaka due to rain, the mayor got a little angry. In an angry voice, he said, "If you reduce air pollution through rain, you complain about the rising water levels. Hey brother, if you solve a problem, this can happen as a side effect. Even if you take medicine, it has side effects. And this is a complete cyclone. Won't the water rise? So you say, let's stop everything."

Headline_English: Locals demand declaration of Bashundhara-Mirpur as haor areas
Content_English:
Bashundhara-Mirpur are submerged under water and take the form of a haor when it rains a little. The locals of these areas have demanded that their areas be declared as haor areas while they are constantly under water. They claim that these two areas have all the features that an area needs to have to be a haor. 

A local resident of Mirpur, who was forming a human chain demanding the declaration of haor, stood in the water and asked us, "What else does it take to be a haor here? We regularly ride boats, swim occasionally, and if we try, we can even catch fish. So what is the need to go to Sunamganj or Kishoreganj just by spending money? If we accept it as a haor, people will get the opportunity to visit the haor from home. In addition, we locals will be able to earn two-pence by doing resort business or lowering barges. But yes, we have to respect premium haors. Bashundhara cannot be considered a haor of our level. 

A local fish trader told us that if these areas are included as haors, it will bring a revolutionary revolution in the country's fishing industry. When fish is brought to Dhaka from different parts of the country, the price of fish doubles. If fish are cultivated in micro-penitentiaries under the pillars of the metro rail, Dhaka can become a hub for fish farming. 

However, in this regard, a resident of Bashundhara told us, since when did Mirpur Haor come into being?

Headline_English: Mirpur residents challenge Babar Ali to board the metro rail during office hours
Content_English:
Babar Ali has achieved the honor of becoming the sixth Bangladeshi to climb Everest. However, the people of Mirpur are reluctant to accept this achievement of Babar Ali as something extraordinary. They will consider Babar Ali as a real adventurer only if he can climb Everest, but not Everest, but if he can climb the metro rail during office hours. An office-going aunty next door who regularly commutes by metro rail told us, anyone can climb Everest, but it is not a common thing to climb the metro rail during office hours. My son rides the metro rail every day to work, pushing the crowd. Even I do it. I want to give Babar Ali an open challenge, first get a chance and see him on the metro rail. We even learned that some residents of Mirpur have challenged Babar Ali to cross the Bijoy Swarani signal during peak hours in one chance. In this regard, the brother who is already stuck at the signal told us, can one go to office after crossing Everest? Otherwise, we do not count those Everest favorites. There is no point in becoming a soldier of Everest, otherwise you will have to become a fighter of the streets like us. Traditional clothing 

After these news were published, Babar Ali, sitting on the top of Everest, went on Facebook live from his fake account and said, "I made a mistake. Please forgive me. I will climb Everest again after training to ride the metro rail and cross the signal at Vijay Sarani in the country."

Headline_English: Debt Default Studies being launched at university, professors from Begumpara will take classes
Content_English:
Since many people are in debt without academic education and considering its future as a career, the Department of Debt Studies is being launched in the country's universities. This program, which has been launched in almost all the first-tier universities of the country, will allow research from honors, masters to PhD levels. Most of the universities will be taught by Begumpara resident debt experts and they will take classes online. However, most universities are looking for teachers, and only those who have a debt of at least one hundred crore taka will be able to get teaching opportunities in these programs.

To know more about the program, when talking to the Dean of the Department of Debt Studies of Savar University, he said, Debt was once just an industry, but now its usefulness as a career has increased. Our main goal is to develop passionate people who are inclined towards debt or trying to learn from a young age into academic scholars. As we are the first in the world to start teaching this subject, I hope that in the future this subject will also be taught at the University of Mangalagrah, along with Oxford or Harvard in the West, and I can proudly say that our graduates will be the teachers there.
A content creator named Khepsen the Mejo Bhai also praised such an initiative. Going live on his Facebook page, he said, "Even though it is late, such a revolutionary initiative in the country's education system is positive for the country. If the debt-ridden industry is legalized in this way, it is also possible to prevent talent trafficking from the country to Begumpara, and even if there is a debt, the country's money will remain in the country." During the live, when an audience commented, "Brother, did you not repay your loan?", he got angry and said, "Brother, have we run away, why are you asking questions like this?" and ended the live. 

However, the people of Begumpara were the happiest about the news of the launch of debt-ridden studies. In addition to the joyous procession in Begumpara, the locals celebrated by distributing sweets and dancing. In a tearful voice, one such debt defaulter brother told us, "Today is a very happy day for me. Even after defaulting on debt, I can now be independent. If I had taken such an initiative a few days ago, I would not have had to flee this country with my wife and children."

Headline_English: Dubai wants to hire vice president from Bangladesh to plant trees
Content_English:
Dubai has taken a plan to plant 100 million trees. This project can be implemented under an initiative called 'Dubai Mangrove'. Under this, a large mangrove or saltwater forest will be created on the coast. There are plans to plant more than 100 million trees there. This initiative has been taken by URB, a sustainable city building company. As the first step of this initiative, they said that they will hire thousands of vice presidents and presidents from Bangladesh. 

URB said that after the decision to plant trees, we did a research on which country is ahead in planting trees. We saw that only Bangladesh is ahead in planting and cutting trees in the whole world. Among all the people of Bangladesh, their vice presidents and presidents are the most active in this regard. We were very surprised by one thing, Bangladesh is a country where all the presidents can plant trees on Facebook! We have never thought of it like this. This innovation of planting trees through Facebook is completely unfamiliar to us. So we are asking for their help in this project. 

URB also informed that we want to hire some special presidents for tree planting. Faraz Karim Chowdhury, Rafsan the younger brother and Salman Muktadir are at the top of our special needs list. We have talked to our research team and found out that they are super experts in this regard! No one else can move forward in this regard at the speed they can. Our research team has also confirmed that with Salman Muktadir, it will be possible to plant trees not only on Facebook but also in many other places.

Headline_English: Sunerah Tasnim was ordered to join the Bhabhi Club immediately by club president Umm Al Hasan Shishir.
Content_English:
In addition to protesting the Rafsan issue, Sunerah Tasnim, known as the future Bhabhi, has also come to the attention of the Nikhil Bangla Bhabhi Club. Even the president of the Bhabhi Club, Umme Al Hasan Shishir Bhabhi, was so impressed with her performance that she ordered her to join the Bhabhi Club immediately. 

Expressing her admiration, the club's vice-president, Mandi Bhabhi, told us, "She is our pride. I thought that this protesting Bhabhi culture would probably disappear after us, but no... I am getting hope from seeing her. Such a great performance before becoming a Bhabhi, if she becomes a Bhabhi, this girl will leave us all behind! We want such a girl for our younger brother. 

On the other hand, the future Bhabhi, Sunerah Tasnim, is very happy to receive a call from the Bhabhi Club. She wrote in a status with a crying emoji from her Fake X account, "First of all, I want to thank the Bhabhis, who are the guardians of the PO, the vanguard of husbands, the fighting soldiers of princes, the intellectual daughters of protest. Today, I have the privilege of becoming a protesting Bhabhi." Today my life has become meaningful, since I was a child I had a dream to become a member of this club one day. At the beginning of our love, I told her that by defending you, I would surpass even our all-rounder Bhabhi. Think about it, Ruhul Amin, where am I today. In response to this tweet by Sunerah Tasnim, the club president Bhabhi wrote another tweet, "Come on Naveen, don't be afraid, Bhabhi wants you in the club."

Headline_English: Raghav Boal Debt Defaulter Society does not accept Rafsan's father as a defaulter
Content_English:
After gifting an Audi car to his parents, food blogger Rafsan's father has found himself in a new trouble. The incident of a loan default of 2.5 crore taka taken from Trust Bank was leaked. After interest, it turned out to be 3.5 crore taka. Rafsan's father is in a lot of discussion on Facebook about this incident. 

Meanwhile, in a different news, it has been reported that the All-Bangla Raghav Boal Loan Defaulter Society does not want to accept Rafsan's father, who has a loan default of only 3.5 crore taka, as a loan defaulter. They said that in a country where people who have a loan of hundreds of crores and thousands of crores live, these petty national loan defaulters cannot be accepted in any way. 

A Bangladeshi businessman who has a loan default of 1,000 crore taka also questioned the huge social media exposure he got by defaulting on only 3.5 crore taka. He said, the whole country now knows about the loan defaulter of only 3.5 crore taka. And we have defaulted on loans of thousands of crores day after day. We are doing it. Where does no one know us like this? In what country are we living? Where incompetent people get more publicity than competent people. 

Although some of the hundred crores of rupees defaulters have given their opinion in favor of placing Rafsan's father in the defaulters' society. One such person said that since he defaulted on a small amount of money, he can also be with us. In a slightly different way. For example, in our chat, as a petty defaulter, he will not get the opportunity to sit on the sofa, he will have to sit on the floor. That is why it is possible to accept him.

Headline_English: Chhatra League holds midnight drill with books, notebooks and pens at Rajshahi University
Content_English:
Last night, two groups of Chhatra League clashed at Rajshahi University. As a result of this clash, they held a weapons drill on the campus at midnight. This was reported by Bangladeshi daily Prothom Alo. 

However, to know the truth of the incident, we contacted the Batabi Lebu desk in Rampura. They reported a different news. The Batabi Lebu desk said that the Chhatra League did not hold a weapon drill on the campus at midnight, but a book-notebook-pen drill. 

A reporter from the Batabi Lebu desk scolded us and said that good Chhatra League boys can never practice with weapons. They spend the whole day studying. It may be that their exams will be the next day, so they have come to the field with books-notebooks-pen drills to complete the syllabus at midnight. For group study. 

Several Chhatra League leaders have also admitted the truth of the incident. One such leader said, Mosi is bigger than Asi. We Chhatra League boys never touch small things. So you can understand that there is no question of practicing with Aussie, i.e. indigenous weapons.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi Raghav Boals urge Rafsan's father to train at loan-debted art school
Content_English:
The entire debt-ridden community of Bengal is quite angry with the father of YouTuber Rafsan the younger brother after the news of his loan default of two to three crores of taka became public. Some of them have also described the day this news spread as a black day for the debt-ridden industry. 

A debt-ridden artist who is currently living in Begumpara with a loan of thousands of crores of taka told us that Bangladesh is a hotbed of the debt-ridden industry. People in this country are living a normal life despite taking loans of several thousand crores of taka and not paying them back. No YouTuber's father could keep the news of a debt-ridden loan of just two to one crore a secret. It is unacceptable to be caught for such a two to one crore in a country of debt-ridden artists. We will appeal to him to enroll in a debt-ridden art school for training. If necessary, we will also arrange a loan for admission there. Still, please don't tarnish our name like this, it is a pity. 

On the other hand, Rafsan's father has been offered a scholarship from the Begumpara branch of the loan-defaulting Art School. The school's founder, Sufi saint Gelman Z. Hasan, told us, "We always train weak students with special care. If he gets admitted to our school, we hope he will be able to repay the loan of thousands of crores of taka easily in the future."

Headline_English: The rest of the players want Liton Das as the 12th player for life
Content_English:
Liton Das' exclusion from the team due to poor form is now a regular occurrence. He was also dropped from the playing XI in the last Zimbabwe series. He was on the field as the 12th player. He entered the field with water, bananas, apples, and various fruits. The Bangladesh team finished a great series against Zimbabwe by eating them. Online Bazaar 

Other players are determined to maintain Liton's consistency. That is why cricketers want to keep Liton with them as the 12th player for the rest of their lives. 
One such cricketer said from one of his fake IDs, after entering the field, the ball was not coming to the bat, I was struggling, I thought I would be out. After that, Liton Bhai came on the field, brought bananas, apples, and malt with him. I played comfortably. After that, my hand opened. Sixes are being hit just by swinging the bat. 

Expressing his gratitude to Liton, this player also said, at one point, I felt like giving my runs to Liton. I actually had no contribution to this run. If Litonda had not been the 12th player, if he had not brought a banana to the field, I would not have scored these runs. 

There has been a lot of discussion about this incident in the Bangladesh dressing room. Many other batsmen have felt the power of Liton being the 12th. After eating Liton's banana, their bats have also shown a flurry of runs. 

This incident left the Bangladesh dressing room and reached the dressing rooms of other teams in the world. As a result, many other cricket-playing countries have written to the BCB asking for Liton as their team's 12th player. However, the BCB has not agreed to let Liton go.

Headline_English: Grandchildren of American VVIPs coming to Bangladesh to learn how to beat up police
Content_English:
Recently, the grandson of a VVIP in Bangladesh has come into the news after being beaten up by the police. This news has caused a stir not only in the country but also abroad. In order to raise their grandchildren to be self-reliant and brave, American VVIPs are going to send them to Bangladesh. American VVIPs claim that their grandchildren are completely naive. They do not want to taste any adventure in life. Many of them even live a very ordinary life. 

A disappointed VVIP told us, I am thrilled to see the grandchildren of Bangladeshi VVIPs. If we do not beat up a policeman or run over ordinary people with our grandfathers' power on the road, then what is the point of being the offspring of such VVIPs? How strong are the grandchildren of Bangladeshi VVIPs! And our grandchildren have become chickens in all farms! What can I say about mine, don't believe it, Russell Bhai goes to work at McDonald's, sh! sh! 

When asked about the details of how the grandchildren of American VVIPs will be trained, a Bangladeshi grandson told us, "They are our VVIP cousins. We will teach them all the abuses of power. As part of our training, in addition to reckless driving on the streets of Gulshan at night and during the day, mock training will be given on raising hands on ordinary people for no reason, and as a special surprise for this course, we have hired some police members. We will also teach them special techniques to tear their clothes or beat them in our school. Our goal is to spread Bangladeshi VVIP culture to the whole world.

Headline_English: Reluctant to wish mom a Happy Mother's Day after eating a large piece of meat
Content_English:
Today is Mother's Day. Everyone wishes all mothers a happy Mother's Day, but a young man named Mahadi from Gulshan has refused to wish them. He made this decision after accusing his mother of eating large pieces of meat. 

When asked to talk about the matter, Mahadi said, "All mothers give their children the big pieces of meat, the thigh, and the fish head. She herself eats the bones, the gravy from the bottom of the pot, and the fish tail. But my mother is the opposite. She herself eats big pieces of fish and pieces of meat. I will write on Facebook with a picture - Happy Mother's Day to you, mother, for giving me the big piece of fish all my life. I don't even have this opportunity." 

Expressing anger at her mother, Mahadi further said, "What kind of mother is this? Doesn't she even remember Mother's Day? She doesn't eat the tail, doesn't eat the bones, doesn't eat the rice lying on the bottom of the pot. It's very surprising! What kind of mother is this?" 

Is there a shortage of rice, fish, or meat in your house? To our question, Mahadi said, "There is no shortage. There is always rice and fish!" Even so, she is a mother. Even if she does, why would she eat a big piece? Won't she serve it to us? Hey brother, there is also something called the emotion of Mother's Day.

Headline_English: Private tutor quits tuition after student's older sister doesn't match his vibe
Content_English:
One of the many challenges of Zenjis is not matching vibes. Many things have happened in Zenjis' lives due to not matching vibes. No one had to fall in love, they couldn't get free time at the office, and even their relationship with their family was not maintained. Now, a private tutor has been giving up tuition for not matching vibes with the student's elder sister. 

Rakin, a first-year student of Dhaka University, has been teaching a sixth-grade student of Uttar Badda High School for two months. Even after everything was going well, this tutor was not finding comfort somewhere. The excitement with which he used to teach, turned into black depression when he returned home. In this regard, Rakin said, 'Yo, I thought where is the prbs here, later I realized that the problem is not the student or me. The problem is the student's sister's fr. She's very weird. Sometimes she brings tea. Then I say let's chat a little, let's hang out. But she never says yes! Right eyeing kre ktha bole abar. IDK. So fishy what she wants but I feel being ghosted. Ejonno I left it... ’ 

But when asked to talk to the student's sister about this, she said, 'What is vibe? What do you mean by that? I don't understand anything... Amma, come here a little. Don't you see what you mean...' 

Says this and calls her mother. Rakin is not the only one, her younger brother Sakin is a Zen Alpha. It is known that when Sakin was ten years old, he ran away from home because his vibe did not match with Basa. After that, he was not found.

Headline_English: SSC results are out, the aunties next door are very busy
Content_English:
Finally, today, the results of this year's SSC exam have come out. As always, the aunties next door are busy as soon as the results are out. These aunties are working tirelessly, forgetting to eat and drink, to find out the results of their children next door. In a video on a YouTube channel called Local BBC Network, the aunt next door expressed her disappointment and said, "The days are not like before, now the Polapan no longer gives bad results. If this continues, we will go nowhere, if Polapan continues to get GPA fives on a mass scale like this, the culture of the aunties next door will have nothing to do with the thousand-year-old tradition of Bengal. Russell believes that not a single child in my neighborhood has failed." 

On the other hand, the aunt next door, who is the former president of the Shilpi Samity, has claimed that the increase in GPA fives is her own achievement. This aunt, who habitually makes the achievements of others her own, told us, "Because we were there, the parents of the children have put pressure on them because of peer pressure. As a result, today you see how many GPA fives there are. You don't have to criticize everything so much, if it weren't for us, the SSC results would have gone to the hands of the people in the jute fields today. 

However, there were reports of clashes between two groups of aunties from neighboring houses in Brahmanbaria today over asking for results and punching. The clash took place after the auntie from one side of the house told the other, "Oh, my doorman's daughter also got a GPA five, your son didn't," said a local reporter for Tanta TV.

Headline_English: Salman Muktadir's name appears in the list of intellectuals
Content_English:
Content creator Salman Muktadir's name has appeared in the list of intellectuals. After seeing Salman's recent activity on social media, the Bangladesh Intellectuals Council added him to the list of intellectuals. Bangla Books 

A review of Salman's recent Facebook activity shows that he is giving his important opinions and suggestions on various issues of the country and society. Salman has started talking about corruption, education, instability in the job market, Audi, content creation, married life and many other topics. 
The matter has fascinated the intellectuals of Bangladesh. The intellectuals praised Salman highly and said, "Now there are no intellectuals in the country. All those who are there are intellectuals. Moreover, there is a shortage of young intellectuals. Salman Muktadir is filling this vacant place. So we want to give him the respect he deserves. From today, he is a listed intellectual. 

The country's two major political parties have already started vying to bring up rising intellectual Salman Muktadir in their party. The main opposition party BNP has said to Salman, "We believe that he will also talk about money laundering, disappearances, juvenile gangs, guest rooms. We also seek his intervention in the arrest of our leaders and activists." 

The government party is also looking at Salman, a completely fake source has confirmed this. A leader of the government party said to Salman from a fake ID, "We need young intellectuals. If Salman joins our party, we will give him the responsibility of a state minister, or at least the responsibility of managing a bank. In return, he just has to speak a little on our behalf." 

Former Awami League minister Golam Dastagir Gazi, however, has given the current government a scare. He said from his fake ID, "Salman worked with me in the 2024 election campaign. We created great content." I can see that the boy has a love for the Awami League. It is my responsibility to get him into the party.

Headline_English: Farmers demand space to grow jute in Bashundhara-Mirpur during the rainy season
Content_English:
As soon as the rainy season arrives, water starts accumulating in some areas of Dhaka, Bashundhara-Mirpur is one of them. This time, farmers have demanded space to grow jute in these areas that have been waterlogged for a long time during the monsoon. As canals, beels and even rivers are gradually being taken over by influential people, jute farmers are currently not getting space to grow jute, so they want to use the temporary rivers of Bashundhara-Mirpur to compensate for their losses and take advantage of the opportunity. 

When contacted in this regard, Dickbal Bhai, the brand ambassador of jute fields and a successful jute farmer, told us that the country's jute industry is dying today due to the inability to grow jute, as a result of which jute fields are decreasing. Due to the decrease in jute fields, problems are also increasing for couples. Nowadays, you will not hear any lover saying, "Come to the jute fields." If this continues, there will be no romanticism about jute fields in the country. However, when Dickbal Bhai is asking why he is only talking about the romanticism of jute fields, leaving aside the real issue, he gets a little excited and says, "Are you itching to die? I will apply ointment on you." On the other hand, along with jute farmers, fishery entrepreneurs also want to use these wetlands to set up temporary fish farms.

Headline_English: Vegetable vendors are very busy ahead of Anjan Dutt's concert
Content_English:
Today is the great 11th of May. Anjan Dutt's concert will start at 6 pm. Even though tickets are sold on tickets, another community is making profit. Everyone knows this business community as vegetable sellers. Their business has been growing exponentially since last night. No vegetable seller has been able to sleep all night due to phone calls from customers. 

When we wanted to know the truth of this matter, we secretly met a vegetable seller. He told us that I sell a lot of vegetables every day. But, a concert is actually a complete green light for my business! Yesterday, Belak's concert was held, then a few kilos of vegetables were sold. Since last night, I have already sold 5 kilos of vegetables for Anjan's concert. . I have placed 2 more orders, I will take them before entering the concert.' 

Although we could not find out who the real consumers of vegetables are, we spoke to someone who came back from Black's concert with red eyes last night. He said that if you eat vegetables and go to the concert, you can get the feel of the music. It feels like you are listening to music from the sky. I like it a lot!

Headline_English: Animal and KGF download rates have increased to watch Shakib Khan's Toofan movie
Content_English:
The trailer of Shakib Khan's Toofan movie is out. The download rate of Animal and KGF movies has increased since the trailer was released 30 minutes ago. It is known from a confidential source that 3,500 Animal and 2,500 KGF have been downloaded in the last 3 hours. Facebook netizens are downloading Animal and KGF and uploading pictures of the movie on it. They are adding the caption, 'Watching Toofan.' 

In this regard, one such netizen said without disclosing his name, 'First I wanted to watch Toofan. After watching the trailer, I decided to watch Animal and KGF before watching Toofan. It was nice to see that Shakib Khan will act in a playful manner, and on the other hand, I am happy to think that we will not miss Ranbir Kapoor, Yash, or anyone. I did not expect such a good movie to come to Bangladesh, I feel very good. I am actually very proud.' 

After such an incident, we tried our best to get an interview with Shakib Khan. But he somehow refused to give an interview. On the way back home, upset, we received a message from Shakib Khan's fake ID. It read, 'This is science!'

Headline_English: Trees in Central Park will be cut down, Smart New York will be built
Content_English:
Dhaka South City Corporation has a reputation for cutting down trees for beautification. But this time, New York City Corporation is also coming to share their fame. Thousands of trees in New York Central Park will be cut down for beautification and building a smart New York. When we contacted the mayor of New York for details, he told us, Marica will be Bengali, the trees will be cleared. There is no point in wasting space by keeping such a big forest in the middle of the city in the name of Central Park. Rather, the smartest solution is to build a few shopping malls here and plant small trees around them. I went to Dhaka a few days ago to get guidance in this regard. At that time, your mayor of the south, our PO brother PO guardian, the fighting soldier of beautification, the mayor, taught us how to handle these issues. We beat up a few people who opposed the issue and threw them into the Atlantic Ocean. 

On the other hand, the local ministers and bureaucrats there have applauded the issue. They have called for launching more and more development projects in the country, taking Bangladesh as an inspiration. One such bureaucrat said to us in a video call, "You're a bad person, understand? Today, I'm still stuck in America because I'm an American bureaucrat. If I were a Bangladeshi bureaucrat, there would be at least two houses in Begumpara. I hope our situation will change this time."

Headline_English: BNP boycotts Indian elections
Content_English:
The Lok Sabha elections in India are underway. Already, many parts of the elections have been completed in several phases. The whole world is interested in this Indian election. Bangladesh is also interested. However, BNP, one of the main opposition parties in Bangladesh, announced its boycott of the Indian elections in a fake message. 

Although the party could not give any specific reason behind the boycott. When asked about the matter, the party boycotted the question in a fake message. 

After not getting any answer from BNP, we contacted some fake psychologists. They are blaming the long-standing mental habit behind boycotting the Indian elections. One such psychologist said, 'They may have done it out of habit after boycotting elections for a long time. They did not notice which country's elections.' 

While analyzing the party's mental state, another psychologist said, 'BNP is in such a mental state right now that they will boycott not only the Indian elections, but even if they hear about the class monitor election of Samaspur Government Primary School.' 

A fake leader of BNP also admitted the matter on condition of anonymity. He said, "We have to boycott whenever we hear that an election is being held somewhere. Otherwise, we can't sleep properly, we can't eat, we feel nauseous. That's why we boycott the election."

Headline_English: Why is a visa being granted only if you buy an air cooler? Biden summons Peter Haas
Content_English:
Recently, there has been news that people are getting American visas just by buying air coolers. Some people have even been forcibly put on a plane and taken to America while buying a cooler and returning home. After this news spread, on the one hand, the demand for coolers has suddenly increased in the market, on the other hand, many people heading to Begumpara are trying to buy coolers at low cost and head to America. President Joe Biden has summoned the Ambassador to Bangladesh Peter Haas as many American politicians have already started expressing their concerns about the matter. 

When asked to know more after a closed-door meeting, Haas Bhai told us from his secret Imo number, 'PO Bhai, PO guardian, fighting soldier of the White House, vanguard of Republican ideology, Biden Bhai had some questions regarding the sudden issuance of so many visas, and I have cleared them. Biden Bhai wanted to know whether those who are being given visas will regularly attend Republican Party rallies, and if night voting is needed in America, he also wanted to know whether he can provide service from the grave if necessary. I have assured you of everything. When asked whether this meeting will have an impact on the visa policy, Has Bhai told us, "There is no problem, you can buy a cooler with all your heart. At least as long as it is hot. If it gets hot, of course, there may be some changes in the visa policy. Then, if you buy a heater, you will be given a visa," he said. 

On the other hand, people from the Nikhil Bangla AC Owners' Association have expressed their anger at being given a visa only if you buy a cooler. The organization has demanded that they also be given a free visa like the people who bought the cooler.

Headline_English: Bangladesh buys diamond nuts, bolts and washers from India
Content_English:
Power Grid Company of Bangladesh has purchased nuts, bolts and washers for their towers from India. The cost of which is about 2 crore 59 lakh taka in Bangladeshi taka. According to the Daily Star, the current market price of the products is about 16 thousand taka. 

So why did Bangladesh buy the products for about 1 thousand 619 times more taka? Many people have raised this question. The government and those concerned are also being criticized. But after delving into the incident, it is known that these nuts, bolts and washers are mainly made of diamond and gold, which is why the price is so high. The concerned told eRK this from a slightly fake source. 

Why did they have to buy diamond products instead of iron products? In response to this question, an official of the company raised the issue of Bangladesh's status. He said that not all products can be bought at a fair price. There is also a matter of dignity. If we wanted, we could have bought iron products for just 16 thousand taka, we could have bought them from Dholaikhan. But would that have brought honor and respect to the country? Isn't there a prestige, Mia? If you don't pay a lot of money to buy it, people won't even respect it. That's why I had to buy the diamond one. 

Another official said, "You haven't listened to the song, my homeland is the queen of all countries. The country that is the queen of all countries can't have a tower with two-paisa nuts, bolts, and washers. Diamonds are a must."

Headline_English: Cutting down trees on Jessore Road will reduce heat, says Forest Department
Content_English:
The Forest Department has decided to cut down about 2,044 big trees in Jessore. The reason for taking such a decision when there is talk of planting trees all around is stated in the fake Facebook ID of the Forest Department, ‘Not by planting trees but by cutting down trees on Jessore Road will the heat reduce.’ 

While explaining the matter scientifically, a Forest Department official told us after lunch, ‘If there are too many trees, the wind cannot move, due to which even if there is a storm, there is no noise in the environment below. The trees have to be cut down for the sake of proper air circulation. Besides, the money earned from selling these trees will also be useful in cooling the heads of our Forest Department seniors. So, even though it may seem like some trees are being cut down, its benefits are much greater.’ 

On the other hand, after learning about this incident, Allen Ginsberg, the creator of the Jessore Road poem, has announced to write another new poem called Jessore Desert. The poet has also written and sent some lines of that poem to our editor’s secret WhatsApp number, the lines are given below.
I will cut down trees 

I will eat fish 

This is my life 

The country will become a desert 

Very, very 

Bury the trees

Headline_English: Messi, Ronaldo express anger over Bangladesh's Black Bengal goat receiving GI recognition
Content_English:
Bangladesh's Black Bengal goat has been recognized as a GI (Geographical Indication) product for the first time in 2024. Not only that, but Tangail's Chamchom, Comilla's Rasmalai, and Kushtia's Til Khajao have also been newly added to this list. So far, the number of geographical indication products in Bangladesh has reached a total of 21. Although everyone is quite happy with the recognition of Black Bengal goat as a GI product, Messi and Ronaldo are angry. Why are they so angry is our main topic of discussion today. 

When asked to talk to Messi about this, he did not open his mouth. However, it is understood from his tweet that he is not happy about this news. He tagged Ronaldo in the tweet and wrote, 'Wtf, Goats are now GI's but not US? Boycott GI' 

However, the matter was revealed when Ronaldo's wife Georgina made a big post from her Facebook account. He wrote, 'Who doesn't know about Ronaldo's contribution to football? Messi also has a slight contribution. What is true must be said. The Black Bengal goat was recognized as a GI but Ronaldo Messi was left out - the matter is very disappointing. I don't know if they can bear such a shameful incident. May God help them. It is doubtful whether they will be able to love or respect the football arena that cannot even give them GI status as before..' 

Not only Ronaldo or Messi, but many others, including the Mejban of Chittagong, the Khejurer Jor of Jessore, are angry at not seeing their names in the GI register. When they tried to talk to the GI board about this, their numbers were disconnected.

Headline_English: General students request establishment of separate university for Chhatra League
Content_English:
Bureaucrats have demanded a separate university for their children. After this incident, ordinary students of various universities in the country have come forward with such a demand. They requested the establishment of a separate university for Chhatra League like the children of bureaucrats. Ordinary students said this in a fake request meeting. 

It was informed by ordinary students that the contribution of Chhatra League for the country, for the people of the country, the wide range of their talents - studying in the same university with ordinary students does not suit them. Moreover, the general education program of the university also does not suit Chhatra League. 
In one of his speeches on the matter, a student said, there are many subjects in our university such as physics, chemistry, triple E, mechanical, etc., but Chhatra League university will not have these subjects or departments. They can have a helmetology department, a hosticology department. Their classes will not be in the classroom either. They will be in the public room or the guest room. 

While explaining the differences in the educational programs of the university requested for the Chhatra League, another student said, their university system will be different from that of a normal university. In a normal university, teachers conduct classes, students conduct classes. Here, the Chhatra League will conduct classes, and teachers will conduct classes. 

The normal students also proposed to name several chairs in the university to maintain the tradition of the Chhatra League. They said, respecting the past traditions of the organization, some chairs named Obaidul Quader Chair, Nanak Chair, Tofail Chair, Nazmul Siddiqui Chair, Saddam Hossain Chair can also be introduced in the university.

Headline_English: Eid al-Adha is coming, Bangladeshi stars are in panic
Content_English:
In just a few days, Eid is coming. Eid is celebrated in every house, but only in the houses of celebrities there is panic. They are very skeptical about the upcoming Eid. To escape from the hands of the cow traders for Eid, they are willing to do any impossible thing in the world. Such a fake information has come to our hands. 

A celebrity, who did not reveal his name, told us in this regard, ‘These traders are very dangerous. They bring cows to the market, then name the cows after the stars. For example, last year I was watching a video of a pink cow on Facebook. Suddenly the trader came and said, look at this cow, this cow’s name is Shakib Khan! What does he eat? Shakib Khan! Only 5 lakhs! Saying this, he gave a paw to the cow’s butt. He thought, even if he put his paw on the cow’s back, it would feel like it, but on my cheek. There was a scar for 5 days!’ 

When talking to another celebrity, he said, ‘I am very upset about this matter. But my point is, why is my name given to a goat when all the stars are named after cows? They and I are the same! I will keep an eye on this matter. If necessary, I will set off four digbazis in Shahbagh, but I will still have to be named after a cow. I cannot be named after a goat!

Headline_English: Colonial style is returning, Neelkuthi is being established in every university
Content_English:
Although they could not take control of the residential halls from the Chhatra League, the teachers of the blue party have taken control of almost all the important posts at the administrative level of Dhaka University. This blue party is the platform of the teachers who support the ruling Awami League. Starting from the vice-chancellor to the post of residential teacher of the hall - the blue party has exclusive dominance in all places. (Source: Prothom Alo) 

After such success of the blue party, it has been reported from an unreliable source that an indigo house will be established at Dhaka University. The teachers of the blue party have also assured to start indigo cultivation in various places of the university. 
Along with the establishment of the indigo house, it has also been reported that indigo farming will be made mandatory for the teachers of the white party. They also assured to take care of them and bring them to the indigo house if they fail to pay. 

It is also known that in the current context of the university, Dinabandhu Mitra's Nildarpan will be rewritten. It will be written by a teacher of the blue party. Although there was a fight between 5 teachers over who would write, they told us that they would confirm the matter after the fight. 

Meanwhile, his girlfriend named Neela has broken up with a teacher from the white party because he does not have any position. The teacher sang in a tearful voice to Neela, ‘I am a poor lover Neela, I have nothing else to do. I do not even have a position.’ 

It is also known that after achieving success in DU, there is a plan to set up such Neelkuthi in every university across the country.

Headline_English: I could have done everything if I had gotten the pink set of questions: A student who got the black and white set of questions in the 46 BCS
Content_English:
The 46th BCS exam was held in a grand ceremony across the country on April 26. The BCS exam is a golden deer for the people of Bangladesh that can be the cause of tears, happiness, marriage and separation for thousands of people. In short, the power of BCS is unlimited. How was the 46th BCS? What do the candidates think about the question paper? And what was the atmosphere like in the hall? To find out this information, we sent a reporter to the exam as a spy on behalf of eRK. 

It is known that most of the students were very happy after leaving the exam hall. They scored 195 out of 200 with certainty. However, some were also sad. Many say that they might have missed it for a while. An examinee named Nazmul said, 'I didn't like the question, I will refund 700 taka...' 

Meanwhile, when another examinee named Anik was asked about his experience, he said, 'The exam is a joke. My life is like this. Wherever I go, it's black and white. The black and white set questions were very difficult. I saw the pink set guy next to me scribbling everything. I heard that was easy. If I had gotten the questions from that set, I would have become a BCS cadre now....’ 

He sighed saying this. Not only that, but many more stories are heard from the examinees about the color of the question paper. An examinee in room 302 of Premier Ideal School in Mymensingh had an argument with the inspector about the color of the set questions. When the examinee was given the questions from the pink set, he said that he wanted the questions from the blue set to match his shirt, otherwise he would not take the exam. The incident did not get much media coverage as it was quieted down in the presence of the magistrate before it could become a big deal. When the eRK reporter present in the room was asked to say something about this, he smiled and said, ‘What’s wrong with me, I’m coming to watch a drama....’

Headline_English: The new season of GOT will actually be less hot, says research
Content_English:
The heatwave is not decreasing in any way, the Dhaka North City Corporation is trying to make the common people take a semi-bath by sprinkling water, but it is not doing much good. In this situation, a sensational information has emerged from this fake study, this study by the Bengali Series Lava Research Center has shown that the new season of GOT will actually reduce the heat, not in anything else. Although the GOT series has officially ended, Bangladesh has requested its makers to make a new season in the interest of reducing the heat in Bangladesh. 

When contacted in this regard, one of the characters of GOT, the Night King, said, 'I have deposited my weapons but I have not forgotten the training, if the PO Director brothers call, I am ready to go to the streets of Dhaka with all my soldiers, feudal lords, and dragons. Seeing the heat in Bangladesh this time, I myself have to take a bath with water three times a day. I hope I will get a call soon.' 

On the other hand, the main writer of GOT, George R. R. Martin, is thinking of writing the story of the new season of GOT centered on Dhaka. When our reporter missed a call to Martin Bhai's secret number, he called back and said, "Don't worry bro, Winter is coming to Dhaka. This season will be the most amazing season in the history of GOT. In this season, in addition to making snow fall at the Bijoy Sarani intersection with Jon Snow, there will be a special dragon fight sequence at Hatirjheel. In addition, there is a plan to have a unit of your country's fighting soldiers, Sammat Bhai, in the Night King's army, special hammer-hockey sticks have been ordered for them. After hearing this, I have a feeling that if I wait a few more days, I will not be able to stand the winter cold."

Headline_English: I scored 199 in BCS. Do you know why I couldn't score another one?
Content_English:
Thousands of students participated in the 46th BCS exam. Shakib was also among the thousands of students. We don't think anyone has prepared for BCS better than Shakib. However, obstacles will come on the way to success! Shakib has also come. Even after all this preparation, Shakib was able to answer only 199 questions in BCS. He left out a whole question! But why? 

Shakib told us about this, I answered 199 questions in BCS. Do you know why I couldn't answer another one? My pen's ink had run out. I asked many people for pens, but no one gave me one. If I had an extra pen, I could have answered 200!' 

Hearing about Shakib's activities, a student who topped the BCS, who did not want to be named, said, 'What kind of talk is this! If you don't have a pen, you have to write it with blood. If you are afraid of fighting, it was hot now, you could have used sweat. People don't pass BCS by cheating like that! We were very dedicated in our time.'

Headline_English: Talking to friends in foreign countries via video calls reduces heat, says study
Content_English:
Despite various efforts to reduce the heat, the common man is not being saved from the heat in any way. However, Swish BORAP research center (SBRC) has brought some relief amidst this ongoing intense heatwave. Recently, in a hypothetical study, they have proven that talking to friends in the country of Borap on video calls during the heat reduces the heat around them. Not only that, but along with the heat reducing, cool air also flows through the body. 

To give details about the matter, SBRC Vice President Kamruzzaman Kamruzzaman actually started blowing cold air throughout our room during a video call with us. Later, our editor told us that this will only happen to Bangladeshis and no special technology will be needed for this. Because any feeling like religious sentiment of Bangladeshis is contagious. So when talking to friends on video calls, when you look at the Borap around you or see a friend wearing a three-four layer jacket, that feeling automatically comes to your body. Similarly, even if you talk to your Middle Eastern expatriate friends on a video call on a winter day, your body will get warm, but you have to talk. But in that case, you have to talk on the imo app. 

All the scientists around the world have praised the spread of such discoveries by SBRC, and some even demanded that the organization be awarded the Nobel Prize. However, using this technology, not only Bangladeshis but also citizens of other countries have made arrangements so that they can survive during global warming.

Headline_English: New visas coming for Bangladeshis, you can spend the summer in Canada
Content_English:
Great news has come amidst the intense heat. If you want to escape the heat, you can now spend the entire summer in Canada. We have learned from a completely unreliable fictional source that the Canadian government has taken such a decision for the sake of humanity after seeing the condition of Bangladeshis in the summer. 

The Canadian Immigration Minister said in a video call from his secret imo account, 'Bangladeshis have contributed a lot to our country's economy thanks to Begum Para. Now is our time to payback. My Bangladeshi brothers can now apply for a special summer visa and play with the barap throughout the summer. There will be a system to buy a house in Begum Para in installments, and if someone wants to turn their black money into white as well as yellow or pink, that system will also be there.' 

Meanwhile, the news of Canada's temporary summer visa is bringing joy to the hearts of domestic leaders and bureaucrats. One such bureaucrat told us from his AC room, 'I don't feel good after breathing the air from the AC. AC in the office, AC at home, AC in the car, I feel like I'm in AC after breathing so much AC air. Thanks to the Canadian government, I can be a little closer to nature this time because of the summer visa. Your sister-in-law loves taking pictures in front of the bar.' 

Another MP told us, 'I knew in advance that it would be so hot, so I bought a house in your sister-in-law's name in Begumpara in advance. But I couldn't find any excuse to go. I think I'll have to go this time.'

Headline_English: Don't plant more trees, we can't cut so many: Bureaucrats, politicians and influential people to Chhatra League
Content_English:
Bangladesh Chhatra League is running a program to plant 5 lakh trees in 10 days to get rid of the intense heat wave and achieve the SDGs. Chhatra League is receiving a lot of praise for this program. Especially, mayors, university vice-chancellors, bureaucrats, politicians, and influential people who have been successfully cutting down trees for a long time have highly praised this tree planting program of Chhatra League. They also said that this love for nature of Chhatra League will be written in the letters of cutting trees for ages. In a statement, they said, ‘We want to encourage Chhatra League in this work. That is why we have decided to write ‘Abhinandan’ on the trunks of all the trees we have cut down so far.’ 

An Upazila Parishad chairman who has gained fame by cutting down trees said, ‘I don’t feel comfortable cutting trees like before. I am tired. Sometimes I feel afraid that I will be able to cut trees! Chhatra League has taken away our worries. These 5 lakh trees are our inspiration for survival. These trees will grow up one day, and I will be able to cut them comfortably—I spend days thinking about this. Thank you Chhatra League.’ 

However, some have also commented that the Chhatra League’s planting of 500,000 trees is too much. One such mayor said to the Chhatra League, ‘Don’t plant more trees, we can’t cut so many trees. We have decided to make the country the Middle East. There will be a desert all around. There are so many trees in the country, we can’t even find a place to cut them. When will we fulfill our dreams by cutting down these 500,000 trees!’ 

However, despite some criticism, the Chhatra League’s activities are mostly praised. A local leader called the Chhatra League a visionary and said, ‘We are eating trees, what will our children eat? I used to worry a lot about this. I couldn’t sleep. The Chhatra League freed us from worry. The Chhatra League is wise, because thinking about the future is the work of a wise person.’

Headline_English: Humans are now amphibians; Darwin's new theory
Content_English:
One of the most important discoveries of modern science is the theory of evolution of British scientist Charles Darwin. His theory shows how animals have gradually changed over time according to natural laws. Now a new dimension has been added to his theory of evolution. Yesterday, through a fake, unbelievable source, scientist Charles Darwin said, 'Humans are now amphibians.' 

He named this process in English, natural transformation or natural change. Through which a person can live in both water and land. 

Through an unbelievable link, it is known, 'He invented such a theory with the aim of the people of Bangladesh taking baths 8 times a day in this summer, and sitting underwater in the bathroom for hours.' 

When this theory became known, all the frog societies of the world are declaring humans as their friends. They said, 'Humans and we are the same. No one has been able to prove it until now, but now they have.'

Headline_English: Egg and paratha are being fried in the sun in several parts of the country, including Dhaka.
Content_English:
The country's soil and people are burning in the scorching heat. The first week of Baishakh has not passed yet. The condition of more or less everyone, including children and the elderly, has deteriorated. However, some special districts of the country, including Dhaka, Dinajpur, Rajshahi, and Bogra, are notable among them. However, Bengalis are always unique. Even though they live in the most adverse conditions, they will turn the tide in their favor. Some such incidents came to light yesterday at 1:30 pm. 

It is known that in several districts of the country, egg parathas and other food items are being prepared in the open air in the afternoon. It is known that they have closed the hotels and now they have opened hotels in the open air. In this regard, the owner of Nirala Hotel, Salimullah Uddin, said that due to cooking in the heat of the sun, our gas bill is also increasing. In the heat of the sun, it takes 2 minutes to poach an egg, 3 minutes and 20 seconds to fry an egg, and 7 minutes to cook rice. Yesterday I also cooked chicken for the first time... 

When asked if the heat is unbearable while cooking, he said with a smile, "We wear earki winter T-shirts while cooking. It feels cold from all sides, you can also try it. However, there is a separate tent for those who come to the hotel for two meals. 

So this is the story of the middle class and the lower middle class. How are the upper class? Even when we look at the lives of the upper class, we see strange things. Out of 100 oven users, 90 have sold their ovens. An engineer named Rahi said, what is the benefit of just increasing the electricity bill? It gets hot when you take food out of the fridge and put it on the balcony, using an oven is a luxury.

Headline_English: Long line for visa in front of the Antarctic embassy
Content_English:
People have been leaving their countries like guest birds to escape the sudden increase in heat. While many have gone to Europe and America, the Antarctic continent is at the top of many people's list of preferences. Almost a thousand applications are being submitted every day to go there. Even long lines can be seen in front of the fake Antarctic embassy. 

When we asked a person standing in that line why he went to the Antarctic, he told us, even if he can't stand up straight in the winter sun, he can stand up straight. But in the heat, I can't lie down, sit, or stand in any position. On top of that, your sister-in-law has a hobby of standing on the barap to watch penguins, how can she not do it? 

On the other hand, seeing the interest of Bengalis in going to the Antarctic, the local resort owners' association has already increased the rent of the resorts there several times. Kamruzzaman Kamruzzaman, owner of the Barapkul Resort, told us, businessmen from your country also do the same thing during the month of Ramadan, why should we be left out? In addition to all the expenses of doing business here, we also have to pay a subscription to the Enterkotik Samat Bhai branch. It is very difficult to survive in the enterkotik season unless you are a little clever.

Headline_English: The mind-blowing benefits Bengalis want from AI
Content_English:
Since the advent of AI, there have been various tensions among Bengalis. Why can't AI do this, why can't it do that—and so on, various demands are being created. We have found out those demands that are now the first demands of Bengalis from AI. Let's find out what benefits Bengalis want from AI. 



1. AI will pull up mosquito nets to resolve the eternal quarrels between husband and wife or roommates about pulling up mosquito nets 



2. You are getting married, but AI will do the wedding ceremony for you 



3. When you go to the market, it gives you rotten things? Why would this happen if AI exists? So while shopping, AI will select fish, meat, and vegetables and bring out fresh things 



4. Have you had a crush but can't tell? AI will make a line with your crush for you 



5. You will break the glass, but AI will listen to all your mother's scolding for you 



6. Are you gaining weight? Even though you are enrolled in the gym, you are not able to exercise? You will lose fat, AI will go to the gym and exercise for you 



7. When your friends break up, AI will listen to all their sad stories, you will just take the treat in time 



8. You will go on a date, and hey, hehe... AI will buy condoms for you 



9. After giving money to your friends, has the friend disappeared? AI will find that friend of yours and return the money 



10. You will do politics, but but but... AI will handle Khaled Muhiuddin 



11. You will eat fast food, Coke or duck meat as much as you want, AI will suffer from physical complications 



12. You will attend Jamaat, AI will face 71

Headline_English: Jaya Ahsan's name is emerging on the list of favorite singers of many youths in the country.
Content_English:
Recently, the song 'Tanti' was released by Coke Studio Bangla. Bangladeshi heartthrob and nation's crush Jaya Ahsan played the main role in the song as a singer. Along with acting, she also showed a surprise in the world of music. 

At 3 minutes and 13 seconds into this 4-minute 56-second long song, Jaya Ahsan is seen entering the stage by walking on the catwalk. At that time, she was wearing an aesthetic saree with a maroon border in off-white. After walking with a microphone in one hand in a smiling manner, she made various gestures with her hands and feet along with the rest of the artists. After that, she focused on the song. At 3 minutes and 20 seconds, she uttered the word 'Chai' in a single voice. After that, the collective voice began, 'Baitarani of the tree, Chhainnna of the tree, Chhai...' Surprisingly, the young and old Bengalis lost their minds with joy after hearing only the word 'Chai' in the song. 

More details about this song can be found by talking to some young people. A young man named Fahim said, 'If I had not listened to Tanti, I would never have understood that Jaya Ahsan can sing such a wonderful song. I cut out only the 'Chai' part of Jaya Ahsan's solo voice with a capcut. 'Chai' is still ringing in my ears. Not only that, now both my ringtone and alarm tone are 'Chai'...' 

Not only Fahim, thousands of other young people are in the same situation as Fahim. Those who did not like listening to music until now have also leaned towards Tanti. Meanwhile, another young man named Jobayer said, 'Don't believe me when I tell you the story. My grandfather is 89 years old. He lives with us. One night I woke up suddenly. I saw the light on the TV. Grandfather was watching the song Tanti on mute. I pretended not to see it and fell asleep again...'

Headline_English: Miraj from Mirpur is going to become a successful entrepreneur by using his bed.
Content_English:
Everyone wants to be an entrepreneur. However, how many can be successful entrepreneurs? If we look around us, we see a couple of successful entrepreneurs among the entrepreneurs. Miraj from Mirpur is developing into another successful entrepreneur. Without any investment, he is starting his journey with his only asset, a bed. 

When we asked Miraj about his story of becoming an entrepreneur, Miraj told us, 'I wanted to be an entrepreneur since I was a child. This is my dream. But, I kept my dream under wraps because I did not have enough investment money. This summer is helping me fulfill my dream. Whenever I lay down in bed, it felt like I was lying on a tawa. Using this thought, I lie in bed for half the day. By that time, both oil and heat come to the bed. Then I start frying parathas, eggs, etc. in that tawa. By selling these, my income has reached 2 lakh 20 thousand taka in the last two days. I am very optimistic about my business. 

Miraj's success story has touched the hearts of thousands of people. Housewives, inspired by him, are cooking fried food in oil at home on a tawa called a bichana.

Headline_English: The Digital Salami Determination Committee (DSCNIC) has released new guidelines for the 2024 Eid Salami.
Content_English:
Yesterday, the salami rate for 1444 Hijri was determined in a mock meeting in the meeting room of the Digital Salami Determination Committee. The meeting was presided over by the president and committee members of the Digital Salami Determination Committee (DSANIC). 

In this regard, the general secretary of the committee said, 'Every time, the elders and the children have a dispute over the amount of salami. This time, to avoid a dispute, DSANIC has determined in advance how much and how much the salami can be.' 
It is known that this time, the Bikash salami has been set for Eid from a minimum of 99 taka to a maximum of 25,000 taka. And emphasis has also been placed on paying the salami early in the morning on the day of Eid. Even if it is delayed in paying on the morning of Eid, it must be done at least on the day of Eid. If salami is given after the day of Eid, it will be considered a donation. 

According to the decision of the meeting, if salami is received through a saree or Punjabi, it will not be considered as taxed, only if the salami is developed, it will be taxed.
