Or the market value of any gift will have to be developed. So that the recipient of the salami can spend it on the necessary sector according to his wishes. Because, a survey has shown that 98% of Eid gifts do not match the size. 

The meeting also decided that there should be no stinginess with salami this Eid. Everyone should show their generosity by giving more and more salami. To avoid trouble, group send money should be done and no money request for salami can be kept pending. No one becomes a celebrity by keeping salami requests pending. Moreover, a survey has shown that giving more and more salami also makes the elders feel good.

Headline_English: Colosseum built in Brahmanbaria modeled after Rome for long holidays
Content_English:
Brahmanbaria is already in the news all year round for its Tanta fights. Meanwhile, lakhs of Brahmanbarians are returning to Brahmanbaria to spend the Eid holidays. It is believed that since this year's holiday is long, the countrymen will see extreme Tanta fights due to various reasons besides land-related issues. This time, the local administration of Brahmanbaria has taken an innovative measure to make Tanta fights more attractive. The Colosseum has been built in Brahmanbaria just like the Colosseum of ancient Rome, where gladiators used to fight. Visitors can watch Tanta fights here in exchange for tickets. Besides, some can also resolve their problems by coming here. 

Regarding this matter, the president of the Colosseum Committee told us, 'It is very important to keep our tradition alive, we are just trying to do that. I want the fame of Tanta fights to spread in the country and abroad, I believe that the world will remember us the way the Colosseum of Rome remembers us. We have a plan to broadcast the Tanta fights here live. On the one hand, this will create a new generation of wrestling fans, and if people are interested, we will be able to export Tanta and play a role in the country's economy.' 

When we asked someone who was on vacation in Brahmanbaria about his feelings about the construction of the Colosseum, he burst into tears. After stopping his tears, he told us, 'I have been deprived and humiliated by my friends in Dhaka for this Tanta, but look, today we are going to get a separate ground for this fight. I demand from the Olympic Committee that this fight be included in the Olympics as soon as possible, and that our Colosseum be kept as a venue.

Headline_English: BUET students await Zafar Sir's sharbat therapy as their last hope
Content_English:
Abrar Fahad, a BUET student, was murdered in a BUET hall in 2019 due to torture by some Chhatra League leaders and activists. After this incident, organized student politics was banned in BUET. Recently, in the dark of night, the Chhatra League demanded to enter the BUET campus and bring back student politics at BUET. BUET students took a stand against this. In the wake of this incident, the High Court ruled in a ruling that student politics can be done at BUET. In the meantime, yesterday, BUET students wrote a letter to the Prime Minister to uphold the decision not to bring back student politics at BUET. 

After such a series of events for a few days, a question is swirling in the minds of people across the country, starting from BUET students, what will happen to BUET? Will student politics return again? 

In this situation, it has been learned from a completely fake source that BUET students are waiting for Zafar Sir's sharbat therapy as their last hope. Students believe that only Jafar Sir's sharbat can keep Chhatra League away from their position. 

Talking about the issue, a BUET student said from his fake ID, 'If you remember the SAST, you should know that a sharbat therapy by Jafar Sir saved Farid Sir. The protesting students withdrew from the movement after drinking Jafar Sir's magic sharbat. After that, Farid Sir is still in good health. Sir, if he tries a little, he can solve the BUET issue. If the sharbat made by him can somehow be fed to the leaders and activists of Chhatra League, then it will be a big deal.' 

The students said to Jafar Sir in a fake message, 'We are making sharbat if you need it, you come sir.'

Headline_English: Students want to hold classes on Eid as well
Content_English:
21st Ramadan is going on. Despite the excitement of shopping and salami all around, students of various schools, colleges and universities are still afraid of going to class. They have to take classes regularly. They have reached such a stage of fear that they want to take classes on Eid as well. They will keep their dreams and nightmares together and not send anyone home and sit on the class bench. 

A university student who did not want to be named said in this regard, ‘21 days of Ramadan are going on! We are still taking classes. If possible, we take classes on Fridays. The month of Ramadan does not feel like Ramadan at all, it feels like a month of extra classes scheduled throughout the year. Taking classes during Ramadan has become such a habit, now if we cannot take classes on Eid, it will not be good. We will feel sad! We want to take classes on Eid anyway.’ 

Teachers also said that they are unable to meet such demands from the students. One said, ‘We are also human, we also have habits. We have also made taking classes a habit. We are trying to take classes on Eid. If we cannot, we will arrange to take online classes. However, classes will be taken.

Headline_English: Harvard-Oxford Chhatra League wants student politics back at BUET
Content_English:
BUET is heated up over student politics. On one hand, there is the Chhatra League for entering the campus, and on the other hand, there is the general student community who do not want student politics on the campus. In the midst of all this, activities have started not only in the country but also abroad to bring student politics back to BUET. Leaders and activists of the Harvard and Oxford branches of the Chhatra League have demanded the return of politics to BUET through protest rallies and procession meetings. A sympathetic brother from the Harvard branch told us, 'The students at BUET no longer want to wear helmets. Do you know how important helmets are to avoid accidents? When we were there, everyone wore helmets. The general students do not understand themselves well, but the Chhatra League does. It is definitely important for the Chhatra League to return to the campus to make them practice wearing helmets regularly and to raise awareness.' 

On the other hand, a vice-president of the Oxford branch told us, 'How is it that a university does not have a guest room? Where will we entertain new students or outside guests when they come? As long as the Chhatra League was on the campus, there was no problem in welcoming anyone at BUET. Even if it is for the sake of restoring the guest room culture, we should stay with BUET Chhatra League. Like the brothers of Baddarhat College, we will also stay on the streets.' He then said, 'Buet Chhatra League is not afraid, we have not left the streets.' However, when they went to hold a procession at Cambridge University, the administration there dispersed the students by saying, 'Suddi brothers, don't study, and start playing politics again.'

Headline_English: Reasons why BUET needs organized student politics
Content_English:
Since the murder of BUET student Abrar Fahad by Chhatra League leaders and activists, organized student politics has been banned in BUET. A few days ago, Chhatra League central leaders and activists entered the BUET campus in the dark of night with outside political activists. BUET students called for a movement regarding this incident. This discussion has given rise to another discussion, is there really a need for organized student politics in BUET or not! eArchive has also considered the suitability of organized student politics in BUET. 
1# 

In a country where it is impossible to imagine a university without a guest room culture, how can one of the best universities in the country be without a guest room? To bring back this guest room culture rich in a thousand years of tradition, BUET definitely needs organized student politics. 



2# 

Without student politics, how can students get a hall? Dear guardians give them a hall. If there is no student politics, then even Adu brothers will not be able to occupy a seat. Again, no one else will be given a seat. In this populous country, the halls should not be left empty like this. Student politics is desperately needed, even if it is to immediately allocate a couple of VIP rooms to dear guardians, and a few public rooms among the rest. 



3# 

Without student politics, how will BUET students get their share of extortion and tenders! If only the party administration takes this share, a large section of students will be deprived. Students will not get money to buy bikes. As a result, they will not buy oil. The domestic economy will face a recession. The only way to escape this crisis is to bring back student politics in BUET. 



4# 

BUET is running peacefully and properly. How can a university in Bangladesh run like this? If there is no shouting from the guest room every night, then what kind of university is it? A university will have rags, public rooms, and abuse in the name of teaching manners—but it will not be a complete university. For these reasons, BUET needs a student policy. 
5# 

Here, students are doing labs, taking classes, chatting, discussing the country and economy with friends, concerts are being held, discussing art and literature—such a decline of a university cannot be accepted. But today, if there were student politics here, all the children of BUET could be taken to processions, and they could be taken to events where they would give flowers to their elder brother. Without student politics, all this is not possible. 

6# 

When did BUET come into discussion about Abrar Fahad, after that BUET is no longer in discussion. Every year, there is a need for an Abrar Fahad incident. For this reason alone, there is a need for organized student politics at BUET.

Headline_English: Premika> If you don't make a video for a song, you won't be an ideal lover.
Content_English:
Various qualities of an ideal lover. Lovers have no shortage of qualities. A lover is only ideal. However, now the song Premika> has come into the market to make lovers ideal. You can become an ideal lover by making a video on the song and uploading it to Facebook Reels, Stories, YouTube Shorts and TikTok. 

When we spoke to a sister who had already uploaded in this regard, she said, 'Nothing much. Take some of your beautiful or ugly pictures, write Premika> on them, and add a song behind them. The pictures will appear in a slide show one after another. You have to keep one thing in mind, the more platforms you upload, the more ideal you are. For example, upload them to YouTube, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok, WhatsApp, etc.' 

Everyone is up in arms to become an ideal lover. Through a fake information, it has been learned that Premika> himself is trying to protect himself from these lovers. He also claimed that if he had known earlier, he would not have brought himself into the market.

Headline_English: Toppers are packing books to read at home during the long Eid vacation
Content_English:
This Eid is a very long holiday. The intensity and permanence of this holiday is beyond words. The country's toppers are ready to make their Eid even more joyful and useful. They have already bought their books before Eid shopping. 

A topper said, 'I did Eid shopping. However, it is for my books. I will do mine later. I took a big bag first. Because I will take all the books of the semester. This is a very long holiday. I think it will be possible to finish the syllabus. If there is time at the end, I will also do a little revision. Along with the books of this semester, I have also taken two books of the next semester. It cannot be said, what will I do if there is no time at the end? I have become a topper by utilizing the holiday in this way. This time too, I will be like that, no one can stop me.' 

The backbencher society is falling under PR pressure due to such activities of toppers. In their society, various types of bitching are already born about toppers. This time it is also being expressed in anger and arrogance. It's impossible to predict when or how you'll do anything.

Headline_English: All Bengali Duck Society is organizing a prayer mahfil to bring Liton back to form
Content_English:
Lord Liton Das keeps calling one after another. Whether it is Test, T20 or ODI format, the Lord of Bengal has maintained the same consistency. Although the opposing team is happy with this, the Bengal duck community is in danger. They are afraid that if they call one call like this in every match, they will soon disappear. In order to save their existence, the entire Bengal duck community is organizing a prayer meeting to bring Liton back to form. 

In this regard, an elder of the duck community told us that when winter comes, it becomes a burden to survive your torture. On top of that, this Lord Liton is a new pain. At a time when we are trying to increase our numbers by breeding, he keeps calling regularly. If he calls like this every day, the sky is full of stars. We have only one demand from the creator, Lord Liton should be quickly returned to his form to save the duck community from this bad time. 

On the other hand, a section of the duck community is also praying for the form of Soumya Sarkar along with Liton. As an argument in favor of their prayers for Soumya's form, one duck told us that while Soumya in form is dangerous for the opponent, Soumya out of form is dangerous for us. Even our golden ducks are half-dead all year round due to the beauty of his performance.

Headline_English: NASA says lunar land will also be available in Nagad campaign
Content_English:
Nagad has surprised everyone with its Oscar-winning land campaign, and as part of its success, NASA is going to join Nagad this time. NASA has announced through a tweet from its fake Twitter account that if you participate in the Nagad campaign, you can also get land on the moon. 

When eArchy contacted the NASA spokesperson on an imo call from abroad to verify the truth of the matter and to know the details, he told us that the NASA team is very proud to be associated with Nagad. The people who win in such an innovative campaign are eligible to buy land not only on Earth but also on the moon and Mars. We have not yet reached Mars, so for now we have to limit ourselves to giving land on the moon. However, please pray that we can also give land on Mars in the future. 

Another NASA member told us from the spaceship, that as soon as we joined Nagad, we started preparing the plot on the moon. The negotiations with the local Sahamat brothers for protection money are also over. Now, if only you could design a great campaign with our Oscar-winning Cillian Murphy, we'd be in awe.

Headline_English: 600+ Buetians get chance at Notre Dame
Content_English:
The results of the Notre Dame admission test were released in a special message on Thursday night. Surprisingly, 687 out of 1,000 Damians who got a chance in the 2024 admission test are Buetians. This renowned institution has been hailed for such an unprecedented success. 

The first-place Notre Dameian (former Buetian) told a fictional media outlet, 'Since I got admitted to Buet, I have been dreaming of studying in Notre Dame. Whenever I heard of someone around me studying in Notre Dame, I took guidelines and inspiration from them. Besides, you will know that every year a large number of students from Buet get a chance in Notre Dame. I had regular contact with them....' 
A lot of research is being done on why so many students from Buet get a chance in Notre Dame every year. Some are even pointing the finger of question leakage at them. 

Eminent sociologist AK Chang said, 'Even if 200-300 students get a chance, it would be considered natural, but 676 is so unnatural...' 

In response to this, the headmaster of BUET has replied. He said, 'From the first year of entering BUET, we groom students for Notre Dame. Our students are also very hardworking, they listen to us. BUET achieves spectacular results every year because of their hard work, dedication and goodwill. And whatever the rest are saying, it is all out of jealousy. They showed that they got a chance at Notre Dame first...' 

Not only that, every year, numerous students from BUET get a chance even in the top batch of Udbhas. Other institutions also suffer from great insecurity due to this. However, leaving all the stories behind, the real story of a large number of students getting a chance at Notre Dame, Udbhas, is waiting for countless students who did not get the chance to be revealed.

Headline_English: Watermelon loans coming to banks, can also be purchased in EMI
Content_English:
Keeping in mind the skyrocketing price of watermelon, people-friendly watermelon loans are coming to domestic banks, and watermelon can even be purchased on EMI if desired. Anyone can buy watermelon with EMI facilities for a period of 6 to 24 months, although it may not seem credible at first, later an official of CD Bank told us, 'The incident is true, I have information. Some will eat it, some will not eat it, it will not happen, it will not happen. Eating watermelon for iftar is our fundamental right, it cannot be allowed that no one will get watermelon due to lack of money. You can easily get a watermelon loan just by showing documents, and anyone who earns more than 1 lakh taka can take EMI facilities if they want.' 

A buyer who bought watermelon on loan told us, 'It has been very beneficial. I have stopped eating lemons and dates for a long time, instead of dates, I am working by sucking date seeds, but watermelon seeds are very small, and there is no cash. I applaud the bank's decision, that's why I can eat two pieces of watermelon with my wife and children today..' However, we have also received news that some people are buying houses in Begumpara with loans for watermelons. When we tried to contact another bank official to verify the truth of the incident, it was learned that he himself had gone to Canada with a loan for watermelons to buy watermelons.

Headline_English: Date and watermelon prices are increasing to maintain compatibility with Europe, traders say
Content_English:
We already know that the roads in our country are similar to those in Europe. However, Bangladeshi date and watermelon traders have given a great explanation for the reason why the prices of goods also become similar to those in Europe during the month of Ramadan. They said that the prices of dates and watermelons are increasing mainly to maintain a complete European environment in the country and to keep in line with the European market. 

A watermelon trader told us on an imo call, first of all, we are grateful to the European hero Riaz Bhai. Due to his generosity, the country's roads have received the respect of Europe. If we sit on that road and sell watermelons at the country's price, it will be an insult to the brother. 

On the other hand, a trader selling dates in Bhori told us, if everything in the country is developing, what is wrong with our development? Are we not human beings because we are not government officials? Don't we want to send our children to study abroad, buy a house in Begumpara, and travel to Europe with our wives? You only get one month to turn on the green light for business, that's why you have so much headache

Headline_English: Zakir of Jigatla blocks his best friend for fear of his fasting becoming light
Content_English:
The month of Ramadan is underway. One of the biggest fears of this month is that fasting will become easy. Because of this fear, many people uninstall Instagram before the start of fasting. They stop running Telegram, Terrabox. They don't even look at Opera Mini. They also boycott TikTok. Zakir from Jigatla has also done these things. However, he blocked his best friend Rakib before everything else! 

When asked why he did it? When asked why he did it, he said, he is such a person that if you face him for a second once a day, your fasting will be broken! It will go like this, you can't bring it back even if you cry a thousand times. I have taken this step to keep myself in check, to keep my fasting in check. As soon as the month of Ramadan is over, I will unblock him again, and our friendship will run with the same enthusiasm as before. 

When asked how he feels about being blocked by Zakir, Rakib told us, what is my fault! If my words break the fast of a Sudanese person, then it is better not to speak to that Sudanese person. Am I talking to a bastard?

Headline_English: Employees want 70 months' salary during Ramadan
Content_English:
Today is the first day of the holy month of Ramadan. Despite being tired after fasting all day, employees are still at their workplaces. There is no significant change in their lives except fasting. However, the employee community has come up with a new demand this Ramadan. They have demanded 70 months' salary in this one month. 

In this regard, the president of Bangladesh Employees Society (BACSO) said, 'Such a demand is not unreasonable in this glorious month. We work hard all day and night, do good work. We deserve this 70 months' salary.' Fashion products When asked what the reason for such a demand was, no one agreed to open their mouths. The joint secretary of BACSO said, 'You have a conscience, you are educated people - you understand...' 

Since most of the institutions have rejected this demand, the Employees Council is thinking of a strike and a simultaneous work stoppage. However, there are also many institutions that have accepted their demand. Some institutions like IFLC Bank and Green Earth have so far agreed with them. When asked about the secret behind accepting such baseless demands, the MD of Green Earth said, 'Oh my god, keep the salary. I will pay you for 70 months, but on loan. Later, you will have to pay back the interest, and if you fail to pay, your property including the land will be confiscated. Hehehe...' 

However, the garment owners are talking differently about the matter. Hearing such demands, a garment owner laughingly said, 'Stop talking like this, workers, work hard. Don't let the machines stop. Let alone 70 months' salary, I won't even get this month's salary and bonus. I am going into hiding. See you later.'

Headline_English: Zayed fans want to see John Cena's Oscar costume on the Meryl-Prothom Alo stage
Content_English:
Recently, wrestler and Hollywood actor John Cena came into the limelight by coming to the Oscars stage in his birthday suit. In continuation of this, Zayed fans want Zayed Khan to perform in John Cena's costume on the Meril-Prothom Alo stage. Zayed fans have expressed their hope that Zayed Khan, who is regularly in trend, will not disappoint his fans. 

In this regard, a Zayed fan told us while giving a dig, "Blood in our veins, we are Zayed Khan fans. Guru has shown us many types of digs, so this time we want something different. I saw John Cena playing quite well in his birthday suit. Our guru is less important, we want him to show off in the same outfit.’ 

Although he doesn’t mind doing a digbazi, when asked if he would do a digbazi in John Cena’s outfit, Zayed Bro told us from his fake X account, ‘I can’t just be in the heat of girls, now if that’s what the fans want, then I’ll become Johnny Sins, not John Cena! But I’m not completely dismissing the matter, let’s think about it. In the context of Bangladesh, maybe you can’t come in a full birthday dress, but you can come wearing a Rolex watch.

Headline_English: Date snatching is increasing in Mohammadpur, not mobile, date lovers are worried
Content_English:
After the evening, Mohammadpur is a place of fear. Especially those who have expensive mobile phones, they try to avoid Mohammadpur unless they have a special need. However, a recent study has revealed eye-opening information. It is not mobile phones, but date snatching incidents that have increased in Mohammadpur. This is what has the date lovers shaken. 

The sky-high price of dates, meanwhile, they are quite worried about such snatching in Mohammadpur. One such date lover told us, 'I am buying and eating dates worth 400 taka for 1500 taka, if I have to live in fear of these expensive dates being snatched, then I have no profit or loss, my life is lost. If necessary, let them take mobile phones, but if they take dates during the month of Ramadan, the nightmare of breaking the fast with plums will come true.’ 

Regarding the reason for the increased greed of thieves for dates, a date researcher told us, ‘When you steal a mobile phone, there is often a fear of being caught, but there is no tension in dates. Because dates cannot be tracked. Besides, many people have started to stay in Mohammadpur instead of buying dates due to the high price of dates.’ 

To verify the truth of the matter, when our reporter tried to contact the president of the Mohammadpur ‘Bhai Atke Ashen Kotha Ache’ association by phone, he invited our reporter to Mohammadpur, but the reporter hung up the phone in fear.

Headline_English: Food Rangers, Mark Wiens and others are coming to Bangladesh to raise awareness at the call of Zarif and Roshan
Content_English:
World-renowned food blogger Food Ranger, Mark Wiens and others are coming to Bangladesh to make people aware of the fire incident at the call of Facebook celebrities Zarif and Roshan. They are mainly coming to make people aware of the fire. When we contacted the Food Ranger to find out about this, he cut off our reporter's call, but Mark Wiens called us on his secret number and first asked us 'kamon asa mama?' Then he said, 'I was actually blind for so long, Zarif and Roshan have opened my eyes. It is not just about food blogging, but informing people about fire safety is also part of our profession. Building owners spend so much money and work so hard to build a building, rent a restaurant in that building, buy MB with the rent money and watch our videos. If we cannot keep their buildings safe, we will not be forgiven in the afterlife. 

On the other hand, another international food blogger, who asked not to be named, told us, “With the tireless efforts of the administration, a new international standard neighborhood called Begumpara has been created in the world. How much more will these people do? Will they take care of it abroad or will they be left to create fire safety regulations in the country? We food bloggers will have to shoulder this responsibility.”

Headline_English: Mad Max movie sequel coming, shooting in Dhaka
Content_English:
It has been known for a long time that the sequel to the world-famous movie Mad Max is coming next year. However, the more surprising information is that the shooting of the next part will be in Dhaka. When we tried to contact its directors George Ogilvie and George Miller to verify the truth of the matter, they said on an emotional call from abroad, "The plan was to move forward with the work on the movie for a long time, but we could not start working because we did not get the environment we wanted. Finally, after many tests by our special-ignorant team, Dhaka was found to be suitable for the filming of this movie. Our team, who went to rehearse, also made quite satisfactory comments about the wind and dust of Dhaka. Along with this, I would like to thank your mayors, thanks to whom our post-production costs will be saved a lot, because in the previous parts we had to spend a lot on creating fake deserts or dust, but there is no problem with these in Dhaka. I hope to finish shooting the entire movie in Mirpur or Uttara Dhula. 

On the other hand, since the news of the shooting of Mad Max has been flowing in the hearts of the city residents, a flood of joy has been flowing. The Unconscious Citizens' Association has called on the mayors to cut down more trees in Dhaka and make the environment of Dhaka completely suitable for Mad Max. In this regard, the president of the Unconscious Citizens' Association told us, "Why only the next part, if necessary, we demand that all the parts of Mad Max be shot in Dhaka. Let the entire Dhaka be cleared of trees, Mad Max is much more effective than trees to reach the world court. Besides, it would be great if our mayor from the south was given a role in this movie."

Headline_English: GPS trackers come to save new writers from book fair
Content_English:
One of the pains of the book fair is the new writers, who are forced to put their books together. Due to this pain of new writers, many people refrain from going to the book fair. Earlier, they used to announce their location through Facebook status, but now these writers suddenly attack the readers. 

But don't worry, a new GPS tracker has come to save yourself from new writers. If you turn on this tracker and enter the book fair, you will be able to clearly see the locations of new writers! As a bonus, this tracker has a special Tipu Sultan feature that will start playing a red alert whenever Tipu Sultan comes within 10 yards of you. 

While explaining the effectiveness of the tracker, its inventor said, 'Last time I went to the book fair, I had a huge loss, an elder brother in the area started writing new books. He forced me to buy 3 copies of his book "Ami aur Amar Status Samagura". I even had to run away from the book fair to save my life after being chased by two new poets. I brought this tracker thinking of myself and my other readers. Now you can save lives and earn money.

Headline_English: Demand to hold Shakib-Tamim match at neutral venue Brahmanbaria
Content_English:
The Shakib-Tamim match in the BPL means a new excitement beyond cricket. Everyone from the fans to the spectators are in fear, when these two cricketers start fighting on the field. Who will come to stop them then? Considering various aspects, cricket fans have demanded that Shakib and Tamim be held at a neutral venue in the BPL. And they want Brahmanbaria as that neutral venue. 

Supporting their demand, a fan said, 'If the game is played in Brahmanbaria, not only Shakib-Tamim, but millions of fans of these two cricketers will be able to participate in this duel.' 

Many have also mentioned that the fields in Mirpur or Chittagong are small for the duel of these two cricketers. One such person said, 'If one lakh people follow Shakib and one lakh follow Tamim to play, can your Mirpur accommodate so many people? It cannot. And if you look at our Brahmanbaria fields, you will notice why 2 lakh here? There is no problem even if 400,000 people come. 

A Tamim fan and a Shakib fan living in Brahmanbaria have assured that there will be no violence even though the stadium is big. They both told journalists and spectators, "Don't worry. We have no place for any violence in Brahmanbaria." 

When shown some batons and spears, the two said, "These are for catching fish."

Headline_English: Reptiles line up to get admitted to North-South
Content_English:
Reptiles have suddenly lined up to get admitted to North South University. Reptiles from all over Bangladesh are preparing to join the university's spring semester. When trying to uncover the reason for this, it is known that even the forests and jungles of this country are not as smooth and safe as the floor of the North South campus compound. Although the reptile species has not been able to move forward towards studies due to lack of security for so long, today North South University has opened their eyes. Very soon, reptiles will also compete with Homo sapiens by studying and gaining knowledge. 

However, when asked how the reptile species came to have such a belief about the safety of North South, a representative of the reptile species, the cobra snake, said, 'Recently, in the flash mob video of North South, I saw a person walking crookedly among numerous dancing people! If people can cross such a road safely, who will stop us?’ Another cobra is heard saying, ‘Whenever a human being turns nineteen or twenty, I see them and abuse them by their names. If I get a chance to study, I will show them a real snake specimen.’ 

As of last news, it is known that even though the reptiles have lined up, the NSU authorities have refused to give them admission to the university. However, everyone has doubts about whether it is possible to stop this inspired reptile species.

Headline_English: Dhaka's skies have become heavy as Pahela Falgun and Valentine's Day fall at the same time
Content_English:
This year, Valentine's Day and Pahela Falgun both fell on the same day, i.e. February 14. As a result, the bleeding in the hearts of singles who were already stressed has increased several times. Singles have started crying in droves as two couple-oriented days fall on the same day. The sky in Dhaka has become heavy with this crying. 

Regarding this matter, the head of the Department of Love Diseases at Shahbagh University told us, 'On special days, the heartbeat of singles increases several times. Many people also suffer from allergy problems. However, what happens more is that they have tears flowing from their eyes, a symptom we also call 'Bapparaj Syndrome'. This time, since the two days have come together, Bapparaj Syndrome has almost reached the second stage for all singles. As a result, the sky in Dhaka has started to become heavy.' 

A single told us to express his feelings, everything is our curse, do you understand? It's not like someone will fall in love one after another and we won't get a single love. Now the sky is just heavy, after a few days you will see that the sky has also collapsed. 
So the brother started crying like a father and brother.

Headline_English: Mahfuzur Rahman sang at Coldplay concert
Content_English:
A two-day Coldplay concert was held in Thailand. Many Coldplay fans from Bangladesh attended the concert. Meanwhile, a video obtained by eArchie shows Bangladeshi musician Mahfuzur Rahman shaking the stage at a Coldplay concert. The Coldplay crew fell off the stage twice due to the shaking of the stage. 

Coldplay, unable to find a way out, let Mahfuzur Rahman off the stage. Mahfuzur Rahman left the stage after singing his song 'Beiman' 5 times. 

All the members of Coldplay, who were in the audience, were thrilled to hear Mahfuzur Rahman's song. Some were even seen headbanging. 

The members of Coldplay expressed their admiration for Mahfuzur Rahman's song. They also said that they would like to share the stage with Mahfuzur Rahman if they come to Bangladesh in the future. They only requested Mahfuzur Rahman not to shake the stage too much.

Headline_English: Demand for traffic police on sidewalks for bikers
Content_English:
Traffic police are stationed at various intersections of roads, three roads, four roads, and even at the ends of many single roads. Along with the traffic police, there are signals on the road, which we can see when vehicles from which direction will go and which ones will stand still and look at the sky. However, now the general public has raised another demand! Along with the road, they want traffic police on the sidewalks as well! However, not for themselves, but for bikers. 

When we talked about this, it was learned through one of them, ‘Bikes no longer run on the road, so what is the use of traffic police on the road? Bikes run on the sidewalk. As soon as there is a little jam on the road, as soon as you give a little signal, all the bikers come to the sidewalk! Then there is a jam on people and bikes. In order to avoid this jam of people and bikes, traffic on the sidewalk will be needed.’ 

Regarding bringing traffic to the sidewalk, a biker said, ‘It can be brought. It will also be beneficial for us, in fact, we will understand which side to get on and which side to get off. Now it happens that we get on right but when we get off, we see that there is no space! Then we have to get off the bike and hold it. But it would be best if a separate sidewalk could be made for riding bikes. Then when there was a jam or signal, we rode bikes on the sidewalk and people walked on other people's sidewalks!

Headline_English: JU bans exotic birds
Content_English:
The JU administration has banned foreign guest birds from the campus to prevent rape. They took this extraordinary decision after the recent rape incident. This has been confirmed by eArchi from a completely unreliable source. 

The university administration said from one of its fake IDs, ‘Rape occurs on campus because of guest birds. If there were no guest birds on our safe campus, we would not have seen such incidents like last Saturday.’ 

Explaining the matter, a proctor of the university said from his fake ID, ‘Campus students cannot control themselves after seeing guest birds. They lose their sense of self. Then there is nothing else to do. Many, unable to control themselves after seeing guest birds, even help the rapist escape. We do not want such degradation of the campus. That is why we had no other option but to ban guest birds.’ 

Meanwhile, another organization has demanded a ban on everything foreign, including snakes, butterflies, dogs, and other animals, on campus. 

Meanwhile, the university's VC is claiming from another fake ID, 'This kind of incident happens because of the trees on the campus. If there were no trees, if there were no forest, they wouldn't have had so much privacy. Such an incident wouldn't have happened. So first of all, all the trees on the campus should be cut down and the campus should be made safe.' 

On the other hand, protesting Trump's statement, a top BNP leader said, 'Why only the Jatiya Party, take us too. If necessary, we will boycott the elections in advance and give them a chance to play on an empty field, but still take us.'

Headline_English: Nazrul opens a bread stall at the book fair
Content_English:
The Amar Ekushey Book Fair is starting tomorrow. Every year, readers, writers, and publishers are excited about the book fair in a different way. It's like a completely different world. Not only books are seen at the book fair, but also fast food, coffee, and tea stalls. Those stalls exude the scent of urban modernity and elegance. However, a 17-year-old young man named Nazrul Kazi has made quite a splash at this year's book fair with a simple bread shop. 

Even though he makes bread full-time, he keeps humming and weaving melodies, and can instantly make up songs and jingles. Some say this young man is the doppelganger of national poet Kazi Nazrul. His strong body, shaggy hair on his head, cup-like eyes, and heavy voice that sounds like semen remind him of Kazi Nazrul. He is always humming and singing while rolling bread, and the premises of the book fair are filled with his loud laughter and chatter. Not only that, but he has also formed a leto song group with the workers of various stalls. The surprises do not end here. Nazrul Kazi's nickname is also Sukhu Mia. Although the two words Dukhu-Sukhu are close, what a huge difference in meaning! Sukhu is the bigger attraction in 'Sukhu Mia's bread shop' than bread. 

While passing in front of the shop, his melodious voice can be heard, singing 'Pelen roti bish, tandur chalish, nan matar sate, tsebbihi gona habho moran khate....' 

Is that all? He is also flirting with girls. He has been nicknamed 'Book Fair's Rezlord' for writing instant songs with a ponytail. 

It is known about Sukhu's personal life that although he was born in a Muslim family, he is currently in a situational relationship with a Hindu girl and in a relationship with another. He did not agree to reveal more. Even during the interview, several journalists were annoyed by Nazrul's camera-averse nature. 

In response to numerous questions, Sukhu Mia simply said, 'I got roti for twenty, tandoor for forty, naan for only sixty...' 

Meanwhile, another news report has revealed that the bread shopkeeper at the book fair is actually the real Nazrul. He opened the bread shop because the book fair was not selling books like before. Rabindranath Tagore is thinking of opening a rice hotel called 'Thakurbari Hensel' at the book fair after seeing Nazrul. Humayun Ahmed is also thinking of opening a Rang Cha shop so as not to compete with Sadat Hossain.

Headline_English: There is a growing trend among engineering students to become psychologists.
Content_English:
Examples of switching subjects have been around for a long time. Doctors become bureaucrats, BBA graduates become police officers, some even leave the army and become businessmen. However, this number is 1 in 20. But recently, a radical change has suddenly come about among the country's engineering students. They are all leaning towards becoming psychologists. Although extensive research has been done on why everyone is suddenly leaning towards this particular profession, no specific data has been available. 

Class teachers said that recently no one comes to lab classes, does not pay attention to classes. Everyone secretly reads psychology books under their own subject. This calculation is becoming very difficult to reconcile. 

Meanwhile, it is also known that many people who have passed out from private engineering universities are playing a role in society as psychologists. I met one such engineer-cum-psychologist at Lifesama Hospital. 

This psychologist named Hiaya Anim said, 'I have wanted to be a psychologist since childhood. Despite studying engineering due to the pressure of home, I studied psychology in between, took free courses online, watched videos on YouTube. Now I am a successful YouTuber as well as a psychologist. However, this journey was not so easy. Basically, after having two children, my complexities started to decrease and the chamber became full. Whenever life starts to feel difficult, I will have one or two children...' 

Thousands of young people are inspired by this statement of Anim. However, the engineering universities of the country, including BUET, are one step ahead of them. It is heard that soon, along with engineering, a new subject, psychology, will be added to the universities.

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan got angry after seeing his opponent on the field
Content_English:
Shakib Al Hasan took to the field for Rangpur in his first match in the BPL today. The opponent was Tamim's Barisal. But Shakib Al Hasan left the field angrily as soon as he entered the field. This is what eArchi has learned from a completely unreliable source. 

Shakib Al Hasan's hangover after winning the election without an opponent just a few days ago has not yet passed. He thought that it is possible to win on the cricket field without an opponent. Shakib got angry and left after seeing the situation not matching his thoughts. 

Shakib said about the matter from his fake ID, 'What kind of game is this? Where there is an opponent! I played a few days ago, but there was no opponent! These days, whenever I see an opponent, my mood gets bad, I want to hold him and give him a little affection.' 

Shakib Al Hasan expressed his anger at the BCB, saying, 'Papan Bhai himself knows all this. He himself won the election a few days ago. Then how can he think of having an opponent in my match!’ 

Shakib Al Hasan also said that he wanted to leave the field and give a message to Papon. He said, ‘If I were the president, there would be no opponent. I would only have three opponents in Tamim’s match. Hahaha.

Headline_English: Winter lovers are going into hiding.
Content_English:
Winter lovers have been going into hiding since the onset of winter. They said that they are mainly victims of social bullying and are no longer able to move around in public. 

After going to the field and researching the matter, it was found that since the onset of winter, summer lovers have been harassing winter lovers in various ways. There have also been reports that some are snatching winter lovers' winter clothes. 

When asked to talk about the matter, a winter lover said, "I am in great danger, brother. I introduced myself as a winter lover. Then my cousin, summer lover, came and took all my winter clothes. While leaving, he said, 'You are a winter lover, winter comes for you. Why should we suffer in that winter? Bear the suffering yourself for the one you love.' 

After this incident, this winter lover said that he bought another set of winter clothes and went to a cave. 

Many people are also boycotting these winter lovers socially. Some people go a step further and say that they are a burden on society. One such person says, "Bones never become flesh, winter lovers never become friends."

Headline_English: I have requested FIFA to give Messi the FIFA The Best Award: AK Abdul Momen
Content_English:
Lionel Messi wins FIFA The Best Award again. The award was announced last night after a heated battle with Holland. 

But a fake message received by eArchie reveals that AK Abdul Momen has requested FIFA to give Messi the FIFA The Best Award. In his message, Momen said, 'What I told FIFA is that Messi must be retained. Many have said that Messi is our ideal. If Messi is retained, football will move towards development. Football will become truly non-sectarian. That is why I have requested FIFA to retain Messi and give him the FIFA The Best Award.' 

Football analysts believe that the FIFA The Best Award went to Messi because of AK Abdul Momen's request. One such person said, ‘The world has seen how effective Abdul Momen Bhai’s requests are twice in January 2024. He is not a human being, he is a whole assembly of requests.’ 

When asked about Abdul Momen’s back-to-back success, Atahar Ali Khan said, ‘Back-to-back success from Momen Bhai. You are proud of it.

Headline_English: Many people cannot see their future due to dense fog
Content_English:
Thick fog all around. Cold wave is going on in some places. People are losing their normal life, their work life is being disrupted. In the meantime, survival. However, the problem is in other places. It has been learned in a secret on-site visit that in this fog, along with other problems, many young people cannot see their future. And the number of young people is gradually increasing at an alarming rate. 

A young man named Razzak said, 'I am in a lot of trouble. I was admitted to admission coaching to study in BUET. I also got a chance in a top batch. Now, in the fog, I can't see what lies ahead, how can I see the future! The pain of my dreams of so many years being shattered will never subside...' 

Not only the future, in this heavy fog, people are forgetting the way to their homes and appearing in other places. A gentleman named Tashbir (35) has been accused of entering someone else's house thinking it was his own and hugging someone else's wife thinking it was his wife. After giving egg therapy on remand, he said, 'Brother, you don't see anything, you don't understand anything. What's my fault?' Such complaints are being heard not only in the name of Tashbir, but also in the name of many others like her. However, the surprising thing is that children aged five to seven, unable to recognize their parents in this fog, have even been heard calling other couples their parents!

Headline_English: Shakib-Mashrafi want an unopposed playing field like the election field
Content_English:
Shakib Al Hasan and Mashrafe Bin Mortaza have seen their best career success in the field of unopposed elections. In addition to double centuries in the 12th National Parliament elections, each of them has achieved the equivalent of 20 wickets in one-day matches. These two Bangladeshi cricketers want to maintain such success in the field of elections on the field of play. They also want to satisfy the country's World Cup drought by playing unopposed. 

Talking about the matter, Shakib Al Hasan said from his fake ID, 'We have always wondered why we could not win an international trophy even after playing cricket for so many years. We have done a lot of analysis, postmortems. But we could not find any reason. Finally, we found the boat, we found the reason. Basically, success was not in our hands because there were opponents on the field. That is why we thought that we want to bring the World Cup home this time by making the field of play unopposed. If we get a World Cup like this, Shishir and Or will be able to give the status of the best success in our lives.' 

Mashrafe also spoke about the matter. Mashrafe said from his fake ID, "I've known how to win the World Cup since 2018. I was telling him, but he didn't believe me. He wanted to test it with his own hands. He did that. He won. This time, we will win the World Cup day by day, God willing."

Headline_English: Candidates who lost the 12th election want a Bangladeshi version of 12th fail
Content_English:
The candidates who lost the 12th national election want a Bangladeshi version of the currently discussed movie 12th fail. Almost all the losing candidates from the boat, plough and independent parties have agreed with this demand. However, when asked whether the background of 12th fail is similar to the election, a losing boatman told us, 'Failure is failure, be it in the exam or the election, and if I lost in the 12th election, I don't want 12th fail, so why do I want an honorable fail? You talk strangely.' 

It is also known that Vidhu Vinod Chopra has already started working on the script of the Bangladeshi version. From his fake Twitter account, he said, 'If I had known earlier, I would have made the Bangladeshi version and released it first, the struggle of the Awami League opponents in the Bangladesh election is much greater than that of my film Manoj. I couldn't control myself and cried with emotion after reading the election stories. I hope to be able to release the movie by the end of this year.’ 

On the other hand, regarding the Bangladeshi version, a candidate from Langol said, ‘I believe the story of this movie will beat the original 12th fail. Especially the struggle of the Jatiya Party candidates is bound to grab everyone’s attention. The movie will also have some glimpses of the story of our party’s poster boy Milon becoming the poster boy.’

Headline_English: Autobiography of a dead voter
Content_English:
I died on June 10, 2011, at 3:46 PM. The sky was dark, and it seemed like it was going to rain. 

Until the moment I died, I wasn't sure if I was really going to die or not. I was very scared. 

After death, I saw a situation like John Lennon imagined. Here we eat, sleep, and chill. There is no discrimination between anyone. There is no reason to be afraid. We are free from the hassle of job hunting, money pressure, and daily shopping. However, there are problems here too. The most important problem is that we have no entertainment system here. We have mobile phones, but no WiFi. Elections bring a treasure trove of joy to our joyless life every 5 years. A few months before the elections, there is a festive atmosphere here. Who will vote for whom, who is a worthy candidate, and all this creates a storm in the teacup. Although at the end of the day, votes are not cast according to our opinion — still, where is the lack of voting? 

If someone wants to die for the sake of voting, it is important to know that even dead people can vote if they want to. There is serialization here too, there is lobbying. Seniority has to be maintained. For example, famous people like Zahir Raihan, Syed Waliullah, Humayun Ahmed, Kazi Nazrul and others vote in every election. Even if we, the people like us, vote like whales, we do not get that opportunity. Everything will be according to serialization. I am supposed to vote in this election. Those who died in the 2010-14 session will vote in this election. Those who died between 2015-19 will vote in the next election. There is a discipline in everything, we do not break that discipline. 

I was hoping to vote last time too, since I could not vote while I was alive! But I could not. When I went to the polling station, I heard that my vote had been cast. I screamed and shouted. Who will vote for dead people again? Later I found out that our friend Selim Reza was doing this. He has never seen an election in his life. He voted double for the service in excitement. I have forgiven him. 

The day before the election is Eid for us. By midnight, everyone is pretty much ready. Everyone takes a hot water and body shower and washes their bodies. Then, wrapped in fragrant, white sheets, they set off for the center. On the way, they meet many family members. Because they also know that people come to vote in the dead. If only they could meet! In this hope, they roam around the center all night before the election. We stand in line. We seal the ballots with utmost secrecy. Even though we maintain secrecy, we know who everyone is voting for. 

The election is here again. The atmosphere of celebration is all around us. On the night of the 7th, we will descend to the earth, cross the wet grass and affix the seal to the ballot with trembling hands, the eulogy for the next five years will be written...

Headline_English: People eat too much radish, air pollution is bound to occur! What's our fault?
Content_English:
Recently, the daily newspaper reported that people in Dhaka were able to breathe clean air for only 8 days in 2023. The mayors of Dhaka, which has pretty much taken the top spot in air pollution, were contacted to find out how they were monitoring the incident. Although they were not willing to talk in real life, they shared some of their opinions on the matter in a fictional interview. Let's find out. 
Reporter: Brother, why are you wearing a mask? 

Mayor of the South: Don't you understand math? Eat dudu? If you play too much, I will drown you in the Buriganga. 

Reporter: Hey brother, why are you getting angry? I understand that there is air pollution. But what's the point of wearing a mask? Look at us, we are spending our days in this city. But your beautification project is wonderful. 
Mayor of the South: Hey, that's a good point. Sometimes people in the city feel like girlfriends. They just get angry at everything we do. What do you think of such a big forest in a city? Now look at what a beautiful flower garden Dhaka South looks like. 


Reporter: That's true, but if you had said something about your plan to reduce air pollution. 

Mayor of the North (getting a little heated): What's wrong with the plan? People in this city eat a lot of radishes, air pollution will definitely occur! What's our fault? If people don't stop eating radishes, air pollution will not be reduced in any way. 



Reporter: So you're saying it's all radishes' fault? Cutting down trees, filling up rivers, unfit vehicles or industrial plants in the middle of the city are not problems? 

Mayor of the North: Are you itching to die, why are you talking so much? Then he controlled himself a little and said, No comments. 



Reporter: You guys get angry all of a sudden, how is it possible to run a city like this? You have to be accountable to the people, right? 

South Mayor: Why do we need to be accountable? WTF bro. If anyone wants an answer, they should be thrown into the Buriganga, the vote will be at night and the talk will be on the hands. 



Saying this, the South Mayor started rolling up his shirt sleeves and our reporter ran away in fear.

Headline_English: English medium students want English versions of quarter to one and a half to one
Content_English:
On the clock, 45 means quarter and 15 means half. Many people know this calculation, but many people get it wrong. A false survey heard by the people says that English medium students get the most wrong. They have now demanded the English version of quarter and half with the help of the head of that survey. 

One such English medium student told us, ‘We don’t understand these timings. We already say time in English, but even if someone tells us 1 o’clock, 2 o’clock, etc., we don’t understand them at all. But, we haven’t read about quarter and half anywhere. We have to bring the English version of these at the list for us.’ 

On the other hand, Farazi told us, ‘I took a six-month course with a BUET brother to understand these. Still, I don’t understand. Now I’m thinking of asking a DU brother to come to my house to teach me these classes along with the BUET brother.’

Headline_English: Michael Jackson, Don Bradman, Pele and Maradona are coming to Bangladesh on the 7th
Content_English:
Famous people like Michael Jackson, Don Bradman, Pele and Maradona are coming to Bangladesh on the 7th. Like Charlie Puth, when we contacted each grave to verify whether the news of their arrival was fake or not, they said that they were really coming. 

But why are they all coming on the 7th? When asked about this, Maradona went ahead and told us, 'I have played a lot of football at night, but I have never gone to the center at night. I am not talking about the voting center, I am talking about the vaccination center. I heard that even dead people can go to the center in your country. I want to use this opportunity. I will meet the Argentina fans on the 7th. The game will be played, bro.' Saying this, he showed the V sign and entered the grave again. 

On the other hand, Michael Jackson said that in addition to going to the center, he is also coming to perform on the boat song "Joy Bangla". Jackson Bhai also said, "I have sung many songs in my life, but I have never seen people vibe like this in any of my own songs, the way people are doing in this song. My life is full of death and now I have only one dream, after winning the boat, I want to perform on the intersection of Vijay Sarani with this song. I also visited the vaccination center at night. Chariots were also sold, bananas were also seen." 

Jackson Bhai did not elaborate as he was chilling on the occasion of the Thirty-First.

Headline_English: Bangladesh's millionaires are becoming poorer by standing for election
Content_English:
Kazi Nazrul Islam said - In the morning, you are a king, in the evening, you are a fakir. With the advent of the electoral system in Bangladesh, this song has become something like - After the vote, you are a king, and the beginning of the fakir. 

Many politicians are suddenly turning from millionaires to street fakirs after standing in the election. Pictures of these helpless, poor candidates are circulating on social media in Bangladesh. 

Shakib Al Hasan and Mashrafe Bin Mortaza, who came to the election field from cricket, are living an inhuman life. 

In an interview on a national television, former Bangladesh cricket captain, former brand ambassador of e-Orange and current member of parliament Mashrafe Bin Mortaza was seen giving an interview in a lungi and sandals. No humane person will be able to hold back tears after seeing that picture. 

Shakib Al Hasan is one of the poster boys of Bangladesh cricket. In addition to playing cricket in the country, he plays cricket in various international leagues. He has several businesses of his own. He has proven himself in the stock market, in showroom inaugurations, advertisements - if he is present in various things, he is seen as a helpless fakir before the elections. This cricketer has been seen eating pitha like farmers, eating rice on banana leaves due to lack of plates, and even shaking hands with a cobbler. 

Ferdous Ahmed, a once popular film actor, has been seen sitting helplessly in a non-AC salon in his neighborhood. Many other such candidates have been seen living in poverty. 

Regarding this issue, economic expert Abdul Jabbar said from one of his fake IDs, 'If you want to go from a millionaire to a hundred crore in life, you have to be a little poor. This is electoral economics.'

Headline_English: The remains of the children Tarin, Ferdous, and Riaz were found in the country.
Content_English:
Recently, oil mines were found in the Sylhet region of the country. Amid the news of this new oil mine, it was learned that young people like Tarin, Ferdous, and Riaz have been found in the country. Most of them are influencers, some are doing motivational speaking, and some are involved in food blogging. But everyone is united in one thing, and that is putting oil on the head. It is believed that in the coming days, Enara will be able to enter the field as worthy successors to Ferdous and Riaz. In addition to producing oil on the highway, some of them may also discover the theory of American roads like European roads. Some have even expressed their desire to stand as candidates in the next election. 

One of them, who is a motivational speaker and currently a resident of a road in Western Europe, told us, "The country is moving forward. And there is no alternative to developing the oil industry to move any country forward. We are trying to do that by following the path of Riaz brothers. I hope our country will soon become an oil mine. 

On the other hand, congratulating the little ones Tarin, Ferdous, and Riaz, a European actor tagged the location of Europe on his Fake X account and tweeted, "As long as there is no end to oil business, Bangladesh will never lose its way."

Headline_English: Imprisoned opposition leaders receive eggs and khichuri in prison on Human Rights Day
Content_English:
The Ugandan government has arranged eggs and khichuri for opposition leaders and activists imprisoned in Uganda's prisons on the occasion of World Human Rights Day. The program began with a welcome speech by the Prime Minister of Uganda. 

It is learned that in view of the day, along with improved diets, new clothes have been gifted to the imprisoned leaders and activists. The Prime Minister of the country has also personally fed some lucky political prisoners, along with personally dressing them. 

To keep the country's democracy alive, dummy elections have also been arranged in prisons on Human Rights Day. There, leaders of the government party have been kept in prison for a day to fight the elections with the leaders of the opposition. 

In his speech, the Prime Minister of the country said, 'We know that rice and clothes do not satisfy your heart. You want to vote a little. That is why we have also arranged for you to vote. You will come, vote, then you will lose. You will go to jail again. You will eat, sleep. We will meet again on Human Rights Day next year.' 

This initiative of Uganda has also been praised by the world. The Prime Minister of Uganda also received a special honor from an organization called Qatisangha, the 'Father of Human Rights', for organizing such an extraordinary event on the day.

Headline_English: Night-time wake-up courses are being launched ahead of the elections
Content_English:
A night-wake course is going to be launched for those who want to vote at night in the elections. The number of night voters in the elections has increased considerably in the last few rounds. Due to which the tendency of voting at night is also increasing among the general voters. However, even if they want to, many are not able to vote at night due to the lack of habit of staying up late. The 'night-wake course' is coming keeping in mind the wishes and needs of such people. 

The organizer of the course, a resident of the southernmost grave of Azimpur graveyard, told us, 'Someone will give and no one will give, it cannot be allowed to happen! We have gradually started to reap the fruits of our efforts and hard work. Now the general public also wants to vote at night like us. In our course, we have brought some ninja techniques to remove night drowsiness, as well as how to vote quickly before anyone notices. I hope that once you do this course, you will never like voting during the day again.' 

On the other hand, it is known that the first three batches were completely booked as soon as the course was launched. One person who was not able to get a seat and wanted to take the course told us, "I was able to vote once in my life after I became old. I had to spend my whole life just listening to 'you're welcome'. I thought that if I could take this course, I would be able to vote at night, if not during the day, at least by learning the techniques of staying awake at night, but even that hope was dashed."

Headline_English: Voters' intense movement to nominate Riaz for Chittagong seat
Content_English:
The list of Awami League nominees was announced yesterday. Although there are many candidates for the upcoming elections, there has been anger among the general voters for not nominating film actor Riaz from Chittagong. Many are seen breaking down in disappointment as they did not get this hero, who selflessly loved the streets of Chittagong, as a candidate in any of their seats. 

When we spoke to one such voter, he told us, 'No one has given us the respect like Riaz Bhai, even when I walk the streets of Chittagong, I no longer feel like I am in the country, I feel like I am in Europe. I cannot imagine anyone other than Riaz Bhai as a candidate in the Chittagong seat. I thought that if Riaz Bhai becomes the MP here, he will not only make the roads, houses, cars and even the people look like Europe. But we are in trouble.' 

On the other hand, the Chittagong Raat Voters' Association is forming a human chain demanding Riaz as an MP in their seat. The vice-president of the night voters' association told us from a local graveyard, "Riyaz Bhai has no alternative to making Chittagong a modern Europe. We are ready to help him win. All we have to do is ask him to give us the nomination."

Headline_English: No one is standing against Shakib in Magura 1 seat for fear of being timed out
Content_English:
In the upcoming elections, Shakib Al Hasan, the boatman from Magura 1 constituency, will contest for the MP post from there. Amidst the discussion and criticism about Shakib Al Hasan's nomination, new news has come that after his timed out incident with Angela Mathews in the World Cup, no one dares to stand against Shakib in Magura 1 constituency. Not to mention BNP, no one was found as an independent candidate there. 

When we inquired about the reason, a local opposition leader told us, 'It is the voters at night who end the game, and now another pain is 'unrepentant Sakep'. After seeing Mathews' condition, our bodies are already shaking with fear, we will see that we have been timed out from the area before we can stand in the election.' 

On the other hand, another leader who has already left the area told us, 'I am already timed out due to the attack case, Shakib bhai will not have to suffer anything else. "However, despite being a BNP supporter in the helmet incident, I supported him, and now I see Shakib bhai himself wearing a helmet and standing against us, it is sad."

Headline_English: Bengali mother society wants GPA-5 in universities
Content_English:
PSC, JSC, SSC, HSC, all have the GPA-5 system. Not only in the university. After getting into the university, no one gets GPA-5. Everyone gets CGPA 4 out of 4. But, even though this trend continues, this time the Bengali mother society wants a change in this trend. 

One such Bengali mother told us, 'My son has been getting GPA-5 since childhood. We are used to seeing GPA-5. After getting into the university, the son no longer gets GPA-5. I don't understand what CG TG gets. You can't get above point 4, but I always get GPA-5. We don't need to worry about things that we don't understand. All you have to do is give up all these CGs and TGs and make them all GPA-5.' 

Another Bengali mother sent a message expressing her sorrow, saying, 'Yesterday the HSC results were announced, all the sisters-in-law are happy, their son has GPA-5. I couldn't say it even once! But I have three sons! If this continues, my name will be removed from the sisters' chat lists.'

Headline_English: Himalayan saints are coming to get admission in North South University
Content_English:
North South University is in the news all year round for various reasons. Recently, this holy university is in the news again for a strange reason. It is known that saints from the Himalayas are coming to study in this holy university. 

These saints have expressed their interest in studying in this university mainly because they are fascinated by the holiness of North South. Some say that this university is holier than a cave. 

Even cavemen from the cave age have spoken about North South University. Although the students of this university are modern in terms of clothing and language, they are still fascinated by this fact that they are still in that primitive era. 

A caveman said about the matter, 'They have not forgotten their roots. They have become modern, but because of our love, they are still in the cave in their thoughts and ideas. We have not seen any other university in the modern world lag behind so much.' 

It is known from another secret source that Islamic devotees like Mufti Ibrahim and Tarek Monowar have also expressed their interest in getting admitted to this university.

Headline_English: Electric tents are coming to the market
Content_English:
A power generation plant is going to be set up in Brahmanbaria Municipality to generate electricity from waste. This new plant is going to open new horizons in Brahmanbaria's traditional baton industry. Several companies are going to bring electric batons to the market, and there has been a lot of excitement among the people of Brahmanbaria to charge their batons with electricity generated in their own area and go to war with them. The owner of a company working with electric batons told us, "Everything needs to change to keep up with the times. Ordinary batons cannot be used for long, and they do not always give good results. Since our company's batons are equipped with sophisticated sensors, they will hit the target exactly. Besides, at least three-four fights can be fought on a single charge. I hope that the name of Brahmanbaria residents will be written in gold letters as digital gladiators in the world after this Tanta comes to the market.’ 

On the other hand, a Tanta fighter is seen in a very excited state. He told us, ‘I have been unable to sleep since hearing about the electric Tanta! There is a possibility of a Ganjam with the neighboring village next week, if we get an electric Tanta in our hands before then, we will play.’ However, it is known that in the initial stage, this Tanta will not be sold to anyone other than the people of Brahmanbaria. If it is commercially successful, the entrepreneurs have plans to sell it to the people of other districts as well.

Headline_English: Fans want to see Morsalin in the Brazil team
Content_English:
Bangladesh cricket team player Morsalin. He seems to single-handedly bring forward every match that he falls behind. This extraordinary forward player has also brought back a match that Bangladesh was losing yesterday. He drew 1-1. Because of his extraordinary game, the fans are now asking him for the Brazil team. We went to Neymar to find out whether Morsalin will go to the Brazil team or not. 

Neymar told us, 'I want Morsalin brother to play in our team. What a great game he plays! Did you see yesterday's goal? That is my dream goal. I have not been able to score in my career so far. I am sure that my dream of scoring a goal will also be successful with Morsalin brother. Now I just want to bring him to the team!' 

Morsalin did not want to tell us anything about whether he is willing to join the team or not. However, it has been learned through a secret source that the irony CR7 style that Morsalin shows after the goal is actually his style. Ronaldo has copied it for ages.

Headline_English: Pat Cummins is becoming BNP's coach to teach the committee team how to defeat them.
Content_English:
Despite being an ICC committee team, India lost to Australia in yesterday's final. This has caused a stir in the cricket world as well as in the domestic political circles. BNP in particular is very excited about the matter, and it is said that they have even signed Pat Cummins as their coach with the aim of winning the upcoming elections. 

When we contacted BNP's fake leader Mirza Ghalib to confirm the truth of the matter, he told us, 'We were not that optimistic about winning the elections until now. Due to the pressure of the government, the hockey stick house of the Sammat brothers and the fear of the night voters, we assumed that the game would not be played this time either. But the Cummins brothers opened my eyes. If a committee team like India can be defeated at night, why can't we? Immediately after winning the World Cup, we contacted Cummins brother and expressed our interest, and he agreed to coach us. I hope he will return to the country in a few days. 

On the other hand, when Cummins' fake imo account was knocked about this, he also said, "I agree, brother, I am coming, this time the game will be played. I have played with India on their soil, I hope I will play on your soil too. I have heard that your helmet army is performing quite well with hockey sticks, we will also play wearing helmets, but we will have bats in our hands instead of hockey sticks."

Headline_English: Ordinary people want Haileybury schools in every district
Content_English:
The famous Haileybury School was established in London, UK in 1862. In that continuity, Haileybury Bhaluka has been established for the first time in Bhaluka, Mymensingh Division, Bangladesh. It will cost about 3.7 million taka per year to study there. There is accommodation for about 1,000 students here. However, the families of the wealthy students are very angry that this school is established only in Mymensingh. They called a press conference and gave an ultimatum to establish Haileybury in every district of the country very soon. 

According to a source, most of those who want to study in Haileybury are the children of prominent businessmen, politicians and bureaucrats. However, there are also descendants of driver Malek as an exception. Regarding the establishment of the school only in Mymensingh, a customs officer said, 'There are schools like Mymensingh in villages, and not in Dhaka city. Aren't we human beings? Don't our children have the ability to study in Haileybury? If I want my daughter to study, I will either study at Haileybury or not. And have I only worked at customs for so long?’ 

No one could give a correct answer to this question. 

Meanwhile, those who cannot afford Haileybury are also in great trouble. Samia Rahman (27), the wife of a police officer, said, ‘It would be nice if we could study at that school. But we don’t really have that much money. We are poor people. Sunnydale is our hope…’

Headline_English: The pyramids can be seen from the Jahangirnagar gate.
Content_English:
Trees are being cut down in Jahangirnagar on a massive scale to build new buildings. However, this is not causing much damage there. Because due to regular tree cutting, Jahangirnagar is turning into a desert and many experts have expressed hope that this desert will rival the Sahara Desert in the near future. Many have even said that pyramids can be seen from the main gate of the university. 

One such person who saw the pyramid told us, ‘I can’t believe my eyes. Last night, after having a hearty dinner with vegetables, I went to the main gate to have some tea. Later, when I was returning, I saw a huge pyramid! Two camels were also walking by.’ 

If his words don’t seem so credible to us, we go to a desert expert. He tells us, ‘If trees are cut down, the area will become a desert. And where there is a desert, there will be pyramids! If we don’t go deep into how it will exist, there will be pyramids, this is the eternal truth.’

Headline_English: Demand to reduce the price of Coke by 5 taka due to non-payment of Coke Studio concert
Content_English:
Many viewers could not enjoy the Coke Studio concert properly due to widespread mismanagement and a bad sound system. This time, they have demanded a reduction of 5 taka in the price of Coke as compensation. 

A viewer who went to the concert after buying a ticket told us, ‘There was no benefit in buying a ticket. Thousands of ticketless viewers, like the voters of the night, occupied our allotted space and watched the concert before us. Is there any need to hold a concert like this during an election? Others are killing our rights in both places. I have boycotted Coke Studio from today and will boycott Coke too if the price of Coke is not reduced.’ 

On the other hand, another viewer told us, ‘Brother, I felt like I was at JU. I am a JU fan, so I became quite nostalgic after going to the Coke concert. However, at JU, we don't fly in the sky with so much ganjam, I hope Coke will reduce the price of Coke and make arrangements to get some compensation for the ganjam that day.' On the other hand, another brother ran away at the beginning of the interview after being caught at a Coke concert with Boycott Coke Studio status.

Headline_English: Fuchka businessman Mizan wants a no-nut November every month
Content_English:
November means No Nut November. It means, say no to nuts. This month, no one says no to nuts, no one goes near nuts. No nuts are eaten, no nuts are bought, and no one even wants to see nuts. At this time, the only demand of people is nuts. That is why Mizan, a nut trader, wants no nuts all year round to light a green light in his business every month. 

Mizan told us about this, ‘Almonds kill half of my business. They are cheap, can be eaten for a long time, and can be delivered by walking. No one comes to me anymore after getting so many benefits. But there is only one month, no one even looks back at nuts. Even if there are thousands of problems, they have to come to me. They have to eat nuts. What I earn in this one month, I don’t earn in the whole year. That is why I want people to say no to nuts every month.’ 

Jhalmuri trader Ramiz also agrees with Mizan. He also has one demand. "No, November, let it come every month."

Headline_English: Shah Rukh Khan received the most expensive gift from his friend Salman on his birthday
Content_English:
Today is the birthday of the famous hero Shahrukh Khan. Along with the wishes and gifts from his fans on his birthday, he is also receiving expensive gifts from his loved ones. It has been learned through a secret and untrue source that the most expensive gift he has received so far is from his friend Salman. What is that gift? To know the answer to this question, we grabbed Salman Khan's imo number from the poor man's friend Zayed Khan. 

When we made a video call to Salman Khan on imo, he told us without showing his face, 'Shah Rukh is my very close friend. Absolutely my best friend. On my best friend's birthday, I want to give the most expensive thing. For this, after thinking and considering everything, I saw that the only expensive thing now is Bangladeshi onions. So I brought one kilogram of onions from Bangladesh through my other friend Zayed Khan and gifted it to Shah Rukh.' 

Shah Rukh Khan was overwhelmed with happiness after receiving the Bangladeshi onion gift from Salman Khan. He said, 'I don't understand how I will eat such expensive onions. I thought, I won't eat onions for the first few days. "I'll just smell it, then put the juice on my tongue, then eat it slowly, little by little. This onion will last until my next birthday."

Headline_English: New song of Arthohin is coming, I know Bangladesh will lose, you too
Content_English:
