Orthaheen’s frontman Suman confirmed the truth of the incident by tweeting from his fake Twitter account. He said that the lyrics of the song will show Bangladesh’s continuous losses as well as the savage replies of the cricketers. 

In addition, he went live on his fake Facebook account and said, ‘There was nothing else to do, actually, since the song was made, Bangladesh has started losing. Now let’s see if there is any change in the remaining matches after making the song about losing.’ 

When asked about the fans’ opinion on the song, a fan told us, ‘This song is just right for them. I thought they would win the World Cup by showing a surprise like the night vote in this World Cup, but in fact, each of them is a BNP worker and the entire team is BNP. There are no signs of winning.

Headline_English: Bengali 2nd paper is being removed, new subject being added to the curriculum with only letter writing
Content_English:
Bengali 2nd paper is no longer useful to students. On the contrary, the importance of letters in the workplace has increased several times. Such information has emerged in a recent survey by a non-political research institute. Based on this survey, policymakers have decided that Bengali 2nd paper will no longer be kept. Instead, a separate subject on letter writing is going to be added to the secondary and higher secondary education curriculum. There is a lot of discussion about this in the country's intellectual community. 

Recently, after the Daily Star published a report on 15 letters written by Education Minister Dipumoni to Balukheko Chairman Selim, a new dimension has been added to this discussion. The importance of letters and their political use will also have special significance in this subject. 

Education Minister Dipumoni spoke about the importance of letters from one of his fake IDs. He believes that the importance of letters is now much greater than ever before. It is becoming difficult to compete in the workplace now. From one table to another, from room to room, from office to office; letters are becoming essential in all fields. All government and private institutions are now training employees in letter writing. Learning to write letters is very important if you want to survive in the market. Dipumoni said from her fake ID, ‘There is no point in reading these etiquette and rules. As much as writing letters is beneficial, learning to write letters properly can go a long way in life.’ 

Eminent intellectual Kalimullah Khan praised this initiative and said that this is a very important decision in the current socio-economic reality. From requesting half-day leave in school to lobbying for jobs, patronizing or backing corrupt people, letters are now the norm in everything! Some are using letters only to do necessary work, while others have taken it to the level of art. It has even happened that politicians have become celebrities by writing letters. 

The syllabus preparation committee has been formed with educationist Professor Akhtar Zaman. When asked about this, he said, our goal is to create an inclusive syllabus. We will not only teach the skills needed, but also the spirit needed to write letters. When preparing the syllabus, it is important to pay attention to how to write letters using formal language, such as an apology to the President, an application for transfer in a government job, an application to cancel a transfer order, an application for budget for a government project, a letter to give a job to one's own people, etc.

Headline_English: Bangladesh wants a 10-team semi-final
Content_English:
Although not directly saying so, the Bangladesh cricket team players had expressed their hope of reaching the semi-finals before the World Cup. However, after 5 matches of the World Cup, their hopes have now been dashed. However, the Tigers are not ready to give up yet, since the format of the World Cup is different this time, they have also asked for a different format of semi-finals. 

The Bangladesh cricket team wants a 10-team semi-final, not a 4-team one. In this regard, the Bangladesh team's secret fake media manager, Free-Asad Azim, told us, 'The best of the best actually come to the World Cup. Since everyone has played the first round, we demand that everyone can play in the semi-finals. If there is a 10-team semi-final, it will be very interesting.' However, Free-Asad Bhai did not agree to say anything about how many teams should be in the final. 

On the other hand, the Sri Lankan Cricket Board has welcomed Bangladesh's call for a 10-team semi-final. A spokesperson for the Sri Lankan Cricket Board told us, hiding his face, 'The times are going bad, so why won't we play the semi-finals? Bangladesh's demand is logical. Even if it's a 10-team semi-final, it's not bad even if the final is 5 teams.' 

Immediately after such a demand from Bangladesh, a fake Twitter account of the BCCI, the Indian Cricket Board, posted the meme 'Shokher toh kamti nai'. Although the real reason for their post is not known, seeing a local meme on the page of a foreign cricket board is causing a flood of joy in the Bangladeshi meme community.

Headline_English: Even if we don't make it to the semi-finals, we want to finish the tournament at 10th: Shakib Al Hasan in an exclusive fictional interview
Content_English:
Bangladesh has often been knocked out of the World Cup after losing to South Africa. Although they started the tournament with hopes of reaching the semi-finals, Bangladesh's expectations have now decreased a bit. Shakib Al Hasan's team wants to finish the tournament at least at number 10. 

In an exclusive interview, Shakib Al Hasan talked about his performance and expectations in the World Cup with eArchie. 

The team is still at number 10 in the points table. The captain said that he wants to maintain this performance. He said, 'We are now at number 10. I hope to stay here. England at number 9 and Sri Lanka at number 8 may be a bit of a threat. But we are optimistic. Even if we do not make it to the semi-finals, we want to secure the number 10 position.' 

To a question about his personal achievements, Shakib said, 'I do not have much desire for personal achievements. I believe in team achievements. However, I want to finish the tournament at the top of the all-rounder ranking. After that, I want to move forward with the work of opening the showroom. I have many showroom openings pending.' 

Shakib Al Hasan also talked about the savage innings of the press conference. Inviting everyone to watch the press conference instead of playing the game, Shakib said, 'Watch the love conference, there is good play there. I will play cricket well and I will also play the press conference well - one person cannot do it all alone. You will not see our performance in the press conference, you will not criticize me, that is not possible. Right?'

Headline_English: Omar Sunny to replace Sanjay Dutt in KGF 3
Content_English:

Headline_English: New word 'Moye Moye' added to Oxford Dictionary
Content_English:
New words are added to the Oxford Dictionary four times a year. The latest words added are Antigodlin, Antigram, Deepfake, cheddar, etc. However, it is rumored that a new viral word 'Moye Moye' is going to be added to the dictionary in a few days. 

The word that is being heard on social media is Moye Moye. No exact information has been found yet about which language it is a word from or what it means. However, word or morphology expert Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah told earki, 'Moye Moye is a liquid word. It has no specific meaning. Just as a liquid substance takes the shape of the container when it is placed in a container, Moye Moye is the same. When it is used, it holds the meaning....' 

Then, when Dr. Muhammad Shahidullah was asked about the etymology of this word, he said with a dull face, 'Moye Moye'. The earki reporter immediately apologized for feeling annoyed by the external expression on his face. Then he smiled and nodded his head and said 'moye moye' 

It is not only linguist Shahidullah sir, the whole country is now affected by the 'moye moye' disease. Yesterday in Dhanmondi 

A woman named her twin children 'moye moye'. Not only that, a 96-year-old man in Khulshi, Chittagong also uttered 'Moye moye' at the moment of his death!

Headline_English: What to do if iPhone 15 gets hot?
Content_English:
The iPhone 15 has been launched in the market. Hundreds of Rich Kids have already bought it. However, after buying it, a special complaint is being received from them. The iPhone is getting hot like fire. Even after this complaint, the iPhone company has admitted this fault of theirs. But they have not given any solution. So for the convenience of everyone, eRki has come up with a solution to this problem. 

1# 

You can keep your iPhone in the fridge like a water bottle from time to time. Run it for 5 minutes, keep it in the fridge for 10 minutes. 
2# 

When your lover gets hot, you can cool her down by saying Babu, Sona, Jaan, Ummah. You can try this with your iPhone too. Patiently explain to her for a while, ‘Babu is not hot, what happened, Jaan, tell me Sona…’ 
3# 

Since the iPhone 15 is waterproof, you don’t have to worry anymore. You can keep a bag of ice cubes with your iPhone all the time. 



4# 

You can tell your phone, ‘Cool down, little brother, report it to the police station.’ 



5# 

You can board a ship to the South Pole today. Far from your iPhone getting hot, you yourself will never get hot. 



6# 

You can scare your iPhone, ‘If you get hot again, you will see my dead face!’ You will see that it will become cold out of fear. 



7# 

If your iPhone 15 does not cool down after all this, then let it stay hot. It is natural for a phone of this price to run on its own accord.

Headline_English: Australian players dream of being eliminated from IPL if they play well
Content_English:
If India plays well in today's India-Australia match, they will be eliminated from the IPL; Australian players are not playing well mainly because they saw it in their dreams. An unreliable secret source has revealed that they had informed the team management about their dream since yesterday morning. At first, a few tried to play well, but later they were able to save their IPL careers by scolding their seniors.

Headline_English: Murad Takla to receive Nobel Prize in Literature in 2023
Content_English:
October means Nobel month. The names of Nobel laureates in medicine have already been announced. The turn of literature is coming. Since most people in Bangladesh are poets and writers by birth, there is a lot of excitement about this. According to fictional sources, Bangladesh is 100% ahead in the possibility of winning the Nobel Prize in Literature in 2023. The analytical book 'Murad Takla Dictionary' is ahead of all the novels in the world. 

In this regard, the vice-president of the Nobel Committee said, 'We have seen various dictionaries of many languages. Even last year, a dictionary of the High Valerian language from Game of Thrones came to our hands. That was also excellent, but it is nothing compared to the Murad Takla Dictionary. In this dictionary of a completely new language, the alphabet, etymology, arrangement, and rhythm of each word have been discussed. Not only that, there is also an important discussion on the pronunciation, gender, digraphs, foot-based indicators, and nature suffixes of the Murad Takla language. There are also examples with each word. After much discussion, we have come to the conclusion that this is the one who deserves to win the Nobel Prize. 

The authors of the Murad Takla dictionary said after receiving this award, 'amara kov anadhita. Tnku nobal komiti ka'

Content_English:

Considering not only these issues, but also various other aspects, the eArchi research team has tried to find out why Bangladesh should lose tomorrow's match. 



1# Bangladesh is still in the semi-final race. As a result, equation scientists are also having a busy time. Bangladesh should lose this match to South Africa to free the equation scientists from this busyness. 

2# Many Bangladeshi fans have often been crying in this tension whether Bangladesh will go to the semi-finals or not. They should be freed from this unbearable pain. That is why there is no other way open for Bangladesh except losing tomorrow's match. 



3# If Bangladesh loses the match, the cricketers will also be relieved of the tension of reaching the semi-finals from the next match. As a result, they will be able to play pressure-free cricket. By playing pressure-free cricket, God willing, they will lose again from the next match. As a result, losing this match is very important. 



4# Losing this match will also be a great advantage in planning your return home. You don't have to be uncertain about when the tickets will be sold. Even if you lose tomorrow, you can still buy your air tickets as planned. You can get your shopping done in time. 



5# Bangladesh will not be able to win against South Africa, who are in great form. As a result, it is better for Bangladesh to lose.

Headline_English: 10 advantages of being poor
Content_English:
Are you poor? Although no one wants to be born poor or live a poor life, recent research says that there are many advantages to being poor. Today, we will shed light on a few of the many advantages. After knowing about the advantages, your sadness about your life will decrease exponentially. Let's see... 

1# 

Being poor, you cannot afford to ride rickshaws, Uber, or Pathao regularly. You walk for miles. This controls your weight, high blood pressure, and some chronic diseases like diabetes. Along with this, your monthly medical expenses are also saved! 

2# 

You do not want to go to the showroom and buy expensive things. When you remember your empty pocket, you will forget to look at it. This will save you a lot of time. 

3# 

Friends do not pressure you for treats. What kind of treats do the poor have? However, you can feel free to sit with them in a restaurant. You can get a full meal even if you are poor. 

4# 

If you are poor, you are not ashamed to say 'I will not get any money even if I kill you'. It is a kind of luxury for the poor to have shame. 



5# 

You become an environment-friendly person by reusing and recycling the same things. The amount of waste you produce is free from any threat to the environment and even if you are poor, you can be given a certificate of a conscious citizen. 

6# 

Being poor, you will not be able to invest or insure large amounts of money anywhere. That is why you will be saved from the fraud of organizations like Evaly, Destiny, MTFE. 

7# 

There is no difference between the good times and bad times of the poor. All times are the same. And this is exactly why even the cuckoo of good times does not come into their lives. Those who are by their side, they are truly there.

8# 

Since your pocket is empty, you will not want to travel to different places in your country or abroad. If you really want to, YouTube is your last hope. And since you are less likely to leave your house, the chances of getting into an accident on the road are also less. Being poor also reduces your risk of losing your life. 

9# 

99.99% of poor people have a great ability to bargain. Although this bargaining is limited to the market at the beginning of life, it is useful in all areas of life later. Just by being poor, you can acquire a life-long skill. 

10# 

Even if you cannot cook or eat fish and meat regularly because you are poor, vegetables will be your daily companion. This means that you are saving money and getting a healthy food habit. Not only that, but since necessity is the father of innovation, the need for protein equivalent to fish and meat is also met within a small budget effort.

Headline_English: Newton's wrong formula
Content_English:
Amar Babu is a science teacher at Rupeshwar New Model High School. 

Amar Nath Pal, B.Sc. (Hons., Gold Medal). 

A very serious type of teacher. The school's teachers have a fake name in addition to their real names. They are known by that name among the students. Amar Babu is known as Ghari Sir in the school. He has a round watch in his breast pocket. Before entering the class, he stands in front of the door and checks the time. As soon as the bell rings for the end of the class, he takes out the watch again and checks the time. If his eyebrows furrow, you will understand that the bell has not been read correctly. It has been a minute or two here and there. 

In his class, you have to sit with your breath held. You cannot laugh, you cannot poke the boy next to you on the back with a pencil, you cannot play with the notebook. If someone laughs even by mistake, he will look at him with shocked eyes for a while and say, "Science is not a child's game." If you laughed while teaching nuances, it means you mocked science. You have done a great injustice. You will be punished for that. You will not go home after the class ends today. You will go home after getting three numbers, 17, 18, 19, out of seven questions in arithmetic. Is it clear? 
The culprit stands with a dry mouth. Seeing his humiliation, someone else might have laughed. Amar Sir will say in a hoarse voice, "What! Why are you laughing? Did I say something funny?" You stand up. You will stand for five minutes as punishment for laughing for no reason.

Headline_English: Riyad of Dhanmondi sleepless for 72 hours to be the first to post a status on Facebook after the earthquake
Content_English:
Seismologists have said that there is a possibility of an earthquake measuring 5.5-6.8 on the Richter scale in Bangladesh and neighboring countries within the next 72 hours. Most people in Bangladesh are worried about such a possibility. However, Riyad of Dhanmondi proved that everyone has a different area of ​​concern. According to a confidential source, he has promised to stay awake for 72 hours to be the first to post a status on Facebook immediately after the earthquake. 

When asked why he has taken such action on a serious issue like an earthquake, Riyad (27) said, "I am also serious about earthquakes. Most people do not know that an earthquake has occurred unless they post a status on Facebook. So I have taken this as an 'act of social service'. I have heard earthquake predictions many times before and waited to post a status first. When I woke up in the morning, I saw that Facebook was flooded with earthquake posts. So this time I have decided to stay awake for 72 hours without taking any more risks. 

Not only verbally, Riyad has also put himself one step ahead in terms of work than before. He has already written a status on Facebook and is ready to post. He showed us the text ‘Earthquake!!!!!!!!!!!!!!’ that is ready to post on his Facebook account. In this regard, he further said, ‘It is a bit difficult to write a status immediately after an earthquake. I am in a very panicked state. So I am sitting with my mobile in my hand after writing a status. I will post it from under the bed as soon as the earthquake occurs...’ 

However, when the earthquake was felt at 3:30 am yesterday, everyone was quite confused because he posted the status immediately. He found out from the comment section that no one else felt it. Riyad Chowdhury was very surprised by this. However, he later found out that a newly married couple had actually moved in upstairs... Riyad, annoyed and embarrassed by such an incident, has already warned the couple upstairs.

Headline_English: The trend of wearing shorts and sleeveless clothes is decreasing in Dhaka
Content_English:
The number of boys and girls wearing shorts has suddenly decreased in Dhaka. Before July, where 30 out of every 100 people wore shorts, by the end of August, that number had gradually decreased to zero. 

In many modern offices, employees wore shorts as a form of comfort and fashion in the heat. Especially in software parks and advertising agencies, shorts are the official attire. Shorts were popular among university students and school and college students as well. After July, the number of people wearing shorts among these offices and students has decreased. No one is seen wearing shorts much anymore. 
The number of people wearing saris has also decreased. Many people are using chadars to keep every part of their body completely covered even when wearing saris. 

Our fictional investigative journalist said that the picture is almost the same in Dhaka as well as the rest of the country. 

It is known that this huge change in the public life of Dhaka has come as a result of the tireless work of the two mayors of Dhaka and other cities. Basically, people have stopped wearing shorts and sleeveless shirts to avoid dengue due to the spread and reproduction of Aedes mosquitoes. 

Leaders of many religious organizations in the country have praised the mayors for this success. They have also given some guidelines for greater success. One such leader said, "If you can make some mosquitoes that can bite you while wearing jeans. And if possible, increase the production further. I still see that it has not come to the full screen." 

However, due to the decrease in wearing shorts and sleeveless shirts, Aedes mosquitoes are struggling to meet their daily target. The Aedes Mosquito Society has expressed some dissatisfaction with the mayors regarding this matter. A vice-president of the Aedes Mosquito Society said, "There is no place to bite except the face now. Everyone wears full sleeves, everyone wears full pants. We cannot meet the target. "Yesterday, I had a target of encountering 10 people, but I could only encounter 5 people by the afternoon. Then I had to go to the sidewalk and bite the poor people in torn clothes to complete the target." 

However, the mosquitoes are not thinking much about this problem. One such person said, "The mayor must be trying. Let another batch of medicine come from Singapore. If you take that medicine, you can bite them even through your clothes."

Headline_English: Oscar congratulates Mahmudullah on winning the 2014 Brazil team
Content_English:
Bangladesh lost to South Africa. Just as no bowler could stand up, most of Bangladesh's batters could not stand up either. However, Mahmudullah Riyad scored a great century in this match dominated by South Africa. 

After the match, Oscar, a member of the Brazilian team that played in the 2014 World Cup semi-finals, posted on X (former Twitter) praising Riyad's century. He mentioned that he was able to score a goal for Brazil in that match. 

Oscar, praising Mahmudullah's century on his Twitter, wrote, 'I know what this feeling is like! You played great Mahmudullah Riyad. Your century reminds me of a goal I scored in 2014. Carry on champs.' 

Mahmudullah Riyad commented on Oscar's tweet from his fake ID. He said, "Your goal, my century and Shakib Al Hasan becoming the number one all-rounder - people don't remember our achievements in this world. Still, we will continue to prove ourselves."

Headline_English: One-third of people in Dhaka suffer from depression due to lack of traffic jams
Content_English:
Dhaka city has suddenly been empty since this morning. There is no traffic jam anywhere, the roads are noisy all around. Where it takes a day to reach Dhanmondi from Uttara, it has come in just 20 minutes today. Everyone should have been happy with today's situation. However, many people in Dhaka city are not happy. We asked them why they are not happy. 

A corporate employee from Banani told us, 'My home is in Dhanmondi and my office is in Banani. Every day I wake up at 6 am, there is no bus, then I brush my teeth on the bus, get ready, have breakfast, and take a nap. It takes 3 hours to do all this, the traffic jam at Bijoy Smroni is over. Then I slowly reach my office. But today, I left at 6 am today and reached this office at 6:30 am! What kind of talk is this! I could not do anything, I rushed to the office. You can't change people's habits like this all of a sudden.' 

Another said, 'My office door opens at 10 am, but I come and sit at 6 am. What a miserable 4 hours I have spent! There is nothing to do, just sit on the stairs quietly. Although I wisely took a picture of the jam on my mobile. But how long will it last? It won't be enough to get us used to the jam and remove it. We want the jam back!'

Headline_English: Nasir and Sabbir are being brought back into the team
Content_English:
Both teams are making various plans to win before the match with India in the group stage of the World Cup. Thousands of influencers are taking note. In the meantime, Pakistani model Sehar Shinwari has been added as a new weapon to the Bangladesh team. In a post on social media X, she said that the Bangladesh team will take revenge for Pakistan's defeat by defeating India. And in return, she will go on a dinner date with the Bangladesh team. On social media 'X', Sehra Shinwari wrote, 'Inshallah, my Bengali friends will take revenge today. I will go to Dhaka and have a dinner date with them with fish if their team is able to defeat India.' 

After this X post by Sehar Sherwani, the selectors of the Bangladesh team are thinking of bringing back Nasir and Sabbir. 
If they get a tempting offer like going on a date with a Pakistani actress, Nasir and Sabbir will undoubtedly give the best game of their careers. Therefore, the cricket board is thinking of adding Nasir Hossain and Sabbir Hossain to the team. 
Team manager Khaled Mahmud Sujan, a former pace bowler, said in a written statement from his fake Facebook profile, "If we want to beat India, we have to think outside the box. They have already marked our eleven tigers. Sabbir and Nasir are now hungry tigers. If they give them a date as a reward, the Tigers will not let India stand. 

This reporter had to go through a lot of trouble to contact Nasir Hossain in this regard. He could not be reached on any of his eighty numbers. Finally, he was reached on the phone on the eighty-first number. When asked how he felt about getting a place in the team after so many days, he became excited. He said, "Who are you? You know I did not get a place in the team?" 

Of course, he became quite cold when the name of Pakistani actress Sehar Shinwari was mentioned. When asked what he expected from himself in today's game, he said, "I will give my life, but I will not let Bangladesh lose. There is no alternative to today's victory. Such opportunities do not come again and again. 

Cricketer Sabbir, however, was in a very relaxed mood. Regarding today's game, he said, 'India is undoubtedly a good team. But Pakistan is on Bangladesh's side; I mean Pakistani actress. As a result, we have nothing to lose, the whole world is to win.' 

However, if Sabbir and Nasir are kept in the team, which two will be dropped, head coach Chandika Hathurusinghe said, 'We have always been keen on building a team of young people. In today's match, we are keeping special consideration to keep the bachelors of the team in the squad. In that case, Nasir can be played instead of Mahmudullah. Again, if Mushfiqur wins the match and goes on a date with Mahmudullah, their family unrest may also start. As a result, we will announce who we will drop before the start of the game.'

Headline_English: Mashrafe called to stop Celebrity Cricket League brawl
Content_English:
There have been reports of a massive brawl in the Charki-Celebrity Cricket League held in Dhaka. It is learned that 6 people have already been admitted to the hospital after the brawl. Meanwhile, Mashrafe is being called to stop this brawl in the Celebrity Cricket League. This former cricketer has a good reputation in Bangladesh for settling various cricket-related problems for a long time. An official in charge of the Celebrity Cricket League said, 'Just as the game of cricket has gone out of our control here, the brawl has also gone out of our control. Now I see no other way than calling Mashrafe.' 

However, some have suggested organizing a new tournament instead of stopping this brawl. One such person in charge of the league said, 'The cricket league is over! Instead of ending the tournament here, a wrestling league can be started from here. I hope T-Sports and Charki will be with us.' 

Meanwhile, Afridi's fans are angry that Tohid Afridi was not called to the celebrity brawl. One such fan said, "Why would Mashrafe come if Afridi Bhai is there? Mashrafe will stop cricket fights, Mashrafe will stop celebrity fights. So what will our Afridi Bhai do? Sit and suck his fingers?"

Headline_English: Rahim from Faridpur wants to buy eggs from the world market
Content_English:
On September 15, 2023, a report in Prothom Alo caused a storm in the teacups of ordinary citizens across the country. It was said that the price of eggs in the world market is 5.61 taka, while in Bangladesh the price of each egg is 12 taka. After knowing this information, many people are getting involved in the debate. However, from the latest information, it is known that many people like Rahim from Faridpur are now interested in buying eggs from the world market. 

What is the secret of these eggs? The earki investigation team appeared in the world market to inspect this difference in egg prices. The investigation showed that the biological value of a standard (Bangladeshi) egg is 96. An egg in Bangladesh contains 143 calories of energy. It contains 0.72 grams of carbohydrates, 12.56 grams of protein, 9.51 grams of fat. It also contains 198 milligrams of phosphorus, 138 milligrams of potassium, and 1.29 milligrams of zinc. It also contains vitamins A, D, E, B12, iron, cholesterol, choline, etc. 
Meanwhile, the biological value of an egg in the world market is 12, the energy is only 42 calories, carbohydrates. 000001 grams, and protein is only .35 grams. Not only that, the vitamin A, D, E, B12, iron, and cholesterol are also absent in the world market eggs. Many eggs there are rotten, the yolk and white part are mixed with hydrogen sulfide gas. Many eggs are plastic eggs. There are no pure and fresh eggs like those in Bangladesh in the world market. 

When talking to the high-ranking authority controlling liquid prices in Bangladesh in this regard, he said, 'The income of the people of Bangladesh is high, and there must be a balance between income and expenditure. Do not compare domestic eggs with the 'world market'. The 'world market' is a poor man's market, a kind of recycle bin. Since we have money, we will eat fresh, improved things. And the price of fresh things will be a little higher! What is there to complain about?’ 

However, many low-income people like Rahim of Faridpur are coming to Bishwa Bazar. Rahim said, ‘Recently, I have been struggling with money, so I have decided to buy food from Bishwa Bazar for a few days. When the situation improves, I will return to our market...’ 

However, a lady named Farida from the same area wanted to know, ‘Where is Bishwa Bazar? Is there a place where you can get eggs at a cheaper price? I can’t even find it on Google Maps. It would be very helpful if you could share the location....’ We are hopeful that we will send her the address of ‘Bishwa Bazar’ very soon.

Headline_English: New vehicle Onlyvans is being launched in Dhaka city
Content_English:
Dhaka is called the city of magic. High quality of life, advanced vehicles, clean pollution-free air, pure water - what is not here? Every citizen of the world dreams of living in such a city. Every day, new facilities are added here to give new surprises to the citizens. Similarly, after Pathao, Uber, and Metrorail, a new vehicle, Onlyvans, is being launched in the capital Dhaka from tomorrow. 

Just by hearing the name, it is understood that this is basically the latest and most modern version of the van. Although it was initially launched on a trial basis only in Gulshan, Banani, and Dhanmondi, it will gradually run throughout the city of Dhaka. According to fictional sources, the world's 7 largest infrastructure and tech companies have worked for Onlyvans. The vehicle, made in the style of a van, has a total of 3 wheels. However, unlike the original van, it will not have an open back like the original van. Instead of wood, the base will be made of high-quality tiles, the sky will be visible through transparent walls, and there will also be an air conditioning system inside. 
However, the most interesting aspect of OnlyVans is that there is a special arrangement for OnlyFans models and TikTokers. In a demo model, the vehicle is divided into two parts. TikTok and OnlyFans. The fare for the TikTok part will be 250 taka per hour and 350 taka for OnlyFans. However, if someone is a hotshot of both, that is, leaving the TikTok room and going to OnlyFans or from OnlyFans to TikTok room, the fare is only 300 taka. 

The first condition for using this vehicle is that you must be a registered TikToker or OnlyFans star. If you take refuge in any kind of fake and false account, you will be expelled from OnlyVans for life. After this announcement, many are rushing to open accounts on TikTok and OnlyFans. A gentleman named Anwarul Islam (64) said in this regard, 'The vehicle looks amazing. I am opening an OnlyFans account to ride here. I'm dancing there regularly on Zynga, but I'm not getting any viewers. So I'm opening 7 more fake accounts and giving myself likes. What else can I do...I'm born a man, so I won't have a hobby or two?...'

Headline_English: Ben Stokes expresses interest in playing for Bangladesh team to get Awami League ticket
Content_English:
England cricketer Ben Stokes is not often seen in the list of the world's best all-rounders. However, this one of the most impactful cricketers in the England team has scored many match-winning innings. He is loved by cricket fans from his own country to the whole world. Still, he is not satisfied. It is known that he has expressed his interest in leaving the England team to play for the Bangladesh team to get a ticket for the Awami League. 

Coming home in the middle of a game, sure victory if the vote is held, serving the people of the country and many other things have influenced this cricketer. While talking about the matter, the cricketer said, 'We also want to go home in the middle of a game. Who likes to talk about games all the time? If you get a little free time, you can also discuss politics and elections. That is why I want to play in Bangladesh.' 

Meanwhile, another source has learned that Stokes took this decision at the insistence of Ben Stokes' mother. Last night, Stokes' mother showed him a news of Shakib and told Stokes to drink the water that washed Shakib's feet. Stokes, who was the victim of scolding, took this decision quickly. Stokes said, "What will happen with these match-winning innings! What will happen if I come back from retirement and can't stand for election like Shakib Al Hasan?" 

The cricketer also said that he will meet the Prime Minister to get Awami League tickets.

Headline_English: Tasneem from Mymensingh dug a tunnel from Aarong's trial room to her house
Content_English:
Currently, the concept of digging a 'tunnel' is not unique to the common man. Although it sounds like an adventure-thriller movie, in reality such activities happen all the time. A few days ago, the movie 'Tunnel' starring Afran Nisho and Raihan Rafi was released. However, this time an incredible story has come to light about this tunnel. No, not under a bank or jewelry shop, but a young woman named Piya Tasnim (25) from Mymensingh dug a tunnel from under the trial room of Aarong to her house! 

It is known that Tasnim entered the trial room at 8 pm yesterday Saturday and did not come out again. After a long time, a salesman of the Aarong Mymensingh outlet first noticed the matter and informed the others. At that time, the officials outside, fearing an accident inside, broke the door of the trial room. Then, that incredible scene was seen. A tunnel has been cut there by making a hole like a manhole cover. On the instructions of a police officer, a salesman named Kamruzzaman immediately went down into that tunnel. It is known that the end of this tunnel is in Tasnim's bedroom. 

Tasnim has not been found after this incident. However, CCTV footage shows that she used to come to Aarong four days a week, entering the trial room with at least 7-8 clothes every day and leaving with 3. She carried out this activity so meticulously that no one ever suspected her. She even used a state-of-the-art drilling machine EK-86 to dig the tunnel, which works like a silent gun. Electricity was supplied from inside the wall. 

Background investigation reveals that Tasnim is a tickler by profession, although her father is a rickshaw puller and mother is a housewife. Mymensingh District Police suspect that she can commit such an incident due to her desire to wear new clothes regularly. So far, the number of missing Aarong sarees is 69, kurtis 53, tagas 39, salwar kameez 26, veils 11, blouse pieces 2. He has also stolen shoes and purses at different times. However, the surprising thing is that a huge amount of clothes from Gentle Park, Rich Man, Sailor, Spark Gear, Deshal were recovered from his bedroom. It is believed that Aarong used to regularly visit these outlets before. 

Since this incident, the trial rooms of the showrooms are being closed. Not only that, the Bangladesh District Police has announced a reward of 5 lakh taka for Tasneem's arrest. If any of you have any information, we urge you to come forward. Stay tuned not only as a reader, but also as a Rajpath associate..

Headline_English: Young man asks for rent for electricity in print
Content_English:
In the 14 and a half years of the current government's three-and-a-half-year term, more than one lakh crore taka has been spent on rent for private power plants. Summit Group alone has received 17610 crore taka for rent. Whether there is electricity production or not, the rent has to be paid as per the contract. (Source: Prothom Alo) 

Meanwhile, after this news, a young man has asked for rent for his printing press. This young man named Tarek, who lives in Mohammadpur, the capital Dhaka, said, 'I have had electricity for a long time. Everyone in the area knows this. Not only me, but many of my friends also have a lot of electricity in their presses. If Summit Group can get rent, why can't we get rent for this electricity.' 

People in the area of ​​this young man also said that this printing press is producing electricity regularly. One such person said, 'There is production somewhere and not somewhere. But our Tarek produces daily. Even during the dengue season, he has visited the airport naked. His printing press has a lot of electricity. He should be paid rent.'

Headline_English: Nobel Committee requests DU Teachers' Association to list Nobel Prize winners
Content_English:
The Nobel Prize was awarded in 1901, five years after the death of Swedish industrialist and dynamite inventor Alfred Nobel. Every year, since October, there has been a lot of buzz about the winners of that year's Nobel Prize. However, to choose a worthy winner, a worthy judge is also needed. That is why the International Nobel Committee has requested the DU Teachers' Association to list the Nobel Prize winners from 2023. 

In a special and personal interview, the current committee head said, 'I recently saw a stand taken by the DU Teachers' Association against a Nobel laureate. After talking to the Teachers' Association and listening to their opinions, I really have doubts about our own judgment. It seems that we are not really worthy judges. In the meantime, two of our judges have resigned due to worthlessness. I sincerely request the teachers of Oxford in the East to take over very soon. We can't do it anymore....' 

The DU Teachers' Association has accepted such a proposal with great joy. It is known that there is a 100 percent chance of Bangladesh getting nominations in all 6 categories of the Nobel Prize this year. However, countless bikes with helmets are being deposited in front of the Teachers' Committee building every day to find out who is getting the nomination.

Headline_English: Young scientist discovers scientific method for poaching boiled eggs
Content_English:
Currently, the price of 1 hali egg is 55 taka. The price of domestic eggs is 60/70 taka per hali. Although many people have stopped eating eggs due to the high price of eggs, the idea of ​​​​keeping boiled eggs in the refrigerator and eating them later went viral on social media two days ago. Those who regularly eat poached/fried eggs are in trouble because of this, but now an alternative method has come for them too. Hasan Hasan (28), an emerging scientist from Gopalganj, has discovered a scientific method for poaching boiled eggs. 

This young scientist said, 'I have also been successfully using this method to deal with the egg crisis for quite some time. First, the boiled eggs kept in the refrigerator should be taken out and kept at room temperature for about three hours. Then it should be chopped finely and heated in water again. It is worth noting that while heating, 5-6 drops of melted wax should be added in a fresh state. This will quickly return the eggs to their raw state. However, in the case of duck eggs, the amount of melted wax drops should be double, that is, 10-12 drops. Keep stirring for 6-7 minutes. Then, mix the eggs with the required amount of salt and pour them into the oil that is boiling in the pan. Within 2 minutes, a delicious and beautiful poached egg will be ready. 

He also said, I have learned from various sources that many people are struggling to buy soybean oil. In that case, they can buy pangasius fish from the market, pull it out and cook it easily. 

The whole country is fascinated by Hasan's discovery. The name of earki specialized scientist Hasan Hasan is being hailed as a frontliner in dealing with the egg crisis. He has currently taken up a project to lay eggs himself instead of relying on chickens. He said that about 70% of the work has progressed well. He is seeking prayers from the countrymen for the remaining 30%.

Headline_English: 50 government officials are going to the African country of Chad to learn how to go to the moon
Content_English:
India has successfully sent a new spacecraft to the moon. Yesterday, their Chandrayaan-3 landed on the moon. After India's success, Bangladeshi government officials have reached a consensus on sending a lunar mission to the moon. eRK's own representative Samiul Aziz Siam said that a group of 50 government officials are going to the African country of Chad to learn how to go to the moon. 

It is known that they will stay in Chad for 3 months during this time. Their wives, daughters, daughters-in-law and grandchildren will also accompany the officials on this trip. 

A government official also said that they will not skimp on going to the moon like India. Criticizing the budget of India's lunar mission, a Bangladeshi government official said, "Are they completing such a big project with just 8 billion like Fakinni? We will not do this work with less than 2000 crore taka. We are not so poor like India anymore.

Headline_English: GenZ HSC candidates took the short form Bengali exam
Content_English:
Today was the exam for this year's HSC candidates. The first day was Bengali. After thousands of meetings, processions, and rallies to postpone the exam, everyone had to appear in the exam hall with a pen. While the frustration of not being able to postpone the exam touched one group, the short form they use in their regular lives touched another group. GenZs also took this Bengali exam in short form. 

In this regard, one of our GenZ candidates messaged us and said, 'Tbh, I needed to finish my exam asap, I used short form to finish the exam asap. pov: My Bengali is very bad, my short form is much better.' 

No one was surprised by their actions, even their parents were normal. A mother said in this regard, 'I couldn't fix it by scolding, beating, or anything. Whenever I said something, they said, "Istegfar." I understood that he would do something like that in the exam too, so I wasn't surprised anymore. Let him just fail, then we'll see where this daily istegfar goes!

Headline_English: Badrul, a bachelor from Mirpur, is eating honey nuts as an alternative to eggs.
Content_English:
The price of eggs is increasing rapidly. And bachelors are struggling to keep up with the price of eggs. Many are giving up eating eggs. Badrul, a young bachelor from Mirpur, has also given up. But instead of sitting around like everyone else, he has started eating honey-nuts. 

Why? When asked by Badrul, he told us in a sweet voice, ‘Because honey-nuts contain a lot of vitamins, minerals, iron, and minerals. It nourishes the body, entertains the mind, and nourishes the soul…’ 

Our reporter stopped him and asked, ‘Why are you memorizing these things like a parrot?’ In response, Badrul said, ‘Actually, I woke up at night listening to Jamshed Majumdar talk about honey-nuts and it got into my head. Since then, I feel empty, even if I don't eat rice, I have to eat honey nuts.' 

When Badrul was told that he had to eat honey nuts for a happy married life. You are a bachelor. Badrul got up and said, 'Who would marry an unemployed boy, brother? But you can't just sit there and say that. If marriage is necessary, I will do it later. I am continuing this work by eating honey nuts.

Headline_English: Come on, youngster, don't be afraid, there are no penalties in the Saudi league: Ronaldo to Neymar
Content_English:
Neymar, the star of Brazil's Noynoy, the hero of the Hexa Mission, is moving from PSG to the Saudi League. He has signed a contract to play for Al Hilal. But what will happen if he goes to Saudi Arabia? Is there a playground, a ball to kick? Or a desert? Neymar has become quite tense about all these. Hearing about that tension, Neymar's older brother, Ronaldo, an experienced soldier of the Saudi League, reassured Neymar. In a message this morning, he said, 'I was also very scared about Saudi Arabia at the beginning. Where will the game be, not in the desert? Then they have balls to play with? If they do, what is inside that ball? Air? Or oil? And what do they eat? Do they only eat dates? Or do they also eat fish and meat?' 

Ronaldo also said, 'But when I came, I saw no tension. Beautiful stadium, even more beautiful ball. The most important thing is, there are no penalties here. You don't need to roll around in the D-box, I don't have to be afraid of being called a penalty either. And since there are no penalties, there is no chance for another team to win the trophy here!' 

Neymar got courage after hearing Ronaldo's words. In this short message, he said, 'I'm coming, I'm coming... I'm coming in five minutes...'

Headline_English: Blue whales are choosing Chittagong to live in
Content_English:
The largest animal in the history of the world is the blue whale. This animal is so big that it can literally play with the tail of ten huge African elephants. This blue whale has been seen flocking to Chittagong for the past couple of days. 

But why? A blue whale floating in the heart of Chittagong was asked. In response, the whale said, ‘You are telling me that? Why don’t you come to Chittagong? Don’t you have any other place to stay, like the fountain of tears?’ 

Our inspector was shocked and said, ‘How did you learn the local language? And I don’t understand any of your language.’ 

In response, the whale said, ‘I learned this language after living permanently in Chittagong. I am speaking in standard Bengali for your understanding. Can a blue whale live comfortably, where is all this water in the sea? There is all the water in Chittagong city now. The waves at the intersection of Halishahar, Nasirnagar, and GEC here are the most comfortable for whales. 

I met another whale housewife with a shopping bag in hand. In an excited voice, this whale said, "The pride, dreams, and Meenabazar of Chittagong are incomparable. I shopped to my heart's content. Where can I find all these things in the ocean?" 

In response to the question of where she would go if the water in Chittagong recedes, the housewife said, "The water will never recede on the roads of Europe. And if it does, my beloved hero Riaz will surely tell us where else we can find roads like Europe."

Headline_English: Awami League is bringing Messi into the team, BNP is eyeing Mbappe
Content_English:
There has been a lot of tension in the political arena for the past few days. Although the two parties are still evenly matched on the streets, the two parties are making different plans for the coming days. A fake source named Marca.com has learned that the Awami League is thinking of bringing Messi into the team to increase the party's strength, while the BNP is looking at Mbappe. 

Another fake source named Goal.com reported that Messi and Mbappe have also confirmed the matter on their official Facebook. 

Uploading a picture of Messi wearing a Bangladesh Awami League jersey on his Facebook page, Messi wrote, 'When I was the president of the Spanish Chhatra League, I had a dream that one day I would play on the streets of Bangladesh. Today that dream is going to come true. The game will be played. Joy Bangla.' 

Meanwhile, despite the BNP's claim, a source close to Mbappe said that even if Mbappe goes to play for BNP, the matter is still not certain. There is a possibility of getting injured while playing on the streets for BNP. Mbappe is still not sure whether to take this risk or not. 

Meanwhile, a BNP source said that Neymar's agent contacted BNP, but BNP did not respond. It has been reported that the Brazilian footballer may join the Jatiya Party camp after being rejected by BNP.

Headline_English: Awami League wants to declare cauliflower as national vegetable
Content_English:
Awami League has come forward to declare their national vegetable. Although no one knew about this announcement except us, because only we get these secret and false information. But, instead of keeping it to ourselves, we are spreading it among you too! We had a detailed discussion about this with an Awami League soldier. 

He told us, ‘The wonderful qualities of cauliflower! Cauliflower is not only for taste, but the sulfur in it is beneficial for maintaining good health. Cauliflower can keep the liver healthy by removing harmful toxic elements. Cauliflower has some special qualities that everyone should know: 
1. Reduces cholesterol: It contains a lot of fiber, which helps in maintaining the cholesterol level in the body. 
2. Reduces weight: Studies have shown that cauliflower keeps the brain healthy, reduces weight and prevents various diseases including colds and coughs. 

3. Strengthens bones and teeth: Cauliflower contains calcium and fluoride, which are beneficial for teeth and gums. Its calcium strengthens bones. 

4. Prevents cancer: Cauliflower can prevent serious cancers. It contains sulforaphane, which kills cancer cells and prevents tumors from growing. Cauliflower also has the ability to fight against breast cancer, colon and bladder cancer germs. 

5. Beneficial for the heart: Cauliflower is good for the heart. The sulforaphane it contains can fight against heart disease. 

Also, there is a deep weakness in the name of our cauliflower. iykyk… ‘ 

Our fat reporter still hasn’t understood anything after this interview, we hope our readers have a thin head.

Headline_English: Jatiya Party wants its share of cases as the opposition party
Content_English:
As the elections approach, the number of missing cases has increased. According to a report in Daily Prothom Alo, a total of 315 cases have been filed against BNP leaders and activists in the past two months. But even though the Jatiya Party occupies the opposition seat in parliament, the same number of cases are not being filed against them. As an opposition party, they also want equal cases alongside BNP. The party is informed from an unreliable source that they are roaming around to file cases. 

Speaking of which, a Jatiya Party leader said from his fake ID, ‘We are the opposition party in parliament. But most of the cases are being filed by BNP leaders and activists. Where are our share of cases? Aren’t we the opposition party? Why is there always such discrimination against us?’ 

Another leader also said that many Jatiya Party leaders are being harassed at home due to the lack of cases. Due to the lack of sufficient cases, the family members of the leaders and activists are reluctant to even accept Jatiya Party as an opposition party. The wife of one such leader said, ‘A friend of mine’s son-in-law is a BNP member, and I have heard that lawyer notices for various cases arrive at his house every two days. But not a single one has come to our house in the last three months. And he says they are the opposition party! No cases, no attacks, no secret places to sleep at night! What kind of opposition party is this?’ 

A grassroots leader of the Jatiya Party is also spending his days in despair because there are no cases in his name. One such leader said from his fake ID, ‘We are the opposition party. But there is not a single case in our name, all the cases are in the name of that BNP. Why? What did we do wrong? Why are we not being told about our share of cases! I feel so disappointed, brother, sometimes I feel like a worker of the Zaker Party instead of a worker of the Jatiya Party.’

Headline_English: Experts say 11 percent voter turnout in Dhaka-17 constituency yesterday was due to Russia-Ukraine war
Content_English:
The election for Dhaka-17 constituency was going on all day yesterday. ERK does not know whether thousands of people came to vote. However, it is known that 11 percent of the votes were cast. There is a special reason for the remaining 89 percent of the votes not being cast. This reason can be known by talking to experts. They said that 11 percent of the votes were cast yesterday only because of the Russia-Ukraine war, if there was no war, none of this would have happened. 

When asked what is wrong with the Russia-Ukraine war, the experts told us, 'They have been fighting for so long, there is no end in sight to this war. The people of our country are scared. Many have stopped leaving their homes, many have even gone abroad due to fear, they do not feel safe at all to be in the country. In this situation, we have lost these votes, we have lost these people. That is why our vote percentage is so low.' 

Another expert said, 'The people of the country have covered their faces, there was no problem with that either. Our plan was to bring the grave dwellers. They would have been a fair election, but sadly, none of the gravediggers agreed to come this time due to the fear of this war. However, we think that these war-torn excuses, no one from the 17 seats actually went to the grave. Everyone is still alive!

Headline_English: Swiss bank asks cattle traders to reduce prices
Content_English:
Swiss bank accounts are being emptied suddenly. Account holders are withdrawing their money. The bank is under a lot of pressure to prevent this worst-ever disaster. Analysts believe that the bank has been hit by this disaster due to the high price of cattle in Bangladesh. 

The bank's board of directors has sought help from Bangladeshi cattle traders to save it from this ongoing disaster. They have requested that the price of cattle be reduced. Officials also said that they will make a request by hand if necessary. 

An official said, "From what I know a little about Bangladesh, it is enough to buy a cow if it costs a lakh taka. Most of the time, it costs 5 to 6 lakh taka. But one account holder told us that he will buy a cow for 6 lakh dollars. He withdrew the money! The closing of June is ahead, and our bank is in a bad situation." 

Meanwhile, talking to cattle traders, it is known that they are not charging that much for cattle. The price of cattle is the same as before. So is the Swiss bank lying? To one of our questions, a cattle trader said, "That Swiss bank account? Those are the ones that big cows buy, we don't sell them."

Headline_English: Egg prices drop in Brazil
Content_English:
The price of egg yolks has suddenly dropped in the Brazilian market since last night. Many believe that the price of egg yolks started falling after Senegal scored 4 goals. After the Seven Up price drop disaster, the price of egg yolks in the Brazilian market is the biggest crisis of this century. 

When we went to the Brazilian market, we saw that everyone from buyers to sellers had 4 eggs. Everyone was trying to sell eggs to everyone. If some did not want to take them, they were forced to give them away. A shopkeeper said about the matter, ‘We have two eggs anyway. We got four tomorrow. Where will we go with so many eggs? That is why the price has dropped.’ 

However, a Brazil supporter from Bangladesh laughed off such information. He said, somewhat angrily, ‘Don’t mix sports with egg yolks. The price of eggs is falling because of the market system. It has nothing to do with Senegal’s four goals.’ 

At the end of his speech, when this supporter wanted to sell us a egg yolk for 4 taka, we refused. In anger, he broke four eggs.

Headline_English: Submarine service to start in Dhaka ahead of monsoon season
Content_English:
The rainy season has begun with light or torrential rain in the morning and afternoon, and in Dhaka, the rainy season means that the areas turn into rivers. Keeping such conditions in Dhaka in mind during the rainy season, a submarine service is going to be started in various areas of Dhaka. A company called Turag Jalpori is going to launch this service with the thought that people do not have to go to the office while getting wet and drowning in the rain. When we tried to talk to an official of Turag Jalpori to know the details of the service, he told us, "Look, it is unfair not to have such a service in a river-based country. For the past few years, we have seen that Mirpur or Bashundhara are turning into channels when the rainy season comes, and ordinary people are crossing these areas by swimming or in boats, getting wet. Our initiative is to make people's lives easier. Initially, we will start providing our services on Mirpur Channel and Bashundhara Channel, later on, our services will also start on other channels as per the demand. 

The news of the submarine service is causing a flood of joy among the employed people, many of whom have even bought a monthly package to go to the office by submarine throughout the rainy season. However, it is now up to us to see how the submarines will reach their destination on time despite being underwater and stuck in Dhaka's traffic jam.

Headline_English: Russia, Ukraine declare one-day ceasefire for mango elections
Content_English:
The mango election is going to be held at 6 pm today. It will continue till 6 am. Mango lovers around the world are making various preparations for this election. Putin and Zelensky are also very excited about the mango election. The two countries have also announced a one-day ceasefire on the occasion of the election. 

Mango is very dear to Putin. Along with Bangladeshi mangoes, he also eats foreign mangoes. He is a fan of amrapali. This world leader said that if he had the opportunity to vote, he would have voted for amrapali. In one of his speeches, he said, 'The last time I ate amrapali, I was so enchanted that I even ate the fruit. Hehe.' Online Bazaar 

Although Zelensky's choice is Himsagar. The vote will also go to the Himsagar box. Zelensky, who was excited about the opportunity to vote, said, 'Many salutes to you. You have given the opportunity to vote for the dead, you have given the opportunity to vote for foreigners. I have never seen such a liberal election before.’ 

Why did you declare a ceasefire during the day, even though the vote was at night? To our question, Putin said, ‘I will sleep during the day and vote at night.’

Headline_English: Joe Biden expresses disappointment that there is no bridge named after him in America
Content_English:
Joe Biden's rise to power after Trump was a big event in America. Many people think that Joe Biden saved America from destruction. But there is no bridge in the whole of America named after Joe Biden. This American president recently expressed his disappointment about this issue. 

Biden expressed his disappointment after the announcement of the construction of a bridge in the name of a mayor in Uganda. From one of his fake IDs, Biden said, 'I have been running America for so long, but I do not have a bridge in my name. Far from a bridge - there is not even a culvert. So what is the use of doing so much in life?' 

Biden also blamed his fate for being born in America. Biden said, 'I would have been better off born in Uganda. I would have elected a city corporation there. I would have become mayor. I would have built a bridge in my name.'

Headline_English: Rohit, Virat want to become Mumbai Development Authority chairman
Content_English:
After losing the Gazipur City Corporation elections, Ajmal Ullah has joined as the chairman of the Gazipur Development Authority as a reward. Even after losing the Test Championship final with Australia recently, Rohit and Virat want to take the responsibility of the Mumbai Development Authority as a reward like Azmat Ullah. 

While explaining his demand, Rohit Sharma said, ‘Two rules cannot operate in the same world. Since Azmat bhai is getting a reward after losing, we should also give a reward. This should be the rule.’ 

Virat Kohli said, ‘If we don’t get the responsibility of the Mumbai Development Authority, then what is the point of losing so hard? Azmat bhai, are we not human?’ 

Virat Kohli also commented that Rohit and Virat have been cheated twice. He said, ‘Before this, we lost to New Zealand, we got nothing. This time too, we got nothing. "It is unacceptable to be repeatedly deprived in this way, even though it is a more developed country than Bangladesh." 

Another cricketer also commented that if the demands are not met, he will leave cricket and go to Bangladesh and lose the election.

Headline_English: Decision to evict people from Dhaka from areas where water does not rise during the rains
Content_English:
Rain in Dhaka city means water. From Gulistan to Gulshan, from Mirpur to Uttara—everyone has to walk in knee-deep water. But even in all this, there are some places where no matter how much it rains, water does not rise. Even in Dhaka, water does not rise—such injustice cannot be accepted. That is why the country's civil society has said in a fake statement that those in areas where water does not rise will no longer be kept in Dhaka city. They will be deported. While explaining the statement, a representative of the civil society said, 'What kind of thing is this that water does not rise during the rain? This cannot be accepted in a free country. Those who do not have water do not have the right to live in this city.' 

To ensure equality, the government should provide water even where water does not rise. This was said by another representative of the civil society. In an interview, he said, 'Equality must be ensured. If necessary, arrangements must be made to raise water in those areas where water does not rise. If necessary, water will be provided by Dhaka WASA. 

A leader of the ruling party has accepted the demands of the people of Dhaka. He said from one of his fake IDs, "We have started work. We are also planning a foreign trip. Hopefully, if this foreign trip goes well, we will be able to solve this problem."

Headline_English: Everyone wants to get a visa, some get it, some don't.
Content_English:
After a lot of confusion over the nomination for the Dhaka-17 seat that fell vacant after the death of Nayak Farooq, Mohammad Arafat has finally been nominated by the Awami League. On the other hand, Hollywood superstar Tom Cruise is coming to Dhaka to contest for this seat along with Hero Alam as Arafat's rival. 

Why is he so interested in the Dhaka seat, leaving his own country? When we wanted to talk to Cruz Bhai to find out, he told us from his private plane, 'I saw that your country's heroes and heroines are very interested in this seat. Seeing their interest, I also became interested in what is here that superstars are crazy about? Besides, the roads in this seat look like Europe and America. I hope that if I fight from here, I will get the feel of my own country.' 

When asked who he wants for his election campaign, Cruz Bhai told us, 'Riyaz-Ferdous brothers are my first choice for the campaign. "I have also arranged for trucks to be brought from Europe so that they can properly dance and sing and campaign for me."

Headline_English: Lionel Messi left for America before the election to avoid new visa policy
Content_English:
Lionel Messi is leaving PSG to join the American soccer club Inter Miami. The best of all time in European football will no longer be seen in European football. But why such a sudden decision? Why not Spain, England or Germany? Why America? Such rumors have been circulating from all sides. 



Messi said, 'He has taken such a decision to avoid the new American visa policy. That is why he is changing teams before the elections.' 

Talking about the matter, Lionel Messi said, 'It has been a long-standing hobby to go to America. My wife and children also want to go. That is why I decided to leave earlier. Elections are ahead. What will happen? You can't say. If I don't get a visa later! I will cope with the sadness of not being able to vote, but how will I cope with the sadness of not being able to go to America?' 

What are your future plans after going to America? When asked, Messi said, 'I used to play football, now I will play soccer.' 

Messi became eager to go to America immediately after the announcement of the new visa policy. This football legend could not find any other option except America. Messi said, 'America is my last hope. I don't have a house in Begumpara anymore.

Headline_English: Review of Awami League-BNP chase and counter-chase on social media
Content_English:
Yesterday, a social media post-chasing battle took place between the ruling party Awami League and the opposition BNP on social media. Yesterday morning, BNP posted on its official Facebook page, ‘Even Hurricane himself did not think that he would regain his full youth in this era of 100% electricity.’ The post has so far received 39,000 reactions, 2,000 comments and more than 7,000 shares. 

In response, at the beginning of their innings, a verified page named ‘Bangladesh Awami League’ posted another post. This post highlights the various irregularities and mismanagement of the electricity sector by the BNP government from 2001 to 2006. As of the writing of this report, the Bangladesh Awami League post has received 8,500 reactions, 1,500 comments and more than 1,600 shares. 
After the first innings, BNP also started their second innings well. The post with the copy ‘Hasina Sarkar’s progress, candle after evening’ has so far received 19 thousand reactions, 1200 comments and 3200 shares. 
In its second innings, the Awami League also focused on playing the Past. This post, which reminisces about the Khamba era, received 2300 reactions, 427 comments and 610 shares. To keep itself in the game, the Awami League’s Facebook page played another inning this morning. ‘Why is Hurricane so popular with BNP?’ also scored quite well. According to the latest news, the post received about 650 reactions, 124 comments and 48 shares in an hour. 

This social media war between the two political parties in the country has caught the attention of netizens. Along with the supporters of both parties, netizens also expressed their interest in the issue on social media. Some have also called such a social media war quite beneficial for democracy. One such person said, ‘If you can go to their posts and make funny comments, your followers will increase. This is really good for democracy.’ 

Global politicians have expressed their admiration for BNP’s first innings. One such person said, ‘We didn’t know that BNP could play such great social media sports. We thought that BNP was like Bangladesh cricket team of 15 years ago and Awami League’s Chaminda Bhas. Whose 4 wickets were supposed to go in the first over. But they played such a great first innings, it is really extraordinary.’ 

Some have also called BNP’s so many reactions as auto reactions. One such person said, ‘They played well. But I think all the reactions, comments, shares were actually taken by bots. These are actually auto runs. Thukku auto reactions. These can be edited, brother. We don’t believe in auto runs.’ 

Many have also called the second innings of Awami League’s page a classic case in the history of counter attacks. One such person said, ‘The last time I saw such a counter attack was Mbappe. Then Awami League. Really a feast for the eyes.’ 

Meanwhile, a special group of vice-presidents seemed a little worried about such social media wires of the two parties. They are thinking, what will happen on the streets if everything goes on social media like this? If there is no work on the streets, what will happen to the vice-presidents? How will they run their families? They have compared such social media sports to farce, sports of killing the poor and vice-presidents kicking in the stomach.

Headline_English: Power plants also shut down in Europe and America
Content_English:
The Payra Thermal Power Plant is temporarily closed due to the Yola crisis. It may take another 20-25 days to purchase coal and start it up. Although there is much criticism from all sides about the issue, many in the government do not see it as a problem. One such official said from his fake ID, ‘Power plants are also closed in Europe and America.’ 

Explaining his statement, he said, ‘Look at Europe and America. They also have problems, their power plants are also closed. That is why their development does not stop! Our development will not stop either. If one plant is closed, more plants will be closed if necessary, but development will continue.’ 

At this time, he also shared an experience of his own. This official said, ‘I went to Europe a few days ago. One of their historians there told me how they faced problems with electricity more than 50 years ago. As such, we are facing such problems much later. This is good news for the people of the country. 

The official urged the people of the country to speak with some intelligence and consideration instead of making unnecessary criticism. He said, "If you turn on something, you have to turn it off. If you turn on a fan, motor, or light in your house, don't you turn it off? It's the same thing. The Payra power plant has also been shut down like this. The plant also needs some rest. They are machines, not people."

Headline_English: Dhaka wants to enter Guinness Book of World Records for being at the top in air pollution
Content_English:
Dhaka is always at the top in air pollution. Not only at the top, but it doesn't give up its top spot. If it makes a mistake and falls behind once, the next day it comes back to the top by spraying more air! Now, it has decided to get its name in the Guinness Book of Records because of its talent. Dhaka claims that if my name is not in the Guinness Book of Records, I will actually be disrespected! 

When Dhaka was given a fake interview on this matter, Dhaka said, 'I am always first. Even the first boy in the school falls behind at some point. But I am not going, I have retained my place. And with the situation in Dhaka, I believe that no one will be able to take my place for the next 100 years. So I have that honorable place to write my name in the Guinness Book of Records! In fact, that place is a place that I deserve. How will it be if I don't get it? I have applied for the form, just give me the form and it will be done. 

Meanwhile, we do not know the identity of those who wrote their names in the Guinness Book of Records, but what happened to them? They informed us through a fake letter, 'We have given the form to Dhaka. It would be really good if Dhaka wrote its own name here. We believe, Dhaka deserves this.' 

It is said that this time Rajshahi has also taken the road to beat Dhaka, it was seen that the field is being cleaned and all the sand is being brought to the road.

Headline_English: Everyone in Gazipur is getting visas to America; CNN leaks secret message
Content_English:
The Gazipur City Corporation elections have been held. According to a leaked information by CNN, America is giving visas to everyone in Gazipur for this election. Although nothing is known specifically about why they are giving visas. 

However, it is believed that America has decided to give these visas based on the recent elections in Gazipur. Based on a fake news from America, it has been learned that they will give American visas to people not only in Gazipur but also in several districts around Gazipur. 

Meanwhile, even if visas are given to all the people of Gazipur, visas will not be given to the grave dwellers and nocturnal democrats. They have expressed various anger over the matter. A man came out of the grave and said, 'We voted in all the previous elections, whenever the American visa was involved in the elections, we were excluded? Why? Why? Why?' 

The people of nocturnal democrats have also protested. One such person said, 'We have been working all night before. We have not done it this time! So why won't we get American visas?'

Headline_English: Pressure to get married is increasing in community centers in North Dhaka
Content_English:
Suddenly, a wave of marriages is sweeping through the community centers of North Dhaka. One after another, marriages are being crushed and crushed in the centers. Today, our incompetent reporter left home to find the reason for such a sudden storm of marriages. 



This incompetent reporter spoke to the owner of a community center in Uttara. He told us, ‘I had no pressure here at all for a long time. Marriages were happening according to the normal rules, but they were not happening. Suddenly, who or what did they do in South Dhaka? The wave of marriages has increased here! I am now renting the center in the form of a schedule. Weddings start at 5 am and are completing a total of 5 marriages by midnight.’ 

As soon as I got down from that center and stood on the street, a masked man came and said, ‘These are nothing but forms of marriage, brother. He is saying this to save his life. In fact, South Dhaka is imposing a tax on marriages. That is why all the people of South Dhaka are secretly coming here and getting married. On the other hand, if I get married, I will have to pay money. Let me tell you another thing, you heard that Kaur did not marry. I was already married 3 times, now I don't have any wives. You think, will I survive? If I had lived in South Dhaka, I would have become a fakir.

Headline_English: Sweet bitter gourd has arrived in the market, can be eaten raw too
Content_English:
When you see bitter gourd, do you remember your mother's extreme anger and your screaming at the top of your lungs when you were a child? Do you remember how your mother would forcefully mix bitter gourd with rice and burn it in your mouth, saying it was vitamin C? If you start to have PTSD just by looking at bitter gourd, then sweet gourd is coming to the market for you, which can be eaten raw too! 

Entrepreneur Fahim Hasan has launched a new type of bitter gourd in the market with the slogan 'The days of bitter gourd are over, sweet gourd will be delicious!' When asked about the motivation behind his innovative business, the new entrepreneur, who passed out from NSU, said, 'I cried a lot when I was young, vowing not to eat bitter gourd. I decided at the age of 6 while crying that if I don't see the benefits of bitter gourd in this life, I will tear up my BBA certificate and float it in the water.' 

Meanwhile, when contacting Fahim Hasan's mother, it was learned that she is very proud of her son's work! To express her pride, she has cooked a kilogram of bitter gourd for her son. Although, as of the last news, it is not yet known whether it is bitter gourd or sweet gourd. However, the reporters were able to get some idea about it from the way his mother painted her eyes.

Headline_English: Amazon forest is being cut down to create flower gardens, modeled after Dhaka
Content_English:
Like killing a cow and giving shoes, large trees have been cut down on Dhaka's Satmasjid Road and flower gardens have been planted. Although the incident has angered the city dwellers, taking inspiration from this incident, a flower garden is being cut down in the Amazon jungle, just like in Dhaka. Although some local residents of Amazon have formed a human chain over this, the forest authorities are continuing their work in full swing, unlike the Dhaka South City Corporation, without taking the matter into consideration. 

When asked about the statement of the mayor of Amazon South on this matter, he said, 'You see, no one likes the jungle. And if you want to beautify it, trees will have to be cut down. Although it is sad, there is nothing we can do about it, but I promise that even if the trees are cut down, I will make Amazon as beautiful as Satmasjid Road.' 

On the other hand, when asked what flower trees will be planted there, a responsible official told us on the condition that we follow his TikTok account, 'We are trying to communicate with the Dhaka South City Corporation. I want to plant the same flower trees that have been planted on Satmasjid Road here. We already have a budget of hundreds of crores of taka and a team of government officials ready to go to Bangladesh to see and buy flower trees.

Headline_English: Programmer ends up in jail after changing profession due to lack of internet in Pakistan
Content_English:
For some time now, the internet has been completely shut down in Pakistan. The extent of the problem it is causing to the common people has not been taken into consideration. However, programmers are quitting their jobs! It is learnt that they have stepped on the path of ending up in jail after quitting programming. When we did a fake interview with one such ex-programmer, he told us, ‘We are programmers. Do we have speed without the internet? We could have accepted it if the internet was shut down for a day. But how can we do this day after day? We have to make ends meet. So, when we couldn’t, we quit our jobs. If we will work in prison from now on, why won’t we need the internet and electricity? Then the government can shut down the electricity if it wants!’ 

However, the Pakistani jailers are unable to accept this! One by one, they are calling us in jails to express their anger. They are telling us that there are already prisons in different directions. We are somehow managing our lives. Now if programmers also come and gather in groups like this, we will get kicked in the stomach. What are they asking the government to give them and still let us live! 

Meanwhile, not only programmers, but also people from CSC engineers and all professions that require internet connection, such as fishermen, farmers, and cobblers, are taking up various professions!

Headline_English: Ronaldo tells Messi to bring everything he needs before coming to Saudi Arabia
Content_English:
