Messi is joining a Saudi club… such is the rumor that is being heard all around. Meanwhile, a completely unreliable source has learned that Ronaldo, believing this rumor, has already sent Messi a list of things to bring for himself. 

Ronaldo has given a list of things to bring, including gastric medicine, hash browns, shimful pitha, beef roast. It is learned that 2 sando jerseys, 2 gamchas and 2 lungis are also on this list. 

When Ronaldo spoke to a fake ID, he admitted the truth of the matter. Ronaldo said, ‘No one has come from the country for a long time. I can’t even bring invoices. I felt better when I heard that Messi will come. I asked him to bring some things. He will come and stay at my house for two days.’ 

Meanwhile, Messi’s wife Rukozz reacted somewhat angrily to Ronaldo’s behavior. In a secret Facebook live from his fake ID, he said, "My brother's brother-in-law wants to send some things for my brother Talto. Now Ronaldo brother who asked to bring so many things, doesn't he have any common sense?"

Headline_English: Brazilians call for cutting down trees in the Amazon for beautification
Content_English:
Brazilian citizens have called for the cutting of trees in the Amazon to enhance the beauty of the forest. It is known that they are forming human chains in the areas around the Amazon jungle with placards reading ‘Remove trees, increase beauty’. We have also learned from local sources that some are trying to cut trees themselves. 

A conscious Brazilian citizen who is in favor of beautification called us on an e-mail from abroad at midnight, ‘If there are trees, it is a problem, the trees have to be watered regularly. The biggest thing is that the entire area needs to be completely jungle for trees. Therefore, our earnest request to the Brazilian government is to cut down the trees as soon as possible to enhance the beauty. If they do not have a plan in mind, they can talk to the mayors of Dhaka. If possible, a team of 420 government employees should be sent to Bangladesh from our country. They should come with training on cutting trees and enhancing beauty and clean up this jungle.’ 

When we tried to talk to the mayor of the Amazon about this, he said, ‘We are thinking very deeply about the matter. Dear guardian, the fighting soldier of the highway, cuts down trees and clears the forest daily. Our dear Tapas Bhai has already given us necessary guidelines in this regard. I hope to be able to start the forest clearing process in the next few days.

Headline_English: Demand for opportunity to write 'detailed first comment' in exam notebooks
Content_English:
Students have various demands regarding the exam. This time, they seem to be above all demands. Like the news media, they also want to write the details of the answers in the comments. Only the heading will be in the notebook. For the rest, you will have to see the first comment! 



When we spoke to one of the students who had gathered in Shahbagh about this demand, he told us, ‘I don’t like to write so much in this short time in the notebook, brother. We are students, it is better to make our lives as easy as possible. If you give us such a difficult system, our minds will be distracted from studying. So this is our demand! We will write the question on the notebook and write below it with a blue pen, ‘Details in the first comment.’ Then there will be a news link on the next page. That’s it! Life is beautiful.’ 

A young rickshaw puller from the crowd said, ‘If the educational institution takes this measure, then let me know too. I will give the SSC exam in 2024. Seeing that I was failing in SSC, my father bought me a rickshaw. But if this opportunity comes now, I won't miss it.' 

Meanwhile, some people from the back of the crowd started saying, 'Why do we have to take the exam? We can just post it on Facebook. If a fill-in works, then the exam!'

Headline_English: Neymar asks Messi for bKash recharge at midnight
Content_English:
Brazil and PSG star Neymar asked his old friend Messi for a recharge in the middle of the night after his mobile balance ran out. The incident started after the Argentine team made bKash their regional partner. However, it is not just Neymar who asked for a recharge. After learning that there is a partnership with bKash, Neymar and Hakimi have also been regularly bothering Messi to recharge his mobile at night. 

When Messi was called to verify the truth of the incident, he immediately said, 'I have no more money in bKash.' Later, when we introduced ourselves, he told us in a somewhat angry tone, 'What a situation, brother! After hearing the news of the partnership with bKash, the boys are making my life miserable. I can't even spend a little time with your bhabhi at night. They are burning one after another, my bKash money is all gone.' 

Regarding Messi's annoyance, Neymar said, 'I was hurt to hear about it. I don't have a bKash account and bKash has no agreement with Brazil. I used to consider Messi my brother, but I didn't know that he considers me his brother. I won't call him again from now on, I'll recharge from my Nagad account if I need it.

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir liked the song Deora.
Content_English:
The new song Deora from Coke Studio Bangla Season 2 was released last night. Although the audience has received mixed reactions to the song, BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir liked the song quite a lot. One line in particular has been remembered by this renowned opposition leader. 
He also thanked everyone involved for a line after 2 minutes and 45 seconds of the song. Mirza also thanked Pritam Hasan for singing the line beautifully. 

While expressing his feelings about this line, Mirza Fakhrul said from his fake ID, 'I hear this line every day in my dreams. But I can't quite grasp it. Listening to the song on Coke Studio Bangla, it seems that this tune, this word, I and we have been humming for thousands of years. It is like the tune of our roots.' 

It has been falsely reported from secret sources that all BNP workers and supporters have been made mandatory to listen to the song Deora from Coke Studio Bangla. In addition, everyone has been instructed to memorize the special line.

Headline_English: AC sales have decreased in North Dhaka, says survey
Content_English:
Recently, in this intense heat, the sale of ACs has increased all over the country. People were buying ACs like they were buying daily necessities. Many even sold their kidneys to buy ACs. But since midnight yesterday, the sale of ACs has suddenly decreased in North Dhaka. We were also not able to understand the reason for such a mysterious incident! Later, through a secret source, we learned that an alternative to heat has been appointed in North Dhaka! When we asked what the alternative to heat could be, we learned that a Chief Heat Officer has been appointed in North Dhaka! Who, spitting fire in his own form, has taken the responsibility of reducing the heat in his region. 

The survey says that people have stopped buying ACs by trusting this Chief Heat Officer. Many even want to sell the ACs they bought before! Meanwhile, all the AC traders are losing their minds. They are seeing red lights in business! It is known that if this continues, there is a possibility of leaving North Dhaka.

Headline_English: Messi to inaugurate 36 commercials and 38 stores in two weeks
Content_English:
PSG has banned Messi for traveling to Saudi Arabia without permission. To utilize this period of ban, the Argentine star has taken up the task of launching 36 advertisements and 38 stores. It is known that he will travel to 11 countries including Dubai, Singapore, and Thailand during this period for the shooting of advertisements. 

While expressing his excitement about the matter, Messi told us in Bangla, (yes, our Messi can speak Bangla), It is good. ‘I am already studying in Saudi Arabia. Now it will take less time to go to Dubai.’ 

At the same time, Messi will attend a gold shop and a wedding reception in Dubai. He will also take a selfie for 1500 taka at the wedding reception. 

There is a lot of criticism about Messi for doing so many advertisements. However, Messi is not very worried about the matter. Do you feel bad about these criticisms? To our question, Messi said, "Stay away from feeling bad, I don't see it." 

Meanwhile, a confidential source has revealed that in addition to advertising and store openings, Messi will also try to learn the stock market business during this vacation.

Headline_English: Saudi Arabia tops goat imports
Content_English:
According to a global survey, Saudi Arabia is the top importer of goats this year. Their best target this year is to import expensive goats from different countries. Even the imported goats are famous goats. 
Our reporter wanted to know how they feel about being at the top of goat imports. Then, a person from Saudi Arabia made a video call to our fake imo number, keeping his identity secret, and said, 'We are very happy to be able to import these expensive and famous goats into our country. Right now, we are only at the top. After a few days, you will see that goats will not be found anywhere else except Saudi Arabia.' 

Meanwhile, the goats are also very happy to be able to go to Saudi in groups. They are expressing their joy to everyone by uploading selfies and new pictures every day. 

A secret source has learned that the grass of Saudi Arabia is the main attraction for the goats. They have never seen such beautiful grass anywhere else.

Headline_English: Alam Company starts producing new rickshaws ahead of SSC exams
Content_English:
The SSC exam has started today. Along with the examinees, guardians are also worried. All their worries are about what will happen to their children's exam results. However, in the meantime, a famous company in the country, Alam Company, has produced 5,000 rickshaws overnight. Their target is to produce 20,000 rickshaws and 10,000 vans before the end of the exam. 
When asked why so many rickshaws and vans are being produced suddenly, the company's CEO told us, 'What should we produce, whether we produce rickshaws and vans or not? After failing the exam, all the boys will use these rickshaws and vans. In the meantime, a group of people who are not taking the exam are also buying rickshaws in the hope of getting married. This is the only season for us to make a profit.' 

Checking their sales list, it was found that 1,000 rickshaws were sold this morning. These 1,000 rickshaws were bought by guardians, boyfriends of SSC examinees, and many others who did not disclose their identities. 

However, it is still unclear whether parents will agree to hand over rickshaws to boys and rickshaw pullers to girls after they fail.

Headline_English: Reading bank messages after Eid holiday is harmful to health, says study
Content_English:
The excitement of Eid is almost over, people have started returning to their daily lives. However, the problem is, after finishing all the salary bonuses on Eid, many people now feel sick just looking at their bank accounts. Therefore, researchers have banned the common people from checking bank messages until the next month's salary arrives. A recent fake study has shown that checking bank messages during this time can cause diseases like heart attack, high blood pressure and diabetes. 

One such fake researcher told us, 'I first discovered the matter through my own personal experience. After 3/4 days of Eid, as soon as I checked my bank messages to know my money account, I felt a slight pain in my chest or side, later when I asked my junior research fellow to check the messages, the same thing happened to him. Then we started extensive research on the incident and when we saw the results, it was a complete surprise. We were really surprised. Therefore, our appeal to the common people is to refrain from checking bank messages for the next few days if you want to stay healthy. 

We have learned that a brother from Badda has already fallen ill after secretly checking bank messages instead of following the researchers' advice. When we sent a message to the brother to find out why he did such a thing, he did not even check our messages out of fear.

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader owns the highest share in Eid's film
Content_English:
On the day of Eid, various stars from different classes and professions have uploaded their Eid pictures on Facebook. Fans and admirers have flooded those pictures with love emojis, as well as expressed their love by commenting and sharing. 

However, Obaidul Quader's Eid album has surpassed all the others in terms of shares, surpassing all the stars from various fields. This Eid album of 7 pictures of him wearing a gray waistcoat and black glasses on a golden colored Punjabi has been shared by fans more than 7,900 times. In the caption of the album, he wished everyone Eid Mubarak.

Headline_English: This year, the Eid salami per person has been set at 99 to 25 thousand taka.
Content_English:
On Friday, the National Salami Development Salami Determination Committee held a virtual meeting in the meeting room of the Eid Salami Sangha to determine the salami rate for the year 1444 Hijri. The meeting was presided over by the President of the National Salami Development Committee and the committee members. 

According to the decision of the meeting, salami received through saree or Punjabi will not be considered as taxable, only salami development will be taxable. Or the market price of any gift will be determined. So that the recipient of the salami can spend it on the necessary sector according to his wishes. Because a survey based on the experience of previous years has shown that 98% of Eid gifts do not match the size. 

In this regard, the general secretary of the committee said, 'Every time, the elders and the children quarrel over the amount of salami has become a regular thing. This time, the National Eid Salami Committee has decided in advance how much salami can be sold to avoid scams. 

On the other hand, the Joint General Secretary of the committee said, "We have also noticed the issue of cheating with salami during Eid. That is why this time an attempt has been made to bring it into a rule. So that salami seekers do not go into shock after facing any unwanted incident. And this amount will remain in force until further instructions come." 

Our local representatives said that the Eid Salami Lovers Committee expressed joy over this incident and took out processions in some areas. Many of them were seen distributing sweets with the slogan 'Eid moon in the sky, salami in the development' on microphones.

Headline_English: Students return to campus to celebrate Eid with department and club families
Content_English:
We celebrate Eid on the 22nd or 23rd of April as soon as the moon is sighted. We have known for a lifetime that everyone's dream is to go home before Eid. But this time it is a completely different homecoming. The dream is to go to the department and club before Eid. 
When we spoke to the president of the Charukala Cultural Club about such a different initiative, he told us, 'I have always celebrated Eid with my family. But since I joined the university, these classmates, seniors, juniors, they are our family. Would it be nice to celebrate Eid with them? So we are all coming from home to the university. This time we will celebrate Eid with our club family.' 

A survey revealed that 3,000 students from about 30 universities in the country are returning from home for the university. Everyone has one light of hope, one joy. They will celebrate Eid with their families. 

It is known that this time the song will also be sung in a completely different style. "My dream will be campus." All students will return to campus with this song in a video!

Headline_English: The countrymen want a rain-seeing committee before the moon-sighting committee
Content_English:
The countrymen have a new demand. The society said that this cannot be called an unfair demand. They wanted a rain-watching committee along with the moon-sighting committee. What will they do with the rain-watching committee? Is it profitable or what? 
When such a question was thrown, a young man standing at the Shahbagh intersection said, 'There is a moon-sighting committee. They see the moon and tell us when Eid will happen or not. It feels good. But who will see the rain? Who will put an end to this staring day and night in the hope of rain? For now, seeing the rain has become more necessary than seeing the moon. Due to the heat, my feet are sweating and my head is sweating. We can't do it anymore.' 

But why do we need a new committee if there is a Meteorological Department? Such a question slipped out of our fat-bellied reporter. Then a young man from the side said, 'Does the Meteorological Department say exactly like the moon-sighting committee, that clouds have been seen in the sky and that it will rain tomorrow? It doesn't say! Where is the brain Raikha coming to do journalism? 

As trouble was coming our way, we left and found out, "They are considering forming this rain-watching committee by hiring a few people from Chandpur."

Headline_English: Putting snow pictures on your profile reduces heat, says study
Content_English:
If you put a picture of snow on your Facebook profile, the heat will instantly decrease. A recent study has revealed such information. At one stage of a research on reducing heat, a researcher at the Bangladesh Heat Research Center (BAGK) found that when he put a picture of snow on his profile, he felt less hot. Later, like Archimedes, he came live and shouted "Eureka Eureka" and confirmed the matter. 

When we tried to find out the details of the incident with the researcher, he said, "I am surprised, bro! While researching how to reduce heat, our feet were sweating. But, we could not reduce the heat in any way. Finally, one day, I suddenly put a picture of snow on my profile as a hobby. It seemed like snowfall was happening around me. I hope that this discovery of mine will make the lives of ordinary people easier. Besides, no one will be able to say much about cutting trees." 

A brother who benefited from putting a picture of snow on his profile told us, "I pray from the bottom of my heart for the researcher brother. Brother saved me the cost of buying an AC. I'm not changing this profile until the heat is over. I have a request to my brother, if you can discover a theory that putting a picture of a fire on your profile on a winter day makes it feel less cold, it would be very helpful.

Headline_English: Fight in Brahmanbaria over whether AC temperature should be 18 or 20
Content_English:
An unbearable heat is sweeping over Bangladesh. In the heat wave, today we are in Saudi Arabia and tomorrow we will be in Dubai. ACs are burning in every house, but it is not comfortable. Yet, our brothers of Brahmanbaria are unable to stop fighting in this heat. Last night, 5 people were injured in a fight over whether the AC temperature should be 18 or 20, and 2 people are sitting there pretending to be killed. 

At that time, an elder brother of the area named Maqsud, who was present at the scene, told us, 'There was a fight between two of my closest younger brothers. They were sitting in a shop in the market and having tea. Suddenly, Iqbal changed the AC temperature from 18 to 20, and that's when the riot started! Iqbal said that if you keep it at 20, the cold will be perfect. Meanwhile, Joni believes that if you don't set it to 18, the house will stay hot. At first, we argued, but then in the blink of an eye, both of us became close. 

When we went to Johnny, who was lying on the hospital bed, he said to us, "What does that Iqbal's child know about AC? Does he see AC in his life? I have been living under AC since birth, and I have AC in my bathroom. Who else but me will know when the AC temperature is perfect? ​​It has been hot for two days, AC is in my eyes, and now it is all about calculations. I will only come back after I recover, and I will see him." 

When we wanted to talk to Iqbal, Iqbal told us through a beautiful nurse that he was not willing to talk. However, Iqbal's nurse whispered in our ears, "Maqsud Bhai told Johnny to do this."

Headline_English: Development activities underway in Sundarbans; Royal Bengal Tiger cutting down trees and installing ACs
Content_English:
ACs are being installed in the Sundarbans by cutting down trees. The Royal Bengal Tiger himself has taken the initiative! It is known that he has decided to cut down half of the trees, even if he does not cut down all the trees. 

When we interviewed the Royal Bengal Tiger on this matter, he told us, ‘Development is happening everywhere in the world. But I noticed that there is no development in our Sundarbans. The trees are still lying like in the past. No one is cutting down trees. How long will this continue? We also want to breathe some AC air, see big buildings. How long will this natural air last?’ 

It is also known that there is a plan to cut down one AC for every 10 trees. They are even talking to various developer companies! They also want houses in this houseless jungle! 

A Bengal Tiger said, ‘We will now live in high-rise buildings, breathe AC air, and not keep so many trees. We do not need these anymore.’

Headline_English: Elon Musk sat on the road with money from Iftar party
Content_English:
The month of Ramadan means a huge Iftar party. But, this Iftar party sometimes becomes the only way to cut throats. This time too, it happened! Friends from the neighborhood, friends from primary school, friends from high school, friends from college, friends from university, cousins, juniors, and many more Iftar parties. However, it is okay to sit in the way of ordinary people, why Elon Musk? He has no shortage of money. 

When we threw such a question at Elon Musk, he angrily said to us, ‘I could understand that you journalists will do a 5 taka news for 2 taka. We friends spread papers on the street in a little aesthetic way and sat there having Iftar. That's why you made the news, Elon Musk sat on the street. You will all be hanged in jail!’ 

But before the hanging in jail, this news reached everyone overnight. One of the elder brother community, who had just become a senior at the university, came to us and said, ‘I understand Elon brother’s situation. All the money brought from home is gone, the money to support the big leaders is also gone. Now all that is left is to rob.’ 

Meanwhile, Azmain from Gulshan told us very simply, ‘I don’t have a shortage of money from my father. I will sponsor Elon Bro with the money for the few Iftar fests that are left now. Father won’t be angry at all!’

Headline_English: World Desert Association invites Dhaka to become a member
Content_English:
The World Desert Association has invited Dhaka to join its organization as a member for fulfilling almost all the criteria. They announced this today in a tweet from the fake Twitter account of the Desert Association. The world's Bagha Bagha Desert experts congratulated Dhaka on this achievement. 

One such expert said in an interview with our reporter, 'I am very happy. Once upon a time, Dhaka was quite green, which used to make me very sad. However, the charisma that Dhaka has shown through cutting down trees and unplanned urbanization in the last few decades will be an example for all other cities in the world. I congratulate the mayor of Dhaka and all its residents on this achievement of being upgraded as a desert.' 

The vice president of the World Desert Association told us, 'We have been sending our observation team to Dhaka for the past few years. We have taken this decision this year based on the report they received. Dhaka has the lowest number of trees in the country, along with dust, black smoke from cars, and intense heat, all of which are necessary for a complete desert. So this membership is a gift from us to Dhaka. 

On the other hand, as a result of such achievements, joyous processions can be seen in several places in Mirpur. We learned that people from surrounding areas are also bringing bags full of dust to join the joy of the Mirpur residents.

Headline_English: Gold plated hilsa-panta launched on the occasion of Baishakh
Content_English:
After Jilapi, now on the occasion of Pohela Baishakh, Gold Plated Hilsa-Panta has come to the market. Ever since this menu of Hotel Rupargaon came, a flood of joy has been flowing in the minds of Boishakh lovers. The item was completely out of stock within a few minutes of its availability online. 

When asked how it is different from the usual Hilsa Panta, the head chef of Rupargaon sent us a large Hilsa head to fry in a pan and told us, ‘I saw that Gold Plated Jilapi had created a stir in the market as an Iftari item. So I thought why should we lag behind? We have first marinated the Hilsa fish with imported gold in a gold pan and then fried it in Sonamukhi brand oil. You can say that the entire process will be done through gold. I can guarantee that you will be completely satisfied by eating this hilsa-panta.’ 

However, the problem is that even after pre-booking, many people are coming and eating the hilsa-panta booked by others. There have already been several rounds of hilsa throwing between the two sides over this. At one point, the hotel’s push shower was used to disperse the rioters to calm the situation.

Headline_English: Hoteliers are selling grill machines this summer
Content_English:
It has become everyone's responsibility to survive the heat. People cannot even be pulled out from under the AC and fans. However, hoteliers have taken all the necessary measures. It is learnt that they are selling all the hotel's grill machines! 

When our reporter Abul went to the hotel, they told us, 'We had 10 grill machines. We haven't kept a single one. We are throwing them all away! What can we do with a grill machine in this heat? If you wrap the chicken in paper with spices and put some salt in it, it will become a full grill. We will buy many broilers with the money for the grill machine.' 

Apart from selling grill machines, the businessmen are not seen selling hot water. They are making everything from tea to coffee with water directly from the tap. 

A businessman who did not want to be named said, 'No one cares. We have given vegetables and fish in tanks at the same time. "I'll come to you with a tap and tell you that it's really spicy. No problem!"

Headline_English: Attendance at universities with AC is 100%: Study
Content_English:
A recent survey has shown that students in universities with properly functioning ACs have 100% attendance. Students who were previously undetectable even in a hurricane are now attending classes regularly. The survey also found that not only students, but also evasive teachers are now showing up at the university ahead of schedule. 

However, AC is the only reason for this 100% attendance of students, not studies. When asked about this, a student said, ‘What’s the point of lying? There are no such crazy people in this country who would regularly attend classes for the sake of education. I can’t stay at home in the heat. So I come to class. Because our classes have AC.’ 

Another student, who asked not to be named, said, ‘I don’t rely on class attendance. Where there is AC, I am there. There is AC in the class, so I come to class.’ 

Universities with AC are struggling to cope with the pressure of students. When asked why this is happening, the Vice-Chancellor of Northeastern University said, "It was expected that as many students would come as there were seats. But now, in the name of surveys, people like you come every day and enter the classroom and never come out. This is disrupting the students' proper environment to breathe the air of the AC. I hope you will also visit various shopping malls, showrooms, etc. in addition to the university. This will reduce the pressure on us."

Headline_English: NASA receives legal notice to halt Mars mission
Content_English:
NASA has received a legal notice to stop the mission to Mars. This notice was sent mainly because the word Mars is in the name of the planet. It is known from the notice that the sentiments of a lawyer named Mamloddin were hurt by the name of Mars. 

When contacted for details, Mamloddin told us while Googling the next issue to file a lawsuit, ‘Mars is a Hindu planet. Does it have anything to do with our solar system culture? There is no point in spending crores of rupees on a mission to such a planet. Instead, you can send astronauts to the sun, but if you change the name of Mars, I will consider withdrawing the writ. If NASA does not suspend the Mars mission even after our sentiments are hurt, then NASA’s ashes will be set on fire.’ 

On the other hand, a NASA spokesperson told us, hiding his face, ‘We have received the notice. Our legal team is working on the matter. Hopefully, we can come to a decision on renaming Mars in a day or two. We don't want to hurt anyone's feelings about our mission.

Headline_English: Mangal Pandey receives legal notice to change his name
Content_English:
After the notice to remove Mars from the solar system, this time the notice has also reached Mangal Pandey! What is this notice? Nothing different. He has also been given a name change notice on the same grounds! 

The notice stated, 'You can put whatever you want before Pandey except Mars. We have no objection to putting an evil name, only Mars has to be removed.' 

Immediately after receiving such a notice, Pandey passed a statement on his Facebook account. His statement read, 'Dead people can vote, they can give statements, but how can we change this name now? Just look at how a dead body will follow the commissioners in the municipality of the area! If there was such a problem with their good name, then I should have told them before I died. I would have changed it. Now all this is not possible, I have made it clear.' 

It is known that after his statement, some people are leaving the country abroad for a system where dead people can change their names. "They will come back to the country after six months of training and find a solution to this."

Headline_English: Zayed Khan is getting married to take his wife's shoes in his hands
Content_English:
After Shahrukh and Ranveer Singh, Bollywood actor Hrithik Roshan has now gone viral with his wife's shoes in his hand. It is learnt that Zayed Khan, known as Dhallywood's Salman Khan, has decided to get married to go viral with his wife's shoes in his hand. He has already bought shoes for his wife before the wedding in order to go viral. 

When asked to talk about this, Zayed Khan said from his fake ID, 'I am buying shoes. The wedding is almost done. The camera is also ready. The photographer is also ready. Now I will just take the shoes in my hand and take a picture and post it on Facebook.' 

Zayed Khan also has a plan to make the picture quite realistic. He said, 'Look, if I want, I can make a picture of the wife and shoes in Photoshop. But I want the picture to be a method picture. It will be realistic like James Kamrul's movie. That is why I am getting married.' 

Along with Zayed Khan, other heroes are also under pressure to take shoes in their hands. However, Shakib Khan is in a lot of trouble. Talking about his thoughts on the matter, Shakib Khan said, "How can I carry so many pairs of shoes! Do I have so many hands!"

Headline_English: Legal notice to remove Mars from the solar system
Content_English:
A NASA scientist has given a legal notice to remove Mars from the solar system. NASA lawyer Mamlarul Islam sent this notice to the Sun and Jupiter. The notice states, 'The solar system is an important part of our culture. Neptune, Pluto, Uranus, Jupiter have been living in the solar system for thousands of years. But it is very sad that an artificial planet called Mars has been inserted into this solar system. Basically, this Mars has no relation to the solar system.' At this time, he got a little annoyed and said, 'Why does a planet have to be named Mars? Just by looking at the name, you can understand, it will hurt the feelings of the people!' 
The notice states that NASA will file a writ if this 'unconstitutional, illegal and artificial' planet is not removed from the solar system within three days. Mamlarul Islam further said, 'When the trouble related to Mars is over, I will also file a case to remove Tuesday from the week.'

Headline_English: Artcell enters printing business after third album flops
Content_English:
If you don't know yet, you will be surprised to know that Artcell released their much-awaited third album 'Atritiya' on February 23rd of this year. If this is brand new information to you, then you must understand how much Atritiya has flopped! To recover from the financial and emotional losses of the third album, Artcell has entered into a new printing business! 



When asked why the song flopped, Artcell's drummer Saju said, 'Who knows which intern is the marketing agency that is deciding the promotional strategy of the album. Even after releasing the album, people ask me, 'Brother, will Artcell's next album never come out?' 

When asked about the new business, Artcell's vocalist and guitarist George Lincoln D'Costa said, 'How can you earn money by singing these songs? You can't even fill your stomach. An artist has to live too, bro. So I got into the printing business. I promoted the song release as I did, this time I won't do that anymore. This time I will follow a good strategy. Look, you are already making news about us.' 

In this time of danger for Artcell, Bhai Bhai Printing Service, Uradhu Print and Photocopy and some other shop owners have come to their side. 

Artcell has called on their huge fanbase (fans from 2000-2010, who still think Artcell is the same as before) to come and stand by them. Even if everyone photocopies at least one sheet, they will be able to somehow run their family.

Headline_English: You can get Tasbeeh gifts by paying a bribe during Ramadan
Content_English:
The All Bengali Bribery Society has come up with a special offer on the occasion of the month of Ramadan. Considering the customers, special gifts have been kept in exchange for bribes. It is known that during the month of Ramadan, Tasbeeh will be given as a gift if you give a bribe. The amount of the bribe also varies. If you give a bribe of more than 50 thousand taka, you will be given Tasbeeh bought from Baitul Mukarram Market. If you give a bribe of more than 1 lakh taka, you will get Tasbeeh brought from Dubai. Tasbeeh brought from Saudi Arabia will be available for customers who bribe more than 2 lakh taka. If you give a bribe of 5 lakh taka, you will get Tasbeeh and prayer. The leaders of the Bribery Society also said that if you give a bribe of more than 20 lakh taka, they will make customers perform Umrah. 
While informing about such an innovative offer keeping in mind Ramadan, a bribe-taking officer said, 'If you do one good deed to someone during the month of Ramadan, you get the reward of 70 good deeds. You can understand that with one Tasbeeh, I basically earned the reward of giving 70 Tasbeeh. This is what is called the master's majesty in Ramadan.' 

Another official is thinking not only about his own goodness, but also about the goodness of his customers. This official said, 'There comes a month in the year. If you do not do good deeds in this month, you will not be able to earn anything. I myself sometimes miss the Asr congregation while going on duty. Our customers also face such problems. That is why I am giving Tasbeeh. So that they come to the path of religion like us during Ramadan.'

Headline_English: Sayeedi invites Christina Koch to eat Dal Bhat for a meal if she goes to the moon
Content_English:
Christina Koch will be the first female astronaut to go to the moon in 2024. She is getting such an opportunity because of the initiative to send astronauts to the moon after almost five decades. After hearing that Christina Koch is going to the moon, Sayeedi, a local resident of Chand, invited her to have a meal of dal bhaat at his house. He tweeted this invitation from the roof of his house on Chand using a fake Twitter account. 



When Christina Koch was called to know her feelings about receiving the invitation, she said, "Before going to the moon, I look at my chankapal! Wherever I go, I always try to spend some time visiting the homes of the local residents there. I thought there was no such opportunity on the moon, but thanks to Sayeedi sir. He may have understood my mind. However, one request, it would be very good if you could have some potato stuffing with the dal and bhaat. I can't eat without potato soup again.' 



On the other hand, the other three astronauts of this lunar mission have expressed their anger at only inviting Christina Koch alone. While the other two refused to speak, Victor Glover told us, 'What kind of two-faced policy is this? We will all travel this far, but why was Christina invited alone? What is our fault? If not for dal and rice, at least we could have received an invitation to have tea.'

Headline_English: Special Gold Digger Loans Come to Eat at Intercontinental's Jilapi
Content_English:
Five-star hotel Intercontinental has brought special gold jilapi to its menu on the occasion of the month of Ramadan. But the fact is, many of us are wary of the price of jilapi. Even if we want to taste it a little, many do not have the courage to buy this jilapi as it costs 20 thousand taka per kg. However, that thought is going to go away this time. So that the common people can get the taste of this golden jilapi, the banks have come up with a special gold digger loan. There is an installment-based facility to pay this loan for buying jilapi. Besides, the interest rate will also be quite low here. 
When we tried to find out the opinion of one of the jilapi beneficiaries about the loan, he was seen quite happy. He told us, 'I was very tense, brother. I am running out of breath buying rice, fish, and rice, in the meantime, my wife has demanded to eat jilapi. She has threatened me that if I do not take this jilapi for Iftar tomorrow, she will not let me enter the house. The Gold Digger Loan came and saved my family.’ 



To know more about the Gold Digger Loan, an official of Village Bank told us, ‘We have taken this decision after seeing the suffering of the people! Some will eat, some will not… it will not happen, it will not happen. We are determined to give everyone a taste of gold. In the future, along with Jilapi, we are also thinking about a loan to buy Halim. We hope that we will be able to come up with a Halim loan within 20 days.

Headline_English: 'Dhoom 4' is bringing the story of a 20,000 taka thief
Content_English:
Bangladesh does not produce world-class films—this bad reputation may soon be erased. A director who did not want to be named said, “After this, he will make a world-class film. The name of the film is Dhoom 4!” When asked about this, the director said, “Series like Dhoom about theft are very rare. If India can make such a wonderful film about theft, why can’t we? Is theft less common in our country? I think no country in the world can beat us if there is a competition about theft.” In response to the question, “Why is the film called Dhoom 4?” the director said, “I stole the name. Although it cannot be technically called theft. They have made three, we will make four. And we will steal jilapi in our film. You know, recently gold-plated jilapi is available. Twenty thousand taka per kg. It is not possible for the common man to eat this thing without stealing. Moreover, we also need to see whether real gold is being used in jilapi. Our hero will steal a gold bar, test it, eat it with his family, send it to his in-laws... Here's what I'm giving you, I'm giving you spoilers! I can't say more, the rest will be seen in the movie.' 



This reporter has tried hard to find out that Arefin Shuvo will act in Dhoom 4. Although the director has avoided it by not directly admitting it. He said, 'Some things should not be kept secret! Who will act, we cannot tell now. But Shuvo can be! He said a few days ago that the cameras are on, which means there is freedom of expression in the country. Anyone who can say such things can handle any situation. And you understand, this kind of movie doesn't work well if there is no clever hero.'

Headline_English: MIT Teachers Association issues statement calling for punishment of Trump's lawyer
Content_English:
Donald Trump's lawyer has questioned the rule of law in the United States. He said, 'The rule of law in the United States is now dead.' 

The MIT University Teachers Association in the United States issued a statement strongly criticizing and condemning Donald Trump's comments. 
MIT University Teachers Association believes that Trump's lawyer's comments are a conspiratorial conspiracy against the United States. 

A statement signed by MIT University Teachers Association President Manisa Nobles last night said, 'We are deeply concerned that Trump's lawyer is conducting conspiratorial activities against the United States in the name of expressing his opinion. The MIT University Teachers Association strongly condemns such a conspiracy.' 

The statement, demanding action against Trump's lawyer and everyone associated with him, also said, 'At a time when the news of the US economy turning around after dealing with the crisis of Corona and the Ukraine war is being broadcast in the international media, the country's opposition leader's attempt to incapacitate the state in the name of expressing his opinion cannot be accepted in any way. "I urge everyone not to be confused by such comments and at the same time, I demand the government to take appropriate legal action against all those involved."

Headline_English: Trump advised to live in party office to avoid future arrest
Content_English:
US opposition leader Donald Trump was arrested by American police last night on 34 charges. After being produced in court shortly after, Trump was granted bail. Although granted bail, Bangladesh's opposition party VNP could not accept Trump's arrest in this way. VNP leaders have also questioned Trump's present intelligence. 



Some have also suggested that Trump should live in the party office to avoid such unwanted arrests in the future. One such VNP leader said, 'He could have learned something from our Rizvi Sahib. If he roams around like this, he will be arrested. He should stay in the party office to avoid arrest.' 
The leaders also questioned American democracy in this incident. One leader got a little excited and said, 'Is America a democratic country? How can the leader of the opposition party roam around outside in a democratic country? He should stay in the party office so that he cannot be arrested.' 

They also criticized the leader for getting bail along with Trump. In his speech, a senior leader of the VNP said, "I heard that the man was arrested and then released on bail! Why, brother! How will they completely destroy the dignity of democracy? If they don't arrest him and keep him in jail for at least a week, how will democracy survive? Wow!" 



Another leader said to Trump, "If there is no room in the Republican Party office, you can come to Paltan. Rizvi Saheb has all the beds and sheets here. No need to buy anything extra."

Headline_English: Leonardo DiCaprio spends his days in the TCB truck line
Content_English:
The situation has become so bad due to the price of goods that recently, Titanic-famous actor Leonardo DiCaprio has been spending most of his day in line for TCB trucks. The actor has been seen fighting several times on the streets of Los Angeles over standing in line in front of TCB trucks. 

Although it was not easy to find him, our reporter caught him in front of an egg shop, but he refused to talk. Later, when we tempted him to buy chicken, he told us, 'This place is Los Angeles from both heaven and earth. But what do you mean by profit? I can't buy a kilogram of mutton even with the money from two movies. I ate the last beef during the last sacrifice, that too at the invitation of a friend in Shekhertek. If this continues, Musk brother will also have to stand in line with us in a few days. However, I would like to thank the government of your country, for considering us and introducing the TCB truck system in Los Angeles. We request the PO guardian to consider increasing the supply a little bit. 

But it's not just Leonardo. Priyanka Chopra and Gerard Butler can also be seen in this line with their faces covered in handkerchiefs. When our reporter recognized them, they ran away.

Headline_English: Joe Biden to buy DU Teachers Association's foot-washing water for Harvard Teachers Association
Content_English:
US President Joe Biden is coming to Dhaka University to buy foot washing water. It is learnt that he will come to DU to buy foot washing water from the Dhaka University Teachers' Association for the Harvard University Teachers' Association. During his stay at DU, this world leader will also eat tea, chapatti, and singara for 10 taka. 

Highly praising the Dhaka University Teachers' Association, Biden said, 'How cute they are! How lucky they are. They always take care of the government. They make the government's face shine. They listen to whatever they say. But they don't care about us. They don't even pay attention to their studies. If they drink the foot washing water from the DU Teachers' Association, they will gain a little knowledge and intelligence.' 

Recently, in the context of Prothom Alo's 'Fish, meat, and freedom, we will have it', Biden also expressed his admiration for the results of Dhaka University. Biden said, 'Excellent results. I have seen their exam papers. Just by looking at them, you can understand how advanced they are. How much they study! I think that if this continues, no one will be able to stop Dhaka University's progress in the education rankings. 

Although, Dhaka University teachers are suffering from some indecision due to such news. In a fake message, a teacher from the Teachers' Association said, 'You can give him water to wash his feet. But we are thinking about other things! Who will handle the business? The teachers or the Sammat brothers!' 

However, after discussing with the Sammat brothers, a section of the teachers have also assured that they will inform Joe Biden in detail. They said, 'If the Sammat brothers give permission, then maybe we will do it. Otherwise, Biden will have to buy it from them.'

Headline_English: The moon's dot will remain above: Rangla Academy issues a stern warning
Content_English:
Yesterday, suddenly, a wrong-looking moonspot was seen in the sky above the head, breaking the rules. Although people did not call it a wrong-looking moonspot, rather, everyone called it a very beautiful moonspot and filled their Facebook feed with moonlight. But, this time, the voice was raised at Rangla Academy. A strict warning came for putting the dot up! 

When we asked Rangla Academy about such a warning, we were informed through a fake voice message from there, ‘Whether it is the moon or the sun, it will not happen if you make a mistake. This is our rule that the dot of the moonspot will remain up, this is what the children are learning! Now if the moonspot appears above the head in such a wrong-looking way, what will the children learn? We do not want to see such a mistake a second time, which has happened.’ 

At that time, they informed us through another untrue email, ‘Yesterday, as a result of taking the right steps immediately, this wrong moonspot was taken down from the sky overnight. Even today, we have strict surveillance of the sky! If we see something like this, we will be asked to take it down immediately. If it is not taken down, we are thinking of making arrangements to cover the sky. 

Our journalist tried to go for a secret interview with the moon, but he could not go. But the dot under the moon told us, 'My name is "Bindu". I am the cousin of the moon. We have not seen each other for a long time, so I came to meet yesterday. It is not right to be so vigilant and warn about this!'

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan wants to inaugurate the showroom during matches where bowling and batting are not required.
Content_English:
Bangladesh's Shakib Al Hasan wants to inaugurate a showroom during the upcoming matches in which Bangladesh will not have to bowl or bat. He said that the idea came to his mind since the last match of the Ireland series. Health Products 

In a fake interview with our hired reporter from Nigeria, the all-rounder said, "Why should I waste unnecessary extra time? Our boys are winning matches without me these days. I might as well earn a little extra time. I have a special discount if I inaugurate a showroom during the match. In addition, there will be a system if someone wants to inaugurate their shop through Zoom call." 

However, when asked what else he wants to do apart from inaugurating a shop, this all-rounder told us, "Even if there is an invitation to a wedding, I want to attend. But you guys can't see my good side. Even when he goes to eat, he makes news about it. 

Inspired by Shakib Al Hasan, Indian batsman Virat Kohli has also become interested in opening various shops or endorsement-based work in his free time during the game. From his fake Twitter account, he told us, 'Shakib bhai is my inspiration in these matters. Earlier, I could not manage my time, but now, after taking his shop opening course, I am doing everything quite well.'

Headline_English: Shaista Khan Amal mode launched in Uganda on the occasion of Ramadan
Content_English:
Like other times, this time too, the Shaista Khan Amal mode has been introduced in Uganda on the occasion of Ramadan. Basically, every year when Ramadan comes, the Ugandan government takes such steps to protect the general public from the rise in prices of goods. It is known that under this project, they have opened their mobile shops at various points in Kampala, the capital of Uganda. Where everything like eight maunds of rice for one taka can be found at a bargain price. 



In this regard, Uganda's Food Minister Dadan Ali told us, 'The people voted us to power at night, what will happen if we don't think about them? If necessary, we will sell our Begumpara house and provide food to the people at a low price. No matter how bad you think of us, we are actually a people-friendly government.' 

At such a time, when our reporter asked about the freedom of speech of the people of Uganda, the minister got quite angry and hung up. 

When we interviewed a man standing in line in front of a mobile shop, he seemed quite happy. The man told us with a smile, "I feel very happy, brother. Seeing so much development in the country has brought tears to my eyes. I have never seen such a people-friendly government before, brother. I don't have to bother voting, I get everything for the price of water. Sometimes I want to cry and shout like Shabana Apa, will we ever be able to bear this much happiness?"

Headline_English: Mohammadpur's Riyad's passport was canceled after he did not post a photo on Facebook after receiving it.
Content_English:
We have learned through a false and untrue information that Riyad from Mohammadpur received his passport last week. However, despite observing him for a week, he was not seen posting any passport photos on his Facebook. As a result of this observation, his passport was officially canceled yesterday at around 12 noon. 

After such a sad incident like the cancellation of the passport, Riyad Saheb told us in a kidney-touching message from his Facebook ID, ‘I was so happy to get my first passport in my life that I didn’t even notice anything. I was showing my passport to all my relatives on video calls for the past week. I even rented it out for a day to show off to my friends. In between all this, I don’t even remember taking any photos.’ 

At that time, when Riyad’s best friend Ziyad was added to the conversation, he said through another message, ‘You idiot! I haven’t received my passport yet, but what’s the point! I have already taken a picture of my elder brother's passport and posted it on my story. Posting the picture on Facebook after getting the passport acts as a license for the passport. If you don't get the license, it will be canceled. It's absolutely correct!' 

To prove the truth of Zia's words, we were also informed by the passport office that this passport was canceled because the license was not obtained even after a week. And there is a possibility that all passports will be canceled for this reason in the future! So it's better not to take the risk.

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan plans to sing at Coke Studio after graduation
Content_English:
Our all-rounder Shakib Al Hasan recently graduated from the private university AIUB and received his degree. After reaching this new milestone, it is being heard that he is planning to sing at Coke Studio. This world-class all-rounder is even taking singing lessons from Snoop Dogg to sing there. 

But why Coke Studio after leaving everything behind? When we missed a call on Shakib Bhai's fake imo number to find out about this, he told us while he was abroad, "I am doing modeling, acting, and opening stores. I thought, why should I leave singing? If I can't do this, then why am I an all-rounder! I have been learning new ways of singing from Ustad Snoop Dogg since last week. I hope that I can bring you something great in Coke Studio 3. And I also hope that Coke Studio will consider taking me. If I am accepted, I will have a discount at the ribbon cutting ceremony of Coke Studio.’ 

However, the all-rounder has not yet made it clear whether he will sing only at Coke Studio Bangla. It is expected that just like in cricket, he plays franchise-based leagues around the world, we will see something similar in Coke Studio. On the other hand, it is learned that after hearing the news of Shakib Al Hasan, Indian batsman Virat Kohli has started lobbying Coke Studio India to sing.

Headline_English: Retina, Joykoli, Udbhas claim Shakib's graduation credit as theirs
Content_English:
World-renowned all-rounder Shakib Al Hasan recently received a degree after completing his graduation. However, the incident does not end here. Retina, Joykoli, Udbhas have claimed Shakib's degree and graduation as their own credit. It is known that each of them has uploaded a picture of Shakib eating sweets on their Facebook pages. 

When contacted via telepathy to find out about this, the admin of Joykoli page said, 'You guys are just finding fault with everything. If you find fault so much, you will not understand. Shakib bhai loved us, scoring centuries and taking wickets, he also completed his studies by sitting in the field regularly and reading our books. We are really proud of Shakib bhai.' 

However, when the admin of Retina and Udbhas was knocked for details, he blocked our reporter. On the other hand, Shakib Al Hasan told us from his fake account, 'I do not want to say anything about this right now. However, I did not like the picture of him eating sweets. If you get their admin ID, please give me some! I would be happy if you showed me a picture of them eating round sweets instead of such long sweets.

Headline_English: Germany: The bread capital of Europe
Content_English:
Although bread originated in Egypt, you will probably not find a love for bread like the Germans anywhere else in the world. Only Germans can swallow bread on the go at any time of the day, be it breakfast, lunch or dinner. The reputation of German bread is not only in Germany, German bakeries are appreciated in all major cities of the world. Let's try to find out the reasons why Germany is called the bread capital of Europe. 

1. There was a common idea that Germany was the only country where you would find 300 types of bread. But in 2012, the 'German Association of Bakery Trade' launched a website to get an idea of ​​how many types of bread are made by local bakers, and in the end, it was found that about 2753 types of bread were registered there. 2. Like many people in our country, Germans have bread on their tables not only for breakfast, but also for lunch or dinner. However, there is a huge difference between breakfast bread and lunch or dinner bread. A German eats about 80 kg of bread a year. 

3. A German breakfast is incomplete without a round or oval bread called Brötschen. This bread is so popular that even on weekends, even when everything else is closed, some bakeries are open only to sell Brötschen. 4. However, German bakeries do not only make bread, about 1200 types of biscuits can also be found in Germany. 



5. Although we are only familiar with bread made from wheat flour or flour, there is a wide variety of ingredients in Germany to make bread. In addition to wheat, corn, barley or sesame seeds are used here, and sunflower or pumpkin seeds are mixed with it depending on the type of bread. Many breads even include small pieces of carrot cut into small pieces. 
6. Every year, many people from other European countries travel to Germany to learn baking, even with the plan to open a German bakery in their own country.

Headline_English: Coke Studio Security Act coming to market
Content_English:
The Coke Studio Security Act is coming to the market to prevent criticism of Coke Studio. This was stated by a fan of Coke Studio in a fictional meeting this morning. It is learned that through this act, defamatory statements about the sovereignty of Coke Studio and Coke Studio will be prevented. 

While talking about the issue, this fictional fan of Coke Studio said, ‘Everywhere in the country, criticism of Coke Studio is being leveled in the name of freedom of speech. Our artists are having to remove it by posting statuses on Facebook. This cannot be allowed to happen in a free country. We are thinking of bringing this act to prevent all such misdeeds.’ 

However, the concerned have appealed to the common people not to be afraid of the Coke Studio Security Act. They said, ‘You have no fear! We will not arrest you. We are always vigilant to ensure human rights.’ 

Meanwhile, the news of the coming of the Coke Studio Security Act is somewhat in danger for the government critics and BNP leaders and activists. It is known that many such people are always leaving a few months' worth of money at home. Many are also saying goodbye to their relatives. Regarding the matter, one such person said, 'Don't live with the pain of a Digital Security Act. The Coke Studio Security Act is coming again. We feel like we have no protection anymore.' 

The Coke Studio Security Act will not catch you; a BNP leader, somewhat angry at our question, said, 'Let any act come to the country! My forehead will burn.'

Headline_English: Businessman buys money vault and perfume from Dubai to prepare for Ramadan
Content_English:
Ramadan is knocking on the door. People from all walks of life are making various preparations ahead of Ramadan. Businessmen are also making preparations. It is learnt that a businessman has bought a money vault and fragrant perfume from Dubai ahead of Ramadan. 

Regarding his preparations, the businessman said, 'Ramadan has arrived. I have to worship. I will apply perfume and go to Tarawih. That is why I bought several perfumes. And I need a tar vault! You understand, Ramadan has arrived.' 

This businessman also has plans to go to Saudi Arabia from Dubai to perform Umrah. Talking about his Umrah, the businessman said, 'I don't know when I will get time again! That is why I performed Umrah. In fact, it won't happen if I am in the illusion of this world! None of this money will actually go to the grave.' 

He also said that he plans to buy Ajwa dates on the way back from Umrah. He said, 'I hear that eating Ajwa during Iftar gives you a little more goodness. "That's why I'm taking it."

Headline_English: Putin boycotts Oscars after NATO awards NATO song
Content_English:
The song Natu Natu from the Indian movie RRR has won the Oscar for Best Original Song. Russian President Vladimir Putin did not take the matter well at all. He also criticized the Oscars for giving the Oscar to the song Natu Natu. 

In such a turbulent time, the Oscars have basically fulfilled the demands of the Western world by giving the Oscar to the song Natu Natu; this is what Putin has claimed. From one of his fake IDs, Putin said, 'They have disrupted our world a few days ago by giving Zelensky an Oscar. Now, they have taken the world one step further towards war by giving NATO an Oscar. They have given the Oscar, but now they are saying that they have given the Oscar to 'Natu Natu' just so that I don't understand! I am such an idiot! I don't understand which one is Natu and which is NATO?' 

Putin's mood has also deteriorated somewhat over this incident. The Russian leader was also seen getting a little angry with Zelensky. He said to Zelensky, 'He is a comedian. He has good connections on these lines. He has used these connections to get NATO an Oscar. I will see to that.’ 

Putin, in a slightly mild threat to the Western world, said, ‘I am raising gas prices again. Now let me cook rice in that Oscar pot.’

Headline_English: PS4s in corporate offices are now spider dens
Content_English:
PS4s are kept in corporate offices for mind refreshment during work breaks. But this time spiders were found in these PS4s. After visiting some offices, it was seen that spiders had made a den. The PS4 is like their own home. 

When I went to a corporate office in Gulshan, I saw that 5-6 spiders were partying together on the PS4 there. A couple was also busy making new spiders. During the break from work, a brother in the office said, 'What are we going to play, brother! I don't even have time to look at this due to the workload.' 

It has been learned through a fake report that although the PS4s in these corporate offices were active for the first few days, they gradually disappeared like X. Then no one cares about them or finds time to give them. 

There should have been a schedule fight between colleagues about who would play when on the PS4, but in the complete opposite way, now the fight is between spiders and lizards! Occasionally, the lizard comes to destroy the spider's house and sits on this PS4!

Headline_English: UK gives voting rights to dead people to address weaknesses in democracy
Content_English:
Bangladesh Foreign Minister AK Abdul Momen has advised the UK to seek advice from Bangladesh if it has any weaknesses in democracy and human rights. The Foreign Minister said he told the UK's Minister of State for Indo-Pacific Affairs Anne-Marie Tribilla on Sunday. Traditional clothing 

Meanwhile, it has been learned from a confidential and unreliable source that the UK has sought advice from Bangladesh. The country has already started working on the Bangladesh model to strengthen democracy. It is learned that as a first step, the country is going to give voting rights to dead people as a pilot project. 
The country's Election Commissioner said, 'Bangladesh has been recognized as a role model of democracy worldwide by providing fair, international and impartial elections for a long time. Taking advice from them, we also want to establish ourselves as a model of democracy in the world. As a result of that, we have taken this groundbreaking decision.' 

A high-level official related to the UK Election Commission believes that awareness about the voting rights of dead people should have been raised earlier. "The UK and Bangladesh will work together to build a democratic world," said Hurul Huda, a British official who spoke on condition of anonymity. "We should have decided earlier on the issue of voting rights for the dead. We have taken such a bold decision, albeit late." 

The Western country is also examining the possibility of holding elections at night if the voting rights for the dead are successfully implemented.

Headline_English: Argentina fans are being called upon to account for the money recovered from Dutch-Bangla Bank
Content_English:
A few days ago, 110 million taka was stolen from Dutch-Bangla Bank. But even though 110 million taka was stolen at once, not all the money was recovered at once. But this stolen money is being recovered in installments. Sometimes 250 million, sometimes 300 million, sometimes 900 million, sometimes 580,000. Those concerned are struggling to keep track of the money recovered in installments. As a result, Argentine football fans are being called upon to keep accurate records. 

For a long time, Argentine fans have occupied their best place in mathematics while calculating the equation for Argentina's second round. This matter has made the bank officials interested in Argentine fans. An official told eArchi, 'We are trying to keep the records but it is not happening. It is actually not possible for anyone except Argentine fans to keep such complex records.' 

Although Argentine fans have refused to do this work for Dutch-Bangla Bank. "We gave up on these calculations a long time ago," said one of the Argentina fans. "We've won the cup now, we're world champions. Now we don't do these little things anymore."

Headline_English: Bangladesh wants to play the final match of the series in the wilderness of Palashi
Content_English:
Bangladesh has won the T20 series with 1 match remaining. The Tigers are confident that they will win the third match as well. Bangladesh will avenge 200 years of oppression and tyranny by losing the third match. With this aim, the team wants to play the third match in the wilderness of Palashi. 

A source from Ek Hawa confirmed this to eRK. 

Talking about the matter, a BCB official told us from one of the 5 fake IDs, ‘We don’t want to miss out on this swag of British slaughter. If the game is played in the wilderness of Palashi, the boys will be excited. Nawab Sahib himself will come and watch the game. He has decided that he will watch the English slaughter and eat khurma.’ 

Meanwhile, Azmul Hasan, a BCB official who did not want to be named, expressed his slight objection if there is no problem with the game in the wilderness of Palashi. In an interview given to eRK, he said, ‘The game is possible! With my tension network! What if I don't get the phone network on time later!'

Headline_English: Two siblings in Rajshahi clash over filling empty bottles and storing them in the fridge
Content_English:
A clash broke out between two siblings over filling empty bottles and keeping them in the fridge at a house in Rajshahi. The clash took place on Saturday night and the secret photo and evidence was shown today, Sunday. 

At night, the parents went to the spot and found them fighting with 2 empty water bottles and 5 half-filled water bottles in their hands. 

When they spoke to their mother, she said, "I do all the housework all day long. Every now and then, they both take water out of the fridge and drink it, let alone fill it up and put the bottle back in. What can I do alone? I see that they are just taking care of their father's family, otherwise I would have left everything behind!" 

Meanwhile, when they tried to talk to the siblings, neither of them showed any desire to talk. Both of them were busy thinking about who to blame! 

It was learned through their father that the younger brother had already given his father some information about his sister's boyfriend. Now, just to make your sister guilty in the eyes of your parents, Future Dulabhai's picture is in the collection!

Headline_English: The entire Bengali Swami Samaj washed pots and pans for a day on the occasion of Women's Day
Content_English:
Today is International Women's Day, and to celebrate Women's Day, members of the Nikhil Bangla Swami Samaj washed the pots and pans at home for a day. It is known that not only the pots and pans, but some are also washing clothes and sweeping the house with due dignity. 

However, when we called Mohammad Samir, vice-president of Nikhil Bangla Swami Samaj, to find out more about washing the pots and pans for just one day instead of helping with the work throughout the year, he said, "Brother, I am very busy today, let's talk tomorrow." Later, after much pleading, Samir's brother told us, "Other days, I am busy with worldly work outside, so I don't get time to do these things. Since today is a holiday, I thought I would take a look at my wife's work from home. You understand that the price of a hobby is lakhs of taka, it's not that much, and my back hurts a little after sitting for an hour and washing clothes." 

On the other hand, a brother named Sabbir is absconding from home after burning the pots and pans while cooking for his wife on the occasion of Women's Day. After many attempts, when we tried to find my brother and call him to verify the truth of the incident, he told us, "I made a mistake, I didn't understand. Cooking is actually a woman's job. But since I am a fan of Nawazuddin Siddiqui, I got into a mood of 'Why are you so daring' and the incident happened."

Headline_English: Miraj cried with emotion after seeing Shakib and Tamim together
Content_English:
There is a lot of buzz in the cricket community about the relationship between Shakib and Tamim. The relationship between these two cricketers came into the spotlight after Nazmul Hasan Papon's comments about their relationship. Meanwhile, today, it was reported through Prothom Alo that Tamim called Shakib this Shakib. 



Meanwhile, from another false source, it was reported that cricketer Mehedi Hasan Miraj could not control his emotions after seeing Shakib and Tamim together in the dressing room. He burst into tears in the dressing room. Unable to stop Miraj's crying in any way, Shakib Al Hasan and Tamim separated again. 

Miraj agreed to stop crying and talk about the matter. He told our correspondent, 'Mashrafi Bhai is not here! In the meantime, hearing these things about Shakib Bhai and Tamim Bhai does not make me feel good. If the relationship between brothers is not good, what will we, the younger ones, learn!’ 



At one point in the conversation, Miraj's throat became heavy, and he paused for a moment, drank a glass of water, and then calmed down, saying, ‘There are so many criticisms and rumors about brothers all around! Who can be happy when you see all this? My heart is bursting with pain.’ 



At one point in the conversation, when Shakib and Tamim came together again to talk, Miraj started crying again. At one point, Saib and Tamim got upset and separated again.

Headline_English: Rabindranath Tagore has gone missing.
Content_English:
World poet Rabindranath Tagore has suddenly disappeared from TSC. However, it is not confirmed whether the people in the white microbus picked him up or not. 

It is learned that Rabindranath came to TSC holding the hand of a group of fine arts students. He was standing next to the TSC Raju sculpture. With tape on his face and nails in his hands, Rabindranath Tagore stood against the world that blocked the path of freedom of speech, free thought, and creativity. Rabindranath's position was also against the oppression that persists on the face of the earth. 

But after staying there until yesterday, Rabindranath could not be found again. That is why the students have hung a banner in place of Rabindranath's sculpture. It is written that Rabindranath has disappeared. 

Meanwhile, an unreliable source has learned that one party has denied the disappearance of Rabindranath. But without saying anything about why they did it, the party said, 'We will be blamed! I know this! That's why I denied it in advance. I stayed a little ahead in the fight for life.' 

Some people criticize and say that Rabindranath should not have been disappeared like this in the dead of night! However, they have denied this allegation too! This party called 'Yunohu' says, 'Look, don't make useless accusations. The countrymen know that we don't do anything other than vote in the dead of night. Disappearance is out of the question!'

Headline_English: European ministers want VIP protocol like Bangladeshi ministers on their streets
Content_English:
European leaders and ministers have demanded a protocol like that of Bangladeshi ministers when they go out on the road. It is learnt that a European minister who visited Bangladesh was inspired by the convoy of Bangladeshi leaders with such protocols and is forming a human chain with others on the roads of Europe. 

When our reporter went there to find out more, crossing the wire, one of them said, ‘The roads in Europe are very developed, and your hero Riaz has also given us a certificate in this regard. But if the ministers of your country can stop ordinary people for hours and move around as they please with VIP protocol, why can’t we? What is our fault? We are fed up with pushing such jams and walking on the roads with everyone. If we don’t get VIP feel and the common people don’t suffer a bit for us, then what are we doing as ministers?’ 

Another of them told us, ‘When we walk on the roads with everyone else like this day after day, the roads no longer feel like European roads, they feel like roads in Chittagong. We stopped eating pasta and grill until we got the real European street food. Let's see what you can do.'

Headline_English: Average pass rate in HSC-equivalent exams is 85.95. Rickshaw pullers express anger
Content_English:
The HSC exam results have been published today. This day is like Eid for rickshaw pullers. Because, the opportunity to marry failed beauties comes only on this day. But this time the pass rate is 85.95%. They can't accept this result in any way. They are expressing their anger at every corner of the city! 

Meanwhile, when I spoke to a rickshaw puller, he said, 'We drive rickshaws. There is very little joy in our lives. This time of the year is a happy time for us because, if we do poorly in the exam, beautiful girls get married to us. Last month, Akkas Bhai from the house next door got married. His beautiful, plump SSC failed wife is mine! I was thinking that this time I will get married, but this time I didn't fail, where will I get a girl! My marriage didn't happen this year either, brother.' 

Meanwhile, a rickshaw puller gave surprising information, 'Brother, I took a rickshaw for my crush. I thought that if my crush fails in HSC, his father will marry him to a rickshaw puller. I won't be able to seduce my crush anymore. But now I see that my crush is passing. Now my crush is gone, and I won't be able to get another girl either.' 

Meanwhile, the passenger sitting in the rickshaw said, 'My father was not accepting my boyfriend at all. So, having no other choice, I also told him, I fail the exam, you drive a rickshaw for a few days. This is the last resort! I helped him buy a rickshaw with my own money, but now I see that I myself did not fail. I can't think of how to face my boyfriend. I have even turned off my phone out of fear.'

Headline_English: Nikhil Bangla Matri Sangh challenges Chat GPT to pass BCS
Content_English:
Chat GPT is really surprising everyone by answering all the questions. It is said that this new technology may even lead the AI ​​revolution ahead. However, despite all the capabilities of Chat GPT, the Nikhil Bangla Matri Sangh is not satisfied with it at all. According to them, they said that they will no longer question its capabilities if they can only pass BCS. 

When contacted for details, a member of the Sangh said, "Everyone can answer two or three such questions, it is not that big of a deal. If I can pass BCS, I will understand that Chat GPT has knowledge. If I have to sit and memorize current affairs all day, Chat GPT will become CAT GPT." 

Meanwhile, it is known that they have started to wind down their activities out of fear after receiving the challenge from Nikhil Bangla Matri Sangh. The spokesperson of Chat GPT told us without showing his face, "Brothers, BCS will not be given to us. This is a tough job. I tried three times but could not pass the preliminary exam, and then I opened Chat GPT. Now, if that BCS gets stuck on your shoulders again, it's dangerous, brother.

Headline_English: Dhaka University to add course on robbery and assault
Content_English:
Gang culture has become rampant in the Dhaka University area. It has been reported through Prothom Alo newspaper that robberies have increased in Suhrawardy Udyan and various areas of Dhaka University in the past few days. Young men and women who come to visit are being harassed in various ways. There have also been complaints of robbery of mobile phones, money and jewelry. It is alleged that an organized gang posing as leaders and activists of the student organization of Dhaka University and the ruling party is involved in this. 

Meanwhile, another confidential source has revealed that Dhaka University is quite aware of the issue. In order to quickly solve such problems, they are thinking of starting a separate course on robbery, assault and molestation in the university. 

It is learned that they have designed such a course for further higher education in robbery and assault. It is known that a master's degree will also be offered in addition to the 4-year honors degree. 

When asked about this, the university's proctor told eRK from a fake ID, "I heard they are doing quite well in kidnapping. We want to utilize their talent. We want to make the university's students more talented by providing higher training through institutional education." 

The institution's goal is to make Dhaka University more unique and realistic in education and research. Stating this, another proctor said, "Earlier, we have shown surprises in tea-chop-singara. Hopefully, we will move one step further in the world ranking through the kidnapping-marthor course."

Headline_English: Nayak Riaz has been invited to be the Dean of the Department of European Road Studies at Oxford.
Content_English:
A new department of European Road Studies has been opened at Oxford University to study European roads. And our very own European road expert, actor Riaz, has been invited to join as the dean of this department. It is learnt that the university authorities have already started lobbying in various places in the international community to get Riaz as the dean of their department. 

When the VC of Oxford was called to know more about this, he said, 'We had been thinking about opening a new department on European roads for a long time. But due to the lack of suitable faculty, we could not implement the idea until now. But recently after watching Riaz Bhai's video, we got a lot of courage in our chest. Now we want Riaz Bhai as our departmental dean.' 

However, when we called actor Riaz in this regard, he could not be reached. His assistant told us that he is currently busy at that level in the lab with a formula for making European roads in a domestic format. It is doubtful whether he will be available in the next few months.

Headline_English: Pakistan wants 10% of Indian spy movies' revenue
Content_English:
After Zayed Khan, Nipun, Pakistan is now thinking of sharing in Indian cinema. It is learnt that the country wants 10 percent of the revenue of all Indian spy genre films. Such a demand of Pakistan cannot be called unreasonable. 

It has been seen that Pakistan has a contribution in most Indian spy genre films. The matter stands that without Pakistan, Indian spy genre films would not have been born! This was said by a high-ranking official of the Pakistani government.
