Regarding the matter, he said, ‘They will use us but will not share the profit with us, that is not possible! There is a thing called copyright, isn’t it!’ 

He also said, ‘I see our countrymen losing and getting beaten up in their films again and again! It hurts! If at least the revenue was shared, the pain could have been tolerated.’ 

At this time, he also criticized Nipun’s demand for 10%. He said, ‘Why would you want 10% in Pathan films! Bangladesh was not used there! They are using us, if you give them money, they will give it to us!’ 

Russia has also supported Pakistan’s claim. They have also claimed 10% of the revenue from Hollywood spy genre movies.

Headline_English: Publishing a book of poetry written with ChatGPT at the book fair
Content_English:
An artificial intelligence bot called ChatGPT is writing everything from features to poems, stories or novels, assignments or theses. It is learned that renowned poet Jibananand Raihan of Dhaka is going to publish a book of poetry using ChatGPT at the Amar Ekushey Book Fair. The book will be available at this book fair. 

Talking about the book, Jibananand Raihan said, 'I have long had a hobby of publishing a book of poetry. But I couldn't write poetry because I couldn't. After ChatGPT came, I decided to publish the book.' 

It is known that the book will be arranged with a total of 30 poems, including 5 from the Rabindranath Gharana, 5 from the Nazrul Gharana, 3 from the Jibananand Gharana, 4 from the Shakespeare Gharana, 3 from the Mahmud Darwish Gharana, and 2 from the Jalaluddin Rumi Gharana. 

After publishing the book of poetry, this writer also has the idea of ​​writing a novel. He is thinking of starting with a novel in the Humayun Ahmed genre. If possible, he wants to launch the novel at this book fair.

Headline_English: Chat GPT is writing research papers, university teachers in Bangladesh are overwhelmed with joy
Content_English:
One of the most talked about topics in the world recently is the artificial intelligence-powered chatbot tool ‘ChatGPT.’ People around the world are quite excited about the arrival of this new technology. Bangladesh is no exception. This chatbot, which has the ability to answer any question, is believed to lead the AI ​​revolution. 

Teachers from various universities in Bangladesh have been completely overwhelmed with joy by writing their research papers using ChatGPT, which has recently become popular in Bangladesh. It is known that they are now not even getting caught in plagiarism cases as a result of writing research papers using it. 

When a teacher from the Department of Computer Science and Engineering at Shahbagh University was contacted to learn about this real-life experience, he first sang, "Today is a very happy day for me, today I have become independent by writing a paper using GPT." 

Then he said, "Brother, how happy I am. I was recently writing a research paper called the industrial use of computers and software and its future, but since my previous paper was filed as 99% plagiarism, I was quite worried about where I would get caught if I copied it. Finally, this app has appeared like an angel for me." 

On the other hand, members of the All-Bangla Copy Research Association have demanded that its inventor be awarded the Nobel Peace Prize for bringing such peace to the lives of Chat GPT University researchers.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi corrupt people are planning to buy up the entire America
Content_English:
Wasa MD Taksim A Khan has bought 14 houses in the United States of America alone. It has been alleged that he became the owner of these houses through money laundering. This information was revealed through a report in the Daily Samakal. 

Meanwhile, all the corrupt people in the country are taking inspiration from Taksim's success. They have expressed their desire to buy America if they get enough opportunities. 
In this regard, the president of the Bangladesh Corruption Organization said, 'Taksim Bhai has shown what we can do despite hundreds of limitations. Today we have 14 houses, tomorrow there will be 28 houses. Then one day we will be able to buy America. Maybe one day Bangladesh will be the owner of this world.' 

The corrupt vice president said that he is not able to match his qualifications due to various problems including various mismanagement in the country, obstacles at every level. He said, 'Along with various advantages, we also have various disadvantages here. We cannot commit corruption peacefully. It becomes news in newspapers, people criticize us on Facebook, and bully us. Despite all these limitations, we are representing Bangladesh on the world stage through corruption, money laundering, and buying houses abroad. We will continue to do so.' 

When I sat down with Taksim A Khan in a secret fictional interview on this subject, he said, 'I had a target of buying 50 houses alone. I played 14 in the field for the news channel. I feel very good that Polapan is learning from me. The children of this era think that if they can eat money illegally, they should correct their mistakes.'

Headline_English: Saifuddin Ahmed Milon expressed hope of putting up the first poster on the metro rail
Content_English:
The dream metro rail has been launched. Who will take this opportunity to fulfill the dream first, who will get on the metro rail first, there are various arguments and competitions going on about this. 

Meanwhile, news has been received from a completely fake source that even though he could not ride the metro rail for the first time, Dhaka's famous poster boy Saifuddin Ahmed Milon has expressed his hope of putting up the first poster on the metro rail. 

Saifuddin spoke to us about the matter from one of his fake IDs. He walked towards us with a bundle of posters and said, 'Every person's goal in life is to give the best to the country. I have been helping to enhance the beauty of the city by putting up posters on pillars and walls for a long time. Now it is time to enhance the beauty of the metro rail.' 

At this time, he also requested us to spread the posters we gave him around the village. From the fake ID, this poster boy said, 'Take it brother. If you need more, let me know. I will put them up around the house. I will give them to my friends. I will give it to my relatives.’ 

Milon also shared his dream of becoming a poster artist. He told our correspondent from a fake ID, ‘There are discussions with Elon Musk. I am sponsoring posters in the dream he has of going to Mars. As if the name of Bangladesh is spread on the walls of Mars.’

Headline_English: Mirpur residents deserve all the benefits they should get after years of struggling for the metro rail
Content_English:
The dream metro rail will be inaugurated tomorrow, December 28. If anyone has the right to this dream metro rail, it is the respected people of Mirpur. So, considering their words, eArchi will highlight the demands and wishes kept in their minds today. Let's see what they have. 



1# 

In memory of their sacrifices in building the metro rail, the metro rail should be named 'Dream Metropur.' 



2# 

Considering those of Mirpur who are still roaming around looking for jobs, a job quota should be kept for them in the metro rail. They will all get jobs in the metro quota. 



3# 

The people of Mirpur definitely deserve a private compartment. After so many sacrifices, why will they compete with people from Uttara, Diyabari, and other places? Don't they have any self-respect? 



4# 

Metrorail should build a connection flyover with every house of Mirpur. Those who have left, it will not be right to walk from station to station. They should be taken directly to their homes. 



5# 

To respect the people of Mirpur, the names of the metrorail coaches should also be changed. For example, Kazipara coach, Shaorapara coach, Taltala coach, Senpara coach, etc. 



6# 

Even if there is no half-fare scheme for other students, at least a half-fare scheme should be introduced for the students of Mirpur. 



7# 

It would be very good if the option of free body massage could be provided in the metro rail to relieve the pain that the people of Mirpur have created in different parts of their bodies over the past few years.

Headline_English: Ronaldo wants to stay in competition with Messi by winning the Walton Blender
Content_English:
The blender of Walton Company wants to beat Ronaldo by leaving behind FIFA World Cup, Ballon d'Or, Golden Gloves, Golden Boot and everything else. People of Bengal want to know why he is running towards such a goal with such great achievements. Our reporter made some fake news to know about his decision. 

In an interview, Ronaldo said, 'I thought, Messi has now won the World Cup. Golden Gloves, Golden Boot, nothing can actually beat the World Cup. So after much meditation, I have found out that this time only Walton's blender can beat Messi's achievement. So I want to win the blender and come to Messi's level. Messi and I are people of similar level, so the achievement and fight should also be similar.' 

When Messi was asked about Ronaldo's decision, Messi said, 'If there is really any chance of winning the Walton blender, then I also want to get this achievement before retirement. I applaud Ronaldo's desire but if you forget this, I will return with what I want for the last time. Now if there is a chance to win something like this before retirement, I will definitely win it and then retire. If we meet face to face, then with Ronaldo too.' 

A video clip was taken while passing by Walton Company to find out what is the situation with all this fuss about blenders. There, they are seen listening to Messi and Ronaldo's statements repeatedly and hugging each other and making sweet faces.

Headline_English: Emiliano Martinez wants to play at Barrister Suman Football Academy to prove himself
Content_English:
Argentina's World Cup-winning goalkeeper Emiliano Martinez has expressed his interest in playing at Barrister Suman Football Academy in order to prove himself after not getting enough opportunities to play at Aston Villa. However, when Martinez brother was called to find out why he is here among so many clubs, he said, "You see, just because I won the World Cup, my needs are not over. I still want to play for a long time. But it should be somewhere where I can prove myself properly and get respect. Even though there are million dollar offers from Manchester City and Real Madrid, I feel that Suman brother's academy is the right place for me because the defense there is weak and I will get enough space to work. And these European clubs also make trouble for money, but I have faith in Suman brother. He will give me my money even if he sells his 13 cows. And show me a club where the club owner comes and practices goalkeeping, if I can stop Suman Bhai's goals, I believe I can stop anyone's goals in the world.' 

However, when I tried to talk to Barrister Suman about this, he said, 'I can't say anything for sure about the matter right now. The first condition if I have to play in my academy is that I will play Matid Foran. I will ask Martinez to practice Aisa in my live video one day, only if he can play Matid Foran properly, then I will consider taking him to the academy team.'

Headline_English: Zayed Khan is preparing himself for the next part of Mission Impossible
Content_English:
Zayed Khan, known as the poor man's Salman Khan, has recently come into the news by jumping into a river with crocodiles. It is known that he did this for the shooting of a movie. However, when we click on Zayed Khan's fake Insta account to know the truth of the incident, we learn a different story, where he said, "Actually, there are talks going on to cast me in the next part of Mission Impossible. So I started preparing myself a little in advance. When I found out that there were crocodiles in the river, I couldn't stop myself anymore. Because if I get a chance in Mission Impossible, then I have to do many more things like this. Although something went wrong after jumping, I still showed courage." 

On the other hand, seeing Zayed Khan's bravery, it is also known that he is being considered for casting in John Wick along with Mission Impossible. However, no one has confirmed whether he will be cast in the film instead of Keanu Reeves or as a villain.

Headline_English: FIFA wants Kazi Salahuddin as president for life
Content_English:
After serving as the president of BFF for a long time, FIFA wants to see him as the president of their organization for life. FIFA confirmed the matter by tweeting from their fake Twitter account with the hashtag #we_want_salauddin. 
When the current president Gianni Infantino was called to verify the truth of the incident, he did not receive the call. Later, when another official's number was missed, he called back and told us, 'This Infantino is a corrupt man. This guy is completely destroying FIFA. People have started retiring in droves because of this. We want an honest man for such a sacred position of FIFA president. And in this regard, our first choice is your country's Kazi Salauddin sir. If he is not honest, how can a person stay in such a big position for so long, people surely love him.' 

On the other hand, ICC has also been shaken by such an incident in FIFA. They also wanted to see Kazi Salauddin as the president of their organization. However, Kazi Salahuddin has not expressed much interest in joining any other sports-related organization other than football as the president.

Headline_English: Christopher Nolan expresses regret over missing artists' association picnic
Content_English:
Recently, the Shilpi Samiti picnic was held in grand style. Many people went to the picnic, but many, including Zayed, could not go. Famous Hollywood director Christopher Nolan could not go either. The Hollywood director's regret for not being able to go to the Shilpi Samiti picnic knows no bounds. 

Regretfully, he said from a fake ID, "I thought I would be invited. But I was not. I borrowed shorts and a camera from a friend to go to the picnic." 

Not just shopping. Nolan had also learned some songs and dance steps to dance to at the picnic. 

Although he was a little regretful, Nolan also said that the regret had diminished somewhat since Zayed Khan did not go. Wiping away tears, he said, "Zayed Khan could not go! And I am no exception." Saying this, Nolan burst into tears again. 

Controlling himself, he said, "I want to go next time. If you could lobby for me a little bit."

Headline_English: Demand to punish Google Translator for not translating properly
Content_English:
Nikhil Nikhil Bangla Writers' Society has demanded punishment for Google Translator for translating into English exactly instead of translating beautiful poetry. 

Yesterday, they demanded this punishment at a protest meeting held under the banner 'We want punishment for Google Translator for its anti-consciousness'. At the meeting, a senior writer said, 'We trusted Google Translator and entrusted it with the task. But we did not understand that they would be so dishonest and trap us. This dishonest Google Translator must be controlled with a strong hand. They will be severely punished.' 

Another writer also said that Google Translate has conspired to question the country's education system. He said, 'I understand, we let them translate! So they will translate whatever they want! Do they have no sense? Or do they want to get pleasure from questioning the education system of this country! That's why I can't trust these foreigners.' 

On the other hand, the leader of the hunger strike organization told us in a tearful voice, 'Brother, I used to copy English poems or quotes from the internet and send them to Crush, and it was pretty much on track, but after the science book incident became known, Crush has now started asking me if I send any poems or quotes online, saying that I will be killed. My dignity has been shattered, brother.'

Headline_English: Influencers want severe winter in Dhaka
Content_English:
Although it is winter in all parts of the country, there is no hint of winter in Dhaka. People are going out without sweaters, there is no cry for sweaters or blankets anywhere. Winter lovers are worried because there is no winter, but this time influencers have brought a different worry. Only they can tell the reason for their worry, so we held a secret meeting. Let's find out what is the secret of wanting winter. 

In this regard, an influencer from Gulshan said, 'Come on! How will I help poor people if winter does not come! I have been waiting all year, when winter comes, I will make 10 to 12 videos of some poor people wearing sweaters, blankets and all. I used to stay on top for a year with 10-12 videos a day. There is no winter, I can't make videos, no views, disgusting!' 

After his statement, we went to a fairly large influencer in Mirpur. He said, 'I have also collected donations from my audience by promising to give winter blankets. Because, I don't have any money of my own. I will make my name with whatever they give. The audience is asking for videos, I can't give blankets because I don't wear them, I can't make videos. Either way, winter will come!' 

At that time, an influencer messaged us, 'Brother, winter is winter. It will come today or tomorrow. I had written a 10-line speech from a motivational speaker, I will say it in the video after distributing blankets. He is asking for payment, I don't have money. Please help.'

Headline_English: No money, just pay the rent and move on: Taskim A Khan in a fictional interview
Content_English:
Not one or two, but 14 houses! Not in the country, but in faraway America. Dhaka WASA Managing Director (MD) Engineer Taksim A Khan has bought these houses in several cities in the United States. The price of all the houses is in the billions of taka. There are allegations that he became the owner of these houses by laundering money from the country. (Source: Daily Samakal) However, Taksim denied all the allegations and said that he has no money. He somehow manages to collect the rent. 
When asked how the 14 houses came about, he said, 'It is the habit of Bengalis to talk in vain. I have a flat in a 14-storey building in Narinda. That is what journalists are bringing to the news like this.' Referring to them as clickbait, he said, '14 houses, America, when people see these, they quickly click on the link. Don't you understand?' 

Expressing regret that no one sees the hardships of landlords, he further said, 'Whenever we go to ask for rent, the tenants ask for time. The hardships of us who rent houses are not written about in the newspapers. These things don't come up in the news. 

When asked if he had laundered money abroad, he took out his mobile and said, 'Look, bKash. I don't know of any other system for sending money other than this. I also take house rent on bKash.' 

Taksim, raising the question of why he should take news of ships as a ginger merchant, said, 'I bring house rent, I eat house rent. If I don't get rent, I can't even recharge my phone.' 

At that time, when the tenant called him on his phone, he started speaking in English. He was also seen shouting, 'Send me the rent ASAP!'

Headline_English: BCB is organizing a sweep to increase the popularity of BPL
Content_English:
You may not know that the Bangladesh Premier League is going on. The league is known as BPL. But even though it is the biggest cricket tournament in the country, people are not very interested in BPL. Many people claim that BPL is at the bottom in terms of popularity. News 

Based on such allegations, the BCB is organizing a sweep as a last-ditch effort to popularize the BPL. It is learned that they will bring a sorcerer and have the field, gallery, cameras and players swept by the sorcerer. 

While talking about this, a fake BCB official said, 'Many people thought that we would not be able to hire a sorcerer. But they may not know that we have an FDR of Tk 900 crore. Therefore, along with modern technology, we did not hesitate to go for the traditional method to popularize the BPL.' 

Another official also said that along with the sweep, arrangements will be made to sprinkle water with gold and silver. He said, 'The gold has been bought. We are also sending it to buy silver. "The water cannon will start spraying. How can the league not become popular!"

Headline_English: Islami Bank maintains November's great form in December
Content_English:
Islami Bank Bangladesh has had a great form in November in terms of irregularities in lending. The bank has also been dubbed 'Terrible November' for its excellent form. Islami Bank has maintained its November form in December as well. The bank has shown great performance in terms of irregularities in lending. 

In November, after lending a large amount of money to a 24-year-old boy using fake documents, the bank has also shown a glimpse in Chittagong. The bank's 3 branches in Chittagong have given loans of more than 3,000 crore taka to 3 institutions without following the rules. 
Many star players from home and abroad have praised Islami Bank's eye-catching form in terms of irregularities in lending. They have flooded it with messages of praise from fake Twitter accounts. Former footballer Zinedine Zidane said from his fake Twitter account, 'Islami Bank is playing great. Even Messi's form in the World Cup was not so good.' 

Indian cricketer Sachin Tendulkar has praised it. Referring to the threat to Kohli for filling out such a form of Islami Bank from his fake ID, Sachin said, 'The cover drives of irregularities in Islamic Bank loans are eye-opening. If this continues, they will soon surpass Virat Kohli.' 

World-famous loan defaulters have requested Islami Bank to maintain the form in January as well as in November and December. One such loan defaulter, who did not want to be named, said, 'I could not watch the Islami Bank games in November-December due to my busy schedule. I am preparing for January. I have also booked the tickets. They just have to keep the form.'

Headline_English: Smart platform coming to market, with load sensor
Content_English:
Smart stages are coming to the market to prevent stage collapses. This stage, made with special technology, will have load sensors. The stage will give a signal if there are more passengers than its capacity. No accidents will happen. 

Recently, Tesla has brought such a state-of-the-art technology to the market. This technology of Tesla is being called the technological revolution of the 21st century to prevent stage collapses at political rallies. 

This Tesla stage will have various features. If an additional leader gets up, in addition to the signal, this digital stage will automatically throw that leader off the stage if he does not get off within 10 seconds. 

Central leaders and activists of various countries have expressed their excitement about this technological stage. However, a vice president from the vice presidents' organization said in a somewhat pleading tone, 'Very good technology. But instead of throwing him off, you can't have a system of kicking him down a little. After all, there is something called dignity.' 

Meanwhile, in addition to the smart stage, decoration businessmen have also asked Elon Musk for smart chairs. One such businessman said, "They used to fight with chairs at gatherings and break our chairs. Make a technology so that if you pick up a chair for a fight, it will break it."

Headline_English: Public leader Abul Kashem distributing ACs to cold-stricken people
Content_English:
This winter, everyone is helping the cold-stricken people as much as they can. However, a fake study shows that the help is very cheap. For example, winter sheets, winter blankets, and sweaters. However, this time, public leader Abul Kashem is standing by these cold-stricken people. He is distributing ACs. Let's hear about such a beautiful initiative from his own mouth. 

In this regard, Abul Kashem said, 'If you give to people, you have to give expensive things. If you give cheap things, the things do not last, and the person who gives them is not appreciated. Moreover, if you give them ACs, it will be very useful in this winter. For example, when the sun suddenly rises and it feels hot, they will be able to come and sit under the AC.' 
Such an initiative will not only reduce the pressure on North Bengal, but also give the poor people a sense of travel, said Mr. Kashem. He said, 'I see many people going to North Bengal to warm up well in the winter. Poor people cannot go because of money. This is my initiative so that they can enjoy the winter flowers of North Bengal by running AC at home.’ 

Maqbul of Kamalapur, who received the first AC gift from his initiative, said, ‘Sir, you are doing a very good job for us. If you only buy cheap blankets, otherwise you will have to pay for them. Does anyone think about us that much? Sir, it is our luck that you are giving us something so expensive. I will sleep at night with this AC. I will show my father the AC, he has a great passion for showing ACs.’ 

Meanwhile, the vice-president of the area’s winter clothing distribution organization, inspired by this work, changed the name of his organization to Winter AC Distribution Organization and told us that the money for 2 ACs has already been raised, and that once the money for 5 ACs is raised, they will be able to arrange for their own winter ACs.

Headline_English: Ronaldo sends soap, shampoo and blankets for Messi from Saudi Arabia
Content_English:
Portuguese football star Cristiano Ronaldo has joined Saudi Arabia's Al Nasser club. Even though he left Saudi Arabia, Ronaldo has not forgotten his dear friend Messi. It is reported that Ronaldo sent Dove soap, shampoo and two blankets for Messi from Saudi Arabia. 

A fake source also reported that he gave a note with the gift. In the note, he expressed his love for Messi and apologized for not being able to send anything for Roccuzzo. 

Ronaldo said in the note, 'I sent it just for you because I don't have any money. When I get my salary next month, I will send Fair and Lovely and Mechtar cream for Roccuzzo's sister. I will also send some chocolates for my nephews.' 

However, Messi was not very happy with such a gift. Rather, he expressed some disappointment and said, 'That's the same thing that he kept. He gets so much money for his salary! "You could have at least sent me a touch mobile." 

The football star also expressed hope that Karim Benzema would send Umrah tickets if he can settle down a bit in Saudi Arabia.

Headline_English: Rabindranath Tagore to sell his Nobel Prize for Litfest tickets
Content_English:
The 10th edition of Dhaka Lit Fest is starting from January 5. Although entry to the Lit Fest was free every time before, this time a ticket system has been introduced. For a one-day ticket, the price of a student ticket is 200 taka, regular ticket is 500 taka and VIP ticket is 3000 taka. For a three-day pass, student ticket is 500 taka, regular ticket is 1500 taka and VIP ticket is 10000 taka. Seeing such a high price of tickets, Rabindranath Tagore is also worried along with the common people. It is known that he will sell his Nobel Prize to come to the Lit Fest. 

When asked about this, Rabindranath said, ‘I don’t have much money in hand. I thought I would go for free this time. But that’s not happening anymore. I can’t stay even if I don’t go. So I’m thinking of selling the Nobel Prize.’ 

But why would you sell the Nobel Prize for one person’s ticket? When asked, Rabindranath said, ‘Not one person’s ticket, brother. Many others will have to pay for tickets. Jibanananda Das has asked for VIP tickets. Nazrul has also been calling and calling on Messenger for three days. When he didn't get a response, he sent a message, "Brother, arrange a few VIP tickets for me and my Leto song group. We can take them wherever we want!" 

Although Nazrul has said that he will set up a bread shop at the Lit Fest. If Rabindranath cuts VIP tickets, he will return the money after the festival if there is a profit from selling bread.

Headline_English: Demand to declare educational institutions closed due to severe winter
Content_English: A video of a newsreader from a report by Jamuna Television claiming that all educational institutions, including schools, colleges and madrasas, have been declared closed until further notice due to severe cold has been circulated on the short video sharing platform TikTok. The video, which was broadcast on November 24, claims that educational institutions have been declared closed indefinitely from tomorrow, i.e., November 25. In the broadcast video, the newsreader can be heard saying, "The Ministry of Education has announced the closure of all secondary and higher secondary level educational institutions and polytechnic institutes under the Ministry of Education until further notice. Colleges affiliated to the National University have been declared closed. This decision was announced in a press release by the Ministry of Education. It is said that this decision has been taken considering the safety of school and college-going students."

Headline_English: Scene of Secretariat vandalism over HSC failure
Content_English: The results of the HSC and equivalent exams were published on October 16. This time the average pass rate is 58.83. In light of this, students who failed the HSC exams are allegedly vandalizing the secretariat.

Headline_English: Conflict between BSc-Diploma Engineering students
Content_English: Since August 31, a photocard featuring the design of the mainstream media Kalbela, quoting and adding his picture to the Local Government Engineering Department's engineer Mr. Momin Mojibul Haque Samaji, has been circulated on various platforms on the internet. The photocard says, 'I studied civil engineering at BUET. I have worked with BUET students and teachers on various projects. I can swear that the engineering knowledge of the diploma engineers I have worked with is more than that of BUET professors. -Bilbandhu Momin Mojibul Haque Tutul Samaji | Project Director, LGED'.

Headline_English: Teacher dies while on duty for JACSU elections
Content_English: After 33 years, the Jahangirnagar University Central Students' Union (JACSU) elections were held on September 11. In view of the demands of some panels participating in the elections, votes were counted manually or by hand in the JACSU elections instead of using the OMR method in the machine like in the DUCSU elections. As a result, it took about three days to publish the election results. Jannatul Ferdous Moumita, assistant professor of the Department of Fine Arts, served as the returning officer and polling officer at the Pritilata Hall polling station in the elections. But the next day (September 12) morning, he suddenly fell ill while participating in the vote counting and died. News of his death was published in the domestic media.

Headline_English: Primary assistant teacher recruitment exam postponed
Content_English: According to the latest information received from the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education, this exam has been postponed from 3 pm on January 9.

Headline_English: Jamaat leader Abdul Quader Mollah, the founder of the school, who scored 100% GPA-5 in the SSC exam
Content_English: The results of the Secondary School Certificate (SSC) examination were published on July 10. In this year's SSC examination, all 320 students of Nasima Qadir Molla High School and Homes in Narsingdi got GPA-5. In view of this, a claim has spread on social media titled "Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami leader Abdul Quader Molla, the founder of the educational institution."

Headline_English: National University first year admission test date changed
Content_English: A low pressure area in the Bay of Bengal is causing heavy rainfall in several districts of the country. Meanwhile, a press release containing the design of the National University press release has been circulated on social media claiming that the date of the National University's undergraduate 1st year admission test has been changed to June 3 due to rain and cyclone.

Headline_English: SSC 2025 Maths Question Leak
Content_English: The SSC and equivalent exams started on April 10. The mathematics exam is going on today (April 21). In this context, recently, pictures of the mathematics board exam question papers have been circulated on social media under the demand of 'SSC Exam - 2025 Mathematics All Board Question Leaks'.

Headline_English: Army to be on duty at SSC exam hall
Content_English: Recently, a photocard bearing the logo of mainstream media Jamuna TV was circulated on social media under the headline "Army will be on duty in the examination room during SSC exams."

Headline_English: The message given to the nation by the coordinator of seven colleges
Content_English: The process of forming a new university with seven government colleges affiliated to Dhaka University (DU) is almost at its final stage. For this purpose, a special committee formed by the government has already completed various activities. In this context, a photo card was recently published on a Facebook page called Central University Unity on social media, claiming, "The message given to the nation by the coordinator of seven colleges." The photo card claims that Abdur Rahman, spokesperson of the Seven College University Transformation Team, said, "By enrolling in the college, we have turned the college into a university. Now we are publicans. From now on, everyone will speak to us with respect."

Headline_English: The proposed new university name for seven colleges is 'Westers University'
Content_English: Recently, a photocard bearing the Prothom Alo logo was circulated on the internet under the title 'The new university name for the seven colleges could be 'Westers University'.

Headline_English: Hunger strike to death at Titumir College
Content_English: Students of the government-run Titumir College in the capital have been protesting for several days demanding state recognition for declaring it an independent university. Since the afternoon of January 29, students under the banner of 'Demand for State Recognition of Titumir University' have started a hunger strike demanding seven points, including converting the government-run Titumir College into an independent university. In this context, a photo card with the logo of The Daily Campus has been circulated on the internet under the headline 'Titumir College students are sitting on hunger strike to death after taking turns eating.'

Headline_English: One killed in clashes at DU and seven colleges last night
Content_English: Yesterday (January 26) night, clashes and chases took place between students of seven colleges affiliated to Dhaka University (DU) and DU students. Both sides were in a face-to-face position throughout the night. Brick-throwing and chases and chases continued intermittently. Rumor Scanner has seen claims of at least one to a maximum of seven deaths in this incident being circulated on social media. In the wake of these claims, three media outlets in the country, Amar Desh, Jamuna TV and Janakantha, have been seen circulating claims of the deaths through photo cards made in the style of Janakantha.

Headline_English: Quran education is being made mandatory in schools and colleges
Content_English: Recently, a photocard with a picture of the religious advisor giving a speech in the press was circulated on social media, claiming that religious advisor AFM Khalid Hossain made a comment titled 'Quran education is being made mandatory in schools and colleges'.

Headline_English: Movement to abolish quota in medical admission exams Movement due to Hindu students ranking first
Content_English: The results of the admission test for the 2024-25 academic year of government and private medical colleges were published on January 19. Khulna's Sushoban Bachar secured the first place in the said results. In the meantime, several posts circulating on social media have claimed that a Hindu boy named Sushoban secured the first place in the medical admission test, and Jamaat is protesting demanding the cancellation of the results of the test.

Headline_English: Abu Saeed's picture on the cover of class 9th-10th Bengali literature books
Content_English: A picture similar to the cover of the ninth and tenth grade Bengali literature books has been circulated demanding the publication of a picture similar to the cover of the ninth and tenth grade Bengali literature books. The circulated picture, which resembles the cover, shows a picture similar to the picture of Abu Sayeed, the first person killed in the July-August movement, with his two arms outstretched.

Headline_English: Students have named Bangabandhu Hall of PUBRI 'Vijay-24', not DU's 'Vijay-71'
Content_English: Recently, on the occasion of Martyred Intellectuals Day, the name of Dhaka University's "Vijay-71" hall was changed to "Vijay 24" with a demand written on it, "Vijay-24 Hall".

Headline_English: Decision to keep all educational institutions open on Saturdays in 2025
Content_English: Recently, all educational institutions will be open on Saturdays from 2025.

Headline_English: Titumir College is being upgraded to a university, Advisor Asif Nazrul
Content_English: Students of the seven colleges affiliated to Dhaka University (DU) (Dhaka College, Eden Women's College, Begum Badrunnesa Government Women's College, Kabi Nazrul Government College, Shaheed Suhrawardy College, Mirpur Bangla College and Government Titumir College) have been agitating for a long time to establish a full-fledged university. In addition, for some time now, a demand has been raised from the students of the institution to make Titumir College a university on its own. Recently, a demand has been circulated on social media, quoting Professor Dr. Asif Nazrul, the interim government's advisor on law, justice and parliamentary affairs, saying, "The six colleges are not becoming universities for the time being, but Titumir College is being made a university."

Headline_English: Stipends for government primary school students to be suspended for the next two years
Content_English: Recently, a demand has been circulating on social media stating that stipends for government primary school students have been discontinued for the next two years.

Headline_English: Presenter Dipti Chowdhury fails HSC exam results
Content_English: The results of the HSC and equivalent exams were published yesterday (October 15). In the wake of this, a person named Tahsan Mahmud on a so-called blog site called Crazy Caption claimed, "Presenter Dipti Chowdhury, who is known for her extraordinary presentation skills and lively personality, recently failed her HSC exam results."

Headline_English: Free mass wedding organized at DU, Shariatpur girls fail to get son-in-law
Content_English: Recently, a photo card featuring the design of mainstream media outlet RTV's photo card was circulated on the internet under the headline, 'Free mass weddings organized at DU, Shariatpur girls did not get son-in-laws'.

Headline_English: Student allowance will be given even apart from stipend: Dr. Yunus, Chief Advisor
Content_English: Recently, a photocard featuring the design of private electronic media Jamuna Television, titled “Student allowance will be given even without stipend: Dr. Yunus Chief Advisor,” was circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: Education will be made free for all poor students in Bangladesh – Dr. Yunus
Content_English: Recently, a photocard featuring the design of private television channel NTV was circulated on social media Facebook under the title 'All poor students of Bangladesh will be made free of education - Dr. Yunus', demanding that the interim government's chief advisor, Dr. Muhammad Yunus, make education free for all poor students in the country.

Headline_English: Asif Mahtab becomes Uts Education Advisor
Content_English: The movement that began in early July demanding quota reforms in government jobs eventually turned into a movement to topple the government. In the face of mass protests, former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigned and left the country on August 5. Then, on August 8, a new interim government was formed in Bangladesh with Nobel laureate Dr. Muhammad Yunus as its chief advisor. In light of this, a claim has been made on social media that Asif Mahtab Uts has been appointed as an education advisor, according to information from the private electronic media Jamuna Television.

Headline_English: Most of the HSC students failed, says Maushi
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled “Most of the students of HSAC 24 have failed – Maushi” is being spread on social media. In this case, a photocard of a Facebook page called News Barta is seen being used.

Headline_English: Ronaldo and Leo Messi agree with HSC 2024 batch
Content_English: In the wake of the quota reform movement in government jobs and the student uprising, the HSC and equivalent examinations were postponed several times. First, the July 18 examination was postponed. Then, the July 21, 23 and 25 examinations were postponed together. Then, the examinations were postponed from July 28 to August 1. Later, it was decided that the HSC and equivalent examinations would be conducted on a new schedule from August 11. But later, it was announced that the examinations would not start on August 11 either. In the meantime, a section of the examinees has demanded auto-pass without taking the postponed examinations. In this context, a photocard with the title "Ronaldo and Leo Messi agree with the HSC 2024 batch" or a design by Prothom Alo has been spread on social media.

Headline_English: Postponed HSC exam with shortened syllabus
Content_English: HSC and equivalent examinations were postponed several times due to the situation arising from the quota reform movement in government jobs. The plan was to re-organize the postponed examination on August 11. However, a notification was issued by the Education Board stating that the examination had been postponed due to unavoidable reasons. In this situation, a demand for the shortened marks for the postponed HSC and equivalent examinations was circulated on social media and later in the mainstream media.

Headline_English: Zafar Iqbal has been relieved of his post as vice-chairman of the 2024-25 Bangladesh Mathematics Olympiad committee.
Content_English: Students of various higher education institutions across the country are continuing their agitation to protest against quota discrimination in government jobs of all grades. Meanwhile, Zafar Iqbal made written comments on the ongoing quota reform movement, which was not taken lightly by the agitators and supporters of the movement. In this context, claims are being spread on social media Facebook that Zafar Iqbal has been relieved of the post of vice-president of the Bangladesh Mathematics Olympiad 2024-25 committee. Although some posts do not mention the post of vice-president, the post of vice-president and Zafar Iqbal's name are being identified in the picture attached to the claimed post.

Headline_English: A student of Dhaka Imperial College committed suicide after not being able to postpone HSC exams
Content_English: HSC and equivalent exams will start from June 30. However, due to floods, the exam start date has been postponed in Sylhet division. Where the Inter-Education Board Coordination Committee has decided to conduct the exam from July 9. After that, a section of students demanded to postpone the exams not only in Sylhet but also across the country. Discussion and criticism have been going on on social media for several days. In view of this, recently, a message with a picture of a young man has been spread on social media Facebook claiming that a student of Dhaka Imperial College committed suicide due to not postponing the HSC exam.

Headline_English: National University's 4th year Honours exam to be held till June 29 postponed
Content_English: Recently, a circular signed by the university's Controller of Examinations (Acting) Mejbah Uddin, bearing the design of the National University's official pad, is being circulated on the social media Facebook with the demand titled "Urgent Notice Regarding Postponement of the Honors 4th Year Examination to be held under the National University until 29/06/2024".

Headline_English: No university from Bangladesh is among the top 1,500 universities in architecture.
Content_English: Recently, it is being claimed in the media and on social media platform Facebook that no university from Bangladesh is among the top 1,500 universities in the 2024 Architecture & Built Environment ranking published by QS.

Headline_English: SSC's new grading system
Content_English: After the new curriculum was introduced in grades 1, 2, 6 and 7 of primary and secondary levels last year, this curriculum has been implemented in grades 3, 4, 8 and 9 from this year. This curriculum demands a new grading system for evaluation in the SSC examination.

Headline_English: Cyclone postponement due to exams: National University
Content_English:
Cyclone Rimal, which originated in the Bay of Bengal, hit the coast of Bangladesh on the night of May 26. Following the forecast of Rimal, the ongoing examinations of several educational institutions in the country were postponed. Like other educational institutions in the country, the National University also postponed the examinations on the 26th and published a notice on its official website on May 25. 
Later, a picture of a notice demanding a notification from the National University was spread on social media. When the said notice was observed, it was seen that the notice said, ‘The examination on Sunday, 26/05/24 has been postponed due to the cyclone.’

Headline_English: Ramayana-Mahabharata to be taught in national curriculum in Saudi Arabian schools
Content_English: At various times, a demand has been circulating on social media and the media under similar headlines, including "Ramayana-Mahabharata to be taught in Saudi schools."

Headline_English: Currently, the standard of education in Bangladesh is the lowest in South Asia.
Content_English: Recently, a claim was made on social media platform Facebook that Bangladesh's education standard is 123rd out of 138 countries, which is the lowest in South Asia.

Headline_English: Schools, colleges to remain closed in 27 districts for an indefinite period today only
Content_English: A severe heat wave is currently raging across the country, resulting in severe heat and heatwave conditions everywhere. In view of this unbearable heat, yesterday (April 29), the Ministry of Education announced the closure of all schools and colleges in 27 districts for an indefinite period, a statement was circulated on the internet claiming.

Headline_English: Education Minister announces closure of Qawmi Madrasa
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information titled "Qawmi Madrasa closed forever, new Education Minister orders" has spread on the internet.

Headline_English: Announcement of passing marks for SSC Mathematics with 9 marks and A+ marks with 55 marks
Content_English: This year's SSC Mathematics exam was held on February 25. Later, a video titled "Math exam is difficult, so good news! Pass if you get only "9", and A+ if you get 55" was circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: Application to UGC to establish a university in the name of Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH)
Content_English: Since last year, claims have been made on various internet platforms that an application has been made to the University Grants Commission (UGC) to establish a university in the name of the last prophet of Islam, Hazrat Muhammad (PBUH).

Headline_English: Lesson on 'Jihad' in 2024 ninth grade Islamic education book
Content_English: On January 27, a video (archive) titled "10 anti-Islamic issues in addition to Sharifa's stories in textbooks" was published on the verified YouTube channel of Islamic thinker and speaker Shaykh Ahmadullah.

Headline_English: 6th-10th grade: Applications for assistance of 5,000 taka for each student have started
Content_English: Recently, an information titled '6th-10th class: Application for 5 thousand taka assistance for every student has started' has been circulated on social media, demanding that all students from class 6 to 10 of secondary level will be provided with 5 thousand taka assistance from the Prime Minister's Education Assistance Trust.

Headline_English: Former BRAC University part-time teacher Asif Mahtab Uts arrested
Content_English: Recently, a video was circulated on the video sharing platform YouTube with the title "Asif Mahtab arrested for openly tearing a book, justifying homosexuality. Bd latest news" and the thumbnail "Asif Mahtab arrested for openly tearing a book" in protest of the incident of Asif Mahtab, a recently retired part-time teacher of philosophy at BRAC University, tearing a page from the "Sharifa Story" section of the "Similarities and Differences Between People" chapter of the textbook of the seventh grade of the university.

Headline_English: Students under the age of 16 will not be able to attend coaching.
Content_English: The incident of students under 16 not being able to attend coaching in Bangladesh

Headline_English: Picture of Durga in third grade Islamic education book
Content_English: There is widespread discussion and criticism on Facebook about the picture of Durga in the third grade Islam and Moral Education book. After the distribution of the book during the festival on the first day of the new year, a video went viral on social media in which the picture of the Hindu goddess Durga can be seen on the inside or side of the cover of the third grade Islam and Moral Education book. Later, the issue of the picture of Durga in the Islamic Education book went viral and created widespread criticism on Facebook.

Headline_English: Gaza declares end of 2023-24 academic year
Content_English: Recently, a claim that the Ministry of Education in Gaza, Palestine, has declared the end of the 2023-24 academic year has spread widely on social media.

Headline_English: Three students arrested for hacking website and changing results
Content_English: The results of the Higher Secondary Certificate (HSC) and equivalent examinations were released on November 26. On the day of the results announcement, a post titled “Breaking News: 3 students arrested for hacking websites and changing results” was circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: BRAC University ranks first in Bangladesh in Times Higher Rankings
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled "BRAC University has secured first place among all universities in Bangladesh in the World University Rankings 2024 by the UK-based education magazine Times Higher Education" is being circulated on social media and the media.

Headline_English: Student dies in CU shuttle train accident
Content_English: Recently, a story is being circulated on social media, including Facebook, claiming that a student died after being hit by a tree while returning from the city to campus on the roof of a Chittagong University shuttle train.

Headline_English: HSC Bengali 1st paper question paper leaked
Content_English: On August 17, the Bangla 1st Paper exam for HSC candidates started at 10 am. Earlier, at 9:01 am, a post (archive) published on Facebook from an account called “Adnan Hasib Arnob” claimed that the HSC Bangla 1st Paper Question will come 100% correct. It is not possible to upload questions from all boards. Here I have given 3 proofs. I have given proof for Dhaka Board, Comilla Board and Jessore Board, that too 1 hour before the exam.

Headline_English: Auto GPA-5 in HSC for dengue-affected candidates
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled 'HSC candidates will get auto GPA-5 if they have dengue' is being promoted on social media Facebook through a photocard made in the style of Prothom Alo.

Headline_English: HSC exams may be postponed due to earthquake
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information titled 'HSC exams may be postponed due to earthquake' is being circulated on social media Facebook through a photocard modeled after Prothom Alo, demanding a comment from Education Minister Dipu Moni.

Headline_English: BUET student Ashiqul Islam Bitu accused in Abrar murder case
Content_English: Recently, an information is being circulated through the media and social media demanding 'BUET students protest over Ashiqul Islam, the accused in the murder case of BUET student Abrar Fahad, joining B2 classes'.

Headline_English: This year's XI admission process will be completed through lottery
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled 'Admission to the current year's XI will be completed through a lottery' is being circulated through the media, including social media.

Headline_English: Comilla University name change
Content_English: In a report on the history of the university's name change, online portal Dhaka Tribune claimed that Comilla University, the country's 26th public university, changed its name from Comilla University (CU) to Cumilla University in 2018.

Headline_English: Student commits suicide after not getting a chance in DU admission test
Content_English: A photo of a letter has gone viral on Facebook, claiming that a Kurigram student named Moumita Mou committed suicide after failing to pass the admission test results for an undergraduate program at a unit of Dhaka University.

Headline_English: Eden College student Mukta Sultana burns her academic certificate to get a government job
Content_English: A claim is being spread on the media, social media Facebook, video sharing platform YouTube, and short video sharing platform TikTok, claiming that Eden College student Mukta Sultana burned her academic certificate to get a government job.

Headline_English: 65 out of 266 teachers are on leave
Content_English: A news report titled "65 out of 266 teachers on leave" has been published in the media regarding the number of teachers and students at Comilla University.

Headline_English: Gazette regarding the appointment of office staff and security guards in government primary schools and their salaries and allowances
Content_English: Two notices titled 'Gazette regarding the appointment of office staff and security guards in government primary schools and their salaries and allowances' are being circulated on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Ronaldo's children beaten at Saudi school
Content_English: Media reports in various countries have claimed that Ronaldo's children were beaten at a school in Saudi Arabia, citing Ronaldo's girlfriend Georgina Rodriguez.

Headline_English: Nafis National University student gets opportunity at MIT
Content_English: An information is being circulated on social media Facebook with the claim, "After studying at a national university rather than a public university, Nafis is now at MIT, an American university."

Headline_English: The acting principal cannot hold the position for more than six consecutive months.
Content_English: Citing a purported notification from the Secondary and Higher Education Department of the Ministry of Education, an information statement titled "Acting head teachers cannot be in charge for more than six consecutive months" was circulated through the media and social media.

Headline_English: Automatically awarding degrees to students if universities are destroyed or damaged
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information titled "According to the Accidental Graduation Act, if a university is destroyed by fire or earthquake, all students must graduate immediately" has been circulating on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: The book 'Know Yourself' is a textbook for NCTB
Content_English: Recently, a picture of a report titled 'What have you learned or what will you teach your children?? The country's education system has been overhauled. The clear proof of this is the new 2023 secondary school textbook. Is Zafar Iqbal the only one behind this?...' has been circulating on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Grade 9-10 Science: Another name for vitamin B5 is niacin.
Content_English: In the first chapter (page 9) of the 'Science' textbook for grades 9-10 of secondary school, in the paragraph titled "Food or Vitamins", while informing about the sources of important vitamins belonging to the vitamin B complex and deficiency diseases, it is claimed, "Niacin or nicotinic acid is another name for vitamin B5."

Headline_English: Send a message to 20 people to prevent your Instagram account from being disabled.
Content_English: Recently, a message was widely forwarded on WhatsApp claiming, ‘Important Notice to All Instagram Users | This message has been sent to all users by Instagram authorities. Instagram is likely to face some technical glitches in the next few days. For this reason, every user must send this message to at least 20 people before October 30. If you fail to do this, your account may be temporarily disabled and you will not be able to reactivate it. However, if you send this message to 20 people, a new feature will be activated on your account after the next update. Please take quick action before October 30. Thank you for your cooperation, Instagram Team’

Headline_English: Facebook sends notifications when profile visits and story screenshots are taken
Content_English: Recently, claims have been circulating on social media platform Facebook about two new features. One claim says that from now on, Facebook will send a notification to the profile owner whenever a user visits another user's profile. Another claim says that if someone takes a screenshot of someone's story, the story owner will also be notified. Two screenshots of the alleged notifications are also being circulated on social media in support of these claims.

Headline_English: Ruthba Yasmin is going to be the first Bangladeshi to set foot on the moon.
Content_English: Recently, claims have been spread through the media and social media that 'Ruthba Yasmin is going to be the first Bangladeshi to set foot on the moon.'

Headline_English: Jules, the famous airplane builder, has a chance to get into Harvard University.
Content_English: Since at least March 6, a collage of two screenshots has been circulating on social media platform Facebook, claiming, "The boy who built and built the plane got a chance at the world-famous Herbert University. Even if Bengalis don't know how to evaluate talent, the UK does."

Headline_English: Elon Musk gets his hair cut by a robot barber
Content_English: Recently, the Daily Janakantha published a report claiming that Tesla and SpaceX CEO Elon Musk is getting his hair cut by a robot barber. The report mentioned that a video has gone viral on social media in which a state-of-the-art robot is seen cutting Elon Musk's hair. At the end of the report, the media outlet termed it as 'Musk's new move towards the future of technology'.

Headline_English: Find out who is viewing your Facebook profile
Content_English: Recently, online news portal Sangbad Prakash published a report titled “Find Out Who is Viewing Your Facebook Profile.” In the report, they mention a few steps and claim that by following these steps, it is possible to know who is viewing your Facebook profile.

Headline_English: The sound of ATM machines counting money is artificial.
Content_English: Recently, a false claim that ATM machines are counting money has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: The reason Elon Musk changed his Twitter name to X
Content_English: After much drama, billionaire Elon Musk bought the popular social media company Twitter in 2022. Later in 2023, he changed the name of Twitter to X. Recently, in the wake of this, a claim is being spread on social media, Facebook, that “Elon Musk’s ex-girlfriend Amber Heard blocked him on Twitter after he found a new boyfriend, which led to their breakup. Elon Musk was very angry about this. Elon Musk then bought Twitter, banned his ex-girlfriend from the site, and renamed the platform “X” as a symbol of his influence.”

Headline_English: Alexander Graham Bell, who invented the telephone, said the first hello.
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information is being circulated on the internet on the social media Facebook, mentioning “Hello, the first sentence of the phone.” It is being claimed, “Hello is the name of a girl. Her full name is Margaret Hello. She is none other than the girlfriend of the famous scientist Alexander Graham Bell. Graham Bell is the inventor of the telephone. After the invention, he made the first experimental call to his girlfriend and the words he said were – Hello is her name. From that moment on, the practice of saying hello on the phone began.”

Headline_English: Google founder announces closure of Google in Israel
Content_English: Recently, a video is being circulated on the short video sharing platform TikTok with the title "Google's founder is supporting Palestine. And he announced the closure of Google in Israel."

Headline_English: The number of female users on Facebook is 5.77 billion.
Content_English: For the past few years, the claim "There are 3.52 billion females in the world, but there are 5.77 billion female Facebook IDs" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Demand to stop Facebook from earning from news-based content
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled "Facebook has started stopping revenue from news-based content. That is, the channels will no longer receive any money from views due to news from any news channel." has been spread on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: NASA scientists find evidence that the moon split in two
Content_English: Recently, a video titled "Modern science proves the secret of the Prophet Muhammad's moon splitting in two! Subhanallah Alhamdulillah" was circulated on the internet claiming that NASA scientists have found evidence of the moon splitting in two.

Headline_English: The government recently announced that TikTok is being banned in Bangladesh.
Content_English: Recently, an information titled 'Bangladesh Education Board announces that the popular "TikTok" is being banned permanently from Bangladesh' is being circulated on social media platforms Facebook, video sharing platform YouTube, and short video sharing platform TikTok.

Headline_English: Warning to turn off phones, mobiles and tabs at certain times of night due to cosmic rays
Content_English: For a long time, a message has been circulating on social media, quoting Google, NASA, and BBC News, titled "Turn off your phone, mobile, tab and keep it away from your body from 12:30 AM to 3:30 AM tonight," claiming, "Singapore Television reported that at that time, our Earth will encounter high-energy cosmic rays that will pass very close to our Earth, so turn off your phone, do not keep your phone close to your body - it can cause serious harm to you."

Headline_English: New communication rules for WhatsApp and phone calls to be implemented from tomorrow
Content_English:
Recently, an information titled “New communication rules for WhatsApp and phone calls will be implemented from tomorrow” is being circulated on social media Facebook. The claims being made in the Facebook posts are 
1. All calls will be recorded. 

2. All phone call recordings will be saved. 

3. WhatsApp will be monitored. 

4. Twitter will be monitored. 

5. Facebook will be monitored. 

6. All social media and forums will be monitored. Inform those who do not know. 

7. Be careful not to connect everyone's devices to the cabinet system, send unnecessary messages. And inform your children, relatives and friends about this to take care. 

8. Do not forward any posts or videos etc. 

9. You should refrain from posting any posts related to politics, the government, the Prime Minister, etc., the current situation. Police have issued a circular titled .. Cyber ​​Crime … and have said that action will be taken. 

10. Inform your friends and others. It is now a crime to write or forward any picture of any political and religious controversy, without a warrant, from today it is very important, inform everyone. 
11. Be careful not to send unnecessary messages and inform everyone about this. Thank you. Rapid Action Battalion (RAB) on alert.

Headline_English: Rahul's birthday celebrated on board while ISRO brings rocket on bicycle
Content_English: Recently, a claim is being circulated on Facebook with the title "When ISRO was having to bring rockets on bicycles due to lack of money, the government was busy celebrating Rahul Gandhi's birthday on a plane in the country," along with a collage image.

Headline_English: Facebook account cloning claims
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been made on Facebook that Facebook users' accounts are being cloned. "Various sources are reporting that almost all of our accounts are being cloned. Another account is being opened with your profile picture and name. Then they are sending friend requests to your friends. And your friends are accepting them, thinking you are the one. And to frame you, they will post various anti-government, anti-religious texts/pictures. This group will use this opportunity to spread their message under your name."

Headline_English: Global ranking by YouTube views and subscribers
Content_English:
Recently, on the occasion of the completion of 20 million subscribers of the domestic media Somoy TV, several information is being circulated on the Internet. 
First claim: Among the most watched news-based TV channels in the world on the YouTube platform, ‘CNN’ is in first place with 14.3 billion views and ‘SOMOY TV’ is in second place with 12.4 billion views. 

Second claim: Somoy is now 23rd among all YouTube channels in the world in terms of subscribers. It is 17th among all YouTube channels in the world in terms of video views.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi-born Russo Kazi is the co-founder of Matter Threads.
Content_English: Several media reports have cited Bangladeshi-born Russo Kazi as the co-founder of Matter Threads.

Headline_English: Bangladesh ranks first in South Asia in agricultural production under commercial solar power plants
Content_English: Recently, a news item titled 'Successful agricultural production under the first commercial solar power plant in South Asia has started in Bangladesh' is being circulated on the media and social media Facebook, citing State Minister for Power, Energy and Mineral Resources Nasrul Hamid and the ministry.

Headline_English: 'You have to pay 1200 taka per month to use Facebook'
Content_English: Recently, an information titled 'Facebook can no longer be used for free. You will have to register and use it for 1200 taka per month' is being circulated on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: The killings of Abu Said, Mughd, and Hadi were all part of meticulous design.
Content_English: A photocard with the Channel 24 logo and a picture of DMP Commissioner Md. Sajjat ​​Ali has gone viral on social media, claiming that the comment titled 'Abu Said, Mughd, and Hadi's killings were all part of meticulous design' was made by the DMP Commissioner.

Headline_English: Revolutionary government to be formed in the evening | Mahmudur Rahman to be the chief advisor
Content_English: Recently, a photocard featuring the design of the media outlet Amar Desh, titled 'Revolutionary government being formed in the evening | Mahmudur Rahman will be the chief advisor', was circulated on social media, with a photo of Mahmudur Rahman, editor of the daily Amar Desh, attached.

Headline_English: Press Secretary Shafiqul Alam asks media to provide their own security
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. As news of Osman Hadi's death spread, buildings were vandalized and set on fire in various parts of the country overnight. Domestic mainstream media outlets Prothom Alo and Daily Star were also attacked and set on fire. In this context, demands have recently been circulated on social media, with the Chief Advisor's Press Secretary Shafiqul Alam telling the media, "Provide your own security."

Headline_English: Army imposes Section 144 across the country
Content_English: At least since the night of December 20, a claim has been circulating on social media, saying, 'Another unstable country is declaring an emergency from the army chief's cantonment.' A link to the detailed claim was attached to the post's comments section, which claimed, 'In view of the ongoing instability and deterioration of the law and order situation in the country, the army has imposed Section 144 across the country. This directive has been implemented since Thursday morning, according to sources from the Inter-Services Public Relations (ISPR).

Headline_English: Claim that 'dishonest' is written on Bir Shrestha Matiur's grave in Pakistan
Content_English:
During the Bangladesh Liberation War, on August 20, 1971, while trying to escape in a fighter jet, Matiur Rahman, a Bengali officer of the Pakistan Air Force, crashed the plane during a fight with a Pakistani trainee pilot named Rashid Minhaj, and both were killed. Matiur was buried that day in the graveyard of Mashrur Air Base in Pakistan. After independence, Matiur Rahman was awarded the title of Bir Shreshtho. On June 24, 2006, his remains were brought to Bangladesh and buried the next day in the Mirpur Shaheed Intellectual Graveyard. 

For many years, there has been a discussion about Bir Shreshtho Matiur Rahman, starting from the pages of the media and in the general public, that in the graveyard where Matiur was buried in Pakistan, the inscription on Matiur's grave was "Idhar Sho Raha Hai Ek Gaddar". Which means in Bengali, "Here lies a traitor."

Headline_English: Abu Saeed died of a heart attack.
Content_English: Abu Sayeed, a student of the English Department of Begum Rokeya University (BEROBI), was killed while participating in a protest against discrimination on July 16 last year. Abu Sayeed, 25, was known as one of the coordinators of the quota reform movement. Recently, a video of a speech by a motorcyclist went viral on social media. In his speech, he claimed, “Abu Sayeed is like this. His mother said, ‘My son has a heart attack.. stroke.’”

Headline_English: Deputy Press Secretary to Chief Advisor Azad attacked
Content_English: Recently, a video was circulated on social media claiming that the Deputy Press Secretary to the Chief Advisor, Abul Kalam Azad Majumder, was attacked.

Headline_English: Resignation of Chief Advisor and transfer of power to the military
Content_English: A photo card with the pictures of Chief Advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus and Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman has been circulated on social media with the demand, "Dr. Yunus resigned and handed over power to the army."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus' residence surrounded on the orders of the army chief
Content_English: A video has been circulating on social media claiming that army chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman's troops have surrounded the residence of Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the interim government's chief adviser.

Headline_English: Militants carry out three bomb attacks in Mohammadpur area of ​​the capital
Content_English: A video has been circulating on social media claiming that militants carried out three bomb attacks in the capital's Mohammadpur area today (November 5). The video shows black smoke rising from the roof of a multi-storey building.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus House Arrest
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the photocard of the national daily Kaler Kantho newspaper with the headline "Heads of 3 forces in Jamuna, state of emergency declared in the country, Yunus house arrest" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: The President did not declare the July Charter invalid or null and void.
Content_English: The July Charter was signed at a ceremony organized by the National Consensus Commission at the South Plaza of the National Parliament Building on October 17. Political parties including BNP and Jamaat-e-Islami participated in it. On the night of October 30, a demand titled 'President Mohammad Shahabuddin declared the July Charter illegal and nullified' spread on social media.

Headline_English: Khaled Muhiuddin involved in Sagar-Runi murder
Content_English: Multiple photo cards featuring journalist Khaled Muhiuddin are being circulated on social media using the logo of the daily Kaler Kantho. The title of one photo card claims that Khaled Muhiuddin lost his job at Deutsche Welle after being accused of raping a German woman. Another photo card claims, citing an alleged colleague of journalist couple Sagar-Runi, that Khaled Muhiuddin is involved in the murder of Sagar-Runi.

Headline_English: Army chief orders bail for Awami League workers
Content_English: A video titled "All Awami League leaders and activists must be granted bail" has been circulated on social media demanding a statement from Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman.

Headline_English: Sanctions on army if Sheikh Hasina's resignation letter is not submitted to the UN
Content_English: Breaking News – A demand titled 'Sanctions on the army if legitimate Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's resignation letter is not submitted to the United Nations' has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Asif Nazrul arrested on President's orders
Content_English: A claim titled 'Breaking News: Advisor Asif Nazrul arrested on the orders of His Excellency the President, watch the video in the comments' has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus says he will resign if the army takes responsibility for his security
Content_English: A photocard bearing the RTV logo has been circulated on social media claiming that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, has made a comment titled "If the army is not responsible for my security, I will resign."

Headline_English: Bodies of expatriates burnt to ashes in Dhaka airport fire
Content_English: A terrible fire broke out in the Cargo Village Complex building of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka on October 18. The fire was brought under control after about six and a half hours of efforts by 37 units from 13 fire stations. In this context, a video of several ambulances was recently circulated on social media, claiming that 'ambulances are leaving the airport one after another with corpses/cases.' Several bodies brought back by expatriates have been completely burnt to ashes in a terrible fire in the cargo section of Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in the capital. Several units of the fire service tried for several hours to bring the fire under control, but it was not possible to save the bodies of expatriates kept in coffins along with valuable cargo.

Headline_English: Noakhali was declared a division
Content_English: The people of the area have been protesting for several days demanding that Noakhali be declared an independent administrative division. In this context, a photocard bearing the logo of the national daily Kalbela newspaper with the title “Declaration of division in the name of Noakhali. The merger of Comilla with Dhaka” is being circulated on social media recently.

Headline_English: Hill people in Khagrachari demand arson at BGB camp
Content_English: At least three people were killed in clashes between law enforcement and Jumma students in Guimara upazila of Khagrachhari over the incident of protesting the rape of a schoolgirl. Several establishments, including local shops, were vandalized and set on fire. In this context, a video has been circulated on social media Facebook claiming that hill tribesmen attacked a BGB camp during the clash on September 28, setting it on fire and looting weapons.

Headline_English: Killed in army firing in Khagrachari
Content_English: At least three people have been killed in clashes between law enforcement and Jumma students in Guimara upazila of Khagrachari over the incident of protesting the rape of a schoolgirl. Tensions have flared between the Pahari and Bengali communities over the incident. In the wake of this, a photo is being circulated on social media today claiming that a woman is lying dead in Ramsu Bazar of Guimara after being shot by the army. The body was left behind at night.

Headline_English: Home Affairs Advisor Jahangir resigns and Babur assumes charge
Content_English: On September 14, BNP leader and former State Minister for Home Affairs Lutfuzzaman Babar visited the Home Ministry after almost 19 years. Lutfuzzaman Babar held a two-hour meeting with Home Affairs Advisor Lieutenant General (retd) Jahangir Alam Chowdhury at the Secretariat. After the meeting, he told reporters that BNP Acting Chairman Tarique Rahman is returning home soon, so he spoke to the advisor about his security. In this context, a video titled "Home Minister voluntarily resigns, Lutfur Rahman Babar is the new Home Affairs Advisor, Babar is India's Yamadoot" has been circulated on TikTok.

Headline_English: UN's Volker Turk's message involving the interim government and the Bangladesh Army
Content_English: UN human rights chief Volker Turk has found "sufficient evidence" of illegal power grabs, extrajudicial killings and a rise in militant activity in Bangladesh against the interim government. Volker Turk has warned that sanctions will be imposed on the Bangladesh army if it does not comply with international human rights law.' A video with the caption 'has been circulated on various internet platforms.

Headline_English: Bangladesh Police's 11-point recommendations in July charter
Content_English:
The July Charter has been under regular discussion since the mass uprising on August 5 last year. The level of discussion about the July Charter has recently increased. In this context, a picture on the letterhead of the Bangladesh Police has recently been circulated on social media, claiming that the picture is of the letter under special consideration of the 11-point recommendation of the Bangladesh Police on the July Charter. 
The image shows a list of 11 recommendations, which recommend, 

“1. The July Charter should properly highlight the positive information about the police in this movement 
2. The correct list of police members killed in the July movement should be published 
3. All police killings in the July movement should be thoroughly investigated 
4. The July Charter should not give immunity to police killers in the July movement in any way 
5. Arrangements should be made to bring those involved in every police killing in the July movement to justice 
6. No obstacles should be created in bringing police killers to justice 
7. The July Charter should mention the killed police members 
8. The July Charter should provide compensation to the killed and injured police members 
9. The police should not be used for the security of any political party since the July Charter was announced 
10. The July Charter should also contain the basic issues of police reform 
11. The July Charter should contain regulations regarding the fact that no political party can control the police anymore.”

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus comments that the upcoming national parliamentary elections will be held through the PR method
