Content_English: A claim titled "Chief Advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus has said that the upcoming 13th National Parliament election will be held under the proportional representation or PR system" has been circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Bangladesh Bank Governor dismissed for adding temple image to new 20 taka note
Content_English: New banknotes of various denominations were released before Eid-ul-Azha, including a 20-taka note. While the existing 20-taka note in the market had a picture of the traditional Shat Gombuj Mosque in Bagerhat, this new 20-taka note has been decorated using pictures of the Kantjiu Temple in Dinajpur and the Paharpur Buddhist Monastery in Naogaon. This has created a lot of discussion on social media. Recently, a demand was spread on social media, "Alhamdulillah! That controversial governor should be expelled. The one who put the picture of the temple on the 20-taka note."

Headline_English: Costa Rica and Ireland's trade agreements with Bangladesh cancelled
Content_English: A photo has been circulated on Facebook claiming that Costa Rican President Mohammed Abdul bin Farhan Khabir has suspended a trade deal with Bangladesh and canceled $345 million in aid, and that Ireland has stopped visa and coal deals. The post further claims that the Costa Rican government departments made this decision jointly on the day the post was published, i.e., June 2.

Headline_English: $20 billion laundered in the last 10 months
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on social media that nearly $20 billion has been laundered from the country in the last 10 months.

Headline_English: Attack on Consumer Affairs Department official Abdul Jabbar
Content_English: A video has been circulated on social media claiming that Abdul Jabbar Mondal, Assistant Director of the National Consumer Rights Protection Department's Dhaka region, was attacked by a mob with the caption 'Consumer Rights Officer Abdul Jabbar Mondal is a victim of a mob!'

Headline_English: 'Nusrat Faria's arrest is embarrassing' Asif Nazrul
Content_English: Actress Nusrat Faria has been arrested by the Immigration Police at Hazrat Shahjalal International Airport in Dhaka. She was arrested at the airport's immigration checkpost on the morning of May 18 while traveling to Thailand. In this context, claims have been circulating in the media and social media today (May 19) that the arrest of actress Nusrat Faria is embarrassing, said Legal Advisor Asif Nazrul.

Headline_English: Comments on the name of the Army Chief on the Pak-India issue
Content_English: Using the photo of Bangladesh Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman, a photocard made in the style of Bangladesh Television is being used to claim his statement, "India has the right to claim its own security. India can use maximum force to protect the country. Pakistan and India prevent war. The situation in Bangladesh is peaceful, but those who have tortured and oppressed us in the past are completely prohibited from using Bangladeshi land."

Headline_English: UN orders arrest of interim government advisers if police killings not prosecuted
Content_English: A piece of information titled "UN orders all advisors to be arrested if 3,200 police killings are not prosecuted in detailed comments" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Religious advisor Dr. AFM Khalid Hossain commits suicide
Content_English: A photo card featuring the design of mainstream electronic media Jamuna TV is being circulated on social media platform Facebook under the headline, "Religious advisor commits suicide after being unable to bear the pain of killing an imam in mob violence in Gazipur."

Headline_English: One hundred taka note with Dr. Yunus's picture
Content_English: Recently, a picture of a 100-taka note with the image of Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, and the words July Movement are being circulated on the internet, claiming to be a genuine note.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus wants to unite Bangladesh and Pakistan
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of mainstream media Daily Janakantha is being circulated on social media with the headline, 'Bangladesh's lost brother Yunus Sarkar is trying hard to reunite the two brothers.'

Headline_English: Army chief injured in road accident in Satkhira
Content_English: Since at least the night of April 21, a claim has been circulating on social media, "Five army personnel, including the army chief, injured in a horrific road accident in Satkhira."

Headline_English: Attack on Dhaka Central Jail, Salman F. Rahman and Shamsuddin Chowdhury Manik also killed
Content_English: An information titled 'Terrible attack on VIP cell of Dhaka Central Jail: Salman F. Rahman and former judge Manik Mia killed' is being circulated on social media.

Headline_English: India, Israel hold secret meeting in Delhi to jointly conduct military operations in Bangladesh (American intelligence agency CIA)
Content_English: A photocard with the BBC Bangla logo has been circulated on social media with the headline 'India, Israel hold secret meeting in Delhi to jointly conduct military operations in Bangladesh (American intelligence agency CIA)'.

Headline_English: Fewer than 100 students killed in July protests Badiul Alam Majumder
Content_English: "The number of students killed in the July movement will be less than 100," commented Badiul Alam Majumdar.

Headline_English: Chief advisor says Padma Bridge demolition to begin tomorrow
Content_English: A claim titled 'The demolition of the Padma Bridge will begin from tomorrow, Chief Advisor says. Detailed comments' is being circulated on social media.

Headline_English: The military has taken power.
Content_English: A claim titled "The military has taken power" is being circulated on social media.

Headline_English: 33 BGB members missing in Naf River
Content_English:
My brother BDR Billal Hasan is working in Teknaf. According to the BDR officer, Hassan and 32 others went on a mission in the Naf River for two days. 
Suddenly, one of their representatives came to us and told us that Billal Hasan and 32 others were missing and that 99% of them were dead. 

33 BDR soldiers who were protecting the country have been missing for 2 days and have not been found, I have not seen any news about this from the BDR! 
Are the lives of 33 BDR soldiers worthless? 
For what purpose is such a big issue being covered up? 
I am drawing the attention of the government.

Headline_English: Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman dies in road accident
Content_English: Hasnat Abdullah, the southern organizer of the Jatiya Nagorik Party, posted on Facebook alleging that a plan is underway to rehabilitate the Awami League from the cantonment. In the wake of this, social media is spreading the news that Bangladesh Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman has died in a road accident. The claim is being spread through a photo card modeled after mainstream media outlet RTV.

Headline_English: Former judge Manik's hanging body recovered from prison
Content_English: After the fall of the Awami League government on August 5 last year in a student-public uprising, former Justice AHM Shamsuddin Chowdhury was arrested by the Border Guard Bangladesh (BGB) on August 23 while trying to flee to India through an illegal border crossing in Kanaighat, Sylhet. He was handed over to Kanaighat police in the early hours of August 24. He has been in jail since then. Recently, several posts based on a report titled ‘Breaking News: Former Justice Manik’s hanging body recovered in prison’ have been circulated on social media Facebook. The report uses Justice Manik’s photo and reads, “**Dhaka, March 17, 2025** – Former Justice of Bangladesh A.B.M. Khairul Haque Manik is no more. His hanging body was recovered in prison this evening.** His death has created a sensation across the country.”

Headline_English: Army chief announces Yunus' resignation and Sheikh Hasina's return to the country on March 20
Content_English: Army Chief Waqar-uz-Zaman came live and made the final announcement. Honorable Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is coming to the country on March 20. An information titled "Dr. Yunus has been announced to resign" is being circulated on TikTok.

Headline_English: Indian Army Chief comments that Dhaka-Delhi relations will be as before if Sheikh Hasina returns to Bangladesh
Content_English: A video has been circulated on the internet claiming that the Indian Army Chief made a comment titled "Dhaka-Delhi relations will be the same as before if Sheikh Hasina returns to Bangladesh."

Headline_English: Section 144 imposed in Dhaka
Content_English: At least since March 5, a demand titled 'Today the situation in Dhaka is bad, Section 144 imposed' has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Home Affairs Advisor kidnapped in Mohammadpur
Content_English: A photocard modeled after the national daily Samakal has been circulated on social media, claiming that Home Affairs Advisor Md. Jahangir Alam Chowdhury was kidnapped in Mohammadpur.

Headline_English: Curfew imposed in Bangladesh
Content_English: A message titled "Curfew has been imposed in Bangladesh" has been spreading on social media.

Headline_English: Peacekeeping deployment in Bangladesh
Content_English: Recently, a video report published by the Indian media Aaj Tak Bangla claimed, "It's true that peacekeeping forces are entering Bangladesh." The report claimed that West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee wanted UN peacekeeping forces to be sent to Bangladesh. This time, the United Nations has published a report on Bangladesh and there is speculation that there is no longer any obstacle to the entry of peacekeeping forces into Bangladesh. The entry of UN peacekeeping forces into Bangladesh is now just a matter of time. The video report also talks about the information mentioned in the report published by the United Nations.

Headline_English: Motorcycles with 600 cc engine limit approved in Bangladesh
Content_English: A claim is being spread on social media Facebook that motorcycles up to 600 cc limit have been approved in the country and will soon be released in gadget form.

Headline_English: The decision to double the price of gas was made with difficulty! How will you cook?
Content_English: Recently, a photocard was circulated from the Facebook page of Bangladesh Awami League using the hashtag #BangladeshCrisis with the title ‘The decision to double the price of gas was made with difficulty! How will you cook?’. At the bottom right of the photocard, a caption ‘I was good before’ is seen. This is meant to imply that the decision to double the price of gas at home has been made, due to which people will not be able to cook even if they can go to the market.

Headline_English: Indian Army Chief threatens attack on Bangladesh
Content_English: An information titled 'Indian Army Chief threatens to attack Bangladesh at any time' is being circulated on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Myanmar's Arakan Army seizes Bangladesh's St. Martin's Island
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on various internet platforms that Myanmar's Arakan Army has captured Bangladesh's St. Martin's Island.

Headline_English: Major Dalim's comments about rape victims in the Liberation War
Content_English: On January 5, a person identified as freedom fighter Major Shariful Haque Dalim (Bir Uttam), who was sentenced to death for the murder of the first President of Bangladesh, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, who had been in hiding for a long time, spoke on a live talk show by expatriate journalist and online activist Ilias Hossain. In the live talk show, Dalim talked about the politics of the time and the Liberation War. When journalist Ilias Hossain asked about the violation of the honor of 200,000 women during the Liberation War, he said, "I know only two women whose honor was violated." In response, Dalim made a comment titled, "Two women were raped in 1971, one is my mother, the other is my wife Nimmi. I have not seen anyone else." A photocard with the logo of the daily Amar Desh has been circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: 'Joy Bangla' slogan banned
Content_English:
The Indian Army will celebrate Bangladesh's great Victory Day on December 16 in Kolkata. Some of the Indian soldiers who fought against the Pakistani invaders in 1971 to liberate Bangladesh will be there. A delegation from Bangladesh will also be there. This delegation should include real freedom fighters. Fake freedom fighters should not get this opportunity. Who are the fake freedom fighters? In the greed of various benefits, different governments of the country have distributed freedom fighter certificates to their relatives at different times. 
Another thing, no one from the Yunus government should be invited. Because everyone in the government now is anti-liberation war, anti-independence, pro-Razakar, and pro-Pakistan. They are the ones who banned the slogan of victory in the liberation war, 'Jai Bangla', a few days ago. They are the ones who have taken an anti-India stance. They are the ones who have ruled that the demolition of all the sculptures of freedom fighters is a celebration of independence.

Headline_English: Hasnat Abdullah's death
Content_English: On November 27, a vehicle carrying Hasnat Abdullah and Sarjis Alam, one of the coordinators of the anti-discrimination student movement, met with a road accident in the Hajipara area of ​​Chunati Union in Lohagara Upazila while they were returning from Chittagong. In the wake of this, a thumbnail titled 'Hasnat Abdullah killed by truck, Sarjis seriously injured' and a video titled 'Hasnat Abdullah killed by truck, Sarjis Alam on life support' have been circulated.

Headline_English: Asif Mahtab appointed as advisor, replacing Farooqui
Content_English: Popular filmmaker Mostafa Sarwar Faruqi was sworn in as the interim government's cultural affairs advisor on November 10. His being part of the advisory council has been the subject of much discussion and criticism on social media for several days. Recently, a claim has been made on Facebook that Mostafa Sarwar Faruqi has been replaced by former BRAC University teacher Asif Mahtab as an advisor.

Headline_English: Army chief comments that Sheikh Hasina is legitimate Prime Minister
Content_English: Recently, a video was circulated on a channel called 'Dekho Khobor 24' on video sharing platform YouTube. The thumbnail of the video claims that Army Chief Waqar Uz Zaman still considers Sheikh Hasina as the legitimate Prime Minister.

Headline_English: The army arrested Hasnat Abdullah and Sarjis Alam
Content_English: Several videos titled "Coordinator Hasnat Abdullah and Sarjis Alam arrested by the army" have gone viral on the internet. The videos, which have been circulating since November 2, claim that Hasnat Abdullah, the convener of the anti-discrimination student movement, and Sarjis Alam, the general secretary of the July Shaheed Smriti Foundation, have been arrested on charges of inciting and being involved in the attack on the Jatiya Party office last Thursday.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus urges everyone to register for unemployment benefits
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of Channel 24 was circulated on social media platform Facebook, demanding that the interim government's chief advisor, Dr. Muhammad Yunus, call on everyone to register for unemployment benefits.

Headline_English: Dr. Muhammad Yunus's comments on women not working
Content_English: A photocard with the title "It is better for women not to work, let boys do it and marry unemployed girls" has been circulated on social media with the picture of Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government. In addition, many people have mentioned Dr. Muhammad Yunus in the caption, claiming that he made such comments.

Headline_English: Consuming drugs under the age of 18 is punishable by 3 months imprisonment and a fine of 3 lakh taka.
Content_English: A photocard with the design of electronic media Jamuna Television in the name of Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, has been circulating on social media with the headline "3 months imprisonment, 3 lakh taka fine for consuming drugs under the age of 18."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus commented on the topic of stopping all drug trade, including cigarettes.
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the photocard of the mainstream media outlet The Bangladesh Moments has been circulated on the internet, with the headline 'All drug trade including cigarettes will be stopped in the country - Dr. Yunus', adding a picture of the interim government's advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus.

Headline_English: Health advisor comments that doctors' fees will be determined according to their degrees
Content_English: Quoting Nurjahan Begum, the interim government's health and family welfare advisor, the demand that "initiatives will be taken to assign doctors free of charge according to their degrees" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: 30000 crore taka of smuggling is coming back today.
Content_English: Quoting Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, the claim that '300 billion taka of smuggled money is coming back today' has been circulated through the media, including social media.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus suggests reciting Surah Fatiha instead of the national anthem
Content_English: A photocard featuring the logo of private electronic media outlet Jamuna Television, depicting the interim government's chief advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus, has been circulated on the internet under the headline 'Chief Advisor Dr. Yunus requests to recite Surah Fatiha instead of the national anthem!'

Headline_English: Stipends and various allowances discontinued
Content_English: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigned and left the country on August 5 in the face of mass student protests demanding quota reforms in government jobs. Then, on August 8, Dr. Muhammad Yunus took oath as the chief advisor to the interim government. In view of this recent political change in Bangladesh, claims have been made on social media Facebook that all types of student stipends have been stopped and all other types of allowances including old age allowance, widow allowance, maternity allowance, and disability allowance have been temporarily stopped.

Headline_English: President Md. Shahabuddin resigns
Content_English: Former Prime Minister of Bangladesh Sheikh Hasina left the country after resigning on August 5. Later, an interim government was formed in the country after the President dissolved the parliament. Various high-ranking officials of the country are being transferred or dismissed. In this context, a video has recently been circulated on YouTube demanding that President Md. Shahabuddin apologize and resign on the orders of the Army Chief.

Headline_English: Dr. Muhammad Yunus gives 1 billion taka aid to Israel
Content_English: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina resigned on August 5 due to military intervention in the wake of the recent quota reform movement in Bangladesh. In the wake of this, Dr. Muhammad Yunus has been appointed as the chief advisor to the interim government. Before he took office, a claim was spread on the internet claiming that Dr. Muhammad Yunus had given 100 million taka in aid to Israel.

Headline_English: A mass grave has been laid at the Parliament building.
Content_English:
Sheikh Hasina resigned and left the country on Monday, August 5, in the face of mass student and public protests. After her resignation, numerous people entered the Prime Minister's residence, Ganabhaban. Similarly, people entered the National Parliament Building and the Prime Minister's Office. 
That evening, the claim that a mass grave had been dug in the Parliament Building and that people were not able to enter it due to the smell of corpses was spread on the Internet. Pictures of some bodies were also circulated in support of the same claim.

Headline_English: Anti-discrimination student movement gives government a seven-day ultimatum, withdraws protest
Content_English: A circular purportedly signed by 6 coordinators has been circulated on social media demanding that the anti-discrimination student movement withdraw its agitation by giving the government a seven-day ultimatum to investigate the deaths of those killed in the ongoing quota reform movement and bring those involved to justice. In addition, another information has been circulated on Facebook claiming that the general students have announced a new programme with 9 demands and given the government 3 months to implement them. It is claimed that if anyone other than the 6 coordinators claims to be the coordinator and gives any programme other than this new programme, it will be cheating the students.

Headline_English: Bangladesh Army removed from UN peacekeeping mission
Content_English: A continuous movement has been going on since July 1 demanding reform of discriminatory quotas in all grades of government jobs, which intensified after a statement by the Prime Minister on July 14. At one point, the government even brought the army onto the streets to quell the protesters. In light of this, a video of a news report about the army is being recently shared to spread the claim that the Bangladesh Army has been excluded from the UN peacekeeping mission.

Headline_English: Bodies of 100 students recovered from Hatirjheel in quota agitation incident
Content_English:
Students across the country have been protesting since July 1, demanding a permanent solution to the quota system by reforming the existing quota system in all grades of government jobs. Meanwhile, in response to questions from journalists at a press conference on July 14 regarding Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's recent visit to China, the Prime Minister also spoke about the ongoing quota reform movement. At that time, university students were outraged by a speech by the Prime Minister. In response to this, students took to the streets in protest programs. There were clashes and violence, and there were reports of many casualties. 
In response, a claim is being spread on social media Facebook, claiming that the mainstream media outlet Kalbela is a source, that more than a hundred bodies of protesters have been found in the Hatirjheel area of ​​Dhaka. 

A video is being circulated on social media Facebook, claiming that the bodies of these 100 students were recovered on July 22, using a video footage from Kalbela.

Headline_English: Musician Tahsan ranks first in the foreign cadre in the canceled 24th BCS
Content_English: Recently, three officials of the Bangladesh Public Service Commission (PSC) and 17 others, including former driver Syed Abed Ali, have been arrested on charges of leaking 30 recruitment exam questions in the last 12 years, including the Bangladesh Civil Service (BCS) exam. After that, discussions started on social media about which chairman of the PSC Abed Ali was the driver. In view of this, many people on social media claimed that he was the driver of former chairman Dr. Mohammad Sadiq. However, in an interview with the media, Sadiq rejected such claims and said that Abed was the driver of the PSC chairman not during his time, but when Dr. Zinatun Nesa Tahmida Begum and ATM Ahmedul Haque Chowdhury were PSC chairmen. In view of this, a message spread on social media Facebook that musician and actor Tahsan Rahman Khan became the first to become the foreign cadre candidate in the 24th BCS. At that time, his mother Dr. Zinatun Nesa Tahmida Begum was the PSC chairman. When the BCS viva was held again due to corruption, Tahsan was dropped from the viva. Later, news was published in some media outlets on the same claim.

Headline_English: Boycott prompts Coca-Cola to debut new white drink
Content_English:
In the wake of the ongoing conflict between Israel and Palestinian militant groups since October 7, 2023, civil society in Muslim countries has called for a boycott of Coca-Cola products, accusing them of supporting Israel. 

In this context, recently, a picture of a product called ‘CocaCola Clear’ with the caption “All colors are gone! Now she is emerging as a completely innocent widow! Will the people still accept it!?” has been circulating on social media. Through which it is being claimed that Coca-Cola has now rebranded itself in white to avoid the boycott.

Headline_English: General holiday declared for January 5-8 due to elections
Content_English: Sonia Hassan, Deputy Secretary of the Ministry of Public Administration, has demanded that a four-day government holiday be declared from January 5 to January 8, 2024, on the occasion of the 12th National Parliament elections, which were held on January 2.

Headline_English: UN orders postponement of 12th National Assembly elections
Content_English: A video titled "Chief Election Commissioner Suspends Elections on UN Orders" and "UN Suspends Elections for 6 Months, Fears Sheikh Hasina" has been circulated on YouTube.

Headline_English: Illegal money recovered from President's son's house
Content_English:
A video with the title and thumbnail titled "Mountain of illegal money found in the house of the President's son, President and his son Arshad Adnan" has gone viral on the internet. 
The video claims that illegal money has been found in the house of Ashraf Adnan, the son of Bangladeshi President Md. Shahabuddin.

Headline_English: Warning issued by DB Police regarding Coca-Cola and Pepsi
Content_English: For a long time, an information titled 'Warning Message' has been circulating on social media Facebook, citing DB Police. 'For the next few weeks, do not consume Coca cola or Pepsi or any drink-like products available in the market!! Because someone has mixed HIV blood in it. This was shown on India's 'ND' TV!! Please share it with all your friends and play the role of a responsible citizen. Please help your friends by sharing it before deleting it. Please reach 16 crore Bangladeshis. This may help someone.

Headline_English: Biden orders Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to resign
Content_English: A digital banner using the Prothom Alo logo is being circulated on social media Facebook with the claim, "US President Joe Biden has ordered Sheikh Hasina to resign within the next week. He also issued a stern warning to withdraw the Bangladesh Army from the UN peacekeeping mission. He said this in an interview with the international media Al-Jazeera."

Headline_English: Canadian court declares BNP a terrorist organization for the fifth time
Content_English: A claim titled 'Canadian court declares BNP a terrorist organization again' is being widely circulated on social media through media sources.

Headline_English: Director (former General Manager) of Bangladesh Bank, Bishnu Pad Biswas, Indian
Content_English: A claim titled "Bangladesh Bank General Manager Bishnu Pad Biswas is a citizen of India" is being circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: America will not recognize the election unless 51% of the vote is cast.
Content_English: A demand titled "America will not recognize the election if 51% of the vote does not get through" is being circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Prime Minister calls Azhari and requests him to return to the country
Content_English: A short video sharing platform TikTok has circulated an informational video claiming that Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has requested Islamic speaker Mizanur Rahman Azhari to come to Bangladesh through a phone call, adding a screenshot of the Facebook page of Bangladesh's mainstream media outlet Soyo TV.

Headline_English: The comment titled 'I sat on the chair with a bribe, I didn't come to provide services for free' was made by the CMP Commissioner.
Content_English: A demand titled 'I sat on the chair with a bribe, I didn't come to provide free services': CMP Commissioner' is being circulated on social media via media sources on Facebook.

Headline_English: Resignation and dismissal of Law Minister Anisul Huq
Content_English: A video has been circulated on YouTube with the headline "Law Minister Anisul Haque resigns on the Prime Minister's orders" and the thumbnail "Law Minister Anisul Haque expelled for talking about the caretaker government."

Headline_English: US sanctions 10 ministers, including Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: A video has been circulated on video sharing platform YouTube claiming that the United States has imposed sanctions on 10 ministers, including Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

Headline_English: The quality of education in Bangladesh is 123rd out of 138 countries.
Content_English: An information claim titled 'Bangladesh's education standard is 123rd out of 138 countries, which is the lowest in South Asia.' is being circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Bangladesh PM announces transfer of power under US pressure
Content_English: Recently, a video was circulated on YouTube using the thumbnail titled 'Hasina announces transfer of power under US pressure'.

Headline_English: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina elected world's third honest head of government
Content_English: For a long time, two different claims have been being made about the current Prime Minister of Bangladesh, Sheikh Hasina, in a survey by an international organization called 'People and Politics'. Sheikh Hasina is ranked third in the list of the world's five honest leaders. Congratulations, dear leader.

Headline_English: Legal notice to stop Mangal Shobhajatra on Pohela Baishakh
Content_English: An information titled 'Court issues legal notice to stop 'Mangal Shobhajatra' on Pohela Baishakh' is being circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Dubai visas for Bangladeshi citizens have been closed
Content_English: A claim titled 'Dubai visas have been closed for Bangladeshi citizens' has spread on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: 7 letters to be dropped from the Bengali alphabet in 2024
Content_English:
Recently, a demand titled ‘7 letters will be removed from the Bengali alphabet in 2024’ has spread on social media Facebook, citing a message sent to a mobile phone quoting the name of Bangla Academy President Selina Hossain. 
The message states exactly as follows- 

“Dear Sudhee! 

In the coming year 2024, ঈ ঊ রি will be removed from the Bengali vowels and ঝ ণ ত ত will be removed from the Bengali consonants. 

Selina Hossain 
President, Bangla Academy”

Headline_English: New law for journalists passed in Bangladesh
Content_English: New law passed for journalism! Article 39 of the Constitution allows media workers to collect and publish news with the greatest freedom! No interference of any kind is allowed! If anyone is aggrieved by the news published, they should complain to the Press Council! The Supreme Court has ruled under its direction that court journalists do not have the power to judge!' An information titled 'Media workers will be able to collect and publish news with the greatest freedom!' is being circulated on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Visa not required to travel from Bangladesh to Argentina
Content_English: An information titled "Bangladesh and Argentina sign visa exemption agreement, no visa required to go to Argentina" is being circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: US sanctions President Shahabuddin Chuppu | Prime Minister trapped
Content_English: An informative video titled "US sanctions on President Shahabuddin Chuppu | The Prime Minister is trapped" has been circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Land Act passed, effective from January 10th
Content_English:
The Land Act has been passed and has come into effect from January 10th. The issues that will be looked into are as follows:- 
01/ No one can have agricultural land above 60 bighas. 
02/ If there is 25 bighas of land in one name, then the rent will be levied. 
03/ The original document is the one whose land it belongs to. 
04/ The Land Crime Act, fake anonymous and burning documents will be banned and the claimant of that document will be jailed. 
05/ Forcible possession of land is a punishable offence. 
06/ The land will be given to the original owner. 
07/ Unregistered documents will be banned. 
08/ Documents that take additional land from someone will be banned and will be a punishable offence. 
09/ Fake burning documents in someone else's name will be banned. Or even if you have forcibly occupied land for 100 years, you will have to give up possession of that land. Which was the case with Hindus. 
10/ If you keep possession of Khas land by using fake documents, that document of that land will have to be discarded and possession will have to be abandoned. 
11/ If you make a document by misrepresenting your siblings, parents, or someone as crazy or disabled, or if you make fake documents and encroach on land in those names, the document will be discarded. 
12/ If you make a fake document by depriving the heir or do not give possession or deprive him, that document will be discarded. 
13/ The documents of the buyer and seller of land must be more accurate.

Headline_English: Prime Minister comments on Bangladesh becoming champion in 2026 World Cup
Content_English: A claim titled "Brazil's Hexa Mission 2026 remains incomplete because our Honorable Prime Minister said Bangladesh will be the champion in the 2026 World Cup" has spread on Facebook.

Headline_English: Enamul Haque Judge Mia was a member of parliament for 9 consecutive years.
Content_English: Several mainstream domestic media outlets reported on the claim that the recently deceased Enamul Haque Judge Mia served as a member of parliament for 9 years.

Headline_English: The destination is written in English and Hindi at the metro station, but not in Bengali.
Content_English: A picture titled 'The destination at the metro station is written in English and Hindi but not in Bengali' has gone viral on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia laid the first foundation stone of the Padma Bridge.
Content_English: During an interaction with journalists at the Thakurgaon Press Club on Sunday (June 5), BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir claimed that former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia laid the first foundation stone of the Padma Bridge.

Headline_English: Journalist Mayukh injured in police lathicharge in front of Bangladesh Deputy High Commission in Kolkata
Content_English: A Hindutva organization called 'Bangiya Hindu Jagran Mancha' protested in front of the Bangladesh Deputy High Commission in Kolkata on December 23 to protest the persecution of minorities in Bangladesh and the murder of Dipu Chandra Das. Police resorted to lathicharge to control the situation. Several protesters were injured. During this, some of the photos of Republic Bangla's news anchor and journalist Mayukh Ranjan Ghosh were circulated on social media, claiming that he was injured in the police lathicharge. In the circulated photos, Mayukh's shirt is seen stained with blood.

Headline_English: Pakistan ready for any help for fair trial in Osman Hadi's murder
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson and potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency in the upcoming parliamentary elections, Sharif Osman Hadi, was shot. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. In this context, a claim has recently been circulated on social media, with Pakistani Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif saying, "Pakistan is ready for any help for a fair trial in the murder of Osman Hadi. Shaheed Osman said, Hadi said that if he kills me, at least justice should be ensured."

Headline_English: Pilot of private jet that crashed in US was Bangladeshi
Content_English: A private jet crashed at Statesville Regional Airport in North Carolina, USA. Leaked FBI chatter claims that the pilot was a Sunni Bangladeshi radical Islamist, affiliated with Jamaat-e-Islami and Al-Qaeda in the Indian Subcontinent (AQIS). He praised Osama bin Laden before the plane crashed.

Headline_English: Shah Rukh Khan donates Rs 25 crore for the construction of Babri Masjid
Content_English: The historic Babri Masjid in Ayodhya, India, was demolished on December 6, 1992. A huge Ram temple was built on the same site last year. There is widespread discussion and criticism in the country's political arena regarding this. Meanwhile, the recently expelled Trinamool Congress MLA Humayun Kabir took the initiative to build a mosque in Murshidabad, West Bengal, in imitation of the Babri Masjid in Ayodhya. As part of this, the foundation stone of the mosque was laid on December 6. It is known that a large amount of financial assistance has started coming from the country and abroad for the construction of the mosque. Even Bangladeshis are known to want to send financial assistance from the personal level for the construction of the mosque. In the wake of this incident, a claim titled "Bollywood superstar Shah Rukh Khan alone donated 25 crore rupees for the Babri Masjid" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Ten Bangladeshis will be beheaded in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. They used to kidnap expatriates to extort money and were involved in various crimes.
Content_English: A picture of several people kneeling on the ground with their faces covered in black cloth has been circulated on social media, claiming, "10 Bangladeshis will be beheaded in Dammam, Saudi Arabia. They used to kidnap expatriates to extort money and were involved in various crimes."

Headline_English: Indian communist leader Sujan Chakraborty is Bangladeshi
Content_English: Various Indian social media accounts are circulating a picture of a card resembling a Bangladeshi national identity card, claiming that Communist Party of India (Marxist) leader Sujan Chakraborty is originally a citizen of Bangladesh and that this is a picture of his Bangladeshi National Identity Card (NID).

Headline_English: Alleged expulsion of Bangladeshis and Rohingyas in India
Content_English: According to the announcement of the Election Commission of India, the process of 'intensive revision' of the voter list began in 12 states and union territories of the country from October 28. Which is better known as SIR or Special Intensive Revision. As part of this, the intensive revision program of the voter list also started in West Bengal from November 4. It is known that if the necessary documents are not shown in this process, there is a risk of many people's names being removed from the voter list. The central leaders of the ruling BJP have been claiming that in some states like West Bengal, many alleged Bangladeshi infiltrators have removed their names from the voter list. Only after the 'intensive revision' will 'illegal Bangladeshis' and 'Rohingyas' be removed. In view of this, a video was recently circulated from some Indian Facebook accounts claiming that Bangladeshis and Rohingyas living there are being driven out. In the videos circulated in support of this claim, it is seen that a young man is forcibly forcing a few people to leave the place. The young man can also be heard speaking in Bengali in the video. From what it can be inferred, the video is claimed to be a video of the expulsion of alleged Bangladeshi settlers from West Bengal or Assam.

Headline_English: Iran abolishes compulsory hijab
Content_English:
‘Iran has abolished the legal obligation to wear the hijab. Now whether women wear the hijab or not will depend entirely on their own will, there is no longer any legal obligation…..In this news, the independent-minded women of Iran are taking to the streets to celebrate by collectively burning their hijabs.’ A video with the caption has been circulated on various platforms on the internet. 
In the circulated video, a woman dressed in white is seen dancing in front of a fire, throwing a piece of cloth into the fire and merging with the crowd. When she sees it, two women dressed in black come forward and throw the cloth into the fire. At this time, the surrounding crowd is seen clapping and celebrating.

Headline_English: Former Pakistani cricketer Imran Khan passes away
Content_English: Recently, a claim with a picture of former Pakistani cricketer and former Prime Minister Imran Khan, titled "Legendary former Pakistani cricketer has migrated to the country of no return," was circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Citizens of non-existent country called 'Torenaza' arrive at US airport
Content_English: Recently, a claim was made on social media, along with a few pictures of a woman, saying, "A strange incident happened at JFK Airport in America. An elderly woman got off a plane from Japan. The airport staff were surprised to see her passport. Her country's name is TORENAZA, there is no country with that name on the face of the earth. However, her passport has dozens of stamps for countries that do not exist on the face of the earth. What is even more surprising is that her passport has biometrics and all the stamps are original. When she was told everything, she said, I feel like I have come from another planet. She seemed like a normal traveler. So the airport staff took her to the observation room. She sat there for 30 minutes, when suddenly the CCTV cameras stopped working. She was never seen again."

Headline_English: Netanyahu's female adviser on Gaza dies
Content_English: A video has been circulating on social media claiming that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's female adviser on Gaza has died.

Headline_English: Pakistan airstrikes in Afghanistan
Content_English:
There are strong rumors that the head of the banned militant group Tehreek-e-Taliban Pakistan (TTP), Noor Wali Mehsud, has been killed in a Pakistani airstrike in the Afghan capital Kabul. His vehicle was reportedly targeted in the counter-terrorism operation conducted on Thursday (October 10) midnight. 
Pakistani media outlet Pakistan Observer reported that not only the TTP chief but also several other senior leaders, including one of his close aides and a potential top leader of the organization, Qari Saifullah Mehsud, are believed to have been killed in the attack. According to one source, Noor Wali was traveling in a car at the time of the attack and the car was directly damaged in the airstrike. Although his death has not been officially confirmed, various sources are reporting that he was seriously injured. 

Witnesses said that the attack targeted a car moving on a road in Kabul. The intensity of the explosion was massive and fighter jets could be seen flying over Kabul for a long time afterwards, causing panic among locals. 

Hours before the attack, Pakistan's Defense Minister Khawaja Asif had issued a stern warning against the TTP, saying, "Enough has happened, we will not tolerate it anymore." 
Islamabad's aggressive move comes after several members of the security forces in Pakistan were killed in various TTP attacks recently. At least 12 Pakistani security personnel were killed in TTP attacks last week. Earlier, dozens of TTP members were killed in army operations in Khyber Pakhtunkhwa province.

Headline_English: Netanyahu beaten and harassed on his way to attend UN session
Content_English: Netanyahu was beaten and abused by Israelis while attending the United Nations. No media outlet in the world reported this news. An Israeli citizen uploaded this video. A video has gone viral on the internet claiming that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu was beaten and abused by the people of his own country while on his way to attend the United Nations General Assembly session.

Headline_English: Donald Trump holds Sheikh Hasina's picture
Content_English: A video has been circulating on social media demanding a photo of former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who was ousted by US President Donald Trump.

Headline_English: Ravi Lakshmi Chitrakar, wife of former Nepali Prime Minister, passes away
Content_English: Nepal has recently witnessed intense protests against social media bans and corruption. At one point, Nepal's former Prime Minister KP Sharma Oli resigned amid chaos, violence and widespread protests by young people. Protesters also set fire to the residences of various important figures in the government. In the wake of this, the media reported, "Rajalakshmi Chitrakar, wife of former Nepali Prime Minister Jhalanath Khanal, died in protests led by the recent Gen Z. Jhalanath Khanal's residence. Angry protesters set fire to it, trapping his wife inside. She later died of burns."

Headline_English: Modi did not comment on Bangladesh-Nepal's hand in the mass movement in India
Content_English: A photo card featuring a design by mainstream media outlet Kalbela, quoting Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and including his photo, has been circulated on social media under the title 'Bangladesh and Nepal have a hand in the mass movement in India'.

Headline_English: UN video message warns of ban on Bangladesh Army's participation in peacekeeping missions
Content_English: A video message sent by the UN Security Council has been circulated on social media recently, claiming that the Bangladesh Army will be banned from participating in peacekeeping missions if political stability in Bangladesh and the return of former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to power are not successfully implemented within the next 15 days. The post further claims that the UN has taken such a decision due to allegations of the forcible ouster of Sheikh Hasina, the widespread presence of militants in Bangladesh and the partisanship of the army.

Headline_English: Possible BRICS notes from Putin's X account revealed
Content_English: ‘Russian President Vladimir Putin has released a picture of the possible currency of B’RICS. Putin published the picture on his X account.…Innumerable countries from the three continents of Asia-Africa-South America will start coming into BRICS and the world will trade in these three currencies of the dollar-euro-BRICS. The coin also has a picture of the flag of Bangladesh, which is the sole contribution of Sheikh Hasina.’ Multiple pictures have been circulated on various platforms on the internet claiming to be pictures of the possible currency of the international organization BRICS in the caption.

Headline_English: Indian jailed in Bangladesh for demanding footage of Bangladeshi illegal immigrants being deported from India
Content_English: A video of several people being tied up in a police car was shared on social media with the caption, "Bengali Muslims are being sent back from all over the world! Visas are almost stopped! A nation is sinking into darkness.. Details in the comments." In the comments section, pictures of a Bangladeshi student's visa being cancelled in the US and news of a ban on admission of Bangladeshi students to London Metropolitan University have been shared. In other words, it has been claimed that the shared video shows scenes of Bangladeshi Muslim citizens being sent back to the country.

Headline_English: Alleged animal trainer Jessica Radcliffe killed in dolphin attack
Content_English:
Marine animal trainer Jessica dies! 
Jessica was an experienced marine animal trainer. Since childhood, her dream was to work with sea animals and give them love. She started raising a baby orca, named Cairo. Cairo would come out of the water when she heard his call and fascinated everyone at the show. But one day in 2025, before the show, Cairo's behavior suddenly changed. He started wandering around, breaking his own rules and suddenly attacked Jessica. Jessica was injured by the guru, and the trainers could not save him. This incident shows that no matter how trained wild animals are, their true nature does not completely change.

Headline_English: Trump's post expresses anger at Narendra Modi
Content_English: On July 30, US President Donald Trump announced a 25 percent tariff on Indian goods. In light of this, recently, Donald Trump posted a post on social media expressing his anger over the lack of response from Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi to Trump's tariff-related remarks. A report was published in the domestic media claiming that Trump wrote in the post, "I can't believe that Prime Minister Modi has not yet responded to my tweets, statements or tariff-related remarks. We have given India many big deals, defense assistance, and yet he is completely silent. Not even a thank you. Don't forget, I am the one who forced India and Pakistan to declare a ceasefire. No one else could have done it. Many said I should have won the Nobel Prize for this. Even though American workers are suffering, India is benefiting from the beginning. I have always liked Modi. But this kind of disrespect is not to be forgotten. Bad for business. Bad for friendship."

Headline_English: Fire breaks out in Tel Aviv, Israel after Iranian missile attack
Content_English:
In the wake of the recent Iran-Israel conflict in the Middle East, a video titled ‘Fires erupt in Tel Aviv after breaking Iranian missile, 24 dead and counting. #Alhamdulillah’ has been circulating on various internet platforms. 

The video shows a huge plume of smoke rising from a building fire.

Headline_English: Trump's statement on Pakistan in the Iran-Israel conflict
Content_English:
In the recent Israel-Iran conflict, an old statement by Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has come to the fore, in which he is seen saying, “The biggest mission is to prevent a radical Islamist regime from getting nuclear weapons, or a radical Islamist regime from getting nuclear weapons. The first is Iran, the second is Pakistan. Because if these extremist regimes get nuclear weapons, they will not abide by the rules that have been followed for the last seven decades.” 
Following this, a statement was circulated on social media demanding a statement from US President Donald Trump. In the statement, which was broadcast in response to Trump's statement, Trump's voice can be heard saying, "Pakistan has warned Israel and the United States because Israel wrongly said that Pakistan is second only to Iran. Pakistan is now on full alert with its air, land and naval forces. Pakistan's Defense Minister Khawaja Asif said that if Israel attacks Iran again, Pakistan will completely destroy Israel. But what I am saying is — Pakistan should not do this. Pakistan has no problem with the United States. The military is already on high alert. In my opinion, Pakistan should not get involved in this war. This is a war between Israel and Iran. We need peace in the region, we need to stop fighting — not get involved in the middle. That is the truth, that is the wise thing to do."

Headline_English: Protests against Trump in the US after attack on Iran
Content_English: In the wake of the June 22 US B-2 stealth bomber attack on three Iranian nuclear facilities, a video was circulated on social media claiming to be footage of protests in the United States against the Trump administration following the attack on Iran.

Headline_English: Israeli Prime Minister Netanyahu killed in Iranian drone strike
Content_English: In the context of the ongoing conflict between Iran and Israel in the Middle East, a message titled "Netanyahu was not killed by an Iranian drone" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Netanyahu meets Putin after fleeing country over Iran fears
Content_English: On June 13, Israel attacked Iran's nuclear facilities and arsenal. In retaliation, Iran launched missile attacks on Tel Aviv and Jerusalem in Israel on the same night. In the wake of this, a claim has been made on Facebook claiming that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has fled the country and sought help from Russian President Putin due to fear of another Iranian attack. The posts also used a photo claiming to be a photo of the meeting between the two heads of state. In which Netanyahu is seen shaking hands with a woman wearing a hijab

Headline_English: Libyan Hajj pilgrim Amer al-Gaddafi dies
Content_English: Recently, a Libyan Hajj pilgrim named Amer Al Gaddafi faced immigration delays due to security concerns related to his surname ‘Al Gaddafi’. Dramatically, the same flight turned back twice and when it departed on the third time, Amer Al Gaddafi was able to board the plane and the flight arrived in Saudi Arabia without any problems. A claim has been circulating on social media that Amer Al Gaddafi died while performing Tawaf after arriving in Mecca.

Headline_English: Pakistan Army Chief Asim Munir arrested
Content_English: A claim has been spread across social media, including social media, that Pakistan Army Chief Asif Munir has been arrested amid the conflict between India and Pakistan.

Headline_English: 17,000 Bangladeshi expatriates arrested in Saudi Arabia
Content_English: The claim has been spread on social media, "17,000 Bangladeshi expatriates arrested in Saudi Arabia due to the contribution of the Yunus Gang terrorist Mamulul Haq Bahini..." In addition, without directly calling all of the 17,000 detained expatriates Bangladeshis, the incident has been promoted with phrases such as "Wow Yunus is wonderful," "Expatriates are enjoying 24 hours of freedom," which portrays the detainees as Bangladeshis.

Headline_English: Lt Gen MV Suchindra Kumar not dismissed for terror attack in Kashmir
Content_English:
Tensions between India and Pakistan are at an all-time high following a deadly attack by militants in Indian-administered Kashmir on April 22. A claim has been circulating on social media that India's Northern Army Commander Lieutenant General MV Suchindra Kumar has been dismissed and arrested. 
The claim is 
“This is India's Northern Army Commander Lieutenant General MV Suchindra Kumar. 
He has been dismissed, investigated and arrested, simply because: 
1. He refused to accept India's official narrative of the Pahelgam incident involving Pakistan. 
2. He declared the Pahelgam incident an internal matter of India. 
3. He said he would not plan any retaliatory measures against Pakistan until the allegations are proven true. 
This is the ugly face of India, where Modi's policies are pushing crores of people to the brink of destruction.”

Headline_English: Five-year ceasefire in Gaza comes into effect
Content_English: On Saturday, April 26, the AFP news agency reported that the Palestinian militant group Hamas has agreed to a five-year ceasefire in Gaza in exchange for the release of all hostages in a one-time deal. In light of this, a video titled 'Breaking: Five-year ceasefire in Gaza' has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: 85 people killed in India-Pakistan clashes over BSF member's arrest or on Kashmir border
Content_English:
Tensions between India and Pakistan are at an all-time high following a deadly attack by militants in Indian-administered Kashmir on April 22. Indian media outlets have reported that Pakistan has detained a BSF personnel for mistakenly entering Pakistani territory through the Ferozepur sector. 
In the wake of this, a claim has been made on social media claiming that 85 people have been killed in clashes surrounding the arrest of the BSF personnel.

Headline_English: 60,000 Bangladeshi expatriates detained in Saudi Arabia for mocking Saudi Crown Prince Salman
Content_English:
The 'March for Gaza' program was held in Dhaka on April 12 to protest the Israeli massacre in Gaza, Palestine. It is claimed that Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman was mocked in the program for supporting the Israeli massacre in Gaza. In addition, there are reports of mocking the Saudi Crown Prince at various times in different parts of the country. In the wake of the claim of mocking the Saudi Crown Prince, a claim has recently been spread on social media that 60,000 Bangladeshis have been detained in Saudi Arabia without checking whether they have an Aqama or not for insulting Saudi Crown Prince Salman. 

It is worth noting that an Aqama is required to work in Saudi Arabia. Aqama is a work permit.

Headline_English: 8,000 Bangladeshi expatriates deported from Saudi Arabia for mocking Saudi Crown Prince Salman
Content_English:
Israel is committing genocide in Palestine by breaking the ceasefire, which has led to an extreme humanitarian crisis in Palestine. Protests against such Israeli aggression in Palestine are coming from various countries of the world. Protests against such Israeli aggression are also being regularly expressed in Bangladesh. Meanwhile, the picture of Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman has been ridiculed in Bangladesh in various ways, claiming that the Saudi Arabian government is playing a silent role in such Israeli aggression. In view of this, a claim has recently been spread on social media, "Saudi Arabia sent back 8 thousand expatriates. This time, more shoes are thrown at the picture of the Saudi king!" 
That is, it has been claimed that 8 thousand Bangladeshi expatriates living in Saudi Arabia have been sent back because of such sarcasm against important figures in the Saudi government. In addition, a claim titled "Saudi Arabia sent back 8 thousand expatriates due to Yunus' diplomatic failure" has also been spread in this regard, involving the interim government.

Headline_English: The news that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu has been killed is false.
Content_English: A message titled "Alhamdulillah, Netanyahu has just been killed" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Donald Trump's visit to India and meeting with Sheikh Hasina on March 13
Content_English: A video claiming that US President Donald Trump has set the date of his visit to India on March 13 has been circulating on social media since March 10. The post also claims that during the visit, after meeting Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, he will also hold an unofficial meeting with former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who is in India.

Headline_English: UN warns millions could die of AIDS if Trump cuts aid to Bangladesh
Content_English: Indian social media claims that the United Nations has commented that millions of people could die from AIDS if Trump stops aid to Bangladesh.

Headline_English: Donald Trump announces date for Bangladesh parliamentary elections on May 26
Content_English: A video has gone viral on the short video sharing platform TikTok, claiming that US President Donald Trump has announced elections in Bangladesh on May 26.

Headline_English: Donald Trump announces cancellation of UN High Commissioner for Human Rights report
Content_English: An investigative report published by the Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) highlights human rights violations during the protests in Bangladesh in July-August 2024. In this context, a video is being shared on social media claiming that US President Donald Trump has declared the report null and void.

Headline_English: Elon Musk accuses Tulip Siddique of being behind the Ainaghar and BDR rebellions
Content_English:
A video has been circulated on social media claiming, “From the BDR rebellion to the mirror house, Elon Musk’s analysis of how Tulip Siddiqui has swung the baton under the umbrella of Sheikh Hasina and Tareq Siddiqui.” 
The video shows Elon Musk analyzing how Tulip Siddiqui has swung the baton under the umbrella of Sheikh Hasina and Tareq Siddiqui.

Headline_English: Tulsi Gabbard on claims of Hindu persecution in Bangladesh and Biden-Yunus' involvement in it
Content_English: A video has recently been circulated on various platforms on the internet claiming that Tulsi Gabbard, the nominee of the Senate Intelligence Committee for the position of Director of National Intelligence of the United States, is concerned about the persecution of Hindus in Bangladesh. The Biden administration is responsible for this, Yunus is directly linked to Biden...' involving Tulsi Gabbard, the nominee of the Senate Intelligence Committee for the position of Director of National Intelligence of the United States, who has been voted in by the Senate Intelligence Committee for the post of Director of National Intelligence of the United States.

Headline_English: Dr. Aafia Siddiqui released from US prison
Content_English: Pakistani neuroscientist Dr. Aafia Siddiqui has been incarcerated in a US prison for over a decade. Recently, claims have been circulating on social media that Dr. Aafia Siddiqui has been released.

Headline_English: Chinese media outlet Xinhua declares Yunus government illegitimate
Content_English: Since the Sheikh Hasina-led Awami League government lost power in the mass uprising of students and the public on August 5, claims have been spread on social media at various times, "China's main media outlet Xinhua has declared the Yunus government illegitimate." In this case, some posts have cited a website called Swadhin Bangladesh as a source of information.

Headline_English: Tulip removed from British anti-corruption post
Content_English: Tulip Siddique, a minister for the UK's ruling Labour Party and niece of former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, has been removed from her British anti-corruption post.

Headline_English: Prayers banned by High Court in India
Content_English: A video circulating on the short video sharing platform TikTok claims that the High Court of India has issued a notice and completely banned prayers in India.

Headline_English: Over 800 Israeli soldiers killed in Lebanon
Content_English: Lebanon has been embroiled in a series of conflicts with Israel for decades, which have recently heightened tensions between the two countries. It has gained new momentum since the war in Gaza began in October last year. Numerous people have been killed in various attacks, including rocket attacks and explosions. In this context, claims have recently been widely circulated in the media and social media that more than 800 Israeli soldiers have been killed in Lebanon.

Headline_English: Swiss court declares Sheikh Hasina legitimate
Content_English: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina left the country after being ousted from power in the face of student and public protests on August 5. Recently, a video of two people sitting side by side signing a document was circulated on the short video sharing platform TikTok, claiming that a Swiss court had declared former Bangladeshi Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina legitimate.

Headline_English: 12 Indian soldiers killed in Israel-Palestine war
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been circulating on social media that 12 Indian soldiers have been killed while fighting against Gaza.

Headline_English: Israeli army chief killed in Hezbollah drone strike
Content_English: The Iranian-backed Lebanese group Hezbollah has launched a drone attack targeting an Israeli military base. In the wake of this, '67 people, including the head of the Israeli army, were killed in a Hezbollah drone attack'

Headline_English: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Dr. Mahathir bin Mohamad has died.
Content_English: Former Malaysian Prime Minister Dr. Mahathir bin Mohamad has died, according to a claim circulated on social media platform X or former Twitter.

Headline_English: Mamata Banerjee's comments on the topic of unrest in India since Sheikh Hasina's entry
Content_English: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina fled the country and took refuge in India on August 5 in the face of a mass uprising by students and the public. On August 9, almost the entire state of West Bengal, India, took to the streets over the allegations of harassment, rape and murder of a female trainee doctor at the RG Kar Medical College and Hospital in Kolkata. In this context, the claim titled 'Unrest has started in India since Sheikh Hasina entered' has been circulated on social media, quoting West Bengal Chief Minister Mamata Banerjee.

Headline_English: China is sending 370,000 troops and 130,000 weapons to Bangladesh
Content_English: Recently, a claim is being spread on the short video sharing platform TikTok, "China is sending 370,000 troops and 130,000 weapons to Bangladesh and will attack India within 24 hours, says the Bangladesh Army Chief."

Headline_English: New Delhi calls emergency meeting on Bangladesh and Seven Sisters issue
Content_English:
In an online interview with Indian media outlet NDTV on August 6, Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government of Bangladesh and Nobel Peace Prize-winning economist, said, “If someone wants to destabilize Bangladesh, its effects will spread all around. There will be instability in neighboring Myanmar, the Seven Sisters of India, and West Bengal.” This comment sparked a huge discussion on social media in Bangladesh about the Seven Sisters of India. 

At the same time, graffiti is being painted on walls across the country after the mass uprising by students. However, some of the graffiti have drawn the map of Bangladesh incorrectly, which has caused widespread discussion and criticism on social media. 
In this situation, Indian mainstream media NDTV has shared a news on its Twitter account titled “New Delhi calls for emergency meeting as BD plans on invading Seven Sister” claiming that two screenshots have been circulating on social media. One of the screenshots shows an image of a wrongly drawn map and the other a screenshot of a post by a person named ‘Shadman Shafin’, which had the caption, “Can’t catch dacoits. Let me know if we have to capture Seven Sisters.”

Headline_English: Google Maps has removed Palestine from their maps
Content_English: A war has been going on between Israel and the Palestinian group Hamas since October last year. The Israeli military is carrying out an offensive in Gaza in the war. In the wake of this, a video of Google Maps searching for ‘Palestine’ has been circulating on the Internet, claiming that Google Maps has removed Palestine from its maps.

Headline_English: Pepsi's full form is Pay Every Penny to Save Israel.
Content_English: For a long time, a claim titled "Pepsi means 'Pay every penny to save Israel'" has been circulating on the internet. Recently, the claim is being circulated again on the social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: In Denmark, marriage is mandatory for people over the age of 24.
Content_English: Recently, a demand is being spread on the social media platform Facebook that marriage should be compulsory for those over the age of 24. Headline_English: Swiss bank releases customer information
Content_English:
Swiss banks are recognized worldwide as the most secure banking institutions. It is the most trusted bank in the world for keeping customers' identities and information confidential. Swiss banks are not a single bank. All banks in Switzerland are known as Swiss banks. In 1713, the Swiss government enacted a law prohibiting banks from disclosing customers' personal information. From there, the issue of protecting the confidentiality of this bank arose. 

In 1934, Switzerland issued a federal law on banks and savings banks, known as the Banking Law of 1934 or the Swiss Banking Act. The most widely studied Article 47 of the law declares it a crime to disclose customer information to anyone. This information cannot be disclosed to the government without the permission of the customers, even without a criminal charge. This Article 47 is one of the strictest banking secrecy laws in the world. A photocard has been posted on the social media Facebook about Swiss banks, claiming that Swiss banks disclose customer information.

Headline_English: Pakistan labels Salman a 'terrorist'!
Content_English:
Salman Khan had referred to Balochistan as a different country. Whether it was a deliberate mistake or he said it unknowingly, the question arises. However, this time Bhaijaan is being targeted by the Pakistani government for that outrageous comment. 
Recently, Salman went to an event in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. There, he was talking about the development of Indian cinema. At that time, Bhaijaan referred to Balochistan as a different country. This time, the Pakistani government labeled Salman a 'terrorist' for this comment. They even banned the Bollywood star. 
Baloch leaders were happy after Salman's comment. They even thanked Salman. After that, Pakistan's counter-terrorism wing labeled Salman a 'terrorist'. 
'What is his sex appeal?' Priyanka made it clear! Why did Shah Rukh call the heroine a rat? 
What exactly did Salman say? Salman said, "If you make a Hindi film and release it in Saudi Arabia, it will be successful. Even if a Tamil, Telugu, Malayalam film is released here, it will do business of one hundred crore rupees. Because, people from different countries come here. For example, people from Balochistan, people from Afghanistan, people from Pakistan. People from all countries work here." 
There is a long debate about whether Salman made this comment in jest or knowingly. However, Salman has not yet responded to this. Baloch leader Mir Yar Baloch thanked him for this comment. The Baloch leader claims that Salman has recognized their independence. 
It is worth noting that the Pakistan-Balochistan debate has been going on for many days. Balochistan wants recognition as an independent state. But the Pakistani government claims that Balochistan is one of the most important parts of their country. Therefore, Salman's comment has served as a catalyst in this debate.

Headline_English: Cricketer Mahmudul Hasan converts from Islam to Hinduism

Headline_English: Rashid Khan's speech apologizing to Bangladesh and Australia
Content_English:
The match between Bangladesh and Afghanistan in the Super Eight stage of the ongoing T20 World Cup held on June 25 was a three-way equation. The Afghans scored 115 runs after batting first. Bangladesh had to match this run in 12 overs to go through to the semi-finals. In addition, even if they had beaten Afghanistan in 20 overs, Australia would have gone through to the semi-finals. However, Afghanistan finally won by 8 runs, confirming their semi-finals. 

The first semi-final between South Africa and Afghanistan was held on May 27. After winning the toss and batting, the Afghans were all out for just 56 runs in 11.5 overs. This is Afghanistan's lowest total in T20s. 

In the meantime, a statement has been spread on social media claiming that Afghan captain Rashid Khan made a comment titled "We ruined the beauty of the World Cup semi-final; Sorry Bangladesh, Sorry Australia."

Headline_English: David Warner makes comments on Bangladesh cricket team selling matches to Afghanistan
Content_English: On June 25, in the Super Eight round of the ICC Men's T20 World Cup, in the Bangladesh vs Afghanistan match at St. Vincent's, the Afghans batted first and scored 115 runs. Bangladesh were set a target of 114 runs in 19 overs due to several spells of rain. They were bundled out for 105 runs with 7 balls remaining. Afghanistan won by 8 runs using the Duckworth Lewis Stern method. In this match, Bangladesh had a chance to play in the semi-finals if they won before 12 overs, 4 or 5 balls, and Australia had a chance to play in the semi-finals if they won after that. Bangladesh lost by 8 runs, shattering Australia's dream of playing in the semi-finals. In light of this, a video footage of Australian cricket team batter David Warner is being claimed on the short video sharing platform TikTok, "Bangladesh sold the match to Afghanistan, David Warner came live and exploded!"

Headline_English: Afghan captain Rashid Khan's comments on the Indian cricket team
Content_English:

Afghanistan came out to bat against India with a target of 182 runs. From the beginning, the Afghan batsmen were defeated by India's excellent bowling attack. In the end, India snatched a huge victory by 47 runs. 

After the match, Afghanistan captain Rashid Khan said, "Virat Kohli, Rohit Sharma are the form of God for us. We and our team have reached this far without Bumrah and without any big players, it is the blessings of all Indians behind it! Please bless our team and the Indian team so that we can play the final and even if we lose there, we will not be sad, because we are also part of India," a claim that is widely seen in India and Bangladesh.

Headline_English: Mark Zuckerberg comments on Bangladeshi Facebook users amid World Cup

A piece of information titled "Breaking News…….!!! Some surprising comments from Mark Zuckerberg about Bangladesh last night!" has spread on the social media platform Facebook. The caption attached to Mark Zuckerberg's photo reads, "Breaking News…….!!! 

–Some amazing comments by Mark Zuckerberg about Bangladesh on the night of the 9th! At 3:45 at night, one of my employees called me and said, Sir, is there a problem with our Facebook? I quickly sat up and said, "Why? What happened?" The employee said, "Sir, at around 11:15 at night, about 25 million posts were uploaded from Bangladesh at once! Then a little later, at around 11:40, all the posts were deleted at once! I checked everything and saw that we had no technical problem, so why did this happen? The employee said, "It doesn't end here, sir." At around 3:40 at night, 37 million posts were uploaded from Bangladesh at once, which is a record number of posts at once in our Facebook journey! Then I found out that there were 2 matches today between Brazil and Argentina, this was a reaction to that!! (To the crazy football fans of Bangladesh)"

Headline_English: Jules Rimet Trophy cannot be considered a FIFA World Cup
Content_English:
"The Jules Rimet Trophy cannot be considered as the FIFA World Cup, and the number of Jules Rimet Trophy wins cannot be counted with the number of World Cup wins." A claim titled "The Jules Rimet Trophy cannot be considered as the number of World Cup wins" is being circulated on social media Facebook. What is being claimed? 
Debabrata Mukherjee, a former senior sports journalist of the national daily 'Ittefaq', made a post (archived) on his verified Facebook account on December 19. 

In the post, he wrote, "I have never posted about Brazil throughout the World Cup. 

“Even though there are some seriously toxic Brazil supporters on my list, I didn’t put them on. Because, I don’t care about all the nonsense. I don’t argue with those who add 3 Jule Rimet trophies to the FIFA World Cup and make it 5. If Jule Rimet trophy is the World Cup, Bangladesh Football League can also be the Champions League. FIFA calculates the World Cup. Argentina 3: Brazil 2 Note: Whatever they say, keep quiet. Just say it in your ear – penalty. They have become penalty-phobic after losing on penalties and seeing Argentina get so many penalties and win. Their name is penalty.” 

In other words, Jule Rimet trophy cannot be considered as FIFA World Cup, he claims that the number of Jule Rimet trophy wins cannot be counted with the number of World Cup wins.

Headline_English: Notification issued appointing 267 people who were excluded from the 43rd BCS
Content_English: The Bangladesh Public Service Commission temporarily nominated 2163 candidates for appointment to various cadres through the 43rd BCS examination and sent recommendations on 25 January 2024. Thereafter, the Ministry of Public Administration published the gazette on 15 October 2024 appointing 2064 people. However, later the Ministry of Public Administration cancelled the notification dated 15 October 2024 and issued a recruitment notification in favor of 1896 candidates on 30 December 2024. In this case, out of the 2163 candidates temporarily nominated on 25 January, a total of 267 people were excluded, including 40 who were absent from the health examination at various stages and 227 who were temporarily unsuitable based on the intelligence agency report. Meanwhile, a notification published by the Ministry of Public Administration on 09 January stated that 267 officers have been appointed as Assistant Commissioners in the BCS (Administration) cadre. Then, in the wake of this, news was spread in the media claiming that a notification had been issued appointing the 267 people who were excluded from the 43rd BCS.
