Headline_English: Abdul Quader calls Tarique Rahman a child freedom fighter
Content_English: A photocard titled 'Tareq Rahman is a child freedom fighter of this country. He played a direct role in the freedom fighters in 1971.' Quoting Abdul Quader, the former coordinator of the anti-discrimination student movement, and including his picture, has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Amir Khasru comments on not getting family cards if he doesn't attend Tarique Rahman's return-to-country rally
Content_English: After almost a decade and a half, BNP acting chairman Tarique Rahman returned home on December 25. On that day, BNP organized a public reception in Purbachal in the capital. Meanwhile, earlier, BNP had planned to provide family cards to the female heads of 50 lakh economically backward families in the name of the government in order to get cooperation from the government when it comes to power. In view of this, a photo card with the design of the mainstream media Banglavision has been circulated on social media since noon on December 25, claiming that BNP standing committee member Amir Khasru Mahmud Chowdhury said, 'Those who do not come to the rally in Dhaka on the occasion of Tarique Rahman's return to the country on the 25th will not get the family card.'

Headline_English: Osman Hadi's killer's transaction of Tk 127 crore in Mirza Abbas's Dhaka Bank
Content_English:
On December 12, Inqilab Mancha spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. The police have identified one person as the main suspect in the shooting of Hadi. The person's name is Faisal Karim Masud alias Daud Khan. In this context, a claim has recently been circulated online, 'Mirza Abbas's Dhaka Bank has a transaction of 127 crore taka of Osman Hadi's murderer!' 
It is worth noting that Mirza Abbas, a member of the BNP's standing committee and a candidate for the post of MP from Dhaka 8, is the founder and former advisor of Dhaka Bank.

Headline_English: Sarjis Alam shot dead
Content_English: The claim, ‘Inna Lillah, Sarjis Alam was just shot today’, has been circulating on social media since at least the afternoon of December 23. A link to the detailed claim was attached to the post’s comments section, which claimed, ‘Sarjis Alam shot in the capital, seriously injured. Sarjis Alam was shot in a shooting incident in a busy area of ​​the capital today. Eyewitnesses said that miscreants on a motorcycle suddenly opened fire on him and quickly left the scene. Sarjis Alam, who was shot, was immediately taken to a nearby private hospital. Doctors said that he was shot in a vital part of his body and is currently undergoing treatment in the Intensive Care Unit (ICU). His condition is said to be critical.’

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul comments on Hadi's wife's lack of public presence after he was shot
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. In the wake of this, claims have been spread on social media. BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir said, "Hadi's family can best say who killed Hadi. Why his wife did not come forward after Hadi was shot is a big reason for suspicion."

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer comments on Victory Day being cancelled if Jamaat comes to power
Content_English: A photo card featuring a design by media outlet Nagorik TV, titled "There was no war in 1971 | Victory Day on December 16 will be canceled if Jamaat-e-Islami comes to power," has been circulated on social media, with a picture of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Shafiqur Rahman attached.

Headline_English: Nahid Islam: India is involved in Hadi's murder
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot. He then died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. When the news of Osman Hadi's death spread, buildings were vandalized and set on fire in different parts of the country overnight. On that day, there were also reports of bricks and stones being thrown at the Indian Assistant High Commission office in Chittagong. In this context, recently, Jatiya Nagorik Party (NCP) convener Nahid Islam made a comment titled, "We do not have accurate information about who killed our July comrade-in-arms Osman Hadi Bhai. We should not create any trouble by going to the Indian embassy. Let it be proven first that India is involved in this murder. Then we will be able to put pressure on them diplomatically." A photocard with the design of electronic media Jamuna Television has been circulated on social media demanding this.

Headline_English: Noor made a comment titled "They took money from me and ate Hadi after the attack on me."
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. In this context, a photo card with Banglavision's design has been circulated on the internet, claiming that the comment, "After the attack on me, Hadi took money in my name," was made by Gana Odhikar Parishad President Nurul Haque Noor.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman has been given the title of 'World Leader' by the UN Secretary-General
Content_English: A photo card designed by mainstream media Jamuna Television titled 'UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has been circulated on social media Facebook, titled 'World Leader' for Tarique Rahman's steadfastness in the face of imprisonment, oppression and torture under the authoritarian regime.'

Headline_English: Mirza Abbas says, 'If we come to power, we will produce a leader more worthy than Osman Hadi'
Content_English: On December 12, Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson for Inqilab Manch, was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He was later reported to have died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. In the meantime, a photo card titled "We will create a more capable leader than Osman Hadi if we come to power" has been circulated on social media, quoting BNP standing committee member and BNP-nominated candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency Mirza Abbas and adding his photo.

Headline_English: 2 killed in Osman Hadi's funeral
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He was taken to Singapore for advanced treatment. His death was reported on December 18 while undergoing treatment. The next day, on December 19, his body reached the country from Singapore. Then, his funeral was held yesterday (December 20) at the South Plaza of the Jatiya Sangsad Bhaban. People from different parts of the country started gathering at Manik Mia Avenue in the capital since morning to attend the funeral. Lakhs of people attended the funeral.

Headline_English: Army officer calls Jamaat a hypocrite party
Content_English:
A video has been circulated on social media claiming that a man in Bangladesh Army uniform is giving a speech to journalists, calling Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami a hypocritical party. 
In the video, a man dressed as an army member can be heard saying, “Dear countrymen, today we are going through a critical time in Bangladesh, this is your last chance to build the country. Jamaat is a hypocritical party, they can do many things for power. They easily fool Bengalis. Once with Awami League, once with BNP, now they want to do (unclear) with real Islamic parties. When they saw that the people of Bangladesh are lovers of Islam, they are claiming themselves to be an Islamic party. How many of their candidates have beards on their faces? Although it is also obligatory to have a beard. Because of them, the rest of the Islamic parties will be tarnished. I think Bangladesh is safe in the hands of BNP, because there are no hypocrites among them. So in the future, everyone should vote for BNP in the name of rice, then the country will improve.”

Headline_English: Home Affairs Advisor blames Jamaat-Shibir for vandalism after Osman Hadi's death
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. When the news of Osman Hadi's death spread, buildings were vandalized and set on fire in different parts of the country overnight. In this context, a photo card with the picture of Home Affairs Advisor Lieutenant General (Retd.) Md. Jahangir Alam Chowdhury was recently circulated on social media. It is claimed that the Home Affairs Advisor said - 'Jamaat Shibir is responsible for the vandalism that has occurred across the country after Osman Hadi's death.'

Headline_English: Asif Nazrul comments that Shishir Monir was involved in the bail of Faisal, a suspect in the attack on Hadi.
Content_English: On December 12, Inqilab Manch spokesperson Sharif Osman Hadi was shot dead on Box Culvert Road in Purana Paltan, Dhaka. He later died on December 18 while undergoing treatment in Singapore. Police have identified one person as the main suspect in the shooting of Hadi. The person's name is Faisal Karim Masud alias Daud Khan. In this context, a photo card with the pictures of Faisal Karim and legal advisor Asif Nazrul was recently circulated on social media. It is claimed that Asif Nazrul said - 'Influential Jamaat lawyer Shishir Monir was involved in the bail of terrorist Faisal'.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman says responsibility for attack on Osman Hadi should be shifted from India to Pakistan
Content_English: Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson of Inqilab Manch, was shot dead in the Box Culvert area of ​​Bijoynagar in the capital on December 12. He later died while undergoing treatment in Singapore on December 18. Many netizens online are blaming Awami League and India for this. In this context, a photo card with pictures of BNP acting chairman Tarique Rahman and Osman Hadi was recently circulated on social media. It is claimed that Tarique Rahman said - 'We should shift the arrow of attack on Hadi from India to Pakistan'.

Headline_English: Sadiq Kayem demands that Ghulam Azam should live in Bangladesh as the Father of the Nation
Content_English: A photocard with the picture of DUCSU VP Sadiq Qaim was circulated on social media. It is claimed that he said - 'Regarding Ghulam Azam as the Father of the Nation, embrace Pakistan. 71 sacks of rotten independence, you have to live in Bangladesh. If you can't do that, then go to India.' The caption of the claim, which is being circulated, reads, 'They will change the name of Bangladesh to East Pakistan when they are in power.'

Headline_English: Junaid Ahmed Palak granted bail
Content_English: A piece of information has spread on the internet claiming that former State Minister for Information and Communications Zunaid Ahmed Palak has been granted bail.

Headline_English: Zulkarnain Sayer's comments implicating Jamaat in the shooting of Osman Hadi
Content_English: Expatriate journalist Zulkarnain Sayer has made a comment titled, "Dhaka-8 Jamaat-nominated MP candidate Dr. Md. Helal Uddin gave Faisal Masud betel nut to shoot Osman Hadi. Advocate Shishir Monir was the one who found Faisal Masud and made a deal with him. Shishir Monir got Faisal Masud bail twice after August 5th," claiming that information has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Faizul Karim commented on the topic, "Jamaat has the black mark of the 1971 massacre, but the Islamic Movement does not."
Content_English: Two separate photo cards have been circulated on social media in the names of electronic media 'Nagorik TV' and Daily Amar Desh, claiming that Senior Nayeb-e-Ameer of Islami Andolan Bangladesh Mufti Syed Muhammad Faizul Karim made a comment titled "Jamaat has the black mark of the 1971 massacre, but Islami Andolan does not."

Headline_English: Sadiq Qayem seeks votes in Osman Hadi's name
Content_English: Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson for Inqilab Manch, was shot dead in the Box Culvert area of ​​Bijoynagar in the capital on December 12. He is currently undergoing treatment at Evercare Hospital. In this context, a statement by Dhaka University Central Students' Union (DUCSU) VP Sadiq Qayem has been circulating on social media since at least the afternoon of December 14, demanding, "If you want to realize the dream that Hadi Bhai had for Dhaka-8 constituency, you will vote for me in a landslide."

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer comments, 'We don't want national elections before the attackers on Osman Hadi are arrested and tried'
Content_English: Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson of Inqilab Manch, has been shot in Bijoynagar in the capital. He was shot in the Box Culvert area of ​​Bijoynagar in the capital on December 12. He is currently undergoing treatment at the hospital. In the wake of this, Jamaat Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman has made a statement saying, "We do not want a national election before the attacker on Osman Hadi is arrested and tried." A demand has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Hadi was taken to Evercare in an ambulance donated by India
Content_English: Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson of Inqilab Manch, has been shot in Bijaynagar in the capital. He was shot in the Box Culvert area of ​​Bijaynagar on December 12. The shot-injured Hadi was first admitted to Dhaka Medical College Hospital. Later, he was taken to Evercare Hospital in the capital in a special ambulance for advanced treatment. In the wake of this incident, a claim has been circulated on social media that Hadi, who has taken an anti-India stance, had to use an ambulance gifted by India during the previous government's tenure.

Headline_English: Khaleda Zia calls Ruhul Kabir Rizvi a 'spineless scoundrel'
Content_English: A video has been circulated on various platforms on the internet demanding BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia's comments on BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi with the caption 'Our Rizvi Ahmed, you know he is a spineless and useless person.'

Headline_English: Rizvi commented that Hadi was shot on Tarique Rahman's orders.
Content_English: Sharif Osman Hadi, a potential independent candidate for Dhaka-8 constituency and spokesperson of Inqilab Manch, has been shot in Bijoynagar in the capital. He was shot in the Box Culvert area of ​​Bijoynagar in the capital on December 12. He is currently undergoing treatment at the hospital. In the wake of this incident, claims are being made on social media that Hadi was shot on the orders of BNP acting chairman Tarique Rahman, said BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi.

Headline_English: Shamsuzzaman commented, "After using BNP, they threw me away like a tissue."
Content_English: A photocard with the image of Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Vice Chairman Shamsuzzaman Dudu has been circulated on social media with the claim, "BNP has thrown me away like a tissue after using me - Dudu."

Headline_English: Narendra Modi made a comment titled 'If AL holds a rally in Delhi, I will throw Hasina out'
Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal has given its verdict in the case filed against ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina for crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. She has been sentenced to death on two charges. In this context, a photo card with a design by mainstream media outlet Banglavision has been circulated under the title 'If Awami League holds a rally in Delhi, I will throw Hasina out - Narendra Modi', quoting Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi.

Headline_English: Narendra Modi comments that Hasina will return home before the elections
Content_English: The upcoming 13th National Assembly elections are scheduled to be held in February 2026. In light of this, a photo card titled "Hasina will return home before the elections" has been circulated on social media, quoting Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi and using his picture.

Headline_English: Sadiq Qayyem comments on the title of Ghulam Azam, the proclaimer of independence
Content_English: A photo card with a revolutionary design has been circulated on social media with the slogan "Ghulam Azam, the great proclaimer of freedom: Sadiq Qayem".

Headline_English: Hasnat Abdullah joins Awami League
Content_English: A video has been circulating on social media claiming that Hasnat Abdullah, the chief organizer of the National Citizens Party (NCP) in the southern region, has joined the Awami League. The video shows Hasnat Abdullah standing on the stage of an event expressing excitement while others are chanting slogans in the name of Sheikh Hasina.

Headline_English: 3,600 murders in 14 months due to internal strife in Jamaat
Content_English: A photocard with the logo of BBC News Bangla has been circulated on social media Facebook, claiming that 3,600 people have been killed across the country in the last 14 months due to internal strife within the Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami. The circulated photocard also claims that the police are not taking any cases even though they want to file a case in the mentioned murders.

Headline_English: Three service chiefs visit Khaleda Zia's body at hospital
Content_English: Former Prime Minister and BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia has been hospitalized since November 23 due to serious illness. She is undergoing treatment at the capital's Evercare Hospital. Since then, rumors and discussions have been going on everywhere about her physical condition. In this context, a photo card with the design of Somoy TV with the information titled '3 service chiefs at hospital to see Khaleda Zia's body' or with the title 'Khaleda Zia's body' and the pictures of Khaleda Zia and the three service chiefs has been spread on social media.

Headline_English: Chief Prosecutor comments on Dr. Yunus's payment of Tk 20 crore to get verdict against Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death on November 17 after finding her guilty in a case of crimes against humanity committed during the July Movement. In light of this, it has recently been claimed that the Chief Prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal, Tajul Islam, said, “Dr. Yunus gave me 20 crores to give a false verdict against Sheikh Hasina, the countrymen will forgive me.”

Headline_English: Jamaat-controlled Dr. Zaima Rahman comments on the topic "I don't trust Yunus"
Content_English: Claims have been circulating online that BNP acting chairman Tarique Rahman's daughter, Barrister Zaima Rahman, has said, "I don't trust Dr. Yunus, who is controlled by the Jamaat. Even if Khaleda Zia is sick, Tarique Rahman will not return to the country before the election schedule is announced."

Headline_English: 57,000 Sanatan Dharma voters, excluding AL, announce not to go to polling stations
Content_English: A photocard titled '57,000 Sanatan Dharma voters declare not to go to polling stations without AL' has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Jamaat may change the scale before the elections
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the national daily Amar Desh, titled 'Jamaat-e-Islami may change the scale markers before the elections,' has gone viral on social media.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus comments that Awami League will be able to do politics again
Content_English: According to the Anti-Terrorism (Amendment) Ordinance, on May 12 this year, the interim government issued a notification banning all activities of the Bangladesh Awami League and all its affiliates, affiliates and fraternal organizations until their trial at the International Crimes Tribunal is completed. Last October, a photo card with the picture of Dr. Muhammad Yunus under the title “Awami League will be able to do politics again: Dr. Yunus” was circulated on social media, quoting Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman calls for postponing elections due to Khaleda Zia's illness
Content_English: BNP Chairperson Khaleda Zia was admitted to Evercare Hospital on the night of November 23. She is currently undergoing treatment there. In the wake of this, a photo card titled "Tarek Zia calls for postponing the election as Khaleda Zia is ill" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: One lakh Hindu voters in Jhenaidah will not go to the polling station without A. League
Content_English: A video titled "One lakh people from the community in Jhenaidah have declared that they will not go to the polling station without the Awami League" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Second letter from UN seeking to overturn Sheikh Hasina's death sentence
Content_English: The International Criminal Tribunal for Bangladesh (ICB) sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death on November 17 in a case of crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. In the wake of this, a message was circulated on social media claiming that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres had sent a letter of instruction to Bangladesh President Mohammad Shahabuddin to overturn Sheikh Hasina's death sentence. Recently, a video was circulated on TikTok claiming that the UN had sent a second letter to overturn Sheikh Hasina's death sentence. The circulated video claimed that Sheikh Hasina's death sentence had been overturned in light of the letter.

Headline_English: "I will not be able to hang Hasina while I am alive," Narendra Modi commented.
Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal has given its verdict in the case filed against ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina for crimes against humanity committed during the July mass uprising. She has been sentenced to death on two charges. In the verdict, the tribunal said that the guilt of three accused, including Sheikh Hasina, has been proven. Sheikh Hasina was charged with five charges. Among them, she was sentenced to death for the murder of 6 people in Chankharpul and the burning of six people in Ashulia. In the wake of this, a photocard with the image of Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has been circulated on social media with the demand, "I will not hang Hasina while I am alive" - ​​Modi.

Headline_English: Samantha Sharmin comments that the fire incident at Rafia's house was staged
Content_English: A cocktail explosion and arson incident took place at the house of Umma Uswatun Rafia, an elected independent member of the Dhaka University Students' Union (DUCSU). In the wake of this, a photo card titled "Allegations of framing others by staging a planned arson incident - NCP leader Samantha" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Chief Prosecutor Tajul Islam is being vilified for issuing Sheikh Hasina's death sentence
Content_English:
The International Crimes Tribunal has sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death for crimes against humanity committed during the July 17 uprising. 
In the wake of this, a video has gone viral on the internet claiming that Tajul Islam, the chief prosecutor of the International Crimes Tribunal, has been subjected to a mass murder. In the video, Tajul Islam is seen being dragged out onto the street and beaten.

Headline_English: Hardline Islamists and Jamaat-e-Shibir attack on Gazipur fair
Content_English: A video has been circulated on social media platform X (formerly Twitter) claiming that hardline Islamists destroyed a music stage at a fair held in Gazipur because music and singing are prohibited in Islam.

Headline_English: Trump demands action if all parties, including AL, do not participate in the elections
Content_English: A video has gone viral on the internet claiming that US President Donald Trump made the comment regarding the upcoming 13th parliamentary elections in Bangladesh, "The elections must be held with the participation of all political parties, including the Awami League. We want to see free, fair and participatory elections in Bangladesh. If this is not the case, we will take strict action. If this is not the case, no government will be able to survive even a day."

Headline_English: Taher says men will be given the freedom to marry four times if Jamaat comes to power
Content_English: A photo card featuring the design of mainstream media outlet Jugantor, attaching a photo of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami's Nayeb Ameer Syed Abdullah Mohammad Taher, under the headline "If Jamaat comes to power, men will be given the freedom to marry four times," has been circulated on social media demanding Taher's statement.

Headline_English: Saudi Gazette's comment titled Sheikh Hasina innocent in July movement
Content_English: A claim titled, "Internationally powerful media outlets like Reuters, Al Jazeera and BBC have published news and interviews about Sheikh Hasina. Like these international media outlets, Saudi Gazette media outlet of Saudi Arabia has also published positive news about Sheikh Hasina. Their news says that Sheikh Hasina is innocent of the killings in the July Movement and that in the overall situation of Bangladesh, the people want her as the head of government again." has spread on social media.

Headline_English: UN Secretary-General's letter to President seeking quashing of Sheikh Hasina's death sentence
Content_English: The International Criminal Tribunal for Bangladesh (ICB) sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death on November 17 for crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. In light of this, a video has been circulated on social media platform Facebook claiming that UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has written a letter of instruction to Bangladesh President Mohammad Shahabuddin to overturn Sheikh Hasina's death sentence.

Headline_English: Jamaat to form government, says ambassadors from 13 countries
Content_English: A photocard featuring NTV's design is being circulated on social media, claiming that "Jamaat will form the government, said ambassadors from 13 countries."

Headline_English: Taher commented on the topic "No one in Bangladesh died in 1971".
Content_English: No one in Bangladesh died in 1971, but many in Pakistan died: Taher, a photocard with the logo and design of Amar Desh, along with the photo of Syed Abdullah Md. Taher, the Nayeb Ameer of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, has been circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: Fakhrul comments on Islam being the safest during Sheikh Hasina's rule
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of mainstream media outlet Ekattor TV has been circulated on social media, claiming that BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir's statement, "Islam was the safest during Sheikh Hasina's time, it was not distorted, Islam was interpreted correctly."

Headline_English: Kim Jong Un says Sheikh Hasina's death sentence is a 'violation of humanity'
Content_English:
The International Crimes Tribunal has sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and former Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal to death in a case of crimes against humanity. The three-member tribunal headed by Justice Golam Mortuza Majumder, Chairman of the International Crimes Tribunal-1, gave the verdict on November 17. 
In light of this, a claim has been circulating on the internet that North Korean Supreme Leader Kim Jong Un has made a comment titled ‘Sheikh Hasina’s death sentence has violated humanity.’

Headline_English: 170 countries reject verdict against Sheikh Hasina as illegal
Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal has sentenced ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina and former Home Minister Asaduzzaman Khan Kamal to death after finding them guilty in a case of crimes against humanity. The three-member tribunal headed by Justice Golam Mortuza Majumder, Chairman of the International Crimes Tribunal-1, gave the verdict on November 17. In light of this, a claim titled '170 countries including Russia, China and India have issued statements that Sheikh Hasina's hanging is illegal' is being circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Gayeshwar Chandra says BNP will establish democracy by banning AL and Jamaat
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of mainstream media outlet Channel 24 has been circulated on social media demanding a statement by BNP standing committee member Gayeshwar Chandra Roy under the headline "Banging Awami League and Jamaat and establishing democracy in this country."

Headline_English: 47 people, including army personnel, killed in clash at Dhanmondi 32
Content_English: On November 17 (Monday), the day of the verdict in the case of crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising, a group of protesters went to demolish Sheikh Mujibur's house at Dhanmondi 32. The protesters took two excavators to Dhanmondi 32. However, they were not allowed to take them near the house. The army and police stopped the protesters. There were repeated clashes there. In this context, a piece of information titled "Terrible clashes in Dhanmondi 32: 47 including army personnel killed in firing" has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Salahuddin Ahmed comments on BNP's decision to stop Awami League processions
Content_English:
The demand has been circulated on social media, BNP Standing Committee member Salahuddin Ahmed said, “BNP will no longer obstruct the Awami League procession.” 
It is worth noting that the post circulated with the discussed demand has a logo named ‘Garam TV’ made in the style of the logo of the mainstream media ‘Samoy TV’ attached to it. However, an analysis of the caption of the post shows that the discussed statement has been circulated with the claim of Salahuddin Ahmed’s original statement. In addition, the discussed demand has also been circulated in text form.

Headline_English: Mirza Abbas collects Tk 32 crore every month from Khilgaon Taltala Market alone
Content_English:
Recently, a photo card made in the style of the photo card of the mainstream media Kaler Kantho, involving Mirza Abbas, a member of the BNP standing committee, has been circulated on social media. The title of the circulated photo card is ‘Mirza Abbas collects 32 crore taka every month from Khilgaon Taltola Market alone’. 
The circulated photo card also has a link to Kaler Kantho’s website, the slogan ‘Partial not whole truth’ used in Kaler Kantho’s photo card. However, ‘Baler Kantho’ has been written in the text logo of Kaler Kantho instead of ‘Kaler Kantho’, in the style of Kaler Kantho’s logo. However, the original website link of Kaler Kantho (www.kalerkantho.com) and the original slogan (Partial not whole truth) have been used in the same photo card. In addition, the photo card is made in the style of Kaler Kantho’s design.

Headline_English: Commentary titled: Half of Bangladeshi voters support AL Reuters
Content_English: The information titled 'Almost half of Bangladeshi voters support Sheikh Hasina's party' has been circulated on social media, demanding comment from international media outlet Reuters.

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul not satisfied with Sheikh Hasina's death sentence
Content_English: The International Crimes Tribunal has sentenced ousted former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to death on November 17 in a case of crimes against humanity committed during the July uprising. In light of this, BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has commented that he is not satisfied with the court's verdict. A photocard demanding the verdict has been circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Fazlur Rahman announces to boycott elections if AL is not allowed to participate
Content_English:
Recently, a screenshot of a post from a Facebook account named 'Advocate Fazlur Rahman' with the photo of Advocate Fazlur Rahman, who was nominated by BNP for the Kishoreganj-4 constituency (Itna-Mithamoin-Ashtagram) in the next national parliamentary election, was circulated on social media, with the caption 'I will boycott the election of Fazlur Rahman if Awami League is not allowed to participate in the next election' attached to the profile picture. The screenshot was circulated with the caption, 'I agree with the demands of the brave freedom fighter Fazlur Rahman, Insha Allah, do you agree?' 
That is, it has been claimed that suspended BNP leader Advocate Fazlur Rahman has commented from his Facebook account that Fazlur Rahman will boycott the election if Awami League is not allowed to participate in the next election.

Headline_English: Rizvi blames Mirza Fakhrul and Salahuddin for creating anarchy in AL
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of mainstream media outlet Channel 24, along with a photo of BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi, has been circulated on social media under the headline "8/10 BNP leaders like Mirza Fakhrul and Shala Uddin are involved in creating anarchy in the Awami League." The photocard, which includes a photo of BNP's senior joint secretary general Ruhul Kabir Rizvi, has been circulated on social media demanding Rizvi's statement.

Headline_English: Richie Solaiman comments on the topic "Awami League is stronger on the streets"
Content_English: The date for the announcement of the verdict of three people, including ousted Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, in the case of crimes against humanity committed in July-August, has been set for November 13. The Awami League announced a 'Dhaka Lockdown' program around this. In light of this, actress Richie Solaiman made a comment in a Facebook post titled 'Awami League on the highway is more powerful and popular. The opponent has already made the lockdown called by the Awami League a success a day earlier. This is the politics of sensible people.' It has been circulated through the media and social media.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus commented on the possibility of elections being held in 2026
Content_English: A photocard with the logo of the national daily Kalbela has gone viral on social media, claiming that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, has made a comment that "national elections are unlikely to be held in 2026."

Headline_English: NCP central office set on fire by angry mob
Content_English: A claim titled 'Angry mob set fire to the central office of the National Civic Party (NCP)' has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Salahuddin Ahmed resigns from BNP
Content_English: A photocard featuring RTV's design has been circulating on social media, claiming that Salahuddin Ahmed, a member of the BNP's standing committee, has resigned from the BNP since October 24.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus comments that Jamaat-A.League is conspiring against the elections
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of electronic media Jamuna Television has been circulated on social media claiming that Chief Advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus made a comment titled "Awami League is conspiring against Jamaat in the elections."

Headline_English: Hindus will not be able to stay in the country if they don't vote for Jamaat, says Golam Parwar
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of online media outlet Barta Bazar has been circulated on social media claiming that Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Secretary Professor Mia Golam Parwar made a comment titled "If Hindus do not vote for Jamaat in the upcoming elections, they will not be allowed to stay in this country."

Headline_English: Parwar made a comment titled 'Hare Krishna Haribol, pull the scales'
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of today's newspaper is being circulated claiming that Jamaat-e-Islami Secretary General Mia Golam Parwar made a comment titled 'Hare Krishna Haribol, lift the scales'.

Headline_English: Army recovers Tk 884 crore from Rizvi's house
Content_English:
A purported news report has been published online claiming, ‘Bangladesh Army has recovered 884 crore taka of extortion money from the house of BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Ruhul Kabir Rizvi’. The purported report also spread the purported news on various other issues, including the possibility of Sheikh Hasina’s return. 
It is worth noting that the purported report also includes several scenes claiming to show footage of the money recovered from Ruhul Kabir Rizvi’s house and footage of Rizvi being arrested.

Headline_English: President Shahabuddin Chuppu passes away
Content_English: A claim titled "President Mohammad Shahabuddin has passed away" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Golam Parwar comments on Jamaat not wanting AL banned
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the national daily Kaler Kantho newspaper has been circulated on the internet, with the headline, "Jamaat-e-Islami does not ban the Awami League in any way," quoting Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Secretary General and former MP Professor Mia Golam Parwar.

Headline_English: Pakistan's Foreign Minister says Jamaat will form government in future
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the daily Amar Desh, titled 'Pakistan's Foreign Minister optimistic that Jamaat will form the government,' has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Nahid Islam calls Dr. Yunus a hero of the country's destruction
Content_English: A video of National Citizens Party (NCP) convener Nahid Islam giving a speech was circulated on social media from a TikTok account named 'Bangladesh Awami League'. The caption of the video read, "Yunus is the hero who destroyed this country. Nahid Islam said."

Headline_English: BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul hacked to death
Content_English: A video demanding the "killing of BNP leader Fakhrul" has been circulating on the video sharing platform TikTok.

Headline_English: Jamaat leader Taher made a comment titled 'Jamaat-e-Islami wants unconditional release of army officers'
Content_English: The tribunal issued arrest warrants on October 8 against a total of 25 former and current army officers in two cases of crimes against humanity related to the disappearances and torture during the 15-and-a-half-year rule of the previous Awami League government and one case related to the killings during the July uprising. The prosecution filed formal charges in the tribunal on the same day. On October 11, the Bangladesh Army announced at a press conference that 15 officers had been taken into military custody. One of them is on retirement preparatory leave (LPR). On October 12, the Home Ministry issued a notification declaring a building in the Dhaka Cantonment as a temporary prison. On October 22, 15 army officers accused in three separate cases of crimes against humanity were taken from the International Crimes Tribunal to the Dhaka Cantonment sub-jail. In this context, since October 22, a photocard featuring the design of the national daily Prothom Alo has been circulated on social media, claiming that Jamaat-e-Islami's Nayeb Ameer Syed Abdullah Md. Taher had made a statement titled "Jamaat-e-Islami demands unconditional release of army officers."

Headline_English: Nurul Haque Nur commented on the topic of Jamaat forming the government
Content_English:
Recently, a photocard with the design of the media outlet Amar Desh, with the caption ‘Don’t get excited, Jamaat will form the government,’ and a picture of the President of the People’s Rights Council, Nurul Haque Nur, was circulated on social media. 

That is, the claim has been circulated that Nurul Haque Nur said, ‘Don’t get excited, Jamaat will form the government,’ is written.

Headline_English: Pro-AL lawyers boycott court demanding Dr. Yunus' resignation
Content_English: A video has gone viral on various internet platforms showing pro-Awami League lawyers across the country boycotting courts and staging protest marches demanding the resignation of Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government.

Headline_English: Mahmudur Rahman commented on the topic: Even if the AL-BNP joins the field in an alliance, they will not be able to stand up to Jamaat-Shibir.
Content_English: The comment titled 'Even if the Awami League and BNP join forces and enter the field together, they will not be able to stand up to the Jamaat Shibir, they will fly away like dust' is being circulated on his own claim, along with a picture of Mahmudur Rahman, the editor of the national daily Amar Desh.

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul commented, "Attacking the Awami League means disrespecting 71."
Content_English: A photocard claiming that BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir made a comment titled "Attack on Awami League means disrespect to 71" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Environmental advisor comments on need to plant grass suitable for human consumption
Content_English: Syeda Rizwana Hasan, the interim government's environmental advisor, has made a comment titled "We must plant grass suitable for human consumption." A photocard with the logo of the daily Samakal has been circulated on social media in support of the demand.

Headline_English: Dhaka College Shibir member arrested for vote-stealing in DUCSU elections
Content_English:
The Dhaka University Central Student Union (DUCSU) elections were held on September 9. In which the candidates of the 'United Student Alliance' supported by Islami Chhatra Shibir won 9 out of the VP, GS and AGS posts and 12 secretary posts. However, Chhatra Dal VP candidate Abidul Islam Khan and independent candidate Umama Fatema announced the rejection of the results, alleging rigging in the election. Earlier, on September 9 at 2:21 pm, a post on the Facebook page named Kantherkella claimed that a member of Dhaka College Student Union named Tahmid Bin Saif had been arrested for stealing votes in DUCSU. 
The post provided a screenshot of a video broadcast by Dainik Jugantar about a suspect being taken to the attic from Shahbagh. In which the detained person is clearly visible. The post claimed that the detained person is Tahmid Bin Saif. In addition, the post also provided screenshots of three posts made on Saif's profile. In this, the involvement of Islami Chhatra Shibir with him can be seen.

Headline_English: Ban on AL activities lifted
Content_English:
The interim government issued a notification on May 12 banning the activities of the Bangladesh Awami League until the trial at the International Crimes Tribunal is completed. In light of this, a purported news story was recently broadcast with the caption, “Awami League Banned | Watch the video of Dr. Yunu in a Dangerous Situation.” In addition, in a news footage at the beginning of the video, the news anchor can be heard saying, “There is no obstacle for the Awami League to do politics. The High Court has dismissed the writ petition to cancel the registration of the party and ban it.” 
In other words, it is claimed that the ban on the activities of the Awami League has been lifted.

Headline_English: Tammy Bruce says AL must participate in Bangladesh's next elections
Content_English: A video titled "The next national elections in Bangladesh should be held under a non-partisan caretaker government," and "UN Human Rights Commission Chief Volker Turk will take steps to ensure the constitutionally elected Awami League government returns to power," has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Tasnim Zara's house raided, Tk 26 crore recovered
Content_English: Recently, a video claiming that Tk 26 crore has been recovered from the house of National Citizens Party (NCP) Senior Joint Member Secretary Tasneem Zara has been circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: US statement on the formation of a caretaker government and Sheikh Hasina's participation in the elections
Content_English: A statement has been circulated on social media quoting the alleged US Secretary of State, demanding "orders to form a non-partisan caretaker government, Sheikh Hasina will be able to participate in the elections."

Headline_English: Rumin Farhana's comment titled 'The Liberation War is safe only in the hands of the Awami League'
Content_English: A video with the caption 'The liberation war is safe only in the hands of the Awami League. - Rumin Farhana' has been circulated on various internet platforms. In the video, former member of parliament and Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Central International Affairs Secretary Barrister Rumin Farhana can be heard saying 'The liberation war is safe only in the hands of the Awami League.'

Headline_English: Jamaat leader Abdul Halim made a comment titled "Jamaat will win all 300 seats, including Mirza Fakhrul's seat."
Content_English: At least since August 20, claims have been circulating through the media and social media, with Jamaat-e-Islami's central assistant secretary general Maulana Abdul Halim saying, "Jamaat will win all 300 seats, including Mirza Fakhrul's seat."

Headline_English: Mabrur Rashid Bannah comments that Ziaur Rahman is Khaleda Zia's son
Content_English:
A video with the caption ‘Bannah is making Ziaur Rahman the son of Khaleda Zia’ has been circulated on various internet platforms. 

In the video, Bangladeshi theatre director Mabrur Rashid Bannah can be heard saying ‘Martyred President Ziaur Rahman is the son of our uncompromising leader Begum Khaleda Zia.’

Headline_English: Sohel Taj was lynched while paying homage to Sheikh Mujib at Dhanmondi 32 on August 15.
Content_English: A video titled 'Sohel Taj was beaten up by the mob while paying homage to Bangabandhu at Dhanmondi 32' is being circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: Stephane Dujarric comments that Sheikh Hasina was forcibly ousted from power
Content_English:
Recently, a video of Stephane Dujarric speaking at a press briefing has been circulated on the internet claiming that the UN held an emergency meeting on the situation in Bangladesh and that UN Secretary-General's spokesperson Stephane Dujarric held an emergency press conference after the meeting. 
The video was circulated with the caption, 'Recently, UN spokesperson Stephane Dujarric held an emergency press conference after the UN emergency meeting on the situation in Bangladesh today. 

In it, he said that Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina was forcibly ousted in the name of the quota movement in Bangladesh. Stephane Dujarric also said that Dr. Yunus has illegally seized power for the past one year with a meticulous plan, which has resulted in the loss of thousands of lives, especially the Yunus administration is committing genocide against Awami League supporters. He said that if Dr. Yunus does not hand over power to the President within the next 25 days, Sheikh Hasina will be returned to the country through UN security forces.' 

That is, it is being claimed that 

A. The United Nations recently held an emergency meeting on the situation in Bangladesh, and then UN Secretary-General's spokesperson Stephane Dujarric held an emergency press conference regarding the meeting.

Headline_English: Health Minister says BNP-Jamaat will not get vaccine
Content_English: On January 2, an online portal published a news report titled “BNP-Jamaat will not get the vaccine: Health Minister”. Part of the news report stated that “BNP-Jamaat members will not get the vaccine due to the government’s work and false information given to the countrymen about bringing the vaccine from India.” The Health Minister said this at a meeting with journalists in Manikganj on Saturday (January 2). Despite saying “BNP-Jamaat will not get the vaccine” at the meeting with journalists, the question remains as to why no report on this was published in the mainstream media.

Headline_English: Large amount of money recovered from Samantha Sharmin's house, she arrested
Content_English: A video has been circulated on the internet claiming that a chest and sacks full of money were recovered from the house of National Citizens Party (NCP) spokesperson Samantha Sharmin.

Headline_English: Chhatra League President Saddam made a comment titled 'He wouldn't have gone to DU even if he was in the country'
Content_English: On August 8, BBC Bangla published a report on the activities of the Awami League in Kolkata. Citing the report, some media outlets in the country are claiming that Saddam Hossain, the president of the banned student organization Bangladesh Chhatra League, told BBC Bangla that even if he were in the country, he would not have visited its campus, Dhaka University.

Headline_English: The army chief resigned and was also arrested.
Content_English:
The Bangladesh Army has recently taken into custody an army officer named Sadequl Haque Sadeq on charges of training Awami League workers. Brigadier General Md. Nazim-ud-Daula, Director of the Military Operations Department of the Army Headquarters, gave this information at a press conference held at Officers Mess 'A' in Dhaka Cantonment on July 31. 

In this context, a video has been circulated on the internet by adding some footage of the media claiming to be news of Jamuna TV, Bangladesh Pratidin, Ekushey Television, and Amar Desh. 

In the footage of Jamuna TV, it is heard that allegations have been made of training Awami League workers, and that Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman has resigned. In the footage of Bangladesh Pratidin, it is heard that Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman has been detained on charges of training Awami League workers. And in footage from my country, we can hear audio of the army officer involved in the secret sabotage training of Awami League workers, Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman, being court-martialed.

Headline_English: FBCCI President's statement on wanting to see Sheikh Hasina back in power
Content_English:
Recently, a video titled “FBCCI President wants to see Sheikh Hasina government back in power” was circulated on TikTok. 
As of the writing of this report, the video has been viewed more than 493,000 times on TikTok. The video has also received reactions from more than 1,300 different accounts and has been shared more than 3,700 times.

Headline_English: Argentinian Foreign Minister declares Sheikh Hasina as legitimate Prime Minister
Content_English:
Recently, the Argentine Foreign Minister declared Sheikh Hasina as the legitimate Prime Minister at a so-called Global Humor meeting and a total of eight countries have legitimized Sheikh Hasina as the Prime Minister – two pictures have been circulated on social media claiming that this. 
The caption of the posts says, ‘Breaking News This time, Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has been declared as the legitimate Prime Minister by Argentine Foreign Minister Mesorfa……….. He made these comments at the Global Humor meeting attended by world leaders. We were able to hold a politically important well-planned meeting. Our meeting was an important moment. 8 countries have legitimized Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina..’

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina leaves India for London
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been spread on social media Facebook that "Sheikh Hasina is going to London from India."

Headline_English: Rahul Gandhi comments that Sheikh Hasina can become an MP in India
Content_English: A photocard has been circulated on social media platform Facebook claiming that former president of the Indian political party Congress and Leader of Opposition in the Lok Sabha Rahul Gandhi has made a comment titled 'Sheikh Hasina can now become an MP in India'.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina ranked 3rd in the world as an honest and corruption-free prime minister
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been circulated on social media platform Facebook claiming that former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who was ousted from power in the face of a student uprising and took refuge in India, is ranked third out of 173 prime ministers in a so-called list of honest and corruption-free prime ministers.

Headline_English: Shibir leader dressed in army uniform opens fire on students
Content_English: An Air Force fighter jet crashed near Milestone School in the Diabari area of ​​Uttara, Dhaka on July 21. In light of this, the government announced the postponement of the HSC and equivalent examinations scheduled for July 22 at around 3 am that day. In response to these incidents, students gathered in front of the main gate of the Secretariat on July 22 to demand the resignation of the Education Advisor and Education Secretary. During this, students also clashed with police and army members. In light of this, two pictures were circulated on social media on July 23, claiming, "Yesterday (July 22), the leader of the camp, dressed in army uniform, opened fire on students."

Headline_English: 23 killed in attack on NCP's Long March to Gopalganj program
Content_English:
As part of the previously announced program, the central leaders and activists of the National Citizens Party (NCP) went on a march in Gopalganj today (July 16). 
In the wake of this, a claim titled "23 members of the National Citizens Party (NCP) were killed in an attack by Gopalganj residents" has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Two NCP leaders die in road accident while entering Gopalganj
Content_English: The National Citizens Party (NCP) is holding a 'July March to Build the Nation' program to celebrate the first anniversary of the July Movement. The party's top leaders are touring 64 districts of the country in this month-long program. As part of this, this program is scheduled to be held in Gopalganj today, Wednesday. In such a context, several posts on social media since midnight today are claiming that two central leaders of the NCP, including the driver, have been killed in a car accident while entering Gopalganj.

Headline_English: Sarjis Alam comments that Chhatra Dal and Jubo Dal should be banned
Content_English: Sarjis Alam, the chief organizer of the Jatiya Nagorik Party (NCP) in the northern region, has made a comment demanding that Chhatra Dal and Jubo Dal be banned. A photo card has been circulated on social media Facebook demanding that the party should be banned. The photo card reads, "The party will not take responsibility for the individual, the party will only take a share of the donation. This donation will come to Bangladesh through remittance from London. We now have only one demand: Chhatra Dal and Jubo Dal should be banned."

Headline_English: Dr. Mosharraf Hossain commented that BNP has no ground under its feet.
Content_English: A photocard with the logo of mainstream media outlet Ekattor has been circulated on social media demanding comments from Dr. Khandaker Mosharraf Hossain, a member of the Bangladesh Nationalist Party's (BNP) standing committee, with the title "BNP has no ground under its feet, national security will become easier if national unity can be established, BNP cannot go to war alone."

Headline_English: Mahathir Mohamad recently called Sheikh Hasina a 'dynamic leader'
Content_English: A claim has been circulated on social media Facebook that former Malaysian Prime Minister Mahathir Mohamad said in a recent interview that Bangladesh was on the rise, whether it was due to a dynamic leader like Sheikh Hasina or not. At one time, I saw unity in Bangladesh, but today it is no longer visible. The country seems to be in the hands of a militant group. During Sheikh Hasina's rule, Bangladesh's economic growth, infrastructural development and international relations reached new heights. Major projects like the Padma Bridge and Metrorail are indicative of her strong leadership. Stopping the pace of development is suicidal for a country. I hope the people of Bangladesh will think about the future of their country and make the right decision.

Headline_English: Disabled man beaten to death by BNP activists for criticizing chief advisor
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on social media that BNP leaders and activists beat a mentally challenged man to death for criticizing Chief Advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus in Jessore.

Headline_English: Three bags of money recovered from Sarjis Alam's friend's house
Content_English: Three bags of money were found at the house of a friend of Sarjis Alam, the chief organizer of the National Citizens Party (NCP) for the northern region, which were kept with him (Sarjis). A video with Sarjis Alam's picture has been circulated on social media under the title of demand for NCP campaign expenses after Eid.

Headline_English: Jamaat-Shibir attack on Abu Nasr Ashrafi
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the online news portal Daily Campus has been circulated on social media platform Facebook under the headline, "Jamaat-Shibir attack on Jamaat's nominated candidate for Chandpur 1 (Kachua) constituency - Abu Nasr Ashrafi..."

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina asks to be buried in her own country, even if it is in Azimpur graveyard
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of mainstream media outlet Ekattor has been circulated on social media, demanding former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's comments, with the headline "If I die, bury me even in my own country, Azimpur cemetery."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus comments that the interest business can change the world
Content_English: Two separate photocards featuring the designs of Samakal and Channel i are being circulated on social media, claiming that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, said, “The business of interest can change the entire world.”

Headline_English: Nurul Haque Nur calls Tarique Rahman a batsman
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the daily Janakantha has gone viral on social media, claiming that Gana Odhikar Parishad President Nurul Haque Nur made a comment titled "People are such big idiots, it's hard to understand without seeing Tarique Rahman."

Headline_English: 19 countries around the world have demanded justice for Dr. Yunus
Content_English: 19 countries have demanded Yunus' trial. "People's leader Sheikh Hasina will return home with a letter from the UN," an information titled has been circulated on the internet.

Headline_English: Nearly Tk 3.5 crore recovered from NCP convener Nahid Islam's house
Content_English: A video of the money being recovered has been circulated on social media, claiming, "The police recovered four bags of money from a small pond behind the village house of Advisor Nahid through secret information. When they saw a bag floating on the water, someone informed the police. When the police went to the scene, they recovered four bags of money and the amount in the four bags was 3 crore 51 lakh 72 thousand. Darna is being done. Someone left the money behind."

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer comments on the topic of a new party coming to power
Content_English: I am reassured by the Chief Advisor's announcement and hope for a free, fair, impartial and acceptable election to be held within the announced time frame. I express the hope that this time a new party will come to power.' A photocard with the design of the mainstream media Kalbela, quoting Dr. Shafiqur Rahman, the Ameer of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami, and adding his picture, has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: UN message stating that there will be no elections in Bangladesh without Awami League
Content_English: Now the international game has begun. There will be no elections in Bangladesh without the Awami League. Official message from the United Nations. The United Nations has expressed deep concern over the banning of the Awami League. A video titled "The United Nations has expressed deep concern over the banning of the Awami League" has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: British intelligence agencies banned the Anti-Discrimination Student Movement or NCP
Content_English:
British intelligence agencies have imposed a ban on Bangladesh Discrimination Student Organization. 
Dr. Mohammad Yunus, along with 89 prominent citizens, participated in the Cup conference organized at the office of the Managing Director of the British King Charles III. 
A notice has been issued against the Bangladesh Discrimination Student Organization NCP or Nagorik Party for money laundering, corruption and smuggling of independence-oriented digital security information. 
A ban has been imposed on the participation of Discrimination Student Organizations without political parties in the Bangladesh national elections. 
Today, a notice has been issued to Dr. Mohammad Yunus, the Chief Advisor to the Bangladesh Interim Government, and he has been ordered to deposit the laundered money in the treasury. 
We, on behalf of 57 prominent citizens, have strongly called for a fair election and democracy. 
There will be no restrictions on the participation of the Bangladesh Awami League, BNP and Jatiya Party in the elections. 
At the same time, an order has been issued to release the accused from the harassment case. 
Speaking on the occasion of the Cup Conference 2025, I call on the Bangladesh interim government not to violate the election law.

Headline_English: Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina arrested
Content_English: A message titled "Former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has been arrested and will be brought back to the country soon" has recently been circulated on social media, claiming that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has been arrested.

Headline_English: Sadiq Qayyem commented on the topic "We are heading towards Iran"
Content_English: Sadiq Qayem, the central publishing editor of Chhatra Shibir, made a comment titled "I have set out on the path with the desire for martyrdom. I fear only Allah. I have set off on the path to Iran." A photocard with the logo of the daily Janakantha has been circulated on social media in support of the demand.

Headline_English: Shafiqul Alam makes comments calling you a hero whenever he speaks against Awami League and India
Content_English: A photocard with the picture of the Chief Advisor's Press Secretary Shafiqul Alam has been circulated on social media under the title 'At this moment, if you speak against the Awami League and India, you are a hero'.

Headline_English: Trump will make Sheikh Hasina the Prime Minister again if the people of Bangladesh want it.
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of Bangladesh Television (BTV) is being circulated on social media with the headline, "If the people of Bangladesh want the Awami League back, Hasina will be the next Prime Minister of Bangladesh," in response to US President Donald Trump's comments.

Headline_English: Ishrak Hossain will remain as Dhaka South mayor for life
Content_English: A photocard featuring a design by mainstream media outlet Kalbela titled "I will remain mayor of Dhaka South for life: Ishraq Hossain" has been circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Home Affairs Adviser orders withdrawal of all murder cases against Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: Jahangir Alam Chowdhury, the home affairs advisor to the interim government, has made a comment titled "Order to withdraw all the murder cases against Sheikh Hasina." A photocard with the Kaler Kantho logo has been circulated on social media demanding the withdrawal.

Headline_English: Former President Abdul Hamid arrested
Content_English: A piece of information titled 'Former President Abdul Hamid arrested' has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina can enter the country at any time
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of private electronic media outlet Channel 24, titled 'Sheikh Hasina can enter the country at any time, so Dr. Yunus wants to leave the country', has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Tarique Rahman comments on election or death after Eid
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the national daily Kalbela has been circulated on social media Facebook with the demand, 'Elections after Eid or death, Tarique Rahman!'

Headline_English: Chief advisor asks to quit politics and beg and eat
Content_English: Politics was not created for division, politics was created for unity, for the good of the country. Those who do politics for division and their own interests should leave politics and beg and eat,” a photo card with the design of the domestic mainstream media Independent TV has been circulated on social media demanding a statement by the interim government's chief advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus.

Headline_English: Khaleda Zia comments on 80 percent of the country's people not wanting elections
Content_English: A demand has been circulated on social media platform Facebook in the form of a photo card, with former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia saying, "80% of the country's people do not want elections, because the environment for elections is not there yet. India is falling into the trap of Chuppu Walker, and BNP is becoming isolated. Everyone is saying that BNP has gone crazy."

Headline_English: After Bangladesh, Awami League banned in India too
Content_English:
The interim government issued a notification on May 12 banning the activities of the Bangladesh Awami League until the trial in the International Criminal Tribunal is completed. 
Meanwhile, on May 21, a Facebook page called ‘Banglar Damal’ circulated a purported screenshot of the Indian mainstream news outlet The Times of India, claiming that ‘Awami League has finally been banned in India’. 
The headline of the purported report reads, ‘After Bangladesh, Awami League banned in India’

Headline_English: Section 144 imposed at 44 points in Dhaka
Content_English: Chief Advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus expressed his thoughts on resigning at the regular meeting of the Advisory Council on May 22. It is known that during this time, he spoke about various obstacles in various initiatives of the government. He expressed anger and disappointment at the prevailing situation in the country, including frequent road blockades, lack of consensus among the parties on various issues including reforms, and non-cooperation from various parties in state work. In this context, recently, an information titled “Emergency at several points including Section 144 imposed in 44 points of Dhaka” has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer comments on 'BNP in deep crisis if reforms are not made before elections'
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of news-based television News Twenty-Four has been circulated on social media, demanding that the comment titled 'BNP will be in deep crisis if reforms are not made before the election, come back while there is still time' be made by Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman.

Headline_English: Hasnat Abdullah commented on the topic of 50-100 people participating in our movement
Content_English: Hasnat Abdullah, the chief organizer of the National Citizens Party (NCP) in the southern region, said, "The army is always vigilant to protect our independence and sovereignty. But we will not accept it if it interferes with our democracy. Although 50-100 people are present in our movement now, this may be a reason for normal busyness, if necessary, a tough response will be given with the cooperation of the pro-Pakistan camp." A photocard with the logo of the daily Kaler Kantho has been circulated on social media in response to the demand.

Headline_English: Khaled Muhiuddin commented on the topic: "There is room for a bunch of homosexuals in the NCP, but no room for the July victims."
Content_English: Recently, a demand is being spread on social media demanding comments from Khaled Muhiuddin, a talk show host of a channel called 'Khaled Muhiuddin at the Address' on YouTube, titled "Nahids opened a party called NCP in exchange for thousands of lives in July. July gave the party its spirit, yet those injured in July are having to protest in Shahbagh demanding medical treatment - not just those with spirit. Although there is a lot of room for homosexuals in the NCP party, there is no room for any of the injured in July."

Headline_English: Ishraq comments on injustice if I want to be auto-mayor
Content_English: In the wake of the court's verdict, the Election Commission published a gazette on April 27 declaring BNP leader Ishraq Hossain as the mayor of Dhaka South City Corporation. Ishraq Hossain's supporters have been protesting since Wednesday demanding that he be sworn in as the mayor of Dhaka South City. In this context, it is being claimed that Ishraq made a comment that "when you get an auto-pass, it is fair. It is unfair if I want to become an auto-mayor."

Headline_English: Trump comments titled 'Sheikh Hasina is still the Prime Minister of Bangladesh'
Content_English:
Recently, a video titled “Sheikh Hasina is still the Prime Minister of Bangladesh: Donald Trump” has been circulating on social media. The video claims that Donald Trump has made such comments about Sheikh Hasina. 

In the video, Trump’s voice can be heard: “On the 15th of May, I will travel to Bangladesh with Sheikh Hasina. There is no reason to worry. Sheikh Hasina will come to Bangladesh as prime minister.” (On May 15, I will travel to Bangladesh with Sheikh Hasina. There is no reason to worry. Sheikh Hasina is returning to Bangladesh as prime minister.)

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul's comment titled 'The country is taking revenge for the restoration of East Pakistan and the defeat in the Liberation War'
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of mainstream media outlet Independent TV has been circulated on social media platform Facebook under the headline “Recovery of East Pakistan and revenge for defeat in the Liberation War are underway in the country: Mirza Fakhrul.”

Headline_English: 9 Shibir members arrested for stealing goats in Mohammadpur
Content_English: A photocard bearing the RTV logo has been circulated on the internet under the headline, "9 Shibir members arrested for stealing goats in Mohammadpur."

Headline_English: Trump's ultimatum to lift Awami League ban
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information titled 'US President Donald Trump gives 24-hour ultimatum to lift ban on Awami League in detailed comments' has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Russia and China express concern over ban on AL activities
Content_English: The interim government issued a notification on May 12 banning the activities of the Bangladesh Awami League until the trial at the International Crimes Tribunal is completed. In light of this, a photocard with the BBC Bangla logo has recently been circulated on social media, claiming, "India, Russia and China have expressed concern over the ban on the political activities of the Awami League."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus made a statement regarding the banning of Awami League by pressing a stone against his chest.
Content_English: Recently, the interim government announced its decision to ban the activities of the Awami League. In response, a photocard made in the style of Jamuna TV is being made using the image of the government's chief advisor, Dr. Muhammad Yunus, demanding his statement, saying, "I am declaring the Awami League banned with a stone pressed against my chest. Chief Advisor."

Headline_English: Hasnat Abdullah threatens Tarique Rahman
Content_English: A video titled 'Tarek, if you are actually in the country, I will ring your 12 o'clock! Hasanath threatens Tarique Rahman' has been circulated on various platforms on the internet, claiming that Hasanath Abdullah, the chief organizer of the National Citizens Party (NCP) in the southern region, has threatened BNP acting chairman Tarique Rahman.

Headline_English: Barrister Suman released on Army Chief's orders
Content_English: Recently, a video has been circulated on the internet claiming that former MP Barrister Syed Sayedul Haque Suman, who is in prison in a murder case, has been released on the orders of Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman.

Headline_English: National Citizen Party banned
Content_English: A claim titled 'Breaking News: National Citizens Party (NCP) has been banned in Bangladesh' has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: The British could not have ruled for 200 years if they had camps.
Content_English: Recently, a photocard bearing the logo of mainstream media Daily Janakantha, titled 'If there were camps during the British period, they could not have ruled India for 200 years', is being circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Mirza Abbas comments on BNP's launch of license system to control extortion
Content_English: A photocard made in the style of Jatiya Janakantha is being circulated on social media, claiming that BNP will introduce a licensing system to control extortion if it comes to power, made by BNP standing committee member Mirza Abbas.

Headline_English: Dipu Moni's death
Content_English: At least since April 23, social media has been spreading rumors that Dipu Moni, a former minister in the previous Awami League government who was imprisoned, has died.

Headline_English: 'BNP extortionists' slogans raised during Mirza Fakhrul's speech
Content_English: A video has been circulated on social media claiming that BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir was seen chanting slogans like 'BNP extortionists' while delivering a speech at a program.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus donates $70,000 to Israel through Zeus Community Foundation
Content_English: Social media has been spreading rumors that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, donated $70,000 to the Jewish Community Foundation through his organization Grameen America. The circulating posts include a video that shows a screen recording of a webpage on the Jewish Community Foundation Los Angeles website called Grameen America, where a grant of $70,000 is written.

Headline_English: China and US issue legal notices to detain Dr. Yunus for five years
Content_English: A claim has been circulated on social media by the National Citizens Party claiming that legal notices have been sent from China and the United States to keep the interim government of Bangladesh and its chief advisor Dr. Muhammad Yunus in power for 5 years.

Headline_English: Shakib returns home to attend case hearing
Content_English: A photocard modeled after local media outlet Somoy TV is being circulated on social media, claiming that 'Shakib Al Hasan is returning home with tight security for the case hearing.'

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus arrested by the army
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on social media that the army has arrested Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus tops the list of the world's top 100 batsmen
Content_English: A photocard featuring Dr. Muhammad Yunus and bearing the RTV logo has been circulated on the internet under the title 'Dr. Yunus tops the list of the world's top 100 batsmen'.

Headline_English: Salahuddin Ahmed arrested for exaggerating about the election
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the daily Kalbela has been circulated on social media, claiming that BNP standing committee member Salahuddin Ahmed has been arrested for overstepping his authority with the chief advisor on the national election.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus needs to hold a referendum to stay in power: Nurul Haque Nur
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of Kaler Kantho has been circulating on social media, claiming that the comment titled 'Dr. Yunus needs to hold a public vote if he wants to stay in power for 5 years, and that the people will vote yes' was made by Nurul Haque Nur, president of the Gana Odhikar Parishad.

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul comments on extortion to increase if elections are not held in December
Content_English: A photocard featuring a DBC News design has gone viral on social media, claiming that BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir made the comment titled 'Extortion will increase if elections are not held in December'.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina's secret meeting with Netanyahu
Content_English: Rumor Scanner has spotted a photo circulating on social media purportedly showing Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu with former Bangladesh Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina.

Headline_English: The president of the organization commented that it would not take a minute for Chhatra Dal to occupy Israel.
Content_English: A photocard featuring Bangladesh Nationalist Chhatra Dal President Rakibul Islam Rakib has been circulated on social media, which reads, “It won’t take a minute for Chhatra Dal to occupy Israel | Rakibul Islam Rakib, President, Chhatra Dal”

Headline_English: President Zahidul Islam commented on the camp's ability to liberate Gaza in 1 week.
Content_English:
On March 18, Israel resumed its attacks on the Gaza Strip, breaking a two-month ceasefire, resulting in increased violence. Many Palestinians were killed and injured, and the humanitarian situation deteriorated further. Various organizations in Bangladesh are holding various programs in solidarity with the Israeli aggression in Gaza. Bangladesh Islami Chhatra Shibir is also holding a week-long program from April 7 to 13. 

In this context, a claim has been made on social media that Islami Chhatra Shibir President Zahidul Islam has made a comment titled ‘Islami Chhatra Shibir has the capacity to liberate Gaza (Palestine) in just 1 week’.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus was seriously injured and attempted to be killed.
Content_English: An information titled 'Attempt to assassinate chief advisor, Dr. Yunus seriously injured, detailed comment' has been spread on social media.

Headline_English: Barrister Sumon's hanging body recovered from prison
Content_English: Mirpur Model Police Station arrested Barrister Syed Sayedul Haque Sumon, former member of parliament from Habiganj-4 constituency, on October 21 last year in connection with two murder cases filed in Mirpur and Adabor police stations during the July uprising. Later, he was also arrested in the murder case of grocery shopkeeper Mizanur Rahman, who was killed in Banasree during the movement. He is currently in jail in these cases. However, recently, a news item titled 'Barrister Sumon is tragically hanging in prison' was circulated on social media Facebook, claiming that his hanging body was recovered.

Headline_English: Former advisor Nahid arrested on orders of army chief
Content_English: A piece of information titled 'Former advisor Nahid arrested on the orders of the army chief, video with detailed comments' has spread on social media.

Headline_English: Inqilab Manch announces a program of feasting and cow slaughter in front of the American Embassy
Content_English: In the wake of the global 'No Work, No School' movement in protest of Israel's ongoing genocide in Gaza, a photo card has been circulated on social media claiming that the Inqilab platform has announced a program to slaughter two cows and a banquet in front of the American embassy to protest the Israeli and US aggression.

Headline_English: Mirza Fakhrul's comments on BNP not going to the elections without Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of electronic media Jamuna Television has been circulated on social media, claiming that Bangladesh Nationalist Party (BNP) Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir made a comment titled 'BNP will not go to the elections without Sheikh Hasina'.

Headline_English: Jamaat-e-Islami's Ameer Says Freedom Fighters Will Be Tried If They Come to Power
