Content_English: A photocard with the picture of Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman has been circulated on social media, which reads, “If Jamaat-e-Islami comes to power, freedom fighters will be tried.” In other words, it has been claimed that Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Ameer Dr. Shafiqur Rahman has said, “If Jamaat-e-Islami comes to power, freedom fighters will be tried.”

Headline_English: Jamaat leader comments on 'won't let elections be held before registration is returned'
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the national daily Janakantha is being circulated on social media, claiming that the comment, "I will not allow the national parliamentary elections in the country until the registration is returned," was made by Bangladesh Jamaat-e-Islami Secretary General and former MP Professor Mia Golam Parwar.

Headline_English: Advocate Abu Hena Razzaqi made a comment titled "Awami League alone is 100"
Content_English: "Awami League alone is one hundred. Awami League has over 50% of the votes. Yunus is a fraud and greedy type of person." The comment, titled "Awami League alone is one hundred. A photocard with the design of the national daily Janakantha is being circulated on social media at the request of Supreme Court lawyer Advocate Abu Hena Razzaky."

Headline_English: Narendra Modi is retiring from politics
Content_English: A photocard bearing the logo of Indian media outlet Times Now claims that Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi has said he will retire from politics on September 16.

Headline_English: Asif Nazrul's praise for the Awami League
Content_English: A video has been circulated claiming that Advisor on Law, Justice and Parliamentary Affairs Dr. Asif Nazrul praised the Awami League.

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina issued a press release announcing the end of her political career on August 5.
Content_English: After the Awami League government came to power through a student-public uprising on August 5, 2024, former Prime Minister of Bangladesh and President of Bangladesh Awami League Sheikh Hasina has been staying in India after leaving the country. Recently, a press release titled 'At this twilight of life, I want to stay away from all kinds of violence, strife, factionalism, and politics for power and my political career will end on August 5, 2024 and my return or my return by the army by declaring a state of emergency is a selfish conspiracy' has been circulated on social media. The release, signed by Sheikh Hasina, reads, 'New Delhi 24/03/2025 Greetings on the occasion of the holy month of Ramadan' Dear countrymen! On the eve of the holy month of Ramadan and the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr, I extend my warmest greetings and greetings to you. Dear countrymen, you must be aware that on August 5, 2024, I had to leave the country and take refuge in the capital of India, New Delhi, due to a tragic incident. Since then, I and my family have abstained from politics. Apart from my physical illness and daily worship, I have no desire or physical ability to do anything else. Since my birth in 1947, 79 years of life have passed one by one. Now only one melody is playing in my mind - "Oh my God, the day has passed, it is evening, pass me by." In this twilight of life, I want to stay away from all kinds of violence, strife, factionalism, politics for power. I have said before that my political career will end on 05.08.2024. My return or the army's declaration of emergency to bring me back is nothing but a vile conspiracy of some selfish miscreants. My last life will be spent next to the holy Rawza Mubarak of Khwaja Moinuddin Chishti (RA) in Ajmer Sharif. I have made a will that my last bed will be next to the court of Khwaja Baba and I have appealed to the Government of India. In this situation, I ended my statement by calling everyone towards peace and prosperity. "Joy Bangla! Joy Bangabandhu!! Long live Bangladesh."

Headline_English: Sheikh Hasina has passed away.
Content_English: Rumor Scanner has seen some screenshots of news posts circulating on social media claiming that former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina, who was ousted from power on August 5 last year and took refuge in India, has recently died.

Headline_English: Tulsi Gabbard made a comment on Sheikh Hasina's return to the country as Prime Minister
Content_English: Breaking news, Yunus in the face of death! With Tulsi's assurance, the compassionate mother of Bengal, Sheikh Hasina, is on her way to becoming the Prime Minister of the country.' A video with the caption "Breaking news, Yunus in the face of death! Sheikh Hasina, the compassionate mother of Bengal, is on her way to becoming the Prime Minister of the country," has been circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Asif Mahmud commented on the topic: The new Bangladesh will be established on the Pakistani ideology.
Content_English: Rumor Scanner has spotted a photocard with a Janakantha design being circulated on social media titled "The new Bangladesh will be established on the Pakistani ideology, no one can stop it: Asif Mahmud."

Headline_English: BNP leader Mirza Abbas calls for jailing the Prophet of Islam
Content_English: Recently, a video titled ‘BNP leader Mirza Abbas asks to jail the Prophet for raising Islamic slogans’ has been circulated on various platforms on the internet. In the video, the crowd at a rally is heard chanting slogans titled “Action direct action by the Prophet lovers. Naray-e-Takbir, Allahu Akbar.” After that, BNP leader Mirza Abbas is heard saying, “Who are you talking about? Say the name clearly. Who are you talking about? That guy, who are you talking about? Where is the Fazil! Put the Prophet in jail and go to the commune, you bastards. Where are the Fazils?”

Headline_English: Army seizes Tk 3 billion from Nahid Islam's account
Content_English:
On February 25, Md. Nahid Islam resigned from the post of advisor to the interim government. He was serving as an advisor to the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting and the Ministry of Posts, Telecommunications and Information Technology. After his resignation, on February 26, he published a post on his verified Facebook account detailing his bank accounts and assets during his tenure as an advisor. 
Recently, a video has been circulated on the internet claiming that the army has seized 300 crore taka from Nahid's account.

Headline_English: The army chief delivered a speech expressing gratitude on Bangabandhu's birth anniversary on March 17.
Content_English: A video titled 'Army Chief's speech on Bangabandhu's birth anniversary' has been circulated on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Bangladeshi passports issued to 69,000 Rohingyas in Saudi Arabia
Content_English:
A poster has been circulated on social media. The poster, based on the mainstream media outlet Inqilab, states, “69,000 Rohingya in Saudi Arabia will receive Bangladeshi passports by June.” In addition, in light of this, the poster asks, “Who gave the Yunus government the right to issue passports to Rohingyas?” The poster was circulated on social media with the caption, “Passport today. What about citizenship next?” 
The caption of some posts containing the poster reads, “The occupying Yunus is going to issue passports and citizenship to the Rohingyas on a state basis. In other words, in a few years, you will see that Bangladesh will be like Palestine. The Rohingyas will claim ownership of this land. With the help of the Deep State, they will be the most powerful population and Bengalis will be like the people of Palestine, some are jihadists and some are refugees.” 

In other words, it is claimed that the interim government’s chief advisor, Dr. Muhammad Yunus' government has decided to issue Bangladeshi passports to Rohingyas living in Saudi Arabia.

Headline_English: "BNP will not contest elections under Dr. Yunus' government," commented Mirza Fakhrul.
Content_English: "BNP will not contest elections under Dr. Yunus' government. Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has made it clear." A video has been circulated on social media demanding the same.

Headline_English: UN Human Rights Commission reports that nearly 400 Awami League activists were killed in the July uprising
Content_English: The United Nations Human Rights Commission (UNHRC) released a preliminary report on August 16 last year on the violence surrounding the anti-discrimination student movement and government collapse in Bangladesh in July-August 2024, and a detailed fact-finding report on February 12. The Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR). In light of this, a claim titled 'UN Human Rights Commission says 350-400 Awami League leaders, activists and supporters were killed out of nearly 650 people killed in the July uprising' has been circulated on social media.

Headline_English: Chhatra Dal president comments on Shibir's attacks in the name of Chhatra League for the past 15 years
Content_English: Social media has claimed that Chhatra Dal President Rakibul Islam Rakib said, "Shibir has carried out all attacks in the name of Chhatra League for the past 15 years."

Headline_English: Jamaat Ameer talks about alliance with Awami League
Content_English: A photocard featuring the design of the media outlet Amar Desh has been circulated on the internet, claiming that the comment titled 'We will ally with the Awami League again if necessary to protect the people of the country from the hands of BNP' was made by Jamaat-e-Islami Amir Shafiqur Rahman.

Headline_English: Trump says all Bangladeshi offices should have Sheikh Mujib's picture
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on the internet titled Donald Trump has ordered the removal of the portrait of Bangladesh's first president, Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, in every government office, court, and institution in Bangladesh within the next two months.

Headline_English: Hasnat Abdullah commented on the topic "Sheikh Hasina was better".
Content_English: Recently, in a photocard modeled after mainstream media outlet Ekattor TV, Hasnat Abdullah, convener of the anti-discrimination student movement, commented that "common people are now saying that Sheikh Hasina was better."

Headline_English: Trump comments on handing over Sheikh Hasina to Modi
Content_English: A photocard featuring a design by the national daily Daily Star with the headline "I handed Hasina over to Modi after August 5. Let Modi do whatever he wants ~Trump" has gone viral on social media.

Headline_English: Chief advisor comments on possibility of parliamentary elections on December 6
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been spread on online media and social media platform Facebook, "Potential date of parliamentary elections is December 6: Chief Advisor."

Headline_English: BBC News claims Hasnat Abdullah is a terrorist
Content_English: A video report has gone viral on the internet claiming that the British media outlet BBC has referred to Hasnat Abdullah, one of the coordinators of the anti-discrimination student movement, as a 'terrorist'.

Headline_English: Asif Nazrul goes live claiming that Dr. Yunus has been arrested in Switzerland
Content_English: On January 21, the interim government's chief advisor, Dr. Muhammad Yunus, left Dhaka to attend the World Economic Forum in Davos, Switzerland. In the meantime, a video of the speech of Legal Advisor Dr. Asif Nazrul has been circulated on various internet platforms, claiming that Asif Nazrul came live and said that Dr. Yunus has been arrested in Switzerland.

Headline_English: Sohel Taj commented on the topic 'How many thieves has Sheikh Mujib given birth to?'
Content_English: Recently, some posts have been circulating on social media claiming that former State Minister for Home Affairs Sohel Taj said, "Sheikh Mujib gave birth to so many thieves."

Headline_English: Army seizes passports of 45 people including Sarjis Alam
Content_English:
The army has seized the passports of 45 people, including Sarjis Alam. They were preparing to go to Europe.’ A piece of information titled ‘They were preparing to go to Europe.’ has been spread on social media. 
That is, it has been claimed that the army has seized the passports of 45 people, including Sarjis Alam, the chief organizer of the National Citizens Committee and the general secretary of the July Shaheed Smriti Foundation.

Headline_English: Azhari commented that if Jamaat comes to power, the tide of development will flow in the country in 5 years.
Content_English: A claim has been circulated on social media Facebook in the form of a photo card, with renowned Islamic speaker Dr. Mizanur Rahman Azhari saying, "If Jamaat comes to power, the tide of development will flow in the country in 5 years."

Headline_English: Over 100 injured in DU Chhatra Dal-Shibir attack over DUCSU election issue
Content_English:
On January 2, there was a verbal altercation between the leaders and activists of Dhaka University branch Chhatra Dal and the Vice Chancellor-Proctor regarding the DUCSU elections. 
In the wake of this, two pieces of information titled 'Chhatra Dal and Shibir attack on DUCSU debate, VC Proctor and more than a hundred injured.' and 'Chhatra Dal attack on DUCSU debate, VC Proctor and more than a hundred injured!!' have spread on social media.

Headline_English: Advisor Nahid made the comment titled "Relations with Pakistan are getting better than with India"
Content_English: Claims have been circulating on social media platform Facebook, with Information and Broadcasting Advisor Nahid Islam saying, "Relations are getting better with Pakistan than with India."

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus commented on the topic "Sheikh Hasina is the right person for this country."
Content_English: A video circulating on the internet claims that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government, went live and made a comment titled "I made a mistake in taking responsibility for this country. It is impossible for me to run the country. Sheikh Hasina is the right person for this country."

Headline_English: Advisor Asif commented that reforms may take 10-15 years
Content_English: During a conversation with journalists on December 24, Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan, the interim government's sports advisor, made a comment titled "We will move towards an election only after implementing the reform program." In light of this, a photocard featuring the logo and design of electronic media outlet Soomi TV was recently circulated on social media, quoting Asif Mahmud and stating, "It may take 10 to 15 years to carry out reforms, then elections."

Headline_English: Donald Trump imposes sanctions on 20 advisers, including Dr. Yunus
Content_English: A video has been circulating on the internet claiming that US President-elect Donald Trump has announced sanctions on 20 advisers, including Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government of Bangladesh.

Headline_English: Andalib Partha commented on the topic, "If advisors Asif-Nahid don't resign, they will be beaten to death."
Content_English: A video has been circulated on the internet claiming that Bangladesh Jatiya Party (BJP) Chairman and former MP Barrister Andalib Rahman Partha has given an ultimatum to the interim government's Youth Development and Sports Advisor Asif Mahmud Sajeeb Bhuiyan and Information and Broadcasting Advisor Nahid Islam to resign, saying, "If Asif and Nahid do not resign, they will be beaten to death."

Headline_English: 9,000 Shibir workers recruited into police force
Content_English: A claim titled '9,000 Shibir workers have been appointed to the police without any notification, training, or examination! Yet no media is reporting this!' has been circulating on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus comments on the issue of paying oil in installments
Content_English: Sheikh Bashiruddin, the interim government's trade advisor, announced the new prices of soybean oil and palm oil after a meeting with edible oil traders on December 9. The new prices of these two edible oils will be effective from December 10. In the meantime, a photo card with the design of the mainstream media Prothom Alo has been circulated on social media, claiming that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the interim government's chief advisor, made a comment titled "Everyone stay calm, we will give oil in installments if necessary" regarding the increase in edible oil prices.

Headline_English: President Shahabuddin comments on Jay to be Prime Minister
Content_English: Recently, a video is being widely circulated on YouTube and social media, claiming that President Mohammad Shahabuddin Sheikh Hasina's son Sajeeb Wazed Joy has been named the next Prime Minister of Bangladesh. The video also claims that Joy himself has expressed his intention to contest the elections in Sheikh Hasina's absence.

Headline_English: Sajeeb Wazed Joy returns home under Trump's security
Content_English: A video has been circulated on the internet claiming that Sajeeb Wazed Joy is returning home under Trump's protection.

Headline_English: Kushtia BNP leader Abdul Majed expelled from the party
Content_English:
A press release signed by Nationalist Party-BNP Senior Joint Secretary General Advocate Ruhul Kabir Rizvi has been circulated on social media Facebook, claiming that Abdul Majed has been expelled from all levels of posts, including the member of the Kushtia District BNP Convening Committee, due to his involvement in extortion, violation of party discipline, and immoral activities that go against the party's principles, ideals, and solidarity. 
The alleged press release states, "Abdul Majed has been expelled for life from all levels of posts, including the member of the Kushtia District BNP Convening Committee, due to his involvement in extortion, violation of party discipline, and immoral activities that go against the party's principles, ideals, and solidarity."

Headline_English: Selina Hayat Ivy released on bail
Content_English:
On May 8, the police arrested former Narayanganj City Corporation Mayor Selina Hayat Ivy from her house at 6 am the next morning after conducting an overnight raid. Then, on May 12, the court rejected her bail and ordered her to be sent to prison. 
Recently, a message titled 'Selina Hayat Ivy has been released on bail' has been circulating on social media. 

In addition, a photo card with the design of Jamuna Television has also been circulated with the same claim.

Headline_English: Jaima Rahman ranks first in the world in the political science exam
Content_English: "Alhamdulillah, Jaima Rahman has passed the political science exam at the University of London, ranking number one in the world," a message has been circulating on social media platform Facebook.

Content_English:

Headline_English: Former Prime Minister Khaleda Zia laid the first foundation stone of the Padma Bridge
Content_English: During an interaction with journalists at the Thakurgaon Press Club on Sunday (June 5), BNP Secretary General Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir claimed that former Prime Minister Begum Khaleda Zia laid the first foundation stone of the Padma Bridge.

Headline_English: Demand for Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina to travel to the United Arab Emirates to appear in the case
Content_English: Recently, a piece of information titled "Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has gone to the United Arab Emirates to appear in a money laundering case" has been circulating on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Obaidul Quader made a comment titled 'Sheikh Hasina has mistakes and shortcomings'
Content_English: A video titled "I can say with my hand on my chest that Sheikh Hasina has made mistakes, the current situation in all four directions, the current crisis" has gone viral on social media platforms Facebook and YouTube.

Headline_English: All types of vehicular traffic closed from December 8 to 10 due to repairs on the Jamuna Bridge

Headline_English: Taslima Nasrin says fasting should be banned in Bangladesh
Content_English:
Muslim fasting is more about subjugation than freedom. Recently, the Chinese government banned fasting in Muslim-populated areas of China. This ban does not apply to anyone other than government officials, Communist Party leaders, workers, and students. It is understandable that students should not fast for health reasons, and since there is a requirement for Communist Party leaders and workers to believe in communism and atheism, they should not fast either. But not all government officials and employees are atheists, if they want to fast, why should they be prevented from fasting? The government must be trying to explain that since fasting makes the body tired, it will disrupt government work during the day. But why shouldn't many people who can work tirelessly even while fasting have the right to fast? Not all fasting people sit in the office and relax! I condemn this ban by the Chinese government. 
In China, it is not that Muslims do not have the freedom to fast. Regardless of religion, race, or gender, no one has the right to freedom of speech or expression in China. No one has the right to criticize the government. Writers and journalists are also forced to keep their mouths shut. None of China's newspapers and magazines can express opinions other than those of the government. People around the world condemn China for its anti-democratic and anti-human role. It is also condemned for taking away the right of Muslims to fast. China, however, has said that the Chinese government keeps a close watch on Muslim-populated provinces during fasting to suppress Muslim militants and separatists. The government has said that cafes and restaurants cannot be closed during the month of Ramadan. I am in favor of not closing cafes and restaurants. The Chinese government did not do this badly. Closing cafes and restaurants will make it difficult for non-Muslims. 
Muslim countries are doing the opposite of what China is doing regarding fasting. Just as China does not like fasting, Muslim countries like fasting so much that they are forcing people to fast. In some countries, if you don't fast, you have to be punished. If you don't fast, it is forbidden to eat or drink anything outside. Many Muslims want to fast, but they can't fast due to illness. They have to take medicine, eat regularly, and there may be no cooking facilities at home. Where will they eat if all the food shops outside are closed? Not only Muslims live in Muslim countries, but also non-Muslims. Why shouldn't they have the right to eat in cafes and restaurants as citizens or residents? Many Muslims don't fast or don't want to fast. Why shouldn't they have the right to drink water when they are thirsty on the street? Eat food when they are hungry? Why shouldn't those who don't believe in religion have the right to go to cafes and restaurants? Religion is everyone's personal matter. Whoever wants to practice their religion will practice it. Whoever doesn't want to practice it, won't. Why should the state or kingdom or society force or compel them to practice religion? If religion doesn't offer a way to freedom, it will only wear the shackles of subjugation? The state is for everyone, not just the majority, but also the minority. It is the government's responsibility to see everyone equally, the majority and the minority. 
In Bangladesh, loud shouting starts from the last night to wake up people. Everyone is woken up by this shouting. Those who do not want to get up to eat Sehri are also woken up. Don't they have the right to sleep? The same can be said about the call to prayer. Once upon a time, when people did not have alarm clocks or mobile phones, the shouting of the neighborhood boys to wake up to eat Sehri might have benefited those who wanted to eat Sehri. Now, in this age of technology, shouting is completely pointless. I believe everyone knows how to set the alarm on their mobile phone. Even if you don't know, it takes two minutes to learn it. 
Those who want to fast have the right to fast. Those who do not want to fast should also have the right not to fast. Every person has the right to be religious, and the right not to be religious. I see that people have all kinds of rights to practice religion all over the world. Not only that, religious people also have the right to condemn those who do not believe in religion. But non-believers have no right to condemn religious believers. If they condemn, they have to be killed, humiliated, implicated in cases, imprisoned, and exiled. 
Scholars of Islam, when praising Islam, always say, --"The Quran says, 'There is no compulsion in religion." For Islam, I think this is the best sentence. But why is this sentence not used in fasting? Why is it not said, 'There is no compulsion in fasting?' If there is no compulsion in religion, there is no compulsion in prayer and fasting. But why don't Muslims practice what Muslims boast about in the Quran? There is no compulsion in religion, Allah has said. Everyone expects that the servants of Allah will follow the advice of Allah. Allah is there to respect the fasting people, they will be seen in the good eyes of Allah on the Day of Judgment. Why do fasting people want to get respect from non-fasting people and non-Muslims? Why should fasting people show respect even if it violates their own human rights? Respect, as far as I know, is mutual. If you respect me, I will respect you. Isn't that right? 
Muslim terrorists started their Ramadan by slaughtering a Hindu priest in Bangladesh. Not only Hindus, but also Buddhists and Christians are being killed. That day, a hijabi girl wearing a burqa was killed because her husband is anti-fundamentalist. No one is safe in Bangladesh today. 
If Islam does not become more liberal, then Muslims will suffer the most. Today, countless people in the world are condemning Muslims. Many no longer trust them. They are shying away and getting scared just by hearing the name Muslim. Muslims are being labeled as intolerant, murderous, and barbaric by some terrorist groups all over the world. Muslims must take the responsibility of liberalizing Islam. Muslims have to prove to the world that they are not terrorists and intolerant, that they do not support militant Muslims, that they believe in forgiveness, generosity, freedom and human rights, that they believe in the right of people to express their opinions. If human rights and democracy are not respected, there is no way to get respect from the sensible people of the world. 
The Chief Minister of West Bengal prays and fasts even though he is not a Muslim. Although we all understand that he does not do these things from his heart, but to get votes from Muslims, but still I do not think that anyone should stop him from praying and fasting. He has the right to follow any religion. Who said that no one has the right to follow more than one religion at the same time? Just as people have the right not to follow any religion, people also have the right to follow one and more than one religion. However, one thing should not be forgotten that in the eyes of the state, those who follow religion and those who do not – both are equally important, both have equal rights.

Headline_English: Black fungus spreading from onions
Content_English: Recently, two news stories titled 'Black fungus spreading from onions' and 'New panic, how black fungus is spreading from onions' were spread on social media Facebook. Black fungus forms when the refrigerator is not cleaned or opened for a long time. They are mainly produced by bacteria and yeast. This can cause food like vegetables, bread, and cheese to go bad. The black fungus that is usually seen on onions is called Aspergillus niger. This fungus is found in the soil. The fungus that causes black fungus is called mucormycosis. Mucormycosis is a fungus that forms on onions or when food is kept in the refrigerator for a long time, says Nasim Gaur, a scientist at the International Center for Genetic Engineering and Biotechnology. He said, "Some bacteria grow inside the refrigerator and on wet walls. Such as black fungus, bacillus and acinetobacter; which enter the body with food. This can cause some diseases."

Headline_English: Jatiya Party boycotts election and Election Commission declares election null and void
Content_English: On January 1, a YouTube channel named HN tech 75 posted a video using the thumbnail titled 'Jatiya Party boycotts elections, EC declares election null and void'.

Headline_English: Jatiya Party withdraws candidates from across the country and joins BNP

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan and Mahia Mahi were killed
Content_English: Recently, an account named Sumon Hosen on the short video sharing platform TikTok spread information stating that Bangladeshi cricketer and Awami League nominated candidate for Magura-1 constituency Shakib Al Hasan and actress and independent candidate for Rajshahi-1 constituency Mahiya Mahi were killed for participating in the upcoming 12th National Parliament elections.

Headline_English: CEC cancels election and announces re-election
Content_English: The day after the 12th National Parliament election held on January 7, i.e. yesterday (January 8), a video was broadcast on a YouTube channel called Sabai Sikhi with the title and thumbnail "CEC cancels election in front of Khaled Muhyiddin, announces re-election."

Headline_English: US demands caretaker government in Bangladesh, deadline looms
Content_English: A video titled 'The United States has given the Awami League government a deadline to form a caretaker government' is being circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Footballers Messi and Neymar are members of the “Illuminati” secret society
Content_English:
A collage photo focusing on two specific tattoos on the arms of Argentinean footballer Lionel Messi and Brazilian footballer Neymar Jr. has gone viral. It is being claimed that this specific tattoo is a symbol of a secret society called “Illuminati” and that both Messi and Neymar are members of the Illuminati. 
There have been many articles written in newspapers and magazines about Messi and Neymar’s tattoos. Messi’s right hand tattoo is drawn like the eyes of his wife Antonella Roccuzzo. Similarly, Neymar’s left hand tattoo is also drawn like the eyes of his baby son Davy Lusa. Messi and Neymar’s tattoos are related to the secret society Illuminati. 

This collage photo has been seen on Facebook since the end of the final match of the Copa America competition at 8 am on July 11, Bangladesh time. Two pictures of Messi and Neymar have been placed side by side and titled with the logo of a secret organization called “Illuminati”, which is the one-eyed symbol of the Antichrist, which is used by members of the Illuminati. 
In a post published on the Facebook group called Brazil Vs Argentina, the caption of this picture says, 
O Muslim youth, the name of the biggest tribulation currently destroying faith is the name of the Dajjal fitna. The name of the advance organization of the Antichrist is the Illuminati. Whose members use one eye as devotees of the Dajjal. The symbol of the Illuminati is one eye. If you don’t believe me, search on Google by typing Illuminati. Wikipedia states, “The Illuminati derive their interests from the worship of Satan. According to Jewish conspiracy theories, the Illuminati’s one-eyed symbol proves that the Illuminati is the organization that is paving the way for the arrival of the one-eyed Dajjal (or 666 or Antichrist according to the Bible).” 

O Ummah of Muhammad, your favorite players Messi-Neymar are members of that one-eyed Dajjal. Yet, are you also falling into this terrible trap of the Illuminati members? Are you also their devotee?

Headline_English: Honors-Masters courses in private colleges to be closed - Education Minister
Content_English:
Recently, several online portals published a news titled “Honours-Masters in private colleges are finally being closed.” The Education Minister also said, “All colleges will be closed completely. As part of the plan to increase vocational education, Honours-Masters will be gradually closed at the private college level, said Education Minister Dipu Moni. He said, “Various types of short courses, diploma courses will be conducted. Which will be more work-oriented, self-employment, and suitable for creating entrepreneurs.” 

The said viral news said, “Various short courses and work-oriented diplomas are being started in private colleges to increase self-employment and create entrepreneurs. And this will stop the Honours-Masters level education in the colleges.”

Headline_English: Tk 50 crore allocated from Prime Minister's Relief Fund in Obaidul Quader's name
Content_English: A picture of a bank check is being circulated on social media Facebook with the claim, "Prime Minister's relief fund looted, Tk 50 crore allocated for Quader's travel luxury."

Headline_English: UN sanctions Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: Breaking News. Hasina's final destination in America. A video titled "UN sanctions on the Prime Minister" is being circulated on YouTube.

Headline_English: Chance to win Tk 10,000 as Walton anniversary gift
Content_English: Recently, a website link was promoted claiming that one could win 10,000 taka as a Walton anniversary gift by answering a few questions.

Headline_English: On the occasion of reaching 130 million subscribers, bKash is giving a bonus of 1300 taka to every customer.
Content_English: A claim titled "Special Bonus on the Occasion of 130 Million Subscribers | To celebrate bKash's extraordinary milestone, every subscriber is getting a free bonus of Tk 1,300—without account verification or any charges!" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Bkash offers Tk 20,000 bonus to everyone on the occasion of Eid-ul-Azha
Content_English: The holy Eid-ul-Azha will be celebrated in Bangladesh on June 7. In this context, recently, a claim titled, "On the occasion of the upcoming Eid-ul-Azha, bKash is giving a bonus of Tk 2000 to all bKash customers! All those who have a bKash account will get this offer." has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Account holders are being given a cash bonus of 5000 taka upon filling out the form.
Content_English: Recently, a claim titled “All those who have cash are getting a bonus of 5000 taka absolutely free!” has been circulating on social media. It has also been claimed that the money can be withdrawn to one’s account by filling out a form.

Headline_English: All citizens to be given an allowance of 1,400 taka on the occasion of New Year
Content_English: A demand titled 'New Year allowance of 1,400 taka for all citizens of the country' has been circulated on social media, Facebook, on the occasion of the Bengali New Year on April 14th.

Headline_English: On the occasion of Eid-ul-Fitr, bKash is offering a Tk. 45,000 Eid greetings to everyone.
Content_English: The month of fasting, Ramadan, is underway. According to the Dubai Astronomical Group of the United Arab Emirates, Eid-ul-Fitr may be celebrated on March 31 in the United Arab Emirates this year. Eid is usually celebrated in Bangladesh a day after the Middle East. Accordingly, Eid-ul-Fitr may be celebrated in Bangladesh on April 1 this year. In view of this, recently, “On the occasion of the upcoming Eid-ul-Fitr, bKash is giving Eid Salami Bonus to all bKash customers! To celebrate this special day, bKash is giving Eid Salami Bonus of 45,000 Taka to all bKash customers!” and “You have received a bonus of 45,000 Taka on the occasion of Eid” has been spread on social media.

Headline_English: 100 GB free internet offer for Ramadan
Content_English: A piece of information titled "100 GB free internet on the occasion of Happy Ramadan! I got it too, you can take it too" has spread on social media, especially messaging platforms.

Headline_English: Aarong's gift of 5,000 taka on the occasion of Ramadan
Content_English: The holy month of Ramadan for Muslims began in Bangladesh on March 2 following the sighting of the moon. On this occasion, a link to a website claiming that clothing manufacturer and marketing company Aarong is offering a chance to win 5,000 taka through a question and answer session has been circulating on various social media, especially messaging platforms.

Headline_English: Bkash gives Tk 8,999 bonus to customers on the occasion of reaching 80 million subscribers
Content_English: A claim has spread on the internet that mobile money transfer (MFS) service provider bKash is giving a bonus of Tk 8,999 to its customers on the occasion of reaching 80 million subscribers.

Headline_English: Government grants Tk 5,300 to everyone in the country on the occasion of Shab-e-Barat
Content_English: On the evening of January 30, the National Moon Sighting Committee meeting at the Baitul Mukarram meeting room of the Islamic Foundation decided that the holy Shab-e-Barat will be celebrated on the night of Friday, February 14. In light of this, a claim titled "On the occasion of the upcoming holy Shab-e-Barat, the government is giving a grant of 5,300 taka to everyone in the country, which will be paid directly to bKash" has recently spread on social media.

Headline_English: Bkash to get 15,000 taka bonus on its 15th anniversary
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on social media that mobile phone-based money transfer (MFS) service provider bKash is giving a bonus of Tk 15,000 to everyone on the occasion of its 15th anniversary.

Headline_English: Dr. Yunus is giving a citizen's allowance of 4000 taka to everyone.
Content_English: A claim titled "Dr. Yunus is giving a citizen allowance of Tk 4,000 to everyone in the current situation in the country" has been spread on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: 100 GB free data for Christmas and New Year
Content_English: Recently, an information offering 100 GB of free data on the occasion of Christmas and New Year is being circulated on various internet platforms.

Headline_English: 30GB free internet offer to celebrate Sheikh Hasina's resignation
Content_English: Sheikh Hasina resigned from the post of Prime Minister and left the country in the face of a mass uprising by students and the public on August 5. Later, based on the demands of the coordinators of the student movement against discrimination, an interim government was formed with Nobel Peace Prize winner Dr. Muhammad Yunus as its chief advisor. In this incident, mobile phone operating company Grameenphone announced to provide completely free internet service on August 9 and 10.

Headline_English: Gambling app involving cricketer Mushfiqur
Content_English: Recently, a video claiming to show cricketer Mushfiqur Rahim promoting Shakib Al Hasan's alleged gambling app has been circulated on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Shakib Khan is a gambling app called 'Banger Casino'
Content_English: A video of Shakib Khan promoting a gambling app has been circulated on social media platform Facebook. In the video, Shakib Khan is seen talking about earning a lot of money by downloading an app called 'BANGER CASINO'.

Headline_English: 9 crores found in old 1 taka coin
Content_English: For the past few years, a message titled "You can also get 9 crore taka if you have an old 1 taka coin!" has been circulating on social media platform Facebook. Recently, the same claim is being circulated on social media platform Facebook again.

Headline_English: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's gift of 5,000 taka to all citizens of the country
Content_English: Recently, a message using Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina's photo and claiming, "I am giving away 5,000 taka to everyone in the country. Click here to get the money," has been circulating on social media Facebook.

Headline_English: Prime Minister's free laptop distribution campaign
Content_English: A campaign link to provide free laptops to financially constrained people titled "PMYP Prime Minister Laptop Scheme 2024 has started accepting applications" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Prime Minister gifts Tk 10,000 each to 3.6 million families on the occasion of the upcoming Eid
Content_English: A claim titled "3.6 million families will receive the Prime Minister's Eid gift of 10,000 taka" has been circulating on social media.

Headline_English: Islami Bank launches campaign to give away 80,000 taka gifts on the occasion of Ramadan
Content_English: A campaign link titled "Islami Bank Bangladesh Limited – Ramadan gifts" has been posted on social media platform Facebook and copied, sent and forwarded through messages on various messaging apps.

Headline_English: DU's 'A' unit question paper leaked
Content_English:
The Faculty of Science (Unit A) exam of the undergraduate program of Dhaka University for the 2023-24 academic year was held on March 1 from 11 am to 12:30 pm. 

Earlier, at 9 am on the same day, a post (archive) published on Facebook by an account named Foysal Ahamed Joy (archive) claimed, “I gave the questions of Dhaka University Admission Test ‘A’ Unit’ for free 2 hours before the exam and it will be 100% common. You will never get questions without money. I have never given any questions to anyone without advance money and I will never give them. I was saying that I will give something free a while before the exam, this is enough to prove it. Those who need 100% common questions of any university admission test including Dental, RU, CU and Guchh, please contact me inbox. Those who have fixed money and understand less Bengali, please do not block them with unnecessary messages.”

Headline_English: Free internet from all SIM operators on the occasion of English New Year
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on social media that all SIM operators have offered free internet on the occasion of the English New Year.

Headline_English: Bkash users get Tk 7,999 bonus on the occasion of reaching 7 crore subscribers
Content_English: A claim has been made on social media platform Facebook that bKash is giving a bonus of 7999 taka to all users on the occasion of bKash reaching 70 million subscribers.

Headline_English: Prime Minister offers free 50GB internet ahead of upcoming elections
Content_English: A message titled '50 GB MB Free' from Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina has been circulating on social media platform Facebook on the occasion of the upcoming 2024 elections.

Headline_English: Unimart gives away 30,000 taka on Mother's Day
Content_English: A claim titled "Unimart is giving away a prize of 30,000 taka on the occasion of Mother's Day" and a related link have been circulating on the internet.

Headline_English: RFL Company is giving away 30,000 taka prizes on the occasion of Mother's Day
Content_English: Recently, a claim went viral on the internet that RFL Company is giving away gifts worth Tk 30,000 on Mother's Day.

Headline_English: Campaign to win 10,000 taka through Q&A from Ispahani
Content_English: A campaign link titled “Ispahani Mirzapore Tea 200th Anniversary Tea Subsidy. Through the questionnaire, you will have a chance to get 10000 taka” has been spread on social media platform Facebook.

Headline_English: Realme phone sale offer at half price
Content_English: A website called 'realme.pro' and a Facebook page called 'Realme Bangladesh' are promoting offers to sell several models of mobile phones from popular Android mobile manufacturer Realme at less than half the fixed price.

Headline_English: 50 GB free internet on the occasion of WhatsApp's 10th anniversary
Content_English: A campaign link titled "Free 50GB (All Networks) Valid for 90 Days to Celebrate WhatsApp Anniversary" has been circulating on WhatsApp and Facebook.

Headline_English: Campaign to win 5,000 taka from Aarong on the occasion of its 35th anniversary
Content_English: A campaign link titled “Aarong 35th Anniversary Celebration! Through the questionnaire, you will have a chance to get 5000 taka” has been circulating on social media platforms WhatsApp and Facebook.

Headline_English: Udichi artist group chants 'Jai Modiji' slogan
Content_English: A video has been circulated on social media. In the video, a section of the Udichi artist group is seen chanting slogans. The caption attached to the video claims that they are chanting 'Jai Modiji' in exchange for receiving donations from India.

Headline_English: Only 6.1 million taka worth of books sold at the 2025 book fair
Content_English:
The Amar Ekushey Book Fair-2025 was held at the Bangla Academy and Suhrawardy Udyan premises throughout February. The curtain fell on this month-long book fair on February 28. In view of this, an account of the books sold at this year's book fair has been spread on social media. According to the claim spread, the amount of book sales this year is the lowest in history. According to the claim, only 61 lakh 65 thousand 593 books were sold in 27 days, which is unprecedentedly less than the previous year. 

The claim further mentions that in comparison, in 2024, approximately 60 crore books were sold at the 29-day book fair. In 2023, this amount was 47 crore, in 2022 about 52.5 crore, and in 2020 about 82 crore. Even in 2021, even during the Covid lockdown, the amount of book sales was 3 crore 11 lakh taka, which is more than three times compared to this year.

Headline_English: Bengali is the second official language of Sierra Leone.
Content_English:
Since 2002, almost every year in February, on Martyrs' Day and International Mother Language Day, a demand has been circulating through various media involving the Bengali language and Sierra Leone. It is claimed that Bengali should be the second national language or one of the national languages ​​or the official language or the official language of Sierra Leone. 
In the ninth chapter (page 111) on 'United Nations and Bangladesh' of this year's ninth-tenth grade 'Bangladesh and World Introduction' textbook, Bengali has been mentioned as the second national language of Sierra Leone.

Headline_English: Only 35 books sold at Pakistan book fair
Content_English: The claim that 1,200 sharmas and 800 plates of biryani were sold at a book fair in Lahore, Pakistan, but only 35 books were sold at the same fair

Headline_English: Faizul Latif Chowdhury appointed as Director General of Bangla Academy
Content_English: Following the fall of the Awami League government on August 5, the then Director General of Bangla Academy, Dr. Md. Harun-ur-Rashid Askari, resigned on August 10. Later, a claim was circulated on social media that economist and writer Faizul Latif Chowdhury had been appointed as the new Director General of Bangla Academy.

Headline_English: Senegal abandons French and declares Arabic as its official language
Content_English: A post is circulating on social media Facebook demanding that the African country Senegal abandon French and adopt Arabic as its official language.

Headline_English: The poem "The Dark Night of Sorrow Again and Again" is the last poem written by Rabindranath Tagore.
Content_English: A poem titled "The Dark Night of Sorrow Again and Again" has been circulated on social media platform Facebook, claiming to be the last poem written by Rabindranath Tagore.

Headline_English: Earthquake causes collapse of Nabarun School and College building
Content_English: On November 21, a strong earthquake measuring 5.7 on the Richter scale was felt in various parts of the country, including the capital Dhaka. At least 10 people were killed across the country, including three people, when the railing of the Bangshale building in the capital collapsed. Several buildings in the capital were seen leaning. In the wake of this, several videos of the building of Nabarun School and College located in the Shanir Akhra area of ​​the capital were circulated on the internet, claiming that the earthquake that day had caused the building to lean.

Headline_English: Three Chhatra League leaders die during flood rescue operations
Content_English: Heavy rains and landslides from India have flooded some areas of Feni, Comilla, Noakhali, Brahmanbaria, Moulvibazar, Habiganj and Khagrachari districts. In the wake of this, a photo card with the title "3 Chhatra League leaders drowned while helping in rescue operations in Feni. Buried in a distant village" has gone viral on social media.

Headline_English: Rare pink dolphins spotted on US beach
Content_English: A beautiful and rare pink dolphin has been spotted on Hatteras Beach in North Carolina, USA, with some photos of the pink dolphins recently circulating on the internet, claiming that they were spotted.

Headline_English: Coca-Cola's logo upside down means 'No Muhammad, No Mecca' in Arabic
Content_English: A campaign to boycott the beverage product Coca-Cola over the Palestinian issue is underway everywhere, including on social media. In this context, a piece of information is being circulated on the Internet, claiming that if Coca-Cola's English logo is written upside down, it means 'No Muhammad, No Mecca' in Arabic.

Headline_English: Columbus discovered America.
Content_English:
Columbus was a great, famous explorer, who blessed the entire human civilization by discovering America... 
So what? 
Columbus was actually a tyrant, a mass murderer, a greedy businessman - the 'famous hero' of history and the European colonizers who were responsible for destroying thousands of years of civilization and almost annihilating the indigenous people through brutal torture, murder, and rape during the discovery of America! 
This has been confirmed day by day by researching history and recently by ancient DNA analysis. Since the eighties and nineties, the indigenous people of America and progressive history-lovers have started a movement to celebrate 'Columbus Day' in America, and since then all this information has been coming out. Here and there, textbooks have also been revised, and Columbus Day has been stopped. Instead, Indigenous Day is celebrated on that day in many places. 
Like Columbus, Pizarro did the same with the Incas of Peru, Cortez with the Aztecs of Mexico, and the English colonists with the Powhatans, Pequots, and other indigenous groups of Virginia and Massachusetts in America. The initial capital for the development of capitalism was created primarily through the plunder, murder, slavery, and brutal oppression of these European imperialists throughout the world.

Headline_English: In the textbook: All scientists in the world participated in a survey on Darwin's theory of evolution
Content_English: In the fourth chapter (112 pages) of the 'Science' textbook for grades 9-10 of secondary school, in the paragraph titled "Different theories on evolution or expression," it is stated, "Although Charles Darwin is called the father of biological evolution, some questions still remain about his theory. Scientists are conducting research to find answers to the questions about his theory. A survey was once conducted among all the scientists in the world, and the subject of the survey was which of the various scientific theories in the world was the greatest. The scientists concluded that the greatest theory of science is Darwin's theory of evolution."

Headline_English: Bangladeshi national arrested in Greece on child rape charges
Content_English: A video circulating on social media X claimed, “A Bangladeshi immigrant, Mohammad Salahuddin Sheikh, has been arrested in Greece on charges of raping a 9-year-old Christian minor. They are spreading obscenity around the world.”

Headline_English: News about Indian media's 'failed coup' against Bangladesh Army
Content_English: Army Chief General Waqar-uz-Zaman returned home on March 6 after a visit to the Central African Republic. In this context, claims are being made on social media, including the Indian media, that the plane carrying the army chief did not land at Dhaka's Shahjalal Airport after his return. It landed at Tejgaon Airport. At the same time, it is also being claimed that there was an attempt to stage a coup in the Bangladesh Army. 11 army officers, including Lieutenant General Faizur Rahman, have been said to be involved in this attempt.

Headline_English: Crores of taka claimed in Binance account of interim government advisor and press secretary
Content_English:
Screenshots of some accounts on the international cryptocurrency trading platform Binance, which are in the names of several advisors to the interim government, press secretaries and leaders who led the July-August movement, have been circulating on social media. These viral screenshots claim that the accounts in the names of the relevant individuals contain a huge amount of Bitcoin, with a market value of hundreds of crores of taka. 
According to the screenshots, the account in the name of the Chief Advisor's Press Secretary Shafiqul Alam has 93.06 Bitcoin, with a market value of about $10 million (Tk 100 crore). Similarly, the account in the name of recently resigned advisor Nahid Islam is claimed to have 204.64 Bitcoin, with a value of $19 million (Tk 220 crore). The account in the name of advisor Asif Mahmud Sajib Bhuiyan has 113 Bitcoin, which is approximately worth $12 million (Tk 130 crore). The list also includes an account in the name of Sarjis Alam, which is said to contain 77.69 Bitcoins, with a market value of approximately $7.76 million (Tk 90 crore). On the other hand, an account in the name of Khan Talat Mahmud Rafi is also claimed to contain 11.09 Bitcoins, with an estimated value of $1.1 million (Tk 13 crore).

Headline_English: UN warns millions could die of AIDS if Trump cuts aid to Bangladesh
Content_English: Indian social media claims that the United Nations has commented that millions of people could die from AIDS if Trump stops aid to Bangladesh.

Headline_English: Bangladesh bans broadcasting of Liberation War-based content in state-run media
Content_English: Recently, several Indian media outlets have reported that Dr. Muhammad Yunus, the chief advisor to the interim government of Bangladesh, has issued an order to ban the broadcasting of content based on the Liberation War on state-run radio and television. The reports claim that the order prohibits the broadcasting of content on the Liberation War genocide on state-run radio and television in Bangladesh, blaming Pakistan for the genocide during the Liberation War, and criticizing Pakistani leaders including Muhammad Ali Jinnah and Zulfikar Ali Bhutto; at the same time, all documents and video footage from 1952 to 1971 have been ordered to be destroyed.

Headline_English: Arakan Army captures Saint Martin's Island
Content_English: A claim has been circulating on various internet platforms that Myanmar's Arakan Army has captured Bangladesh's St. Martin's Island.

Headline_English: Hindus banned from entering government jobs
Content_English: A post was made on January 1 by an X account named Times Algebra claiming that the Bangladesh government has banned Hindus from entering government jobs. The post claimed that the interim government has restricted the recruitment of Hindus to all levels of posts in the Bangladesh Police, from constables. The applications of 1,500 candidates who applied for the posts have also been rejected. In addition, 100 Hindu officers have also been dismissed. The post also claimed that Home Affairs Advisor Jahangir Alam Chowdhury had made a comment in this regard titled “Bangladesh is a Muslim-majority country, so whether it is police or government jobs, Muslims will get priority.”

Headline_English: Interpol issues red notice against Sheikh Hasina
Content_English: A news report has spread through the media and social media claiming that Interpol has issued a red notice against former Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina on December 22 (Sunday).

Headline_English: Four Awami League leaders arrested in India on rape charges
Content_English:
The Awami League government was ousted on August 5 in the face of mass protests. After the fall of the government, many leaders from the Awami League center to the grassroots, including ministers and MPs, went into hiding. Although law enforcement arrested several of them, many left the country and took refuge in various countries around the world, including India. 

Recently, the police of Dawki police station in the Indian state of Meghalaya arrested four leaders of the Awami League and Jubo League in Sylhet from Kolkata. The arrested are Sylhet District Awami League General Secretary and former Zilla Parishad Chairman Nasir Uddin Khan, Sylhet Metropolitan Jubo League President Alam Khan (Mukti), Vice President Abdul Latif (Ripon) and member Ilias Hossain (Jewel). 

Various media outlets in Bangladesh and India have claimed that the leaders have been arrested on charges of rape.

Headline_English: Premier's Vice Chancellor Dr. Anupam forced to resign for being Hindu
Content_English: Professor Dr. Anupam Sen, who has been the Vice-Chancellor of Chittagong's Premier University since 2006, resigned in the face of student protests. The Indian media is spreading the news of Dr. Anupam Sen's resignation as a communal incident. It is being claimed that a hardline Islamist group has agitated against him and forced him to resign because he is a supporter of ISKCON and a Hindu.

Headline_English: Air base built with Chinese assistance in Lalmonirhat
Content_English: Recently, some posts going viral on various social media platforms and the internet are claiming that the Bangladesh Air Force will build Asia's second largest air base near Chicken Neck with technical assistance from China.

Headline_English: Those affected by Corona will receive 2500 taka each.
Content_English: On September 8, 2021, an online portal named worldnewsbot.com published a news titled “How Corona victims will get 2500 taka each.” Last year, the government provided 2500 taka each to 50 lakh families affected by the lockdown to control the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic on the occasion of Eid-ul-Fitr. The Bangla Tribune report was about the 2500 taka assistance provided by the government on the occasion of Eid-ul-Fitr to 50 lakh families affected by the lockdown to control the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic last year. “The government is providing 2500 taka each to 50 lakh families affected by the ongoing lockdown to control the spread of the Covid-19 pandemic on the occasion of Eid. The postal department’s mobile financial service provider ‘Nagad’ is sending money to 17 lakh families among the beneficiaries. This is the ‘Prime Minister’s Eid gift’ for the helpless people.”

Headline_English: Forced conversion of Hindus by Jamaat-e-Islami in Lalmonirhat
Content_English: On September 7, 3-4 leaders and activists led by Abdul Ahad Azam, the Ameer of Khuniagach Union Jamaat-e-Islami under Sadar Upazila of Lalmonirhat district, paid a courtesy call on the Hindu community in Kalmati area of ​​Khuniagach Union. Hafez Md. Shah Alam, Assistant Secretary of Lalmonirhat District Branch Jamaat-e-Islami, was present there. At that time, they promised to provide cash assistance to Hindu temples and relief assistance in natural disasters. On that day, the Ameer of Union Jamaat informed the people of the Hindu community present about the ideology of Jamaat-e-Islami and their political philosophy. He read out Article 12 of the organization's constitution to them. At that time, they were made to fill out the membership form prescribed for non-Muslim members and were given a book named 'Non-Muslims and Jamaat-e-Islami' to give them an idea about Jamaat-e-Islami.

Headline_English: Niagara Falls illuminated for Victory Day
Content_English: ‘Canada’s Niagara Falls lit up in honour of Bangladesh’s Victory Day over the weekend’ – a post has gone viral on Facebook since December 6. The picture of the decorated Niagara Falls is claimed to be a picture of Niagara decorated on the occasion of Bangladesh’s Victory Day. On December 6, 2021, at 5:18 am, a picture of the waterfall decorated with red-green lights was first posted on Facebook by the page The Bangladesh defense Analyst under the title ‘Niagra Falls in Canada lit up in honour of Bangladesh’s Victory Day over the weekend’. This post, filled with patriotic sentiments, was shared at least 3,900 times. A video message of Canadians paying tribute to Bangladesh’s national anthem along with the Victory Day on December 16 was released from the official Facebook page of the Canadian High Commission in Bangladesh. Information was given on the lighting of Niagara Falls on the occasion of Victory Day.

Headline_English: Indian Navy rescues Bangladeshi ship MV Abdullah
Content_English: On March 12, the Bangladeshi-flagged ship MV Abdullah was captured by Somali pirates in the Indian Ocean. Amidst the discussions regarding the rescue of the ship and the ransom demand, several Indian media outlets have been claiming since March 15 that the ship has been rescued by the Indian Navy.

Headline_English: Zuckerberg tells everyone to 'chill'
Content_English:
Popular social media platforms Facebook, Messenger, Instagram and Threads have suddenly been logged out around the world. On Tuesday (March 5), Facebook was logged out and session out in various countries including Bangladesh at around 9:30 pm. Those who were logged in to Facebook were also automatically logged out. 
Immediately after this, at 9:39 pm, Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg spoke of hope on another social media platform, Xe (formerly Twitter). He wrote, Chill (relax), wait a few minutes, everything will be resolved.

Headline_English: British billionaire Asif Aziz donates Rs 1000 crore for construction of Ayodhya mosque
Content_English: Recently, a claim has been circulating on the internet that British billionaire Asif Aziz has donated Rs 5,000 crore for the construction of the Muhammad bin Abdullah Mosque in Ayodhya.

Headline_English: Covid-19 vaccine linked to blood clots
Content_English:
On July 7, 2021, Canadian physician Charles Hoff claimed in a video clip shared on social media that most people who receive the COVID-19 vaccine will experience blood clotting problems. However, experts say that Dr. Hoff's analysis is published according to the scientific method, is peer-reviewed (a method of evaluating scientific research) and that blood clots occur after taking the COVID-19 vaccine. Dr. Charles Hoff is also sharing in Bangladesh. In a video posted on Facebook on July 7, 2021, Charles Hoff claimed that the spike proteins produced by the COVID-19 vaccine, which is made using mRNA technology, will help blood clot “microscopically” and spread, causing permanent tissue damage. Hoff claimed that the clot was too small to show up on a scan report, but he detected the clots in a blood test based on the levels of a substance called D-dimer, which is used to understand signs of clotting. 

Health agencies in North America and Europe have confirmed that the Covid-19 vaccine is safe. “I’m trying to gather more data, but from what I have so far, 62 percent of them have evidence of clotting, which means that this blood clot is not rare. It means that most people are getting blood clots and they don’t know it.” 

However, experts told AFP that elevated D-dimer levels are not evidence of blood clots. A D-dimer test can be done by a specialist if a blood clot is suspected. But elevated D-dimer levels are not a cause for concern in vaccinated patients. 
“When you get vaccinated, inflammation often occurs: you have a slight fever, aches and pains. This is proof that the vaccine is working. D-dimer levels can increase as a side effect, but that doesn’t mean that it will cause blood clotting,” Marie-Antoinette Sevestre-Pietri, president of the French Society of Vascular Medicine, said in July.

Headline_English: The waters of two seas never mix.
Content_English:

In one, a white water boat is seen running in green and blue water, while in the other video, a boat with passengers is seen moving in green and blue water. The scene of these two colors of water is also available as still images. The posts claim that the water of the two seas or rivers does not mix here. Most of the posts mention the meeting point of the Mississippi River and the Gulf of Mexico as the location of these two different colors of water, while some posts mention the Gulf of Alaska. 
The 2016 report confirmed the meeting point of the Mississippi River and the Gulf of Mexico as the location of the first video. It is said that the two different colors of water do not mix with each other and called this incident a work of God. This video was recorded in the dead zone of the Gulf of Mexico where the Mississippi River meets. The Mississippi River carries water containing farm manure, soil, and livestock waste into the Gulf of Mexico. This nitrogen- and phosphorus-rich water produces algae, which then alters the water's food chain and causes oxygen depletion. The confluence of the Mississippi River and the Gulf of Mexico is one of the world's largest dead zones, forming every summer.

Headline_English: UNESCO survey finds Bengali as the sweetest and melodious language in the world
Content_English:
The latest report (23rd edition) published in 2020 by the international organization 'Ethnologue', which collects information on languages, lists the 100 most widely spoken languages ​​in the world. Along with this, the organization has listed the languages ​​as mother tongues. According to the organization, there are 7,117 living languages ​​in the world. Among them, Bengali is ranked fifth in the list of world languages ​​as a mother tongue and seventh as a most widely spoken language. 265 million people speak Bengali, which belongs to the Indo-European language group. It is estimated that the number of Bengali speakers will reach 316 million by 2050. 
The status of Hindi, the national language of neighboring India, as a mother tongue is sixth after Bengali. Urdu, the national language of neighboring Bangladesh, Pakistan, is 18th. In addition, the Lahanda language of Pakistan is ranked 10th in the list of world languages, and the positions of Telugu, Marathi and Tamil languages ​​of India are 15th, 16th and 20th respectively. The other top ten languages ​​in the list of most widely used languages ​​are Mandarin (Chinese), English, Spanish, French, Arabic, Russian, Portuguese and Indonesian. 

The national language of Bangladesh is Bengali. Article 3 of the Constitution of Bangladesh mentions Bengali as the national language. Bengali is the main language used in Tripura and West Bengal, India. A large number of Bengali-speaking people live in the Cachar districts of Bihar, Odisha and Assam. Bengali is the administrative language of West Bengal and Tripura. Bengali is also one of the administrative languages ​​of Cachar district. Bengali is one of the 18 languages ​​listed in the Eighth Schedule of the Indian Constitution. Bengali is being used in the US Department of Justice and the Immigration website. Announcements are made in Bengali at Heathrow Airport in the UK. 

Meanwhile, according to a 2010 survey conducted by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO), ‘Bangla’ is the sweetest language in the world. After it, ‘Spanish’ and ‘Dutch’ are the second and third sweetest languages, respectively. Even after so many years, the results of that survey have not changed. The Bengali language is truly as sweet as the mother tongue. What concession can be made for such a sweet language? That is why the Bengali-speaking people of this town did not hesitate to shed their blood. 

Today is the seventeenth day of February, the month of language. In 1952, the day was Sunday. On this day, Muslim League leader Sardar Abdur Rab Nishtar, while addressing a meeting in Lahore, said, 'I firmly say that only Urdu will gain the status of the national language in Pakistan.' At the same time, the Governor of the State Bank of Pakistan, Zahid Hussain, proposed the introduction of Urdu checks in the State Bank. 

One of the organizers of the language movement, Dr. Ahmed Rafiq writes in his book titled ‘Language Movement, History and Northern Influence’, ‘On the one hand, when the atmosphere was heated in the provincial capital Dhaka and other major cities and towns of East Bengal due to the demand for language, some of the Muslim League leaders did not hesitate to give speeches and statements in favor of Urdu as the state language. Perhaps they thought that this would reduce the language fever in East Bengal to some extent.’ 

The second chapter of the widely read memoir ‘Satyababu Mara Jhet’ written by renowned journalist and writer Faiz Ahmed is ‘If the Cow’s Hump is Language’. In that chapter, Faiz Ahmed highlighted the inevitability and intellectual strategy of the language movement. He writes, ‘Shortly after the establishment of Pakistan, in the early fifties, the conflict between two rival trends in the field of literature and culture in East Bengal became clear. If progressive and democratic cultural activists and groups of poets and writers had not come forward to establish themselves amidst certain strong opposition, perhaps thirty years later a declining, alien character would have been seen in today's Bangladeshi literature and culture. Those who stood up against the foreign orientation of the reactionary circles in the fields of language, literature and culture were a handful compared to the powerful forces under government patronage.

Headline_English: 101-year-old woman gives birth to baby
Content_English:
An old woman has created a stir by giving birth to a child at the age of 101. Her skin is sagging, her body is fragile. 
At this age, when no one is able to take care of themselves, a cute son has come to the arms of Anatolia Vartadella from Italy. However, this centenarian has become a mother through an ovary transplant and is embroiled in controversy. 
According to European law, ovary transplant is illegal. However, Anatolia said that she gave birth to her child in a private hospital in Turkey. Ovary transplant is legal in Turkey. However, she did not want to reveal the name of the clinic where she gave birth to the child. She said, I am grateful to the doctors who performed my surgery. For so long, I felt unnecessary to my God. Since I was diagnosed with ovarian cancer at the age of 48, I have not been able to give birth to any more children. Sometimes I thought that God was punishing me for giving birth to only 16 children. But by the grace of God, I was able to become a mother again. The 17th child came to my lap. Anatolia cried as she spoke. Her doctor, Alessandro Popolici, said that she had given birth to a beautiful baby. Of course, this is a gift from God. This surgery is completely legal in Turkey and was performed by specialist doctors. Even at this age, she is in good health. Hopefully, she will live for many more years. Anatolia's husband died in 1998. While searching for a sperm donor on the Internet, this old woman contacted a 26-year-old Catholic man. That was enough for her. She just wanted her child to be accepted by the Catholic Church. 

She said that she did not marry the father of her child Francesco. That young man will not have any role in her child's life either. She wrote to the Pope to inform him of this. She also named the child after the Pope. She said, "I believe that the Pope will forgive me. I still love my dead husband. I want to live as his widow for as long as I live." The oldest mother was saying these words while holding her newborn in her arms. 

Anatolia holds the record for the oldest mother in the world. Until now, this record was held by Malegwale Ramokgopa of South Africa. The woman gave birth at the age of 92. 101-year-old Anatolia has broken her record.

The notification said that an order of the High Court Division of the Supreme Court in Writ Petition No. 4515/2022 has been issued to immediately stop obscenity, nudity, DJ parties, indecent behavior, cruel and prohibited activities and bullying in the name of celebrating 'Rag Day' in all educational institutions of the country. He also said that this directive has been given to private universities to implement and enforce the High Court's directive. Similar instructions will be given to public universities on Tuesday (July 5). 

Earlier, on April 7, Supreme Court lawyer Mohammad Kamrul Hasan filed a writ in the High Court seeking an order to stop 'DJ parties, bullying, nudity, obscenity, crazy, ugly and objectionable activities' in educational institutions in the name of celebrating 'Rag Day'. Later, on April 17, the High Court ordered to stop bullying, nudity and obscene culture in educational institutions within 30 days in the name of Rag Day.

Headline_English: Three economists win Nobel Prize in economics for showing way to avoid bailouts
Content_English:
Former Federal Reserve Bank of the United States Chairman Ben S. Bernanke, University of Chicago professor Douglas W. Diamond and University of Washington professor Philip H. Debwig have won the Nobel Prize in Economics this year for their research on banking and financial sector crises. The Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences announced the names of this year's Nobel laureates in economics on Monday. 

The reason for their award, according to the Nobel Prize.org website, is that modern research on banking has shown how to protect the banking system during crises. It has also shown how financial crises intensify when banks collapse. And these three economists—Ben S. Bernanke, Douglas W. Diamond and Philip H. Debwig—initiated these studies in the 1980s. 

To make the economy work, people's savings need to be converted into investments. However, there is a contradiction here. That is, savers want to immediately break their savings in the event of unexpected events. But businessmen and homeowners want a guarantee of repayment within the term, that is, the guarantee that they will not have to repay the loan before the term. Diamond and Debvig have shown how banks can best solve this problem. Banks basically act as intermediaries between savers and investors. That is, they provide savers with an opportunity to withdraw their savings immediately, while also providing long-term loans to borrowers. 

But the fact that banks are serving both parties in this way creates a kind of uncertainty about banks. Rumors are created that the bank may collapse while doing this. When a large number of savers go to the bank to withdraw their savings at the same time, these rumors come close to becoming reality. To avoid this dangerous situation, the government can play the role of a rescuer. That is, the government can emerge as an emergency banker for banks by insuring deposits. 

On the other hand, Diamond has shown that banks can do another important job for society. By acting as an intermediary between savers and depositors, banks are in the best position to assess the creditworthiness of borrowers. And it is also the job of banks to ensure that loans are used for good investments. 

The most severe economic crisis in modern history was the crisis of the 1930s. Ben Bernanke has studied that crisis. He has shown that the economic crisis in the 1930s was deepened and prolonged due to a large number of depositors withdrawing money from banks at once (bank runs). When banks then collapsed, important information about borrowers was lost and could not be recovered soon. As a result, the ability to convert savings into productive investments was severely hampered. 

Tore Ellingsen, chairman of the Prize in Economic Sciences Committee, said, “These three economists have shown us the way to deal with serious crises while avoiding costly bailouts.”

Headline_English: If you can't stand on one leg for 10 seconds, you risk death
Content_English:
You can easily check whether your physical balance is good or not by standing on one leg. 

If you can stand on one leg for more than 10 seconds, then you are physically fit. And if you can't, then the risk of death may increase, according to a recent study. 

According to the study, not being able to stand on one leg for 10 seconds is associated with the risk of death. This study was conducted on 1,702 people. 

Researchers said that the body's balance starts to decrease after the age of 50. As a result, the risk of various problems including falls increases. The participants in the study were asked to stand on a flat platform. Their static balance was measured by standing on one leg for 10 seconds. 

The participants were asked to stand on their left or right leg as desired. A doctor or nurse assistant was next to them to prevent falls or injuries. 

The participants kept their elbows extended while standing and their gaze was fixed on a point 2 meters away. What was found in the study? 

The study found that the elderly were more likely to be among those who could not stand on one leg for 10 seconds. Among those aged 51-55, 4.7 percent were unable to complete the task. Among those aged 71-75, the rate was 50 percent. 

The study found that middle-aged and older participants who were unable to complete the task had a lower chance of survival and an 84 percent higher risk of all-cause mortality. 

According to statistics, about 684,000 people worldwide die from sudden falls due to poor balance. Of these, more than 80 percent are in low/middle-income countries. 

According to the World Health Organization (WHO), people over 60 years of age are the most likely to die from falls. 

The World Health Organization also says that more than 80 percent of deaths from falls occur in low- and middle-income countries. 

Where the Western Pacific and Southeast Asian regions have a mortality rate of 60 percent. 

Although experts say that maintaining physical balance depends largely on activities of daily living, exercise interventions can improve balance, researchers say. 

WHO even recommends functional training, balance exercises like Tai Chi, to improve balance in the elderly. 
In addition, it recommends home assessments, withdrawal of psychotropic medications, and vitamin D supplementation for the elderly to improve balance and reduce associated mortality.
