Headline_English: Demand to exclude religious education from the new curriculum
Content_English:
Religious education excluded from new curriculum outline 
Dr. AFM Khalid Hossain 
The new curriculum outline from pre-primary to higher secondary level has been finally approved on May 30, 2022. The four-hour meeting was held at the International Mother Language Institute. Religious education has not been provided at any level in this outline. Although values ​​and ethics are included in the curriculum up to the tenth grade, it will be secular. It is not religious education in any way. Students of different ethnic groups in the country will not be able to receive religious education up to pre-university level, this is not only painful for an independent and dignified nation, but also shameful. Any religious person wants their children to receive proper religious education. They never want their children to grow up without religion. Practicing religion is a constitutional right of people. How can they practice religion if they do not have religious education and knowledge? According to statistics, three crore students go to school. Of these, about five million students study in Aliya and Qawmi madrasas. The remaining 25 million students attend schools and colleges. After passing the 12th standard exams, these students will pursue higher education in specialized subjects and disciplines. So, in simple terms, these students were deprived of the opportunity to receive religious education throughout their entire educational life. The path to practicing religion in real life was blocked. If this continues, the number of religious people among the educated people will decrease at an alarming rate in the next 20-30 years. 
Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina gave in-principle approval for the outline of the new curriculum in September 2021. Now, with the official approval of the NCCC of the two ministries, its formalities have been completed. The new curriculum has fixed 10 types of learning areas from pre-primary to 10th grade. These are language and communication, mathematics and reasoning, life and livelihood, society and global citizenship, environment and climate, science and technology, information and communication technology, physical and mental health and safety, values ​​and ethics, and art and culture. There will be no separate books for pre-primary children, teachers will teach them. Apart from this, from now on, students will study the same syllabus up to the tenth grade in the new curriculum. And whether the student will study in the science, humanities or commerce department, that division will be made in the eleventh grade. In the new curriculum, there will be no SSC and HSC exams like now. The SSC exam will be based on the syllabus of the tenth grade only. There will be two public exams in the eleventh and twelfth grades. This exam will be held under the board at the end of each year. Then, the final HSC results will be published by combining the results of these two exams. Education Minister Dipu Moni was the chief guest at the joint meeting held under the chairmanship of Md. Abu Bakar Siddique, Secretary of the Secondary and Higher Education Department of the Ministry of Education. The meeting was attended by members of the NCCC, including Md. Aminul Islam Khan, Secretary of the Ministry of Primary and Mass Education (Prothom Alo, Jugantor, May 30, 2022). 
Seven education commissions have been formed at different times since the country gained independence. Each education commission report clearly narrows religious education. The current Education Policy Formulation Committee has taken special consideration of the reports of the Qudrat-e-Khuda Education Commission of 1974, the Shamsul Haque Education Commission of 1997 and the National Education Policy 2000 Committee (page 2). However, the proposal of the Qudrat-e-Khuda Education Commission was an expression of contempt and ridicule towards religion, religious education and Islam. In fact, the Qudrat-e-Khuda Education Commission is a black document against Islamic ideals. This report was a burning reflection of the ideological poverty of the so-called intellectuals. Many are not surprised but disappointed to see the reflection of the proposal of the Qudrat-e-Khuda Education Commission in the National Education Policy 2009. One of the objectives of the current Education Committee is to create a suitable manpower to create a ‘worldly political environment’ that excludes religion by keeping young students away from religious values ​​and ideal morality. 
‘In the latest National Education Policy formulated in 2010, the Prime Minister gave special priority to religion, science and technical education. The National Curriculum 2012 was written based on this policy. But the education policy formulated in 2010 was not reflected in the National Curriculum. In the National Curriculum 2012, Islamic education was ignored in classes 11 and 12. Islamic education was completely excluded from the science and business branches. And currently, Islamic education is kept as an optional subject in the humanities branch. Till now, this education has been neglected in colleges. Due to this, the Islamic education teachers in colleges have become unimportant teachers of optional subjects. On the other hand, the number of students of this subject has also gradually disappeared and reached the bottom. However, in the 2012-13 academic year, students of all branches - humanities, science and business - in colleges used to take Islamic education as a compulsory subject. Again, in the proposed National Curriculum Outline 2020, the subject 'Islam and Moral Education' was excluded from the board examination of class 10. 
The proposal stated that board examinations would be held for class 10 Bengali, English, Mathematics, Science and Social Science subjects. Class examinations for these subjects would be conducted regularly. There would be a collective evaluation of the subjects. A student's grade would be determined based on this evaluation. In this proposal, 'Islam and Moral Education' was kept out of the board examination as unimportant. This means that students would not need to study 'Islamic Education' to improve their grades. Teachers would also not have much interest in taking class examinations. Because students would never be interested in studying it without the board examination. And teachers would also not give any importance to taking classes on this subject. However, the National Education Policy clearly stated that 'the purpose and goal of education is to help students at the primary and secondary levels develop good character through their own religion and moral education'. But here it is clear that the purpose and goal of education mentioned in the education policy have been disregarded and ignored. The subject of 'Islamic Education' has been completely excluded from the national curriculum. It is noteworthy that no mechanism to reflect the Prime Minister's statement was included in the 2020 curriculum! And the education policy, which states that students should develop a better character through their own religion and moral education, has also been stopped nationally. That is, there is no more opportunity to study 'Islamic education' in schools and colleges' (Professor Dr. Md. Kamruzzaman, Inqilab, Dhaka, June 11, 2022). 
The current education framework will be implemented in phases by 2027. For natural reasons, the entire nation is concerned about this. In our opinion, this framework does not reflect the thoughts, consciousness, cherished culture and heritage of the country's larger population. Bangladesh is the second largest Muslim-majority country in the world. The larger population of this country is religious and non-sectarian. The people will not easily accept the reduction of religious education in the education system. The initiative to introduce a religion-free education system will bring disaster and harm to the country and the nation. Such an education system will be a curse for Bangladesh. The state cannot deprive any citizen of the right to teach, practice and propagate the Islam religion of Muslims, the Sanatan religion of Hindus, the Buddhism of Buddhists, the Christianity of Christians, and the Paharis' own ethno-religious religion. As far as we know, the Education Framework Formulation Committee took the advice and opinions of secular educationists and intellectuals, but did not accept any statements or opinions from scholars or Islamic scholars who are experts in Islamic matters; as a result, the new Education Framework has become one-sided, incomplete and fragmented. It appears that the comprehensive opinion that was needed in the formulation of an important document like the National Education Framework was not taken. According to the recommendation of the National Curriculum Coordination Committee (NCCC), if this education is introduced, the entire nation will quickly face an undesirable situation devoid of ideological values. 
Professor of Kushtia Islamic University Dr. Md. Kamruzzaman said that basically, a group of people have been prejudiced against Islamic education since 2001. At that time, a section of the caretaker government started plotting to destroy Islamic education. They did not touch any of the 10 subjects of class 10. They touched the 100-mark 'Islamic education'. They started a despicable attempt to reduce the 100-mark Islamic education to 50. Everyone in the country knows that the caretaker government's job is only to conduct elections. The government that was in power for three months was not supposed to interfere in this matter. But some Islamophobic individuals who were hiding in that government started conspiring against this education. Their hatred for the 100-mark Islamic education began. Later, due to the protest of the religious people, they could not implement it. This conspiracy against Islamic education did not end there. No one has any headache or conspiracy about any other education. All the headaches and conspiracies are only about Islam and 'Islamic education'. In this continuation of the conspiracy, a new manipulation began in 2013 regarding the school's 'Islamic Education'. At that time, the name of the book 'Islamic Education' was changed. The new name was given to 'Islam and Moral Education'. However, no such name was given to the books 'Hinduism Education' and 'Christianity Education'. Here, two different things were meant by the preposition 'o' between the two names. And the seeds of a manipulation were sown by saying that there was a conflict between the two. Based on this manipulation, the next step of the evil circle was to permanently exclude this education from the curriculum. The circle was 100% successful in implementing their objectives. Currently, in the 2022 academic year, the book 'Islam and Moral Education' has been excluded from the syllabus (Inqilab, Dhaka, June 11, 2022). 
While describing the purpose of education, the author of Encyclopedia Britannica said, 'The purpose of education is to transfer the accumulated knowledge and values ​​of a society.' Spiritual, human, moral and cultural development should be the goal of the education system. Without the ideals and values ​​cherished in the divine consciousness, it is not possible to create an ideal and honest citizen through an education system designed for worldly and materialistic purposes only. The moral lapse in the education system that is devoid of the ideal values ​​prevalent in the West is truly shocking. The currently approved education framework will consider religious education as a whole unnecessary and will destroy its existence over time. What Lord Maclay or Warren Hastings did not or could not do, will be fully effective through this education system. The current education framework has nothing to do with our social and cultural understanding. If religious education is removed from schools and colleges, people will become apathetic to religion. Religious education will become apathetic to life and society according to the new curriculum outline. No education vision that is not in line with the beliefs and understanding of the people can continue. 
We propose that religious education should be made compulsory at all levels of education to create a moral manpower. Religious education should be made compulsory at the secondary and higher secondary levels of general education. We appeal to the government's policy-making bodies to consider our concerns, doubts, proposals and demands rationally. At the same time, we call on the people to speak out against the implementation of this education framework that is against religious education and national values.

Headline_English: Allama Iqbal's daughter-in-law and former Pakistan High Court judge Nasira Javed Iqbal has written a column on the American role behind Imran's downfall.
Content_English:
I saw a post on social media by Nasira Javed Iqbal, a Pakistani lawyer and a former judge of the Lahore High Court of Pakistan. She herself, however, said that she did not post such a post. Of course, who wrote it is not the main point for our discussion. Nasira Javed is the daughter-in-law of Allama Iqbal by family. But the post is important. The post is an explanation of why Imran Khan was recently removed from power. Whoever wrote the post, I think it is important to cite the source to be intellectually honest. 
Imran Khan's removal from power in Pakistan cannot be fully understood by the conflicts in Pakistan's internal politics. Especially, it cannot be understood without excluding the context of the Ukraine war. The main conflict of this war is the collapse of the US-led unicentric world order and the emergence of a multicentric world order. 
The main driving force of the existing world order is the dollar. The global currency and trade system is controlled by the dollar. The dollar is the main medium of exchange in the world monetary system. So how did the dollar become a world currency and where is the current main global conflict centered or the real but abstract battlefield against it? To understand exactly where is the dollar's monopoly and controlling role as a world currency, we need to understand it. That truth has come out in Nasira Javed Iqbal's recent writing. As a result, it has helped us to better understand Pakistan's local conflict in the light of the global monetary system. How empty is the conventional way we understand or pretend to understand politics? All that nonsense is getting lost in this small discussion. 
1. The context of the petrodollar 
We hear and learn the word 'petrodollar' as an insult, but we do not try to understand its meaning. 'Petrodollar' is neither just a dollar nor a combustible substance. The petrodollar is actually an agreement made between King Faisal and President Nixon in 1974. 
. 
According to this agreement, Saudi Arabia's responsibility is to accept the dollar as the sovereign world currency. That is, oil will only be bought and sold in dollars, not in any local currency. The United States wants to ensure that no other currency other than the dollar is used in international trade. The dollar was linked to gold. But in 1971, the United States experienced an economic recession and inflation. Many countries then converted their accumulated dollars into gold after their trade. Then, President Richard Nixon decoupled the dollar from the gold standard. But even after the decoupling of gold and the dollar, the dollar has survived as the world currency because of the agreement to pay the price of oil in dollars. The dollar was decoupled from gold and linked to petroleum. If the Saudi monarchs want to stay in power, they have only one job: to convince all OPEC (Organization of the Petroleum Exporting Countries) countries not to sell oil in any currency other than the dollar or in exchange for gold. As a result, the petrodollar was born and the demand for the dollar increased in the international market, making the dollar a much stronger currency. The dollar became a phantom currency or international currency, made of paper printed by the US mint and petroleum. This relationship between the dollar and flammable substances is known as the 'petrodollar'. The world system is based on the business of this phantom currency system. 
.Lawyer Nafis Javad Iqbal rightly said that in exchange for this, America guarantees the Saudi king that the Saudi family will remain in power as long as they comply with the petrodollar agreement. Also, the exchange rate of the Saudi currency is fixed at 1USD=3.75 SR. No matter what the state of the Saudi economy is, this rate does not fluctuate due to American intervention. As a result, the Saudi currency does not devalue like Turkey or Pakistan. America has always wanted to ensure that no country leaves this system. Iraq and Libya tried to leave, we all know what a terrible situation they faced. 
2. Ruble-Rupee Trade Agreement 
India and the Soviet Union signed an agreement in 1953 to trade with each other in rubles and rupees. That was under the Indo-Soviet Trade Agreement. India would use its rupee to buy goods including oil from India. This would create demand for the Indian rupee and the value of the rupee would increase in the international market. Similarly, the Russian ruble would also strengthen. After the recent US sanctions, India would use its own currency in trade with each other under the old agreement. As a result, there would be no need for the dollar or the SWITZERLAND system. And the demand would increase, and the currencies of both countries would become stronger. 
Following the same idea, Imran Khan, the first Pakistani Prime Minister, signed an agreement between Pakistan and China to use their own currency for trade. This agreement was to buy semiconductors, electrical transformers, and broadcasting equipment. America was unhappy but kept quiet because the agreement did not include oil. It should be remembered here that this agreement was made in 1953, but the petrodollar agreement was made much later, in 1974. 
.3. Imran Khan Context 
If we remember this context of the monetary system, we will be able to understand Pakistan's politics better. He is trying to get out of the circle of American dominance in the world system that is like a millstone. This is very risky for him, no doubt. It is also for Pakistan. But his politics are related to the dignity of the people of Pakistan. Earlier, he has clearly stated that the days of sitting back and forth as the United States says are over. Slavery should end. A group of people must stand on their sense of self-esteem. Coming out of the American dominance and being brave, in 2022, Imran Khan started discussions to buy oil from Russia using rubles and Pakistani rupees. This is the real secret of America's extreme anger. Because if everyone follows Imran's example and starts buying or trading oil without dollars, the dollar will lose its current global dominance and US dominance in the world system will also be shaken. This will weaken America's position as a 'superpower'. 
Imran was the first Pakistani Prime Minister to sign the Pakistani Rupee-Chinese Yuan deal in 2019. This deal included semiconductors, transformers, broadcasting equipment, etc. The US was certainly unhappy with this. But it did not stop it, because this deal did not include oil. Let it go because it did not include oil. The process of signing the Pakistani Rupee-Russian Ruble deal for oil is happening in 2022. Remember, the petrodollar deal was in 1974. As a result, the US cannot allow this deal to happen. Because if other countries follow Imran, the US dollar will weaken and the 'petro-dollar' will collapse. The US economy will weaken. The US is declining as a superpower. If this agreement had been made, Pakistan would have come out of the shackles of American slavery. That is why he had to be removed in a hurry.

Headline_English: Maxwell sued for stealing shoes at wedding
Content_English:
Australian all-rounder Glenn Maxwell will now play for Royal Challengers Bangalore in the Indian Premier League (IPL) as an Indian son-in-law. He tied the knot with Indian-origin doctor Vinny Raman a few days ago. 
Maxwell and Vinny got married officially last week. Earlier, the two were in a love relationship. Only relatives and close friends were present at the wedding ceremony. Earlier, a mehndi party and a song were also held on the occasion of their wedding. Why was Maxwell's shoes stolen on such a happy day! 
Hiding the shoes of the new son-in-law at weddings in the subcontinent is a big joke for the brothers-in-law and sisters-in-law. This happens in almost all weddings. Even amidst tight security, someone takes Maxwell's shoes and hides them like this. Poor Maxwell thought that the shoes were stolen and went straight to the police station to complain. Headline_English: Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina leaves for UAE to appear in case
Content_English:
Travel to Emirates to appear in money laundering case 
Bangladesh's unelected Prime Minister Sheikh Hasina is going to the United Arab Emirates on March 7. But why does she visit this Middle Eastern country so often? It is learned that she is going there to appear in a money laundering and illegal wealth acquisition case. It is worth noting that Sheikh Hasina herself is also an accused in the money laundering case of her daughter's ex-husband Khandaker Masrur Hossain Mitu in the United Arab Emirates along with her daughter Putul. Although she has been appearing in court through a lawyer so far, the court is no longer accepting it. Therefore, Hasina will have to appear in the Emirates in person along with her daughter. However, since she holds a state position, she will probably have to appear virtually or submit her passport. However, there is a fear that the court may block her if she is not satisfied. Ministers and high-level government representatives visit Abu Dhabi from time to time to make this appearance and court proceedings comfortable. Foreign Minister Abdul Momen recently made a mysterious 5-day visit, which achieved almost nothing. 
It is worth noting that in January 2020, Sheikh Hasina's daughter's son-in-law Masrur Hossain Mitu was arrested by the police from apartment number 3013 of Al Nasir-5 Tower in Buhaira area of ​​Sharjah city, United Arab Emirates. A few days before that, 45 million dirhams (which is about 100 million taka in Bangladeshi currency) was suddenly deposited in Mitu's personal account at ADCB Bank from Qatar. After seeing the account of such a large amount of money transferred from the banned state Qatar, the United Arab Emirates used the Money Laundering Unit to conduct an investigation. Because at that time, the United Arab Emirates had severed all relations with Qatar and canceled all kinds of agreements. Later, a search was conducted in Mitu's flat in Sharjah and a laptop, iPad, many phones and SIMs, a large amount of alcohol and drugs were recovered. Mitu's passport was seized, arrested and sent to prison. Later, Mitu's 680 million euros were seized. Many money laundering cases were filed. After admitting the involvement of his wife and mother-in-law with the money, Putul and Sheikh Hasina were made defendants in the case. Mitu was recently released on bail after spending a long time in detention. But before that, Sheikh Hasina divorced Mitu to save her daughter from the case.

Headline_English: Moeen Ali is not the first, these cricketers also did not want to advertise alcohol
Content_English:
Recently, in the IPL, England cricketer Moeen Ali requested that the logo of a liquor company be removed from his jersey because the Chennai Super Kings jersey had the logo of that company. After that, discussions and criticism started. 
Controversial writer Taslima Nasreen has already called Moeen Ali a 'militant'. Her controversial comments have caused a storm of criticism on social media Twitter. 
However, it is not only Moeen Ali who has made such a request in the history of cricket, but also the two Indian superstars themselves have not responded to such a proposal. Virat Kohli did not want to endorse brands like Pepsi and Fair & Lovely in 2017. 
Sachin Tendulkar turned down the offer of a tobacco company. In 1996, that company wanted Sachin to use the company's logo on his bat. 
Besides, Rashid Khan did not want to advertise alcohol brand West End while playing for Adelaide Strikers in the 2017-18 season. 
Imad Wasim refused to wear a jersey with the logo of rum manufacturer Appleton Estate while playing for Jamaica Tallawahs in the CPL in 2016. 

Azhar Ali refused to wear a jersey with the logo of beer manufacturer Tribute Ale while playing for Somerset in 2019. 

Faheem Ashraf refused to wear a jersey with the logo of beer manufacturer Indian Pale Ale while playing for Northamptonshire in 2019. 

Hashim Amla refused to wear a jersey with the logo of beer manufacturer Castle Lager in the South African jersey.

The announced Ramadan package includes 2 kg of flour, 1 kg of sugar, basmati rice, oil, milk, chapati, water, dates, ghee and other items. In which the Pakistani government will subsidize about Tk 350 crore of Bangladeshi taka. 
The prices of daily necessities have been fixed, basmati rice is priced at five taka (10 rupees) per kilogram of Bangladeshi taka, one and a half liters of edible oil is priced at 12.5 taka, 800 milliliters of sherbet is priced at 10 taka, 500 grams of chapati is priced at 25 taka, 1 liter of milk is priced at 10 taka, 1 kg of sugar is priced at 34 taka. The price of 20 kg of flour is priced at 400 taka. A kg of ghee is priced at 100 taka.

Headline_English: Success of Sheikh Hasina government
Content_English:
Although the current government was formed in 2019, these messages compare the data from 2006, i.e. 17 years ago. In 2006, the other majority party in Bangladesh, BNP, left office. It is assumed that the data from 2006 has been brought here for comparison with the BNP government. 

However, several major national and global changes have occurred in this long period of 17 years. In addition, the current government's political party, 'Bangladesh Awami League', has been in power for the past three consecutive terms since 2009, and the last caretaker government was in power for the 2006-2008 term. 

Considering these considerations, we have tried to present the data from 2006 as well as the data obtained around the time of the formation of the subsequent governments, so that it gives some overall idea of ​​the development process. 

As a reference, we have used the data from the Bangladesh Bureau of Statistics (BBS) as well as the information provided by other relevant government institutions. In addition, we have also mentioned the data from international organizations in relevant cases. 

Claim # 1: Unemployment rate 
“In 2006, the unemployment rate was 6.77%. Under the current government, unemployment has decreased to 3.6% in 2023.” Claim # 2: Number of primary schools 
“In 2006, the number of primary schools was only 65,672. Under the current government, it has increased to 1,18,891.” Claim # 3: Tea production 
“In 2006, tea production was 39 million kg. Under the current government, tea production has increased to 81 million kg.” Claim # 4: Salt production 
“In 2006, salt production was 8.54 lakh MT. Tons. Under the current government, salt production stood at 23.48 lakh MT. Tons.” Claim # 5: Availability of safe water 
“In 2006, the availability of safe water was only 55%. Under the current government, it has increased by 43.7% to 98.8% in 2023.” Claim #6: Maternal mortality rate 
“In 2006, the maternal mortality rate was 370 (per lakh). Under the current government, it has decreased to 161.”

Headline_English: Shakib Al Hasan bids farewell to Bangladesh cricket team despite BCB's objection
Content_English:
Among the five pandavas of Bangladesh cricket, Mashrafe bin Mortaza is out of the field. Tamim Iqbal is not seen on the field regularly due to injury. Meanwhile, Mahmudullah Riyad, who turned 35 during the Zimbabwe tour, has said that he will no longer play in the Test format. 
Meanwhile, Mushfiqur Rahim and Shakib Al Hasan have reached the age of 34. 
Naturally, the question arises, how long will the five pandavas continue to serve the country? Because cricketers play until the average age of 36-37. 
Will they be able to play in the 2027 ODI World Cup? They will be 40 by then. 
Shakib Al Hasan revealed when he will end his career in response to such a question. 
In a recent interview with the media, the world's best all-rounder said that he wants to keep wearing the national team jersey as long as his fitness and performance last. He has no problem playing even after reaching the age of 40. 
Shakib said, "Actually, it's difficult to say about the time. I never think about whether I can play for 5 or 10 years. As long as I am fit and have performance, I want to play. Let's see how long it is possible." 
He also said, "All plans are in place until this year. I will plan for next year at the beginning of that year. There are not many games left this year. I missed a lot of games due to the ban. So I will try to end this year very well. I will think about it later, discuss it with everyone, and do what is best."

Headline_English: Bangladeshi youth beaten to death by mob
Content_English: A post from an ex (former Twitter) handle named Radharam Das, operated from India, claimed that a Hindu youth named Kamdev Das was brutally murdered by Muslim mobs in Habiganj district of Bangladesh. Verification has shown that the death of a youth named Kamdev Das in Ajmiriganj upazila was not due to a Muslim mob. The case file mentions that this incident was a love-related murder and all the defendants in the case are Hindus. After a relevant search, a report published on the online portal Dhaka Mail on December 23 was found. It said that the police recovered the body of a youth named Kamdev Das (19) from a pond in the Dighalbag area of ​​Badalpur union of Ajmiriganj upazila of Habiganj around 3:30 pm on December 23, two days after he went missing. The family claims that he was killed over a love-related incident. The deceased's elder brother Yuvraj Das told the media that Kamdev was in a love relationship with the daughter of Shankar Das of the same area. On the evening of December 21, there was a fight and trouble between the two families. Kamdev had been missing since that night. The family members searched for him in various places but could not find him and his mobile phone was also switched off. The same information was also found in a report published in a newspaper on December 24. In this regard, Ajmiriganj Police Station OC (Investigation) Biswajit Pal said, "Kambdev Das was in a relationship with a young woman named Smriti Das. Two days before the recovery of Kamdev Das's body, a village arbitration was held between their two families due to the trouble in this relationship. We have found some evidence in this regard. However, Kamdev Das's family has filed a complaint against Smriti Das's family. No Muslim has been mentioned as an accused in this case.

Headline_English: Sadiq Qayyem with the assassin who shot Osman Hadi
Content_English: A photocard with the design of our country titled “Sadiq Qayem’s number on the call list of the killer who shot Osman Hadi” was circulated on the social media platform Facebook. The poster wrote in the caption, “The reckoning is slowly coming together.” Another photocard is being circulated claiming, “Sadiq Qayem next to the killer who shot Osman Hadi.” See here https://www.facebook.com/share/17vffE2WDd/ https://archive.ph/JK6XX (archive), here https://www.facebook.com/share/p/14SYve3zZoJ/ https://archive.ph/NVK0J (archive) Upon verification, it is seen that our country has not published any photocard or news with the title “Sadiq Qayem’s number on the call list of the killer who shot Osman Hadi” or “Sadiq Qayem next to the killer who shot Osman Hadi.” In fact, with the help of digital technology, the media has copied the design and discussed The photo cards have been created. After observing the discussed photo card, it mentions the logo of the mainstream media Amar Desh and the publication date of 12 December 2025. Based on the above source, a photo card titled “Demand to identify a person in the incident of shooting at Hadi” was found on the Amar Desh Facebook page on 13 December 2025. The photo used in the photo card is similar to the photo card discussed but the title is not. The design of the discussed photo card is not similar to the conventional photo card of Amar Desh and there is also a difference in the font of the writing. Therefore, the photo cards circulated in the name of Amar Desh, linking Sadiq Qayem with the assassin who shot Osman Hadi, are fake.
